articles.title: Canadian Poet Anne Carson Brings Ancient Wisdom to Modern Audiences. Now, She's a Nobel Laureate in Literature

paras.en: Anne Carson has been awarded the 2026 Nobel Prize in Literature for her genre-bending works that range from poetry and ancient Greek translations to collaborations with dancers and musicians.
paras.zh: 安妮·卡森 (Anne Carson) 因其跨流派的作品荣获 2026 年诺贝尔文学奖，作品涵盖诗歌、古希腊语翻译以及与舞蹈家和音乐家的合作。

paras.en: The Swedish Academy recognized the 76-year-old Canadian poet, essayist and translator on October 8 for “her bold and inventive oeuvre that, in playful dialogue with the classical tradition, has created new forms for contemporary literature.”
paras.zh: 10 月 8 日，瑞典学院表彰了这位 76 岁的加拿大诗人、散文家和翻译家，表彰她“大胆而富有创造力的作品，与古典传统进行有趣的对话，为当代文学创造了新的形式”。

paras.en: Throughout her career, Carson has repeatedly taken texts and ideas from the ancient world and made them feel contemporary, using unconventional forms and a modern voice to probe enduring questions about love, loss, desire and identity.
paras.zh: 在她的整个职业生涯中，卡森不断地从古代世界汲取文本和思想，并让它们具有当代感，使用非传统的形式和现代的声音来探讨有关爱、失落、欲望和身份的持久问题。

paras.en: The Nobel Committee for Literature praised Carson’s boundary-defying approach, which has led “to playful and ironic works that move not only between classical and modern poetry but also between different genres and art forms,” chair Anders Olsson said during the award announcement.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔文学委员会主席安德斯·奥尔森（Anders Olsson）在颁奖典礼上表示，赞扬了卡森打破界限的创作方式，这种创作方式“带来了“俏皮而讽刺的作品，不仅在古典诗歌和现代诗歌之间游走，而且在不同流派和艺术形式之间游走”。

paras.en: Mark Carney, Canada’s prime minister, also complimented Carson’s unique style, saying in a statement that by “drawing on ancient traditions with bold imagination and originality,” Carson had “reimagined the classics with wit, imagination and a style entirely her own.”
paras.zh: 加拿大总理马克·卡尼也对卡森的独特风格表示赞赏，他在一份声明中表示，卡森“以大胆的想象力和独创性借鉴了古老的传统”，“用智慧、想象力和完全属于她自己的风格重新塑造了经典”。

paras.en: Carney adds, “She has brought ancient stories to new audiences and transformed the way we think about literature.”
paras.zh: 卡尼补充道：“她将古老的故事带给了新的受众，并改变了我们对文学的思考方式。”

paras.en: Carson’s 1986 debut book-length essay, Eros the Bittersweet, examined the pleasure and pain of desire in ancient Greek literature, while “The Glass Essay,” a long, lyrical poem published in 1995, explored the aftermath of unrequited love and grief.
paras.zh: 卡森 1986 年的处女作《苦乐参半的厄洛斯》探讨了古希腊文学中欲望的快乐和痛苦，而 1995 年出版的长篇抒情诗《玻璃散文》则探讨了单相思和悲伤的后果。

paras.en: The author brought a similarly inventive approach to Autobiography of Red, her 1998 verse novel that transformed the myth of Heracles and the giant Geryon into a coming-of-age story about a gay teenager and his heartbreaking romance. The book has sold nearly 100,000 copies in the United States, according to its publisher. Red Doc>, published in 2013, resumes the story, following the now-middle-aged characters on a road trip.
paras.zh: 作者在她 1998 年的诗体小说《红色自传》中采用了类似的创造性方法，将赫拉克勒斯和巨人革律翁的神话转变为一个关于同性恋青少年和他令人心碎的浪漫的成长故事。据出版商称，该书在美国已售出近 10 万册。 2013 年出版的《红色文档》继续讲述了这个故事，讲述了中年人物的公路旅行。

paras.en: Carson’s work has continued to move freely between poetry, prose, myth and biography. Men in the Off Hours, a 2000 collection of poetry and prose, won Canada’s inaugural Griffin Poetry Prize, while the performance piece Norma Jeane Baker of Troy brought together the stories of two women separated by thousands of years: Marilyn Monroe and Helen of Troy.
paras.zh: 卡森的作品继续在诗歌、散文、神话和传记之间自由游走。 2000 年出版的诗歌和散文集《男人在下班时间》赢得了加拿大首届格里芬诗歌奖，而表演作品《特洛伊的诺玛·珍妮·贝克》汇集了两个相隔数千年的女人的故事：玛丽莲·梦露和特洛伊的海伦。

paras.en: Carson’s 2024 poetry collection, Wrong Norma, a finalist for a National Book Award, ranged from compositions about her father to pieces about snow and Roget’s Thesaurus. The subjects had no obvious connection. “That’s why I’ve called them ‘wrong,’” the poet told the Nation’s Emily Wilson in 2024.
paras.zh: 卡森的 2024 年诗集《错误的诺玛》入围了国家图书奖的决赛，内容涵盖了从有关她父亲的作品到有关雪和罗杰同义词库的作品。受试者之间没有明显的联系。 “这就是为什么我称他们‘错误’，”这位诗人在 2024 年告诉《国家报》的艾米丽·威尔逊。

paras.en: Over the years, Carson has “moved closer to bizarreness for the sake of bizarreness,” Daisy Fried wrote in a 2013 review of Red Doc> for the New York Times. “But she still pulls it off, mainly because the impulse behind it is mischief. ‘Can I get away with this?’ she seems to ask. And she does—because it’s fun. She’s having fun.”
paras.zh: 黛西·弗里德 (Daisy Fried) 在 2013 年为《纽约时报》撰写的《红色文档》评论中写道，这些年来，卡森“为了离奇而离奇”。 “但她仍然成功了，主要是因为背后的冲动是恶作剧。她似乎在问‘我能逃脱惩罚吗？’她确实这么做了——因为这很有趣。她玩得很开心。”

paras.en: Carson has also translated and reimagined foundational works of ancient Greek literature, including fragments by the poet Sappho in If Not, Winter; Sophocles’ plays Electra and Antigone; and Euripides’ The Bacchae. The Nobel Committee praised these translations as “independent works in their own right.”
paras.zh: 卡森还翻译和重新构思了古希腊文学的基础作品，包括诗人萨福在《如果不是，冬天》中的片段；索福克勒斯的戏剧《厄勒克特拉》和《安提戈涅》；和欧里庇得斯的《酒神》。诺贝尔委员会称赞这些翻译是“本身就是独立的作品”。

paras.en: Born in Toronto in 1950, Carson discovered ancient Greek texts in high school and quickly became fascinated with the language.
paras.zh: 卡森 1950 年出生于多伦多，在高中时发现了古希腊文本，并很快对这门语言着迷。

paras.en: “[It] seems different than other languages,” Carson told NPR’s Scott Simon in 2016. “It seems, somehow, more original, more like being in the morning of language. And that’s partly because the words are new. Those people are inventing ways of thinking about stuff, but also because we have thousands of years of building the words into other things, using their words to build out our words.”
paras.zh: 2016 年，卡森对 NPR 的斯科特·西蒙 (Scott Simon) 表示：“[它]似乎与其他语言有所不同。”“不知何故，它似​​乎更具原创性，更像是处于语言的早晨。部分原因是这些单词是新的。这些人正在发明思考事物的方式，但也因为我们有数千年的时间将单词构建到其他事物中，用他们的单词来构建我们的单词。”

paras.en: Carson studied at the University of Toronto, then taught classics at the University of Calgary and McGill University while establishing herself as a writer. As her career blossomed, Carson also held positions at the University of Michigan, Princeton University, Cornell University and New York University.
paras.zh: 卡森在多伦多大学学习，然后在卡尔加里大学和麦吉尔大学教授古典文学，同时确立了自己的作家地位。随着她的职业生涯蓬勃发展，卡森还在密歇根大学、普林斯顿大学、康奈尔大学和纽约大学担任过职务。

paras.en: In 2024, Carson, who rarely shares much about her personal life, revealed that she had been diagnosed with Parkinson’s disease and had taken up boxing to help manage the condition.
paras.zh: 2024 年，很少透露太多个人生活的卡森透露，她被诊断出患有帕金森病，并开始练习拳击来帮助控制病情。

paras.en: “When I try to produce a complicated movement like a one-two-four-five combination in boxing (left jab, right cross, right hook, left uppercut), I can feel the neurons in my brain struggling and striving,” Carson wrote in an essay for the London Review of Books. “Yes, I can feel it.”
paras.zh: 卡森在《伦敦书评》的一篇文章中写道：“当我尝试做出一个复杂的动作，比如拳击中的一二四五组合（左刺拳、右交叉、右勾拳、左上勾拳）时，我能感觉到大脑中的神经元在挣扎和努力。” “是的，我能感觉到。”

paras.en: Carson and her partner, visual artist Robert Currie, live part-time in Iceland, where they gained citizenship in 2022. “She means a lot to the scene here,” Ragnar Kjartansson, a multidisciplinary Icelandic artist, tells the New York Times’ Alex Marshall. “She’s a force, and everyone’s really happy.”
paras.zh: 卡森和她的伴侣、视觉艺术家罗伯特·柯里 (Robert Currie) 在冰岛兼职生活，并于 2022 年获得了冰岛公民身份。“她对这里的场景意义重大，”多学科冰岛艺术家拉格纳·基贾坦森 (Ragnar Kjartansson) 告诉《纽约时报》的亚历克斯·马歇尔 (Alex Marshall)。 “她是一股力量，每个人都很高兴。”

paras.en: When Ingrid Carlberg, the Swedish Academy’s secretary, called Carson to deliver the good news, the poet said she was in Iceland “listening to the wind.”
paras.zh: 当瑞典学院秘书英格丽德·卡尔伯格打电话给卡森传达这个好消息时，诗人说她正在冰岛“听风”。

paras.en: “She was taken by surprise but very happy,” Carlberg said during a livestream of the award announcement.
paras.zh: “她很惊讶，但也很高兴，”卡尔伯格在颁奖典礼的直播中说道。

paras.en: Later, in a telephone interview with the Nobel Prize’s outreach team, Carson reiterated that winning the award “seems a little insane. I think you’re all insane.”
paras.zh: 后来，在接受诺贝尔奖外展团队的电话采访时，卡森重申，获奖“似乎有点疯狂。我认为你们都疯了。”

paras.en: The Nobel committees are announcing the winners of their six award categories this month, starting with the prize in physiology or medicine on October 5 and ending with the economics prize on October 12. Each award comes with a cash prize of 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million).
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会将于本月公布六个奖项类别的获奖者，从 10 月 5 日的生理学或医学奖开始，到 10 月 12 日的经济学奖结束。每个奖项都附带 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元）的现金奖励。

articles.title: Margaret Hamilton, a Pioneering Software Engineer Who Made the First Human Moon Landing Possible, Dies at 90

paras.en: Software engineering pioneer Margaret Hamilton died on September 30 at age 90, leaving behind a trailblazing legacy of problem-solving and entrepreneurship that paved the way for a new branch of computer science and engineering.
paras.zh: 软件工程先驱玛格丽特·汉密尔顿 (Margaret Hamilton) 于 9 月 30 日去世，享年 90 岁，留下了解决问题和创业精神的开拓性遗产，为计算机科学和工程的新分支铺平了道路。

paras.en: Hamilton is best known for her major contributions to the Apollo missions. Her work famously resolved a computer issue that enabled NASA’s Apollo 11 mission to put humans on the moon for the first time.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿因其对阿波罗任务的重大贡献而闻名。她的工作以解决计算机问题而闻名，使 NASA 的阿波罗 11 号任务首次将人类送上月球。

paras.en: “Her coding foresight and prowess really made that mission a success,” Andrew Meade McGee, curator of computing at Smithsonian’s National Air and Space Museum, tells Smithsonian magazine. Her impact goes far beyond the lunar landing, though, and has had long-lasting effects, he adds. “She created the logical software basis for many of the critical systems we use to maintain our infrastructure today, and that silently power today’s modern aerospace world.”
paras.zh: 史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆计算机部馆长安德鲁·米德·麦吉 (Andrew Meade McGee) 告诉《史密森尼》杂志：“她的编码远见和卓越能力确实使该任务取得了成功。”不过，他补充说，她的影响远远超出了登月，并且产生了持久的影响。 “她为我们今天用来维护基础设施的许多关键系统创建了逻辑软件基础，​​并默默地为当今的现代航空航天世界提供动力。”

paras.en: Hamilton was not widely recognized outside of computing and aerospace circles until about 20 years ago, and in 2016, she received the Presidential Medal of Freedom, McGee says. “A generation of coders and young women in STEM came to see her as a pioneer.”
paras.zh: 麦吉说，直到大约 20 年前，汉密尔顿才在计算机和航空航天界之外得到广泛认可，2016 年，她获得了总统自由勋章。 “一代程序员和 STEM 领域的年轻女性将她视为先驱。”

paras.en: Hamilton was born in Paoli, Indiana, in 1936. After earning her bachelor’s degree in mathematics from Earlham College in 1958, she and her husband moved to Massachusetts. Hamilton started working on weather prediction software at MIT with Edward N. Lorenz, the meteorologist who founded chaos theory. This position marked the beginning of her computer programming journey.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿 1936 年出生于印第安纳州保利。1958 年从厄勒姆学院获得数学学士学位后，她和丈夫搬到了马萨诸塞州。汉密尔顿开始在麻省理工学院与创立混沌理论的气象学家爱德华·N·洛伦茨一起研究天气预报软件。这个职位标志着她计算机编程之旅的开始。

paras.en: In 1965, she joined the Instrumentation Lab at MIT, which was tasked with developing the onboard flight software for the Apollo program, with the goal of sending humans to the moon.
paras.zh: 1965 年，她加入了麻省理工学院的仪器实验室，该实验室的任务是为阿波罗计划开发机载飞行软件，目标是将人类送上月球。

paras.en: “I was attracted both by the sheer idea and the fact that it had never been done before. I was the first programmer to join and the first woman they hired,” Hamilton told the Guardian’s Zoë Corbyn in 2019. “Male engineers were already working on the project, but they were hardware engineers, and it wasn’t their thing. I had [software writing] as my background. I think [the lab] just figured that I could handle the unknown.”
paras.zh: “我被这个纯粹的想法和以前从未做过的事实所吸引。我是第一个加入的程序员，也是他们雇用的第一个女性，”汉密尔顿在 2019 年告诉《卫报》的佐伊·科尔宾。“男性工程师已经参与了这个项目，但他们是硬件工程师，这不是他们的事。我有[软件编写]作为我的背景。我认为[实验室]只是认为我可以处理未知的事情。”

paras.en: Hamilton eventually became the lead of the team creating the on-board flight software for the crewed missions and then assistant director in charge of the Command and Service Module team.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿最终成为为载人任务创建机载飞行软件的团队的领导者，然后成为负责指挥和服务模块团队的助理主任。

paras.en: Her signature work in the field was “defensive” programming—computer programs capable of predicting or fixing issues by themselves—and “priority-driven” software. The approach played a major role in the first human moon landing in July 1969. Shortly before the landing module was supposed to reach the lunar surface, alarms sounded from the onboard computer. A fault in a hardware switch had caused the computer to overload, threatening the success of the mission.
paras.zh: 她在该领域的标志性工作是“防御性”编程（能够自行预测或解决问题的计算机程序）和“优先级驱动”软件。这种方法在 1969 年 7 月人类首次登月中发挥了重要作用。就在登陆舱预计到达月球表面之前不久，机载计算机发出了警报。硬件开关故障导致计算机过载，威胁到任务的成功。

paras.en: Thankfully, Hamilton and her colleagues’ priority-driven software turned off unnecessary background tasks to make room for top-priority tasks, and the mission was able to carry on. “I was not concentrating on the mission per se, I was concentrating on the software,” she explained in an interview with Makers in 2017. “All of a sudden, it was like everything you did on Apollo to that point in time, it just all happened in front of you. People say that before they’re no longer here, they see their life. I could see the Apollo life. Just, my god, look what happened. We did it. It worked.”
paras.zh: 值得庆幸的是，汉密尔顿和她的同事的优先级驱动软件关闭了不必要的后台任务，为最优先的任务腾出空间，任务得以继续进行。 “我并没有专注于任务本身，我专注于软件，”她在 2017 年接受 Makers 采访时解释道，“突然之间，就像你在阿波罗上所做的一切一样，一切都发生在你的面前。人们说，在他们离开这里之前，他们看到了自己的生活。我可以看到阿波罗的生活。天啊，看看发生了什么。我们做到了。它成功了。”

paras.en: No issues were ever found in any of the Apollo guidance software overseen by Hamilton, according to the Wall Street Journal’s Robert Lee Hotz. What’s more, Hamilton popularized the term software engineering.
paras.zh: 据《华尔街日报》的罗伯特·李·霍茨称，汉密尔顿监督的阿波罗制导软件中从未发现任何问题。更重要的是，汉密尔顿普及了软件工程这个术语。

paras.en: “I fought to bring the software legitimacy so that it—and those building it—would be given its due respect, and thus I began to use the term ‘software engineering’ to distinguish it from hardware and other kinds of engineering, yet treat each type of engineering as part of the overall systems engineering process,” Hamilton told El Pais’ Javier Pedreira in 2017, per a translation cited by MIT. “When I first started using this phrase, it was considered to be quite amusing.”
paras.zh: 根据麻省理工学院引用的翻译，汉密尔顿在 2017 年告诉《国家报》的哈维尔·佩德雷拉：“我努力争取软件的合法性，以便它以及构建它的人得到应有的尊重，因此我开始使用‘软件工程’这个术语来将其与硬件和其他类型的工程区分开来，同时将每种类型的工程视为整个系统工程过程的一部分。” “当我第一次开始使用这个短语时，我觉得它很有趣。”

paras.en: In 1976, Hamilton founded the software company Higher Order Software. A decade later, she founded her second software company, Hamilton Technologies. She is an author of more than 130 publications, according to MIT.
paras.zh: 1976年，汉密尔顿创立了软件公司Higher Order Software。十年后，她创立了第二家软件公司 Hamilton Technologies。据麻省理工学院称，她是 130 多篇出版物的作者。

paras.en: In 2003, she was honored with a NASA Exceptional Space Act Award for her scientific and technical contributions. Hamilton also won the Computer History Museum Fellow Award in 2017 and the Intrepid Lifetime Achievement Award in 2019, and she was inducted into the National Aviation Hall of Fame in 2022. The Smithsonian’s National Air and Space Museum awarded her the 2025 Michael Collins Trophy for lifetime achievement.
paras.zh: 2003年，她因其科学和技术贡献而被授予美国宇航局杰出太空法案奖。汉密尔顿还于 2017 年获得计算机历史博物馆研究员奖，于 2019 年获得无畏终身成就奖，并于 2022 年入选国家航空名人堂。史密森尼国家航空航天博物馆向她颁发了 2025 年迈克尔·柯林斯终身成就奖。

paras.en: Hamilton was even immortalized in Lego’s now-retired Women of NASA set. She is survived by three siblings, her daughter, son-in-law, two grandsons and four great-grandchildren.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿甚至在乐高现已退役的美国宇航局女性套装中永垂不朽。她身后留下了三个兄弟姐妹、女儿、女婿、两个孙子和四个曾孙。

articles.title: J.M.W. Turner Painted This Breathtaking Roman Landscape Nearly 200 Years Ago. If You Look Closely, You Can Still See His Fingerprints

paras.en: When J.M.W. Turner landed a commission to paint Rome in the early 19th century, his patron gave him specific instructions: He was to capture the city authentically, showing modern life beside the ancient ruins. The piece should be “‘a copy,’ not an ideal picture,” according to an early Turner biographer, and the artist was “particularly anxious to comply.”
paras.zh: 当 J.M.W.透纳在十九世纪初期接到了描绘罗马的委托，他的赞助人给了他具体的指示：他要真实地捕捉这座城市，在古代废墟旁边展示现代生活。根据特纳早期传记作者的说法，这幅作品应该是“‘复制品’，而不是一幅理想的画作”，而这位艺术家“特别渴望遵守”。

paras.en: The patron, Hugh Andrew Johnstone Munro of Novar, kept Rome, From Mount Aventine for the rest of his life. After he died, the painting was purchased by Archibald Primrose, who would later become the British prime minister. It remained with his descendants until 2014, when it sold for $47.4 million, becoming the most expensive Turner ever auctioned.
paras.zh: 赞助人诺瓦尔的休·安德鲁·约翰斯通·门罗在他的余生中将罗马从阿文丁山保留了下来。他去世后，这幅画被后来成为英国首相的阿奇博尔德·普里姆罗斯购买。这幅画一直由他的后代保管，直到 2014 年，它以 4740 万美元的价格售出，成为特纳有史以来拍卖的最昂贵的作品。

paras.en: Now, it’s up for grabs once again. On December 9, the landscape will appear at a much-anticipated Sotheby’s auction, where it’s expected to fetch a record-breaking $66 million. Accounting for inflation, this estimate is about 15 percent higher than the 2014 price.
paras.zh: 现在，它再次可供争夺。 12 月 9 日，这幅景观将出现在备受期待的苏富比拍卖会上，预计将拍出破纪录的 6600 万美元成交价。考虑到通货膨胀因素，这一估计比 2014 年的价格高出约 15%。

paras.en: “As an artist, Turner is at his best when working with a subject that has close personal meaning, and no subject could be closer to his heart than Rome,” Julian Gascoigne, a senior director at Sotheby’s, writes in an essay. “In all my years in the art world, few other works have appeared that are as exceptional as this.”
paras.zh: “作为一名艺术家，特纳在处理具有密切个人意义的主题时处于最佳状态，没有哪个主题比罗马更贴近他的内心，”苏富比高级总监朱利安·加斯科因在一篇文章中写道。 “在我从事艺术界的这些年里，很少有其他作品能像这件作品一样出色。”

paras.en: Nearly 200 years later, the canvas still bears evidence of the Romantic artist’s energetic handiwork: Small hairs from his brush and marks from his palette knife are visible. Viewers can even make out some of his fingerprints. The painting will be sold in its original frame, and it’s one of only two late Turners that remain unlined.
paras.zh: 近 200 年后，画布上仍然保留着这位浪漫主义艺术家充满活力的手工作品的证据：画笔上的细小毛发和调色刀上的痕迹清晰可见。观众甚至可以辨认出他的一些指纹。这幅画将以其原始画框出售，也是仅有的两幅未加衬里的已故特纳作品之一。

paras.en: - “Lining” is a treatment that involves attaching new fabric to the back of a painting to support its original canvas. This process can also cause damage, and it’s been the subject of extensive debate among conservators.
paras.zh: - “衬里”是一种将新织物附着在画作背面以支撑其原始画布的处理方法。这个过程也会造成损害，这一直是保护者广泛争论的话题。

paras.en: - “Lining is a major treatment, which should only be carried out when absolutely necessary,” according to Royal Museums Greenwich. “The 1974 Greenwich Lining Conference sought to broker an international agreement on how and when to carry out the process.”
paras.zh: - 格林威治皇家博物馆表示，“衬里是一项主要处理措施，只有在绝对必要时才应进行”。 “1974 年格林威治衬里会议试图就如何以及何时执行这一过程达成一项国际协议。”

paras.en: Ahead of the auction, the painting went on display in Rome for a few days last week. It will now travel to London, Hong Kong and New York. Mario Tavella, chairman of Sotheby’s Europe, tells Agence France-Presse that he hopes the piece will find its way to a museum “where it could be admired by everyone.”
paras.zh: 在拍卖之前，这幅画上周在罗马展出了几天。它现在将前往伦敦、香港和纽约。苏富比欧洲区主席马里奥·塔维拉 (Mario Tavella) 告诉法新社，他希望这件作品能够进入博物馆，“让每个人都能欣赏到它”。

paras.en: Born in London in 1775, Turner started painting as a boy, and his father proudly displayed his creations in the barbershop where he worked. He was accepted into the Royal Academy at age 14, and he studied paintings and sculptures by famous Italian artists years before he traveled to the country. With time, “his works became more and more expressive,” per the Ashmolean Museum, “with some bordering on abstract as form, and detail became secondary to the mood of the scene.” Today, the so-called painter of light is known for his sweeping landscapes and dramatic colors.
paras.zh: 特纳 1775 年出生于伦敦，小时候就开始绘画，他的父亲在他工作的理发店自豪地展示了他的创作。他 14 岁时被皇家艺术学院录取，在前往意大利旅行之前的几年里，他学习了意大利著名艺术家的绘画和雕塑。随着时间的推移，“他的作品变得越来越富有表现力，”阿什莫林博物馆表示，“有些作品在形式上接近于抽象，而细节对于场景的情绪来说变得次要。”如今，这位所谓的光画家以其广阔的风景和戏剧性的色彩而闻名。

paras.en: “Turner was revolutionary. He broke down the formal structure of the painting and moved toward forms that are looser and more abstract,” Gascoigne tells Artnet’s Richard Whiddington. “It’s a new vision of what painting can be and how we should perceive the painted image.”
paras.zh: “特纳是革命性的。他打破了绘画的形式结构，转向更宽松、更抽象的形式，”加斯科因告诉 Artnet 的理查德·惠丁顿。 “这是关于绘画是什么以及我们应该如何感知绘画图像的新愿景。”

paras.en: Experts aren’t sure exactly when Munro commissioned Rome, From Mount Aventine. According to a statement from Sotheby’s, Turner started working on the painting in the late 1820s, when he traveled to the city and completed five detailed studies. He later finished the scene in London. The landscape shows the Tiber River flowing through the bustling city, which is lit by brilliant yellow sunshine. Turner added a priest and a young girl in the foreground beneath a towering umbrella pine.
paras.zh: 专家们不确定芒罗何时委托《罗马，从阿文丁山》建造。根据苏富比的一份声明，特纳于 1820 年代末开始创作这幅画，当时他前往这座城市并完成了五项详细的研究。后来他在伦敦完成了这一场景。景观展示了台伯河流经繁华的城市，被灿烂的黄色阳光照亮。特纳在前景中一棵高耸的伞松下添加了一名牧师和一名年轻女孩。

paras.en: In 1836, the painting went on view at the Royal Academy, where it sparked heated disagreements. “There was a group of critics who did not ‘get’ him, who thought his coloring was crude and sloppy and didn’t understand his fascination with light and atmosphere,” Gascoigne tells the London Times’ Tom Kington. “Others, however, saw him as a revolutionary genius.”
paras.zh: 1836年，这幅画在皇家学院展出，引发了激烈的争论。加斯科因告诉《伦敦时报》的汤姆·金顿：“有一群评论家没有‘理解’他，认为他的色彩粗糙、草率，不理解他对光线和氛围的迷恋。” “然而，其他人则认为他是一位革命天才。”

articles.title: Inside the Muslim Manosphere Policing Women Online
articles.author: Maysaa Ajjan

paras.en: Mariam recently disabled Facebook Messenger. As the administrator of a Facebook group for women in the United Arab Emirates with close to 400,000 members, she’d become accustomed to receiving messages from strangers. But then came a shift in the volume—and nature—of those messages until they were impossible to ignore.
paras.zh: Mariam 最近禁用了 Facebook Messenger。作为阿拉伯联合酋长国一个拥有近 40 万名会员的 Facebook 女性群组的管理员，她已经习惯了接收陌生人的消息。但随后这些信息的数量和性质发生了变化，直到它们变得无法忽视。

paras.en: “Being the admin of this group has subjected me to all kinds of harassment,” says Miriam, who asked to be identified only by her first name because she fears online retaliation. They “either want to advise you to be holy and cover up, or they want to sexually harass you—or both.”
paras.zh: “作为这个群组的管理员，我受到了各种各样的骚扰，”米里亚姆说。她要求只透露自己的名字，因为她担心遭到网上报复。他们“要么想建议你保持圣洁并掩盖真相，要么他们想对你进行性骚扰——或者两者兼而有之。”

paras.en: Mariam has run the group for more than a year. And even though intended for women, the group’s size and visibility has meant that Miriam also gets a lot of messages from men. She has received a deluge of unsolicited messages telling her how to dress, not to raise her voice or wear makeup, and to cover her hands with gloves so that no skin is visible.
paras.zh: 玛丽雅姆管理该集团已经一年多了。尽管该团体是针对女性的，但其规模和知名度意味着米里亚姆也收到了很多来自男性的信息。她收到了大量不请自来的信息，告诉她如何着装，不要提高声音或化妆，并用手套遮住双手，以免露出皮肤。

paras.en: “I couldn’t take it any longer. It was starting to affect my mental well-being,” Miriam says.
paras.zh: “我再也受不了了。它开始影响我的心理健康，”米里亚姆说。

paras.en: Many women who are conspicuous on the internet have been harassed online. That comes in countless forms, even if the same misogyny underlies it. The particular variety Miriam was subjected to stems from a section of the “manosphere” dressed in the clothes of religion—the Muslim manosphere.
paras.zh: 许多在网络上引人注目的女性都曾遭受过网络骚扰。这有无数种形式，即使其背后隐藏着同样的厌女症。米里亚姆所经历的特殊变体源于披着宗教外衣的“马诺圈”的一部分——穆斯林马诺圈。

paras.en: At its core, the manosphere is built around male grievance and antifeminist ideology—though whether that’s entirely organic or engineered to sell supplements and other products is up for debate. Regardless, it has no shortage of subcultures to chose from: Incels, pick-up artists, men’s rights activists, and followers of the Red Pill.
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，马诺圈是围绕男性不满和反女权主义意识形态而建立的——尽管这是否完全是有机的，还是为了销售补充剂和其他产品而设计的，尚有争议。无论如何，它不乏可供选择的亚文化：非自愿独身者、把妹艺术家、男权活动家和红色药丸的追随者。

paras.en: Some nuances may make these groups distinct, but they largely share a common worldview: Feminism has destabilized society, women have acquired too much power, and men must reassert control. And the Muslim manosphere is no different. It’s adopted those ideas circulating through the wider manosphere and rebranded them in the language of faith.
paras.zh: 一些细微差别可能使这些群体有所不同，但他们在很大程度上拥有共同的世界观：女权主义破坏了社会的稳定，女性获得了太多的权力，而男性必须重新获得控制权。穆斯林大气层也不例外。它采用了在更广泛的马诺圈中传播的那些想法，并用信仰的语言重新命名它们。

paras.en: Sarah Kaddoura, a feminist researcher and creator of the YouTube channel Haki Nasawi, examined the Arabic-speaking manosphere in a 2025 report. In her study, she describes some of the most prominent influencers, such as Jordanian relationship coach Kareem Atta’i, who posts online as Coach Kareem or Red Pill Arabic.
paras.zh: 女权主义研究员、YouTube 频道 Haki Nasawi 的创建者 Sarah Kaddoura 在 2025 年的一份报告中研究了阿拉伯语马诺圈。在她的研究中，她描述了一些最著名的影响者，例如约旦关系教练卡里姆·阿塔伊（Kareem Atta’i），他在网上发帖称“卡里姆教练”或“红色药丸阿拉伯语”。

paras.en: Atta’i packages his ideas as relationship advice, but his videos frequently frame interactions between men and women as contests for power. Atta’i’s videos, which WIRED Middle East has watched, describe violence as a means of “disciplining” women or retaliating against sexual rejection.
paras.zh: 阿塔伊将他的想法包装为人际关系建议，但他的视频经常将男性和女性之间的互动视为权力之争。 《连线》中东频道看过阿塔伊的视频，视频中将暴力描述为“管教”女性或对性拒绝进行报复的一种手段。

paras.en: The Arabic manosphere does more than translate Western Red Pill content. Its creators have adapted the ideology to local anxieties around religion, masculinity, marriage, money, and social change.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯语马诺圈不仅仅翻译西方红药丸的内容。它的创造者使这种意识形态适应了当地对宗教、男子气概、婚姻、金钱和社会变革的焦虑。

paras.en: Kaddoura says influencers use financial insecurity, political instability, religious identity, and fears about declining morality or social cohesion to build their audiences. Misogyny becomes an explanation for a much wider sense of frustration—and women become its most visible target.
paras.zh: 卡多拉表示，影响力人士利用经济不安全、政治不稳定、宗教身份以及对道德下降或社会凝聚力的担忧来吸引受众。厌女症成为了对更广泛的挫败感的解释——而女性成为其最明显的目标。

paras.en: The problem is not religious expression online but the use of religious authority—real or claimed—to legitimize misogyny, harassment, and the public surveillance of women. The Muslim manosphere is also not confined to the Arab world. Like the broader manosphere, it crosses borders, languages, and platforms.
paras.zh: 问题不在于网上的宗教表达，而在于利用宗教权威（无论是真实的还是声称的）来使厌女症、骚扰和对妇女的公共监视合法化。穆斯林的马气圈也不局限于阿拉伯世界。就像更广泛的马诺圈一样，它跨越国界、语言和平台。

paras.en: Take prominent UK-based creator Ali Dawah, whose channel features street debates and commentary about relationships, gender roles, religion, and Western culture. In one clip, Dawah says he hates Muslim feminists “the most.” In another video, he approaches women in public and challenges them over clothing he describes as immodest.
paras.zh: 以英国著名创作者 Ali Dawah 为例，他的频道以有关人际关系、性别角色、宗教和西方文化的街头辩论和评论为特色。在一个视频中，达瓦说他“最讨厌”穆斯林女权主义者。在另一段视频中，他在公共场合接近女性，并以他认为不端庄的着装挑战她们。

paras.en: “Dawah” is not just this YouTuber’s name. In Arabic, it means to make an invitation to someone to learn about Islam. Ali is just one of many influencers often called “Dawah Bros,” and they’re generally known for being more aggressive than offering an invitation when it comes to promoting their manosphere-esque content.
paras.zh: “Dawah”不仅仅是这位 YouTuber 的名字。在阿拉伯语中，这意味着邀请某人了解伊斯兰教。阿里只是通常被称为“Dawah Bros”的众多影响者之一，他们通常以在推广他们的马诺圈式内容时比发出邀请更积极而闻名。

paras.en: Kaddoura sees the Dawah Bros as a platform-native successor to an older variety of media figure. During the 1990s, Islamic television programs in Egypt and Saudi Arabia regularly featured sheikhs answering callers’ questions about relationships, clothing, and acceptable behavior. However, unlike television preachers, today’s influencers are not limited to scheduled broadcasts, and they aren’t only interacting with people who’ve chosen to call in.
paras.zh: Kaddoura 将 Dawah Bros 视为旧媒体人物的平台原生继承者。 20 世纪 90 年代，埃及和沙特阿拉伯的伊斯兰电视节目经常出现酋长回答来电者有关人际关系、着装和可接受行为的问题。然而，与电视传教士不同，今天的影响者不仅限于预定的广播，而且他们不仅与选择打电话的人互动。

paras.en: For many Muslim women—especially those who are in prominent places on the internet—these ideas do not remain confined to podcasts or debate videos. They spill into comment sections and private messages, where strangers appoint themselves enforcers of morality.
paras.zh: 对于许多穆斯林女性来说，尤其是那些在互联网上处于显要地位的女性，这些想法并不局限于播客或辩论视频。它们渗透到评论区和私人信息中，陌生人将自己称为道德的执行者。

paras.en: A 2026 report by the Institute for Strategic Dialogue analyzed nearly 14,000 comments directed at 40 prominent public figures and influencers on Instagram in Jordan over a 12-month period. Among comments classified as hate speech, harassment, or abusive language, 72 percent targeted women, 11 percent were classified as religious or moral harassment, and the vast majority of those comments—85 percent—targeted female influencers.
paras.zh: 战略对话研究所 2026 年的一份报告分析了 12 个月内约旦 Instagram 上针对 40 位知名公众人物和影响者的近 14,000 条评论。在被归类为仇恨言论、骚扰或辱骂性语言的评论中，72% 针对女性，11% 被归类为宗教或道德骚扰，而其中绝大多数（85%）针对女性影响者。

paras.en: Additionally, all of the comments classified as sexual harassment were directed at women, underlining the pervasive contradictions in how women are policed on the internet—the same online environment that instructing women to make themselves invisible also subjecting them to unwanted sexual attention. That contradiction is visible in the messages Mariam has received.
paras.zh: 此外，所有被归类为性骚扰的评论都是针对女性的，这突显了女性在互联网上受到监管的普遍矛盾——同样的网络环境指示女性隐藏自己，也让她们遭受不必要的性关注。这种矛盾在玛丽雅姆收到的信息中显而易见。

paras.en: The manosphere’s reach is shaped in part by the recommendation systems that determine what users encounter in their feeds. “As soon as you create an account on TikTok, YouTube, X, Instagram, and others as a male, it doesn’t take long for the algorithm to start recommending misogynistic content,” Kaddoura says.
paras.zh: Manosphere 的覆盖范围部分取决于推荐系统，该系统确定用户在其提要中遇到的内容。卡多拉说：“一旦你以男性身份在 TikTok、YouTube、X、Instagram 和其他平台上创建了账户，算法很快就会开始推荐厌恶女性的内容。”

paras.en: Engagement-based systems can amplify emotionally charged and polarizing content, including manosphere videos. Content blaming women for men’s loneliness or financial insecurity can generate reactions from supporters, critics, and the women being targeted. Those interactions may increase its visibility.
paras.zh: 基于参与的系统可以放大情绪激动和两极分化的内容，包括马诺球视频。将男性的孤独或经济不安全归咎于女性的内容可能会引起支持者、批评者和目标女性的反应。这些互动可能会增加其知名度。

paras.en: That becomes even thornier when religion enters the picture. The relationship coaches and other men preaching religion online often present personal opinions as religious instruction, Kaddoura says. This can make disagreement appear immoral, and criticism can then be presented as evidence that the creator is defending the faith against hostile forces.
paras.zh: 当宗教介入时，这变得更加棘手。卡多拉说，关系教练和其他在网上宣扬宗教的人经常将个人观点作为宗教指导。这可能会使分歧显得不道德，然后批评可以作为创造者正在捍卫信仰免受敌对势力侵害的证据。

paras.en: But how exactly a user’s behavior tips over from passively encountering the content to actively engaging with it remains an open question. Researchers can examine publicly available videos and identify influential accounts, but they have limited access to the internal data needed to trace how users move between creators and communities. This leave key questions unanswered, such as whether prolonged exposure changes their behavior.
paras.zh: 但用户的行为究竟如何从被动接触内容转变为主动参与内容仍然是一个悬而未决的问题。研究人员可以检查公开视频并识别有影响力的帐户，但他们对追踪用户如何在创作者和社区之间移动所需的内部数据的访问权限有限。这使得一些关键问题没有得到解答，例如长期接触是否会改变他们的行为。

paras.en: For women such as Mariam, the technical route behind the harassment may be invisible, but its effects are not. A creator publishes a video. Recommendation systems carry it into other users’ feeds. And then, eventually, users repeat its message in women’s comment sections and inboxes. Repeat ad infinitum.
paras.zh: 对于玛丽雅姆这样的女性来说，骚扰背后的技术路线可能是看不见的，但其影响却并非如此。创作者发布视频。推荐系统将其带入其他用户的提要中。然后，最终，用户会在女性评论部分和收件箱中重复其信息。无限地重复。

paras.en: WIRED Middle East contacted Ali Dawah and Kareem Atta’i for comment. Neither responded by the time of publication.
paras.zh: 《连线》中东版联系了 Ali Dawah 和 Kareem Atta’i 请其置评。截至发稿时，双方均未做出回应。

paras.en: This story originally appeared in WIRED Middle East.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在《连线》中东版上。

articles.title: 13 Best Gifts for Every Traveler Should Have (2026)
articles.author: Boutayna Chokrane

paras.en: Even the most seasoned globe-trotter likely finds traveling stressful. Between panic-packing, navigating cramped terminals, and living out of a suitcase, each phase of being away from home can be overstimulating. That’s why the best gifts for travelers are ones that focus on ease and peace of mind.
paras.zh: 即使是经验最丰富的环球旅行者也可能会发现旅行压力很大。惊慌失措的打包行李、在狭窄的航站楼中穿行、以及提着行李箱生活，离开家的每个阶段都可能会让人过度刺激。这就是为什么给旅行者最好的礼物是那些注重轻松和安心的礼物。

paras.en: Jet-setters may think they have their travel routine down to a science, but the perfect gift can enhance any experience, whether it's a three-day business retreat or a two-week adventure across Europe. Below, find my favorite gifts for frequent travelers, from an essential suitcase set and a portable e-reader to comfortable compression socks and the perfect neck pillow.
paras.zh: 坐飞机的人可能认为他们的旅行习惯是一门科学，但完美的礼物可以增强任何体验，无论是为期三天的商务度假还是为期两周的欧洲探险。下面是我最喜欢的送给常旅客的礼物，从必备的行李箱套装和便携式电子阅读器到舒适的压缩袜和完美的颈枕。

paras.en: For more travel gifts, check out our guides to the Best Travel Tote Bags, Gifts for Women, and the Best Stocking Stuffers.
paras.zh: 如需更多旅行礼物，请查看我们的最佳旅行手提包、女士礼物和最佳圣诞袜指南。

paras.en: Every traveler needs a luggage set that includes a checked case and a carry-on. Chances are, the jet-setter in your life already has one they love. But if they’re due for a refresh, this set from Quince is an excellent (and expandable) gift. The brand makes some of my favorite travel gear, with pieces that look remarkably similar to designs from premium brands—but at a fraction of the price. This set comes in a range of minimalist colors and has all the features you could want in luggage, including 360-degree spinner wheels, a TSA-approved lock, and high-quality zippers.
paras.zh: 每个旅客都需要一套行李箱，其中包括一个托运行李和一个随身行李。很有可能，您生活中的喷气机旅行者已经有了他们所爱的人。但如果他们需要更新，Quince 的这套套装是一份极好的（且可扩展的）礼物。该品牌生产了一些我最喜欢的旅行装备，其中的单品看起来与高端品牌的设计非常相似，但价格却只有其一小部分。该套装具有一系列简约的颜色，并具有您想要的行李箱的所有功能，包括 360 度万向轮、TSA 批准的锁和高品质拉链。

paras.en: For the bookworm who’s always traveling, the Kindle Paperwhite is the obvious gift. Reviewer Nena Farrell says the 12th-generation model has the highest contrast ratio of any Kindle and lasts up to three months on a single charge. Whether you're reading in direct sun or a dim plane cabin, its 7-inch display is crisp and easy on the eyes thanks to its warm backlighting. Plus, its IPX8 waterproofing rating means you can confidently read poolside without worrying about water damage. The Signature Edition adds wireless charging, auto-brightness, and double the storage at 32 GB.
paras.zh: 对于经常旅行的书虫来说，Kindle Paperwhite 显然是一份礼物。评论家 Nena Farrell 表示，第 12 代型号的对比度是所有 Kindle 中最高的，一次充电可持续使用三个月。无论您是在阳光直射下还是在昏暗的机舱内阅读，其 7 英寸显示屏由于其温暖的背光而清晰易读。此外，其 IPX8 防水等级意味着您可以放心地在池畔阅读，而不必担心水损坏。签名版增加了无线充电、自动亮度和双倍存储空间（32 GB）。

paras.en: Check out our guides to the Best Kindles and the Best E-Readers for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 查看我们的最佳 Kindle 和最佳电子阅读器指南，了解更多建议。

paras.en: If you’re traveling abroad—or just don’t yet have your Real ID—a travel wallet is a must. The puffy Luka from Calpak comes in 23 colors, so you’re sure to find an option that fits your giftee’s vibe. It’s got plenty of room for cash, cards, your passport, and other documents, and it zips securely for peace of mind. Just note that it is quite large—about the size of a mass-market paperback. On the plus side, this makes it easy to find at a glance in a big bag or backpack. On the minus, a flight attendant once asked me to put it in the overhead compartment when she saw it on my lap. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 如果您要出国旅行，或者只是还没有真实身份证件，那么旅行钱包是必须的。 Calpak 的蓬松 Luka 有 23 种颜色，因此您一定能找到适合您的礼物送礼者氛围的选择。它有足够的空间容纳现金、银行卡、护照和其他文件，并且拉链安全，让您安心无忧。请注意，它相当大——大约有大众市场平装书的大小。从好的方面来说，这使得在大包或背包中一眼就能找到它。缺点是，一位空乘人员看到它放在我腿上时，请我把它放在头顶的行李架上。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: Frequent travelers who don't use collapsible cubes when packing are struggling, and they don't even know it. Give them this travel tip: Eagle Creek's set is the best, made of durable fabric with compression and high-quality zipper pulls. Editor Kat Merck says there's just enough mesh for air circulation to prevent odor buildup or fabric degradation, and the bottom and back of the cubes are opaque for privacy. They're water-resistant and designed with a top handle. The largest cube in this set is also split into two sections for clean clothes and dirty laundry. Eagle Creek also sells larger sets for extended stays and slim cubes to help you maximize narrow spaces in your luggage.
paras.zh: 经常旅行的人在收拾行李时不使用可折叠的立方体是很困难的，他们甚至不知道这一点。给他们这个旅行提示：Eagle Creek 的套装是最好的，由耐用的面料制成，具有压缩功能和高品质的拉链头。编辑凯特·默克 (Kat Merck) 表示，立方体的网格足以促进空气流通，以防止气味积聚或织物降解，并且立方体的底部和背面是不透明的，以保护隐私。它们具有防水功能，并配有顶部手柄。该套装中最大的立方体也分为两个部分，分别用于存放干净的衣服和脏衣服。 Eagle Creek 还销售适合长期住宿的大型套装和纤巧的立方体，以帮助您最大限度地利用行李箱中的狭窄空间。

paras.en: Check out our guide to the Best Packing Cubes for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 请查看我们的最佳包装立方体指南以获取更多建议。

paras.en: Do you know a frequent traveler who’s always headed somewhere sunny and always comes back with a sunburn as a souvenir? Solbari’s hats make the perfect gift, as they're all designed for sun protection with built-in Ultraviolet Protection Factor (UPF). As a resident of sunny San Diego, I wear this UPF 50+ hat often to protect my face and scalp, but it would work well anywhere. It travels well, too, since it’s soft, flexible, and doesn't take up much space. I regularly stow it in the bottom of my beach bag or stroller, and it would also be easy to pack in a carry-on. —Nena Farrell
paras.zh: 您是否认识一位经常旅行的人，他总是前往阳光明媚的地方，但总是带着晒伤作为纪念品回来？ Solbari 的帽子是完美的礼物，因为它们均专为防晒而设计，内置紫外线防护系数 (UPF)。作为阳光明媚的圣地亚哥的居民，我经常戴这顶 UPF 50+ 的帽子来保护我的脸部和头皮，但它在任何地方都很有效。它也很适合旅行，因为它柔软、灵活，而且不占用太多空间。我经常把它放在沙滩包或婴儿车的底部，而且也很容易装入随身携带的行李中。 ——妮娜·法雷尔

paras.en: This is my all-time favorite travel makeup bag. It comes in eight colors and three sizes (small, medium, and large). The medium has enough room for all the makeup I need for a two-week trip, and I'm an overpacker. It has 15 small pockets in addition to four larger mesh pockets, three flexible compartments, and two adjustable dividers, meaning you'll have a designated spot for nearly every product you own, including your makeup brushes. The customizable layout lets you configure it around what you actually pack. And it also feels and looks luxe. For everyday needs, get the small. The medium is my pick for short trips, and the large has enough space to double as a toiletry bag for longer trips.
paras.zh: 这是我一直以来最喜欢的旅行化妆包。它有八种颜色和三种尺寸（小号、中号和大号）。中号有足够的空间容纳我两周旅行所需的所有化妆品，而且我是一个过度包装的人。除了四个较大的网状口袋外，它还有 15 个小口袋、三个灵活的隔层和两个可调节的隔板，这意味着您几乎可以为您拥有的所有产品（包括化妆刷）指定一个位置。可定制的布局让您可以根据实际包装的内容进行配置。而且它给人的感觉和外观都很奢华。满足日常需求，选择小号。中号是我短途旅行的选择，大号有足够的空间，可以兼作长途旅行的洗漱包。

paras.en: Airports are chaotic enough without needing to worry about losing your luggage. AirTags can be a bit divisive, but they’re the best way to keep tabs on your valuables if you have an iPhone. Plus, with busy flights often leading to last-minute gate checks and delays, AirTags are well worth the extra security. If your friend or loved one is an Android user, I recommend the Chipolo Pop instead.
paras.zh: 机场已经够混乱的了，不用担心行李丢失。 AirTags 可能有点争议，但如果您有 iPhone，它们是监视贵重物品的最佳方式。此外，由于繁忙的航班经常导致最后一刻的登机口检查和延误，AirTags 非常值得额外的安全保护。如果您的朋友或亲人是 Android 用户，我推荐 Chipolo Pop。

paras.en: Check out our guide to the Best Bluetooth Trackers for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 请查看我们的最佳蓝牙跟踪器指南以获取更多建议。

paras.en: Traveling means sacrificing the comfort of your bed and sometimes facing unpredictable sleeping conditions. An eye mask for sleep is a small luxury that can make even the least ideal sleep arrangements more tolerable. I love Bearaby's full temple-to-temple coverage and gentle fit that doesn't squeeze your head. Made from natural eucalyptus fibers, it's breathable and anti-frizz, which is perfect for anyone who styles their hair before flights.
paras.zh: 旅行意味着牺牲床的舒适度，有时还面临不可预测的睡眠条件。睡眠眼罩是一种小奢侈，它可以让最不理想的睡眠安排变得更容易忍受。我喜欢 Bearaby 完全覆盖太阳穴到太阳穴的设计，而且轻柔贴合，不会挤压您的头部。它由天然桉树纤维制成，透气且防毛躁，非常适合在飞行前打理头发的人。

paras.en: Check out our guide to the Best Sleep Masks for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 查看我们的最佳睡眠面膜指南以获取更多建议。

paras.en: If I’m traveling away from home, whether for a day or a week, it’s a sure bet that I have Rumpl’s machine-washable Travel Puffy with me. I’ve had to use it for countless unexpected situations—sitting on something cold or wet, napping or relaxing at the airport or on a cold airplane, using it as a beach or picnic blanket, or just wearing it as a poncho because I forgot a jacket. (It has a little clip in the front for this purpose.) It’s also super easy to return it to its 4-by-10-inch dry-bag-style stuff sack, which can slip into a travel backpack’s water bottle slot or clip onto a loop or MOLLE webbing. —Kat Merck
paras.zh: 如果我要离开家旅行，无论是一天还是一周，我肯定会随身携带 Rumpl 的可机洗旅行蓬松袋。我不得不在无数意想不到的情况下使用它——坐在寒冷或潮湿的东西上，在机场或寒冷的飞机上小睡或放松，用它作为海滩或野餐毯，或者因为我忘记穿夹克而只是把它当作斗篷穿着。 （为此目的，它的前面有一个小夹子。）将其放回 4 x 10 英寸的干燥袋式物品袋也非常容易，它可以滑入旅行背包的水瓶槽或夹在环或 MOLLE 织带上。 ——凯特·默克

paras.en: This portable 3-in-1 charger is a great gift for on-the-go Apple lovers. It delivers up to 15 watts to an iPhone or any Qi2-certified device via an adjustable magnetic pad, so you can doomscroll while you charge. There's a second pad tucked behind for AirPods (or other wireless earbuds) and a fold-out Apple Watch charger. Anker even includes a 5-foot USB-C cable and a wall adapter, all backed by a two-year warranty.
paras.zh: 这款便携式三合一充电器是送给忙碌的苹果爱好者的绝佳礼物。它通过可调节磁性垫为 iPhone 或任何 Qi2 认证的设备提供高达 15 瓦的功率，因此您可以在充电时进行末日滚动。后面还有一个用于放置 AirPods（或其他无线耳机）的垫子和一个折叠式 Apple Watch 充电器。 Anker 甚至还包括一条 5 英尺的 USB-C 电缆和一个壁式适配器，所有这些均享有两年保修。

paras.en: Check out our guides to the Best Apple 3-in-1 Wireless Chargers, Best Power Banks, and Best Portable Chargers for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 查看我们的最佳 Apple 三合一无线充电器、最佳移动电源和最佳便携式充电器指南，了解更多建议。

paras.en: You don’t normally realize you need a travel pillow until 45 minutes before an international flight, when you’re standing in the Hudson News debating whether the overpriced U-shaped bolster is worth it. (It isn’t.) Save your friend the agony and get them the Trtl Neck Pillow. It may look corny, but it’s my favorite travel pillow. Instead of constricting your neck in a doughnut, these scarf-style travel pillows have an internal frame that cradles your head without physical strain. It's lightweight—just half a pound—and packable; you can stuff it into its accompanying storage bag and clip it onto your travel bag when not in use.
paras.zh: 通常，直到国际航班起飞前 45 分钟，当您站在《Hudson News》上争论这个价格过高的 U 形枕垫是否值得时，您才会意识到自己需要一个旅行枕头。 （事实并非如此。）为你的朋友省去痛苦，给他们买一个 Trtl 颈枕。它可能看起来很老套，但它是我最喜欢的旅行枕头。这些围巾式旅行枕头没有将您的颈部束缚在甜甜圈中，而是具有一个内部框架，可以支撑您的头部而不会造成身体压力。它重量轻，仅半磅，并且可折叠；您可以将其放入随附的储物袋中，并在不使用时将其夹在旅行包上。

paras.en: Check out our guide to the Best Travel Pillows for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 请查看我们的最佳旅行枕头指南以获取更多建议。

paras.en: This 100-watt universal travel adapter covers more than 200 countries and can charge multiple devices at once. The classic slider design pushes out EU, UK, and US plugs, and you can rotate the pins for sockets in Australia and China. There’s a universal input socket, an additional side socket for US or Japanese plugs, and two USB-C ports and two USB-A ports on the bottom. Reviewer Simon Hill especially loves the retractable USB-C cable, which is around 25 inches long, delivers up to 100 watts in total, and saves you from having to pack an extra cable.
paras.zh: 这款 100 瓦通用旅行适配器覆盖 200 多个国家/地区，可同时为多个设备充电。经典的滑块设计可推出欧盟、英国和美国插头，您还可以旋转澳大利亚和中国插座的插针。底部有一个通用输入插座、一个用于美国或日本插头的附加侧面插座，以及两个 USB-C 端口和两个 USB-A 端口。评论员 Simon Hill 特别喜欢可伸缩的 USB-C 电缆，该电缆长约 25 英寸，总功率高达 100 瓦，让您无需携带额外的电缆。

paras.en: Check out our guide to the Best Travel Adapters for more recommendations.
paras.zh: 请查看我们的最佳旅行适配器指南以获取更多建议。

paras.en: No matter how short or long the flight, I don’t fly without the Bombas compression socks. Available in men’s and women’s styles, these medium-compression socks (15 to 20 mmHg) support healthy circulation, reduce and relieve swelling, and help speed up recovery after long days of travel and sightseeing. Bombas also gives back with every purchase, donating a pair of socks to someone in need.
paras.zh: 无论飞行时间多短或多长，我都不会在没有 Bombas 压力袜的情况下飞行。这些中等压力的袜子（15 至 20 毫米汞柱）有男士和女士款式可供选择，可支持健康循环，减少和缓解肿胀，并有助于在长时间旅行和观光后加快恢复。 Bombas 还会在每次购买时进行回馈，向有需要的人捐赠一双袜子。

articles.title: I Made Terrible Games With Google’s AI Playground
articles.author: Boone Ashworth

paras.en: Neon Don is really pissed at his ex-wife’s lawyer. He’ll tell you any chance he gets while he shotguns lines of pixelated bad guys. He’s also not real—his likeness has only existed for a few minutes in a top-down cyberpunk-style shooter game, generated in the Google Labs service Playground.
paras.zh: 霓虹灯对他前妻的律师非常生气。当他用枪射击一排像素化的坏人时，他会告诉你任何机会。他也不是真实的——他的肖像只在谷歌实验室服务 Playground 中生成的自上而下的赛博朋克风格射击游戏中存在了几分钟。

paras.en: “Keep shooting!” Neon Don says as he mows enemies down. “Brenda took everything else away!”
paras.zh: “继续射击！”霓虹唐边说边砍倒敌人。 “布伦达把所有东西都拿走了！”

paras.en: Playground, which Google launched this week, is part of Google Labs, the company’s landing page for its various AI experiments that haven’t made it into an app or official service quite yet. (Google has done this before with things like music production). It works similarly to Horizon Create, the game generation service Meta announced in September.
paras.zh: 谷歌本周推出的 Playground 是谷歌实验室的一部分，谷歌实验室是该公司各种人工智能实验的登陆页面，但尚未将其变成应用程序或官方服务。 （谷歌之前已经在音乐制作等方面做到了这一点）。它的工作原理与 Horizo​​n Create 类似，后者是 Meta 于 9 月推出的游戏生成服务。

paras.en: Playground is essentially vibe coding for video games, letting people describe in plain language what kind of game they want to make in a chatbot-like interface. Playground then builds a working in-browser version of a game. You can add further instructions to tweak the design from there. If you have assets you want to use as a reference, you can upload photos, videos, or models. Otherwise, the visuals and designs are all AI-generated.
paras.zh: Playground 本质上是视频游戏的氛围编码，让人们用简单的语言描述他们想要在类似聊天机器人的界面中制作什么样的游戏。然后，Playground 构建一个可在浏览器中运行的游戏版本。您可以添加进一步的说明来调整设计。如果您有想要用作参考的资源，您可以上传照片、视频或模型。除此之外，视觉效果和设计都是人工智能生成的。

paras.en: The process of making a game is very straightforward, conversational, and responsive. That means it is perfect for dummies like me with little to no video game development chops or even decent coding skills. By simply throwing out some ideas, I built three playable, stable, and not even remotely good games in one day.
paras.zh: 制作游戏的过程非常简单、对话式且响应迅速。这意味着它非常适合像我这样几乎没有视频游戏开发能力甚至没有良好编码技能的傻瓜。通过简单地提出一些想法，我在一天内构建了三款可玩的、稳定的、甚至不是很好的游戏。

paras.en: My first work was Pork Drop, a result generated from the prompt “Tetris but with cute pigs instead of blocks.” I typed that in, hit Build. The AI chugged, then spit out a farm-themed version of Tetris with little pig faces drawn on every block.
paras.zh: 我的第一个作品是 Pork Drop，是根据“俄罗斯方块，但用可爱的猪而不是方块”提示生成的结果。我输入了该内容，然后点击“构建”。人工智能发出嘎嘎声，然后吐出一个以农场为主题的俄罗斯方块，每个方块上都画着小猪脸。

paras.en: I had to iterate a bit to realize my vision, telling the AI not just to stick pig faces on the blocks but to have the blocks shaped like distorted pigs. “Each block is a pig,” I wrote, “contorted into the shape of the Tetris blocks. Make ’em look a little squished but still cute!” This resulted in a clean, playable version of Tetris, though the occasional block looked like a T-posed pig with its legs spread-eagle. The AI suggested the title Piggy Stacker, but I thought mine was better. (I’m right.)
paras.zh: 我必须进行一些迭代才能实现我的愿景，告诉人工智能不仅要把猪脸贴在积木上，还要让积木的形状像扭曲的猪。 “每个方块都是一头猪，”我写道，“扭曲成俄罗斯方块的形状。让它们看起来有点被压扁，但仍然很可爱！”这产生了一个干净、可玩的俄罗斯方块版本，尽管偶尔的方块看起来像一只双腿张开的 T 形猪。 AI 建议使用“Piggy Stacker”这个标题，但我认为我的更好。 （我是对的。）

paras.en: The next game idea came courtesy of my colleague Jay Dayrit, who, when asked what kind of game I should make, immediately requested, “Gay dinner party.” I typed that in.
paras.zh: 下一个游戏创意来自我的同事 Jay Dayrit，当被问到我应该制作什么样的游戏时，他立即要求“同性恋晚宴”。我输入了这个。

paras.en: With no follow-up requests, the result was a 2D flash-style game called Dinner Darling. The art looks like everyone is a Bitmoji. You’re placed in the shoes of a very stressed-out-looking host, Julian, who is tasked with hosting a fancy dinner party with fussy guests who can’t seem to sit in their chairs at the table. As timers count down, you have to prepare various artisanal bruschettas and espresso martinis for your increasingly angry guests.
paras.zh: 由于没有后续请求，结果是一款名为《Dinner Darling》的 2D Flash 风格游戏。艺术看起来就像每个人都是 Bitmoji。你扮演的是一位看起来非常紧张的主人朱利安，他的任务是举办一场盛大的晚宴，嘉宾们似乎都无法坐在桌边的椅子上。随着计时器倒计时，您必须为日益愤怒的客人准备各种手工烤面包和浓缩马提尼酒。

paras.en: After it generates, I give the game a shot and fail miserably, unable to figure out the controls in time to bring my guests a timely pastry or cocktail. (Sasha, one of the guests, required numerous espresso cocktails in a row.) “PARTY CATASTROPHE,” the game-over screen read.
paras.zh: 当它生成后，我尝试了一下游戏，但惨败了，无法及时弄清楚控制方式，无法及时为我的客人带来糕点或鸡尾酒。 （萨沙，其中一位客人，连续需要大量浓缩咖啡鸡尾酒。）“派对灾难”，游戏结束屏幕上写着。

paras.en: There is no mention of anybody’s sexuality in the game at all, but when I lost, Dayrit called from across the office, “See? You're bad at the game because you're straight!” Well played, Playground.
paras.zh: 游戏中根本没有提及任何人的性取向，但当我输了时，戴里特从办公室的另一边打来电话，“看到了吗？你在游戏中表现不佳，因为你是异性恋！”玩得好，游乐场。

paras.en: My colleague Reece Rogers was less impressed when he looked at the game. “This is very unrealistic, because there’s not a vegan or dairy-free option,” he said.
paras.zh: 我的同事里斯·罗杰斯（Reece Rogers）在观看比赛时并没有留下深刻的印象。 “这是非常不现实的，因为没有纯素食或不含乳制品的选择，”他说。

paras.en: The game that took the most work is the one that has since been played the most by random people on Playground. (Anyone can sign in with their Google account and play these user-generated games.) I’m up to seven unique players as of publication, which apparently means this game is my masterpiece.
paras.zh: 花费最多精力的游戏是 Playground 上随机玩家玩得最多的游戏。 （任何人都可以使用他们的 Google 帐户登录并玩这些用户生成的游戏。）截至发布时，我有多达七位独特的玩家，这显然意味着这款游戏是我的杰作。

paras.en: I asked the AI to make a “cyberpunk-style rhythm game” where you play as a “very divorced” grizzled ex-cop who battles waves of rogue agents and corrupt politicians. It started as a Beat Saber–type title, but I asked the AI to make it more like the top-down shooter Hotline Miami. The result was Neon Don (title mine), a top-down, arcade-like shooter with pulsing synth wave background music.
paras.zh: 我要求人工智能制作一款“赛博朋克风格的节奏游戏”，你扮演一个“非常离婚”、头发花白的前警察，与一波又一波的流氓特工和腐败政客作斗争。它一开始是一款 Beat Saber 类型的游戏，但我要求人工智能让它更像自上而下的射击游戏《迈阿密热线》。结果就是《Neon Don》（标题是我的），一款自上而下的街机式射击游戏，带有脉动的合成波背景音乐。

paras.en: Neon Don is also the game I tried to push the content bounds on, to see what Playground would let me get away with.
paras.zh: Neon Don 也是我尝试突破内容界限的游戏，看看 Playground 能让我逃脱什么惩罚。

paras.en: I described the enemies, and Playground AI added its own details on top, including “bulky, wide builds with prominent beer bellies straining against their tight tactical shirts and cargo pants” and “custom tough-guy swagger animations.” OK, Playground, go off.
paras.zh: 我描述了敌人，Playground AI 在上面添加了自己的细节，包括“笨重、宽大的体型，突出的啤酒肚紧绷着紧身战术衬衫和工装裤”和“定制的硬汉招摇动画”。好啦，操场，出发吧。

paras.en: The game had several small issues at first. I countered them and added features a little bit at a time. I dictated systems for level scaling, boss generation, and better enemy variety. I flagged mobility issues, like the player getting stuck, and it fixed them. (And occasionally introduced other problems.) I asked it to develop a text-based snark system that made the main character respond to combat with witty in-character quips like “Keep shooting! Brenda took everything else away!” or “I’ve taken worse hits from my ex-wife’s lawyer!”
paras.zh: 游戏一开始有几个小问题。我反击了他们，并一次添加了一点功能。我规定了关卡缩放、Boss 生成和更好的敌人种类的系统。我标记了移动性问题，例如玩家被卡住，它解决了这些问题。 （偶尔还会引入其他问题。）我要求它开发一个基于文本的尖刻系统，让主角用俏皮的俏皮话来应对战斗，比如“继续射击！布伦达把其他一切都拿走了！”或者“我前妻的律师对我的打击更严重！”

paras.en: I imagine that a real game developer would know what to actually say to sharpen features and make the game more fun or playable. Some of the top games people have created on the platform are much better than mine, since I tended to lean on more vibe-based iterative changes like, “Make Don taller” or “more divorced.”
paras.zh: 我想真正的游戏开发者会知道应该说什么来增强功能并使游戏更有趣或更可玩。人们在该平台上创建的一些顶级游戏比我的好得多，因为我倾向于依赖更多基于氛围的迭代更改，例如“让唐更高”或“更离婚”。

paras.en: After a certain point, Google throttles your usage of its Playground service. Every new game and iteration therein uses up more of your allowance. (Note for all my new loyal fans: Updates on my titles will be coming on October 14 when my usage allowance refreshes.)
paras.zh: 在某一点之后，Google 会限制您对其 Playground 服务的使用。每个新游戏及其迭代都会消耗更多的津贴。 （所有新忠实粉丝请注意：我的游戏更新将于 10 月 14 日更新，届时我的使用限额将刷新。）

paras.en: That means my games still have many issues. I wanted to add a “Backflip” button to Neon Don, but the AI called it “Doge flip,” which I think sucks but cannot change until my usage credits recharge. I want to change the difficulty and add more weapon options. I want to do a lot of things, but I ain’t paying for more usage credits.
paras.zh: 这意味着我的游戏仍然存在很多问题。我想给 Neon Don 添加一个“后空翻”按钮，但人工智能将其称为“Doge Flip”，我认为这很糟糕，但在我的使用积分充值之前无法更改。我想改变难度并添加更多武器选项。我想做很多事情，但我不会支付更多的使用积分。

paras.en: Playground does make me interested in the actual art of making video games. It’s fun and somewhat intuitive, and there are tangible results you can play with in real time. People are probably going to make some interesting stuff with it. But the limitations keep it from being truly useful.
paras.zh: Playground 确实让我对制作视频游戏的实际艺术感兴趣。它很有趣，而且有点直观，并且您可以实时体验有形的结果。人们可能会用它制作一些有趣的东西。但这些限制使其无法真正发挥作用。

paras.en: Also, when you scroll through the Playground games, an unmistakable sameness permeates everything. Different game genres wind up with almost identical menus and music. You start to see the same types of combat options and style choices.
paras.zh: 此外，当你滚动浏览 Playground 游戏时，你会发现一切都明显相同。不同的游戏类型最终会带来几乎相同的菜单和音乐。你开始看到相同类型的战斗选项和风格选择。

paras.en: Playground is fun for a bit. But soon it becomes pretty clear it’s AI slop all the way down. Tell that to your ex-wife’s lawyer.
paras.zh: 游乐场很有趣。但很快人们就会清楚地看到，人工智能正在一路下滑。把这件事告诉你前妻的律师。

articles.title: Category 4 Hurricane Simon nears landfall on Mexican coast

paras.en: Oct. 10 (UPI) -- Hurricane Simon neared landfall on Mexico's Pacific coast Sunday morning as a Category 4 storm, the National Hurricane Center said.
paras.zh: 10 月 10 日（合众国际社）——国家飓风中心称，飓风西蒙周日上午以 4 级风暴的形式接近登陆墨西哥太平洋海岸。

paras.en: The eye of the storm was about 65 miles west-southwest of Manzanillo, Mexico, and about 85 miles south-southeast of Cabo Corrientes, Mexico, the NHC said in its 10 a.m. CST update. The storm had maximum sustained winds of 145 mph and was moving north-northwest at 7 mph.
paras.zh: NHC 在上午 10 点的 CST 更新中表示，风暴中心位于墨西哥曼萨尼约西南偏西约 65 英里处，以及墨西哥卡波科连特斯东南偏南约 85 英里处。风暴的最大持续风速为 145 英里/小时，并以 7 英里/小时的速度向西北偏北方向移动。

paras.en: Hurricane warnings are in effect for Punta San Telmo to El Roblito and Las Islas Marias, Mexico.
paras.zh: 墨西哥蓬圣特尔莫至埃尔罗布利托和拉斯群岛玛丽亚斯的飓风警告已生效。

paras.en: The NHC said that after making landfall, Simon was expected to travel northward along Mexico's coast, gradually weakening until it reaches tropical storm strength Tuesday.
paras.zh: 美国国家飓风中心表示，西蒙登陆后预计将沿着墨西哥海岸向北移动，强度逐渐减弱，直到周二达到热带风暴强度。

paras.en: "On the forecast track, Simon is expected to be very near the coast of west-central Mexico later today and remain close to the coast on Monday," the NHC said.
paras.zh: NHC 表示：“根据预测，西蒙预计今天晚些时候将非常靠近墨西哥中西部海岸，并在周一保持在靠近海岸的位置。”

paras.en: Rain totals are expected to be around 8 to 16 inches over parts of southwestern Mexico and could have up to 30 inches for parts of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco through Monday. The rain could produce life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in areas with steep terrain.
paras.zh: 预计到周一，墨西哥西南部部分地区的降雨总量约为 8 至 16 英寸，米却肯州、科利马州和哈利斯科州部分地区的降雨量可能高达 30 英寸。降雨可能会引发危及生命的洪水和泥石流，特别是在地形陡峭的地区。

paras.en: Storm surge is expected along the coast near and to the east of where the center makes landfall, the NHC said. At the coast, the surge will bring large, destructive waves.
paras.zh: 国家飓风中心表示，风暴潮预计将出现在中心登陆地点附近和东部的海岸。在海岸，海浪会带来巨大的破坏性波浪。

articles.title: Man arrested for plotting to assassinate Polish PM Donald Tusk

paras.en: Oct. 11 (UPI) -- Police in Poland on Sunday arrested a man who threatened and planned to assassinate Prime Minister Donald Tusk, the nation's interior minister said.
paras.zh: 10 月 11 日（UPI）——波兰内政部长称，波兰警方周日逮捕了一名威胁并计划暗杀总理唐纳德·图斯克的男子。

paras.en: The suspect also threatened to kill Defense Minister Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz, Interior Minister Marcin Kierwiński said. Kosiniak-Kamysz is also one of three deputy prime ministers in Poland.
paras.zh: 内政部长马尔钦·基尔文斯基 (Marcin Kierwiński) 表示，嫌疑人还威胁要杀死国防部长瓦迪斯瓦夫·科西尼亚克·卡米什 (Władysław Kosiniak-Kamysz)。科西尼亚克-卡米什也是波兰三名副总理之一。

paras.en: Officials declined to identify the suspect and did not reveal any details of the alleged plot, Politico reported.
paras.zh: 据《Politico》报道，官员拒绝透露嫌疑人的身份，也没有透露涉嫌阴谋的任何细节。

paras.en: Kierwiński said security officials in Poland had been on high alert after being tipped off about the planned attack, Euronews reported.
paras.zh: 据欧洲新闻报道，基尔文斯基表示，波兰安全官员在接到有关计划中的袭击的举报后一直处于高度戒备状态。

paras.en: Jacek Dobrzyński, spokesperson for Special Services Minister Coordinator Tomasz Siemoniak, told reporters that officials were taking the matter "very seriously."
paras.zh: 特别服务部长协调员托马斯·西蒙尼亚克（Tomasz Siemoniak）的发言人雅采克·多布尔津斯基（Jacek Dobrzyński）告诉记者，官员们“非常严肃”地对待此事。

paras.en: "Month after month, year after year, more and more threats and worrying messages are reaching the police," he said. "In this case, we are talking about a strong probability that these threats could have been acted upon."
paras.zh: “月复一月，年复一年，越来越多的威胁和令人担忧的信息到达警方，”他说。 “在这种情况下，我们谈论的是这些威胁很可能已被采取行动。”

articles.title: Rosalía Dazzles With Balletic and Rain-Soaked ‘LUX’ Performances on ‘Saturday Night Live’: Watch
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Rosalía brought theatrical flair to Studio 8H.
paras.zh: Rosalía 为 Studio 8H 带来了戏剧天赋。

paras.en: The Spanish singer-songwriter returned to Saturday Night Live on Oct. 10 to deliver two striking performances from her fourth studio album, LUX.
paras.zh: 这位西班牙创作歌手于 10 月 10 日重返《周六夜现场》，带来了她的第四张录音室专辑《LUX》中的两场精彩表演。

paras.en: Following an introduction from host Shane Gillis, Rosalía opened with “Reliquia,” delivering a ballet-inspired performance that appeared to keep her en pointe for nearly its entirety. The singer trained with a professional ballerina to prepare for the choreography featured on her LUX tour.
paras.zh: 在主持人肖恩·吉利斯 (Shane Gillis) 的介绍后，罗莎莉亚以《Reliquia》开场，带来了一场受芭蕾舞启发的表演，似乎让她几乎全程保持足尖姿势。这位歌手接受了专业芭蕾舞演员的训练，为她的 LUX 巡演中的编舞做准备。

paras.en: Dressed in a dark, ballet-inspired outfit, Rosalía delivered the song — which reached the top 10 on Billboard’s Hot Latin Songs chart in November 2025 — as shadows of orchestral musicians played across the flowy curtain behind her.
paras.zh: 罗莎莉亚身穿深色芭蕾舞服装，演唱了这首歌曲，这首歌在 2025 年 11 月登上公告牌热门拉丁歌曲排行榜前十名，管弦乐音乐家的影子在她身后飘逸的幕布上演奏。

paras.en: For her second performance, Rosalía took to the dimly lit stage in a sheer gown to sing “Magnolias,” the devastating closing track from LUX. Halfway through the performance, in-studio rain began to pour over the singer as she finished the song.
paras.zh: 在她的第二场演出中，罗莎莉亚穿着透明礼服登上灯光昏暗的舞台，演唱了 LUX 毁灭性的片尾曲《Magnolias》。演出进行到一半时，歌手唱完歌曲后，录音室开始下起倾盆大雨。

paras.en: The appearance marked Rosalía’s second time as a musical guest on SNL. She made her debut in 2022, performing “Chicken Teriyaki” and “La Noche de Anoche” from her album MOTOMAMI. She also made a cameo during Bad Bunny’s 2021 appearance on the show, when the pair performed “La Noche de Anoche.”
paras.zh: 这次亮相标志着罗莎莉亚第二次作为 SNL 的音乐嘉宾。她于 2022 年首次亮相，表演了专辑《MOTOMAMI》中的“Chicken Teriyaki”和“La Noche de Anoche”。她还在 Bad Bunny 2021 年的节目中客串，当时两人表演了《La Noche de Anoche》。

paras.en: Released to widespread attention, LUX made a strong debut on the Billboard charts, entering the Billboard 200 at No. 4. The set also debuted at No. 1 on five Billboard charts, including Top Latin Albums, Classical Albums, Classical Crossover Albums and World Albums.
paras.zh: LUX 发行后受到广泛关注，在 Billboard 排行榜上强势亮相，进入 Billboard 200 排行榜第 4 名。该专辑还首次在五张 Billboard 排行榜上排名第一，包括顶级拉丁专辑、古典专辑、古典跨界专辑和世界专辑。

paras.en: Rosalía recorded LUX in 13 languages, a creative approach that helped the album reach audiences across multiple musical genres, including classical and classical crossover.
paras.zh: Rosalía 用 13 种语言录制了 LUX，这种创造性的方法帮助专辑吸引了多种音乐流派的听众，包括古典音乐和古典跨界音乐。

paras.en: Watch Rosalía perform “Reliquia” and “Magnolias” on SNL below.
paras.zh: 请观看下面罗莎莉亚在《周六夜现场》中表演的《Reliquia》和《Magnolias》。

articles.title: Cornell University Cancels Homecoming Concert Amid Fallout From Sexual Assault Case
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Cornell University has canceled its upcoming homecoming concert amid backlash over its handling of sexual assault allegations.
paras.zh: 由于对性侵犯指控的处理方式遭到强烈反对，康奈尔大学取消了即将举行的返校音乐会。

paras.en: The Cornell Concert Commission announced on Instagram Friday (Oct. 9) that it had canceled a homecoming concert featuring indie-pop duo Between Friends, which was scheduled for Oct. 17 at Barton Hall in Ithaca, New York.
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学音乐会委员会周五（10 月 9 日）在 Instagram 上宣布，取消了原定于 10 月 17 日在纽约伊萨卡巴顿大厅举行的由独立流行二人组 Between Friends 举办的返校音乐会。

paras.en: “The Cornell Concert Commission is a student-run organization and, as students, we stand with Jane Doe and all survivors of sexual violence,” the post reads. “It takes so much strength to come forward with such a painful truth, and Jane Doe needs all the support she can get to stay strong during this turbulent time.”
paras.zh: 帖子中写道：“康奈尔大学音乐会委员会是一个由学生管理的组织，作为学生，我们与无名氏和所有性暴力幸存者站在一起。” “说出这样一个痛苦的事实需要很大的力量，而无名氏需要她能得到的所有支持，才能在这个动荡的时期保持坚强。”

paras.en: The cancellation comes amid mounting scrutiny over a lawsuit filed in September by a woman identified as Jane Doe against Cornell University and seven members of its Chi Phi fraternity. The lawsuit alleges that the men gave her drugs and alcohol before repeatedly sexually assaulting and raping her at a fraternity party in October 2024. The men have denied wrongdoing, saying that the encounters were consensual or misrepresented in the suit, according to The New York Times.
paras.zh: 此次取消正值九月份一名名叫无名氏的女性对康奈尔大学及其 Chi Phi 兄弟会的七名成员提起的诉讼受到越来越严格的审查之际。该诉讼称，这些男子在 2024 年 10 月的一次兄弟会聚会上多次对她进行性侵犯和强奸之前，给了她毒品和酒精。据《纽约时报》报道，这些男子否认有不当行为，称这些遭遇是双方自愿的，或者在诉讼中歪曲了事实。

paras.en: On Oct. 3, Cornell President Michael I. Kotlikoff pledged an independent review of the university’s handling of the case, saying, “We as an administration and community must do better.” Three days later, Cornell announced that former U.S. Deputy Attorney General Sally Yates would lead the review.
paras.zh: 10 月 3 日，康奈尔大学校长迈克尔·科特利科夫 (Michael I. Kotlikoff) 承诺将对学校处理此案的方式进行独立审查，并表示：“我们作为行政部门和社区必须做得更好。”三天后，康奈尔大学宣布，美国前副司法部长萨莉·耶茨将领导此次审查。

paras.en: “It is essential that we advocate and stand up for those failed by the university’s administration,” the Cornell Concert Commission continued on Instagram. “We call on Cornell to create meaningful changes that protect and support survivors.”
paras.zh: 康奈尔大学音乐会委员会在 Instagram 上继续说道：“我们必须倡导并支持那些因大学管理而失败的人。” “我们呼吁康奈尔大学做出有意义的改变来保护和支持幸存者。”

paras.en: The concert commission also said it is working to organize a charity event featuring student bands and DJs to support sexual violence prevention efforts. All proceeds from the planned concert will benefit RAINN, a nonprofit organization dedicated to combating sexual violence.
paras.zh: 音乐会委员会还表示，正在努力组织一场由学生乐队和 DJ 参加的慈善活动，以支持预防性暴力的工作。计划中的音乐会的所有收益将捐献给致力于打击性暴力的非营利组织 RAINN。

paras.en: If you or anyone you know needs support, you can reach out to the Rape, Abuse & Incest National Network. The organization provides free, confidential support to sexual assault victims. Call RAINN’s National Sexual Assault Hotline (800-656-HOPE) — which is available 24/7, 365 days — or visit the anti-sexual violence organization’s website.
paras.zh: 如果您或您认识的任何人需要支持，您可以联系强奸、虐待和乱伦国家网络。该组织为性侵犯受害者提供免费、保密的支持。请拨打 RAINN 的全国性侵犯热线 (800-656-HOPE)（365 天、每天 24/7）或访问反性暴力组织的网站。

articles.title: Inside the Halftime Music Strategy For the NFL’s International Games: ‘The Biggest Challenge Is Expectation’
articles.author: Dan Rys

paras.en: When the NFL prepared to kick off its 2026-2027 season with an opening game in Melbourne, Australia on Sept. 10, Tim Tubito was gearing up for the beginning of his own journey of a season. The NFL’s senior director of global game presentation and entertainment, Tubito had an ambitious slate ahead of him: the league was planning its most ambitious international slate of games ever, with its largest group of major halftime headliners taking stages around the world.
paras.zh: 当 NFL 准备于 9 月 10 日在澳大利亚墨尔本举行揭幕战，拉开 2026-2027 赛季的序幕时，蒂姆·图比托 (Tim Tubito) 正在为开始自己的赛季之旅做好准备。 NFL 全球比赛展示和娱乐高级总监图比托 (Tubito) 面临着一个雄心勃勃的计划：联盟正在计划有史以来最雄心勃勃的国际比赛，其中最大的半场主要人物将在世界各地登台亮相。

paras.en: So when the Jonas Brothers hit the halftime stage in Melbourne that day, it was the first of what will now become seven major halftime shows the NFL hosts in seven international cities on four different continents around the world, up from six shows in five cities last year, and marking the NFL’s major foray into this kind of event, having hosted the biggest stage in the world for decades in the annual Super Bowl Halftime Show.
paras.zh: 因此，当乔纳斯兄弟那天在墨尔本登上中场休息舞台时，这是 NFL 在全球四大洲七个国际城市举办的七场大型中场表演中的第一场，而去年在五个城市举办了六场表演，标志着 NFL 在年度超级碗中场表演中数十年来主办了世界上最大的舞台，标志着 NFL 首次涉足此类活动。

paras.en: “The success we had last year internationally, frankly, that was kind of a test run,” Tubito tells Billboard. “We were going to see how that was received, and it was received really well. And so, as the league expands, the idea is to continue to expand with it.”
paras.zh: “坦率地说，我们去年在国际上取得的成功是一种试运行，”图比托告诉《告示牌》。 “我们将看看人们对此的反应如何，而且反响非常好。因此，随着联盟的扩张，我们的想法是继续随之扩张。”

paras.en: With yesterday’s (Oct. 10) announcement that The Warning would be performing the game in Mexico City on Nov. 22, that expanded slate is now set: the Jonas Brothers played in Melbourne Sept. 10; Pedro Sampaio & Ricky Martin performed at the game in Rio de Janeiro, Brazil, on Sept. 27; Ayra Starr headlined the game in London between the Philadelphia Eagles and Jacksonville Jaguars earlier today (Oct. 11); and Burna Boy (Paris, Oct. 25), Manuel Turizo (Madrid, Nov. 8) and Cage the Elephant (Munich, Germany, Nov. 15) will round out the lineup. It’s a diverse, and global, array of stars, and helps to highlight the NFL’s further foray into the live music space, particularly as it expands around the globe.
paras.zh: 昨天（10 月 10 日）The warning 宣布将于 11 月 22 日在墨西哥城进行比赛，扩大的赛程现已确定：乔纳斯兄弟于 9 月 10 日在墨尔本进行比赛； 9月27日，佩德罗·桑帕约和瑞奇·马丁在巴西里约热内卢举行的比赛中表演；今天（10 月 11 日）早些时候，艾拉·斯塔尔 (Ayra Starr) 成为伦敦费城老鹰队 (Philadelphia Eagles) 和杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 (Jacksonville Jaguars) 之间比赛的头条新闻； Burna Boy（巴黎，10 月 25 日）、Manuel Turizo（马德里，11 月 8 日）和 Cage the Elephant（德国慕尼黑，11 月 15 日）将完善阵容。这是一群多元化、全球性的明星，有助于凸显 NFL 进一步进军现场音乐领域，特别是随着它在全球范围内的扩张。

paras.en: And that expansion is not slowing down. Here, Tubito speaks about the NFL’s music strategy, the challenges and complications that can arise from hosting these types of events in venues not specially built for them, and how these performances differ from that vaunted Super Bowl stage. “Music connects to memory for people,” Tubito says. “It’s that nostalgia thing. Beyond just the halftime show itself, music plays such a big part in what we do at an NFL game.”
paras.zh: 而且这种扩张并没有放缓。在这里，Tubito 谈论了 NFL 的音乐策略、在非专门为其建造的场地举办此类活动可能带来的挑战和复杂性，以及这些表演与备受赞誉的超级碗舞台有何不同。 “音乐与人们的记忆联系在一起，”图比托说。 “这就是怀旧之情。除了中场表演本身之外，音乐在 NFL 比赛中也扮演着重要的角色。”

paras.en: The NFL started doing regular season halftime shows a few years ago. Why did that first get going?
paras.zh: NFL 几年前开始举办常规赛中场表演。为什么首先会发生这种情况？

paras.en: Specifically for the international games, back when we were only doing games in London, we tested out some smaller local halftime shows. And I think the expectation with international fans, especially, is they watch the Super Bowl and they expect that spectacle to be a part of it. So we started to look into growing that. And for us, there’s certainly the entertainment value in engaging the fan and creating that experience in the stadium, but it’s also a way to engage the casual fan or someone who’s not necessarily familiar with football, which is both helpful domestically but certainly helpful internationally.
paras.zh: 特别是对于国际比赛，当我们只在伦敦做比赛时，我们测试了一些较小的当地中场表演。我认为国际球迷的期望尤其是他们观看超级碗比赛，并且他们希望这种奇观成为其中的一部分。所以我们开始考虑种植它。对我们来说，吸引球迷并在体育场创造这种体验当然具有娱乐价值，但这也是吸引普通球迷或不一定熟悉足球的人的一种方式，这不仅对国内有帮助，而且在国际上也肯定有帮助。

paras.en: The music itself and the artists we work with reach audiences that might not necessarily be tuning into a football game, and that happens for multiple reasons and multiple touch points. So there’s the show itself, but also the lead up, whether that is on the artist channels promoting the show or artists appearing on morning news shows where football or sports aren’t typically discussed, or even publications like Billboard where it’s more of a music listener. You’re now reaching fans who might not typically be tuning into a sports network or a football game. So the idea is certainly entertainment and engaging the fans first, but it’s bringing people in who might not necessarily watch the game, and then when they tune in for the music, they stick around for the game and fall in love with the game as well.
paras.zh: 音乐本身和与我们合作的艺术家所吸引的受众可能不一定会观看足球比赛，这种情况的发生有多种原因和多个接触点。因此，既有节目本身，也有前期准备，无论是在宣传节目的艺术家频道上，还是在通常不讨论足球或体育的早间新闻节目中出现的艺术家，甚至在《公告牌》(Billboard) 等出版物上，更多的是作为音乐听众。您现在接触到的粉丝可能通常不会收看体育网络或足球比赛。所以这个想法肯定是首先是娱乐和吸引球迷的，但它吸引了那些不一定会观看比赛的人，然后当他们收听音乐时，他们会留下来观看比赛并爱上比赛。

paras.en: How much have you learned from the Super Bowl Halftime Show being so successful over the years, and been able to apply that to to these kinds of shows?
paras.zh: 您从多年来超级碗中场秀的成功中学到了多少东西，并能够将其应用到此类节目中？

paras.en: The scale that we’re able to do at the Super Bowl is very different. But I think at the core, it’s the same. It starts with the artist, and it starts with developing a great idea around the artist’s music. So we work with artists that are really looking to lean in and connect with that local audience.
paras.zh: 我们在超级碗上能够做到的规模非常不同。但我认为本质上是一样的。它从艺术家开始，从围绕艺术家的音乐发展一个好主意开始。因此，我们与真正希望与当地观众建立联系的艺术家合作。

paras.en: Just as you saw in the Super Bowl Halftime Show this year, music is also about the storytelling behind the music. The days of, “The band just gets up on stage and plays,” that’s still great, and you love that. But having that story behind it, it brings that second layer to it, where it really connects with people a bit deeper.
paras.zh: 正如您在今年的超级碗中场秀中看到的那样，音乐也是关于音乐背后的故事讲述。 “乐队就站上舞台演奏”的日子仍然很棒，你喜欢这样。但有了这个故事的背后，它就带来了第二层，它真正与人们建立了更深层次的联系。

paras.en: We have a strategy behind it. It’s not just, “Let’s get the biggest name.” That’s not always the answer, especially for these international markets. We take a bunch of things into consideration: How do they resonate in the local market? And for the broadcast audience, how do they resonate globally? What kind of show do they put on? Is it a show that’s going to translate to a live audience? Because you can feel that in the broadcast if the energy in the stadium isn’t strong. So that’s a big part of it. And then their willingness to lean in with us and really create a year-round partnership, whether that’s through posting with us, attending events in the lead-up, promoting the game, promoting our causes, just being a part of things a little bit deeper.
paras.zh: 我们背后有一个战略。这不仅仅是“让我们选出最有名的”。这并不总是答案，尤其是对于这些国际市场而言。我们考虑了很多因素：它们如何在当地市场引起共鸣？对于广播观众来说，他们如何在全球范围内引起共鸣？他们上演什么样的节目？这是一个能够向现场观众传达的节目吗？因为如果体育场内的能量不强，你可以在转播中感觉到。所以这是其中很大一部分。然后他们愿意与我们合作，真正建立全年的合作伙伴关系，无论是通过与我们一起发帖、参加筹备活动、推广游戏、促进我们的事业，还是更深入地参与其中。

paras.en: For us, the next step has been, we get these performers, they put on a great show, we have a great experience with them, they have a great experience. We don’t want them to just leave and we never work with them again. We want that to be a kind of a year-round engagement. So that all plays a part in it, and certainly a key to it, which makes things a lot easier, is when you have artists who are authentic football fans and they care about the game as well. That really helps.
paras.zh: 对我们来说，下一步是，我们得到这些表演者，他们上演了一场精彩的表演，我们和他们在一起有很棒的经历，他们有很棒的经历。我们不希望他们离开，我们再也不会与他们合作。我们希望这是一种全年的参与。因此，所有的一切都在其中发挥作用，当然，让事情变得容易得多的关键是，当你拥有真正的足球迷并且他们也关心比赛的艺术家时。这确实有帮助。

paras.en: Are there particular genres that you try to go for?
paras.zh: 您有尝试尝试的特定类型吗？

paras.en: It depends market by market. What resonates in Munich is certainly not the same in Mexico City, so that plays a factor in it. We’re still learning about the markets. We have great local offices who give us great intel, and we work with them. We do a lot of research on what resonates in those markets. So that’s where we start. We look at what’s resonating.
paras.zh: 这取决于市场。在慕尼黑引起共鸣的东西在墨西哥城肯定不一样，所以这是其中的一个因素。我们仍在了解市场。我们有很棒的当地办事处，他们为我们提供了丰富的情报，我们与他们合作。我们对哪些因素能在这些市场产生共鸣进行了大量研究。这就是我们开始的地方。我们看看什么能引起共鸣。

paras.en: When we look at Europe or even Australia, you wouldn’t think country music, internationally, is as big as it is, but it’s tremendous. And then we’ve leaned in heavy to Latin over the past couple of years, both with halftime at the Super Bowl, but also what we did last year in some of these different markets, with Latin music exploding internationally. So I think we take those all into consideration when we go with genre. But when we do lay out the games, we do try to cross every genre. We want the music to be as diverse as our audience.
paras.zh: 当我们看看欧洲甚至澳大利亚时，你不会认为乡村音乐在国际上有那么大，但它是巨大的。然后，在过去的几年里，我们严重依赖拉丁音乐，无论是超级碗的中场休息，还是我们去年在一些不同市场所做的事情，拉丁音乐在国际上呈爆炸式增长。所以我认为当我们选择类型时，我们会考虑所有这些。但当我们设计游戏时，我们确实尝试跨越各种类型。我们希望音乐与我们的听众一样多样化。

paras.en: What are some of the challenges that you have in putting these together?
paras.zh: 将这些整合在一起时遇到哪些挑战？

paras.en: The biggest challenge is expectation. The expectation is Super Bowl Halftime. What we’re able to put behind all these games is not the same as Super Bowl Halftime. But we still put out an amazing product in what we do. So it’s a little bit of managing the expectations, because we also don’t have the luxury of an extended halftime at these games.
paras.zh: 最大的挑战是期望。期待的是超级碗中场休息。我们能够在所有这些比赛背后投入的东西与超级碗中场休息不同。但我们仍然在我们所做的事情中推出了令人惊叹的产品。所以这有点管理期望，因为我们在这些比赛中也没有延长中场休息的时间。

paras.en: The second part is going into stadiums that are not built for football to start with, and then layering a concert on top of it. I’m in Melbourne right now, and we’re preparing for that game and trying to prepare a concert. And we do the entire entertainment for the game halfway around the world and working with the local team. That can be challenging at times. But first and foremost, it’s protecting the field, because it is about the football game and protecting the integrity of the game.
paras.zh: 第二部分是进入本来就不是为足球而建的体育场，然后在其上举办音乐会。我现在在墨尔本，我们正在为那场比赛做准备，并努力准备一场音乐会。我们在半个地球以外的地方与当地团队合作，为游戏提供全部娱乐服务。有时这可能具有挑战性。但最重要的是，它是保护球场，因为它关系到足球比赛并保护比赛的完整性。

paras.en: Take [soccer giants] Real Madrid for example. When they bring in concerts, they lift the seats to bring in the stages. Obviously, for a halftime show in Madrid, we can’t lift the seats because people are in them. So we have to find a way to store the stage around the field during the game and not obstruct views. Those are the types of challenges you come across in these different stadiums that aren’t exactly designed for an NFL football game, and they’re not designed for an NFL football game with a live concert in the middle of it.
paras.zh: 以[足球巨头]皇家马德里为例。当他们举办音乐会时，他们会抬起座位以引入舞台。显然，对于马德里的中场表演，我们无法抬起座位，因为里面有人。所以我们必须找到一种方法，在比赛过程中将舞台存放在场地周围，并且不遮挡视线。这些是你在这些不同的体育场中遇到的挑战类型，这些体育场并不是专门为 NFL 橄榄球比赛而设计的，也不是为中间有现场音乐会的 NFL 橄榄球比赛而设计的。

paras.en: There’s a whole suite of entertainment programming that you guys are doing. How does music fit into all of that?
paras.zh: 你们正在制作一整套娱乐节目。音乐如何融入这一切？

paras.en: Every stadium has their sing-along songs. There’s a soundtrack to the game that enhances the experience. A big touchdown happens, hitting the right track after it to keep that energy going is such a critical subliminal part of the game. If a big play happens and you come in with something soft, you’re automatically taking the audience down. You want to take that energy and lift it up. So, music plays such a big part in everything we do.
paras.zh: 每个体育场都有他们的伴唱歌曲。游戏的配乐可以增强体验。一次重大触地得分发生后，击中正确的轨道以保持能量持续存在是比赛中至关重要的潜意识部分。如果一场大戏上演，而你却带着一些柔和的东西进来，你就会自然而然地让观众失望。你想要吸收这种能量并提升它。所以，音乐在我们所做的一切中扮演着如此重要的角色。

paras.en: Even with the Super Bowl, when we present the Vince Lombardi Trophy, we have the Vince Lombardi soundtrack. But a couple years ago, we used Aerosmith’s “Dream On” to tell the story of the Lombardi Trophy through the season up to the team winning. So everything we do, we keep music on the forefront of the storytelling and the highlights that we play and the moments in games.
paras.zh: 即使在超级碗比赛中，当我们颁发文斯·隆巴迪奖杯时，我们也会有文斯·隆巴迪的配乐。但几年前，我们使用 Aerosmith 的“Dream On”讲述了隆巴迪奖杯整个赛季直至球队获胜的故事。因此，我们所做的一切，都是将音乐置于故事讲述、游戏亮点和游戏时刻的最前沿。

paras.en: What did you think of the World Cup Final having a halftime show this year?
paras.zh: 您对今年世界杯决赛的中场表演有何看法？

paras.en: It’s great. I think anytime sports are bringing in entertainment — and the lineup they had was amazing — it’s a plus for everyone. You’re seeing it across so many sports doing larger halftimes, whether that’s the NWSL or MLB. I think there’s that natural connection between sports and music, and the more you see it, the more opportunities there are for artists, the better. And it gives them an understanding of what it’s like to perform in these environments when it’s not a touring concert and you have to quickly come in and come out. I think it’s a great thing.
paras.zh: 这很棒。我认为只要体育运动能够带来娱乐——而且他们的阵容非常棒——这对每个人来说都是一个好处。无论是 NWSL 还是 MLB，您都会在许多体育赛事中看到更长的中场休息时间。我认为体育和音乐之间存在着天然的联系，你看到的越多，艺术家的机会就越多越好。这让他们了解在不是巡回演唱会并且必须快速进出的情况下在这些环境中表演是什么样的。我认为这是一件很棒的事情。

paras.en: How important would you say that music is to the NFL as a whole?
paras.zh: 您认为音乐对整个 NFL 有多重要？

paras.en: It’s at the forefront of everything we do, on social and digital, from little bump ins and bump outs on broadcast. Some of the networks just do such a great job of being in touch with what is modern, what connects to the game. And then we play so much music in stadium. It’s just a critical component. I can’t imagine sitting in a stadium with no music. Even in a sport like soccer, where they don’t have those natural breaks to play music, fans sing the entire time. Music is just such a critical part of sports. It’s just a natural connection.
paras.zh: 无论是在社交还是数字领域，从广播中的小插曲，它都处于我们所做的一切的最前沿。有些网络在接触现代事物、与游戏相关的事物方面做得非常出色。然后我们在体育场里播放很多音乐。它只是一个关键组件。我无法想象坐在没有音乐的体育场里。即使在足球这样的运动中，他们没有自然的休息时间来演奏音乐，球迷们也会一直唱歌。音乐正是体育运动的重要组成部分。这只是一种自然的联系。

paras.en: Do you see an appetite for this being a part of every regular season game at some point?
paras.zh: 您是否认为有兴趣在某个时候将其纳入每场常规赛比赛中？

paras.en: I think it’s tougher domestically for clubs to do it every week. Unlike the international games where we get one crack at it, I think clubs have a bigger challenge. They have to vary that every week and change the entertainment approach. And there’s other things that they have to do within their community, whether that’s honoring a legend or honoring local heroes and things like that. You get to a point where if you do too many, you might water it down. There are only so many artists in the world that can do it and rise to that occasion.
paras.zh: 我认为对于国内的俱乐部来说，每周做到这一点更加困难。与我们在国际比赛中一试身手不同，我认为俱乐部面临着更大的挑战。他们必须每周改变一下并改变娱乐方式。他们还必须在社区内做其他事情，无论是纪念传奇人物还是纪念当地英雄等等。你到了这样一个地步：如果你做的太多，你可能会淡化它。世界上能做到这一点并能应对这种情况的艺术家屈指可数。

paras.en: But I think there are other opportunities to make sure that music is included in a game. It’s not always about the big spectacle of halftime. It’s sometimes just giving that audience some live, different entertainment to incorporate the music into the show.
paras.zh: 但我认为还有其他机会来确保游戏中包含音乐。这并不总是与中场休息的大场面有关。有时只是为观众提供一些现场的、不同的娱乐，将音乐融入到节目中。

paras.en: Is there anything that you would like to do that you haven’t been able to do yet?
paras.zh: 有没有什么事情是你想做却还没能做到的？

paras.en: I have some kind of pie in the sky dreams of things I would love to do to bring multiple artists together on the stage, kind of like those old tributes that you would see on the Video Music Awards, where you have like six of the greatest guitarists on stage together across generations. I think it’s about bringing a show together that’s larger than life.
