paras.en: The hypothesis about hidden rooms was first proposed more than a decade ago. A key advocate of the idea, archaeologist Nicholas Reeves, mentions clues that he believes may point to Nefertiti’s burial being nearby. These include “hidden” hieroglyphics that were painted over on the north wall of Tutankhamun’s tomb.
paras.zh: 关于隐藏房间的假设是在十多年前首次提出的。这一想法的主要倡导者、考古学家尼古拉斯·里夫斯提到了一些线索，他认为这些线索可能表明纳芙蒂蒂的墓地就在附近。其中包括画在图坦卡蒙陵墓北墙上的“隐藏”象形文字。

paras.en: If you're enjoying this article, consider supporting our award-winning journalism by subscribing. By purchasing a subscription you are helping to ensure the future of impactful stories about the discoveries and ideas shaping our world today.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢这篇文章，请考虑通过订阅来支持我们屡获殊荣的新闻报道。通过购买订阅，您将有助于确保有关塑造当今世界的发现和想法的影响力故事的未来。

paras.en: A team has now published a review of archaeological and geophysical investigations at Tutankhamun’s burial chamber (also known as KV62), including results from a survey carried out between 2023 and 2024.
paras.zh: 一个团队现已发表了对图坦卡蒙墓室（也称为 KV62）的考古和地球物理调查的回顾，其中包括 2023 年至 2024 年期间进行的一项调查的结果。

paras.en: Lead researcher Mamdouh Eldamaty told Nature that the results were suggestive of concealed structures beyond KV62. A decision on whether to carefully drill through the north wall and deploy miniature cameras could be made in coming months. However, other experts are cautious about the findings.
paras.zh: 首席研究员 Mamdouh Eldamaty 告诉《自然》杂志，这些结果暗示了 KV62 以外的隐藏结构。未来几个月可能会决定是否仔细钻穿北墙并部署微型摄像机。然而，其他专家对研究结果持谨慎态度。

paras.en: There is a delicate balance between speculation, hypothesis testing, and discovery. Some of the greatest scientific and archaeological breakthroughs have come from researchers willing to challenge paradigms and pursue ideas drawn from vague and improbable historical clues.
paras.zh: 推测、假设检验和发现之间存在着微妙的平衡。一些最伟大的科学和考古突破来自于愿意挑战范式并追求从模糊和不可能的历史线索中得出的想法的研究人员。

paras.en: However, limited evidence combined with great expectations can encourage conclusions that run ahead of the data. The possibility of hidden chambers beyond the tomb of Tutankhamun sits precisely at this intersection.
paras.zh: 然而，有限的证据与巨大的期望相结合可能会得出超前于数据的结论。图坦卡蒙墓之外隐藏的密室的可能性恰好位于这个交叉点。

paras.en: Yet the distinction between evidence for unexplored spaces and evidence for the burial of Nefertiti remains substantial. The challenge is not to decide what we hope to find, but to evaluate objectively what the available evidence does, and does not, support.
paras.zh: 然而，未探索空间的证据和纳芙蒂蒂埋葬的证据之间的区别仍然很大。挑战不是决定我们希望找到什么，而是客观评估现有证据支持和不支持什么。

paras.en: The media readily gravitates toward the most spectacular conclusions. The search for Cleopatra’s tomb at Taposiris Magna provides a cautionary example.
paras.zh: 媒体很容易得出最引人注目的结论。在塔波西里斯·麦格纳 (Taposiris Magna) 寻找克利奥帕特拉 (Cleopatra) 坟墓的行动提供了一个警示性的例子。

paras.en: Previously looted tombs, artifacts, and even the renewed investigation of a subterranean hydraulic tunnel were frequently presented as indications that the discovery of Cleopatra’s tomb was imminent. Yet the existence of an aqueduct consistent with Hellenistic (Greek-influenced) urban infrastructure does not constitute evidence for a royal burial.
paras.zh: 之前被洗劫一空的坟墓、文物，甚至对地下水力隧道的重新调查，都经常表明克利奥帕特拉坟墓的发现即将到来。然而，与希腊化（受希腊影响的）城市基础设施一致的渡槽的存在并不构成皇家墓葬的证据。

paras.en: A more measured approach can be seen in the work of Greek archaeologist Calliope Papakosta in Alexandria, Egypt. During a visit to her excavations, she showed me evidence suggesting that Alexander the Great’s tomb might lie nearby. The most compelling object was a marble statue of a young warrior that she argued, and I agree, may depict Alexander.
paras.zh: 埃及亚历山大的希腊考古学家卡利奥佩·帕帕科斯塔 (Calliope Papakosta) 的工作中可以看到一种更加谨慎的方法。在参观她的发掘过程中，她向我展示了证据，表明亚历山大大帝的坟墓可能就位于附近。最引人注目的物品是一个年轻战士的大理石雕像，她认为，我同意，它可能描绘的是亚历山大。

paras.en: The style was consistent with the school of Lysippus, Alexander’s court sculptor. Unfortunately, the sculpture had been discarded within a Roman fill layer and thus removed from its original context.
paras.zh: 其风格与亚历山大宫廷雕塑家利西波斯流派一致。不幸的是，该雕塑已被丢弃在罗马填充层中，因此从其原始环境中移除。

paras.en: Papakosta recognized both the promise and limitations of the evidence. While hopeful that her work might illuminate the fate of Alexander’s tomb, she consistently framed her discoveries within the bounds of what the data demonstrated.
paras.zh: 帕帕科斯塔认识到证据的希望和局限性。虽然她希望自己的工作能够阐明亚历山大墓的命运，但她始终将自己的发现限制在数据所显示的范围内。

paras.en: The debate surrounding Tutankhamun’s tomb raises similar issues. The burial site is unusually small for one hosting a pharaoh, and Nicholas Reeves has argued that it represents only the outer portion of a larger Amarna-period (roughly 1350–1325 BC) royal burial complex.
paras.zh: 围绕图坦卡蒙墓的争论也引发了类似的问题。对于法老的墓地来说，这个墓地异常小，尼古拉斯·里夫斯认为，它仅代表了较大的阿玛纳时期（大约公元前 1350-1325 年）皇家墓葬群的外部部分。

paras.en: The abnormality of the tomb is widely accepted and it has been presumed to be a small private tomb that was hastily adapted for the king because of his death at a young age.
paras.zh: 人们普遍认为这座坟墓的异常现象是一座小型私人坟墓，是由于国王英年早逝而匆忙改建的。

paras.en: A suggestion of door seams in the decorated north wall of the burial chamber stimulated the extended tomb complex theory, but damaging the wall to probe it would be out of the question. Progress would therefore depend upon geophysics providing a means to peer through the wall without damaging it.
paras.zh: 墓室北墙上装饰的门缝的建议激发了扩展墓葬群理论，但破坏墙壁来探测它是不可能的。因此，进展将取决于地球物理学提供一种在不损坏墙壁的情况下透视墙壁的方法。

paras.en: The first investigations employed relatively low-frequency Ground Penetrating Radar (GPR), principally in the 400-900 megahertz (MHz) range. Such frequencies provide greater penetration into the surrounding limestone than higher-frequency radar. But this comes at the expense of spatial resolution. Later investigations expanded this range and included frequencies as high as 3 gigahertz (GHz).
paras.zh: 第一项调查采用频率相对较低的探地雷达 (GPR)，主要在 400-900 兆赫 (MHz) 范围内。与高频雷达相比，这种频率可以更好地穿透周围的石灰岩。但这是以牺牲空间分辨率为代价的。后来的研究扩大了这个范围，包括高达 3 GHz 的频率。

paras.en: My own inclination would have been to place particular emphasis on the highest-frequency radar antennae (the parts of the GPR system that transmit and receive electromagnetic pulses) because resolving whether the north wall contains evidence of a door seam is an important first step to answering other key questions.
paras.zh: 我自己的倾向是特别强调频率最高的雷达天线（探地雷达系统中发射和接收电磁脉冲的部分），因为解决北墙是否包含门缝的证据是回答其他关键问题的重要第一步。

paras.en: High-frequency systems offer less penetration but are generally better suited to detecting subtle structural discontinuities immediately behind the wall surface.
paras.zh: 高频系统的穿透力较低，但通常更适合检测紧邻墙面后面的细微结构不连续性。

paras.en: More recent investigations added microgravity surveys made from above the theorized complex. These measure minute variations in the Earth’s gravitational field caused by differences in density below ground. Higher-frequency GPR has also now been added to the team’s toolkit.
paras.zh: 最近的调查增加了从理论综合体上方进行的微重力调查。它们测量由地下密度差异引起的地球引力场的微小变化。更高频率的探地雷达现已添加到该团队的工具包中。

paras.en: This was a sensible evolution of the research strategy. The problem was, to protect the wall paintings, the GPR antennae could not be placed directly against the decorated surfaces.
paras.zh: 这是研究策略的明智演变。问题是，为了保护壁画，探地雷达天线不能直接放置在装饰表面上。

paras.en: The resulting air gap weakened coupling between the antenna and the wall, reducing signal quality and complicating interpretation. For GPR, the farther the antenna is from the surface, the more difficult it becomes to resolve subtle architectural features.
paras.zh: 由此产生的气隙削弱了天线和墙壁之间的耦合，降低了信号质量并使解释变得复杂。对于探地雷达来说，天线距离地表越远，解析细微的建筑特征就越困难。

paras.en: Microgravity surveys do not suffer from this limitation. They are capable of identifying anomalies within the limestone below the sensor. The challenge facing both types of investigation is that they have not produced unambiguous evidence for a large open chamber immediately beyond the wall.
paras.zh: 微重力勘测不受此限制。它们能够识别传感器下方石灰岩内的异常情况。两种类型的调查面临的挑战是，他们没有提供明确的证据来证明墙外有一个大型开放房间。

paras.en: To account for this, proponents of the hidden chamber hypothesis have suggested that any passageways may have been deliberately backfilled with rubble, obscuring the void signatures that investigators originally expected to detect. This is plausible and merits further testing, but it remains an interpretation, not fact.
paras.zh: 为了解释这一点，隐藏室假说的支持者提出，任何通道都可能被故意用碎石回填，从而掩盖了调查人员最初期望检测到的虚空特征。这是有道理的，值得进一步检验，但它仍然是一种解释，而不是事实。

paras.en: Some investigators have argued that the currently available geophysical evidence does not demonstrate the presence of hidden chambers.
paras.zh: 一些调查人员认为，目前可用的地球物理证据并不能证明隐藏室的存在。

paras.en: This has led to the next logical step in the scientific process: direct testing. The current proposal to drill a small borehole and deploy miniature cameras into one of the identified anomalies has the potential to move the discussion from inference to observation.
paras.zh: 这导致了科学过程中的下一个合乎逻辑的步骤：直接测试。目前的提议是钻一个小钻孔并将微型摄像机部署到已识别的异常之一，这有可能将讨论从推理转向观察。

paras.en: Whatever the outcome, the investigations undertaken by Eldamaty and colleagues represent the most comprehensive scientific assessment of the question to date.
paras.zh: 无论结果如何，埃尔达马蒂及其同事进行的调查代表了迄今为止对该问题最全面的科学评估。

paras.en: Currently, the hidden chamber theory remains exactly what a good scientific hypothesis should be: intriguing, testable, and worthy of investigation. What it is not, at least yet, is a discovery.
paras.zh: 目前，隐室理论仍然是一个好的科学假设应有的样子：有趣、可检验、值得研究。至少目前还不是一个发现。

paras.en: This article was first published by The Conversation. Read the original article here.
paras.zh: 本文最初由《对话》发表。在这里阅读原文。

articles.title: The world’s loudest bird could drown out a rock concert
articles.author: Elie Dolgin

paras.en: The bare-throated bellbird is loud. Very, very loud.
paras.zh: 裸喉钟鸟的声音很大。非常非常大声。

paras.en: The explosive, metallic mating call of the snow-white male — a stout bird with a broad bill and distinctive blue-green throat patch — can top 130 decibels, louder than a jackhammer or a front-row seat at a Counting Crows concert.
paras.zh: 雪白的雄鸟——一种粗壮的鸟，有着宽阔的喙和独特的蓝绿色喉咙斑——发出爆炸性的、金属般的求偶叫声，声音可达130分贝，比手提钻或数乌鸦音乐会前排座位的声音还要大。

paras.en: That makes this South American forest dweller a contender for the title of world’s loudest bird. And now researchers think they know how it and other avian loudmouths produce such eardrum-rattling vocalizations.
paras.zh: 这使得这种南美森林居民成为世界上声音最大的鸟类称号的有力竞争者。现在研究人员认为他们知道它和其他鸟类大嘴鸟是如何发出这种震耳欲聋的声音的。

paras.en: Bigger bodies and, especially, wider beaks help these feathered screamers belt it out, behavioral ecologists João Menezes and Jeff Podos of the University of Massachusetts Amherst report September 29 in Evolution.
paras.zh: 马萨诸塞大学阿默斯特分校的行为生态学家 João Menezes 和 Jeff Podos 于 9 月 29 日在《进化论》杂志上报道称，更大的身体，尤其是更宽的喙有助于这些长有羽毛的尖叫鸟将其表达出来。

paras.en: But what pushed some birds to evolve such volume in the first place remains a mystery. The researchers looked at mating behavior, habitat density and flight ability, but found no explanation that consistently held across species. “We weren’t able to find an overarching pattern that applies to birds in general,” Menezes says.
paras.zh: 但最初是什么促使一些鸟类进化出如此大的体积仍然是一个谜。研究人员观察了交配行为、栖息地密度和飞行能力，但没有发现在不同物种之间一致成立的解释。 “我们无法找到适用于一般鸟类的总体模式，”梅内塞斯说。

paras.en: The quest to understand these sonic extremes dates back to 2019. That is when Podos and a colleague crowned the white bellbird (Procnias albus), an Amazonian cousin of the bare-throated bellbird (P. nudicollis), as a record-setting vocal powerhouse. Its 125-decibel calls were the loudest bird calls ever measured at the time.
paras.zh: 对这些声音极端现象的探索可以追溯到 2019 年。当时，波多斯和一位同事将白钟鸟 (Procnias albus)（裸喉钟鸟 (P. nudicollis) 的亚马逊近亲）评为创纪录的声音强者。它的叫声高达 125 分贝，是当时测量到的最响亮的鸟叫声。

paras.en: Beyond the attention-grabbing number, the finding raised a broader question: What makes some birds so extraordinarily loud?
paras.zh: 除了引人注目的数字之外，这一发现还提出了一个更广泛的问题：是什么让一些鸟类的声音如此之大？

paras.en: The honk of a Canada goose, for example, can reach chainsaw volume (100 decibels), while the chatter of a starling rarely rises above a dishwasher-level hum (70 decibels) — and ornithologists have surprisingly little understanding of why. Although scientists have spent decades cataloging the timing and frequency of birdsong, hoping to decode what birds are saying, the sheer loudness of bird voices has gone largely unexplored.
paras.zh: 例如，加拿大鹅的叫声可以达到电锯音量（100 分贝），而椋鸟的叫声很少会超过洗碗机级别的嗡嗡声（70 分贝）——令人惊讶的是，鸟类学家对其中的原因知之甚少。尽管科学家们花了几十年的时间对鸟鸣的时间和频率进行分类，希望能够解码鸟类所说的内容，但鸟类声音的响度在很大程度上还没有被探索过。

paras.en: To get a read on the racket, Podos lugged a high-grade sound meter, the kind used to monitor noise levels in industrial workplaces, and a laser rangefinder into the woods, swamps and open fields around his home in western Massachusetts. He measured the calls of whatever birds he could find — warblers, sparrows, robins and more.
paras.zh: 为了了解球拍情况，波多斯将一台高级声级计（用于监测工业工作场所噪音水平的那种）和一台激光测距仪拖进了他位于马萨诸塞州西部的家周围的树林、沼泽和开阔的田野。他测量了他能找到的所有鸟类的叫声——莺、麻雀、知更鸟等等。

paras.en: After logging a few dozen species, he enlisted Menezes, a then-grad student who at the time had recently joined his lab, to help turn the collection into a broader evolutionary analysis. Menezes measured bird vocalizations across his home country of Brazil, from the Atlantic Forest near São Paulo to the mountains surrounding Rio de Janeiro and beyond. He captured everything from the soft chirps of the dusky-throated hermit hummingbird to the piercing yelps of the red-legged seriema, a shaggy type of grassland bird.
paras.zh: 在记录了几十个物种后，他聘请了当时刚加入他实验室的研究生梅内塞斯来帮助将这些收集品转化为更广泛的进化分析。梅内塞斯测量了他的祖国巴西各地的鸟类发声，从圣保罗附近的大西洋森林到里约热内卢周围的山脉及更远的地方。他捕捉到了一切，从暗喉隐士蜂鸟的柔和鸣叫到红腿鸫（一种毛茸茸的草原鸟类）的刺耳叫声。

paras.en: All told, he and Podos compiled vocal volume data on 123 species, creating what they say is the largest such dataset to date.
paras.zh: 总而言之，他和 Podos 收集了 123 个物种的发声量数据，创建了他们所说的迄今为止最大的此类数据集。

paras.en: The heftier the bird, the louder its call tended to be, and the same went for birds with broader beaks — a connection between anatomy and acoustic performance that biophysicist Gabriel Mindlin from the University of Buenos Aires in Argentina finds “sensible and plausible.”
paras.zh: 鸟越重，它的叫声往往越大，对于喙部较宽的鸟来说也是如此——阿根廷布宜诺斯艾利斯大学的生物物理学家加布里埃尔·明德林认为，解剖学和声学性能之间的联系“合理且合理”。

paras.en: “Larger birds have the potential to generate greater respiratory pressures and flows, while morphological features such as beak opening can affect how efficiently acoustic energy radiates,” says Mindlin, who studies birdsong but was not involved in the work.
paras.zh: “较大的鸟类有可能产生更大的呼吸压力和流量，而喙张开等形态特征会影响声能的辐射效率，”研究鸟鸣但未参与这项工作的明德林说。

paras.en: Why evolution cranked up the volume on these avian megaphones, though, is a puzzle that remains, for now, unhatched.
paras.zh: 然而，为什么进化会提高这些鸟类扩音器的音量，目前仍然是一个尚未解开的谜团。

articles.title: ‘A Mother’s Brain’ explores the neuroscience of motherhood
articles.author: Laura Sanders

paras.en: When it comes to new motherhood, the baby typically takes center stage, garnering most of people’s attention. But in a refreshing twist, neuroscientist Susana Carmona shifts the spotlight to the mom. In the opening pages of A Mother’s Brain, Carmona cheerfully tells us, “here, we’ll hardly discuss babies at all.” Mothers are her protagonists.
paras.zh: 当谈到新妈妈时，婴儿通常占据中心舞台，吸引大多数人的注意力。但令人耳目一新的是，神经科学家苏珊娜·卡莫纳将焦点转移到了母亲身上。在《母亲的大脑》的开头几页中，卡莫纳愉快地告诉我们，“在这里，我们几乎不会讨论婴儿。”母亲是她的主角。

paras.en: What follows is a captivating, passionate and well-grounded journey through the fascinating process of “matrescence.” A word coined to echo “adolescence,” another time of seismic changes, matrescence includes the intense reorganization a woman’s brain undergoes as she becomes a mom. So far, early studies have revealed a sculpting of brain circuits (and Carmona is quick to point out that less can be more), heightened social instincts and perhaps even a boost of resilience during old age.
paras.zh: 接下来是一段引人入胜、充满激情且基础扎实的旅程，穿越令人着迷的“成熟期”过程。这个词是为了呼应“青春期”，即另一个发生巨大变化的时期，女性期包括女性在成为母亲后大脑所经历的剧烈重组。到目前为止，早期研究已经揭示了大脑回路的塑造（卡莫纳很快指出，少即是多）、社交本能的增强，甚至可能会增强老年时的适应能力。

paras.en: This mom found the book to be a treasure trove of motherly delights. Scientific concepts are woven with social and cultural strands, from the poignant to the weird to the profound. Certain passages in the book allowed me the pleasure of relistening to the song “The Mother” by Brandi Carlile, in which she sings, “Welcome to the end of being alone inside your mind.” A Mother’s Brain also kindly pointed me to the viral video, “Mother Rat Saves Baby from Snake.”
paras.zh: 这位妈妈发现这本书是母爱快乐的宝库。科学概念与社会和文化脉络交织在一起，从深刻到怪异到深刻。书中的某些段落让我有幸重听布兰迪·卡莱尔的歌曲《母亲》，她在歌中唱道：“欢迎来到你内心孤独的终结。”一位母亲的大脑还好心地向我指出了一段火爆的视频：“鼠妈妈从蛇手中拯救了婴儿。”

paras.en: As one of the foremost scientists studying matrescence, Carmona is an authoritative guide through the latest research, of which there is a dismayingly small amount. Still, the book covers scientific ground including hormones, evolution and brain networks. History, social constructs and the pressures of modern life come into the story, too.
paras.zh: 作为研究基质形成的最重要的科学家之一，卡莫纳是最新研究的权威指南，但这些研究的数量少得令人沮丧。尽管如此，这本书涵盖了科学领域，包括激素、进化和大脑网络。历史、社会结构和现代生活的压力也出现在故事​​中。

paras.en: If you prefer a light read, Carmona will occasionally warn you when a section is scientifically dense. Then she will invite you along anyway. “But if you do like hormones — well, we’re going to have fun,” Carmona writes at the beginning of a chapter. And it was fun. I was shocked to learn, for instance, just how massive the hormonal upheaval during pregnancy is. The amount of estrogen that floods a woman’s body, including her brain, during the 40 weeks of pregnancy is more than that of the amount that would otherwise accumulate over her entire fertile life, which lasts 35 years on average.
paras.zh: 如果您喜欢轻松阅读，卡莫纳偶尔会在某个部分的科学密度很高时向您发出警告。然后她无论如何都会邀请你一起去。 “但如果你确实喜欢荷尔蒙——好吧，我们会玩得很开心，”卡莫纳在章节开头写道。这很有趣。例如，当我得知怀孕期间荷尔蒙的变化有多大时，我感到震惊。在怀孕 40 周期间，女性体内（包括大脑）所分泌的雌激素数量，超过了她整个生育期（平均持续 35 年）所积累的雌激素量。

paras.en: Along the way, Carmona thoughtfully addresses scientific puzzlers such as this: Mothers often report feeling less mentally sharp, yet laboratory studies show almost no neurological decline. Attributed to “mommy brain” or “momnesia,” mental slips might be due to a lack of sleep, or a shifting of attention, or even just an expectation.
paras.zh: 在此过程中，卡莫纳深思熟虑地解决了诸如此类的科学难题：母亲们经常报告感觉精神不那么敏锐，但实验室研究显示几乎没有神经功能下降。被认为是“妈妈脑”或“记忆症”的精神失误可能是由于睡眠不足、注意力转移、甚至只是一种期望造成的。

paras.en: This pervasive, negative stereotype of “mommy brain” can then build on itself, getting stronger as women buy into the incorrect idea that motherhood leaves them dumber. If a woman expects her memory to get worse, she’ll see signs of it in even normal mistakes. “I have watched brilliant women grow so insecure about their intelligence on becoming mothers that they abandon the projects that were once vital to them,” Carmona writes. Assumptions about their diminished brainpower can lead women to pull back from valuable parts of their lives. “It matters — a lot — how we talk to ourselves about these things.”
paras.zh: 这种普遍存在的、消极的“妈妈脑”刻板印象会不断增强，随着女性接受“母性会让她们变得更笨”的错误观念，这种刻板印象会变得更加强烈。如果一个女人预计自己的记忆力会变差，那么即使是正常的错误，她也会看到这种迹象。卡莫纳写道：“我看到才华横溢的女性在成为母亲后对自己的智力变得如此不自信，以至于放弃了曾经对她们至关重要的项目。”对女性脑力下降的假设可能会导致女性放弃生活中有价值的部分。 “我们如何与自己谈论这些事情很重要。”

paras.en: As a mother herself, Carmona brings her experiences into the narrative. It couldn’t be any other way. “Motherhood is lived,” she writes. “It happens in your gut, your identity, your core.”
paras.zh: 作为一名母亲，卡莫纳将她的经历融入到叙述中。不可能有其他方式。 “母性是活生生的，”她写道。 “它发生在你的直觉、你的身份、你的核心。”

paras.en: At its heart, this book is a love letter to moms, who have been invisible to the scientific gaze for too long. It’s time to write a new tale of matrescence, Carmona argues. “A story that recognizes mothers as the essence of the human species, the carriers of knowledge about how we create bonds — and, through them, society and culture.”
paras.zh: 从本质上讲，这本书是一封写给妈妈们的情书，她们已经在科学的视线中消失太久了。卡莫纳认为，是时候写一个新的女性成长故事了。 “这个故事承认母亲是人类的本质，是我们如何建立联系的知识载体，并通过母亲建立社会和文化。”

paras.en: By putting the intense and wild changes of motherhood into words, Carmona offers us a powerful and necessary story.
paras.zh: 通过用语言表达母性的强烈而疯狂的变化，卡莫纳为我们提供了一个有力而必要的故事。

paras.en: Buy A Mother’s Brain from Bookshop.org. Science News is a Bookshop.org affiliate and will earn a commission on purchases made from links in this article.
paras.zh: 从 Bookshop.org 购买《母亲的大脑》。 《科学新闻》是 Bookshop.org 的附属机构，通过本文中的链接进行购买将赚取佣金。

articles.title: An extinct crocodilian was found among rocks that built the Great Sphinx
articles.author: Jake Buehler

paras.en: The Great Sphinx of Giza isn’t the only ancient, stony visage in the area missing its nose.
paras.zh: 吉萨大狮身人面像并不是该地区唯一没有鼻子的古老石像。

paras.en: A fossil crocodilian discovered in the same 45-million-year-old limestone that ancient Egyptians used to build the Sphinx is also missing the tip of its snout. But the broken specimen is intact enough to be reclassified as a new branch of the gavial family tree, which may help uncover these mysterious animals’ evolutionary history, researchers report October 7 in Royal Society Open Science.
paras.zh: 在古埃及人用来建造狮身人面像的同一块 4500 万年前的石灰岩中发现的鳄鱼化石也缺失了鼻子。但研究人员 10 月 7 日在英国皇家学会开放科学杂志上报告称，破碎的标本足够完整，可以被重新分类为鳄类家族树的一个新分支，这可能有助于揭示这些神秘动物的进化历史。

paras.en: Most living crocodilians are in either the crocodile or alligator families. But there are also two species of gavial living in tropical Asia. These are huge, critically endangered, fish-eating crocodilians with long, slender snouts full of needlelike teeth. Fossils of extinct gavials have been found around the world. In 1927, German researchers reported a gavial skull fossil collected from hills near Cairo. The fossil was identified as an extinct species of Tomistoma, a genus found today only as a single species in Southeast Asia.
paras.zh: 大多数现存鳄鱼属于鳄鱼科或短吻鳄科。但也有两种鳄鱼生活在热带亚洲。这些是巨大的、极度濒危的、以鱼为食的鳄鱼，它们长着细长的鼻子，长满了针状的牙齿。世界各地都发现了已灭绝的鳄鱼化石。 1927年，德国研究人员报道了从开罗附近的山上采集到的鳄类头骨化石。该化石被鉴定为已灭绝的 Tomistoma 物种，该属如今仅在东南亚作为单一物种发现。

paras.en: But more recent evolutionary studies including this fossil suggested this classification didn’t fit. In 2023, while working on a doctoral degree at University College London, paleontologist Paul Burke went to Germany to study the fossil in detail. Burke and his colleagues made careful measurements of the skull, using 3-D X-ray methods to measure the insides of the brain and nasal cavities.
paras.zh: 但最近的进化研究（包括这块化石）表明这种分类并不合适。 2023年，古生物学家保罗·伯克在伦敦大学学院攻读博士学位期间，前往德国详细研究这块化石。伯克和他的同事对头骨进行了仔细的测量，使用 3D X 射线方法测量大脑和鼻腔的内部。

paras.en: “As we’ve advanced in the last 100 years, we’ve got so many new methodologies we could implement to figure out what kind of species this fossil is,” says Burke, currently at the Sweden Museum of Natural History in Stockholm.
paras.zh: “随着我们在过去 100 年中取得的进步，我们已经有了很多新的方法可以用来弄清楚这块化石是什么物种，”目前在斯德哥尔摩瑞典自然历史博物馆工作的伯克说。

paras.en: The team compared the measurements to those taken of living and fossil gavials and found that this purported Egyptian Tomistoma was actually an undescribed gavial genus. The researchers named it Herugavialis cairensis, referencing the Egyptian god Heru (or Horus), who has been associated with the Great Sphinx. Coincidentally, the Herugavialis skull is missing the end of its snout — something it shares with the noseless statue.
paras.zh: 研究小组将测量结果与现存的和化石的鳄鱼进行了比较，发现这种所谓的埃及托米斯托马实际上是一种未被描述的鳄鱼属。研究人员将其命名为 Herugavialis cairensis，参考与大狮身人面像有关的埃及神赫鲁（或荷鲁斯）。巧合的是，Herugavialis 头骨缺少鼻子末端——这是它与无鼻子雕像共有的部分。

paras.en: “So many species are found from the same [geologic] formation,” Burke says, including fish, sharks and mammals. “But this is the first one with the name associated with the Sphinx.”
paras.zh: “在同一[地质]构造中发现了如此多的物种，”伯克说，包括鱼类、鲨鱼和哺乳动物。 “但这是第一个与狮身人面像相关的名字。”

paras.en: Today, gavials are only found in freshwater environments. But tens of millions of years ago, the reptiles also inhabited nearshore saltwater environments. Herugavialis appears to have been a coastal predator back when the ancient Tethys Ocean covered northern Egypt.
paras.zh: 如今，鳄鱼只生活在淡水环境中。但数千万年前，爬行动物也栖息在近岸咸水环境中。当古特提斯洋覆盖埃及北部时，Herugavialis 似乎是一种沿海掠食者。

paras.en: Khalafallah Salih, a paleontologist at Al Neelain University in Khartoum, Sudan, says the finding supports the idea that the evolution of gavials and their relatives in Africa was much more complex than researchers thought. Herugavialis doesn’t appear closely related to other known gavial-type crocodilians in Africa or the Mediterranean, he says. It appears to have branched off from the lineage early in its evolution.
paras.zh: 苏丹喀土穆阿尔尼兰大学的古生物学家 Khalafallah Salih 表示，这一发现支持了这样一种观点，即非洲的长吻鳄及其近亲的进化比研究人员想象的要复杂得多。他说，Herugavialis 似乎与非洲或地中海其他已知的鳄类鳄鱼没有密切关系。它似乎在进化的早期就从该谱系中分支出来。

paras.en: Burke notes that gavials barely breach the public consciousness compared to alligators and crocodiles.
paras.zh: 伯克指出，与短吻鳄和鳄鱼相比，长吻鳄几乎没有打破公众的意识。

paras.en: “They’re still alive today and they’re endangered,” he says. “So, we should know about them and their long history.”
paras.zh: “它们今天仍然活着，而且濒临灭绝，”他说。 “所以，我们应该了解它们以及它们悠久的历史。”

articles.title: Scientists Gave People 2 Nearly Identical Meals. One Triggered Much More Insulin.
articles.author: Peter Dockrill

paras.en: You've probably heard a bit about ultra-processed foods by now, and if so, you likely know they're not the healthiest things you can eat.
paras.zh: 您现在可能已经听说过一些有关超加工食品的信息，如果听说过，您可能知道它们不是您可以吃的最健康的食物。

paras.en: These industrially manufactured foods are increasingly being linked to heightened risk of disease, and research suggests they may affect how we think and harm our mental health.
paras.zh: 这些工业制造的食品越来越多地与疾病风险增加联系在一起，研究表明它们可能会影响我们的思维方式并损害我们的心理健康。

paras.en: In light of all the concerning associations scientists are finding, it's easy to assume that ultra-processed foods are unhealthy because they're packed full of nutritionally poor ingredients – but what if there's more to it than that?
paras.zh: 鉴于科学家们发现的所有相关关联，人们很容易认为超加工食品是不健康的，因为它们富含营养不良的成分——但如果还有更多呢？

paras.en: "We know that the majority of ultra-processed foods are high in fat, they're high in sugar, they're low in fiber, and they're low in protein," says neuroscientist Alex DiFeliceantonio from Virginia Tech.
paras.zh: “我们知道，大多数超加工食品的脂肪含量高，糖含量高，纤维含量低，蛋白质含量低，”弗吉尼亚理工大学的神经科学家 Alex DiFeliceantonio 说。

paras.en: "But if we artificially hold all of those things constant, is there something about the processing that leads to a different outcome?"
paras.zh: “但是，如果我们人为地保持所有这些事情不变，是否有一些处理过程会导致不同的结果？”

paras.en: The answer, it seems, is yes, according to a surprising finding reported in Nature Metabolism.
paras.zh: 根据《自然代谢》杂志报道的一项令人惊讶的发现，答案似乎是肯定的。

paras.en: In their study, DiFeliceantonio and her team recruited 57 healthy-weight adults, with an average age of 26 years. Of these, 32 people took part in an eating experiment, in which they ate two separate meals on two separate days, in a randomized order.
paras.zh: 在他们的研究中，DiFeliceantonio 和她的团队招募了 57 名健康体重的成年人，平均年龄为 26 岁。其中 32 人参加了一项饮食实验，他们在两天内按照随机顺序分别吃了两顿饭。

paras.en: The other meal was made up of minimally processed foods, including a hard-boiled egg, banana, cranberries, cheese, and some sea salt.
paras.zh: 另一餐由最低限度加工的食物组成，包括煮鸡蛋、香蕉、蔓越莓、奶酪和一些海盐。

paras.en: The kicker was that these two meals – while very different-looking on the plate – were largely the same from a nutritional perspective, being matched for both nutritional composition and energy (300 calories each).
paras.zh: 令人惊奇的是，这两顿饭虽然在盘子上看起来非常不同，但从营养角度来看基本相同，营养成分和能量都相匹配（每顿 300 卡路里）。

paras.en: "The two meals are matched within 1 percent of carbs, fat, proteins, calories, water, and salt," says Virginia Tech biomedical researcher Zach Hutelin, the study's first author.
paras.zh: “这两顿饭的碳水化合物、脂肪、蛋白质、卡路里、水和盐的比例在 1% 以内，”该研究的第一作者、弗吉尼亚理工大学生物医学研究员扎克·胡特林 (Zach Hutelin) 说。

paras.en: "If these meals had a nutritional label, they would be practically identical."
paras.zh: “如果这些食物有营养标签，它们实际上是相同的。”

paras.en: While their nutritional labels might have been the same, the metabolic responses they triggered turned out to be very different.
paras.zh: 虽然它们的营养标签可能相同，但它们引发的代谢反应却截然不同。

paras.en: A series of blood samples taken during the three hours after each meal showed that blood glucose responses were generally similar for both meals, although glucose remained elevated for longer after the ultra-processed meal.
paras.zh: 每餐后三小时内采集的一系列血液样本显示，两餐的血糖反应总体相似，尽管在超加工餐后血糖仍保持较高水平的时间更长。

paras.en: The contrast in insulin response was more marked, with insulin levels rising significantly higher after the ultra-processed meal and staying higher for about two hours, before both meals returned to near-baseline levels by the three-hour mark.
paras.zh: 胰岛素反应的对比更加明显，超加工餐后胰岛素水平显着升高，并保持较高水平约两个小时，然后两餐均在三小时后恢复到接近基线水平。

paras.en: The ultra-processed meal triggered a higher metabolic rate and greater fat burning during the three-hour observation window, but less carbohydrate burning than the minimally processed foods.
paras.zh: 在三小时的观察期内，超加工食品引发了更高的代谢率和更大的脂肪燃烧，但与最低加工食品相比，碳水化合物的燃烧更少。

paras.en: "We were shocked when every single metabolic metric differed," Hutelin says.
paras.zh: “当每一个代谢指标都不同时，我们感到震惊，”胡特林说。

paras.en: "What we noticed with the ultra-processed food is that insulin response was much higher and blood sugar stays a little bit higher for a little bit longer."
paras.zh: “我们注意到，超加工食品的胰岛素反应要高得多，血糖保持在较高水平的时间也会更长一些。”

paras.en: While we don't know for sure why the metabolic responses were so different, the research offers a few clues.
paras.zh: 虽然我们不确定为什么代谢反应如此不同，但研究提供了一些线索。

paras.en: In a separate experiment, the participants viewed pictures of ultra-processed and non-ultra-processed foods while having their brain activity monitored by functional MRI.
paras.zh: 在另一项实验中，参与者观看了超加工和非超加工食品的图片，同时通过功能性核磁共振监测他们的大脑活动。

paras.en: For the participants who also took part in the meal-eating phase of the experiment, the brain activity showed an association between neural activity in the striatum (a part of the brain involved with reward systems) and how they burned carbohydrates in the meal-eating session.
paras.zh: 对于也参与实验进餐阶段的参与者来说，大脑活动显示纹状体（大脑中与奖励系统有关的部分）的神经活动与他们在进餐过程中如何燃烧碳水化合物之间存在关联。

paras.en: The researchers suggest that this could mean that the way our bodies burn food for fuel is linked to specific cues about the foods we're eating – and, possibly, their level of processing.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为，这可能意味着我们的身体燃烧食物作为燃料的方式与我们所吃食物的特定线索有关，而且可能与食物的加工水平有关。

paras.en: "Collectively, our findings support the hypothesis that food processing might influence metabolic responses and reward processing through mechanisms extending beyond caloric content and macronutrient composition," the researchers explain in a briefing on their study.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究简报中解释说：“总的来说，我们的研究结果支持这样的假设：食品加工可能通过超出热量含量和常量营养素组成的机制影响代谢反应和奖励加工。”

paras.en: "These mechanisms might involve altered nutritional availability as a result of altered physical structure in ultra-processed foods."
paras.zh: “这些机制可能涉及由于超加工食品的物理结构改变而改变的营养可用性。”

paras.en: Another possibility is that commercial food additives incorporated in ultra-processed foods might affect our metabolic response when we eat them, which is something the researchers intend to examine next.
paras.zh: 另一种可能性是，超加工食品中含有的商业食品添加剂可能会影响我们食用这些食品时的代谢反应，这是研究人员下一步打算研究的问题。

paras.en: The findings are reported in Nature Metabolism.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《自然代谢》杂志上。

articles.title: Your Mouth's Bacteria May Be Linked to How Quickly You Think
articles.author: Esra Öz

paras.en: A new study published in PLOS ONE found some intriguing statistical links between bacteria on your tongue and how quickly we process information.
paras.zh: 发表在 PLOS ONE 上的一项新研究发现，舌头上的细菌与我们处理信息的速度之间存在一些有趣的统计联系。

paras.en: Among 60 healthy adults in the UK and Belgium, the abundance of certain tongue bacteria was associated with performance on cognitive tests.
paras.zh: 在英国和比利时的 60 名健康成年人中，某些舌头细菌的丰度与认知测试的表现有关。

paras.en: That might sound weird, but think about this: you swallow a mouthful of beetroot. Some of its nitrate enters your bloodstream, then takes an unexpected detour: back into your mouth.
paras.zh: 这可能听起来很奇怪，但想一想：你吞下了一口甜菜根。它的一些硝酸盐进入您的血液，然后意想不到地绕道：回到您的嘴里。

paras.en: Bacteria on your tongue help transform it into a substance your body can use to make nitric oxide, a molecule that helps blood vessels widen.
paras.zh: 舌头上的细菌有助于将其转化为身体可以用来制造一氧化氮的物质，一氧化氮是一种有助于血管扩张的分子。

paras.en: This small chemical journey is one reason scientists are investigating whether the microbes in our mouths are connected to memory, attention and how quickly we process information.
paras.zh: 这种小小的化学旅程是科学家们研究我们口腔中的微生物是否与记忆、注意力以及我们处理信息的速度有关的原因之一。

paras.en: To understand the link further, researchers led by Joanna E. L'Heureux at the University of Exeter, with colleagues at Vrije Universiteit Brussel, recruited 15 younger and 15 older adults in each country.
paras.zh: 为了进一步了解这种联系，埃克塞特大学 Joanna E. L'Heureux 领导的研究人员与布鲁塞尔自由大学的同事在每个国家招募了 15 名年轻人和 15 名老年人。

paras.en: The younger groups were generally in their twenties, while the older groups averaged in their sixties or seventies.
paras.zh: 年轻群体的平均年龄在二十多岁，而老年群体的平均年龄在六七十岁。

paras.en: Participants completed tests of memory, attention, emotion recognition and processing speed. The team also measured blood pressure and collected blood, saliva and swabs from the tongue.
paras.zh: 参与者完成了记忆力、注意力、情绪识别和处理速度的测试。研究小组还测量了血压，并从舌头上采集了血液、唾液和拭子。

paras.en: All participants were non-smokers; people with recent antibiotic use or an oral disease history were excluded.
paras.zh: 所有参与者均不吸烟；最近使用抗生素或有口腔疾病史的人被排除在外。

paras.en: By identifying the bacteria in those swabs, researchers could compare each person's oral microbial community with their test performance.
paras.zh: 通过识别这些拭子中的细菌，研究人员可以将每个人的口腔微生物群落与其测试表现进行比较。

paras.en: One finding appeared in both countries. People with more of a bacterium called Prevotella histicola responded faster on certain tests, although the tasks differed between countries.
paras.zh: 两国都出现了一项发现。尽管不同国家的任务有所不同，但体内含有较多组织普雷沃氏菌的人在某些测试中反应更快。

paras.en: Another species, Haemophilus parainfluenzae, showed a mixed pattern. In Belgium, it was linked to faster responses on emotion recognition and visual learning tasks, and better working-memory accuracy. In the UK, it was linked to faster responses on some tasks but slower emotion recognition responses.
paras.zh: 另一种物种，副流感嗜血杆菌，则表现出混合模式。在比利时，它与情绪识别和视觉学习任务的更快反应以及更好的工作记忆准确性有关。在英国，它与对某些任务的更快反应有关，但与较慢的情绪识别反应有关。

paras.en: Having more of a particular bacterium therefore did not necessarily mean performing better across all tests.
paras.zh: 因此，拥有更多的特定细菌并不一定意味着在所有测试中表现更好。

paras.en: Age itself was the most consistent predictor of cognitive performance: older age was associated with lower overall scores and slower responses in both countries.
paras.zh: 年龄本身是认知表现最一致的预测因素：在这两个国家，年龄越大，总体得分越低，反应速度越慢。

paras.en: The researchers also found that 17 bacterial species differed in abundance between younger and older adults.
paras.zh: 研究人员还发现，年轻人和老年人之间有 17 种细菌的丰度存在差异。

paras.en: At a broader grouping level, bacteria from the genera Treponema and Tannerella, which include species associated with gum disease, were more abundant in older adults. One nitrate-reducing species was more abundant in younger participants.
paras.zh: 在更广泛的分组水平上，来自密螺旋体属和坦纳氏菌属的细菌（包括与牙龈疾病相关的物种）在老年人中更为丰富。一种硝酸盐还原物质在年轻参与者中更为丰富。

paras.en: But being more common in younger mouths did not automatically make a bacterium a marker of better cognition. That same nitrate-reducing species was also more abundant in the UK group with lower overall test performance.
paras.zh: 但在年轻口腔中更常见的细菌并不能自动成为更好认知的标志。同样的硝酸盐还原物种在英国组中也更丰富，但总体测试性能较低。

paras.en: All participants were healthy and had passed cognitive screening. These differences reflected variation among healthy people, rather than diagnoses of cognitive impairment.
paras.zh: 所有参与者都很健康，并通过了认知筛查。这些差异反映了健康人之间的差异，而不是认知障碍的诊断。

paras.en: Geography was another important part of the picture. The bacterial communities differed between the UK and Belgian participants, even though some age-related patterns appeared in both places.
paras.zh: 地理是这幅图景的另一个重要部分。英国和比利时参与者之间的细菌群落不同，尽管两个地方都出现了一些与年龄相关的模式。

paras.en: The study builds on an earlier study from the same group, published in PNAS Nexus in 2025, which examined oral microbes and nitric oxide biomarkers in older adults, including people with mild cognitive impairment.
paras.zh: 该研究建立在同一小组于 2025 年发表在 PNAS Nexus 上的一项早期研究的基础上，该研究检查了老年人（包括患有轻度认知障碍的人）的口腔微生物和一氧化氮生物标志物。

paras.en: The new research examined whether similar associations appeared across younger and older healthy adults in two countries.
paras.zh: 这项新研究调查了两个国家的年轻和老年健康成年人是否存在类似的关联。

paras.en: Chemical measurements were mixed. In the UK, higher plasma nitrate was linked to better performance on one test but poorer emotion recognition accuracy. Higher nitrite was linked only to slower responses.
paras.zh: 化学测量结果参差不齐。在英国，较高的血浆硝酸盐与一项测试中的更好表现有关，但情绪识别准确性较差。较高的亚硝酸盐仅与较慢的反应有关。

paras.en: The chemical pathway involving oral bacteria is also relevant to research on beetroot and physical performance. Bacteria convert nitrate into nitrite, which can subsequently contribute to nitric oxide production.
paras.zh: 涉及口腔细菌的化学途径也与甜菜根和物理性能的研究相关。细菌将硝酸盐转化为亚硝酸盐，随后有助于一氧化氮的产生。

paras.en: But the new study did not show that this process caused the differences in test performance. Nor did it test whether changing someone's oral bacteria could improve their cognitive performance.
paras.zh: 但新研究并未表明这一过程导致了测试表现的差异。它也没有测试改变某人的口腔细菌是否可以提高他们的认知能力。

paras.en: With just 30 participants in each country, the findings are exploratory. The authors say larger studies are needed to distinguish genuine biological patterns from statistical variability.
paras.zh: 由于每个国家只有 30 名参与者，因此研究结果具有探索性。作者表示，需要进行更大规模的研究来区分真正的生物学模式和统计变异性。

paras.en: Diet was not controlled, and physical activity and sleep were not comprehensively assessed. These could influence both the bacteria in someone's mouth and how they perform on cognitive tests.
paras.zh: 饮食没有控制，体力活动和睡眠没有综合评估。这些可能会影响某人口腔中的细菌以及他们在认知测试中的表现。

paras.en: Data were collected between 2017 and 2019. Belgian samples were transported in liquid nitrogen to the UK; the authors acknowledge storage differences that could introduce variability.
paras.zh: 数据收集于 2017 年至 2019 年期间。比利时样本通过液氮运输至英国；作者承认存储差异可能会带来变异性。

paras.en: The paper describes multiple-comparison corrections for some analyses but not for the regressions linking bacteria to cognitive tests. Testing numerous associations can increase the chance of apparent findings arising by chance.
paras.zh: 该论文描述了一些分析的多重比较校正，但没有描述将细菌与认知测试联系起来的回归。测试多种关联可以增加偶然出现明显发现的机会。

paras.en: The team compared younger and older people rather than following individuals as they aged. It cannot establish whether oral bacteria predict cognitive decline or influence its speed.
paras.zh: 该团队比较了年轻人和老年人，而不是跟踪个人的年龄。它无法确定口腔细菌是否预测认知能力下降或影响其速度。

paras.en: The results therefore do not demonstrate that altering oral microbes prevents dementia, improves memory or slows brain aging.
paras.zh: 因此，结果并不能证明改变口腔微生物可以预防痴呆、提高记忆力或延缓大脑衰老。

paras.en: For now, certain mouth bacteria appear to accompany differences in thinking skills. Whether those microbes help shape the differences, or reflect other influences shared by the mouth and brain, remains to be established.
paras.zh: 目前，某些口腔细菌似乎伴随着思维能力的差异。这些微生物是否有助于形成差异，或者反映了口腔和大脑共有的其他影响，仍有待确定。

paras.en: The research has been published in PLOS ONE.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在 PLOS ONE 上。

articles.title: A Little Fish in The Deep Sea Swallowed a Meal Way Bigger Than Itself. Scientists Caught It on Camera.
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: There's always a bigger fish in the sea.
paras.zh: 海里总有更大的鱼。

paras.en: For most of us, that idiom is a warning – but for one little swimmer in the deep, it's a blessing.
paras.zh: 对于我们大多数人来说，这个成语是一个警告，但对于一个深海游泳者来说，这是一个祝福。

paras.en: The black swallower fish (Chiasmodon niger) is a little creature that grows, on average, just 10-20 centimeters (3.9–7.9 in) long, and no more than a school ruler.
paras.zh: 黑吞鱼 (Chiasmodon niger) 是一种小型生物，平均长度仅为 10-20 厘米（3.9-7.9 英寸），不超过一条鱼。

paras.en: Still, that doesn't stop it from aiming high. This unassuming fish can gulp down prey up to ten times its mass.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这并不能阻止它追求更高的目标。这种不起眼的鱼可以吞下十倍于自身质量的猎物。

paras.en: It's an underdog moment for sure – like if David ate Goliath – and in a spectacularly rare event, scientists just captured it on camera.
paras.zh: 这肯定是一个失败的时刻——就像大卫吃了歌利亚一样——在一个极其罕见的事件中，科学家们用相机捕捉到了这一时刻。

paras.en: During a recent deep-sea dive near the islands of Trinidad and Tobago, a remotely operated vehicle snapped a black swallower fish at 1,259 meters deep, lugging around a stomach so distended it looks like a sidecar.
paras.zh: 最近，在特立尼达和多巴哥群岛附近的一次深海潜水中，一架遥控潜水器在 1,259 米深的地方捕获了一条黑色吞咽鱼，它拖着一个膨胀的胃，看起来像一个跨斗。

paras.en: The skin is stretched almost transparent, to the point where you can actually see its internal organs and intestines.
paras.zh: 皮肤被拉伸得几乎透明，以至于你可以看到它的内部器官和肠道。

paras.en: "[Black swallower fish] are notoriously rare to spot in the wild. I saw my first nearly a decade ago in the Gulf of Mexico," says Diva Amon from the Schmidt Ocean Institute, the chief scientist of the expedition.
paras.zh: “[黑吞鱼]在野外非常罕见。大约十年前，我在墨西哥湾第一次看到了它，”这次探险的首席科学家、施密特海洋研究所的迪瓦·阿蒙 (Diva Amon) 说道。

paras.en: "I never imagined I'd get a second chance. But this expedition delivered BIG."
paras.zh: “我从未想过我会有第二次机会。但这次探险取得了巨大的成果。”

paras.en: Black swallower fish have evolved to make the most of their deep-sea environment, where food is scarce, explains Amon.
paras.zh: 阿蒙解释说，黑吞鱼已经进化到能够充分利用食物稀缺的深海环境。

paras.en: They have a dislocating jaw and a stomach that stretches like a balloon. That way, if they see a tasty morsel swim along, they can swallow it whole, even if it is bigger than themselves.
paras.zh: 它们的下巴脱臼，胃像气球一样伸展。这样，如果它们看到有美味的食物游过，它们就能把它整个吞下去，即使它比它们大。

paras.en: Like the best of us, however, black swallower fish can sometimes bite off more than they can 'chew'.
paras.zh: 然而，就像我们中最优秀的人一样，黑吞鱼有时会咬掉比它们“咀嚼”更多的东西。

paras.en: Most specimens have been found dead at the ocean's surface.
paras.zh: 大多数标本被发现死在海洋表面。

paras.en: If this creature doesn't digest its food fast enough, the meal in its distended stomach can start to decay.
paras.zh: 如果这种生物消化食物的速度不够快，其膨胀的胃中的食物就会开始腐烂。

paras.en: That releases gases that can force it to the surface, like a balloon.
paras.zh: 它会释放出气体，迫使其浮到表面，就像气球一样。

paras.en: In one famous case from 2007, a dead swallower fish just 19 centimeters (7.5 in) long was found in the Cayman Islands, having swallowed a snake mackerel (Gempylus serpens) measuring 86 cm (34 in) in length.
paras.zh: 2007 年的一个著名案例中，在开曼群岛发现了一条长度仅为 19 厘米（7.5 英寸）的死吞鱼，它吞下了一条长度为 86 厘米（34 英寸）的蛇鲭鱼（Gempylus serpens）。

paras.en: The Woods Hole Oceanographic Institution describes the sight of this distended stomach as "a semi-transparent spare tire hanging from their bellies".
paras.zh: 伍兹霍尔海洋研究所将这种膨胀的胃描述为“腹部悬挂着一个半透明的备胎”。

paras.en: This new sighting is extra special because the fish is swimming in its natural habitat, and its stomach is much more distended than in some other live footage.
paras.zh: 这一新的景象格外特别，因为这条鱼在其自然栖息地中游泳，而且它的胃比其他一些现场镜头中的要膨胀得多。

paras.en: The downside is that, deep in the ocean, it's impossible to know what the animal actually ate.
paras.zh: 缺点是，在海洋深处，不可能知道动物到底吃什么。

paras.en: "If only we had a CT scanner at sea," says Amon. "The mystery of what this little guy had for lunch may never be solved."
paras.zh: “如果我们在海上有一台 CT 扫描仪就好了，”阿蒙说。 “这个小家伙午餐吃什么的谜团可能永远无法解开。”

paras.en: This elusive fish and its special use of 'swell dining' remain poorly understood.
paras.zh: 这种难以捉摸的鱼及其“盛宴”的特殊用途仍然知之甚少。

paras.en: Some scientists have speculated that the creature eats its prey tail first, slowly 'walking' the meal back into its belly with its unique set of hooked, backwards-pointing teeth.
paras.zh: 一些科学家推测，这种生物首先吃掉猎物的尾巴，然后用其独特的钩状、向后指向的牙齿慢慢地将猎物“走”回腹部。

paras.en: But unfortunately, that's just speculation based on appearance.
paras.zh: 但不幸的是，这只是基于外观的猜测。

paras.en: Who knows if we will ever see the fish in hunting action.
paras.zh: 谁知道我们是否会看到鱼的狩猎活动。

articles.title: Scientists created a tiny device that can control your nerves to treat chronic pain

paras.en: Scientists created a tiny device that can control your nerves to treat chronic pain
paras.zh: 科学家发明了一种可以控制神经来治疗慢性疼痛的微型装置

paras.en: Scientists have created a seed-sized injectable device that could treat chronic pain and movement disorders without surgery, batteries, or wires.
paras.zh: 科学家们创造了一种种子大小的注射装置，可以治疗慢性疼痛和运动障碍，无需手术、电池或电线。

paras.en: - Scientists have developed a tiny, injectable device that can control nerve activity without surgery, batteries, or wires, potentially transforming treatment for chronic pain and movement disorders. Powered wirelessly from outside the body, the seed-sized technology has shown promising results in early testing.
paras.zh: - 科学家们开发出了一种微型注射装置，无需手术、电池或电线即可控制神经活动，有可能改变慢性疼痛和运动障碍的治疗方法。这项种子大小的技术通过体外无线供电，在早期测试中显示出了可喜的结果。

paras.en: A miniature medical device small enough to be delivered through a standard needle could change how doctors treat chronic pain and movement disorders. Developed by scientists at NYU Abu Dhabi in partnership with Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi, the technology can regulate nerve activity without surgical implantation, batteries, or connecting wires.
paras.zh: 一种足够小、可以通过标准针头输送的微型医疗设备可能会改变医生治疗慢性疼痛和运动障碍的方式。该技术由纽约大学阿布扎比分校的科学家与阿布扎比克利夫兰诊所合作开发，无需手术植入、电池或连接线即可调节神经活动。

paras.en: Roughly the size of a small seed, the device is injected into the body and positioned close to a specific nerve. Once in place, it sends carefully controlled electrical signals that alter the nerve's activity. Power is supplied wirelessly from outside the body, allowing doctors or patients to adjust the stimulation in real time.
paras.zh: 该装置大约有一颗小种子大小，被注入体内并靠近特定神经放置。一旦到位，它就会发送精心控制的电信号来改变神经的活动。从体外无线供电，允许医生或患者实时调整刺激。

paras.en: The findings, published in Science Advances, describe a potentially less invasive way to deliver precise nerve stimulation. Rather than replacing existing treatments, which can include medications and surgically implanted devices, the technology could provide another option tailored to individual medical needs.
paras.zh: 该研究结果发表在《科学进展》上，描述了一种可能的侵入性较小的方法来提供精确的神经刺激。该技术不是取代现有的治疗方法（包括药物和手术植入设备），而是可以提供另一种适合个人医疗需求的选择。

paras.en: "This work represents a shift in how we think about treating nerve-related conditions," said Prof. Khalil Ramadi, Assistant Professor of Bioengineering at NYU Abu Dhabi and NYU Tandon and the study's senior author. "By creating a device that can be injected rather than surgically implanted, we are making these therapies simpler, safer, and more accessible, while still maintaining precise control over nerve activity."
paras.zh: “这项工作代表了我们对治疗神经相关疾病的看法的转变，”纽约大学阿布扎比分校和纽约大学坦登分校的生物工程助理教授、该研究的资深作者哈利勒·拉马迪教授说。 “通过创造一种可以注射而不是手术植入的装置，我们使这些疗法更简单、更安全、更容易获得，同时仍然保持对神经活动的精确控制。”

paras.en: Wireless Nerve Stimulation Without Surgery
paras.zh: 无需手术的无线神经刺激

paras.en: One of the device's key advantages is that doctors can locate and monitor it using familiar imaging techniques, including ultrasound and computed tomography (CT) scans. These methods help guide placement near the intended nerve and allow the device's position to be checked afterward.
paras.zh: 该设备的主要优势之一是医生可以使用熟悉的成像技术（包括超声波和计算机断层扫描（CT）扫描）对其进行定位和监控。这些方法有助于引导放置在预期神经附近，并允许随后检查设备的位置。

paras.en: The implant also provides programmable electrical stimulation. This means the signals it delivers can be adjusted to suit a patient's needs, potentially giving healthcare providers greater flexibility in managing conditions that involve abnormal or unwanted nerve activity.
paras.zh: 植入物还提供可编程的电刺激。这意味着它传递的信号可以根据患者的需求进行调整，从而可能为医疗保健提供者提供更大的灵活性来管理涉及异常或不需要的神经活动的情况。

paras.en: "This collaboration with NYU Abu Dhabi reflects our commitment to advancing innovative, clinically relevant research that translates into meaningful improvements in patient care," said Dr. Sawsan Abdel-Razig, Chief Academic Officer at Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi. "By bringing together multidisciplinary expertise, this work highlights how academic partnerships can accelerate the development of safer, less invasive therapies and expand access to advanced treatments for patients."
paras.zh: 克利夫兰诊所阿布扎比首席学术官 Sawsan Abdel-Razig 博士表示：“与纽约大学阿布扎比分校的合作体现了我们致力于推进创新的、临床相关的研究，从而转化为患者护理方面的有意义的改进。” “通过汇集多学科专业知识，这项工作凸显了学术伙伴关系如何加速开发更安全、侵入性较小的疗法，并扩大患者获得先进治疗的机会。”

paras.en: Promising Early Results for Chronic Pain Treatment
paras.zh: 慢性疼痛治疗的早期结果有希望

paras.en: The researchers evaluated the technology through laboratory experiments and preclinical testing. Their results showed that the miniature device could deliver precise nerve stimulation while maintaining consistent performance under conditions designed to resemble real-world use.
paras.zh: 研究人员通过实验室实验和临床前测试对该技术进行了评估。他们的结果表明，微型设备可以提供精确的神经刺激，同时在类似于现实世界使用的条件下保持一致的性能。

paras.en: The team also demonstrated that the device could successfully activate nerves in vivo, meaning within a living organism rather than only in an isolated laboratory setting. This finding represents an important early step toward determining whether the technology could eventually be used in medical care.
paras.zh: 该团队还证明，该设备可以成功激活体内神经，即在活体生物体内而不是仅在孤立的实验室环境中激活神经。这一发现代表了确定该技术最终是否可以用于医疗保健的重要早期步骤。

paras.en: "This technology has the potential to bridge the gap between non-invasive therapies and traditional implants," said Dr. Mohamed Elsherif, Research Associate at NYU Abu Dhabi and first author of the study. "It opens the door to treatments that are both effective and easy to deliver, which could significantly improve patient care."
paras.zh: “这项技术有潜力弥合非侵入性疗法和传统植入之间的差距，”纽约大学阿布扎比分校研究员、该研究的第一作者 Mohamed Elsherif 博士说。 “它为有效且易于实施的治疗打开了大门，这可以显着改善患者护理。”

paras.en: Although the device has demonstrated promising results in early testing, its ability to relieve chronic pain or improve movement disorders in human patients has not yet been established.
paras.zh: 尽管该设备在早期测试中显示出有希望的结果，但其缓解人类患者慢性疼痛或改善运动障碍的能力尚未确定。

paras.en: If further research confirms its safety and effectiveness, the technology could reduce the need for more invasive procedures while making advanced nerve stimulation treatments easier to deliver. Avoiding surgical implantation could also help decrease procedure-related risks and shorten recovery times, potentially expanding access to these therapies.
paras.zh: 如果进一步的研究证实其安全性和有效性，该技术可以减少对更具侵入性手术的需求，同时使先进的神经刺激治疗更容易实施。避免手术植入还有助于降低手术相关风险并缩短恢复时间，从而有可能扩大获得这些疗法的机会。

paras.en: Additional contributors to the study from NYU Abu Dhabi were Salma Mansour, Zhansaya Makhambetova, Fotoon Aldhanhani, Batoul Khlaifat, Mahmoud Elbeh, Vega Pradana Rachim, and Sohmyung Ha. The Cleveland Clinic Abu Dhabi co-authors were Hicham Abada, Juan S. Barajas-Gamboa, and Carlos M. Abril Vega.
paras.zh: 纽约大学阿布扎比分校的其他贡献者包括 Salma Mansour、Zhansaya Makhambetova、Fotoon Aldhanhani、Batoul Khlaifat、Mahmoud Elbeh、Vega Pradana Rachim 和 Sohmyung Ha。阿布扎比克利夫兰诊所的共同作者是 Hicham Abada、Juan S. Barajas-Gamboa 和 Carlos M. Abril Vega。

paras.en: Materials provided by New York University. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由纽约大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Mohamed Elsherif, Salma Mansour, Zhansaya Makhambetova, Fotoon Aldhanhani, Batoul Khlaifat, Mahmoud Elbeh, Vega Pradana Rachim, Sohmyung Ha, Hicham Abada, Juan S. Barajas-Gamboa, Carlos M. Abril Vega, Khalil B. Ramadi. An injectable, leadless bioelectronic interface for battery-free wireless peripheral neuromodulation. Science Advances, 2026; 12 (24) DOI: 10.1126/sciadv.aeg1437
paras.zh: - Mohamed Elsherif、Salma Mansour、Zhansaya Makhambetova、Fotoon Aldhanhani、Batoul Khlaifat、Mahmoud Elbeh、Vega Pradana Rachim、Sohmyung Ha、Hicham Abada、Juan S. Barajas-Gamboa、Carlos M. Abril Vega、Khalil B. Ramadi。一种可注射、无引线生物电子接口，用于无电池无线外周神经调节。科学进展，2026； 12 (24) DOI：10.1126/sciadv.aeg1437

articles.title: Neanderthals may have used prehistoric glue as an ancient antibiotic

paras.en: Neanderthals may have used prehistoric glue as an ancient antibiotic
paras.zh: 尼安德特人可能使用史前胶水作为古代抗生素

paras.en: - Neanderthals may have used a sticky substance made from birch bark to treat wounds thousands of years before antibiotics existed. Researchers recreated ancient birch tar production techniques and discovered that every sample could inhibit the growth of bacteria responsible for dangerous wound infections. Previously known mainly as a prehistoric glue, birch tar may have doubled as a surprisingly effective natural medicine.
paras.zh: - 在抗生素出现之前数千年，尼安德特人可能已经使用桦树皮制成的粘性物质来治疗伤口。研究人员重现了古老的桦木焦油生产技术，发现每个样品都可以抑制导致危险伤口感染的细菌的生长。桦木焦油以前主要被称为史前胶水，现在可能已成为一种令人惊讶的有效天然药物。

paras.en: Neanderthals may have used a sticky substance made from tree bark not only to construct tools but also to treat wounds and fight bacterial infections. Scientists have discovered that birch tar, a material commonly associated with prehistoric toolmaking, has antibacterial properties that could have made it useful as an ancient form of medicine.
paras.zh: 尼安德特人可能使用树皮制成的粘性物质不仅可以用来制造工具，还可以用来治疗伤口和对抗细菌感染。科学家们发现，桦木焦油是一种通常与史前工具制造有关的材料，具有抗菌特性，可以使其成为一种古老的药物。

paras.en: The findings come from a study conducted by researchers at the University of Cologne, the University of Oxford, the University of Liège, and Cape Breton University in Canada. By recreating techniques believed to have been used by Neanderthals, the team produced birch tar and tested its ability to inhibit harmful bacteria.
paras.zh: 该发现来自科隆大学、牛津大学、列日大学和加拿大布雷顿角大学的研究人员进行的一项研究。通过重建据信尼安德特人使用的技术，该团队生产了桦木焦油并测试了其抑制有害细菌的能力。

paras.en: Their results suggest that this prehistoric adhesive may have served a second, previously overlooked purpose: helping protect wounds from infection.
paras.zh: 他们的研究结果表明，这种史前粘合剂可能还有第二个之前被忽视的用途：帮助保护伤口免受感染。

paras.en: The research was published in PLOS One under the title "Antibacterial properties of experimentally produced birch tar and its medicinal affordances in the Pleistocene."
paras.zh: 该研究发表在《PLOS One》上，标题为“实验生产的桦木焦油的抗菌特性及其在更新世的药用价值”。

paras.en: Ancient Neanderthal Glue May Have Had a Medical Purpose
paras.zh: 古代尼安德特人的胶水可能有医疗用途

paras.en: Birch tar is a thick, sticky substance obtained by heating birch bark. Archaeologists have discovered traces of it at numerous Neanderthal sites across Europe, often still attached to ancient stone tools.
paras.zh: 桦焦油是通过加热桦树皮获得的一种粘稠物质。考古学家在欧洲各地的许多尼安德特人遗址中发现了它的痕迹，通常仍然附着在古代石器上。

paras.en: For decades, these discoveries led researchers to believe that Neanderthals primarily used the material as glue. In particular, birch tar would have helped them attach stone blades or points to wooden handles, a technique known as hafting. This process allowed different components to be joined together to create more practical and effective tools.
paras.zh: 几十年来，这些发现使研究人员相信尼安德特人主要使用这种材料作为胶水。特别是，桦木焦油可以帮助他们将石刀片或石尖固定在木柄上，这种技术被称为“安装”。这个过程允许将不同的组件连接在一起以创建更实用和有效的工具。

paras.en: However, scientists are increasingly exploring whether birch tar played a broader role in prehistoric life.
paras.zh: 然而，科学家们正在越来越多地探索桦木焦油是否在史前生活中发挥了更广泛的作用。

paras.en: "However, new studies suggest that birch tar may also have been used for other purposes," says Tjaark Siemssen of the University of Cologne and Oxford University, who is leading the current study.
paras.zh: “然而，新的研究表明，桦木焦油也可能被用于其他目的，”领导这项研究的科隆大学和牛津大学的 Tjaark Siemssen 说。

paras.en: Evidence from traditional societies around the world shows that birch tar has been used for medicinal purposes as well as other applications. Combined with archaeological discoveries suggesting that Neanderthals used plants and practiced forms of medical care, this raised an intriguing question: Could Neanderthals have recognized the medicinal potential of the same substance they used to make tools?
paras.zh: 来自世界各地传统社会的证据表明，桦木焦油已用于医药目的以及其他用途。考古发现表明尼安德特人使用植物并实行医疗保健，这就提出了一个有趣的问题：尼安德特人是否已经认识到他们用来制造工具的相同物质的药用潜力？

paras.en: "Alongside these findings, there is also growing evidence of medicinal practices and the use of plants among Neanderthals, which is why we were interested in the use of birch tar in this context," says Siemssen.
paras.zh: “除了这些发现之外，还有越来越多的证据表明尼安德特人进行医学实践和使用植物，这就是为什么我们对在这种情况下使用桦木焦油感兴趣，”西姆森说。

paras.en: Recreating the Ancient Methods Used To Make Birch Tar
paras.zh: 重现用于制造桦木焦油的古代方法

paras.en: To investigate, the researchers produced their own birch tar using tree species that were present during the Neanderthal era. Rather than relying on modern industrial processes, they recreated production techniques reconstructed from archaeological evidence associated with Neanderthals.
paras.zh: 为了进行调查，研究人员使用尼安德特人时代存在的树种生产了自己的桦木焦油。他们没有依赖现代工业流程，而是根据与尼安德特人相关的考古证据重建了生产技术。

paras.en: One technique involved placing birch bark inside a sealed underground pit and heating it with little or no oxygen. Under these conditions, the bark undergoes a process called dry distillation, in which heat breaks down the material and releases substances that can be collected as tar.
paras.zh: 一种技术是将桦树皮放入密封的地下坑中，并在很少或没有氧气的情况下对其进行加热。在这些条件下，树皮会经历一个称为干蒸馏的过程，其中热量会分解材料并释放出可作为焦油收集的物质。

paras.en: The team also experimented with a simpler approach that involved burning birch bark near a solid surface, such as a stone. As the bark burned, tar vapors condensed against the cooler surface, leaving behind a sticky residue that could be collected.
paras.zh: 该团队还尝试了一种更简单的方法，即在固体表面（例如石头）附近燃烧桦树皮。当树皮燃烧时，焦油蒸气在较冷的表面凝结，留下可以收集的粘性残留物。

paras.en: These experiments allowed the scientists to investigate whether birch tar made through different prehistoric techniques would have similar antibacterial properties.
paras.zh: 这些实验使科学家能够研究通过不同史前技术制成的桦木焦油是否具有类似的抗菌特性。

paras.en: Prehistoric Birch Tar Shows Antibacterial Activity
paras.zh: 史前桦木焦油显示出抗菌活性

paras.en: The results revealed a potentially important benefit of this ancient material.
paras.zh: 结果揭示了这种古老材料的潜在重要好处。

paras.en: When the researchers tested their samples, every type of birch tar they produced was able to inhibit the growth of Staphylococcus aureus, a bacterium commonly associated with wound infections.
paras.zh: 当研究人员测试他们的样品时，他们生产的每种类型的桦木焦油都能够抑制金黄色葡萄球菌的生长，金黄色葡萄球菌是一种通常与伤口感染相关的细菌。

paras.en: Staphylococcus aureus, often shortened to S. aureus, is particularly important in modern medicine because it can cause serious infections. Some strains have developed resistance to multiple antibiotics and are responsible for difficult-to-treat infections acquired in hospitals.
paras.zh: 金黄色葡萄球菌（通常缩写为金黄色葡萄球菌）在现代医学中特别重要，因为它可以引起严重的感染。一些菌株已经对多种抗生素产生了耐药性，并导致医院内出现难以治疗的感染。

paras.en: Remarkably, the antibacterial activity appeared regardless of which prehistoric extraction technique the researchers used. This suggests that the bacteria-inhibiting properties of birch tar were not dependent on one particular production method.
paras.zh: 值得注意的是，无论研究人员使用哪种史前提取技术，抗菌活性都会出现。这表明桦木焦油的细菌抑制特性并不依赖于一种特定的生产方法。

paras.en: "The findings suggest that antimicrobial properties played a role as far back as the time of the early Neanderthals and could have been used in a targeted manner," explains Siemssen.
paras.zh: “研究结果表明，抗菌特性早在早期尼安德特人时代就发挥了作用，并且可以有针对性地使用，”西姆森解释道。

paras.en: Although the experiments do not prove that Neanderthals actually applied birch tar to wounds, they demonstrate that the material they were capable of producing had properties that could have made it useful for medical care.
paras.zh: 尽管实验并没有证明尼安德特人确实将桦木焦油涂抹在伤口上，但他们证明了他们能够生产的材料具有可用于医疗护理的特性。

paras.en: Could Neanderthal Medicine Offer Clues for Modern Antibiotics?
paras.zh: 尼安德特人医学能为现代抗生素提供线索吗？

paras.en: Beyond revealing another possible dimension of Neanderthal behavior, the discovery may also have implications for modern medicine.
paras.zh: 除了揭示尼安德特人行为的另一个可能维度之外，这一发现还可能对现代医学产生影响。

paras.en: Antibiotic resistance is a growing global health concern. As more bacteria become resistant to commonly used treatments, scientists are searching for additional substances that could help combat infections.
paras.zh: 抗生素耐药性是一个日益严重的全球健康问题。随着越来越多的细菌对常用治疗方法产生抗药性，科学家们正在寻找有助于对抗感染的其他物质。

paras.en: The antibacterial activity of prehistoric birch tar suggests that ancient materials and traditional medicinal practices may deserve closer scientific investigation. Substances used thousands of years ago could contain compounds with properties that remain relevant today.
paras.zh: 史前桦木焦油的抗菌活性表明，古代材料和传统医学实践可能值得更密切的科学研究。数千年前使用的物质可能含有具有今天仍然适用的特性的化合物。

paras.en: However, the ability to inhibit bacteria in laboratory experiments does not necessarily mean that birch tar would be safe or effective as a treatment for human wounds. Further research would be needed to evaluate any potential medical applications.
paras.zh: 然而，在实验室实验中抑制细菌的能力并不一定意味着桦木焦油作为人类伤口的治疗方法是安全或有效的。需要进一步的研究来评估任何潜在的医学应用。

paras.en: "Our findings show that it might be worthwhile to examine targeted antibiotics from ethnographic contexts - or, as in this case, from prehistoric contexts - in greater depth," concludes Siemssen.
paras.zh: 西姆森总结道：“我们的研究结果表明，从人种学背景——或者在本例中，从史前背景——更深入地研究靶向抗生素可能是值得的。”

paras.en: The findings add to a growing body of research portraying Neanderthals as resourceful humans who understood and exploited the natural materials around them. What archaeologists once regarded primarily as prehistoric glue may also have been a useful substance for protecting wounds, offering another intriguing possibility about the origins of human medical knowledge.
paras.zh: 这些发现进一步丰富了越来越多的研究，将尼安德特人描绘成足智多谋的人类，他们理解并利用周围的自然材料。考古学家曾经主要认为是史前胶水的物质也可能是一种保护伤口的有用物质，这为人类医学知识的起源提供了另一种有趣的可能性。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Cologne. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由科隆大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

paras.en: - Tjaark Siemssen, Aderonke Oludare, Marcel Schemmel, Janos Puschmann, Matthias Bierenstiel. Antibacterial properties of experimentally produced birch tar and its medicinal affordances in the Pleistocene. PLOS One, 2026; 21 (3): e0343618 DOI: 10.1371/journal.pone.0343618
paras.zh: - Tjaark Siemssen、Aderonke Oludare、Marcel Schemmel、Janos Puschmann、Matthias Bierenstiel。更新世实验生产的桦木焦油的抗菌特性及其药用价值。 PLOS One，2026 年； 21（3）：e0343618 DOI：10.1371/journal.pone.0343618

articles.title: A plastic once thought harmless may be fueling fatty liver disease

paras.en: A plastic once thought harmless may be fueling fatty liver disease
paras.zh: 曾经被认为无害的塑料可能会加剧脂肪肝疾病

paras.en: Scientists have uncovered a surprising link between one of the world's most common plastics and fatty liver disease, with unhealthy diets potentially making the damage worse.
paras.zh: 科学家发现世界上最常见的塑料之一与脂肪肝之间存在令人惊讶的联系，不健康的饮食可能会使损害更加严重。

paras.en: - One of the world's most common plastics may pose a hidden threat to liver health. Texas A&M researchers discovered that polyethylene microplastics can contribute to fatty liver disease, with potentially worse effects when combined with an unhealthy diet. Even more surprising, this widely used plastic was previously considered relatively harmless.
paras.zh: - 世界上最常见的塑料之一可能对肝脏健康构成潜在威胁。德克萨斯农工大学的研究人员发现，聚乙烯微塑料可能导致脂肪肝疾病，与不健康的饮食相结合可能会产生更严重的影响。更令人惊讶的是，这种广泛使用的塑料以前被认为相对无害。

paras.en: Microplastics have spread into nearly every corner of the environment. These tiny plastic particles have been found in ocean water, drinking water, and even inside the human body. Although their presence is well documented, scientists are still working to understand what prolonged exposure could mean for human health.
paras.zh: 微塑料几乎已经扩散到环境的每个角落。这些微小的塑料颗粒存在于海水、饮用水甚至人体内。尽管它们的存在有据可查，但科学家们仍在努力了解长期接触它们对人类健康意味着什么。

paras.en: Researchers at the Texas A&M College of Veterinary Medicine and Biomedical Sciences (VMBS) have now identified a potential health concern involving polyethylene, one of the most widely used plastics in the world. Their findings suggest that polyethylene microplastics may contribute to fatty liver disease, particularly when exposure occurs alongside an unhealthy diet.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯农工大学兽医和生物医学科学学院 (VMBS) 的研究人员现已发现，聚乙烯是世界上使用最广泛的塑料之一，存在潜在的健康问题。他们的研究结果表明，聚乙烯微塑料可能会导致脂肪肝疾病，特别是当与不健康饮食同时接触时。

paras.en: Polyethylene accounts for approximately one-third of plastic production worldwide. It is used in numerous everyday products, including food wrappers, storage containers, plastic packaging, and the linings of beverage cups. Despite its widespread use, scientists have devoted relatively little attention to its potential effects on the liver compared with other types of microplastics.
paras.zh: 聚乙烯约占全球塑料产量的三分之一。它用于许多日常产品，包括食品包装纸、储存容器、塑料包装和饮料杯的衬里。尽管其用途广泛，但与其他类型的微塑料相比，科学家们对其对肝脏的潜在影响的关注相对较少。

paras.en: "No studies have really looked into polyethylene's effect on liver health, and it's the most widely produced plastic," said Dr. Adi Joshi, associate professor in VMBS' Department of Veterinary Physiology and Pharmacology. "What we now know is that these microplastics, especially polyethylene, affect our liver's natural defense and repair mechanisms."
paras.zh: VMBS 兽医生理学和药理学系副教授 Adi Joshi 博士说：“没有研究真正研究过聚乙烯对肝脏健康的影响，而且它是生产最广泛的塑料。” “我们现在知道，这些微塑料，尤其是聚乙烯，会影响我们肝脏的自然防御和修复机制。”

paras.en: Common Microplastics May Contribute to Fatty Liver Disease
paras.zh: 常见的微塑料可能导致脂肪肝

paras.en: To investigate the possible health effects of polyethylene, Joshi and his colleagues examined whether exposure to this common plastic could promote fatty liver disease.
paras.zh: 为了研究聚乙烯可能对健康产生的影响，乔希和他的同事研究了接触这种常见塑料是否会促进脂肪肝。

paras.en: The condition develops when excessive fat accumulates inside liver cells. According to the American Liver Foundation, it affects approximately 25% of people worldwide, making it a major global health concern.
paras.zh: 当肝细胞内积聚过多脂肪时，就会出现这种情况。据美国肝脏基金会称，它影响着全世界大约 25% 的人，使其成为全球主要的健康问题。

paras.en: The researchers discovered that polyethylene exposure increased indicators of fatty liver disease even without the added influence of an unhealthy diet. When the plastic was combined with a diet rich in fat, fructose, and cholesterol, the signs of liver disease became more severe.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，即使没有不健康饮食的额外影响，聚乙烯暴露也会增加脂肪肝疾病的指标。当塑料与富含脂肪、果糖和胆固醇的饮食相结合时，肝脏疾病的迹象变得更加严重。

paras.en: These results suggest that exposure to environmental pollutants and poor dietary habits may reinforce each other's harmful effects, potentially worsening liver damage.
paras.zh: 这些结果表明，接触环境污染物和不良饮食习惯可能会加剧彼此的有害影响，可能加剧肝脏损伤。

paras.en: "Those who have a more Western-style diet, including foods like burgers and sodas, may have a greater chance of progressing to fatty liver disease if they are also exposed to polyethylene," Joshi said.
paras.zh: 乔希说：“那些饮食习惯更西化的人，包括汉堡和苏打水等食物，如果他们也接触聚乙烯，可能更有可能患上脂肪肝。”

paras.en: The results were especially unexpected because polyethylene has traditionally been regarded as a relatively biologically inert material. In other words, scientists generally considered it less likely to interact with biological systems than more reactive substances.
paras.zh: 结果尤其出人意料，因为聚乙烯传统上被认为是一种相对生物惰性的材料。换句话说，科学家普遍认为它与活性更强的物质相比不太可能与生物系统相互作用。

paras.en: However, the findings indicate that polyethylene may influence liver function in ways that were previously overlooked. Its effects appeared both independently and alongside dietary risk factors, raising important questions about how this common plastic interacts with the body's metabolism and protective mechanisms.
paras.zh: 然而，研究结果表明聚乙烯可能以以前被忽视的方式影响肝功能。它的影响既独立出现，又与饮食风险因素一起出现，引发了关于这种常见塑料如何与人体新陈代谢和保护机制相互作用的重要问题。

paras.en: Scientists Pinpoint How Microplastics Affect the Liver
paras.zh: 科学家查明微塑料如何影响肝脏

paras.en: Understanding where and how polyethylene causes biological changes could help explain its potential role in liver disease.
paras.zh: 了解聚乙烯在何处以及如何引起生物变化有助于解释其在肝病中的潜在作用。

paras.en: To investigate these effects in greater detail, the Texas A&M team partnered with scientists at the University of Oklahoma and applied a powerful technique called spatial transcriptomics.
paras.zh: 为了更详细地研究这些影响，德克萨斯农工大学团队与俄克拉荷马大学的科学家合作，应用了一种称为空间转录组学的强大技术。

paras.en: This technology allows researchers to study gene activity while preserving information about where individual cells are located within a tissue. Rather than simply measuring which genes are active, scientists can identify precisely where biological changes are occurring.
paras.zh: 这项技术使研究人员能够研究基因活性，同时保留有关单个细胞在组织内位置的信息。科学家们不是简单地测量哪些基因处于活跃状态，而是可以准确地识别生物变化发生的位置。

paras.en: Using this approach, the team mapped areas of liver damage associated with polyethylene exposure and identified molecular pathways that may help explain the effects.
paras.zh: 使用这种方法，研究小组绘制了与聚乙烯暴露相关的肝损伤区域，并确定了可能有助于解释其影响的分子途径。

paras.en: One important finding involved PPAR-alpha, a protein that helps regulate fat metabolism in the liver. The researchers found that polyethylene activated this protein, suggesting that it plays a significant role in the liver's response to microplastics.
paras.zh: 一项重要发现涉及 PPAR-α，这是一种有助于调节肝脏脂肪代谢的蛋白质。研究人员发现聚乙烯激活了这种蛋白质，表明它在肝脏对微塑料的反应中发挥着重要作用。

paras.en: They also identified ANXA2, a gene associated with tissue repair, as another possible contributor to the disease process.
paras.zh: 他们还发现 ANXA2（一种与组织修复相关的基因）是疾病过程的另一个可能的促成因素。

paras.en: Together, these discoveries provide a more detailed picture of how polyethylene may interfere with the liver's normal functions, including the mechanisms involved in protecting and repairing damaged tissue.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现提供了聚乙烯如何干扰肝脏正常功能的更详细信息，包括保护和修复受损组织的机制。

paras.en: Joshi believes that understanding these biological pathways could eventually help researchers identify potential treatments that reduce the harmful effects of microplastic exposure.
paras.zh: 乔希认为，了解这些生物途径最终可以帮助研究人员找到减少微塑料暴露有害影响的潜在治疗方法。

paras.en: Could Microplastics Contribute to More Serious Liver Damage?
paras.zh: 微塑料会导致更严重的肝脏损伤吗？

paras.en: Although the findings reveal a previously underexplored connection between polyethylene and fatty liver disease, several important questions remain unanswered.
paras.zh: 尽管研究结果揭示了聚乙烯与脂肪肝之间先前未充分探索的联系，但仍有几个重要问题尚未得到解答。

paras.en: The researchers plan to investigate whether polyethylene exposure could contribute to more advanced forms of liver disease, including fibrosis. This condition occurs when repeated or ongoing liver damage leads to the accumulation of scar tissue, which can interfere with the organ's ability to function properly.
paras.zh: 研究人员计划调查聚乙烯暴露是否会导致更高级的肝病，包括纤维化。当反复或持续的肝脏损伤导致疤痕组织堆积时，就会出现这种情况，这会干扰器官的正常功能。

paras.en: The team also intends to examine other molecular processes involved in the liver's response to polyethylene. One particular focus will be determining whether targeting the PPAR-alpha pathway could help protect the liver against microplastic-related damage.
paras.zh: 研究小组还打算检查肝脏对聚乙烯反应所涉及的其他分子过程。一个特别关注的焦点是确定靶向 PPAR-α 通路是否有助于保护肝脏免受微塑料相关损伤。

paras.en: "This is the pioneering study showing that polyethylene can contribute to fatty liver disease and the use of spatial transcriptomics has determined exactly where the damage has happened within the liver," Joshi said. "The other microplastics might also be harmful to the liver, and we definitely need to look into other classes of microplastics."
paras.zh: 乔希说：“这是一项开创性的研究，表明聚乙烯可能导致脂肪肝疾病，并且空间转录组学的使用已经确定了肝脏内损伤发生的确切位置。” “其他微塑料也可能对肝脏有害，我们绝对需要研究其他类别的微塑料。”

paras.en: The findings add to growing concerns about the possible health consequences of microplastics, although further research is needed to establish how these experimental observations translate to everyday human exposure.
paras.zh: 这些发现加剧了人们对微塑料可能对健康造成的担忧，尽管还需要进一步研究来确定这些实验观察结果如何转化为人类日常接触。

paras.en: For Joshi, the discovery highlights why scientists need to look beyond familiar risk factors such as diet when investigating chronic diseases. As research continues, understanding how common environmental pollutants interact with the body could reveal previously unrecognized contributors to long-term health problems.
paras.zh: 对于乔希来说，这一发现凸显了为什么科学家在研究慢性病时需要超越饮食等熟悉的风险因素。随着研究的继续，了解常见的环境污染物如何与身体相互作用可能会揭示以前未被认识到的长期健康问题的因素。
