articles.title: Terran Orbital Names Jamin Brown Chief Operating Officer
articles.author: Terran Orbital

paras.en: IRVINE, Calif. – Sept. 29, 2026 – Terran Orbital, a Lockheed Martin company and a global leader in satellite-based solutions primarily serving the aerospace and defense industries, today announced the appointment of Jamin Brown as Chief Operating Officer (COO).
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州欧文 – 2026 年 9 月 29 日 – 洛克希德·马丁公司旗下公司、主要服务于航空航天和国防工业的卫星解决方案全球领导者 Terran Orbital 今天宣布任命 Jamin Brown 为首席运营官 (COO)。

paras.en: In this role, Brown will lead Terran Orbital’s operational execution, focusing on increasing production capacity, strengthening operational performance, and enabling the company to deliver at greater speed, scale, and cost efficiency. Based at Terran Orbital’s headquarters in Irvine, California, Brown will work closely with Peter Krauss, President and Chief Executive Officer, as the company prepares to meet growing customer demand.
paras.zh: 在此职位上，布朗将领导 Terran Orbital 的运营执行，重点关注提高产能、加强运营绩效，并使公司能够以更快的速度、更大的规模和更高的成本效率交付产品。布朗将驻扎在加利福尼亚州欧文市的 Terran Orbital 总部，与总裁兼首席执行官彼得·克劳斯 (Peter Krauss) 密切合作，帮助公司做好满足不断增长的客户需求的准备。

paras.en: “Terran Orbital is entering an important phase in our evolution, and our ability to scale while maintaining the agility, innovation, and mission focus that define us will be critical to our success,” said Krauss. “Jamin brings extensive experience leading complex technical organizations and executing some of the most demanding aerospace and defense programs. His operational leadership will help us strengthen execution, increase production, and ensure we are positioned to deliver for our customers as their needs continue to grow.”
paras.zh: 克劳斯说：“Terran Orbital 正在进入我们发展的一个重要阶段，我们在保持敏捷性、创新和任务重点的同时进行扩展的能力对于我们的成功至关重要。” “贾明带来了领导复杂技术组织和执行一些最苛刻的航空航天和国防项目的丰富经验。他的运营领导力将帮助我们加强执行力，增加产量，并确保我们能够随着客户需求的不断增长而为他们提供服务。”

paras.en: Brown joins Terran Orbital from Lockheed Martin Space, where he most recently served as Vice President of Missile Defense Programs and Huntsville Site General Manager. In that role, he led a diverse portfolio delivering integrated missile defense solutions for U.S. government and international military customers, including efforts involving Terminal High Altitude Area Defense (THAAD), Targets and Countermeasures Programs, directed energy, hypersonic defense, and space surveillance.
paras.zh: 布朗在加入人族轨道公司之前曾在洛克希德·马丁航天公司担任导弹防御项目副总裁和亨茨维尔基地总经理。在此职位上，他领导了多元化的产品组合，为美国政府和国际军事客户提供综合导弹防御解决方案，包括末段高空区域防御 (THAAD)、目标和对抗计划、定向能、高超音速防御和太空监视等方面的工作。

paras.en: Brown has more than two decades of experience at Lockheed Martin, beginning his career as an Electronics Engineer before progressing through positions of increasing responsibility across engineering, program management, and operations. His background includes P&L leadership roles, leadership in systems engineering, avionics development, and major program execution.
paras.zh: 布朗在洛克希德·马丁公司拥有二十多年的经验，他的职业生涯始于电子工程师，随后在工程、项目管理和运营等领域担任越来越重要的职务。他的背景包括损益领导角色、系统工程领导、航空电子设备开发和主要项目执行。

paras.en: He previously served as Deputy Vice President of the Hypersonic Strike Weapon Systems mission segment, where he helped lead rapid prototyping and fielding efforts for the Conventional Prompt Strike and Long-Range Hypersonic Weapon programs. Brown also served as Fleet Ballistic Missile Reshaping Site Director in Colorado, leading the transition of personnel and program operations from Sunnyvale, California, to Denver.
paras.zh: 他此前曾担任高超音速打击武器系统任务部分的副总裁，帮助领导常规快速打击和远程高超音速武器项目的快速原型设计和部署工作。布朗还担任科罗拉多州舰队弹道导弹改造基地主任，领导人员和项目运营从加利福尼亚州桑尼维尔到丹佛的过渡。

paras.en: “I’m excited to join Terran Orbital at such an important time for the company and our customers,” said Brown. “Terran Orbital has built a reputation for innovation, agility, and mission-focused execution. I look forward to working alongside Peter and the entire Terran Orbital team to build on that foundation, strengthen our operations and scale our capabilities to meet the growing needs of our customers.”
paras.zh: “我很高兴能在对公司和我们的客户来说如此重要的时刻加入 Terran Orbital，”布朗说。 “Terran Orbital 因创新、敏捷性和以任务为中心的执行力而享有盛誉。我期待着与 Peter 和整个 Terran Orbital 团队合作，在此基础上再接再厉，加强我们的运营并扩展我们的能力，以满足客户不断增长的需求。”

paras.en: Brown holds a Bachelor of Science in Electronics Engineering, a Master of Science in Industrial & Systems Engineering, and an MBA from San Jose State University. He is also a graduate of Stanford University’s Certified Program Manager program.
paras.zh: Brown 拥有圣何塞州立大学电子工程理学学士学位、工业与系统工程理学硕士学位以及 MBA 学位。他还是斯坦福大学认证项目经理项目的毕业生。

paras.en: Terran Orbital is a leading manufacturer of satellite solutions, providing end-to-end mission services for commercial, civil, and government customers. Terran Orbital specializes in designing, manufacturing, and operating advanced small satellites that support Earth observation, national security, and deep-space exploration missions. Terran Orbital is a wholly owned subsidiary of Lockheed Martin.
paras.zh: Terran Orbital 是领先的卫星解决方案制造商，为商业、民用和政府客户提供端到端任务服务。 Terran Orbital 专门从事设计、制造和运营支持地球观测、国家安全和深空探索任务的先进小型卫星。 Terran Orbital 是洛克希德·马丁公司的全资子公司。

articles.title: Commercial Defense Satcom Service Revenues to Surpass $22.6B by 2035
articles.author: Novaspace

paras.en: Paris, France | September 2026 — Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition highlights a defense Satcom market poised for rapid growth. By 2035, commercial satellite service revenues are projected to exceed $22.6 billion, while global defense Satcom demand is forecast to surpass 7.5 Tbps, driven by the adoption of next-generation non-geostationary orbit (NGSO) constellations.
paras.zh: 法国巴黎 | 2026 年 9 月——Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版强调了国防卫星通信市场即将快速增长。到 2035 年，商业卫星服务收入预计将超过 226 亿美元，而在下一代非对地静止轨道 (NGSO) 星座采用的推动下，全球国防卫星通信需求预计将超过 7.5 Tbps。

paras.en: As defense organizations prioritize mobility, situational awareness, and network resilience, satellite communications are becoming a core element of modern military architectures, driving investment in secure, resilient connectivity for mission-critical operations.
paras.zh: 随着国防组织优先考虑移动性、态势感知和网络弹性，卫星通信正在成为现代军事架构的核心要素，推动对关键任务行动的安全、弹性连接的投资。

paras.en: “The growing adoption of distributed satcom architectures is rapidly enhancing military satcom resilience against disruption, jamming, and kinetic attacks,” notes Santiago Perez, Senior Manager at Novaspace. “As defense users increasingly adopt multi-orbit connectivity strategies, NGSO constellations will play a pivotal role in delivering the capacity, low latency, and resilience required for future military operations.”
paras.zh: Novaspace 高级经理圣地亚哥·佩雷斯 (Santiago Perez) 表示：“分布式卫星通信架构的日益普及正在迅速增强军用卫星通信抵御干扰、干扰和动能攻击的能力。” “随着国防用户越来越多地采用多轨道连接策略，NGSO 星座将在提供未来军事行动所需的容量、低延迟和弹性方面发挥关键作用。”

paras.en: NGSO service revenues are expected to reach $21.3 billion by 2035, supported by a 34% CAGR. Although GEO revenues will decline from $2.3 billion in 2025 to $1.3 billion in 2035, GEO capacity demand is forecast to triple, underscoring its strategic importance within hybrid, multi-orbit networks.
paras.zh: NGSO 服务收入预计到 2035 年将达到 213 亿美元，复合年增长率为 34%。尽管 GEO 收入将从 2025 年的 23 亿美元下降到 2035 年的 13 亿美元，但 GEO 容量需求预计将增加两倍，凸显其在混合多轨道网络中的战略重要性。

paras.en: The United States is expected to remain the largest defense Satcom market through 2035, accounting for more than 50% of global demand and 48% of revenues. China is projected to follow with around 30% of global demand and revenues, reinforcing the central role of satellite communications in the military modernization efforts of the world’s leading powers.
paras.zh: 预计到 2035 年，美国仍将是最大的国防卫星通信市场，占全球需求的 50% 以上和收入的 48% 以上。预计中国将占据全球约 30% 的需求和收入，从而加强卫星通信在世界主要大国军事现代化努力中的核心作用。

paras.en: “What we’re witnessing is not simply a shift in satellite capacity demand. This is a fundamental evolution in military communications,” adds Perez. “Multi-orbit connectivity is becoming the foundation of modern defense networks and will shape procurement, operations, and strategic planning for years to come.”
paras.zh: “我们看到的不仅仅是卫星容量需求的变化。这是军事通信的根本性演变，”佩雷斯补充道。 “多轨道连接正在成为现代国防网络的基础，并将影响未来几年的采购、运营和战略规划。”

paras.en: Novaspace’s Satellite Communications for Defense and Security, 2nd Edition delivers a comprehensive analysis of the military Satcom market, examining key industry trends and the evolving balance between supply and demand for broadband satellite communications. The report provides detailed qualitative and quantitative insights by region, military force, orbit, and frequency band, alongside profiles of the leading commercial satellite systems supporting defense and security operations.
paras.zh: Novaspace 的国防和安全卫星通信第二版对军用卫星通信市场进行了全面分析，研究了关键行业趋势以及宽带卫星通信供需之间不断变化的平衡。该报告提供了按地区、军事力量、轨道和频段详细的定性和定量见解，以及支持国防和安全行动的领先商业卫星系统的概况。

paras.en: Novaspace is the leading independent consulting and market intelligence firm dedicated to the global space sector. Leveraging over 40 years of industry expertise, the company supports public and private stakeholders across the entire space value chain with high-impact, data-driven advisory services, combining management and technology consulting, market intelligence, and executive summits to help organizations navigate complexity, manage risk, and capture growth opportunities.
paras.zh: Novaspace 是致力于全球航天领域的领先独立咨询和市场情报公司。该公司利用 40 多年的行业专业知识，通过高影响力、数据驱动的咨询服务，结合管理和技术咨询、市场情报和高管峰会，为整个空间价值链的公共和私人利益相关者提供支持，帮助组织应对复杂性、管理风险并抓住增长机会。

paras.en: Trusted by more than 1,200 clients in over 60 countries, Novaspace operates globally with offices in Bangalore, Brussels, London, Montreal, Munich, Paris, São Paulo, Singapore, Sydney, Tokyo, Toulouse, and Washington, D.C.
paras.zh: Novaspace 深受 60 多个国家 1,200 多名客户的信赖，在全球范围内开展业务，在班加罗尔、布鲁塞尔、伦敦、蒙特利尔、慕尼黑、巴黎、圣保罗、新加坡、悉尼、东京、图卢兹和华盛顿特区设有办事处。

articles.title: Quantum Space Executes Launch Processing Agreement with All Points Logistics for Prime Mission
articles.author: Quantum Space

paras.en: ROCKVILLE, Md. and MERRITT ISLAND, Fla. — September 30, 2026 — Quantum Space, LLC (the “Company” or “Quantum Space”), a company developing the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security and commercial missions, today announced that it has executed a new spacecraft processing work order with All Points Logistics, LLC (“All Points”) for the launch campaign for Quantum Space’s Prime mission.
paras.zh: 马里兰州罗克维尔和佛罗里达州梅里特岛 - 2026 年 9 月 30 日 - Quantum Space, LLC（“公司”或“Quantum Space”）是一家为国家安全和商业任务开发下一代先进机动航天器的公司，今天宣布它已与 All Points Logistics, LLC（“All Points”）执行了一项新的航天器处理工作订单，用于 Quantum Space 的 Prime 任务的发射活动。

paras.en: Prime is a pathfinder mission for the Company’s Ranger and Scout platform and will help the Company evaluate spacecraft performance, payload hosting, and data collection. Quantum Space has completed a Systems Integration Review for the mission and is targeting the second half of 2027 for launch. Under the agreement, All Points will provide specialized spacecraft processing services in preparation for the launch, including clean-room facilities, propellant servicing support, launch-site safety and operational reviews, ground support activities, and transportation to the launch vehicle integration facility. The work is scheduled to support Prime launch preparations in 2027.
paras.zh: Prime 是该公司 Ranger 和 Scout 平台的探路者任务，将帮助该公司评估航天器性能、有效载荷托管和数据收集。 Quantum Space 已完成该任务的系统集成审查，并计划于 2027 年下半年发射。根据协议，All Points 将提供专门的航天器处理服务，为发射做准备，包括洁净室设施、推进剂服务支持、发射场安全和操作审查、地面支持活动以及运载火箭集成设施的运输。这项工作计划支持 2027 年 Prime 的推出准备工作。

paras.en: “This agreement comes as Prime moves into the detailed planning and execution stage required to successfully conduct a launch campaign,” said Kerry Wisnosky, President of Quantum Space. “Many activities must come together between completing a spacecraft and getting it safely integrated onto a launch vehicle, and All Points brings the specialized infrastructure, people and launch-site experience required to help us execute that process.”
paras.zh: Quantum Space 总裁 Kerry Wisnosky 表示：“这项协议的签署正值 Prime 进入成功开展发射活动所需的详细规划和执行阶段。” “在完成航天器和将其安全地集成到运载火箭上之间必须进行许多活动，而 All Points 提供了帮助我们执行该过程所需的专业基础设施、人员和发射场经验。”

paras.en: The new work order builds upon an existing Master Services Agreement between the two companies. It establishes a specific scope of work for the Prime mission, focused on ground processing and launch-site activities required for Prime at Vandenberg Space Force Base in California, representing another concrete step toward launch.
paras.zh: 新的工作订单建立在两家公司之间现有的主服务协议的基础上。它为 Prime 任务确定了具体的工作范围，重点关注 Prime 任务在加利福尼亚州范登堡太空部队基地所需的地面处理和发射场活动，这代表着发射又迈出了具体的一步。

paras.en: “Supporting Prime is exactly the type of mission where All Points’ launch infrastructure and spacecraft processing capabilities can make a difference,” said Phil Monkress, President and CEO of All Points Logistics. “We are pleased to expand our relationship with Quantum Space and support their team as Ranger Prime advances toward launch.”
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 总裁兼首席执行官 Phil Monkress 表示：“支持 Prime 正是 All Points 的发射基础设施和航天器处理能力可以发挥作用的任务类型。” “我们很高兴扩大与 Quantum Space 的关系，并在 Ranger Prime 即将发射之际为他们的团队提供支持。”

paras.en: Prime will be the first of Quantum Space’s high-performance class spacecraft, being developed to provide customers with significant maneuverability, long-duration operations and the ability to host and support a broad range of national security and commercial missions.
paras.zh: Prime 将成为 Quantum Space 高性能级航天器中的第一艘，其开发目的是为客户提供显着的机动性、长期运行以及托管和支持广泛的国家安全和商业任务的能力。

paras.en: “Securing our launch-site processing capability is another important element of mitigating execution risk as we move Prime toward flight,” Wisnosky added. “Our focus now is on completing the spacecraft, executing the environmental test campaign and moving through launch integration and ultimately to on-orbit operations.”
paras.zh: Wisnosky 补充道：“在我们将 Prime 推向飞行的过程中，确保我们的发射场处理能力是降低执行风险的另一个重要因素。” “我们现在的重点是完成航天器、执行环境测试活动并进行发射集成并最终进入在轨运行。”

paras.en: Quantum Space is building the next generation of advanced maneuverable spacecraft for national security, civil, and commercial space operations. Its highly maneuverable spacecraft are being designed to address the needs of national security and commercial operators. With patented propulsion, extended on-orbit endurance, and modular flexibility, these platforms are being engineered to outmaneuver legacy satellites and operate dynamically across diverse mission sets. For more information, visit www.quantumspaceinc.com.
paras.zh: 量子空间公司正在为国家安全、民用和商业太空运营建造下一代先进的可操纵航天器。其高度机动的航天器旨在满足国家安全和商业运营商的需求。凭借获得专利的推进力、延长的在轨续航力和模块化灵活性，这些平台的设计目的是超越传统卫星，并在不同的任务集中动态运行。欲了解更多信息，请访问 www.quantumspaceinc.com。

paras.en: Established in 1997 as a service-disabled veteran-owned small business (SDVOSB), All Points Logistics has operations in multiple states and has grown into a leading solution provider to a diverse array of government and commercial customers, with award-winning expertise in software development, IT services, modeling and simulation, launch support services, and integrated logistics. Learn more at allpointsllc.com.
paras.zh: All Points Logistics 成立于 1997 年，是一家退伍军人拥有的小型企业 (SDVOSB)，在多个州开展业务，现已发展成为面向各类政府和商业客户的领先解决方案提供商，在软件开发、IT 服务、建模和模拟、启动支持服务和综合物流方面拥有屡​​获殊荣的专业知识。如需了解更多信息，请访问 allpointsllc.com。

paras.zh: 本新闻稿包含的某些陈述并非历史事实，但可能被视为《1933 年证券法》修订案（“证券法”）第 27(a) 条和《1934 年证券交易法》修订案第 21(e) 条含义内的“前瞻性陈述”。前瞻性陈述通常附有“相信”、“可能”、“将”、“估计”、“继续”、“预期”、“打算”、“预期”、“应该”、“会”、“计划”、“预测”、“潜力”、“似乎”、“寻求”、“未来”、“展望”等词语或这些术语的否定词或其变体或预测或指示未来事件的类似术语或表达。或趋势或不是历史事件的陈述。这些前瞻性陈述包括但不限于有关未来事件的陈述、Inflection Point Acquisition Corp. VI（“Inflection Point”）、Quantum Space 及其其他方之间拟议的业务合并（“业务合并”）、业务合并后合并后公司（“新 Quantum Space”）的估计或预期未来结果和收益，包括以下内容的可能性和能力： 量子空间和拐点成功完成业务合并、新量子空间的未来机会以及其他非历史事实的陈述。这些陈述基于拐点和/或量子空间管理层的当前预期，并非对实际业绩的预测。这些前瞻性陈述仅供说明之用，无意作为且不得被任何投资者视为保证、保证、预测或事实或概率的明确陈述。实际事件和情况很难或不可能预测，并且会与假设有所不同。许多实际事件和情况超出了拐点和量子空间的控制范围。这些陈述受到有关 Quantum Space 业务和业务合并的许多风险和不确定性的影响，实际结果可能存在重大差异。这些风险和不确定性包括但不限于：发生可能导致终止与业务相关的任何最终协议的任何事件、变化或其他情况 组合;在宣布企业合并及任何相关最终协议后，可能针对 Inflection Point、Quantum Space、合并后的公司或其他方提起的任何法律诉讼的结果；由于未能获得股东批准、未能获得完成业务合并的融资或其他交割条件而无法完成业务合并；根据适用的法律或法规，或作为获得企业合并监管部门批准的条件，可能需要或适当地对企业合并的拟议结构进行变更；新量子空间在业务合并完成后满足证券交易所上市标准的能力；由于业务合并的宣布和完成而导致业务合并扰乱量子空间当前计划和运营的风险； Quantum Space 无法成功完成其旗舰车辆 Ranger 的开发，该车辆目前正在开发中，迄今为止尚未制造、运营或销售，也无法满足 Quantum Space 的要求 设计标准，包括其预期燃料容量、具有可加油和模块化架构以及长达 15 年的使用寿命；新量子空间认识到业务合并的预期收益的能力，该收益可能会受到竞争等因素的影响，新量子空间发展和管理增长的能力，维持与客户和供应商的关系以及保留其管理层和关键员工的能力；与企业合并相关的成本；适用法律或法规的变更； Quantum Space 或合并后的公司可能受到其他经济、业务和/或竞争因素不利影响的可能性； Inflection Point 股东提出的赎回请求金额；量子空间卫星系统安全性能不理想或量子空间设施发生安全事件；卫星市场未能实现量子空间预期的增长潜力；任何延迟发射、发射失败、量子空间卫星未能到达计划轨道位置以及与卫星发射相关的成本大幅增加；处理， 在量子空间运营中生产和处置潜在爆炸性和可燃性高能材料以及其他危险化学品； Quantum Space 的产品无法按预期方式运行或其产品存在缺陷；与 Quantum Space 客户签订的合同的交易对手风险以及 Quantum Space 的主承包商未能维持与交易对手的关系并履行其合同义务；未能成功抵御其他政府合同投标人的抗议；与 Quantum Space 开展业务的各个政府实体的资金水平发生变化；以及已向美国证券交易委员会（“SEC”）提交或即将提交的拐点和/或量子空间文件中讨论的其他风险和不确定性。上述风险因素列表并不详尽。可能存在拐点和量子空间目前不知道的或拐点和量子空间目前认为无关紧要的其他风险，这些风险也可能导致实际结果与前瞻性陈述中包含的结果不同。此外， 前瞻性陈述提供了拐点和量子空间对未来事件的预期、计划或预测以及截至本新闻稿发布之日的观点。拐点和量子空间预计后续事件和发展将导致他们的评估发生变化。然而，虽然拐点和量子空间可能选择在未来更新这些前瞻性陈述，但拐点和量子空间明确表示不承担任何这样做的义务。这些前瞻性陈述不应被视为代表 Inflection Point 或 Quantum Space 在本新闻稿发布后任何日期的评估。因此，不应过度依赖前瞻性陈述。本文中的任何内容均不应被视为任何人表示本文中提出的前瞻性陈述将会实现或此类前瞻性陈述的结果将会实现。

articles.title: NASA Announces Bold Science Initiatives for America’s Golden Age Summit
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: Editor’s note: This release was updated Oct. 8, 2026 with the formal name of the summit.
paras.zh: 编者注：本新闻稿于 2026 年 10 月 8 日更新，并使用了峰会的正式名称。

paras.en: NASA is launching two new science and technology initiatives to deepen scientific understanding and accelerate the innovation that will shape America’s future in space.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局正在启动两项新的科学和技术举措，以加深科学理解并加速创新，从而塑造美国在太空的未来。

paras.en: The initiatives are announced in conjunction with the White House Office of Science and Technology Policy’s (OSTP) “Science: A Golden Age Summit” in Washington on Thursday with top U.S. agency leaders. The programs reflect NASA’s commitment to pioneering research and transformative technologies and advancing the Trump Administration’s vision as outlined in the July report to the President, Science: A New Golden Age. One focuses on peer review and the other on fellowship researchers.
paras.zh: 这些举措是与白宫科学技术政策办公室 (OSTP) 于周四在华盛顿举行的“科学：黄金时代峰会”与美国最高机构领导人一起宣布的。这些计划反映了 NASA 对开拓性研究和变革性技术的承诺，并推进特朗普政府在 7 月份向总统提交的报告《科学：新黄金时代》中概述的愿景。一个侧重于同行评审，另一个侧重于研究员研究人员。

paras.en: “NASA has a proud history of pursuing bold ideas and achieving the near impossible,” said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. “Under President Trump’s leadership, we are building on that legacy by creating new opportunities for great science, experimenting with how we evaluate and accelerate the best ideas, and investing in the next generation of researchers through the Genesis Mission Fellowships. We are entering a new Golden Age of American innovation and discovery, and NASA will be at the forefront.”
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 表示：“NASA 有着追求大胆想法和实现几乎不可能的目标的光荣历史。” “在特朗普总统的领导下，我们正在继承这一遗产，为伟大的科学创造新的机会，尝试如何评估和加速最好的想法，并通过创世任务奖学金投资下一代研究人员。我们正在进入美国创新和发现的新黄金时代，而美国宇航局将走在最前沿。”

paras.en: During a fireside chat, Isaacman and Michael Kratsios, assistant to the President for science and technology and director of OSTP, will discuss the following:
paras.zh: 在炉边谈话中，Isaacman 和总统科技助理兼 OSTP 主任 Michael Kratsios 将讨论以下内容：

paras.en: - Establishing a coordinated metascience initiative within NASA’s Science Mission Directorate to strengthen the reliability, efficiency, transparency, and overall productivity of the agency’s scientific practices. As part of this effort, NASA is expanding the agency’s use of dual anonymous peer review to ensure proposals are evaluated solely on their intrinsic scientific merit. This approach enhances fairness and supports innovative and unconventional research ideas. Started as a pilot program during the first Trump Administration, this initiative has helped position NASA as a leader in advancing best practices in scientific review.
paras.zh: - 在 NASA 科学任务理事会内建立协调的元科学计划，以加强该机构科学实践的可靠性、效率、透明度和整体生产力。作为这项努力的一部分，美国宇航局正在扩大该机构对双重匿名同行评审的使用，以确保提案仅根据其内在的科学价值进行评估。这种方法增强了公平性并支持创新和非常规的研究想法。该计划作为特朗普第一届政府期间的试点计划启动，帮助美国国家航空航天局 (NASA) 成为推进科学审查最佳实践的领导者。

paras.en: - NASA will support 10 Genesis Mission Fellows, who are accelerated doctoral students with dual competencies in super intelligence (SI) and science or engineering. Fellows will work directly on NASA mission areas and conduct research at NASA laboratories, advancing SI-enabled scientific discovery. The fellowships will be based on NASA’s successful Future Investigators in NASA Earth and Space Science and Technology program.
paras.zh: - NASA 将支持 10 名创世纪任务研究员，他们是具有超级智能 (SI) 和科学或工程双重能力的加速博士生。研究员将直接在 NASA 任务领域工作，并在 NASA 实验室进行研究，推进 SI 支持的科学发现。该奖学金将基于美国宇航局成功的“美国宇航局地球和空间科学与技术未来调查员”计划。

paras.en: NASA leads the nation in space exploration, scientific discovery, and technological innovation. Through these new initiatives, NASA will continue to inspire the world and drive progress in science and technology.
paras.zh: NASA 在太空探索、科学发现和技术创新方面处于全国领先地位。通过这些新举措，NASA 将继续激励世界并推动科学技术进步。

paras.en: camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov / elizabeth.a.shaw@nasa.gov
paras.zh: camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov / elizabeth.a.shaw@nasa.gov

articles.title: NASA Briefing to Highlight Contributions to Martian Moons Mission
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: Media are invited to join NASA for a media teleconference at 4 p.m. EDT, Thursday, Oct. 15, to preview the agency’s contributions to JAXA’s (Japan Aerospace Exploration Agency) Martian Moons eXploration (MMX) mission. The mission is scheduled to launch from JAXA’s Tanegashima Space Center in Japan on Monday, Oct. 19 EDT (Tuesday, Oct. 20 JST).
paras.zh: NASA 邀请媒体参加下午 4 点举行的媒体电话会议。美国东部时间 10 月 15 日星期四，预览该机构对 JAXA（日本宇宙航空研究开发机构）火星卫星探索 (MMX) 任务的贡献。该任务计划于美国东部时间 10 月 19 日星期一（日本标准时间 10 月 20 日星期二）从日本 JAXA 种子岛航天中心发射。

paras.en: Audio of the media teleconference will stream on the agency’s website at:
paras.zh: 媒体电话会议的音频将在该机构的网站上播放：

paras.en: Participants in the briefing, who will provide an overview of the mission and NASA’s contributions, include:
paras.zh: 简报会的参与者将概述此次任务和 NASA 的贡献，包括：

paras.en: - Lindsay Hays, acting director, Planetary Science Division, NASA Headquarters in Washington
paras.zh: - Lindsay Hays，美国宇航局华盛顿总部行星科学部代理主任

paras.en: - Tom Statler, MMX program executive and scientist, Planetary Science Division, NASA Headquarters
paras.zh: - Tom Statler，NASA 总部行星科学部 MMX 项目主管兼科学家

paras.en: - David Lawrence, MEGANE (Mars-moon Exploration with Gamma-rays and Neutrons) principal investigator, Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory
paras.zh: - David Lawrence，MEGANE（伽马射线和中子火星月球探索）首席研究员，约翰霍普金斯大学应用物理实验室

paras.en: - Kris Zacny, vice president, Blue Origin’s Honeybee Robotics
paras.zh: - Kris Zacny，蓝色起源蜜蜂机器人公司副总裁

paras.en: Media interested in participating by phone must RSVP no later than two hours prior to the start of the teleconference to Molly Wasser at molly.l.wasser@nasa.gov. A copy of NASA’s media accreditation policy is online.
paras.zh: 有兴趣通过电话参加的媒体必须在电话会议开始前两小时内通过 molly.l.wasser@nasa.gov 回复 Molly Wasser。美国宇航局媒体认证政策的副本已在线发布。

paras.en: The MMX spacecraft will arrive at Mars in August 2027 to begin its survey of the Red Planet’s two moons, Phobos and Deimos. After surveying Phobos in detail, the spacecraft will collect a sample of the moon’s surface no earlier than December 2028 and deliver it to Earth in 2031. NASA’s contributions to the mission include the MEGANE gamma-ray and neutron spectrometer, the spacecraft’s surface sampler mechanism, and communications and navigation support from the agency’s Deep Space Network, as well as funding United States scientists participating on the MMX science team.
paras.zh: MMX 航天器将于 2027 年 8 月抵达火星，开始对这颗红色星球的两颗卫星火卫一和火卫二进行勘测。在详细勘察火卫一后，该航天器将在 2028 年 12 月之前收集月球表面样本，并于 2031 年将其传送到地球。NASA 对此次任务的贡献包括 MEGANE 伽马射线和中子光谱仪、航天器的表面采样器机构、来自该机构深空网络的通信和导航支持，以及资助参与 MMX 科学团队的美国科学家。

paras.en: The MEGANE instrument was developed by Johns Hopkins Applied Physics Laboratory. Honeybee Robotics, a Blue Origin company, developed the spacecraft’s pneumatic sampler mechanism. NASA’s contributions to the MMX mission were funded by the agency’s Discovery Program, which provides frequent flight opportunities for high-value, focused planetary science investigations. The Discovery Program is managed by NASA’s Marshall Space Flight Center in Huntsville, Alabama, for the agency’s Science Mission Directorate in Washington.
paras.zh: MEGANE 仪器由约翰·霍普金斯应用物理实验室开发。蓝色起源公司旗下的蜜蜂机器人公司开发了航天器的气动采样器机构。 NASA 对 MMX 任务的贡献由该机构的发现计划资助，该计划为高价值、重点突出的行星科学研究提供频繁的飞行机会。发现计划由美国宇航局位于阿拉巴马州亨茨维尔的马歇尔太空飞行中心为该机构位于华盛顿的科学任务理事会管理。

paras.zh: 有关 MMX 任务的更多信息，请访问：

articles.title: Floodwaters Overwhelm Thailand

paras.en: September falls in the heart of the monsoon season in Thailand, where cities and towns are accustomed to the afternoon rains and thunderstorms that frequently roll through. But throughout late September and early October 2026, persistent heavy rains punctuated by intense downpours left low-lying areas across the country in Southeast Asia under sustained flooding.
paras.zh: 九月正值泰国季风季节的中心，那里的城镇习惯于下午经常下雨和雷暴。但2026年9月末至10月初，持续暴雨夹杂着倾盆大雨，导致东南亚全国低洼地区遭受持续洪涝灾害。

paras.en: Prachin Buri province was among the areas where flooding was widespread. The right image above shows land along the Bang Pakong River and nearby agricultural areas and aquaculture facilities inundated on October 2, 2026. The left image shows the same area at the same time of year in 2025. Acquired with NASA-USGS Landsat satellites, the images are false-color to better distinguish water from vegetation, developed land, and other surfaces. The bright red shapes are floating solar arrays.
paras.zh: 巴真府是洪水泛滥的地区之一。上右图显示了 2026 年 10 月 2 日被淹没的 Bang Pakong 河沿岸土地以及附近的农业区和水产养殖设施。左图显示了 2025 年同一时间的同一区域。这些图像是通过 NASA-USGS Landsat 卫星获取的，是假彩色的，以便更好地区分水与植被、发达土地和其他表面。鲜红色的形状是漂浮的太阳能电池阵列。

paras.en: Some of the flooding likely stemmed from a low-pressure system that stalled over the area for several days in late September. Stoked by moisture and energy from the warm Gulf of Thailand nearby, the system delivered especially intense rains to the region. About 100 kilometers (60 miles) to the west, Bangkok received nearly 300 millimeters (11.8 inches) of rain over a 48-hour period, according to news reports, close to the average monthly rainfall total for September of 344 millimeters (13.5 inches).
paras.zh: 部分洪水可能是由于九月下旬该地区的低压系统停滞了几天造成的。在附近温暖的泰国湾的湿气和能量的推动下，该系统给该地区带来了特别强的降雨。据新闻报道，在以西约 100 公里（60 英里）处，曼谷在 48 小时内降雨量接近 300 毫米（11.8 英寸），接近 9 月份平均月降雨量 344 毫米（13.5 英寸）。

paras.en: Since mid-September, flooding has occurred in 50 provinces across the country, affecting over 4 million people and causing dozens of deaths, according to the International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies. Government agencies estimate about 270,000 hectares (670,000 acres) of farmland, including rice fields and fruit orchards, have been damaged.
paras.zh: 据红十字会与红新月会国际联合会统计，自9月中旬以来，全国50个省份发生洪涝灾害，受灾人数超过400万人，数十人死亡。政府机构估计约 270,000 公顷（670,000 英亩）农田遭到破坏，其中包括稻田和果园。

paras.en: NASA Earth Observatory images by Lauren Dauphin, using Landsat data from the U.S. Geological Survey. Story by Lindsey Doermann.

articles.title: 'Very scary!' - Antonelli relieved Verstappen is not in F1 title fight

paras.en: Kimi Antonelli relieved Max Verstappen is not in 2026 F1 title fight after Red Bull driver dominates Singapore GP
paras.zh: 红牛车手统治新加坡大奖赛后，基米·安东内利松了一口气，马克斯·维斯塔潘没有参加 2026 年 F1 冠军争夺战

paras.en: Max Verstappen made it back-to-back wins with a dominant victory at the Singapore Grand Prix; Kimi Antonelli can win the drivers' title next time out in Austin and is relieved Verstappen is not closer; watch the US Grand Prix from October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1
paras.zh: 马克斯·维斯塔潘在新加坡大奖赛上以压倒性优势取得了背靠背胜利；基米·安东内利（Kimi Antonelli）下次在奥斯汀就能赢得车手冠军，这让维斯塔潘（Verstappen）没有更接近而感到欣慰；观看 10 月 23 日至 25 日天空体育 F1 直播的美国大奖赛

paras.en: Kimi Antonelli says it would be "very scary" if Max Verstappen was a championship rival after the Red Bull driver won the last two Formula 1 races.
paras.zh: 基米·安东内利表示，在红牛车手赢得最后两场一级方程式比赛后，如果马克斯·维斯塔潘成为冠军竞争对手，那将“非常可怕”。

paras.en: Verstappen scored maximum points across the Sprint weekend in Singapore to add to his victory earlier this month in Malaysia but, unlike last year, is too far back to make a championship charge.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在新加坡冲刺周末取得了最高分，为本月早些时候在马来西亚的胜利增添了色彩，但与去年不同的是，他距离冠军头衔还差得太远。

paras.en: In fact, Antonelli could wrap up the title at the next race in Austin on October 23-25, live on Sky Sports F1, if he outscores Mercedes team-mate George Russell by 23 points and Ferrari's Lewis Hamilton by 14 points.
paras.zh: 事实上，如果安东内利的得分超过梅赛德斯队友乔治·拉塞尔 23 分和法拉利车队的刘易斯·汉密尔顿 14 分，他就可以在 10 月 23 日至 25 日在奥斯汀举行的下一场比赛中夺得冠军，比赛由天空体育 F1 直播。

paras.en: Antonelli had another damage limitation weekend in Singapore but still finished on the podium in third after a good strategy call by Mercedes to give him fresh soft tyres to overtake McLaren's Lando Norris and Hamilton late on in Sunday's race.
paras.zh: 安东内利在新加坡的周末再次受到损伤限制，但在梅赛德斯采取了良好的策略后，他仍然以第三名的成绩登上了领奖台，为他提供了新的软胎，以便在周日的比赛中超越迈凯轮的兰多·诺里斯和汉密尔顿。

paras.en: It was an unexpected result given the new upgrades, which Mercedes introduced in Malaysia, were not giving the major performance gain the team expected.
paras.zh: 这是一个意想不到的结果，因为梅赛德斯在马来西亚推出的新升级并没有给车队带来预期的主要性能提升。

paras.en: "It would be very scary!" Antonelli told Sky Sports F1 when asked if he is glad Verstappen is not in this year's championship battle.
paras.zh: “那会非常可怕！”当被问及维斯塔潘没有参加今年的冠军争夺战是否感到高兴时，安东内利告诉天空体育F1。

paras.en: "All in all I feel like we are doing a great job. At the end, you look at the season, and we have always been there.
paras.zh: “总而言之，我觉得我们做得很好。最后，你看看这个赛​​季，我们一直都在那里。

paras.en: "Obviously we have had a great car and now we are trying to understand this new package. I'm very proud of the team this weekend because we pushed through the difficulties and started to see life at the end of the tunnel. It's just a matter of time.
paras.zh: “显然，我们拥有一辆很棒的赛车，现在我们正在尝试了解这个新套件。这个周末我为车队感到非常自豪，因为我们克服了困难，并开始看到隧道尽头的生活。这只是时间问题。

paras.en: "Now we go to Austin, a normal weekend, where we can hopefully do a lot of changes and understand the package more."
paras.zh: “现在我们去奥斯汀，一个正常的周末，我们希望可以在那里做很多改变并更多地了解这个方案。”

paras.en: Antonelli, 20, is set to break Sebastian Vettel's record of being the youngest F1 world champion and has six races to get over the line.
paras.zh: 20 岁的安东内利有望打破塞巴斯蒂安·维特尔 (Sebastian Vettel) 保持的最年轻 F1 世界冠军纪录，并且还有六场比赛需要冲线。

paras.en: Mercedes team principal Toto Wolff is usually cautious with his expectations but even he admits Antonelli is almost certainly going to win the title.
paras.zh: 梅赛德斯车队领队托托·沃尔夫通常对自己的期望持谨慎态度，但即使他也承认安东内利几乎肯定会赢得冠军。

paras.en: "You look at the numbers and ask the probability of him winning, and it's probably almost 100 per cent. But it's motor racing, you can break down, you can have accidents, and then things could start to stress," he told Sky Sports F1.
paras.zh: “你看看这些数字，然后问他获胜的概率，可能几乎是 100%。但这是赛车运动，你可能会崩溃，你可能会发生事故，然后事情可能会开始变得紧张，”他告诉天空体育 F1。

paras.en: "So, I think we need to look at it race by race, make sure that we are continuing to score the points, and eventually hopefully it's going to come towards him."
paras.zh: “所以，我认为我们需要逐场比赛地看待它，确保我们继续得分，并最终希望它会降临到他身上。”

paras.en: Verstappen: Maybe Lambiase was happy radio was not working!
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘：也许兰比亚斯很高兴收音机坏了！

paras.en: Red Bull's recent resurgence appears to have ended Mercedes' large dominance over the season, although Verstappen's win in Singapore was not straightforward as he was unable to talk to the team for the whole race.
paras.zh: 红牛最近的复苏似乎结束了梅赛德斯在本赛季的巨大统治地位，尽管维斯塔潘在新加坡的胜利并不容易，因为他无法在整场比赛中与车队交谈。

paras.en: Verstappen, who has won at every track on the calendar apart from Madrid, could hear his engineer Gianpiero Lambiase, but not the other way around.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘在除了马德里之外的所有赛道上都取得了胜利，他可以听到他的工程师吉安皮耶罗·兰比亚斯的声音，但反之则不然。

paras.en: "Maybe he was happy that it was not working! I couldn't really say anything. He did try at one point to ask me a few things in code, and I think he understood well what I meant or did not do," said Verstappen.
paras.zh: “也许他很高兴它不起作用！我真的什么也说不出来。他确实曾经尝试用代码问我一些事情，我认为他很好地理解了我的意思或没有做的事情，”维斯塔潘说。

paras.en: "But it's never nice. I've been having difficulty with my radio already the whole season, and this weekend has been particularly bad."
paras.zh: “但这从来都不是一件好事。整个赛季我的收音机都出现了问题，这个周末尤其糟糕。”

paras.en: The biggest threat to Verstappen's win came at the start from Charles Leclerc as Red Bull have been poor off the line throughout 2026.
paras.zh: 维斯塔潘获胜的最大威胁来自查尔斯·勒克莱尔，因为红牛在整个 2026 年的表现都很差。

paras.en: However, Verstappen got a good enough launch to move to the inside and pinch Leclerc, forcing the Ferrari driver to brake early and back out of the move.
paras.zh: 然而，维斯塔潘的起步足够好，可以移动到内侧并夹住勒克莱尔，迫使法拉利车手提前刹车并退出移动。

paras.en: "The start was critical, so that was just good enough. Something was not particularly right at the start, so I need to understand what went wrong there," he said.
paras.zh: “起步很关键，所以这已经足够好了。一开始有些事情不太对劲，所以我需要了解哪里出了问题，”他说。

paras.en: "Before releasing the clutch, it didn't feel good. But it was just good enough. Then we had a few laps with some deployment issues, so that's where Charles almost got me actually into Turn 7.
paras.zh: “在松开离合器之前，感觉不太好。但已经足够好了。然后我们在几圈中遇到了一些部署问题，所以这就是查尔斯差点让我真正进入第 7 号弯的地方。

paras.en: "Once we had cleared the deployment problems, it was fine. The car was really good on the tyres. I could really manage them well.
paras.zh: “一旦我们解决了部署问题，就很好了。这辆车的轮胎非常好。我真的可以很好地管理它们。

paras.en: "But to be honest, I think it was one of the first times that I've driven in clean air here in Singapore in the race, so I guess that's also nice.
paras.zh: “但说实话，我认为这是我第一次在新加坡的比赛中在干净的空气中驾驶，所以我想这也很好。

paras.en: "It's been just a fantastic weekend for us. I mean, we were flying on the soft, we were okay on the medium, and then of course with the VSC, I think it was right what Charles did with pitting and going back on a soft tyre. But, we just had it under control and of course, really happy to win here."
paras.zh: “这对我们来说是一个美妙的周末。我的意思是，我们在软胎上飞行，在中性胎上表现还不错，当然还有VSC，我认为查尔斯进站和使用软胎返回的做法是正确的。但是，我们只是控制住了局面，当然，很高兴在这里获胜。”

articles.title: Defiant Man City issue on-field statement by beating 10-man Liverpool

paras.en: Liverpool vs Manchester City; Premier League
paras.zh: 利物浦对阵曼城；英超联赛

paras.en: Liverpool vs Manchester City. Premier League.
paras.zh: 利物浦对阵曼城。英超联赛。

paras.en: Liverpool 0-3 Man City: Premier League leaders make defiant statement with Anfield victory in first match since guilty verdict
paras.zh: 利物浦0-3曼城：英超领头羊发表挑衅声明，安菲尔德在有罪判决后首场比赛获胜

paras.en: Report and free match highlights as Manchester City beat 10-man Liverpool 3-0 at Anfield; Merseyside trip was City's first game since guilty verdict on all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules; Ryan Gravenberch's red card proved to be the turning point
paras.zh: 报道曼城在安菲尔德 3-0 击败 10 人利物浦的免费比赛集锦；默西塞德之行是曼城自所有严重违反英超财务规则的指控被判有罪以来的第一场比赛；瑞恩·格拉文伯奇的红牌被证明是转折点

paras.en: Manchester City shut out all the noise and controversy to overcome a hostile Anfield atmosphere and beat 10-man Liverpool 3-0 on their return to Premier League action.
paras.zh: 曼城排除了所有噪音和争议，克服了安菲尔德的敌对气氛，以 3-0 击败 10 人利物浦，重返英超联赛。

paras.en: The trip to Merseyside was City's first game after an independent commission found them guilty of all charges related to serious breaches of Premier League financial rules. The club have since appealed the verdict and continue to deny any wrongdoing.
paras.zh: 默西塞德之行是独立委员会认定曼城犯有与严重违反英超财务规则有关的所有指控后的第一场比赛。此后，俱乐部对判决提出上诉，并继续否认有任何不当行为。

paras.en: The City players were welcomed by a chorus of boos for both their warm-ups and ahead of kick-off as they settled into the Anfield cauldron. However, they would end up silencing the crowd after a Ryan Gravenberch red card shortly after the hour mark allowed them to seize control.
paras.zh: 当曼城球员们在热身和开球前进入安菲尔德球场时，都受到了一片嘘声的欢迎。然而，在比赛结束后不久，瑞安·格拉文伯奇（Ryan Gravenberch）被红牌罚下，他们最终控制了比赛，让观众保持沉默。

paras.en: The game mirrored the atmosphere in the early stages - frantic. The visitors were run ragged and on the receiving end of some strong tackles as the game threatened to boil over in the opening exchanges.
paras.zh: 这场比赛反映了早期阶段的气氛——疯狂。客队在开场比赛中表现不佳，并遭受了一些强力铲球，比赛有可能爆发。

paras.en: By half-time, City had managed to settle themselves and the crowd down. However, with Liverpool attacking The Kop in the second half, Enzo Maresca's men had to weather the storm all over again.
paras.zh: 半场结束时，曼城已经成功地让自己和观众安静下来。然而，随着利物浦在下半场攻击科普队，恩佐·马雷斯卡的球队不得不再次度过难关。

paras.en: Gianluigi Donnarumma was on his toes to keep out multiple vicious strikes, but then came the turning point. Gravenberch was shown a second yellow card for a foul on Jeremy Doku. Up until that point, City's xG was just 0.16. From then on, the floodgates opened.
paras.zh: 吉安路易吉·多纳鲁马（Gianluigi Donnarumma）保持警惕，抵御了多次恶意攻击，但转折点随后到来。格拉文贝赫因对杰里米·多库犯规而被出示第二张黄牌。在那之前，曼城的 xG 仅为 0.16。从此，闸门打开了。

paras.en: Two minutes and 36 seconds after the sending off, Erling Haaland emphatically put City ahead before Doku and Rayan Cherki turned on the style as the Premier League leaders sent a message about what they are still capable of on the pitch.
paras.zh: 被罚下场后 2 分 36 秒，埃尔林·哈兰德大力帮助曼城取得领先，随后多库和拉扬·切尔基开启了比赛风格，英超领头羊传达了他们在球场上仍有能力的信息。

paras.en: City's ruthlessness means they remain the only team to make a perfect start to the league campaign, with Andoni Iraola's Reds already nine points adrift following their first defeat.
paras.zh: 曼城的残酷意味着他们仍然是唯一一支在联赛中取得完美开局的球队，安多尼·伊劳拉的红军在首场失利后已经落后九分。

paras.en: 'Pep who? - Keane impressed by Man City 'statement'
paras.zh: '佩普谁？ - 基恩对曼城的“声明”印象深刻

paras.en: "There have been lots of statements made over the last few weeks, but the team made a statement today.
paras.zh: “过去几周发表了很多声明，但团队今天发表了声明。

paras.en: "The sending off was a big help but you still have to show your quality. The three goals were fantastic.
paras.zh: “被罚下是一个很大的帮助，但你仍然必须展示你的实力。这三个进球太棒了。

paras.en: "It will be a big boost to City. They have had a good start to the season, great for [Enzo Maresca].
paras.zh: “这对曼城来说将是一个巨大的推动。他们本赛季有一个良好的开局，这对恩佐·马雷斯卡来说很棒。

paras.en: "You're thinking, 'Pep who?' at this stage. It's not even been mentioned the concerns we had when Pep left or Rodri.
paras.zh: “你在想，‘佩普是谁？’在这个阶段。甚至没有提到佩普或罗德里离开时我们所担心的问题。

paras.en: "Doku made a big difference going at people. He basically changed the game [off the bench] on top of the sending off."
paras.zh: “多库在对抗人方面发挥了很大作用。除了被罚下之外，他基本上还[替补]改变了比赛。”

articles.title: Miracle in London as Jaguars beat Eagles with field goal as time expires

paras.en: NFL in London: Cam Little kicks game-winning field goal as Jacksonville Jaguars beat Philadelphia Eagles 19-17 in Tottenham Hotspur Stadium thriller
paras.zh: NFL 在伦敦举行：在托特纳姆热刺体育场惊悚片中，杰克逊维尔美洲虎队以 19-17 击败费城老鹰队，卡姆·利特尔 (Cam Little) 射入制胜一球

paras.en: Cam Little kicks 57-yard field goal as time expires to give Jacksonville win over Philadelphia; Eagles kicker Jake Elliott had hit 48-yarder for lead with 12 seconds remaining; game had a record Tottenham Hotspur NFL attendance of 61,322
paras.zh: 比赛结束时，卡姆·利特尔 (Cam Little) 射门 57 码，杰克逊维尔队战胜费城队；老鹰队踢球手杰克·埃利奥特 (Jake Elliott) 在比赛还剩 12 秒时打出 48 码取得领先；这场比赛创下 NFL 托特纳姆热刺队上座人数纪录，达 61,322 人

paras.en: Cam Little kicked a 57-yard field goal as time expired to give the Jacksonville Jaguars a 19-17 win over the Philadelphia Eagles in a miraculous ending at the Tottenham Hotspur Stadium.
paras.zh: 在托特纳姆热刺球场，卡姆·利特尔 (Cam Little) 在比赛时间结束时踢出一记 57 码射门，帮助杰克逊维尔美洲虎队 (Jacksonville Jaguars) 以 19-17 战胜费城老鹰队 (Philadelphia Eagles)，奇迹般地结束了比赛。

paras.en: Jaguars quarterback Trevor Lawrence threw a 27-yard touchdown to Parker Washington on fourth down with under four minutes remaining to give them a 16-14 lead, and when they forced the Eagles to punt with two minutes left, the win looked all but secure.
paras.zh: 美洲虎队四分卫特雷弗·劳伦斯在比赛还剩不到 4 分钟时，在第四次落后时向帕克·华盛顿传出 27 码达阵，帮助他们以 16-14 领先，当他们在比赛还剩两分钟时迫使老鹰队弃踢时，胜利看起来几乎稳操胜券。

paras.en: But when Jalen Hurts led the Eagles 32 yards downfield in nine plays to set up a Jake Elliott 48-yard field goal with 12 seconds to go, the Eagles-heavy crowd celebrated what appeared to be a 17-16 Philadelphia win in London.
paras.zh: 但当贾伦·赫茨在九场比赛中带领老鹰队前场 32 码，在比赛还剩 12 秒时为杰克·埃利奥特 (Jake Elliott) 48 码射门得分时，老鹰队的大批观众在伦敦庆祝费城队以 17-16 获胜。

paras.zh: 在劳伦斯的出色表现后，美洲虎队本赛季取得 4 胜 1 负的战绩，看起来完全是超级碗的有力竞争者。
