articles.title: Pope Leo says he will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV announced Sunday that he will undergo surgery to remove an early-stage nodule on his lung.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世周日宣布，他将接受手术切除肺部的早期结节。

paras.en: The Vatican said the procedure was planned for this week.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈表示，程序计划于本周进行。

paras.en: “Recently, during some medical tests, doctors discovered a localized nodule in my lung,” the American pontiff, 71, said during his noon prayer at St. Peter’s Square.
paras.zh: “最近，在一些医学检查中，医生在我的肺部发现了一个局部结节，”71 岁的美国教宗在圣彼得广场的中午祈祷中说道。

paras.en: “It was detected at a very early stage and is well localized,” Leo said from the window of the Apostolic Palace. “The doctors believe it is best to intervene, so, following their advice, I have decided to undergo surgery to have it removed.”
paras.zh: “它是在很早的阶段就被发现的，并且定位得很准确，”利奥在使徒宫的窗户里说道。 “医生认为最好进行干预，因此，按照他们的建议，我决定接受手术将其切除。”

paras.en: The pontiff said that surgery had already been scheduled “for the coming days,” and thanked onlookers for their support.
paras.zh: 教宗表示，手术已安排在“未来几天”，并感谢旁观者的支持。

paras.en: “I entrust myself to your prayers,” he said.
paras.zh: “我将自己托付给你们的祈祷，”他说。

paras.en: The news drew applause from the thousands gathered in the square, before he wished the crowd a “happy Sunday.”
paras.zh: 这一消息引起了聚集在广场上的数千人的掌声，然后他祝愿人群“周日快乐”。

paras.en: Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni said in a statement that “the operation is scheduled for the first days of this week and the estimated post-operative recovery time will be about one week.”
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈发言人马泰奥·布鲁尼在一份声明中表示，“手术计划于本周头几天进行，预计术后恢复时间约为一周。”

paras.en: Leo announced the surgery at the end of his regular address, in which he appealed for an end to the war in Ukraine and the safe transport of grain across the Black Sea.
paras.zh: 利奥在例行讲话结束时宣布了这一手术，他在讲话中呼吁结束乌克兰战争并安全地穿越黑海运输粮食。

paras.en: “The daily bread of millions of people cannot be held hostage by war,” he said.
paras.zh: “数百万人的日常面包不能被战争劫持，”他说。

paras.en: Leo has no previously known health problems and is known to be physically active, including weekly games of tennis.
paras.zh: 狮子座以前没有已知的健康问题，并且身体活跃，包括每周打网球。

paras.en: The pontiff has a major trip scheduled to visit Uruguay, Argentina and Peru in November. It’s unclear whether the planned surgery and recovery would affect the itinerary.
paras.zh: 教宗计划于十一月进行一次重要访问，访问乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁。目前尚不清楚计划中的手术和康复是否会影响行程。

paras.en: Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni wished Leo well.
paras.zh: 意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼祝利奥一切顺利。

paras.en: “I would like to express to the Holy Father my personal support, and that of the Italian government, as he faces this challenge in the coming days,” she said in a statement.
paras.zh: 她在一份声明中说：“我想向教宗表达我个人和意大利政府的支持，因为他在未来几天将面临这一挑战。”

paras.en: “The serenity and composure with which he spoke about it (today) ...are reassuring,” Meloni added.
paras.zh: “他（今天）谈论这件事时的平静和镇定......令人放心，”梅洛尼补充道。

paras.en: Born Robert Francis Prevost, he became the first American pope when he was appointed in 2025.
paras.zh: 他原名罗伯特·弗朗西斯·普雷沃斯特 (Robert Francis Prevost)，于 2025 年被任命为第一位美国教皇。

paras.en: Originally from the South Side of Chicago, he spent much of his career ministering in Peru and leading the Vatican’s powerful office of bishops.
paras.zh: 他来自芝加哥南区，职业生涯的大部分时间都在秘鲁传教，并领导梵蒂冈强大的主教办公室。

paras.en: Leo’s father, Louis Prevost, served in the Navy during World War II and worked as a superintendent of schools in the south suburbs of Chicago. His mother, Mildred Martinez Prevost, was a librarian with a master’s degree in education and two sisters who were nuns.
paras.zh: 利奥的父亲路易斯·普雷沃斯特在第二次世界大战期间在海军服役，并担任芝加哥南郊学校的校长。他的母亲米尔德里德·马丁内斯·普雷沃斯特 (Mildred Martinez Prevost) 是一名图书管理员，拥有教育学硕士学位，两个姐妹都是修女。

paras.en: Leo’s predecessor, Pope Francis, died of a stroke last April at age 88 after a long hospitalization following a number of health issues.
paras.zh: 利奥的前任教皇方济各在因一系列健康问题长期住院后于去年四月因中风去世，享年 88 岁。

articles.title: Trump claims Russia and Ukraine agree to energy ceasefire, but Zelenskyy says this is ‘news for me’
articles.author: Freddie Clayton

paras.en: President Donald Trump claimed Sunday that Ukraine and Russia have agreed to an “energy ceasefire” as part of the ongoing conflict. There was no immediate confirmation from Moscow, while Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy reportedly said this “was news for me.”
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周日声称，乌克兰和俄罗斯已同意“能源停火”，作为持续冲突的一部分。莫斯科没有立即证实这一消息，而据报道，乌克兰总统泽连斯基表示，这“对我来说是新闻”。

paras.en: Trump made a similar announcement a month ago, only for the two sides to continue their aerial attacks on each other’s energy facilities.
paras.zh: 特朗普一个月前也曾发表过类似的声明，结果双方继续对对方的能源设施进行空袭。

paras.en: “Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine,” Trump posted on Truth Social on Sunday morning. “Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” He did not elaborate further on what the ceasefire might include.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争实现能源停火，立即生效，”特朗普周日上午在“真相社会”上发帖称。 “双方已经约定，不可破坏！”他没有进一步详细说明停火可能包括哪些内容。

paras.en: Zelenskyy told Axios that he knew nothing about a ceasefire deal.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基告诉 Axios，他对停火协议一无所知。

paras.en: “But if Russians agree to an energy ceasefire Ukraine will agree,” Zelenskyy said, according to Axios. “If President Trump negotiated it with [Russian President Vladimir] Putin — please tell us when the ceasefire begins — we are ready and we will accept it.”
paras.zh: 据 Axios 报道，泽连斯基表示：“但如果俄罗斯同意能源停火，乌克兰也会同意。” “如果特朗普总统与[俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔]普京进行了谈判——请告诉我们停火何时开始——我们已经准备好了，我们会接受它。”

paras.en: NBC News has reached out to Zelenskyy’s office for further comment.
paras.zh: NBC 新闻已联系泽伦斯基办公室寻求进一步评论。

paras.en: It follows a dramatic few days in which Trump agreed to a diesel deal with the Kremlin, demanded Kyiv halt attacks on Russian oil refineries and called for Zelenskyy to be replaced. The shift left Kyiv and its European allies reeling.
paras.zh: 此前几天发生了戏剧性的事件，特朗普同意与克里姆林宫达成柴油协议，要求基辅停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，并要求泽伦斯基被替换。这一转变让基辅及其欧洲盟友感到震惊。

paras.en: The U.S. agreed Friday to lift sanctions on Russian fuel in a deal that Trump said would see Russia “immediately” release 300,000 tons of diesel “to the American and global marketplace,” followed by 500,000 tons in November and another million after that.
paras.zh: 美国周五同意解除对俄罗斯燃料的制裁，特朗普表示，俄罗斯将“立即”向美国和全球市场释放 30 万吨柴油，随后在 11 月释放 50 万吨，之后再释放 100 万吨。

paras.en: After strong criticism from Zelenskyy, Trump said Saturday: “I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal, because he could have made many deals.”
paras.zh: 在遭到泽连斯基的强烈批评后，特朗普周六表示：“我建议他们找一位能够达成协议的新领导人，因为他本可以达成很多协议。”

paras.en: Trump has sought to blame the Ukraine conflict, rather than his own assault on Iran, for a global fuel shortage that has driven diesel prices to record highs since the U.S. launched the Middle East war in February.
paras.zh: 特朗普试图将全球燃料短缺归咎于乌克兰冲突，而不是他自己对伊朗的攻击，自美国二月份发动中东战争以来，全球燃料短缺导致柴油价格创下历史新高。

paras.en: Zelenskyy reiterated Sunday that he was ready to halt strikes on Russian refineries if the Kremlin halts its own attacks on Ukraine’s energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周日重申，如果克里姆林宫停止对乌克兰能源基础设施的袭击，他准备停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击。

paras.en: “We are ready for energy ceasefire, not to attack energy — both sides,” he said in interview on ABC News’ “This Week.” He added that if Russia wants an energy ceasefire, “we are open for this.”
paras.zh: 他在接受美国广播公司新闻频道“本周”采访时表示：“我们已经做好能源停火的准备，而不是攻击能源——双方。”他补充说，如果俄罗斯希望实现能源停火，“我们对此持开放态度。”

paras.en: “Don’t attack us,” he said. “Don’t kill our children. We will stop attack your diesel.”
paras.zh: “不要攻击我们，”他说。 “不要杀死我们的孩子。我们将停止攻击你们的柴油机。”

paras.en: The Ukrainian president also told ABC News he would hold elections if Russia agreed to a 60-day ceasefire.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统还告诉美国广播公司新闻，如果俄罗斯同意 60 天停火，他将举行选举。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said “it’s up to Ukrainians” to choose their leader and noted that Putin would also like to change who is leading Ukraine.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示“由乌克兰人”选择他们的领导人，并指出普京也希望改变乌克兰的领导者。

paras.en: He said it is easy for Ukraine to be blamed for higher fuel prices “when everybody in the world understands [that] because of the war in [the] Middle East, the prices are rising.”
paras.zh: 他表示，乌克兰很容易因油价上涨而受到指责，“当世界上每个人都明白，由于中东战争，油价正在上涨。”

paras.en: Zelenskyy was also asked on ABC News why Trump and Elon Musk blamed the Ukrainian president for the war’s continuation.
paras.zh: 美国广播公司新闻还问泽伦斯基为什么特朗普和埃隆·马斯克将战争的持续归咎于乌克兰总统。

paras.en: “Because these people can’t find a key how to stop Putin, because it’s more difficult to stop Putin than to pressure others, because it’s more simple to speak about the prices and connect it with Ukraine,” he responded, pointing to how the war in Iran was leading to higher fuel prices.
paras.zh: “因为这些人找不到阻止普京的关键，因为阻止普京比向其他人施压更困难，因为谈论价格并将其与乌克兰联系起来更简单，”他回应道，并指出伊朗战争如何导致燃油价格上涨。

articles.title: What to know about Pope Leo’s lung surgery
articles.author: Akshay Syal, M.D.

paras.en: Pope Leo XIV said Sunday he will have surgery this week to remove an early-stage nodule on his lung.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥十四世周日表示，他将于本周接受手术，切除肺部的早期结节。

paras.en: The Vatican didn’t say what type of lung surgery the pontiff will undergo, but that the “small, localized nodule” was found in his lung during recent medical tests.
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈没有透露教皇将接受哪种类型的肺部手术，但表示在最近的医学检查中在他的肺部发现了“局部小结节”。

paras.en: A lung nodule is a small mass of tissue detected through X-ray or CT scan screening. According to the American Lung Cancer, nodules can be caused by a number of factors, including irritants such as air pollution, diseases such as rheumatoid arthritis and cancer. They can also be caused by scar tissue from a previous infection.
paras.zh: 肺结节是通过 X 射线或 CT 扫描筛查发现的一小块组织。据美国肺癌协会称，结节可能是由多种因素引起的，包括空气污染等刺激物、类风湿性关节炎和癌症等疾病。它们也可能是由先前感染的疤痕组织引起的。

paras.en: Leo said the nodule was detected “at a very early stage.”
paras.zh: 利奥说，这个结节是在“非常早期的阶段”被发现的。

paras.en: There are several approaches to surgery, depending on the size and location of the nodule and whether doctors suspect cancer, said Dr. Ankit Bharat, the chief of thoracic surgery at Northwestern Medicine.
paras.zh: 西北医学院胸外科主任安基特·巴拉特博士说，手术方法有多种，具体取决于结节的大小和位置以及医生是否怀疑患有癌症。

paras.en: Most nodules are benign, and it’s unclear whether the pope had a biopsy after the tests.
paras.zh: 大多数结节是良性的，目前还不清楚教皇在检查后是否进行了活检。

paras.en: “When doctors decide to proceed directly to surgery rather than first obtaining a biopsy, it can suggest a higher level of concern on the lung scan,” Bharat said.
paras.zh: 巴拉特说：“当医生决定直接进行手术而不是首先进行活检时，这可能表明对肺部扫描有更高的关注度。”

paras.en: What to know about Pope Leo’s surgery to remove a lung nodule
paras.zh: 关于教皇利奥的肺结节切除手术需要了解什么

paras.en: Lung cancer is more treatable if caught early. The deadly cancer is most often caused by cigarette smoking, but about 20% of lung cancer cases are diagnosed in people who have never smoked or used tobacco, according to the American Cancer Society.
paras.zh: 如果及早发现，肺癌的治愈率更高。这种致命的癌症通常是由吸烟引起的，但据美国癌症协会称，大约 20% 的肺癌病例是在从未吸烟或使用过烟草的人中诊断出来的。

paras.en: However, finding a nodule on a scan doesn’t confirm a cancer diagnosis, Bharat said, and the surgery will reveal more information as doctors are able to put the nodule under a microscope.
paras.zh: 然而，巴拉特说，在扫描中发现结节并不能确认癌症诊断，而且手术将揭示更多信息，因为医生能够将结节放在显微镜下。

paras.en: Advances in the procedures mean they are generally less invasive and some patients begin walking within a day or two.
paras.zh: 这些手术的进步意味着它们通常侵入性较小，一些患者在一两天内就可以开始行走。

paras.en: Vatican spokesman Matteo Bruni said in a statement Sunday that “the operation is scheduled for the first days of this week and the estimated post-operative recovery time will be about one week.”
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈发言人马泰奥·布鲁尼周日在一份声明中表示，“手术计划于本周头几天进行，预计术后恢复时间约为一周。”

paras.en: If the nodule is larger and more lung tissue is removed, meaning the surgery is more extensive, it may be three to four weeks before a patient is fully recovered.
paras.zh: 如果结节较大并且切除了更多的肺组织，这意味着手术范围更大，患者可能需要三到四个星期才能完全康复。

paras.en: “Given the pope’s age, his recovery could be slower than that of a younger, otherwise healthy patient,” Bharat said. Leo is 71.
paras.zh: 巴拉特说：“考虑到教皇的年龄，他的康复可能比年轻且健康的患者慢。”利奥今年71岁了。

paras.en: The pontiff has a major trip scheduled to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru in November. It’s possible he could make the trip, doctors suggest, if the surgery is minimally invasive and there are no surprise findings. If the nodule is cancerous, doctors will determine whether he can be treated while traveling or the trip may need to be postponed.
paras.zh: 教宗计划于 11 月对乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁进行一次重要访问。医生建议，如果手术是微创的并且没有任何意外发现，他有可能完成这次旅行。如果结节是癌性的，医生将确定他是否可以在旅行时接受治疗，或者可能需要推迟旅行。

articles.title: Saudi Arabia extends airport closure as Houthis warn 'worse is yet to come'

paras.en: Yemen's Houthis have warned airlines, travellers and airport workers to stay away from Saudi Arabian airports.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装警告航空公司、旅客和机场工作人员远离沙特阿拉伯机场。

paras.en: It comes a day after an attack on Riyadh's international airport killed 12 people and wounded more than 300 others.
paras.zh: 一天前，利雅得国际机场发生袭击，造成 12 人死亡、300 多人受伤。

paras.en: The Houthis said further Saudi military action in Yemen would trigger a stronger response, while world leaders called for de-escalation and the protection of civilian lives.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，沙特在也门的进一步军事行动将引发更强烈的反应，而世界领导人则呼吁缓和局势并保护平民生命。

paras.en: Yemen's Houthis have warned airlines, travellers and airport workers to stay away from Saudi airports, a day after an attack on Riyadh's international airport killed 12 people and wounded more than 300 others.
paras.zh: 利雅得国际机场发生袭击事件，造成 12 人死亡、300 多人受伤，一天后，也门胡塞武装警告航空公司、旅客和机场工作人员远离沙特机场。

paras.en: It was the deadliest such attack in the kingdom in more than a decade and comes amid an escalation of fighting between the Iran-backed Houthis and Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces.
paras.zh: 这是该国十多年来最致命的此类袭击，发生在伊朗支持的胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府军之间的战斗升级之际。

paras.en: "We renew our warning to all airlines, experts, employees, workers and travellers against using Saudi airports and airspace, as they are vulnerable to attack and have become a theatre of operations for our forces, with the exception of the airports in (the holy cities of) Mecca and Medina," the Houthis said in a post on X on Sunday.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装周日在 X 网站上发帖称：“我们再次警告所有航空公司、专家、雇员、工人和旅客不要使用沙特机场和领空，因为这些机场和领空很容易受到攻击，并且已成为我们部队的行动战场，但麦加和麦地那（圣城）的机场除外。”

paras.en: "We urge everyone to take our warnings seriously, and Saudi Arabia bears responsibility for any failed interceptions."
paras.zh: “我们敦促每个人认真对待我们的警告，沙特阿拉伯对任何失败的拦截负有责任。”

paras.en: Saudi authorities said that schools in the capital would be online until the end of the week.
paras.zh: 沙特当局表示，首都的学校将在本周末之前上线。

paras.en: Meanwhile, the kingdom extended an ongoing airport closure until at least 9pm on Sunday, local time, according to Flightradar24.
paras.zh: 与此同时，据 Flightradar24 报道，沙特将机场关闭时间延长至当地时间周日晚上 9 点以上。

paras.en: The Australian embassy in Saudi Arabia urged Australian citizens in Riyadh to "shelter in place".
paras.zh: 澳大利亚驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆敦促利雅得的澳大利亚公民“就地避难”。

paras.en: "We advise the Australian community in Riyadh to shelter in place. Stay indoors, follow the advice of local authorities and avoid unnecessary travel," the embassy said in a statement.
paras.zh: 大使馆在一份声明中表示：“我们建议利雅得的澳大利亚社区就地避难。呆在室内，听从地方当局的建议，避免不必要的旅行。”

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has stepped up its military involvement in Yemen in recent weeks, launching strikes against the Houthis and backing a Yemeni government counteroffensive after the group seized strategic territory along the Red Sea coast last month.
paras.zh: 最近几周，沙特阿拉伯加强了对也门的军事介入，对胡塞武装发动袭击，并支持也门政府在该组织上个月夺取红海沿岸战略领土后的反攻。

paras.en: Yemen's Houthi-run foreign ministry said on Sunday that further Saudi military action in Yemen would trigger a stronger response, adding that its actions would be guided by the principle of reciprocity.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装外交部周日表示，沙特在也门的进一步军事行动将引发更强烈的反应，并补充说其行动将遵循互惠原则。

paras.en: "Unless the Saudi enemy stops its aggression and interference in Yemen, worse is yet to come, God willing," the ministry said in statements carried by Houthi-run Al Masirah television.
paras.zh: 该部在胡塞武装旗下的马西拉电视台发表的声明中表示，“除非沙特敌人停止对也门的侵略和干涉，如果上帝保佑，更糟糕的事情还在后头。”

paras.en: The Houthis reported on Sunday that two air strikes hit Yemen's capital, Sanaa, blaming Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装周日报道称，也门首都萨那遭到两次空袭，并指责沙特阿拉伯。

paras.en: Yemen's Houthi-run Al Masirah TV also reported on a strike it said was carried out by Saudi Arabia on Yemen's Sanaa International Airport.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装运营的 Al Masirah 电视台也报道了沙特阿拉伯对也门萨那国际机场发动的袭击。

paras.en: There was no immediate comment from Saudi authorities or reports of casualties.
paras.zh: 沙特当局没有立即发表评论，也没有伤亡报告。

paras.en: The Houthi-run health ministry says 91 Yemenis have been killed and 168 injured by the Saudi-led coalition in five weeks.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装卫生部表示，五周内，沙特领导的联军已造成 91 名也门人死亡、168 人受伤。

paras.en: It said that 60 per cent of those killed were women and children.
paras.zh: 据称，遇难者中 60% 是妇女和儿童。

paras.en: The latest attack on the Saudi airport drew widespread condemnation from world leaders.
paras.zh: 沙特机场最近发生的袭击事件引起了世界领导人的广泛谴责。

paras.en: "Attacks by Iran's proxies are pushing the region into a spiral of violence," European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen wrote Sunday on X.
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩 (Ursula von der Leyen) 周日在 X 上写道：“伊朗代理人的袭击正在将该地区推向暴力的漩涡。”

paras.en: "They are destabilising crucial global transport and energy nodes."
paras.zh: “它们正在破坏重要的全球运输和能源节点的稳定。”

paras.en: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres said he was "deeply shocked" by the attack.
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯表示，他对这起袭击事件“深感震惊”。

paras.en: "Attacks on civilians and civilian infrastructure are a violation of international law. These attacks must cease immediately," he wrote on X.
paras.zh: “对平民和民用基础设施的攻击违反了国际法。这些攻击必须立即停止，”他在 X 上写道。

paras.en: Arab countries, including Iraq, Lebanon, Syria and the United Arab Emirates also condemned the attack.
paras.zh: 伊拉克、黎巴嫩、叙利亚和阿联酋等阿拉伯国家也谴责了这起袭击事件。

paras.en: The Iraqi prime minister's spokesman Sabah al-Numan warned it endangered "regional security and stability", calling for "a comprehensive cessation of military operations" to protect civilians.
paras.zh: 伊拉克总理发言人萨巴赫·努曼警告称，这危及“地区安全与稳定”，呼吁“全面停止军事行动”以保护平民。

paras.en: The United Arab Emirates said it stands in solidarity with Saudi Arabia and expressed support for "all measures" to safeguard the kingdom's security.
paras.zh: 阿拉伯联合酋长国表示与沙特阿拉伯站在一起，并表示支持维护王国安全的“一切措施”。

paras.en: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul said he "firmly condemns" the attack, which he described as "a terrorist act against Saudi Arabia and civil aviation".
paras.zh: 德国外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔表示，他“坚决谴责”这次袭击，并将其描述为“针对沙特阿拉伯和民航的恐怖行为”。

paras.en: Meanwhile, UK Defence Minister Wes Streeting said the attacks were "contemptible" and a "dangerous escalation".
paras.zh: 与此同时，英国国防部长韦斯·斯特里廷表示，这些袭击是“可鄙的”，是“危险的升级”。

paras.en: Türkiye called the attack "a flagrant violation of international law" and called for "actions threatening regional security and stability" to stop immediately.
paras.zh: 土耳其称此次袭击“公然违反国际法”，并呼吁立即停止“威胁地区安全与稳定的行动”。

paras.en: Pakistan's Foreign Minister Ishaq Dar said "attacks targeting civilians and civilian infrastructure are totally unacceptable," adding that Pakistan's embassy in Riyadh was coordinating with authorities to provide assistance to injured Pakistani nationals.
paras.zh: 巴基斯坦外交部长伊沙克·达尔表示，“针对平民和民用基础设施的袭击是完全不可接受的”，并补充说巴基斯坦驻利雅得大使馆正在与当局协调，为受伤的巴基斯坦国民提供援助。

paras.en: The Russian foreign ministry condemned the attack and said the situation in the Middle East could only be resolved through diplomatic means, while taking into account the interests of all countries in the region, Russian news agency Interfax reported.
paras.zh: 据俄罗斯国际文传电讯社报道，俄罗斯外交部谴责了这起袭击事件，并表示中东局势只能通过外交手段解决，同时考虑到该地区所有国家的利益。

paras.en: President Donald Trump said on Saturday the United States was considering joining Saudi strikes on the Houthis in the conflict, a spillover from the wider war on Iran that the US and Israel launched in February.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普总统周六表示，美国正在考虑加入沙特对这场冲突中胡塞武装的打击，这是美国和以色列二月份对伊朗发动的更广泛战争的溢出效应。

articles.title: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after discovery of lung nodule

paras.en: Pope Leo to undergo surgery after discovery of lung nodule
paras.zh: 教皇利奥在发现肺部结节后接受手术

paras.en: Pope Leo says he will undergo surgery to remove a lung nodule.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥表示，他将接受手术切除肺部结节。

paras.en: The 71-year-old pontiff, who is relatively young for a church leader, did not say whether the lesion was malignant during his Sunday address to the faithful.
paras.zh: 这位71岁的教宗对于教会领袖来说相对年轻，他在周日向信徒发表讲话时没有透露病变是否是恶性的。

paras.en: The Catholic leader is due to make an 11-day tour of Uruguay, Argentina and Peru from November 6-17.
paras.zh: 这位天主教领袖将于11月6日至17日对乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁进行为期11天的访问。

articles.title: 'Up to our people': Zelenskyy responds to Trump's election call

paras.en: Volodymyr Zelenskyy says a Ukrainian election can only be held if Russia agrees to a 60-day ceasefire, as he rejects US President Donald Trump's call for him to be replaced as Ukrainian president.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，只有俄罗斯同意 60 天停火，乌克兰选举才能举行，他拒绝了美国总统唐纳德·特朗普要求他接替乌克兰总统的呼吁。

paras.en: Mr Trump has sharpened his criticism of the wartime leader in recent days, blaming Ukrainian strikes on Russian refineries for high diesel prices in the US.
paras.zh: 最近几天，特朗普加强了对这位战时领导人的批评，将美国柴油价格居高不下归咎于乌克兰对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击。

paras.en: The US president has also announced that his administration had temporarily lifted US sanctions on Russian fuel, as Mr Trump faces pressure domestically over his handling of the Iran war and high energy prices.
paras.zh: 美国总统还宣布，由于特朗普因处理伊朗战争和高能源价格而面临国内压力，他的政府暂时取消了美国对俄罗斯燃料的制裁。

paras.en: Speaking to the American Broadcasting Company, Mr Zelenskyy pushed back on Mr Trump's call for Ukrainians to pick a new leader.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在接受美国广播公司采访时反驳了特朗普要求乌克兰人选出新领导人的呼吁。

paras.en: "First of all, with all respect to President Trump, it's up to our society, up to our people to choose one or another leader," Mr Zelenskyy said in a televised interview.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在接受电视采访时表示：“首先，我谨向特朗普总统表示敬意，我们的社会、我们的人民应该由我们的社会、我们的人民来选择一位或另一位领导人。”

paras.en: Mr Zelenskyy said he told Mr Trump's team that if they really wanted Ukraine to hold elections, "please tell Putin give us two months, 60 days of total ceasefire, 60 days, and we will organise elections".
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，他告诉特朗普团队，如果他们真的希望乌克兰举行选举，“请告诉普京给我们两个月、60 天的全面停火时间，60 天，我们将组织选举”。

paras.en: Mr Trump's deal with the Kremlin and increased criticism of Ukraine prompted European leaders to rally around Mr Zelenskyy.
paras.zh: 特朗普与克里姆林宫的协议以及对乌克兰的批评不断增加，促使欧洲领导人团结在泽伦斯基周围。

paras.en: German Foreign Minister Johann Wadephul restated Berlin's support for Mr Zelenskyy and urged more pressure to be put on Russia to resume peace talks.
paras.zh: 德国外交部长约翰·瓦德菲尔重申柏林对泽连斯基的支持，并敦促对俄罗斯施加更大压力，以恢复和谈。

paras.en: "We don't need less pressure, we need more pressure on Putin to make him be ready to negotiate," Mr Wadephul said.
paras.zh: 瓦德菲尔表示：“我们不需要减少压力，我们需要对普京施加更多压力，让他做好谈判的准备。”

paras.en: "That is what this moment requires and that's what the government stands for."
paras.zh: “这就是此时此刻所需要的，也是政府所主张的。”

paras.en: British Prime Minister Andy Burnham spoke with Mr Zelenskyy on Saturday and told him the UK would continue to strengthen its sanctions on Russia, a Downing Street spokesperson said.
paras.zh: 唐宁街发言人表示，英国首相安迪·伯纳姆周六与泽伦斯基进行了交谈，并告诉他英国将继续加强对俄罗斯的制裁。

articles.title: Pope Leo will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung

paras.en: Pope Leo will undergo surgery to remove a nodule on his lung
paras.zh: 教皇利奥将接受手术切除肺部结节

paras.en: Pontiff to undergo surgery in coming days, with an expected recovery time of a week, Vatican said
paras.zh: 梵蒂冈表示，教宗将在未来几天内接受手术，预计康复时间为一周

paras.en: Pope Leo announced Sunday he will undergo surgery in the coming days to remove a nodular lesion on his lung that was recently discovered during medical checks.
paras.zh: 教皇利奥周日宣布，他将在未来几天内接受手术，以切除最近在体检中发现的肺部结节性病变。

paras.en: The 71-year-old Pope said the nodule was found at an early stage and was "circumscribed" or well-localized. The Vatican later said Leo would undergo surgery in the first days of the week, with an expected recovery time of a week.
paras.zh: 这位 71 岁的教皇表示，该结节是在早期发现的，并且“范围有限”或定位良好。梵蒂冈随后表示，利奥将在本周的头几天接受手术，预计康复时间为一周。

paras.en: The American Pope made the announcement during his Sunday noon blessing. He thanked the crowd for their closeness and entrusted himself to their prayers.
paras.zh: 美国教皇在周日中午的祝福中宣布了这一消息。他感谢群众的亲近，并为他们祈祷。

paras.en: A lung nodule is a small abnormal area measuring less than three centimetres that sometimes appears on a CT scan of the chest or abdomen, according to the American Cancer Society. Often, the scans are done to investigate trauma or a lung infection, unrelated to a lung cancer screening.
paras.zh: 根据美国癌症协会的说法，肺结节是一种小于三厘米的小异常区域，有时会出现在胸部或腹部 CT 扫描上。通常，进行扫描是为了调查创伤或肺部感染，与肺癌筛查无关。

paras.en: Leo, elected Pope by the world's cardinals in May 2025, is relatively young for a Church leader. He has no previously known health problems and is considered physically active, with weekly tennis games and swimming at the papal summer retreat in Castel Gandolfo.
paras.zh: 利奥于 2025 年 5 月被世界红衣主教选举为教皇，对于教会领袖来说，他相对年轻。他之前没有已知的健康问题，并且被认为身体活跃，每周都会打网球，并在冈多菲堡的教皇夏季度假胜地游泳。

paras.en: The Pope has a major trip planned Nov. 6-17 to Uruguay, Argentina and Peru. It's unclear whether the planned surgery and recovery would affect the itinerary, but Leo said earlier in his remarks Sunday that he planned to go.
paras.zh: 教皇计划于 11 月 6 日至 17 日对乌拉圭、阿根廷和秘鲁进行一次重要访问。目前尚不清楚计划中的手术和康复是否会影响行程，但利奥在周日早些时候的讲话中表示，他计划去。

paras.en: In his remarks, delivered in Italian, Leo said during a recent medical check, "doctors found a small, localized nodule in my lung. It was detected at a very early stage and is circumscribed. The doctors believe it's best to take action, so, following their advice, I've decided to have surgery to remove it."
paras.zh: 利奥在用意大利语发表的讲话中说，在最近的一次医疗检查中，“医生在我的肺部发现了一个小的、局部的结节。它是在很早的阶段就被发现的，并且已经被限制住了。医生认为最好采取行动，所以，根据他们的建议，我决定进行手术将其切除。”

paras.en: "The surgery is already scheduled for the coming days. Thank you for your spiritual support, and I entrust myself to your prayers," he said.
paras.zh: “手术已安排在未来几天进行。感谢你们的精神支持，我将自己托付你们的祈祷，”他说。

paras.en: Before mentioning his health issue in his address on Sunday, the Pope referred to the trip, thanking Catholics for their prayers "for the pastoral visit I will undertake."
paras.zh: 在周日的讲话中提到他的健康问题之前，教皇提到了这次旅行，感谢天主教徒为“我将进行的牧灵访问”祈祷。

paras.en: Leo's predecessor, Pope Francis, died April 21, 2025, of a stroke following a long hospitalization brought on by a respiratory crisis that developed into double pneumonia. Francis suffered from chronic lung disease and had part of one lung removed as a young man.
paras.zh: 利奥的前任教皇弗朗西斯于 2025 年 4 月 21 日因中风去世，此前他因呼吸道危机发展为双重肺炎而长期住院。弗朗西斯患有慢性肺病，年轻时曾切除了部分肺。

paras.en: Leo is expected to undergo surgery at Rome's Gemelli hospital, where Francis and popes before him were treated and where there is a special apartment for pontiffs.
paras.zh: 利奥预计将在罗马的杰梅利医院接受手术，弗朗西斯和他之前的教皇都在那里接受过治疗，那里还有一间专门为教皇提供的公寓。

paras.en: Italian Premier Giorgia Meloni, among the few outsiders to visit Francis during his long final hospitalization, expressed her support, and that of the Italian government, to Leo "as he faces this challenge in the coming days." In a statement, she added that "the serenity and calm with which he spoke about it" were reassuring.
paras.zh: 意大利总理乔治亚·梅洛尼（Giorgia Meloni）是在弗朗西斯漫长的最后住院期间探望他的少数外人之一，她向利奥表达了她和意大利政府的支持，“因为他在未来几天面临这一挑战”。她在一份声明中补充说，“他谈论这件事时的平静和平静”令人放心。

paras.en: A nodule on the lung is a small, localized lesion that can be benign. The American Thoracic Society says fewer than five per cent of lung nodules overall prove cancerous, although risk rises with age, size and other factors.
paras.zh: 肺部结节是一种小的、局部病变，可能是良性的。美国胸科学会表示，尽管风险随着年龄、大小和其他因素的增加而增加，但总体上只有不到百分之五的肺结节被证明是癌性的。

articles.title: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire,' which Zelenskky says he hasn't seen but supports

paras.en: Trump announces Russia-Ukraine 'energy ceasefire,' which Zelenskky says he hasn't seen but supports
paras.zh: 特朗普宣布俄罗斯与乌克兰“能源停火”，泽连斯基表示他没有看到但支持

paras.en: Zelenskyy says energy ceasefire news to him, but would agree to one if Russia does
paras.zh: 泽连斯基向他透露能源停火消息，但如果俄罗斯同意，他会同意

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said he has discussed the possibility of an energy ceasefire with Russia with Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney, Finnish President Alexander Stubb and NATO Secretary General Mark Rutte but is waiting for more information from the United States.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽伦斯基表示，他已与加拿大总理马克·卡尼、芬兰总统亚历山大·斯塔布和北约秘书长马克·鲁特讨论了与俄罗斯实现能源停火的可能性，但正在等待美国提供更多信息。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump had said in a social media post Sunday that Ukraine and Russia had agreed to what he described as an "energy ceasefire" without offering specifics on terms.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日在社交媒体上发帖表示，乌克兰和俄罗斯已同意他所说的“能源停火”，但没有提供具体条款。

paras.en: In an interview with Axios, Zelenskyy said Trump's post was the first he had heard of the deal, though a senior Ukrainian official told Reuters that Ukraine was ready to agree to such a ceasefire, if Russia was.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在接受 Axios 采访时表示，特朗普的帖子是他第一次听说该协议，不过乌克兰一名高级官员告诉路透社，如果俄罗斯同意的话，乌克兰准备同意停火。

paras.en: In a social media post of his own, the Ukrainian president said he had just spoken with Carney, Stubb and Rutte to discuss the alleged ceasefire announced by Trump.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统在自己的社交媒体帖子中表示，他刚刚与卡尼、斯塔布和吕特进行了交谈，讨论了特朗普宣布的所谓停火协议。

paras.en: "Ukraine supports the ceasefire, and it is important that Russia support it as well. We are awaiting details from the American side," Zelenskyy wrote on X Sunday afternoon. "For our part, Ukraine always FULLY supports steps toward de-escalation, the protection of lives, and the decisions needed to end the war and guarantee lasting peace."
paras.zh: “乌克兰支持停火，重要的是俄罗斯也支持停火。我们正在等待美国方面的细节，”泽连斯基周日下午写道。 “就我们而言，乌克兰始终全力支持缓和局势、保护生命的措施以及结束战争和保证持久和平所需的决定。”

paras.en: The announcement comes a day after Trump blamed Zelenskyy for attacking diesel facilities in Russia and contributing to a global shortage. Russia and Ukraine have repeatedly attacked each other's energy infrastructure during the war.
paras.zh: 就在这一消息发布的前一天，特朗普指责泽伦斯基袭击了俄罗斯的柴油设施并导致全球短缺。俄罗斯和乌克兰在战争期间多次攻击对方的能源基础设施。

paras.en: Trump's brief post said only that the ceasefire takes effect immediately and that both sides had agreed to it. "Do not break it!" he said in his social media post.
paras.zh: 特朗普的简短帖子仅表示停火立即生效，并且双方均已同意。 “别弄坏它！”他在社交媒体帖子中说道。

paras.en: The White House did not immediately clarify the president's post or add detail. The Kremlin did not provide comment.
paras.zh: 白宫没有立即澄清总统的帖子或添加细节。克里姆林宫没有发表评论。

paras.en: Ukraine's President Volodymyr Zelenskyy meets with U.S. President Donald Trump during the United Nations General Assembly, on Sept. 22 at the UN headquarters. (Julia Demaree Nikhinson/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 9 月 22 日，乌克兰总统泽连斯基在联合国总部举行的联合国大会期间会见美国总统唐纳德·特朗普。 （朱莉娅·德玛丽·尼金森/美联社）

paras.en: Trump, whose war in Iran has been blamed for high diesel prices that are weighing on Republicans' prospects at next month's midterm elections, had previously announced an energy ceasefire in Ukraine in mid-September, though neither side ever confirmed such an agreement was reached.
paras.zh: 特朗普因伊朗战争而被指责为柴油价格高企，这给共和党下个月中期选举的前景带来压力。特朗普此前曾于9月中旬宣布在乌克兰实施能源停火，但双方均未证实已达成此类协议。

paras.en: "Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!" Trump wrote on Truth Social.
paras.zh: “俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争已经实现能源停火，立即生效。双方都已同意。不要破坏它！”特朗普在《真相社会》上撰文。

paras.en: Earlier on Sunday, Zelenskyy had repeated Ukraine's long-standing position that it was willing to halt attacks on Russian refineries, but only if Moscow ceased its own strikes on Ukrainian power infrastructure.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候，泽伦斯基重申了乌克兰的长期立场，即乌克兰愿意停止对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击，但前提是莫斯科停止对乌克兰电力基础设施的袭击。

paras.en: Any such deal would need to come with "real guarantees," Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，任何此类协议都需要有“真正的保证”。

paras.en: "The real cause of the war in Europe is Russia and Russia alone," Zelenskyy said. "It's possible to stop strikes on energy infrastructure as early as today, but Putin does not want to do so."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说：“欧洲战争的真正原因是俄罗斯，而且是俄罗斯一个人。” “最早今天就可以停止对能源基础设施的袭击，但普京不想这样做。”

paras.en: In a dramatic deterioration in their relations, Trump on Saturday had warned Zelenskyy that he had "better damn well stop" attacking Russian refineries, and he urged Ukrainians to replace Zelenskyy as their leader via new elections because he had missed several opportunities to strike a deal with Moscow.
paras.zh: 在两国关系急剧恶化的情况下，特朗普周六警告泽连斯基，他“最好停止”攻击俄罗斯炼油厂，并敦促乌克兰人通过新的选举取代泽连斯基成为领导人，因为他错过了几次与莫斯科达成协议的机会。

paras.en: Appearing on ABC's This Week on Sunday, Zelenskyy responded that he would organize elections in Ukraine if Russian President Vladimir Putin agreed to a 60-day ceasefire.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周日在美国广播公司的《本周》节目中回应称，如果俄罗斯总统普京同意 60 天停火，他将在乌克兰组织选举。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said it was "up to Ukrainians" to choose their leader, but noted that there needed to be an end to the fighting first. Ukrainian law prohibits elections under martial law for security reasons.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，“由乌克兰人”选择他们的领导人，但他指出，首先需要结束战斗。出于安全原因，乌克兰法律禁止在戒严期间举行选举。

paras.en: "Please tell Putin, give us two months, 60 days of total ceasefire, 60 days, and we will organize elections," Zelenskyy said.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基说：“请告诉普京，给我们两个月、60天的全面停火时间，60天，我们将组织选举。”

paras.en: The Ukrainian leader rejected being blamed for energy price rises, adding that "everybody in the world" knew that the war in the Middle East was a bigger factor.
paras.zh: 这位乌克兰领导人否认因能源价格上涨而受到指责，并补充说“世界上每个人”都知道中东战争是一个更大的因素。

paras.en: The steep rise in global diesel prices, which followed the outbreak of the Iran war in February, has become a political liability for Trump's Republican Party ahead of the midterms, when opposition Democrats could gain control of one or both houses of Congress.
paras.zh: 2月份伊朗战争爆发后，全球柴油价格急剧上涨，已成为特朗普领导的共和党在中期选举前的政治负担，届时反对派民主党可能会获得国会两院或两院的控制权。

paras.en: On Saturday, Zelenskyy had responded angrily to Trump's announcement of a diesel supply deal with Russia, saying it would embolden Moscow's attacks on Ukraine and lead to a greater loss of civilian lives.
paras.zh: 周六，泽伦斯基对特朗普宣布与俄罗斯达成柴油供应协议做出愤怒回应，称这将助长莫斯科对乌克兰的袭击，并导致更多平民丧生。

paras.en: Analysts said Trump's diesel supply agreement with Moscow was unlikely to lead to sustained lower fuel prices as the volumes involved were too small.
paras.zh: 分析师表示，特朗普与莫斯科的柴油供应协议不太可能导致燃油价格持续走低，因为涉及的数量太小。

paras.en: The diesel deal was also criticized by U.S. lawmakers, including one of Trump's fellow Republicans, Rep. Don Bacon, who said it was time to apply more sanctions, not lift them.
paras.zh: 柴油交易也受到美国立法者的批评，其中包括特朗普的共和党同僚、众议员唐·培根(Don Bacon)，他表示现在是实施更多制裁而不是取消制裁的时候了。

paras.en: On the streets of Kyiv, several residents expressed anger at Trump's suggestion that Ukraine should find a new leader willing to make a deal with Putin.
paras.zh: 在基辅街头，一些居民对特朗普建议乌克兰应该找到一位愿意与普京达成协议的新领导人表示愤怒。

paras.en: "No one has the right to tell us what to do, especially since elections cannot be held during wartime," said Sabina, a 40-year-old primary school teacher. "In my view, it is a betrayal by our partners," she said, describing Trump's remarks.
paras.zh: “没有人有权告诉我们该做什么，特别是因为战时不能举行选举，”40 岁的小学教师萨宾娜说。 “在我看来，这是我们合作伙伴的背叛，”她在描述特朗普的言论时说道。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said he would continue discussions with European leaders on Sunday, and there were daily conversations around additional air defence packages, including ammunition for combat aircraft that are used to down Russia's jet-powered drones.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示，他将于周日继续与欧洲领导人进行讨论，并且每天都会围绕额外的防空方案进行对话，其中包括用于击落俄罗斯喷气式无人机的战斗机弹药。

paras.en: On Monday, Ukrainian Foreign Minister Andrii Sybiha is due to participate in a European Union foreign affairs council meeting that is expected to discuss increasing sanctions pressure on Russia and advancing negotiations on Ukraine’s EU accession.
paras.zh: 周一，乌克兰外交部长安德里·西比哈将参加欧盟外交事务理事会会议，预计会议将讨论加大对俄罗斯的制裁压力以及推进乌克兰加入欧盟的谈判。

articles.title: Children among at least 139 dead after migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti coast

paras.en: Children among at least 139 dead after migrant boat capsizes off Djibouti coast
paras.zh: 移民船在吉布提海岸倾覆 至少139人死亡 儿童死亡

paras.en: Toll only includes those buried by authorities, says UN migration agency
paras.zh: 联合国移民机构表示，死亡人数仅包括被当局埋葬的人

paras.en: At least 139 people, including children, have died after a boat carrying more than 300 migrants capsized off the coast of Djibouti in East Africa, the International Organization for Migration said Sunday.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织周日表示，一艘载有 300 多名移民的船只在东非吉布提海岸倾覆，造成至少 139 人死亡，其中包括儿童。

paras.en: That number only includes those buried by authorities in Djibouti. Others have been buried by the migrants themselves, but they won't be added to the official count until authorities can verify the bodies, Alexandre Coissac, IOM chief of mission in Djibouti, told The Associated Press.
paras.zh: 这个数字只包括吉布提当局埋葬的人。国际移民组织驻吉布提代表团团长亚历山大·科瓦萨克 (Alexandre Coissac) 告诉美联社，其他人已被移民自己埋葬，但在当局核实尸体身份之前，这些尸体不会被纳入官方统计。

paras.en: "What is terrible is that they were buried with no names, in a common grave, like in a war situation," Coissac said. "They all have a mother, a father, and we may never learn what happened."
paras.zh: 科瓦萨克说：“可怕的是，他们被埋在一个共同的坟墓里，没有名字，就像在战争情况下一样。” “他们都有母亲、父亲，我们可能永远不会知道发生了什么。”

paras.en: Coissac said the migrants boarded the ship in the evening of Oct. 8 and that it sank very soon after, close to the shore, "mainly because it was overcrowded."
paras.zh: 科瓦萨克说，移民们于 10 月 8 日晚登上了这艘船，不久之后船就在靠近海岸的地方沉没，“主要是因为船太拥挤了”。

paras.en: "The local authorities did their best," Coissac said, "but they were overwhelmed with all the bodies that kept coming at once towards the shore."
paras.zh: 科瓦萨克说：“地方当局已尽了最大努力，但他们对不断涌向海岸的尸体感到不知所措。”

paras.en: He said authorities were bringing the surviving migrants to the IOM rescue centre in Obock where they would receive medical assistance after swallowing sea water, and psychological support.
paras.zh: 他说，当局正在将幸存的移民送往奥博克的国际移民组织救援中心，他们在吞下海水后将在那里接受医疗援助和心理支持。

paras.en: A pair of trousers believed to belong to a migrant lies on the shore near Guhere. (Kennedy Omondi Okoth/International Organization for Migration/Reuters)
paras.zh: 古赫雷附近的海岸上有一条据信属于移民的裤子。 （肯尼迪·奥蒙迪·奥科斯/国际移民组织/路透社）

paras.en: "They're all in a state of shock," said Coissac, who visited the area of the shipwreck Saturday. "I tried to talk to some of them, but it's very difficult."
paras.zh: “他们都处于震惊状态，”周六参观沉船地区的科瓦萨克说。 “我尝试与他们中的一些人交谈，但这非常困难。”

paras.en: Some of the migrants in the IOM centre are already aware that their family members died during the shipwreck. Others were given access to phones to call loved ones back home to notify them they are alive.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织中心的一些移民已经知道他们的家人在海难中丧生。其他人则可以使用电话给亲人打电话回家，通知他们还活着。

paras.en: At least 84 people remained missing in one of the deadliest shipwrecks yet on the popular but perilous crossing from the Horn of Africa to the Arabian Peninsula, where many migrants seek work in rich Gulf nations.
paras.zh: 这是迄今为止最致命的沉船事故之一，至少有 84 人失踪，这是从非洲之角到阿拉伯半岛的热门但危险的航线，许多移民到阿拉伯半岛富裕国家寻找工作。

paras.en: The boat was travelling from Djibouti to Yemen when it capsized on Thursday night or Friday morning, according to the IOM. More than 80 people survived, all of them Ethiopian nationals, it said.
paras.zh: 据国际移民组织称，这艘船于周四晚上或周五早上从吉布提前往也门时倾覆。报道称，超过 80 人幸存，全部是埃塞俄比亚国民。

paras.en: The Geneva-based UN migration agency said the vessel had 305 people on board and warned that the death toll could still rise.
paras.zh: 总部位于日内瓦的联合国移民机构表示，船上有 305 人，并警告死亡人数可能还会上升。

paras.en: Personal items likely belonging to the migrants, including shoes, were seen on a beach in a video shared by IOM. Rescue work continued as fears grew for the missing.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织分享的一段视频中，在海滩上看到了可能属于移民的个人物品，包括鞋子。随着人们对失踪人员的担忧加剧，救援工作仍在继续。

paras.en: Tens of thousands of migrants from the Horn of Africa travel every year through Djibouti and across the Bab el-Mandeb Strait toward Gulf countries in search of safety and economic opportunities, the IOM said in its statement.
paras.zh: 国际移民组织在声明中表示，每年都有数以万计的来自非洲之角的移民通过吉布提并跨越曼德海峡前往海湾国家，寻求安全和经济机会。

paras.en: That movement has continued despite newly escalating fighting in Yemen, on the other side of the strait.
paras.zh: 尽管海峡另一边的也门的战斗最近不断升级，但这一运动仍在继续。

paras.en: "This is a devastating loss of life," said Coissac. "This tragedy is a stark reminder of the dangers faced by migrants along this migration corridor as they seek economic opportunities."
paras.zh: 科瓦萨克说：“这是一次毁灭性的生命损失。” “这场悲剧清楚地提醒人们，沿这条移民走廊寻找经济机会的移民所面临的危险。”

paras.en: Members of the International Organization for Migration receive migrants near Guhere. (Kennedy Omondi Okoth/International Organization for Migration/Reuters)
paras.zh: 国际移民组织成员在古赫雷附近接待移民。 （肯尼迪·奥蒙迪·奥科斯/国际移民组织/路透社）

paras.en: In recent weeks, at least 2,000 Yemenis have received aid in Djibouti as the fighting has escalated in Yemen between the Saudi-backed, internationally recognized government and Iran-backed Houthi rebels.
paras.zh: 最近几周，随着也门沙特支持的国际公认政府与伊朗支持的胡塞武装之间的战斗升级，至少 2000 名也门人在吉布提获得了援助。

paras.en: That's the opposite direction from the movement of the migrants who died in the shipwreck and the typical migration patterns of recent years: the tens of thousands who cross from eastern Africa toward Yemen each year have typically been looking for work in places like Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 这与在海难中丧生的移民的流动方向以及近年来的典型移民模式相反：每年从东非前往也门的数万人通常是在沙特阿拉伯等地寻找工作。

paras.en: - At least 53 killed after migrant boat sinks off Libyan coast
paras.zh: - 移民船在利比亚海岸沉没 至少53人死亡

paras.en: - In northern France, beaches turn to border zones as migrants wait months to cross the English Channel
paras.zh: - 在法国北部，移民等待数月才能穿越英吉利海峡，海滩转向边境地区

paras.en: Over 900 migrants died or went missing along the route last year, according to IOM's Missing Migrants Project.
paras.zh: 根据国际移民组织失踪移民项目的数据，去年有超过 900 名移民沿途死亡或失踪。

paras.en: "No one gets into a boat like that unless they believe there is no other safe way," IOM director general Amy Pope said. "We cannot keep treating these deaths as normal. Safe and legal pathways save lives. I am asking governments and donors to act before the next boat goes down."
paras.zh: 国际移民组织总干事艾米·波普 (Amy Pope) 表示：“除非相信没有其他安全方法，否则没有人会登上这样的船。” “我们不能继续将这些死亡视为正常现象。安全合法的途径可以拯救生命。我要求各国政府和捐助者在下一艘船沉没之前采取行动。”

articles.title: Who are the Ukrainian 'volunteers' under Russian command?

paras.en: Pavlo Oliynyk, 25, says he joined enemy forces to escape Russian captivity. Before his capture in the Donbas region in 2024, he was a senior lieutenant for Ukraine's armed forces.
paras.zh: 25 岁的帕夫洛·奥利尼克 (Pavlo Oliynyk) 表示，他加入敌军是为了逃离俄罗斯的囚禁。 2024 年在顿巴斯地区被捕之前，他是乌克兰武装部队的一名高级中尉。

paras.en: As a prisoner of war (POW), he says he was electrocuted, beaten and psychologically tortured. So when he received the offer to join the Maksym Kryvonis battalion — named after a famous 17th-century Cossack commander — he accepted.
paras.zh: 作为一名战俘，他说自己遭到电击、殴打和心理折磨。因此，当他收到加入马克西姆·克里沃尼斯营（以 17 世纪一位著名哥萨克指挥官的名字命名）的邀请时，他接受了。

paras.en: Oliynyk says he wanted to use this opportunity to reach the front lines, so he could escape to Ukrainian-controlled territory. DW was able to contact Oliynyk through his lawyer.
paras.zh: 奥利尼克说，他想利用这个机会到达前线，这样他就可以逃到乌克兰控制的领土。德国之声通过奥利尼克的律师联系到了他。

paras.en: 'Ukrainian volunteers' consist mostly of POWs
paras.zh: “乌克兰志愿者”主要由战俘组成

paras.en: Reports of Russian combat units consisting of Ukrainian prisoners of war and former service members of Ukraine's armed forces began emerging in late 2022. Several detachments were initially formed and in August 2026, they were merged into the so-called "Ukrainian Volunteer Special Forces Brigade."
paras.zh: 2022 年底开始出现关于由乌克兰战俘和前乌克兰武装部队军人组成的俄罗斯作战部队的报道。最初组建了多个分遣队，并于 2026 年 8 月合并为所谓的“乌克兰志愿特种部队旅”。

paras.en: Of the individual units, the Maksym Kryvonis battalion has perhaps drawn the most public attention for having evidently taken part in combat. Its true size is unknown — Russian media reports claim about 200 fighters while available footage only suggests several dozen.
paras.zh: 在各个部队中，马克西姆·克里沃尼斯营可能因明显参加过战斗而引起了最多的公众关注。它的真实规模尚不清楚——俄罗斯媒体报道称约有 200 名战士，但现有的镜头仅表明有数十名。

paras.en: An investigative team of the Ukrainian public broadcaster Suspilne has identified over 30 members and confirmed they are all former Ukrainian servicemen, captured by Russian forces between 2023 and 2024.
paras.zh: 乌克兰公共广播公司 Suspilne 的调查小组已确认了 30 多名成员的身份，并确认他们都是前乌克兰军人，于 2023 年至 2024 年期间被俄罗斯军队俘虏。

paras.en: An 'imitation' of Russian legions fighting for Ukraine
paras.zh: 为乌克兰作战的俄罗斯军团的“模仿”

paras.en: Pavel Luzin, an expert for Russian foreign policy and defense at the Center for European Policy Analysis, believes these units are an "imitation" of the Russian Volunteer Corps and the Freedom of Russia Legion — units in the Ukrainian armed forces, consisting of Russian citizens — and an attempt by Moscow to distract from the fact that these units exist in the first place. Ukrainian intelligence services tend to agree.
paras.zh: 欧洲政策分析中心的俄罗斯外交政策和防务专家帕维尔·卢津认为，这些部队是对俄罗斯志愿军和俄罗斯自由军团（乌克兰武装部队中由俄罗斯公民组成的部队）的“模仿”，并且莫斯科试图转移人们对这些部队存在的事实的注意力。乌克兰情报部门倾向于同意这一观点。

paras.en: "It bothers them that Russians would fight on Ukraine's side, but Ukrainians won't fight on Russia's side," Yevhen Shybalov, author and veteran of the war in Ukraine, told DW. He added that Russian troops have never tried to hide the fact that Russian volunteer units in Ukrainian ranks were the main reason Russian forces wanted to create Ukrainian units for their owns ranks.
paras.zh: “让他们感到困扰的是，俄罗斯人会站在乌克兰一边作战，但乌克兰人不会站在俄罗斯一边作战，”作家、乌克兰战争老兵叶夫亨·希巴洛夫(Yevhen Shybalov)告诉德国之声。他补充说，俄罗斯军队从未试图隐瞒这样一个事实：乌克兰军队中的俄罗斯志愿部队是俄罗斯军队希望为自己的军队创建乌克兰部队的主要原因。

paras.en: Just how voluntary are these combat units?
paras.zh: 这些作战部队到底有多自愿？

paras.en: In 2025, the Office of the UN High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR) reported that 95% of the released Ukrainian POWs interviewed reported torture or ill-treatment during Russian captivity.
paras.zh: 2025 年，联合国人权事务高级专员办事处 (OHCHR) 报告称，接受采访的获释乌克兰战俘中，95% 的人表示在俄罗斯囚禁期间遭受过酷刑或虐待。

paras.en: Bill Wiley, executive director of the NGO Commission for International Justice and Accountability, said the physical and psychological state of the returned combatants raises serious doubts that their recruitment was voluntary. Mykhailo Savva of the Center for Civil Liberties, a Kyiv-based human rights organization, points to the criminal procedures running against several of the battalion members, which he said indicates that these suggest the combatants had switched sides voluntarily.
paras.zh: 非政府组织国际正义与问责委员会执行主任比尔·威利表示，返回的战斗人员的身心状况令人严重怀疑他们的招募是自愿的。总部位于基辅的人权组织公民自由中心的米哈伊洛·萨瓦(Mykhailo Savva)指出，针对该营几名成员的刑事诉讼表明，这表明战斗人员自愿倒戈。

paras.en: But where to draw the line between voluntary and involuntary recruitment? The war veteran and human rights activist Maksym Butkevych, who spent 28 months as a prisoner of war, said the conditions in Russian captivity make that line hard to distinguish. On the one hand, he said, there is a constant atmosphere of pressure, and on the other hand, it's not implausible that some prisoners defected out of ideological proximity.
paras.zh: 但自愿招募和非自愿招募之间的界限在哪里呢？作为战俘度过了 28 个月的退伍军人和人权活动家马克西姆·布特克维奇 (Maksym Butkevych) 表示，俄罗斯的囚禁条件使这条界限很难区分。他说，一方面，压力的气氛持续存在，另一方面，一些囚犯出于意识形态的接近而叛逃，这并非不可能。

paras.en: How were Ukrainian prisoners made to join Russian forces?
paras.zh: 乌克兰囚犯是如何被迫加入俄罗斯军队的？

paras.en: Butkevych told DW that between 2022 and 2023, all Ukrainian prisoners of war had received offers, "more or less persistently," to join the Russian army. In his case, he recounted, it was after he had been severely mistreated.
paras.zh: 布特克维奇告诉德国之声，2022年至2023年间，所有乌克兰战俘都“或多或少地持续”收到加入俄罗斯军队的邀请。他回忆道，就他而言，那是在他受到严重虐待之后。

paras.en: "They showed us they could do anything they wanted to us," he explained, "which was why we should agree to everything."
paras.zh: “他们向我们展示了他们可以对我们做任何他们想做的事，”他解释道，“这就是为什么我们应该同意一切。”

paras.en: The veteran Shybalov reported similar experiences, speaking of attempts to force confessions of war crimes, or to recruit members for Russia's intelligence services. He told DW all prisoners were first interrogated and then made certain propositions under duress.
paras.zh: 退伍军人希巴洛夫也报告了类似的经历，谈到试图强迫承认战争罪行，或为俄罗斯情报部门招募成员。他告诉德国之声，所有囚犯首先都会受到审问，然后在胁迫下提出某些主张。

paras.en: "You can torture people to get them to confess, but there comes the difficult moment when you need to give them a weapon," he said. "That's why it's more about psychological pressure, and forcing voluntary compliance."
paras.zh: “你可以折磨人们让他们招供，但困难的时刻到来了，你需要给他们武器，”他说。 “这就是为什么更多的是心理压力，以及强迫自愿服从。”

paras.en: Butkevych confirmed these accounts with his own tales. But neither veteran has ever met someone willing to join Russian units, they said.
paras.zh: 布特克维奇用他自己的故事证实了这些说法。但他们表示，两位老兵都没有遇到过愿意加入俄罗斯部队的人。

paras.en: Oliynyk, from the Maksym Kryvonis battalion, said he initially turned down multiple bids to join Russian forces. He said he only accepted the fourth offer so he could flee.
paras.zh: 来自马克西姆·克里沃尼斯营的奥利尼克表示，他最初拒绝了多次加入俄罗斯军队的提议。他说他只接受了第四个提议，这样他就可以逃跑。

paras.en: He claimed he didn't sign official Defense Ministry paperwork, but a private contract with an individual offering military services. Afterwards, he said, he was brought to a room where he heard lectures and saw videos and photos he was later asked to retell.
paras.zh: 他声称自己没有签署国防部的官方文件，而是与提供军事服务的个人签署了一份私人合同。他说，后来他被带到一个房间，在那里他听到了讲座，看到了视频和照片，后来他被要求复述。

paras.en: Oliynyk said fellow service members in the Maksym Kryvonis battalion consisted both of those who had switched sides of their own volition, and those who had been forced.
paras.zh: 奥利尼克说，马克西姆·克里沃尼斯营的战友中既有自愿改变立场的人，也有被迫改变立场的人。

paras.en: In a video circulating online that appears to be of a trial in Ukraine, he also says former Ukrainian POWs in the unit were followed and guarded by mercenaries of the private Russian military company Redut. In the same video, he also speaks of beatings and torture, and receiving monthly wages in envelopes handed out by a member of Russia's military intelligence.
paras.zh: 在网上流传的一段似乎是在乌克兰进行审判的视频中，他还表示，该部队中的前乌克兰战俘受到俄罗斯私营军事公司 Redut 的雇佣兵的跟踪和看守。在同一视频中，他还谈到了殴打和酷刑，以及接受俄罗斯军事情报人员发放的装在信封里的每月工资。

paras.en: Oliynyk told DW he had been given a phone, but that he was too scared to call anyone in Ukraine because it was under constant surveillance. He denied having fought against Ukrainians, as he fled in March 2025 before his first deployment in the Donetsk province. After running across a field, he said he spent two days hiding from drones in basements and houses before making contact with Ukrainian fighters.
paras.zh: 奥利尼克告诉德国之声，他们给了他一部电话，但他不敢给乌克兰的任何人打电话，因为电话一直处于监视之下。他否认曾与乌克兰人作战，并于 2025 年 3 月在顿涅茨克省首次部署之前逃离。他说，跑过一片田地后，他在地下室和房屋里躲了两天无人机，然后才与乌克兰武装分子取得联系。

paras.en: Now, Oliynyk has been in detention in Ukraine for nearly two years while authorities investigate possible treason. He has yet to be formally charged.
paras.zh: 现在，奥利尼克已在乌克兰被拘留近两年，当局正在调查可能的叛国罪。他尚未受到正式指控。

paras.en: Sergey Nikitin contributed to this article, which originally appeared in Ukrainian.
paras.zh: 谢尔盖·尼基丁 (Sergey Nikitin) 对这篇文章做出了贡献，该文章最初以乌克兰语发表。

articles.title: Surrogacy in Georgia is booming, but at what cost?

paras.en: Three years ago, Olga, 40, and Daniel (both names changed to protect the their identities) from Hamburg decided to employ the services of a surrogate mother. But surrogacy is illegal in Germany, and people whose children are born through surrogacy must pursue the legal recognition of their parenthood in German courts.
paras.zh: 三年前，来自汉堡的 40 岁奥尔加和丹尼尔（为了保护身份而化名）决定聘请代孕母亲。但代孕在德国是非法的，通过代孕出生的孩子必须在德国法院寻求对其父母身份的法律承认。

paras.en: Olga is a German citizen, but was born and raised in Russia. That's why the couple wanted to learn more about the surrogacy market in Russia. But foreign customers have been banned from signing Russian surrogacy contracts since 2022. After Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, many international agencies that liaise between surrogates and intended parents moved to Georgia. So, Olga and Daniel traveled there.
paras.zh: 奥尔加是德国公民，但在俄罗斯出生和长大。这就是为什么这对夫妇想更多地了解俄罗斯代孕市场。但自2022年起，外国客户被禁止签署俄罗斯代孕合同。俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰后，许多负责代孕者和准父母之间联络的国际机构都搬到了格鲁吉亚。于是，奥尔加和丹尼尔前往那里。

paras.en: Georgia the new destination for surrogate mothers
paras.zh: 乔治亚州成为代孕母亲的新目的地

paras.en: In the past years, Georgia, a mountainous country in the Caucasus region, has become a sort of surrogacy hub, with women traveling from all over the world to work as surrogates. According to Georgia's Public Service Development Agency, over 3,000 surrogate mothers were registered in 2023 across the country. Since 2012, they've given birth to over 5,000 children. And since the beginning of Russia's war in Ukraine, the number of children born to surrogate mothers has skyrocketed. While an estimated 300 surrogate mothers gave birth in 2021, that number leapt to over 1,100 by 2023.
paras.zh: 在过去的几年里，高加索地区的山区国家格鲁吉亚已经成为一种代孕中心，来自世界各地的女性纷纷前来从事代孕工作。据佐治亚州公共服务发展机构称，2023 年全国有超过 3000 名代孕母亲进行了登记。自2012年以来，他们已经生下了5000多个孩子。自从俄罗斯在乌克兰发动战争以来，代孕母亲所生的孩子数量猛增。 2021 年估计有 300 名代孕母亲分娩，但到 2023 年这一数字将跃升至 1,100 多名。

paras.en: Anastasia, 39, is a surrogate mother from Russia working in Georgia. She has a grown daughter and has already seen through three surrogate pregnancies. Her first was in 2021, which she used to finance a property down payment.
paras.zh: 39 岁的阿纳斯塔西娅是一位来自俄罗斯的代孕母亲，在格鲁吉亚工作。她有一个已经成年的女儿，并且已经经历了三次代孕。她的第一次是在 2021 年，她用这笔钱支付了房产首付。

paras.en: Anastasia says she completed her first two surrogacies in Russia, and her third — for a Japanese couple, brokered through the branch office of a Moscow clinic — in Georgia. Like many surrogate mothers, she went home to Russia after the embryo was implanted, and returned to Georgia when she was 22 weeks pregnant.
paras.zh: 阿纳斯塔西娅说，她在俄罗斯完成了前两次代孕，第三次是在格鲁吉亚，为一对日本夫妇，通过莫斯科一家诊所的分支机构进行了中介。和许多代孕妈妈一样，她在胚胎植入后回到了俄罗斯的家中，并在怀孕22周时返回了格鲁吉亚。

paras.en: "I live in an apartment with another surrogate mother who carried twins to term. This program was the easiest and most practical one for me, but maybe I just got lucky with the right clinic," Anastasia told DW. "Other women who gave birth in Georgia told me they had difficulties. For example, after giving birth, they had to wait a long time before they were paid." She says she's ready to become a surrogate mother again.
paras.zh: “我和另一位代孕妈妈住在一间公寓里，她生下了双胞胎。这个项目对我来说是最简单、最实用的项目，但也许我只是运气好，找到了合适的诊所，”阿纳斯塔西娅告诉德国之声。 “其他在佐治亚州生孩子的妇女告诉我，她们遇到了困难。例如，生完孩子后，她们必须等待很长时间才能拿到工资。”她说她已经准备好再次成为代孕母亲。

paras.en: Estimates vary, but there are about 19 clinics that offer such services across Georgia. And at around €45,000 ($50,400) to €55,000, the average service costs for agencies in Tbilisi or Batumi are only about a third of what agencies in other countries charge.
paras.zh: 虽然估计有所不同，但佐治亚州约有 19 家诊所提供此类服务。第比利斯或巴统的机构平均服务成本约为 45,000 欧元（50,400 美元）至 55,000 欧元，仅为其他国家机构收费的三分之一左右。

paras.en: Several surrogate mothers who gave birth in Georgian clinics told DW that their average salary was between €18,000 and €28,000, with premiums added for birthing twins, for example.
paras.zh: 几位在格鲁吉亚诊所生孩子的代孕妈妈告诉德国之声，她们的平均工资在18,000欧元至28,000欧元之间，例如，生双胞胎还要额外支付保费。

paras.en: Surrogate mothers from Ukraine in demand
paras.zh: 乌克兰代孕妈妈需求旺盛

paras.en: Daniel and Olga told DW that they spent months looking for surrogacy agency in Georgia. "Pretty soon, we had access to a list of women from Russia, Ukraine, Kazakhstan, and Georgia, and were given a detailed description of the process, along with the contact information of lawyers who could help take care of the formalities," they recount. "We were a little concerned that not every agency could give clear answers about the health of some of the surrogate mothers."
paras.zh: 丹尼尔和奥尔加告诉德国之声，他们花了几个月的时间在佐治亚州寻找代孕机构。 “很快，我们就获得了来自俄罗斯、乌克兰、哈萨克斯坦和格鲁吉亚的女性名单，并获得了整个过程的详细描述，以及可以帮助办理手续的律师的联系信息，”他们回忆道。 “我们有点担心，并不是每个机构都能对一些代孕母亲的健康状况给出明确的答案。”

paras.en: Both work in the medical field, and Olga says perhaps some of their questions about the physical health and possible genetic disorders might have been too probing. "We picked a 30-year-old woman from Ukraine who had already been a surrogate mother once for a European couple," she says. The Russian-Georgian agency set up half-hour long Zoom call, "but that hardly seemed enough to make a final decision," Olga adds.
paras.zh: 两人都在医学领域工作，奥尔加说，也许他们对身体健康和可能的遗传疾病的一些问题过于探究。 “我们挑选了一位来自乌克兰的 30 岁女性，她曾为一对欧洲夫妇做过代孕妈妈，”她说。俄罗斯-格鲁吉亚机构安排了半小时的 Zoom 通话，“但这似乎不足以做出最终决定，”奥尔加补充道。

paras.en: In the spring of 2024, the married couple traveled to Georgia's capital to meet Elena (her name has been changed to protect her identity). Following a long discussion, the agency had seemed reluctant when they agreed to bring her to Tbilisi for the meeting. Elena made a good first impression on the couple from Hamburg, showing them pictures of her children and telling them she wanted to use the money she earned to renovate her apartment.
paras.zh: 2024 年春天，这对夫妇前往佐治亚州首府会见埃琳娜（为保护身份，她的名字已更改）。经过长时间的讨论，该机构在同意带她去第比利斯参加会议时似乎不太情愿。埃琳娜给这对来自汉堡的夫妇留下了良好的第一印象，她向他们展示了自己孩子的照片，并告诉他们她想用赚来的钱翻修公寓。

paras.en: "They had initially told us that the surrogate would spent the entire pregnancy living in a rented apartment in Tbilisi," Olga and Daniel tell DW. "But then we found out that Elena was going back home for a few months after the embryo was implanted, back to Ukraine, where there's war."
paras.zh: 奥尔加和丹尼尔告诉德国之声：“他们最初告诉我们，代孕妈妈将在整个怀孕期间住在第比利斯的一间租来的公寓里。” “但后来我们发现，胚胎植入后埃琳娜要回家几个月，回到正在发生战争的乌克兰。”

paras.en: Human rights experts criticize legislation
paras.zh: 人权专家批评立法

paras.en: Georgian laws have a weak spot, the human rights lawyer Nino Bogveradze tells DW: They only regulate the relationship between the surrogate mothers, the intended parents, and the clinics, but they do not consider the roles that agencies play.
paras.zh: 人权律师尼诺·博格韦拉泽 (Nino Bogveradze) 告诉德国之声，格鲁吉亚法律有一个弱点：它们只规范代孕母亲、预期父母和诊所之间的关系，但没有考虑机构所扮演的角色。

paras.en: In Georgia, surrogate mothers have limited rights. Most concerns related to their pregnancy, medical care or payment are not regulated by national law but in contracts between the involved parties. And the state does not set minimum standards for social guarantees or contractual terms.
paras.zh: 在佐治亚州，代孕母亲的权利有限。大多数与怀孕、医疗或付款有关的问题不受国家法律管辖，而是在相关各方之间的合同中规定。国家也没有设定社会保障或合同条款的最低标准。

paras.en: After an embryo has been implanted, surrogate mothers are not allowed to keep the child, leave the program, or end the pregnancy. Several human rights groups, including Human Rights Watch and the International Women's Health Coalition say the established practice in Georgia violates women's rights to reproductive self-determination.
paras.zh: 胚胎植入后，代孕母亲不得保留孩子、退出计划或终止妊娠。包括人权观察组织和国际妇女健康联盟在内的多个人权组织表示，格鲁吉亚的既定做法侵犯了妇女的生殖自决权。

paras.en: "Agencies often speak of their special mission to help people have the child they've been dreaming of," Olga Doletskaya from the University of Leeds tell DW. "But in reality, they're primarily driven by financial interests. And that's why they exploit the precarious situation of surrogate mothers, and pressure intended parents."
paras.zh: 利兹大学的奥尔加·多莱特斯卡娅 (Olga Doletskaya) 告诉德国之声：“各机构经常谈到他们的特殊使命，即帮助人们拥有他们梦想的孩子。” “但实际上，他们主要是受经济利益驱动。这就是为什么他们利用代孕母亲的不稳定处境，并向意向父母施加压力。”

paras.en: Olga and Daniel from Hamburg agree. "We were constantly being made to understand that we should decide as quickly as possible. We had to hurry because apparently several other couples were also interested in our surrogate," Olga says.
paras.zh: 来自汉堡的奥尔加和丹尼尔同意这一点。 “我们不断地被告知，我们应该尽快做出决定。我们必须抓紧时间，因为显然其他几对夫妇也对我们的代孕妈妈感兴趣，”奥尔加说。

paras.en: And the agency kept stressing that it had paid out of pocket for bringing the potential surrogate mother to Georgia, despite that not being contractually agreed. "At some point, a representative noticed my emotional state and asked me how long I wanted to remain childless," Olga recounts. "I felt like I was being manipulated."
paras.zh: 该机构一直强调，尽管合同上没有达成一致，但它还是自掏腰包将潜在的代孕母亲带到佐治亚州。 “在某个时候，一位代表注意到了我的情绪状态，并问我想要不生孩子多久，”奥尔加回忆道。 “我感觉自己被操纵了。”

paras.en: The couple returned to Germany with mixed feelings and decided to shelve the idea of employing a surrogate mother — at least, for now.
paras.zh: 这对夫妇怀着复杂的心情回到德国，并决定搁置雇用代孕母亲的想法——至少现在是这样。

paras.en: Mark Sheider and Asja Lokina contributed to this article, which originally appeared in Russian.
paras.zh: Mark Sheider 和 Asja Lokina 对这篇文章做出了贡献，该文章最初以俄语发表。

articles.title: Trump announces 'energy ceasefire' between Russia and Ukraine

paras.en: US President Donald Trump said Sunday that Russia and Ukraine had agreed to halt strikes on each other's energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周日表示，俄罗斯和乌克兰已同意停止对彼此能源基础设施的袭击。

paras.en: "Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine," the president wrote on his Truth Social network.
paras.zh: 总统在他的真相社交网络上写道：“俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争实现能源停火，立即生效。”

paras.en: Trump continued: "Both parties have agreed," before urging restraint from both Kyiv and Moscow: "Do not break it!"
paras.zh: 特朗普继续说道：“双方都同意”，然后敦促基辅和莫斯科保持克制：“不要打破它！”

paras.en: Zelenskyy: Energy ceasefire 'news for me'
paras.zh: 泽连斯基：能源停火“对我来说是新闻”

paras.en: There was no immediate confirmation from Moscow, but Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy told the news site Axios within minutes of Trump's post that the ceasefire was "news for me."
paras.zh: 莫斯科没有立即证实，但乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基在特朗普发帖后几分钟内告诉新闻网站 Axios，停火“对我来说是新闻”。

paras.en: "The ceasefire announcement was news for me. But if Russians agree to an energy ceasefire, Ukraine will agree. If President Trump negotiated it with Putin, please tell us when the ceasefire begins; we are ready and we will accept it," he told Axios.
paras.zh: “停火声明对我来说是新闻。但如果俄罗斯同意能源停火，乌克兰也会同意。如果特朗普总统与普京进行谈判，请告诉我们停火何时开始；我们准备好了，我们会接受它，”他告诉 Axios。

paras.en: Earlier Sunday, Zelenskyy repeated his stance that Ukraine would stop hitting Russian oil refineries if the Kremlin curbed its energy attacks.
paras.zh: 周日早些时候，泽伦斯基重申了他的立场，即如果克里姆林宫遏制其能源袭击，乌克兰将停止袭击俄罗斯炼油厂。

paras.en: Trump and Zelenskyy have argued this week over Ukraine's attacks on Russian diesel facilities, which the US president said have contributed to a global diesel shortage, rather than the Iran war.
paras.zh: 特朗普和泽伦斯基本周就乌克兰袭击俄罗斯柴油设施问题发生争执，美国总统表示，乌克兰袭击俄罗斯柴油设施是导致全球柴油短缺的原因，而不是伊朗战争。

paras.en: Trump needs lower fuel prices before midterms
paras.zh: 特朗普需要在中期选举前降低燃油价格

paras.en: Trump said Friday he had struck a deal with Russian President Vladimir Putin to buy diesel from Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普周五表示，他已与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京达成协议，从俄罗斯购买柴油。

paras.en: The controversial move was an attempt to bring down high fuel prices ahead of the US midterm elections next month.
paras.zh: 这一有争议的举措是为了在下个月美国中期选举之前降低高油价。

paras.en: However, this move undercuts fresh US sanctions Trump signed just weeks ago to further hurt Russian energy revenues funding the war.
paras.zh: 然而，此举削弱了特朗普几周前签署的新制裁措施，该制裁措施进一步损害了俄罗斯为战争提供资金的能源收入。

paras.en: Backing Zelenskyy in the Trump row, European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen said that she "fully supported" the call for a "ceasefire that protects global food supplies and energy infrastructure in Ukraine and Russia."
paras.zh: 欧盟委员会主席乌苏拉·冯德莱恩在特朗普之争中支持泽连斯基，表示她“完全支持”“停火以保护乌克兰和俄罗斯的全球粮食供应和能源基础设施”的呼吁。

paras.en: "And my full support for President Zelenskyy as he leads the fight for his people's freedom," she wrote online.
paras.zh: 她在网上写道：“我全力支持泽连斯基总统领导人民争取自由的斗争。”

paras.en: French President Emmanuel Macron said his country backs a "real energy ceasefire," but lamented that "Russia continues to refuse that."
paras.zh: 法国总统马克龙表示，法国支持“真正的能源停火”，但遗憾的是“俄罗斯继续拒绝这样做”。

paras.en: Russia has repeatedly struck Ukraine's power plants and transmission lines around Kyiv, Kharkiv, Odesa and elsewhere, to lower civilian morale, especially during the winter months.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯多次袭击乌克兰基辅、哈尔科夫、敖德萨等地周边的发电厂和输电线路，以降低民众士气，尤其是在冬季。

paras.en: Recently, Ukraine has stepped up long-range strikes deep inside Russian territory, targeting major oil refineries and other facilities to curb Moscow's refining capacity and fuel supplies.
paras.zh: 近期，乌克兰加强了对俄罗斯领土深处的远程打击，以主要炼油厂和其他设施为目标，以遏制莫斯科的炼油能力和燃料供应。

paras.en: Kyiv on Sunday pressed on its campaign against Russian infrastructure, hitting a data center run by Russian technology giant Yandex.
paras.zh: 基辅周日加大力度打击俄罗斯基础设施，袭击了俄罗斯科技巨头 Yandex 运营的数据中心。

paras.en: It was the third strike on the company’s facilities in four days.
paras.zh: 这是四天内对该公司设施的第三次罢工。
