articles.title: Jason Kelce’s Eagles-Jaguars broadcast shows why NFL booths could use more offensive linemen

paras.en: Jason Kelce made an emergency long snapper one of the most interesting parts of Eagles-Jaguars on Sunday morning.
paras.zh: 杰森·凯尔斯（Jason Kelce）在周日早上的紧急长笛比赛中成为了老鹰队与美洲虎队最有趣的部分之一。

paras.en: I wasn’t expecting to spend much time thinking about Jacksonville’s long-snapping situation when I turned on the game. But that’s where we ended up, and having a former offensive lineman in the booth made it worth listening to.
paras.zh: 当我打开游戏时，我没想到会花太多时间思考杰克逊维尔的长断情况。但这就是我们最终的结果，并且在展位上有一位前进攻线卫，这使得它值得一听。

paras.en: Kelce joined Dave Pasch and Kurt Warner for NFL Network’s broadcast from London. The assignment is one of four games on Kelce’s NFL Network schedule this season.
paras.zh: 凯尔斯 (Kelce) 与戴夫·帕什 (Dave Pasch) 和库尔特·华纳 (Kurt Warner) 一起在伦敦进行 NFL Network 的转播。这项任务是凯尔斯 NFL Network 本赛季日程中的四场比赛之一。

paras.en: The combination worked really well. Warner can explain the game from the quarterback’s perspective, while Kelce spent his career dealing with everything happening directly in front of the quarterback.
paras.zh: 这种组合效果非常好。华纳可以从四分卫的角度解释比赛，而凯尔斯则在他的职业生涯中处理直接在四分卫面前发生的一切。

paras.en: Most game broadcasts spend a lot of time talking about quarterback play, and rightfully so: it's the most important position on the field. That said, it was refreshing to get some perspective from a former offensive lineman and it added depth to the presentation.
paras.zh: 大多数比赛转播都会花很多时间谈论四分卫的比赛，这是理所当然的：这是球场上最重要的位置。也就是说，从一位前进攻前锋那里获得一些观点令人耳目一新，并且增加了演示的深度。

paras.en: After Jaguars long snapper Ross Matiscik suffered a shoulder injury, Jacksonville turned to defensive tackle DaVon Hamilton.
paras.zh: 在美洲虎队长抢手罗斯·马蒂西克肩部受伤后，杰克逊维尔转向防守截锋达文·汉密尔顿。

paras.en: Long snapper isn't a position most fans spend much time thinking about (at least not until something goes horribly wrong), but it's a critical position.
paras.zh: 大多数球迷不会花很多时间考虑长笛手的位置（至少在出现严重错误之前不会），但这是一个关键的位置。

paras.en: Kelce had actually done the job in high school and knew something about the difficulty of doing it as a very large human being.
paras.zh: 凯尔斯实际上在高中时就做过这项工作，并且知道作为一个非常大的人做这件事的难度。

paras.en: "When I got fat, when I put on weight, I used to long-snap in high school," Kelce said. "When I got to over 300 pounds-ish, it became really hard to look in between your legs."
paras.zh: “当我变胖，当我体重增加时，我在高中时常常会发长发，”凯尔斯说。 “当我的体重超过 300 磅左右时，我就很难看到双腿之间的情况了。”

paras.en: Well, there’s something I hadn’t considered.
paras.zh: 嗯，有件事我没有考虑到。

paras.en: Hamilton, a 29-year-old, 6-foot-4, 335-pound defensive tackle who long snapped in high school, was being asked to handle a job that could swing the game with one bad snap.
paras.zh: 汉密尔顿是一名 29 岁、身高 6 英尺 4 英寸、体重 335 磅的防守截锋，他在高中时就长期表现不佳，现在被要求处理一项可能因一次糟糕的突破而改变比赛的工作。

paras.en: Kelce was enjoying Hamilton’s effort, too.
paras.zh: 凯尔斯也很享受汉密尔顿的努力。

paras.en: Warner, meanwhile, wanted to correct Kelce’s description of himself.
paras.zh: 与此同时，华纳想要纠正凯尔斯对自己的描述。

paras.en: "You’ve never been fat. You’re just husky."
paras.zh: “你从来都没有胖过，你只是哈士奇而已。”

paras.en: Some viewers have already had enough of Jason Kelce
paras.zh: 有些观众已经受够了杰森·凯尔斯

paras.en: The reviews on X were considerably less friendly in places.
paras.zh: X 上的评论在某些地方相当不友好。

paras.en: "Jason Kelce is on the call for Jaguars/Eagles?… Yeah, this won’t be a biased broadcast at all," one user wrote.
paras.zh: “杰森·凯尔斯参加了美洲虎/老鹰队的比赛？……是的，这根本不会是有偏见的广播，”一位用户写道。

paras.en: Another viewer said: "Yeah I’m sorry, Jason Kelce cannot do Eagles games. Clear bias and won’t stop talking."
paras.zh: 另一位观众说：“是的，我很抱歉，贾森·凯尔斯不能参加老鹰队的比赛。明确偏见，不会停止说话。”

paras.en: Playing for the Eagles doesn’t automatically make Kelce a bad choice to call their games. Judge him on what he says.
paras.zh: 为老鹰队效力并不意味着凯尔斯就成为了他们比赛的糟糕选择。根据他所说的话来判断他。

paras.en: Kelce did lay it on a little thick when praising Eagles head coach Nick Sirianni for calling a timeout late in the first half. The timeout gave replay officials more time to look at a potential fumble. It was a smart move, but Kelce was a little over-the-top in his approval.
paras.zh: 凯尔斯在赞扬老鹰队主教练尼克·西里安尼在上半场晚些时候叫了暂停时，确实有点过分了。暂停给了重赛官员更多的时间来审视潜在的掉球。这是一个明智的举动，但凯尔斯的认可有点过头了。

paras.en: The other main complaint was that Kelce talked too much. One user posted, "Jason Kelce hasn’t stopped talking," while another viewer accused him of leaving Warner with nothing to do.
paras.zh: 另一个主要抱怨是凯尔斯话太多。一位用户发帖称，“杰森·凯尔斯一直在说话”，而另一位观众则指责他让华纳无所事事。

paras.en: I don't agree with that assessment. The three-man booth can be challenging to navigate and often one analyst spends more time talking. But I felt the distribution made sense.
paras.zh: 我不同意这个评价。三人展位可能很难驾驭，而且一名分析师通常会花费更多时间进行交谈。但我觉得这种分配是有道理的。

paras.en: There’s room for Kelce’s enthusiasm alongside Warner’s analysis, especially when they’re looking at the game from different positions. The long-snapping sequence was my favorite part, but I’d like to hear that quarterback-center conversation on more broadcasts.
paras.zh: 凯尔斯的热情与华纳的分析相结合，尤其是当他们从不同的角度看待比赛时。长镜头是我最喜欢的部分，但我想在更多的广播中听到四分卫中锋的对话。

paras.en: And social media wasn't entirely negative. Chase Senior had a take I agreed with: "I actually think this role suits him better than being on the set for ESPN."
paras.zh: 社交媒体也不完全是负面的。我同意 Chase Senior 的看法：“我实际上认为这个角色比 ESPN 的片场更适合他。”

paras.en: Kelce is a natural as a game broadcaster. I wouldn’t be surprised if a network offers him a nice raise to do it full-time.
paras.zh: 凯尔斯是天生的游戏播音员。如果网络公司给他加薪让他全职工作，我不会感到惊讶。

articles.title: Rescue expert warns FlyDubai hijacking attempt shows US, allies are ‘playing checkers’ against terror threat

paras.en: The FlyDubai attempted hijacking shows the U.S. and its allies are still using outdated counterterrorism assumptions against increasingly sophisticated enemies, a U.S. rescue expert and 9/11 first responder warns.
paras.zh: 美国救援专家和 9/11 急救人员警告说，迪拜航空企图劫机事件表明，美国及其盟友仍在使用过时的反恐假设来对付日益复杂的敌人。

paras.en: "They’re good at chess," Bryan Stern, chairman and CEO of Grey Bull Rescue, told Fox News Digital on Monday, saying the radical ideology behind the FlyDubai attack is a ringing "bell" for global aviation security and Western counterterrorism strategy.
paras.zh: 灰牛救援公司董事长兼首席执行官布莱恩·斯特恩周一对福克斯新闻数字频道表示：“他们擅长国际象棋。”他表示，FlyDubai 袭击事件背后的激进意识形态为全球航空安全和西方反恐战略敲响了“警钟”。

paras.en: "And we’re, if we’re lucky, playing checkers – if we’re lucky – and I would argue we’re not even playing checkers that well."
paras.zh: “如果我们幸运的话，我们正在玩跳棋——如果我们幸运的话——而且我认为我们甚至玩跳棋都没有那么好。”

paras.en: Stern, whose global nonprofit conducts evacuations from war zones and hostage situations, said the thwarted FlyDubai attack by "an angry, radicalized, Sunni bad guy" is showing just how far behind our enemies we are in this post-9/11 world.
paras.zh: 斯特恩的全球非营利组织负责从战区和人质局势中进行疏散，他表示，“一个愤怒的、激进的逊尼派坏人”对迪拜航空的袭击遭到挫败，这表明在9/11后的世界里，我们远远落后于我们的敌人。

paras.en: "They understand us significantly more than we understand them," Stern, who has been "hunting the bad guys" for 30 years, said. Stern said the U.S. has to understand the "asymmetric warfare" as well as the increasingly sophisticated enemy does.
paras.zh: “他们对我们的了解远远超过我们对他们的了解，”30 年来一直在“追捕坏人”的斯特恩说。斯特恩表示，美国必须像日益复杂的敌人一样了解“不对称战争”。

paras.en: "The reason why a football coach watches game tapes is not to watch his own team play, it's to watch the bad guys play," he said. "We gotta start watching some game tapes."
paras.zh: “足球教练看比赛录像不是为了看自己球队的比赛，而是为了看坏人的比赛，”他说。 “我们得开始看一些比赛录像了。”

paras.en: Stern is intimately in tune with the playbook on the ground in war zones, including the Middle East and Iran.
paras.zh: 斯特恩与中东和伊朗等战区的实际行动非常吻合。

paras.en: "We conduct these operations in these places still to this very day," he said. "We're actually on the ground, meaning I know people in Hezbollah, I know people in the Taliban. I know people in ISIS. I know people in ISIS-K. I've met with radical jihadi weirdos and whack jobs personally."
paras.zh: “直到今天我们仍在这些地方进行这些行动，”他说。 “我们实际上是在实地，这意味着我认识真主党的人，我认识塔利班的人。我认识伊斯兰国的人。我认识伊斯兰国的人。我认识伊斯兰国的人。我亲自见过激进的圣战怪人和打击工作。”

paras.en: United Arab Emirates investigators have described the incident aboard FlyDubai flight FZ1073 as an attempted terror attack after the co-pilot allegedly stabbed the captain and tried to hijack the plane, which was carrying more than 170 passengers and crew, most of them Israelis. Australian authorities have also said a counterterrorism unit is investigating the co-pilot’s links to Australia.
paras.zh: 阿联酋调查人员将迪拜航空 FZ1073 航班上的事件描述为一次未遂恐怖袭击，副驾驶据称刺伤了机长并试图劫持飞机，飞机上载有 170 多名乘客和机组人员，其中大多数是以色列人。澳大利亚当局还表示，一个反恐部门正在调查副驾驶与澳大利亚的联系。

paras.en: "The bad guys are completely not afraid. They're completely emboldened. They have got the whole world to hate Israel, the whole world to hate us," he said. "It's a tough problem."
paras.zh: “坏人完全不害怕。他们完全有胆量。他们让全世界都恨以色列，全世界都恨我们，”他说。 “这是一个棘手的问题。”

paras.en: Since the incident, there has been renewed vigilance in aviation and foreign airline security. Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu instructed his national security council to review security procedures for foreign civil aviation to Israel, while Vice President JD Vance said Monday that flight security procedures are also under review in the U.S.
paras.zh: 事件发生后，航空界和外国航空公司的安全再次引起警惕。以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡指示其国家安全委员会审查飞往以色列的外国民用航空的安全程序，而副总统万斯周一表示，美国也在审查飞行安全程序。

paras.en: "I was asked years ago when I was still with the government," Stern said. "A team was put together and the question before the court was, if you were al-Qaeda, what would you do?"
paras.zh: “几年前有人问我什么时候还在政府工作，”斯特恩说。 “一个团队被组建起来，法庭上的问题是，如果你是基地组织，你会怎么做？”

paras.en: "What I came up with was ... I would get 19 hijackers, and I would hijack four airplanes, and I would fly them into buildings in America, and then issue a communique that said: 20 years of war, you are no safer today than you were before – that for TSA, and Homeland Security, and Iraq, and Afghanistan and all the different things, you are actually no safer, America, today than you were before," he said.
paras.zh: “我的想法是......我会抓到19名劫机者，我会劫持四架飞机，我会把它们飞进美国的建筑物，然后发表一份公报说：20年的战争，今天并不比以前更安全——对于运输安全管理局、国土安全部、伊拉克、阿富汗和所有不同的事情来说，今天的美国实际上并不比以前更安全，”他说。

paras.en: "We're seeing, sadly," he lamented, "that academic hypothetical situation has now become a reality, or certainly a possibility."
paras.zh: “可悲的是，我们看到，”他感叹道，“学术假设的情况现在已经成为现实，或者肯定是一种可能性。”

paras.en: Despite President Donald Trump and the War Department's best efforts to rid the world of terrorist groups – and Iran of nuclear weapons aspirations – "you can't bomb your way into peace," Stern claimed.
paras.zh: 尽管唐纳德·特朗普总统和陆军部尽最大努力消除世界上的恐怖组织 — — 以及伊朗的核武器野心 — — “你无法通过轰炸实现和平，”斯特恩声称。

paras.en: "They have been in holy war against us," he added. "We have now engaged in a holy war against them."
paras.zh: “他们一直在与我们进行圣战，”他补充道。 “我们现在正在对他们进行一场圣战。”

paras.en: "On Ramadan, the holiest month of the year in Islam, on the first day, which is the holiest day, we detonated the leader of the Shia faith, the Ayatollah," he said, likening it to "if somebody assassinated the pope on Easter Sunday while he's giving mass at the Vatican."
paras.zh: “在伊斯兰教一年中最神圣的月份斋月的第一天，也就是最神圣的一天，我们引爆了什叶派信仰的领袖阿亚图拉，”他说，并将其比作“如果有人在复活节周日在梵蒂冈做弥撒时刺杀了教皇。”

paras.en: Stern explained that rooting out ideological terror in the U.S. is more complex than ever, because even if the border is not open any longer under Trump, the terrorist networks might be infiltrating America with U.S. passport holders – making them tough to investigate, if not impossible to spot before an attack.
paras.zh: 斯特恩解释说，根除美国的意识形态恐怖比以往任何时候都更加复杂，因为即使特朗普领导下的边境不再开放，恐怖分子网络也可能会带着美国护照持有人渗透到美国 — — 这使得他们很难调查，甚至不可能在袭击前被发现。

paras.en: Stern likened it to the release of the suspects in the RAF Fairford investigation – potential terrorist passport holders walking free.
paras.zh: 斯特恩将其比作英国皇家空军费尔福德调查中嫌疑人的释放——潜在的恐怖分子护照持有者逍遥法外。

paras.en: "Until I actually squeeze the triggers, I haven't committed a crime yet," he said. "Now give me an airplane."
paras.zh: “在我真正扣动扳机之前，我还没有犯罪，”他说。 “现在给我一架飞机。”

paras.en: Stern noted that the nature of America's adversaries in the current conflict is unlike what the U.S. faced in places like Afghanistan.
paras.zh: 斯特恩指出，美国在当前冲突中的对手的性质与美国在阿富汗等地所面临的不同。

paras.en: "We need to remember we are very used to shooting people like the Taliban who don't know what plumbing is – who literally for years lived in caves until we showed up and gave them stuff," he continued. "The bad guys that we're talking about today are extremely sophisticated. They are extremely resourced, extremely resourceful. They're very intelligent, they're very smart, and they're very good at what they do."
paras.zh: “我们需要记住，我们非常习惯射击像塔利班这样的人，他们不知道管道是什么——他们实际上在洞穴里生活了多年，直到我们出现并给他们东西，”他继续说道。 “我们今天谈论的坏人非常狡猾。他们资源丰富，足智多谋。他们非常聪明，他们非常聪明，而且他们非常擅长他们所做的事情。”

paras.en: "The Persian Empire is the only empire of empires who have been all the way on top and all the way defeated at the bottom – six times," he said. "They're looking at us going, you're 250 years old. How adorable. You're cute, America."
paras.zh: 他说：“波斯帝国是帝国中唯一一个曾六次一路领先又一路失败的帝国。” “他们看着我们走，你已经 250 岁了。太可爱了。你很可爱，美国。”

paras.en: Stern predicted that some day even 9/11 — which he survived as a first responder — is ultimately going to be dwarfed.
paras.zh: 斯特恩预测，有一天，即使是 9/11（他作为第一响应者幸存下来）最终也将变得相形见绌。

paras.en: "What will happen, probably is we'll get attacked – just like 9/11, we'll get attacked," he said. "We'll say, 'Oh my God, how did this happen?' People will wake up."
paras.zh: “将会发生的情况是，我们可能会受到攻击——就像 9/11 一样，我们会受到攻击，”他说。 “我们会说，‘天哪，这是怎么发生的？’人们会醒来的。”

paras.en: "I promise you there will come a time, it will be, you know, June 26 or whatever, where we're gonna read about 9/11, and we're gonna say, 'Wow, that wasn't so bad, only 3,000 died,'" he warned.
paras.zh: “我向你保证，总有一天，你知道，6 月 26 日或者什么时候，我们会读到有关 9/11 的报道，我们会说，‘哇，那还不错，只有 3,000 人死亡，’”他警告说。

paras.en: "Why? Because we have created a holy war. We have now gotten into the crazy. And you cannot unring that bell."
paras.zh: “为什么？因为我们制造了一场圣战。我们现在已经陷入疯狂。而你无法敲响那钟声。”

articles.title: Kevin Costner's bachelor era: Actor sparks romance rumors with Jewel, Sharon Stone, Brooks Nader and more

paras.en: Kevin Costner is living the life of a bachelor following his 2023 divorce.
paras.zh: 凯文·科斯特纳 (Kevin Costner) 于 2023 年离婚后过着单身汉的生活。

paras.en: After his ex-wife, Christine Baumgartner, filed for divorce in May 2023, the 71-year-old actor has been sparking romance rumors with a number of women, both in and out of the entertainment industry.
paras.zh: 在他的前妻克里斯汀·鲍姆加特纳 (Christine Baumgartner) 于 2023 年 5 月提出离婚后，这位 71 岁的演员一直与娱乐圈内外的多名女性传出浪漫传闻。

paras.en: Most recently, he was photographed shopping in Santa Barbara with a much younger lifestyle coach, and prior to that had the internet buzzing with speculation he was dating actress Brooks Nader.
paras.zh: 最近，他被拍到与一位年轻得多的生活方式教练在圣巴巴拉购物，在此之前，互联网上流传着他正在与女演员布鲁克斯·纳德约会的猜测。

paras.en: Here is a rundown on some of the women Costner has been connected to since entering her bachelor era.
paras.zh: 以下是科斯特纳进入单身时代以来所接触的一些女性的概要。

paras.en: Costner was recently photographed on a shopping date with his latest reported romance, a woman the Daily Mail identified as 40-year-old lifestyle coach Jennifer Milburn.
paras.zh: 科斯特纳最近被拍到与他最新报道的恋情一起购物约会，《每日邮报》称这名女子是 40 岁的生活方式教练詹妮弗·米尔本 (Jennifer Milburn)。

paras.en: The pair were photographed smiling as they walked down the aisles of the grocery store and through the parking lot together, taking turns pushing the shopping cart around.
paras.zh: 两人被拍到微笑着一起走过杂货店的过道，穿过停车场，轮流推着购物车。

paras.en: Milburn kept it casual in cutoff denim shorts and a white button-up shirt, while Costner walked the aisles in an all-white outfit paired with sunglasses.
paras.zh: 米尔本穿着牛仔短裤和白色纽扣衬衫，保持休闲风格，而科斯特纳则穿着全白服装，戴着太阳镜走在过道上。

paras.en: It is unclear when their relationship began.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚他们的关系何时开始。

paras.en: The "Dances with Wolves" star has also been spotted out and about with influencer McKenna Wesley a few times throughout the past year.
paras.zh: 去年，这位《与狼共舞》明星也多次被发现与网红麦肯纳·韦斯利 (McKenna Wesley) 一起外出。

paras.en: They were first photographed sitting next to each other at a screening of "Field of Dreams" in Arizona, in October 2025.
paras.zh: 2025 年 10 月，他们第一次被拍到坐在亚利桑那州的《梦想之地》放映会上。

paras.en: Nearly one year later, the two were photographed together again, while enjoying lunch in Santa Barbara.
paras.zh: 近一年后，两人再次被拍到一起在圣巴巴拉享用午餐。

paras.en: One source told Page Six that "They met in Scottsdale about a year ago. They both love to golf," while another added that "She has been his guest on multiple occasions at his Santa Barbara and Aspen properties."
paras.zh: 一位消息人士告诉第六页，“他们大约一年前在斯科茨代尔相识。他们都喜欢打高尔夫球”，而另一位消息人士补充说，“她曾多次在他的圣巴巴拉和阿斯彭房产中做客。”

paras.en: In November 2024, The Daily Mail reported that the "Yellowstone" actor and Sharon Stone were getting "flirty" with each other while at the 2024 Governors Awards.
paras.zh: 2024 年 11 月，《每日邮报》报道称，这位《黄石》演员和莎朗·斯通在 2024 年州长颁奖典礼上互相“调情”。

paras.en: "They started off polite with small talk then he put on his Kevin Costner charm, you know, like the vibes he gave off in Bull Durham and Tin Cup, like heyyyy baby," a source told Daily Mail at the time.
paras.zh: 一位消息人士当时告诉《每日邮报》：“他们一开始有礼貌地闲聊，然后他表现出了凯文·科斯特纳的魅力，你知道，就像他在《公牛达勒姆》和《锡杯》中散发出的氛围，就像嘿宝贝一样。”

paras.en: The source went on to say that it seemed like the two actors "liked each other a lot."
paras.zh: 消息人士接着说，这两位演员似乎“非常喜欢对方”。

paras.en: While rumors of a romance between the two ran rampant, Stone shut down any speculation when speaking with Extra TV in December 2024.
paras.zh: 尽管两人之间的恋情传闻甚嚣尘上，但斯通在 2024 年 12 月接受 Extra TV 采访时否认了任何猜测。

paras.en: "First of all, I'm not dating Kevin Costner. I’ve known Kevin Costner for probably 30 years, and I think if we haven’t dated so far, we’re probably not going to," she told the outlet.
paras.zh: “首先，我不会和凯文·科斯特纳约会。我认识凯文·科斯特纳大概有 30 年了，我想如果我们到目前为止还没有约会过，我们可能就不会约会，”她告诉媒体。

paras.en: Costner sparked speculation he was dating country music star, Jewel, when TMZ published photos of the two of them spending time together.
paras.zh: 当 TMZ 发布两人共度时光的照片时，科斯特纳引发了人们对他正在与乡村音乐明星朱厄尔约会的猜测。

paras.en: In the photos, Costner has his arm around Jewel while the two were visiting Richard Branson's private island, Necker Island.
paras.zh: 照片中，科斯特纳搂着朱厄尔，两人正在参观理查德·布兰森的私人岛屿内克尔岛。

paras.en: Both Costner and Jewel addressed the rumors separately, noting the singer was there doing work for her charity, The Inspiring Children Foundation, while Costner was there because he finally decided to accept Branson's invitation to the island after 10 years of saying no.
paras.zh: 科斯特纳和朱厄尔都分别回应了这些谣言，并指出这位歌手在那里为她的慈善机构“鼓舞儿童基金会”工作，而科斯特纳在那里是因为他在拒绝布兰森十年后终于决定接受布兰森的邀请，前往该岛。

paras.en: "Jewel and I are friends. We've never gone out ever," Costner explained on "The Howard Stern Show" in June 2024. "She's special – and I don't want - I don't want these rumors to ruin our friendship because that's what we have. She's special to me. She's beautiful enough to go out with."
paras.zh: “朱厄尔和我是朋友。我们从来没有出去过，”科斯特纳在 2024 年 6 月的《霍华德·斯特恩秀》中解释道。“她很特别——我不想——我不想让这些谣言破坏我们的友谊，因为这就是我们所拥有的。她对我来说很特别。她足够漂亮，可以一起出去。”

paras.en: Costner and casting director, Kelly Noonan Gores, casually began seeing each other in August 2025, according to People.
paras.zh: 据《人物》杂志报道，科斯特纳和选角导演凯利·努南·戈尔斯于 2025 年 8 月偶然开始约会。

paras.en: "Kelly is seeing Kevin, but it's very casual," a source told the outlet at the time. "She thinks he's wonderful and interesting."
paras.zh: “凯利正在和凯文约会，但非常随意，”一位消息人士当时告诉媒体。 “她认为他很棒而且很有趣。”

paras.en: The two kept their relationship mostly private, with a source telling US Weekly in January that Gores has been "grounding" for Costner, and that he is "not looking for a serious relationship or marriage any time soon."
paras.zh: 两人的关系大多保密，一月份有消息人士告诉《美国周刊》，戈尔斯一直在“禁足”科斯特纳，而且他“不会很快寻求认真的关系或婚姻”。

paras.en: "It’s very private and casual," the source said. "After such a public and expensive divorce, he’s being cautious. They see each other when schedules allow, often spending time at his Santa Barbara estate. They love dinners at home, walks on the beach and quiet nights in."
paras.zh: “这是非常私密和随意的，”消息人士说。 “在经历了如此公开且昂贵的离婚之后，他变得很谨慎。他们在日程允许的情况下见面，经常在他位于圣巴巴拉的庄园里度过时光。他们喜欢在家吃晚饭，在海滩上散步，享受安静的夜晚。”

paras.en: It is unclear when or if the two stopped seeing each other.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚两人何时或是否不再见面。

paras.en: Brooks Nader and Costner sparked romance rumors when they were photographed together at the Las Vegas opening of the social club Zero Bond.
paras.zh: 布鲁克斯·纳德和科斯特纳在拉斯维加斯社交俱乐部“零债券”的开幕式上被拍到在一起，引发了浪漫传闻。

paras.en: According to TMZ, the two both attended Scott Sartiano’s VIP dinner and were seen chatting.
paras.zh: 据 TMZ 报道，两人都参加了斯科特·萨蒂亚诺的 VIP 晚宴，并被看到聊天。

paras.en: The "Baywatch" actress shut down the rumors while speaking to Entertainment Tonight later that month.
paras.zh: 这位《海滩救护队》女演员在当月晚些时候接受《今夜娱乐》采访时澄清了谣言。

paras.en: "Oh my gosh. I am single. As of right now, I am single," she told the outlet before covering her face with her hands.
paras.zh: “天哪。我是单身。截至目前，我还是单身，”她告诉媒体，然后用手捂住了脸。

articles.title: Volkswagen boss backs EU plan to bolster domestic European industry
articles.author: Jasper Jolly in Paris

paras.en: The boss of Volkswagen has backed EU proposals to boost its domestic industry, arguing European carmakers need to be able to “compete under comparable conditions” with Chinese rivals.
paras.zh: 大众汽车老板支持欧盟提振国内工业的提议，认为欧洲汽车制造商需要能够与中国竞争对手“在同等条件下竞争”。

paras.en: Oliver Blume said “Made in Europe” rules from the EU “must reward real value creation in Europe”, speaking in Paris before the motor show this week.
paras.zh: 奥利弗·布鲁姆 (Oliver Blume) 本周在巴黎车展前发表讲话时表示，欧盟的“欧洲制造”规则“必须奖励欧洲创造的真正价值”。

paras.en: The rules are aimed at countering the rapid rise of Chinese brands in Europe in the automotive sector and other important manufacturing industries. Lower-priced Chinese manufacturers have prompted a crisis in several industries.
paras.zh: 这些规则旨在遏制中国品牌在欧洲汽车行业和其他重要制造业的快速崛起。价格低廉的中国制造商引发了多个行业的危机。

paras.en: Volkswagen is among the most-affected European companies. Germany’s biggest carmaker has launched a brutal plan to cut as many as 100,000 jobs. Blume said it was the “largest transformation programme in its history”.
paras.zh: 大众汽车是受影响最严重的欧洲公司之一。德国最大的汽车制造商推出了一项残酷的裁员计划，裁员多达 10 万人。布鲁姆表示，这是“其历史上最大的转型计划”。

paras.en: The proposals for the Made in Europe rules, formally known as the Industrial Accelerator Act, would limit subsidies and public procurement to products with a large proportion of their materials and manufacturing coming from within the EU.
paras.zh: 欧洲制造规则的提案（正式名称为《工业加速器法案》）将限制对大部分材料和制造来自欧盟境内的产品的补贴和公共采购。

paras.en: Blume listed a litany of challenges facing European carmakers, saying: “Europe is under enormous competitive pressure.” These included: high energy costs; lower demand as consumers struggle with high inflation; the need to be quicker to develop cars; and intense competition from China.
paras.zh: 布鲁姆列举了欧洲汽车制造商面临的一系列挑战，并表示：“欧洲面临着巨大的竞争压力。”其中包括：能源成本高；由于消费者与高通胀作斗争，需求下降；需要更快地开发汽车；以及来自中国的激烈竞争。

paras.en: On Friday, the EU said it had reached a landmark deal with China to “halve” its sales of hybrid cars in the bloc amid fears surging sales could kill off parts of the European car industry.
paras.zh: 周五，欧盟表示已与中国达成一项具有里程碑意义的协议，将其在欧盟的混合动力汽车销量“减半”，因为担心销量激增可能会扼杀部分欧洲汽车行业。

paras.en: Blume said Germany’s carmakers were happy to compete with Chinese rivals, but said the EU should try to reward businesses with significant European footprints.
paras.zh: 布鲁姆表示，德国汽车制造商很乐意与中国竞争对手竞争，但他表示，欧盟应该努力奖励在欧洲拥有重要足迹的企业。

paras.en: “Companies that invest and develop in Europe must see a clear benefit,” he said.
paras.zh: “在欧洲投资和发展的公司必须看到明显的利益，”他说。

paras.en: Referring to Chinese companies, he added: “Those who sell here should compete under comparable conditions and create jobs and value here in Europe, too.
paras.zh: 在谈到中国​​公司时，他补充道：“那些在这里销售的公司也应该在类似的条件下竞争，并在欧洲创造就业机会和价值。

paras.en: Blume added: “We believe in open markets, but openness also means standing up for our own interests in Europe. Because a strong industrial base means more than economic success. It protects technological independence.”
paras.zh: 布鲁姆补充道：“我们相信开放市场，但开放也意味着维护我们在欧洲的自身利益。因为强大的工业基础不仅仅意味着经济成功。它可以保护技术独立性。”

paras.en: Volkswagen is exhibiting at the Paris show for the first time in 20 years. Blume emphasised the “close ties between France and Germany”, while hosting the French industry minister, Sébastian Martin.
paras.zh: 这是大众汽车 20 年来首次参加巴黎车展。布鲁姆在接待法国工业部长塞巴斯蒂安·马丁时强调了“法国和德国之间的密切关系”。

paras.en: Arno Antlitz, VW’s chief financial officer, said the job cuts were necessary to “increase our economic power” by increasing profitability and allowing it to defend its “home turf”.
paras.zh: 大众汽车首席财务官阿诺·安特利茨表示，裁员对于通过提高盈利能力并捍卫“主场”来“增强我们的经济实力”是必要的。

paras.en: The company is cutting the number of models it offers worldwide from 150 to 75 across brands including Audi and Škoda. It hopes the move will reduce complexity in its factories and for dealers, cutting the cost of each vehicle it makes.
paras.zh: 该公司正在将其在全球范围内提供的车型数量从 150 款削减至 75 款，旗下品牌包括奥迪和斯柯达。该公司希望此举能够降低其工厂和经销商的复杂性，从而降低其生产的每辆车的成本。

paras.en: On Sunday, it revealed the production version of its ID Tiguan, an electric edition of its bestselling family SUV.
paras.zh: 周日，该公司发布了 ID Tiguan 的量产版，这是其最畅销的家用 SUV 的电动版。

articles.title: Middle East crisis live: Riyadh airport hit again as Houthis claim attacks, including strike that killed 12
articles.author: Marina Dunbar (now) and Frances Mao (earlier)

paras.en: Saudi authorities say latest airport attack 'resulted in injuries'
The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation said in a statement that today’s attack on King Khalid international airport in Riyadh “resulted in injuries” but did not specify how many.
The statement said that an “assessment of the damage and verification of the safety of the facilities is ongoing”.

Earlier on Sunday, an “unidentified projectile” hit Riyadh’s international airport, the same site targeted in Saturday’s strike which injured hundreds of people and killed 12. Minutes earlier, Yemen’s Houthis claimed responsibility for the attack.
Indian national dies from injuries following Riyadh airport attack
An Indian national wounded in yesterday’s Houthi airport attack in Riyadh has died from his injuries, the Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia said in a statement.

“It is learnt that one Indian national injured in the Riyadh attack has unfortunately lost his life today,” the embassy said. “We convey our heartfelt condolences to the family of the deceased. We are in touch with the family and will provide all support for ensuring the early repatriation of mortal remains.”
In an earlier statement, the embassy said that 11 Indians were among those injured in yesterday’s attack.

Yemen’s Houthis are claiming responsibility for both Saturday and Sunday’s attacks on Riyadh Airport. The group said on Sunday they had targeted Riyadh’s airport several times as well as Saudi energy facilities, a day after Saturday’s deadly attack.
Houthi military spokesman Yahya Saree said the Iran-backed group “carried out four qualitative operations in the past 24 hours using ballistic and cruise missiles and drones,” AFP reported.
Saree said the group targeted the Riyadh airport multiple times, as well as the Dammam airport and two facilities belonging to the Saudi state oil company Aramco.
Saudi authorities say latest airport attack 'resulted in injuries'
The Saudi General Authority of Civil Aviation said in a statement that today’s attack on King Khalid international airport in Riyadh “resulted in injuries” but did not specify how many.
The statement said that an “assessment of the damage and verification of the safety of the facilities is ongoing”.

Earlier on Sunday, an “unidentified projectile” hit Riyadh’s international airport, the same site targeted in Saturday’s strike which injured hundreds of people and killed 12. Minutes earlier, Yemen’s Houthis claimed responsibility for the attack.
Israeli prime minister condemns attack on Riyadh airport
Benjamin Netanyahu, the Israeli prime minister, condemned on Sunday the “horrific terrorist attack” on Riyadh airport in Saudi Arabia.

“I condemn in the strongest possible terms the horrific terrorist attack on King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh,” Netanyahu wrote in a social media post, adding that he extended Israel’s “deepest condolences” to the families of the victims.
Yemen’s Houthis claim responsibility for Riyadh airport attack that killed 12 people
Yemen’s Houthis have claimed responsibility for the attack targeting Riyadh airport, according to a statement released by the group.

The Houthis claimed to have launched strikes against Dammam airport and Saudi Aramco facilities located in Saudi Arabia’s Eastern Province. It is not immediately clear whether the group is claiming just yesterday’s attack or the strike from earlier today as well. Saudi authorities have not yet issued a confirmation.

SriLankan Airlines announced that it has suspended all flights to Riyadh, Saudi Arabia until October 18 “in view of the recent security incident affecting Riyadh Airport and ongoing safety and operational assessments.”

“The safety and security of our passengers and crew remain our highest priority and services will resume once the prevailing conditions are assessed to be suitable for commercial flight operations,” the statement said.
Attacks on Riyadh airport and capital come on eve of major oil summit
Saudi Arabia of course is the world’s top oil exporter and its oil refineries and facilities have been repeatedly targeted by the Houthis this past month.
It was forced to temporarly close its key East-West pipeline last month after a drone attack on the 1,200km Saudi Aramco pipeline which spans the Arabian peninsula.

That temporarily halted oil flows; the kingdom had been diverting much of its oil that used to go out through the Strait of Hormuz through the pipeline to be shipped out through the Red Sea, however that trade route has now also been targeted by the Iran-allied Houthis.
That has driven up global oil prices and spooked the market. The kingdom was in fact due to host a major oil summit – the World Petroleum Congress - this week in Riyadh.

The CEOs of major companies Shell, ExxonMobil, BP, TotalEnergies had been due to attend but given the attacks, it’s unclear if exceutives will take the risk. Saudi authorities were saying this morning that the summit would still proceed.
If confirmed as a strike, this marks the fourth attack on the Saudi capital’s airport just this week alone.

The Houthis haven’t claimed responsibility for Saturday’s attack on King Khalid International in Riyadh, but earlier this morning issued a threat warning travellers and airlines and trade operators to stay away from all Saudi airports and airspaces – barring those of Islamic holy cities Mecca and Medina.
The Houthis have declared that all Saudi airspace is a theatre of their military operations.

They’ve escalated their attacks as Saudi Arabia has launched hundreds of airstrikes on Houthi areas in Yemen this week, as part of the Yemeni government force’s counter-offensive this week to repel the Houthis from a critical Red Sea strait.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯本周对也门胡塞武装地区发动了数百次空袭，这是也门政府军本周反攻的一部分，旨在将胡塞武装赶出关键的红海海峡。

paras.en: Riyadh international airport reportedly hit again in second strike
paras.zh: 据报道利雅得国际机场在第二次罢工中再次遭受袭击

paras.en: The Saudi-led coalition in Yemen says an “unidentified projectile” hit Riyadh’s international airport on Sunday – the same site targeted in Saturday’s strike which injured hundreds of people and killed 12.
paras.zh: 沙特领导的也门联军表示，周日，一枚“身份不明的弹丸”袭击了利雅得国际机场——周六的袭击也瞄准了同一地点，导致数百人受伤，12 人死亡。

paras.en: Coalition spokesman Major General Turki al-Malki said the projectile struck Terminal 4 at King Khalid International Airport, causing a fire, AFP reported.
paras.zh: 据法新社报道，联军发言人图尔基·马尔基少将表示，导弹击中了哈立德国王国际机场 4 号航站楼，引发火灾。

paras.en: Al-Malki said air defences also “intercepted and destroyed a cruise missile” in the vicinity of the airport.
paras.zh: 马尔基表示，防空系统还在机场附近“拦截并摧毁了一枚巡航导弹”。

paras.en: The airport has been closed today following yesterday’s deadly attack.
paras.zh: 昨天发生致命袭击后，机场于今天关闭。

paras.en: Houthi airport attack forces swift rethink of Trump’s new 'Blame Ukraine' strategy
paras.zh: 胡塞机场袭击迫使特朗普重新考虑“指责乌克兰”新战略

paras.en: The reckless missile attack on King Khalid international airport in Riyadh on Saturday did not just export the death and misery inside Yemen to Saudi Arabia, it also left Donald Trump forced to reconsider his diplomatic and political strategy designed to take him into the midterm elections next month.
paras.zh: 周六对利雅得哈立德国王国际机场的鲁莽导弹袭击不仅将也门境内的死亡和痛苦输出到沙特阿拉伯，还让唐纳德·特朗普被迫重新考虑他旨在参加下个月中期选举的外交和政治战略。

paras.en: The US president’s plan had only been unveiled on Saturday.
paras.zh: 美国总统的计划于周六才公布。

paras.en: It was to blame what he described as “a world problem” – spiralling diesel prices – on the Ukrainian president, Volodymyr Zelenskyy, saying his attacks on Russian oil refineries were the cause. He was going to keep the political temperature down on his war of choice in Iran and its spillover in Yemen until after the midterms.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基将他所说的“世界问题”——柴油价格飙升——归咎于乌克兰总统弗拉基米尔·泽伦斯基，称其对俄罗斯炼油厂的袭击才是原因。他打算在中期选举结束之前，对他选择的伊朗战争及其对也门的影响保持较低的政治气氛。

paras.en: In pursuit of this strategy, he claimed the Iranian blockade in the strait of Hormuz was in effect broken, producing figures on daily oil barrel exports to assuage the markets. As a further insurance he also claimed it was impossible to negotiate with the Iranians since there was no single leadership in Tehran.
paras.zh: 为了实施这一战略，他声称伊朗对霍尔木兹海峡的封锁实际上已被打破，并提供了每日石油桶出口数据以安抚市场。作为进一步的保险，他还声称不可能与伊朗人谈判，因为德黑兰没有单一的领导层。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia, in conjunction with Turkey, and Pakistan, were largely to be left to sort out the Houthis along the Red Sea. The fate of Yemen, the poorest country in the world according to the International Monetary Fund, was not going to shift votes in Kansas or Alaska.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯、土耳其和巴基斯坦将主要负责解决红海沿岸的胡塞武装。根据国际货币基金组织的数据，也门是世界上最贫穷的国家，它的命运不会改变堪萨斯州或阿拉斯加的选票。

paras.en: Now, after the Riyadh airport attack, it is doubtful, for a basket of reasons, that this anyway threadbare strategy, largely born of desperation, can hold.
paras.zh: 现在，在利雅得机场袭击事件发生后，出于多种原因，人们怀疑这种基本上出于绝望的陈旧策略是否能够维持下去。

paras.en: For all the talk of the Gulf becoming responsible for its own security, it is doubtful that Saudi Arabia can be left to fend for itself after the carnage in Riyadh. One of the the 12 dead is an American and there may be more among the severely injured. Something is clearly wrong with Saudi defences since the Houthis are firing rockets from 500 miles away, and they are reaching their target too often.
paras.zh: 尽管人们都在谈论海湾地区要对自身安全负责，但在利雅得大屠杀之后，沙特阿拉伯能否自力更生还是值得怀疑的。 12名死者中有一名美国人，重伤者中可能还有更多人。沙特的防御显然出了问题，因为胡塞武装从 500 英里外发射火箭，而且他们太频繁地到达目标。

paras.en: The US has had a unilateral ceasefire with the Houthis since 2025, and once the hostilities between Saudi Arabia and the Houthis recommenced in the summer, the pact was quietly renewed.
paras.zh: 自2025年以来，美国与胡塞武装达成单方面停火，而一旦沙特与胡塞武装在夏季重新开始敌对行动，该协议就悄然续签。

paras.en: Trump has twice rejected Saudi appeals for help. Can he spurn them three times? The pressure to act as allies are expected to may prove overwhelming.
paras.zh: 特朗普曾两次拒绝沙特的帮助请求。他能拒绝他们三遍吗？预计充当盟友的压力可能会压倒性的。

paras.en: Egyptian flight attendant and Syrian woman among 12 killed at Saudi airport
paras.zh: 沙特机场12人遇难 包括埃及空姐和叙利亚妇女

paras.en: We have some more detail on the 12 people killed in the Houthi missile strike on Riyadh’s King Khalid International Airporton Saturday.
paras.zh: 我们了解了周六胡塞武装对利雅得哈立德国王国际机场进行导弹袭击造成 12 人死亡的更多细节。

paras.en: The attack on a civilian space – the airport had no military facility- has drew widespread condemnation from Arab and Western leaders and the UN.
paras.zh: 对民用空间（机场没有军事设施）的袭击引起了阿拉伯和西方领导人以及联合国的广泛谴责。

paras.en: Saudi authorities said the dead included four Saudi citizens, two Bangladeshi nationals, a Palestinian, a U.S. citizen, an Egyptian, a Jordanian, a Syrian and a Sudanese.
paras.zh: 沙特当局表示，死者包括四名沙特公民、两名孟加拉国公民、一名巴勒斯坦人、一名美国公民、一名埃及人、一名约旦人、一名叙利亚人和一名苏丹人。

paras.en: The Egyptian woman killed has been identified as Azza Ramzy, 28, a flight attendant who worked for the Saudi airline Flynas, according to the Egyptian state-run TV.
paras.zh: 据埃及国营电视台报道，遇难的埃及妇女被确认为 28 岁的阿扎·拉姆齐 (Azza Ramzy)，她是沙特航空公司 Flynas 的一名空乘人员。

paras.en: The Syrian woman has been identified as Buthaina Ahmad Oweida by the Syrian embassy in Riyadh.
paras.zh: 叙利亚驻利雅得大使馆确认这名叙利亚妇女为布塞娜·艾哈迈德·奥韦达。

paras.en: She was a widowed mother of four who had been living in Saudi Arabia for the past five years after fleeing the Syrian civil war, her niece told AP. She had been visiting her sister in Riyadh and was on her way home to Mecca, where she lived, when she was killed in the attack.
paras.zh: 她的侄女告诉美联社，她是四个孩子的丧偶母亲，逃离叙利亚内战后，过去五年一直住在沙特阿拉伯。她当时正在利雅得探望姐姐，并在返回自己居住的麦加的途中，在袭击中丧生。

paras.en: There is attention too on the still yet to be identified American citizen who was killed at the airport because that will add to Saudi pressure on Donald Trump for the U.S. to join in the fight.
paras.zh: 在机场被杀的尚未确认身份的美国公民也受到关注，因为这将增加沙特对唐纳德·特朗普施加的压力，要求美国加入战斗。

paras.en: As we await more detail on this reported blast in the Saudi capital, it’s worth noting that there’s been a distinct lack of information coming from Saudi authorities on the Houthi attacks and other dangers.
paras.zh: 当我们等待有关沙特首都爆炸事件的更多细节时，值得注意的是，沙特当局明显缺乏有关胡塞武装袭击和其他危险的信息。

paras.en: Officials have announced that schooling will move online until the end of the week, meaning schools and campuses are closed.
paras.zh: 官员们宣布，学校教育将在本周末之前转移到网上，这意味着学校和校园将关闭。

paras.en: But they have otherwise been largely quiet on the major attack on the country’s largest airport yesterday which killed 12 people and injured 300 more.
paras.zh: 但对于昨天该国最大机场发生的重大袭击事件，造成 12 人死亡、300 多人受伤，他们基本上保持沉默。

paras.en: They have not issued a wider emergency alert, nor given a national address or offered any assurance to residents on why and how the kingdom’s air defences failed. We know that Saudi Arabia has been requesting more missile interceptors from the US and other European allies – but the US is also facing its own shortage due to the Iran fighting.
paras.zh: 他们没有发布更广泛的紧急警报，也没有发表全国讲话，也没有就沙特防空系统失败的原因和方式向居民提供任何保证。我们知道，沙特阿拉伯一直要求美国和其他欧洲盟国提供更多的导弹拦截器，但由于伊朗的战斗，美国也面临着自身的短缺。

paras.en: The Houthis have targeted Riyadh’s airport for the past few weeks – including two attacks earlier in the week, which killed four people. But Saudi authorities have not publicly announced a closure of King Khalid International Airport, with the suspension of flights detected through air traffic monitoring sites instead.
paras.zh: 过去几周，胡塞武装一直以利雅得机场为目标，其中包括本周早些时候的两起袭击，造成四人死亡。但沙特当局尚未公开宣布关闭哈立德国王国际机场，而是通过空中交通监控站点检测到暂停航班。

paras.en: This withholding of information the public is in line with a pattern of communication from not just Saudi but other Gulf state authorities these past seven months since they’ve come under attack from Iranian missiles and drones.
paras.zh: 这种向公众隐瞒信息的做法符合沙特和其他海湾国家当局在过去七个月遭受伊朗导弹和无人机攻击后的沟通模式。

paras.en: Gulf authorities have tended to suppress the flow of information – ostensibly for national security purposes and to maintain public confidence in the countr'y’s defences.
paras.zh: 海湾当局往往压制信息流动 — — 表面上是出于国家安全目的，并维持公众对该国国防的信心。

paras.en: However, the lack of information is also leading to confusion and speculation online, particularly as the Houthis continue to threaten new strikes against the kingdom.
paras.zh: 然而，信息的缺乏也导致了网上的混乱和猜测，特别是胡塞武装继续威胁对沙特发动新的袭击。

paras.en: Houthi state media says capital's airport hit by Saudi strike
paras.zh: 胡塞官方媒体称首都机场遭到沙特袭击

paras.en: Houthi-run state TV is reporting that Saudia Arabia has carried out a strike on the main airport in Sana’a, the Yemeni capital currently controlled by the Houthis.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装控制的国家电视台报道称，沙特阿拉伯对目前由胡塞武装控制的也门首都萨那的主要机场进行了袭击。

paras.en: Al Masirah TV said the strike had hit Sana’a International Airport.
paras.zh: Al Masirah TV 称，萨那国际机场发生了罢工。

paras.en: No comment yet from Saudi authorities or the Saudi-backed government forces in Yemen.
paras.zh: 沙特当局或沙特支持的也门政府军尚未发表评论。

paras.en: Earlier however, the coalition had issued a issued a statement saying they would “respond decisively” to the Houthis’ “terrorist attack” on Riyadh’s airport on Saturday which killed 12 people and injured 309.
paras.zh: 然而早些时候，该联盟发表声明称，他们将“果断回应”胡塞武装周六对利雅得机场的“恐怖袭击”，该袭击造成12人死亡、309人受伤。

paras.en: The Saudis have launched hundreds of air strikes on Houthi positions in Yemen since fighting recommenced last month.
paras.zh: 自上个月战斗重新开始以来，沙特已对也门胡塞武装阵地发动了数百次空袭。

paras.en: UK advises against travel to parts of Saudi Arabia
paras.zh: 英国建议不要前往沙特阿拉伯部分地区

paras.en: The UK Foreign Office has updated guidance for British nationals following the deadly Houthi attack on Saturday.
paras.zh: 在周六发生致命的胡塞武装袭击后，英国外交部更新了针对英国国民的指南。

paras.en: All travel to within 10km of the border with Yemen
paras.zh: 所有旅行均在距也门边境 10 公里范围内

paras.en: All but essential travel to Aseer province, Riyadh province, Najran province, Jizan province and Taif city and Taif International Airport
paras.zh: 前往阿西尔省、利雅得省、纳季兰省、吉赞省、塔伊夫市和塔伊夫国际机场的所有必要旅行

paras.en: There are an estimated 20,000- 30,000 British nationals living in Saudi Arabia, although those numbers have presumably fluctuated since the war began and Iran and its allies fought back against US and Israeli strikes by targeting cities like Dubai and Doha, in Gulf states allied with the US.
paras.zh: 据估计，有 20,000 至 30,000 名英国国民居住在沙特阿拉伯，尽管自战争开始以来，这些数字可能有所波动，伊朗及其盟国通过针对与美国结盟的海湾国家的迪拜和多哈等城市来反击美国和以色列的袭击。

paras.en: In the first fortnight of the war earlier this year in March, more than 102,000 Britons across the Middle East registered with the Foreign Office for help.
paras.zh: 在今年 3 月初战争爆发的前两周，中东地区有超过 102,000 名英国人向外交部登记寻求帮助。

articles.title: Trump announces partial ceasefire in Ukraine war as Zelenskyy says deal is ‘news to me’
articles.author: Luke Harding

paras.en: Donald Trump has announced an energy ceasefire between Ukraine and Russia, apparently without consulting Volodymyr Zelenskyy, who said the deal to stop long-range attacks was “news to me”.
paras.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）宣布乌克兰和俄罗斯之间的能源停火，显然没有咨询Volodymyr Zelenskyy ，他表示停止远程攻击的协议是“对我来说的新闻”。

paras.en: In a social media post, the US president claimed the two sides had reached an agreement. “Effective immediately, there is an ENERGY CEASEFIRE in the War between Russia and Ukraine. Both parties have agreed. Do not break it!” he wrote on Truth Social.
paras.zh: 在社交媒体帖子中，美国总统声称双方已达成协议。“俄罗斯和乌克兰之间的战争立即生效，能源停火。双方都同意了。不要破坏它！”他在Truth Social上写道。

paras.en: He offered no further details. Zelenskyy said he was surprised by the announcement but would agree to it if Vladimir Putin did the same. “If President Trump negotiated it with Putin – please tell us when the ceasefire begins. We are ready and we will accept it,” the Ukrainian president told the Axios website.
paras.zh: 他没有提供进一步的细节。泽伦斯基说，他对这一宣布感到惊讶，但如果弗拉基米尔·普京也这样做，他会同意的。“如果特朗普总统与普京谈判，请告诉我们停火何时开始。我们已经做好准备，我们将接受它，”乌克兰总统告诉Axios网站。

paras.en: Earlier, Zelenskyy rebuffed Trump’s demand made on Saturday that Kyiv stop bombing Russian oil refineries. Zelenskyy said Moscow had to first halt its own “brutal” attacks on his country’s energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 早些时候，泽伦斯基拒绝了特朗普周六提出的要求，即基辅停止轰炸俄罗斯炼油厂。泽伦斯基说，莫斯科必须首先停止对本国能源基础设施的“野蛮”攻击。

paras.en: Any deal to end long-range drone strikes by Ukraine on targets inside Russia would have to be “reciprocal”, he said. It should be backed by “real guarantees” – meaning punitive measures against Moscow from Ukraine’s allies, including the US.
paras.zh: 他说，任何结束乌克兰对俄罗斯境内目标的远程无人机袭击的协议都必须是“互惠的”。它应该得到“真正的保证”的支持，这意味着包括美国在内的乌克兰盟友对莫斯科采取惩罚性措施。

paras.en: There was no sign that the Kremlin was observing Trump’s ceasefire. According to Zelenskyy, Russian drones took to the sky “throughout the day” on Sunday. There were also “unfortunately” several airstrikes, he said, including “on our energy infrastructure”.
paras.zh: 没有迹象表明克里姆林宫正在遵守特朗普的停火。根据Zelenskyy的说法，俄罗斯无人机在周日“全天”飞向天空。他说， “不幸的是”还有几次空袭，包括“对我们的能源基础设施”的空袭。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president said the Russians hit thermal power station No 5 in the eastern city of Kharkiv – the latest of more than 200 strikes this week against electricity generation and transmission facilities in Ukraine. There were another 17 hits on gas and oil facilities, he added.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统表示，俄罗斯人袭击了东部城市哈尔科夫的5号热电站–这是本周针对乌克兰发电和输电设施的200多次罢工中的最新一次。他补充说，天然气和石油设施还有17次被击中。

paras.en: The fast-moving row between Washington and Kyiv began on Friday when Trump announced he was lifting sanctions on Russian diesel exports. He said the move would reduce global and domestic fuel prices before next month’s US midterm elections.
paras.zh: 华盛顿和基辅之间的快速争吵始于周五，当时特朗普宣布取消对俄罗斯柴油出口的制裁。他说，此举将在下个月的美国中期选举之前降低全球和国内燃料价格。

paras.en: A furious Zelenskyy called the decision “weak” and said it would generate “billions” in extra revenue for Putin, enabling him to wage war “even more intensely”. An equally irate Trump said Zelenskyy should “damn well stop” hitting Russian refineries. Ukraine needed a “new leader”, he said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 一位愤怒的泽伦斯基称该决定“软弱” ，并表示这将为普京带来“数十亿美元”的额外收入，使他能够“更加激烈地”发动战争。同样愤怒的特朗普表示，泽伦斯基应该“该死的停止”打击俄罗斯炼油厂。他周六表示，乌克兰需要一位“新领导人”。

paras.en: Responding to Trump, Zelenskyy said it was up to Ukrainians to choose “one or another leader”. He told ABC News he was willing to accept Trump’s demands and to organise elections, but only if Putin agreed to a “total” 60-day ceasefire.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基在回应特朗普时表示，乌克兰人应该选择“一个或另一个领导人”。他告诉美国广播公司新闻，他愿意接受特朗普的要求并组织选举，但前提是普京同意“全面”停火60天。

paras.en: The bitter public feud is the most serious between the US and Ukraine since last year, when Trump berated Zelenskyy in the Oval Office.
paras.zh: 自去年特朗普在椭圆形办公室斥责泽伦斯基以来，美国和乌克兰之间的仇恨最为严重。

paras.en: The New York Times has reported that US officials have offered the Kremlin lucrative economic incentives in exchange for a ceasefire. They reportedly include releasing billions in Russian sovereign assets that are frozen. The Trump administration also revisited a plan to sell parts of Russia’s energy company, Lukoil. The multibillion deal would benefit Middle Eastern investors, the paper reported, some with “business ties” to US negotiators.
paras.zh: 《纽约时报》报道称，美国官员向克里姆林宫提供了利润丰厚的经济激励措施，以换取停火。据报道，这些措施包括释放被冻结的数十亿美元俄罗斯主权资产。特朗普政府还重新审视了一项出售俄罗斯能源公司卢克石油(Lukoil)部分股份的计划。据该报报道，这笔数十亿美元的交易将使中东投资者受益，其中一些投资者与美国谈判代表有“商业关系”。

paras.en: On Saturday, Trump criticised Zelenskyy and said he had refused to make a deal to end the fighting. In response, Ukraine’s president laid the blame for Europe’s biggest war since 1945 on “Russia and Russia alone”. “It is possible to stop strikes on energy infrastructure as early as today, but Putin does not want to do so,” he said.
paras.zh: 周六，特朗普批评泽伦斯基，并表示他拒绝就结束战斗达成协议。作为回应，乌克兰总统将1945年以来欧洲最大规模的战争归咎于“仅俄罗斯和俄罗斯”。“早在今天就有可能停止对能源基础设施的罢工，但普京不想这样做，”他说。

paras.en: Ukrainian officials point out that the White House is demanding Kyiv give up its most effective weapon, without demanding any corresponding concessions from Russia. In recent weeks, Kyiv has dealt a major blow to Russia’s economy, striking oil complexes, warehouses and datacentres.
paras.zh: 乌克兰官员指出，白宫要求基辅放弃其最有效的武器，而不要求俄罗斯做出任何相应的让步。最近几周，基辅对俄罗斯经济造成了重大打击，袭击了石油综合体、仓库和数据中心。

paras.en: Russia’s own bombing campaign has been relentless. On Saturday it killed 23 people in the city of Zaporizhzhia, including four children, and hit a five-storey apartment block in the frontline town of Sloviansk. Zelenskyy said Moscow’s aerial campaign involved thousands of aerial bombs and jet-powered drones. It continued “unabated”, he said.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯自己的轰炸行动一直是无情的。星期六，它在Zaporizhzhia市造成23人死亡，其中包括四名儿童，并袭击了前线城镇Sloviansk的一个五层公寓楼。泽伦斯基说，莫斯科的空袭涉及数千枚空中炸弹和喷气式无人机。他说，这种情况“有增无减”。

paras.en: The head of Ukraine’s foreign affairs committee, Oleksandr Merezhko, said Trump’s “bullying” demand for Zelenskyy to quit had strengthened him at home “paradoxically”, after recent damaging corruption scandals. “Putin’s plan is to decapitate Zelenskyy and remove him as a wartime leader. Trump is siding with Putin,” Merezhko said.
paras.zh: 乌克兰外交事务委员会主席亚历山大·梅列日科（ Oleksandr Merezhko ）表示，在最近的破坏性腐败丑闻之后，特朗普对泽伦斯基辞职的“欺凌”要求使他在国内“自相矛盾”。“普京的计划是斩首泽连斯基，罢免他作为战时领导人的职务。特朗普支持普京，”梅列日科说。

paras.en: He added: “I’m afraid that behind this situation is Trump’s worldview. He wants to do business with Putin. For him, Ukraine seems like an obstacle to be removed. Both Trump and Putin wish to pressure us into capitulation.”
paras.zh: 他补充说： “我担心这种情况背后是特朗普的世界观。他想和普京做生意。对他来说，乌克兰似乎是一个需要消除的障碍。特朗普和普京都希望迫使我们投降。”

paras.en: Referring to the notorious 1939 agreement between Nazi Germany and the USSR, Merezhko said: “We are moving to a new Molotov-Ribbentrop pact and to a world of strongmen and spheres of influence.”
paras.zh: 在谈到1939年纳粹德国与苏联之间臭名昭著的协议时，梅雷日科说： “我们正在走向新的莫洛托夫-里宾特洛甫条约，走向一个强人和势力范围的世界。”

paras.en: Merezhko said Ukraine would continue to destroy enemy oil refineries, against US wishes, because they funded Russia’s war machine and acknowledged that a cutoff of US intelligence sharing with Kyiv – threatened by the Trump administration – would “blind” Ukraine’s air defence systems. “This would be an act of complicity with Putin’s genocide. It would mean more dead civilians and dead children,” he said.
paras.zh: 梅雷日科表示，乌克兰将继续违背美国的意愿摧毁敌方炼油厂，因为他们资助了俄罗斯的战争机器，并承认切断美国与基辅的情报共享–受到特朗普政府的威胁–将使乌克兰的防空系统“失明”。“这将是普京种族灭绝的同谋行为。这意味着更多的平民和儿童死亡，”他说。

paras.en: Ukrainian negotiators had been meeting in Florida with their American counterparts, Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner, when Trump announced the US was lifting sanctions on Russian diesel. Blindsided, the Ukrainians went home early. “It felt like a trap,” one stunned Ukrainian official told the Kyiv Independent newspaper.

On Sunday, Zelenskyy shored up support in a series of conversations with key allies including Canada’s prime minister, Mark Carney, the Polish leader, Donald Tusk, and the European Commission president, Ursula von der Leyen.

Earlier Zelenskyy spoke with the UK prime minister, Andy Burnham, France’s president, Emmanuel Macron, and the Finnish president, Alexander Stubb. Downing Street said Burnham recognised the last 24 hours had been “difficult” for Ukraine and “reiterated his complete solidarity”.

Downing Street said the two leaders agreed “to maintain pressure on Russia” and to strengthen the sanctions regime, despite Trump’s efforts to the contrary. “Russia should agree to an immediate energy ceasefire, ending its brutal strikes on Ukrainian infrastructure and its attacks on shipping in the Black Sea,” a statement added.

Speaking over the weekend, Zelenskyy said Trump’s decision empowered Putin and gave him “extra money for the war”, running into millions and “perhaps billions”. “It is certainly not fair. It is certainly not how partners should act. And, in my view, it is a weak decision,” he said.
- Luke Harding’s Betrayal: Trump, Putin and the New Age of Conquest is published by Guardian Faber

articles.title: Riyadh airport attacks another dangerous moment in already tense conflict

paras.en: The attacks on King Khalid Airport in Riyadh mark another dangerous moment in a region that is already fraught with tension and conflict.
paras.zh: 对利雅得哈立德国王机场的袭击标志着这个已经充满紧张和冲突的地区的另一个危险时刻。

paras.en: In recent weeks the Houthis have stepped up their attacks on Saudi Arabian soil, but their attacks over the past few days have hit the country's critical infrastructure in the form of the capital's main airport, apparently penetrating Saudi air defences with ease.
paras.zh: 最近几周，胡塞武装加大了对沙特阿拉伯领土的袭击力度，但他们过去几天的袭击以首都主要机场的形式袭击了该国的关键基础设施，显然轻松穿透了沙特的防空系统。

paras.en: Saturday's attack killed 12 people and hurt more than 300. On Sunday the Saudi-led coalition fighting the Houthis said an "unknown projectile" had hit a passenger hall and a cruise missile had been intercepted nearby.
paras.zh: 星期六的袭击造成12人死亡， 300多人受伤。周日，沙特领导的与胡塞武装作战的联军表示，一枚“不明弹丸”击中了一个乘客大厅，一枚巡航导弹在附近被拦截。

paras.en: The physical damage can be quickly repaired, but the country's reputation as a safe haven of stability is taking a battering.
paras.zh: 物理损坏可以很快修复，但该国作为稳定避风港的声誉正在遭受重创。

paras.en: As well as all the airport attacks, the Houthis have sought to take control of strategically significant positions along the Red Sea coast and around the Bab al-Mandeb Strait. This further increases the risk to safe navigation along the vital maritime corridor - although the Yemeni government says it has "secured" the strait.
paras.zh: 除了所有机场袭击事件外，胡塞武装还试图控制红海沿岸和曼德海峡周围的战略要地。这进一步增加了沿重要海上走廊安全航行的风险-尽管也门政府表示已“保护”该海峡。

paras.en: The civil war in Yemen between the country's government - which is internationally recognised and supported by Saudi Arabia - and the Houthis, who are backed by Iran, has been going on for more than a decade. It has left many thousands of people dead and plunged Yemen into one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.
paras.zh: 也门政府（得到沙特阿拉伯的国际认可和支持）与伊朗支持的胡塞武装之间的内战已经持续了十多年。它已造成数千人死亡，并使也门陷入世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一。

paras.en: It is a complex and often confusing geopolitical conflict, and this latest escalation needs to be seen in the broader context of the tension between Iran, the United States and Israel.
paras.zh: 这是一场复杂且经常令人困惑的地缘政治冲突，需要在伊朗、美国和以色列之间紧张局势的更广泛背景下看待这一最新升级。

paras.en: Not since the al-Qaeda insurgency of the mid-2000s has the Kingdom faced such a serious threat.
paras.zh: 自2000年代中期的基地组织叛乱以来，沙特王国从未面临过如此严重的威胁。

paras.en: The Saudi government overcame that challenge through an effective hearts and minds campaign. Then it weathered the Arab Spring uprisings around the region which saw off leaders in Tunisia, Libya, Egypt and Yemen.
paras.zh: 沙特政府通过有效的心灵运动克服了这一挑战。然后，它经历了该地区的阿拉伯之春起义，这些起义击败了突尼斯、利比亚、埃及和也门的领导人。

paras.en: It even shrugged off â with some annoyance â an Iranian ballistic missile attack on Riyadh in March.
paras.zh: 它甚至在3月份伊朗对利雅得的弹道导弹袭击中（有些烦恼）摆脱了。

paras.en: But this is different. Saudi Arabia may have one of the most powerful air forces in the Middle East, and it has been carrying out devastating air strikes on Houthi positions. Despite this, the opposing forces have managed to seize large portions of the country, particularly in the north and west.
paras.zh: 但这是不同的。沙特阿拉伯可能拥有中东最强大的空军之一，它一直在对胡塞阵地进行毁灭性的空袭。尽管如此，敌对部队仍设法占领了该国的大部分地区，特别是在北部和西部。

paras.en: But the Houthis know exactly where to hit back: at the soft underbelly of the Saudi economy.
paras.zh: 但胡塞武装确切知道在哪里反击：在沙特经济疲软的腹部。

paras.en: As part of the "axis of resistance", the Houthis are a vital strategic partner for Iran. From Jizan on the Red Sea to the petrochemical complex at Khurais, the Houthis are delivering explosive drones and missiles with deadly accuracy.
paras.zh: 作为“抵抗轴心”的一部分，胡塞武装是伊朗的重要战略伙伴。从红海的吉赞到Khurais的石化综合体，胡塞武装正在以致命的精确度运送爆炸性无人机和导弹。

paras.en: The Red Sea shipping route has become increasingly important, because the Strait of Hormuz, on the other side of the Gulf, has still not fully reopened since the US and Iran have failed to reach a deal to end their war.
paras.zh: 红海航线变得越来越重要，因为海湾另一边的霍尔木兹海峡仍未完全重新开放，因为美国和伊朗未能达成结束战争的协议。

paras.en: Targeting ships in the Red Sea is another way that the Houthis are trying to exert leverage - the attacks cause global economic damage, which is a key bargaining chip for Tehran.
paras.zh: 瞄准红海的船只是胡塞武装试图发挥杠杆作用的另一种方式-袭击造成全球经济损失，这是德黑兰的一个关键讨价还价筹码。

paras.en: In early September, the White House stated it would not directly intervene in the Yemen conflict, but could provide intelligence support to the Saudis. It later confirmed that it was supplying intelligence and had deployed military experts to Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 9月初，白宫表示不会直接干预也门冲突，但可以向沙特提供情报支持。它后来证实，它正在提供情报，并向沙特阿拉伯部署了军事专家。

paras.en: However the situation may have taken a new turn following the latest attack on Riyadh, which killed a US citizen.
paras.zh: 然而，在最近对利雅得的袭击造成一名美国公民死亡后，局势可能出现了新的转折。

paras.en: Speaking to reporters, US President Donald Trump called Saturday's attack "terrible" and indicated he may intervene militarily with the Saudis.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普在接受记者采访时称，周六的袭击“可怕” ，并表示他可能会对沙特进行军事干预。

paras.en: "We just found out about the recent attack, so we'll make a decision. We move very quickly," Trump said.
paras.zh: “我们刚刚发现了最近的袭击事件，所以我们会做出决定。我们行动非常迅速，”特朗普说。

paras.en: But that now seems unlikely, at least before crucial US midterm elections next month.
paras.zh: 但现在似乎不太可能，至少在下个月关键的美国中期选举之前是这样。

paras.en: When he was re-elected in 2024, Trump promised to end America's role in wars around the world. Despite this, the US is currently involved in three unresolved conflicts in the Middle East - in Gaza, Lebanon and Iran.
paras.zh: 当他于2024年再次当选时，特朗普承诺结束美国在世界各地战争中的作用。尽管如此，美国目前仍卷入了中东的三场悬而未决的冲突--加沙、黎巴嫩和伊朗。

paras.en: Should Trump get embroiled in another one, this time in Yemen, it is unlikely to go down well with voters.
paras.zh: 如果特朗普卷入另一场选举，这次在也门，它不太可能在选民中流行。

paras.en: This war now looks like it will intensify before it ends in another shaky truce - with or without US involvement.
paras.zh: 这场战争现在看起来在它以另一个不稳定的休战结束之前会加剧-无论有没有美国的参与。

paras.en: Additional analysis from Abdelbassir Hassan, BBC Arabic
paras.zh: 来自英国广播公司阿拉伯语频道Abdelbassir Hassan的补充分析

articles.title: Saudi Arabia's Riyadh airport hit by second Houthi strike in two days

paras.en: An international airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh has been hit by a second strike in as many days, officials have said.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，沙特首都利雅得的一个国际机场在多天内遭到第二次袭击。

paras.en: A Saudi military spokesman said a projectile had hit King Khalid International Airport on Sunday, causing a fire in one of its passenger halls. Saudi Arabia's civil aviation authority said there had been injuries.
paras.zh: 沙特军方发言人表示，周日，一枚射弹击中哈立德国王国际机场，导致其中一个乘客大厅起火。沙特阿拉伯民航局表示，有人受伤。

paras.en: It comes a day after a strike on the same airport killed 13 people and injured 308 others, following similar strikes earlier this week.
paras.zh: 在本周早些时候发生类似罢工后，同一机场发生的罢工造成13人死亡， 308人受伤。

paras.en: The Houthis in Yemen said they were behind the attacks and warned airlines and passengers against using Saudi Arabian airports and airspace.
paras.zh: 也门的胡塞武装表示，他们是袭击的幕后黑手，并警告航空公司和乘客不要使用沙特阿拉伯的机场和领空。

paras.en: The group said they had targeted the airport with a mix of ballistic and cruise missiles, as well as drones in the past 24 hours.
paras.zh: 该组织表示，他们在过去24小时内用弹道导弹和巡航导弹以及无人机瞄准了机场。

paras.en: They also attacked oil facilities and Dammam airport in eastern Saudi Arabia, their military spokesman Brig Gen Yahya Saree said.
paras.zh: 他们的军事发言人叶海亚·萨里准将说，他们还袭击了沙特阿拉伯东部的石油设施和达曼机场。

paras.en: He vowed to continue the "escalating operations deep inside Saudi Arabia", warning that all Saudi airports were potential targets apart from those in the holy cities of Mecca and Medina.
paras.zh: 他发誓要继续“在沙特阿拉伯深处不断升级的行动” ，并警告说，除了圣城麦加和麦地那之外，所有沙特机场都是潜在的目标。

paras.en: The Houthis have said they are targeting Saudi Arabia over its support for government forces in Yemen's civil war, as well as an air strike on the airport in Sanaa.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们的目标是沙特阿拉伯在也门内战中对政府军的支持，以及对萨那机场的空袭。

paras.en: On Sunday Maj Gen Turki al-Maliki, spokesman for the Saudi-led military coalition, said air defences had intercepted a missile near the airport in Riyadh, while authorities were dealing with the fire caused by an "unknown projectile" that hit Passenger Hall No 4.
paras.zh: 周日，沙特领导的军事联盟发言人Turki al-Maliki少将表示，防空部队在利雅得机场附近拦截了一枚导弹，而当局正在处理一枚撞击4号乘客厅的“不明弹丸”引起的火灾。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump has said the US would "make a decision" and "move very quickly" on whether to strike the Houthis, while UK Defence Secretary Wes Streeting suggested the UK could "potentially" provide more support for Saudi Arabia.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普（ Donald Trump ）表示，美国将“做出决定” ，并“非常迅速地”决定是否打击胡塞武装，而英国国防大臣韦斯·斯特林（ Wes Streeting ）则表示，英国“可能”为沙特阿拉伯提供更多支持。

paras.en: Saturday's strike was the deadliest single attack on a Gulf Arab country since the war between Israel, the US and Iran began in February. The Saudi-led coalition vowed to respond, calling it a "war crime".
paras.zh: 星期六的袭击是自2月份以色列、美国和伊朗之间的战争开始以来对海湾阿拉伯国家最致命的一次袭击。沙特领导的联盟发誓要作出回应，称其为“战争罪”。

paras.en: Four Saudi nationals, two people from Bangladesh and one person each from the US, Jordan, Palestine, Syria, Sudan and Egypt were among the dead, the Saudi civil aviation authority said.
paras.zh: 沙特民航局表示，死者中有四名沙特国民，两名来自孟加拉国，一人来自美国、约旦、巴勒斯坦、叙利亚、苏丹和埃及。

paras.en: The Indian embassy in Saudi Arabia said on Sunday that an Indian man had succumbed to the injuries he sustained in the attack.
paras.zh: 印度驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆周日表示，一名印度男子在袭击中受伤身亡。

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio condemned the attacks and confirmed that a US citizen was killed in the strikes. Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband said he was "appalled".
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥（ Marco Rubio ）谴责了这些袭击，并确认一名美国公民在罢工中丧生。外交大臣埃德·米利班德（ Ed Miliband ）表示，他“感到震惊”。

paras.en: The UK Foreign Office is advising against all travel to parts of Saudi Arabia, including areas within 10km (6.2 miles) of the border with Yemen, while other western embassies have warned their nationals about travel in the region.
paras.zh: 英国外交部建议不要前往沙特阿拉伯部分地区，包括与也门边境10公里（ 6.2英里）以内的地区，而其他西方大使馆则警告其国民不要在该地区旅行。

paras.en: Houthi-run Al Masirah TV said "the Saudi enemy" had launched an air strike on Sanaa International Airport in Yemen's capital. Saudi Arabia has not confirmed the attack and the BBC has been unable to verify this claim.
paras.zh: 胡塞运营的Al Masirah电视台说， “沙特敌人”对也门首都萨那国际机场发动了空袭。沙特阿拉伯尚未确认此次袭击，英国广播公司也无法核实这一说法。

paras.en: Abdullah Al-Alimi Bawazir, vice-president of Yemen's internationally recognised government, called for "decisive actions" from regional and international partners.
paras.zh: 也门国际公认的政府副总统阿卜杜拉·阿利米·巴瓦齐尔（ Abdullah Al-Alimi Bawazir ）呼吁区域和国际合作伙伴采取“果断行动”。

paras.en: Riyadh's airport was struck on Thursday, an attack that killed three Saudi nationals. The Houthis claimed responsibility and said they had used cruise missiles to target the airport.
paras.zh: 利雅得机场周四遭到袭击，造成三名沙特国民死亡。胡塞武装声称对此负责，并表示他们曾使用巡航导弹瞄准机场。

paras.en: There were two other deadly attacks on Saudi airports in Abha and Riyadh in the two days prior to that.
paras.zh: 在此之前的两天内，沙特阿卜哈和利雅得的机场发生了另外两起致命袭击事件。

paras.en: The latest uptick in violence comes after a temporary ceasefire between the Houthis and Saudi-led forces, brokered in 2022, collapsed in July.
paras.zh: 暴力事件的最新升级发生在胡塞武装和沙特领导的部队之间的临时停火之后，该停火于2022年斡旋，于7月崩溃。

paras.en: The conflict worsened after the Houthis seized strategically important stretches of the Red Sea coast in a rapid offensive, prompting Saudi strikes. Yemeni pro-government forces later said they had secured the regions.
paras.zh: 在胡塞武装迅速发动进攻，夺取红海沿岸具有战略意义的重要地区后，冲突恶化，促使沙特发动罢工。也门亲政府部队后来表示，他们已经确保了这些地区的安全。

paras.en: The Houthis currently control around a quarter of Yemeni territory and as much as 80% of the country's population. The Iran-backed armed group hopes to eventually seize complete control.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装目前控制着也门约四分之一的领土和高达80 ％的人口。伊朗支持的武装组织希望最终夺取完全的控制权。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia fears this would lead to the establishment of an Iranian satellite state on its southern border.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯担心这将导致在其南部边境建立一个伊朗卫星国。

articles.title: Poland detains man suspected of planning assassination of PM Tusk

paras.en: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk said a man accused of plotting an assassination attack against him and his defence minister has been detained.
paras.zh: 波兰总理唐纳德·图斯克（ Donald Tusk ）表示，一名被指控策划对他及其国防部长进行暗杀袭击的男子已被拘留。

paras.en: The interior ministry earlier reported that police had received credible information about possible attacks against Tusk and Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz.
paras.zh: 内政部早些时候报告说，警方已收到有关可能袭击Tusk和Wladyslaw Kosiniak-Kamysz的可靠信息。

paras.en: Security services convened a special meeting on Sunday after receiving information about the planned attacks, with a spokesman saying officials were treating the threat as "deadly serious".
paras.zh: 安全部门在收到有关计划袭击的信息后于周日召开了一次特别会议，一名发言人表示，官员们正在将这一威胁视为“致命的严重”。

paras.en: Tusk thanked the police for "swift and decisive action" in arresting the suspect.
paras.zh: 图斯克感谢警方在逮捕嫌疑人时采取了“迅速而果断的行动”。

paras.en: The suspect was arrested in the Lower Silesia region and is a Polish national, Jacek Dobrzynski, a spokesman for the Special Services Coordinator told local media.
paras.zh: 特别服务协调员发言人Jacek Dobrzynski告诉当地媒体，嫌疑人在下西里西亚地区被捕，是波兰国民。

paras.en: "In this case we are talking about a strong likelihood that these threats could actually be carried out," he said.
paras.zh: “在这种情况下，我们谈论的是这些威胁实际上很可能被实施，”他说。

paras.en: The plan was uncovered when an email with information about the potential attack was forwarded to police by the State Protection Service, which is responsible for ministers' security, Interior Ministry spokeswoman Karolina Galecka said.
paras.zh: 内政部发言人卡罗琳娜·加莱卡（ Karolina Galecka ）表示，负责部长安全的国家保护局（ State Protection Service ）向警方转发了一封包含有关潜在攻击信息的电子邮件，从而发现了该计划。

paras.en: Tusk has been Polish prime minister since 2023 after previously holding the office from 2007 to 2014.
paras.zh: 图斯克自2023年以来一直担任波兰总理，此前曾于2007年至2014年担任总理。

paras.en: He served as president of the European Council from 2014 to 2019.
paras.zh: 他于2014年至2019年担任欧洲理事会主席。

articles.title: 'It looks like a chimera' — 168 million years ago, a strange platypus-like mammal relative lived in China alongside dinosaurs
articles.author: Chris Simms

paras.en: A newly discovered platypus-like creature is the largest-known mammal relative from the entire Jurassic period, a new study finds — although it still only weighed as much as a Chihuahua.
paras.zh: 一项新的研究发现，一种新发现的类似鸭嘴兽的生物是整个侏罗纪时期已知的最大的哺乳动物亲戚，尽管它的重量仍然只有吉娃娃犬那么重。

paras.en: The critter, which hunted salamanders in the freshwater lakes and rivers of what is now Inner Mongolia, China, lived during the mid-Jurassic between 168 million and 163 million years ago. It seems to be the earliest known mammal-type animal that lived a semiaquatic life.
paras.zh: 这种生物生活在 1.68 亿至 1.63 亿年前的侏罗纪中期，在现在的中国内蒙古的淡水湖泊和河流中捕食蝾螈。它似乎是已知最早的半水生哺乳动物。

paras.en: Researchers unearthed the delicate and detailed fossil in 2016, which revealed that the animal likely weighed about 2.2 to 4.4 pounds (1 to 2 kilograms). It was large for a mammal relative during the Jurassic, but its name, Megacauda sungei, was inspired by its tail: Megacauda means "big tail." The discovery was detailed in a study published on Wednesday (Oct. 7) in the journal Nature.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 2016 年出土了这块精致而细致的化石，结果显示该动物的重量可能约为 2.2 至 4.4 磅（1 至 2 公斤）。对于侏罗纪时期的哺乳动物亲戚来说，它的体型很大，但它的名字 Megacauda sungei 的灵感来自于它的尾巴：Megacauda 的意思是“大尾巴”。周三（10 月 7 日）《自然》杂志上发表的一项研究详细介绍了这一发现。

paras.en: The furry predator had a mix of features seen in modern-day animals, with a broad, flattened tail that marks it as a powerful swimmer, and short hind legs with relatively long feet.
paras.zh: 这种毛茸茸的捕食者具有现代动物的特征，宽而扁平的尾巴标志着它是一个强大的游泳者，后腿较短，脚相对较长。

paras.en: "It's like a chimera," study co-author Zhe-Xi Luo, a paleontologist at the University of Chicago, told Live Science. "The back half of this animal is very much like a platypus. As are the limbs, which would be capable of swimming or digging tunnels in river banks."
paras.zh: “它就像一个嵌合体，”研究合著者、芝加哥大学古生物学家罗哲熙告诉《生活科学》。 “这种动物的后半部分非常像鸭嘴兽。四肢也很像，能够在河岸游泳或挖掘隧道。”

paras.en: But the teeth "are definitely not like a platypus," Luo said. It possessed robust canines and shearing cheek-teeth that would cut and chew meat in a different way from modern carnivorous mammals. "It's a predator with gigantic and very specialized canines," Luo said. "So, it's partly otter-like and partly platypus-like."
paras.zh: 但这些牙齿“绝对不像鸭嘴兽，”罗说。它拥有强壮的犬齿和剪切颊齿，能够以与现代肉食哺乳动物不同的方式切割和咀嚼肉。 “它是一种掠食者，拥有巨大且非常专业的犬齿，”罗说。 “所以，它部分像水獭，部分像鸭嘴兽。”

paras.en: Tiny bits of vertebrate bones found in what would have been the animal's stomach and the surrounding fossil beds hint that M. sungei dined on salamanders, Luo said.
paras.zh: 罗说，在该动物的胃和周围的化石床中发现的微小脊椎动物骨头表明，双溪大蜥蜴以蝾螈为食。

paras.en: He added that M. sungei may have sheltered in burrows on land in the temperate plant-filled climate, and hunted in lakes and rivers for fish and invertebrates.
paras.zh: 他补充说，在温带植物丛生的气候下，双溪巨蜥可能在陆地上的洞穴中躲避，并在湖泊和河流中捕猎鱼类和无脊椎动物。

paras.en: Another notable aspect of the fossil is its throat. Modern mammals, including humans, have hyoid bones in the throat arranged in a "U"-shaped saddle. These help us use throat muscles to swallow chewed food one chunk at a time, instead of gulping down huge bites or whole prey. The structures also enable babies to suckle their mother's milk.
paras.zh: 该化石的另一个值得注意的方面是它的喉咙。现代哺乳动物，包括人类，喉咙里的舌骨呈“U”形鞍状排列。这些帮助我们利用喉咙肌肉一次吞下一大块咀嚼过的食物，而不是吞下一大口或整个猎物。这些结构还使婴儿能够吮吸母乳。

paras.en: M. sungei seems to have had the apparatus needed to do this, study co-author Thomas Martin, a paleontologist at the University of Bonn in Germany, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、德国波恩大学古生物学家托马斯·马丁 (Thomas Martin) 告诉《生活科学》杂志，M.sungei 似乎拥有做到这一点所需的设备。

paras.en: "This is an incredibly important evolutionary innovation," Luo said, adding that this capability is one of the things that helped early mammals diversify into carnivores, insectivores, herbivores or omnivores to take advantage of all sorts of foods.
paras.zh: 罗说：“这是一项极其重要的进化创新。”他补充说，这种能力是帮助早期哺乳动物多样化为食肉动物、食虫动物、食草动物或杂食动物以利用各种食物的能力之一。

paras.en: Finding this in M. sungei suggests that the apparatus needed for suckling milk and swallowing had already evolved by the Middle Jurassic (around 174 million to 164 million years ago), Martin said.
paras.zh: 马丁说，在 M.sungei 中发现这一点表明，哺乳和吞咽所需的器官在中侏罗世（大约 1.74 亿至 1.64 亿年前）就已经进化出来。

paras.en: This is before marsupials like kangaroos and placental mammals like primates and bears are thought to have diverged from each other 160 million years ago, after descending from an egg-laying common ancestor that lived approximately 180 million years ago.
paras.zh: 据认为，袋鼠等有袋动物和灵长类动物和熊等胎盘哺乳动物在 1.6 亿年前彼此分化，它们是生活在大约 1.8 亿年前的产卵共同祖先的后代。

paras.en: "Now we push the history of it back to before the split of modern marsupials and modern eutherian [placental] mammals," Luo said.
paras.zh: “现在我们把它的历史推回到现代有袋动物和现代真兽（胎盘）哺乳动物分裂之前，”罗说。

paras.en: "Neonatal suckling behaviour was previously thought of as being a hallmark of advanced mammals, but it now appears to have evolved well before then, in the common ancestor of docodontans and mammals at least 165 million years ago," said Sue Hand, a vertebrate paleontologist at the University of New South Wales in Australia who wasn’t involved in the study.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的澳大利亚新南威尔士大学脊椎动物古生物学家苏·汉德（Sue Hand）表示：“新生儿吮吸行为以前被认为是高级哺乳动物的标志，但现在看来，这种行为似乎早在1.65亿年前就已经在齿齿兽类和哺乳动物的共同祖先中进化出来了。”

paras.en: M. sungei is from an extinct lineage of docodonts, which are relatives of mammals from the dinosaur-dominated Jurassic and Cretaceous periods, living between about 200 million and 120 million years ago.
paras.zh: M.sungei 属于已灭绝的Docodonts 谱系，它们是恐龙主导的侏罗纪和白垩纪时期哺乳动物的近亲，生活在大约2 亿至1.2 亿年前。

paras.en: Docodonts adapted to a wide variety of habitats. For example, there was the Jurassic tree-dwelling shrew-like docodont called Microdocodon gracilis, and Docofossor brachydactylus, a tunnel-digger with shovel-like paws. Luo was also part of the team that described a semiaquatic "Jurassic beaver", Castorocauda lutrasimilis, which lived 164 million years ago.
paras.zh: Docodonts适应了各种各样的栖息地。例如，侏罗纪树栖的鼩鼱科动物，称为 Microdocodon gracilis，还有 Docofossor brachydactylus，一种爪子像铲子的隧道挖掘者。罗也是描述半水生“侏罗纪海狸”Castorocauda lutrasimilis 的团队的一员，这种动物生活在 1.64 亿年前。

paras.en: "It seems that an aquatic lifestyle arose often in early mammal-like species," said Tim Flannery, a mammalogist at the Australian Museum Research institute who wasn't involved in the work.
paras.zh: 澳大利亚博物馆研究所的哺乳动物学家蒂姆·弗兰纳里（Tim Flannery）没有参与这项工作，他说：“水生生活方式似乎经常出现在早期的类哺乳动物物种中。”

paras.en: If anything, the newly described "spectacular fossil" shows that docodonts were wide-ranging during the dinosaur age, Hand told Live Science in an email.
paras.zh: 汉德在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》杂志，如果说有什么不同的话，那就是新描述的“壮观的化石”表明，在恐龙时代，Docodonts分布广泛。

paras.en: "This very detailed study adds to accumulating evidence that mammaliaforms occupied a wide range of ecological niches long before the evolution of living mammals," Hand said.
paras.zh: 汉德说：“这项非常详细的研究进一步证明，早在现存哺乳动物进化之前，哺乳动物就占据了广泛的生态位。”

paras.en: Li, Y., Li, P., Neander, A., I., Zhang, H., Zhou, C., Martin, T., & Luo, Z. (2026a). A Jurassic mammaliaform swimmer and transformation of the mammalian pharynx. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11107-0
paras.zh: Li, Y.、Li, P.、Neander, A.、I.、Zhang, H.、Zhou, C.、Martin, T. 和 Luo, Z. (2026a)。侏罗纪哺乳动物游泳者和哺乳动物咽部的转变。自然。 https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11107-0

paras.en: Chris Simms is a freelance journalist who previously worked at New Scientist for more than 10 years, in roles including chief subeditor and assistant news editor. He was also a senior subeditor at Nature and has a degree in zoology from Queen Mary University of London. In recent years, he has written numerous articles for New Scientist and in 2018 was shortlisted for Best Newcomer at the Association of British Science Writers awards.
paras.zh: 克里斯·西姆斯 (Chris Simms) 是一名自由撰稿人，曾在《新科学家》杂志工作了 10 多年，担任过首席副主编和助理新闻编辑等职务。他还是《自然》杂志的高级副编辑，并拥有伦敦玛丽女王大学动物学学位。近年来，他为《新科学家》撰写了大量文章，并于2018年入围英国科学作家协会奖最佳新人奖。
