articles.title: Jonathan the tortoise has lived to 194 years old — now scientists think they know why
articles.author: Lauren Schneider

paras.en: The remote south Atlantic island of St. Helena boasts an international celebrity: the tortoise Jonathan, the oldest living land animal. At 194 years old, he has outlasted the expected lifespan for an Aldabra giant tortoise (Aldabrachelys gigantea) by about a century. Now, scientists have identified a range of unique genetic and epigenetic traits that may hold the key to this longevity.
paras.zh: 偏远的南大西洋圣赫勒拿岛拥有一位国际名人：乔纳森乌龟，它是现存最古老的陆地动物。他已经 194 岁了，比亚达伯拉象龟 (Aldabrachelys gigantea) 的预期寿命多了大约一个世纪。现在，科学家们已经确定了一系列独特的遗传和表观遗传特征，这些特征可能是长寿的关键。

paras.en: The new research zoomed in on Jonathan's genes, as well as the chemical tags that sit on top of DNA molecules, known as "epigenetic markers." These markers help control which genes are activated and to what degree. The analysis finds that Jonathan's genes associated with mitochondrial function are in great shape, epigenetically speaking, which suggests that they've played a big role in the tortoise's success.
paras.zh: 这项新研究重点关注乔纳森的基因，以及 DNA 分子顶部的化学标签，即“表观遗传标记”。这些标记有助于控制哪些基因被激活以及激活的程度。分析发现，从表观遗传学的角度来看，乔纳森与线粒体功能相关的基因状态良好，这表明它们在乌龟的成功中发挥了重要作用。

paras.en: While mitochondrial function has long been linked to longevity and mitochondrial dysfunction has been tied to disease, Jonathan offers fresh insight into that dynamic, said study co-author Stephen Clark, chief scientist of the Kallel Foundation, a nonprofit in Nashville researching drug targets to promote human longevity.
paras.zh: 研究合著者、纳什维尔非营利组织卡勒尔基金会的首席科学家斯蒂芬·克拉克表示，虽然线粒体功能长期以来一直与长寿有关，而线粒体功能障碍也与疾病有关，但乔纳森对这种动态提供了新的见解。

paras.en: Clark and colleagues published their findings Wednesday (Oct. 7) in the journal Science Advances.
paras.zh: 克拉克和同事于周三（10 月 7 日）在《科学进展》杂志上发表了他们的发现。

paras.en: Decoding Jonathan's secrets to long life
paras.zh: 解读乔纳森的长寿秘诀

paras.en: Nearly a decade ago, the researchers enlisted Joe Hollins, the vet tasked with Jonathan's care, to collect samples from the record-setting animal. Island authorities forbade the vet from drawing the tortoise's blood, fearing the risk of an infection.
paras.zh: 大约十年前，研究人员聘请了负责照顾乔纳森的兽医乔·霍林斯(Joe Hollins)，从这只创纪录的动物身上采集样本。岛上当局禁止兽医为乌龟抽取血液，担心有感染的风险。

paras.en: "I didn't want to be the doctor that killed Jonathan," Clark told Live Science. Hollins collected samples via cheek swab instead.
paras.zh: “我不想成为杀死乔纳森的医生，”克拉克告诉《生活科学》。霍林斯改为通过脸颊拭子收集样本。

paras.en: When the samples arrived in the U.S., the researchers sequenced them, but when their computers kept crashing, they discovered that the DNA had been isolated from bacteria in Jonathan's mouth rather than the tortoise's own cells.
paras.zh: 当样本到达美国后，研究人员对它们进行了测序，但当他们的计算机不断崩溃时，他们发现DNA是从乔纳森嘴里的细菌中分离出来的，而不是从乌龟自己的细胞中分离出来的。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Clark "had to go back and beg" for permission to collect more data, he said. The vet then sent cheek scrape samples, which are collected with a slightly different tool than cheek swabs. This time, the DNA was in fact from Jonathan.
paras.zh: 克拉克说，他“不得不回去乞求”允许收集更多数据。然后，兽医发送了脸颊刮擦样本，收集样本的工具与脸颊拭子略有不同。这一次，DNA确实来自乔纳森。

paras.en: The DNA isolated from those cheek tissue samples was more fragmented than it would have been in a blood sample, so the researchers filled in the gaps using an existing reference genome from a 36-year-old Aldabra tortoise named Tank. They also compared Jonathan's DNA to that of a Galápagos tortoise (Chelonoidis abingdoni) named Lonesome George, who was believed to be over 100 years old at the time of his death in 2012.
paras.zh: 从这些面颊组织样本中分离出的 DNA 比血液样本中的 DNA 更加碎片化，因此研究人员使用来自 36 岁亚达伯拉象龟 Tank 的现有参考基因组来填补这些空白。他们还将乔纳森的 DNA 与一只名叫“孤独乔治”的加拉帕戈斯象龟 (Chelonoidis abingdoni) 的 DNA 进行了比较，据信后者在 2012 年去世时已经 100 多岁了。

paras.en: The team found that, compared to Tank and Lonesome George, Jonathan carried 287 unique variants of genes that had previously been linked to aging-related pathways. These included genes involved in DNA repair and the function of telomeres — the protective tips at the end of chromosomes that tend to shorten with age.
paras.zh: 研究小组发现，与坦克和孤独的乔治相比，乔纳森携带 287 个独特的基因变体，这些基因先前与衰老相关途径有关。其中包括参与DNA修复和端粒功能的基因——端粒是染色体末端的保护性尖端，随着年龄的增长往往会缩短。

paras.en: These pathways are also related to aging processes in humans, highlighting a "broader signature of aging" across species, Greer Dolby, an assistant professor of biology at The University of Alabama at Birmingham, who was not involved with the study, told Live Science.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的阿拉巴马大学伯明翰分校生物学助理教授格里尔·杜比（Greer Dolby）告诉《生活科学》杂志，这些途径也与人类的衰老过程有关，凸显了跨物种的“更广泛的衰老特征”。

paras.en: The researchers also looked at epigenetic changes, including DNA methylation, which is when a chemical tag called a methyl group binds the DNA. Certain patterns of DNA methylation can function as a "clock" in that they reflect an organism's biological age; scientists have recently harnessed these patterns in the study of human aging. In this case, the team compared the DNA methylation across Jonathan's genome to that of young and old Aldabra tortoises.
paras.zh: 研究人员还研究了表观遗传变化，包括 DNA 甲基化，即甲基化化学标签与 DNA 结合的情况。 DNA甲基化的某些模式可以起到“时钟”的作用，因为它们反映了生物体的生物年龄。科学家最近利用这些模式来研究人类衰老。在这种情况下，研究小组将乔纳森的基因组 DNA 甲基化与年轻和年老的亚达伯拉象龟进行了比较。

paras.en: The methylation patterns were more disordered in the older tortoises, reflecting random changes acquired over time, the researchers found. Scientists call this phenomenon "methylation entropy." For most genes, Jonathan's DNA methylation patterns were more disordered than those of the young tortoises. But in a suite of genes tied to mitochondrial function — specifically the bits of those genes that switch them "on" — Jonathan had more organized methylation patterns. That might keep expression of these genes consistent over time, the researchers theorized.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，老年陆龟的甲基化模式更加无序，反映了随着时间的推移而发生的随机变化。科学家将这种现象称为“甲基化熵”。对于大多数基因来说，乔纳森的 DNA 甲基化模式比幼龟的更加无序。但在一系列与线粒体功能相关的基因中——特别是那些“开启”线粒体功能的基因片段——乔纳森拥有更有组织的甲基化模式。研究人员推测，随着时间的推移，这可能会使这些基因的表达保持一致。

paras.en: Mitochondria produce energy that cells need to function properly, repair themselves and reduce further damage to DNA. "Keeping the entropy low in these mitochondrial genes, or keeping pristine mitochondria, is likely to be a contributor to longevity," Clark said.
paras.zh: 线粒体产生细胞正常运作、自我修复和减少 DNA 进一步损伤所需的能量。克拉克说：“保持这些线粒体基因的熵较低，或者保持原始线粒体，可能有助于长寿。”

paras.en: However, the authors couldn't determine a causal relationship — they didn't run any tests that could definitively prove that Jonathon's lack of entropy in these genes explains his long life. Clark argued that additional experiments on a blood sample from Jonathan could offer a more comprehensive view of his genome.
paras.zh: 然而，作者无法确定因果关系——他们没有进行任何测试来明确证明乔纳森这些基因中缺乏熵解释了他的长寿。克拉克认为，对乔纳森的血液样本进行额外的实验可以更全面地了解他的基因组。

paras.en: Jonathan's full genetic profile can't be known until after the tortoise's death, when researchers can collect DNA from more tissues, said Vincent Lynch, a professor of biology at the University at Buffalo, who was not involved with the study.
paras.zh: 未参与这项研究的布法罗大学生物学教授文森特·林奇 (Vincent Lynch) 表示，乔纳森的完整基因谱要等到乌龟死后才能得知，届时研究人员可以从更多组织中收集 DNA。

paras.en: "Some organs are more susceptible to different diseases of old age than other ones, and that happens because mutations accumulate over time," he told Live Science. "We would ideally like to know what those mutations are in those specific tissues."
paras.zh: 他告诉《生活科学》杂志：“一些器官比其他器官更容易受到不同老年疾病的影响，这是因为突变随着时间的推移而积累。” “我们理想地想知道这些特定组织中的突变是什么。”

paras.en: Furthermore, Lynch questioned whether entropy was a useful characterization of age-related DNA methylation patterns, as methylation can be unpredictable. That said, he agreed that the genes flagged in the study offer helpful data for future work on longevity.
paras.zh: 此外，Lynch 质疑熵是否是与年龄相关的 DNA 甲基化模式的有用表征，因为甲基化可能是不可预测的。尽管如此，他同意该研究中标记的基因为未来的长寿研究提供了有用的数据。

paras.en: More experiments are needed to determine whether these mitochondrial genes actually play a role in longevity across all Aldabra tortoises, let alone in other animals, or if Jonathan is just an outlier.
paras.zh: 需要更多的实验来确定这些线粒体基因是否真的在所有亚达伯拉陆龟的长寿中发挥作用，更不用说在其他动物中，或者乔纳森是否只是一个异常值。

paras.en: "Maybe Jonathan is just really good at being old," Lynch said.
paras.zh: “也许乔纳森真的很擅长变老，”林奇说。

articles.title: OpenAI claims we've entered the AGI era — has GPT-6 Astra really demonstrated general intelligence?
articles.author: Adam Shepherd

paras.en: OpenAI representatives claim that the recent launch of one of its latest models, GPT-6 Astra, marks the beginning of the artificial general intelligence (AGI) era — a hypothetical scenario in which artificial intelligence (AI) can learn and reason like humans. Following very recent claims from technology executives that we've now reached this milestone, how likely is this claim to stand up to scrutiny?
paras.zh: OpenAI 代表声称，最近推出的最新模型之一 GPT-6 Astra 标志着通用人工智能 (AGI) 时代的开始——这是一个假设场景，人工智能 (AI) 可以像人类一样学习和推理。技术高管最近声称我们已经达到了这一里程碑，那么这种说法经得起审查的可能性有多大？

paras.en: Amid revelations that safety concerns have forced the company to abandon the planned rollout of GPT-6.1 Astra, independent researchers and benchmark creators warn that GPT-6 Astra's record-breaking scores rely on heavy prompt optimization rather than true general intelligence. This comes as experts warn about the risks of future AI systems and AI executives jointly call for a slowdown in AI research.
paras.zh: 据透露，安全问题迫使该公司放弃了 GPT-6.1 Astra 的推出计划，独立研究人员和基准创建者警告称，GPT-6 Astra 破纪录的分数依赖于大量的即时优化，而不是真正的通用智能。在此之际，专家警告未来人工智能系统的风险，人工智能高管联合呼吁放缓人工智能研究。

paras.en: In announcing the model's release, OpenAI President Greg Brockman suggested that Astra signaled a fundamental turning point in AI evolution. "If we fast-forward a couple years, and we look back and say when was it really that AGI was created, I think it's going to be about this time, and I think it might be about this model," Brockman said during a Sept. 3 news conference marking the launch.
paras.zh: OpenAI 总裁 Greg Brockman 在宣布该模型发布时表示，Astra 标志着人工智能进化的根本转折点。布罗克曼在 9 月 3 日的发布会上表示：“如果我们快进几年，回顾一下 AGI 真正诞生的时间，我认为会是在这个时候，而且可能会是在这个模型上。”

paras.en: How did the new model perform in benchmarking?
paras.zh: 新模型在基准测试中的表现如何？

paras.en: As part of the testing-and-verification process for the new model, OpenAI released benchmark results across a range of tests that measure the capabilities of AI models at various tasks. OpenAI representatives claimed in a statement that the company's new model delivers "state-of-the-art" performance across a variety of fields, including software engineering, the autonomous use of computer programs, mathematics problems, and even scientific research.
paras.zh: 作为新模型测试和验证过程的一部分，OpenAI 发布了一系列测试的基准结果，这些测试衡量人工智能模型在各种任务中的能力。 OpenAI 代表在一份声明中声称，该公司的新模型在各个领域提供了“最先进”的性能，包括软件工程、计算机程序的自主使用、数学问题，甚至科学研究。

paras.en: Demonstrations, for example, highlighted Astra's ability to generate 3D CAD code; lay out printed circuit boards in CAD (computer-aided design) software; convert digital 3D models into interactive, video-game-style environments; and deploy hosted web applications directly from prompts.
paras.zh: 例如，演示强调了 Astra 生成 3D CAD 代码的能力；在 CAD（计算机辅助设计）软件中布置印刷电路板；将数字 3D 模型转换为交互式视频游戏风格的环境；并直接根据提示部署托管 Web 应用程序。

paras.en: "In our early testing, Astra stood out by approaching legal work the way a discerning lawyer does: it distinguishes documents from established records, surfaces unsupported assumptions, and converts gaps into concrete drafting positions," said Niko Grupen, head of applied research at legal services AI developer Harvey as part of OpenAI’s announcement.
paras.zh: 作为 OpenAI 公告的一部分，法律服务人工智能开发商 Harvey 的应用研究主管 Niko Grupen 表示：“在我们的早期测试中，Astra 以挑剔的律师处理法律工作的方式脱颖而出：它将文件与既定记录区分开来，提出不受支持的假设，并将差距转化为具体的起草立场。”

paras.en: On ARC-AGI-3 — a benchmark designed to measure how efficiently AI systems acquire new skills in novel, abstract environments — Astra achieved a headline score of 99.9%. Independent testing by the nonprofit ARC Prize Foundation, which oversees the benchmark, revealed that Astra surpassed "human action-efficiency" baselines on 96% of levels, taking 51.7% fewer actions per level, on average, than human solvers.
paras.zh: 在 ARC-AGI-3（旨在衡量人工智能系统在新颖、抽象的环境中如何有效地获取新技能的基准）上，Astra 取得了 99.9% 的总体得分。负责监督该基准的非营利组织 ARC 奖基金会进行的独立测试显示，Astra 在 96% 的关卡上超越了“人类行动效率”基线，与人类求解器相比，每个关卡的行动平均减少了 51.7%。

paras.en: "Not only is this the best model we've ever tested," ARC Prize Foundation President Greg Kamradt said as part of the OpenAI announcement, "but it also represents a meaningful step change in frontier-model performance — not only in its ability to navigate and solve novel environments but also in how efficiently it learns to do so."
paras.zh: ARC 奖基金会主席 Greg Kamradt 在 OpenAI 公告中表示：“这不仅是我们测试过的最好的模型，而且它还代表了前沿模型性能的重大变化——不仅体现在它导航和解决新环境的能力方面，还体现在它学习这样做的效率方面。”

paras.en: Many researchers have highlighted that Astra's top ARC-AGI-3 performance relied on a proprietary "Provider Adapter" harness, a specialized software scaffolding layer that's inaccessible to rival developers. When tested using the benchmark's neutral Standard harness, this score dropped to 62.7%. ARC Prize organizers also noted that saturating the benchmark does not constitute proof of achieving AGI — emphasizing that its closed, deterministic puzzle environments do not capture the open-ended complexity of the real world.
paras.zh: 许多研究人员强调，Astra 的顶级 ARC-AGI-3 性能依赖于专有的“Provider Adapter”工具，这是竞争对手开发人员无法访问的专用软件脚手架层。当使用基准测试的中性标准线束进行测试时，该分数下降至 62.7%。 ARC 奖组织者还指出，基准测试饱和并不构成实现 AGI 的证据——强调其封闭的、确定性的谜题环境并不能捕捉现实世界的开放式复杂性。

paras.en: "When we launched ARC-AGI-3, "we made it clear that saturating the benchmark would not represent 'proof of achieving AGI,'" Kamradt wrote in a blog post. "Therefore, while we believe Astra represents meaningful progress towards generalization, we are not claiming that it is AGI."
paras.zh: Kamradt 在一篇博文中写道：“当我们推出 ARC-AGI-3 时，我们明确表示，基准测试饱和并不代表‘实现 AGI 的证明’。因此，虽然我们相信 Astra 代表了通用化方面的有意义的进展，但我们并不声称它是 AGI。”

paras.en: Discrepancies in the data were reportedly present even before the official announcement. As reported by Fortune, an embargoed draft provided to news organizations prior to the model's launch listed Astra's ARC-AGI-3 score at 98.6% before it jumped to 99.9% on the live site.
paras.zh: 据报道，甚至在官方宣布之前，数据就已经存在差异。据《财富》杂志报道，在该模型推出之前向新闻机构提供的一份禁运草案将 Astra 的 ARC-AGI-3 得分列为 98.6%，然后在现场网站上跃升至 99.9%。

paras.en: Anka Reuel and Mike Hardy, doctoral researchers in AI at Stanford University, also raised concerns over OpenAI quietly revising several published metrics post-launch, including halving Astra's reported hallucination rate from 4.2% to 2.0% before reverting it.
paras.zh: 斯坦福大学人工智能博士研究员 Anka Reuel 和 Mike Hardy 也对 OpenAI 悄悄修改发布后的几项已发布指标表示担忧，其中包括将 Astra 报告的幻觉率从 4.2% 减半至 2.0%，然后再恢复。

paras.en: Speaking to Fortune, Reuel and Hardy attributed the shifting figures to "benchmaxxing" — an industry term that describes the practice of repeatedly rerunning evaluations under subtly tweaked prompts, scaffolds or compute allocations to hunt for peak theoretical scores.
paras.zh: 鲁埃尔和哈迪在接受《财富》杂志采访时将这些数据的变化归因于“基准最大化”——这是一个行业术语，描述了在巧妙调整的提示、支架或计算分配下反复重新运行评估以寻找最高理论分数的做法。

paras.en: In a 2025 paper published on pre-print server arXiv titled ‘Benchmarking is Broken -- Don't Let AI be its Own Judge’, experts including Princeton doctoral candidate Zerui Cheng and University of Luxembourg postdoctoral researcher Dr. Stella Wohnig warned that such practices create confusion and undermine trust, particularly when official technical documentation omits the basic methodology, making independent verification nearly impossible. Crucially, scores achieved through benchmaxxing reflect idealized performance ceilings under optimal lab conditions rather than practical, out-of-the-box reliability.
paras.zh: 2025 年，在预印本服务器 arXiv 上发表的一篇题​​为“基准测试已被打破——不要让人工智能成为自己的法官”的论文中，包括普林斯顿大学博士生 Zerui Cheng 和卢森堡大学博士后研究员 Stella Wohnig 在内的专家警告说，这种做法会造成混乱并破坏信任，特别是当官方技术文档省略基本方法时，使独立验证几乎不可能。至关重要的是，通过基准测试获得的分数反映了最佳实验室条件下的理想性能上限，而不是实际的、开箱即用的可靠性。

paras.en: According to OpenAI's benchmark data, across specialized domain evaluations, GPT-6 Astra delivered 10% to 20% better performance than both its predecessor, GPT-5.6 Sol, and top market competitors.
paras.zh: 根据 OpenAI 的基准数据，在专业领域评估中，GPT-6 Astra 的性能比其前身 GPT-5.6 Sol 和顶级市场竞争对手高出 10% 到 20%。

paras.en: Highlights include a 98% score on FrontierMath Tier 4 (v2), which evaluates expert-level mathematical reasoning; a perfect 100% on ExploitBench, which is designed to test offensive cybersecurity capabilities; 95.9% on BenchCAD, which measures an AI's ability to reconstruct 3D objects using CAD code; 57.9% on Terminal-Bench 4.0, which assesses complex terminal-based system administration and software engineering; and 41.4% on AutomationBench, which tests whether agents can complete multistep business workflows across applications.
paras.zh: 亮点包括 FrontierMath Tier 4 (v2) 得分为 98%，用于评估专家级数学推理；在旨在测试进攻性网络安全能力的 ExploitBench 上获得完美 100%； BenchCAD 为 95.9%，该工具衡量 AI 使用 CAD 代码重建 3D 对象的能力； Terminal-Bench 4.0 得分为 57.9%，该软件评估基于终端的复杂系统管理和软件工程； AutomationBench 上的得分为 41.4%，该测试测试座席是否可以跨应用程序完成多步骤业务工作流程。

paras.en: But independent findings from external AI benchmarking firm Artificial Analysis contradict these results. Astra's score on the independent Artificial Analysis Intelligence Index — an aggregate metric that evaluates general reasoning across frontier models — remained completely flat, at 61, compared with GPT-5.6 Sol, while trailing competitors like Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.1 and Meta's Muse Spark 1.3.
paras.zh: 但外部人工智能基准测试公司 Artificial Analysis 的独立调查结果与这些结果相矛盾。与 GPT-5.6 Sol 相比，Astra 在独立人工智能分析智能指数（评估前沿模型一般推理的综合指标）上的得分完全持平，为 61，同时落后于 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5.1 和 Meta 的 Muse Spark 1.3 等竞争对手。

paras.en: While some benchmark results have seen improvement since the previous generation, Astra underperformed in other tests. Artificial Analysis' testing showed that against GDPval-AA v2 — an economically focused benchmark that measures real-world workplace tasks across 44 occupations — Astra suffered a significant drop in its relative leaderboard ranking compared with GPT-5.6 Sol. Additional regressions were observed in benchmarks that test customer service support, scientific Python programming, and long-context reasoning across large documents.
paras.zh: 尽管自上一代以来一些基准测试结果有所改善，但 Astra 在其他测试中表现不佳。 Artificial Analysis 的测试表明，与 GDPval-AA v2（衡量 44 种职业的现实世界工作场所任务的经济基准）相比，Astra 的相对排行榜排名与 GPT-5.6 Sol 相比显着下降。在测试客户服务支持、科学 Python 编程以及跨大型文档的长上下文推理的基准测试中还观察到了其他回归。

paras.en: In terms of overall token use — the metering system that measures the fragments of text or data processed by AI models — OpenAI representatives said GPT-6 Astra achieved dramatic efficiency gains on complex, long-horizon tasks. Findings from Artificial Analysis confirmed that on software engineering benchmarks, Astra was approximately 70% more token-efficient than GPT-5.6 Sol, using roughly one-third the total tokens of its predecessor and one-fifth the tokens of Claude Opus 5.
paras.zh: 就整体代币使用（衡量人工智能模型处理的文本或数据片段的计量系统）而言，OpenAI 代表表示，GPT-6 Astra 在复杂的长期任务上取得了显着的效率提升。 Artificial Analysis 的调查结果证实，在软件工程基准测试中，Astra 的代币效率比 GPT-5.6 Sol 高出约 70%，使用的代币总数大约是其前身的三分之一，是 Claude Opus 5 的五分之一。

paras.en: On professional workplace evaluations like Agents' Last Exam, the new model reduced output token consumption by up to 65% compared with Opus 5, while on general intelligence evaluations, Astra achieved a roughly 10% output token reduction at max effort compared with Sol.
paras.zh: 在《Agents' Last Exam》等专业工作场所评估中，与 Opus 5 相比，新模型将输出令牌消耗减少了高达 65%，而在一般智力评估中，与 Sol 相比，Astra 在最大努力下实现了约 10% 的输出令牌消耗减少。

paras.en: On the other hand, this achievement is offset by a 250% increase in the base API pricing for GPT-6 Astra compared with GPT-5.6 Sol. Token prices jumped from $4/$20 to $10/$50 per million input/output tokens. As a result, Astra ends up approximately 75% more expensive per task than its predecessor on general intelligence evaluations, despite using 10% fewer output tokens. This trade-off has led researchers at Artificial Analysis to question whether AI labs are relying on expensive computational brute force to squeeze out minor gains, rather than achieving true technical breakthroughs.
paras.zh: 另一方面，与 GPT-5.6 Sol 相比，GPT-6 Astra 的基本 API 定价增加了 250%，抵消了这一成就。每百万输入/输出代币的代币价格从 4 美元/20 美元跃升至 10 美元/50 美元。因此，尽管使用的输出代币减少了 10%，但在一般智力评估方面，Astra 每项任务的成本比其前身高出约 75%。这种权衡让人工分析公司的研究人员质疑人工智能实验室是否依赖昂贵的计算暴力来榨取微小的收益，而不是实现真正的技术突破。

paras.en: With its latest model, OpenAI has placed a stronger emphasis on safeguards and controls. The move follows a series of high-profile incidents in which frontier AI models inadvertently hacked into third-party networks and computer systems as part of routine testing operations, after the models went beyond what humans expected they would do when encountering challenging tasks.
paras.zh: OpenAI 的最新模型更加强调保障和控制。在此之前发生了一系列备受瞩目的事件，在这些事件中，前沿人工智能模型在例行测试操作中无意中侵入了第三方网络和计算机系统，这些模型超出了人类在遇到挑战性任务时的预期。

paras.en: According to OpenAI representatives, Astra did not exceed the scope of its tasks in any security evaluations. For comparison, GPT-5.6 Sol went beyond its authorized parameters in almost 50% of test cases. Hallucination rates have also been reduced significantly, falling to 4.2% on internal tests, compared with 12.2% for GPT-5.6 Sol (with independent testing by Artificial Analysis showing a drop from 92% to 51% at max effort). The model also showed an improved ability to handle ambiguous prompts.
paras.zh: OpenAI代表表示，Astra在任何安全评估中都没有超出其任务范围。相比之下，GPT-5.6 Sol 在近 50% 的测试用例中超出了其授权参数。幻觉率也显着降低，在内部测试中降至 4.2%，而 GPT-5.6 Sol 为 12.2%（人工分析的独立测试显示，在最大努力下，幻觉率从 92% 降至 51%）。该模型还表现出处理模糊提示的能力有所提高。

paras.en: David Wood — chair of London Futurists, a non-profit that hosts discussion groups on emerging technology — argued that beyond individual test results, Astra highlights a fundamental shift in how humans will interact with AI as models move from answering questions to autonomously pursuing complex goals in digital environments.
paras.zh: 伦敦未来主义者 (London Futurists) 主席大卫·伍德 (David Wood) 认为，除了个人测试结果之外，Astra 还强调了随着模型从回答问题转向在数字环境中自主追求复杂目标，人类与人工智能互动方式发生了根本性转变。

paras.en: - AI agents resorted to crime and self-destruction to survive in a simulated world — but does this mean they would do the same in the real world?
paras.zh: - 人工智能特工诉诸犯罪和自毁来在模拟世界中生存——但这是否意味着他们会在现实世界中做同样的事情？

paras.en: - We're not about to awaken an evil digital god — AI is far more likely to end in a great disappointment
paras.zh: - 我们不会唤醒邪恶的数字神 - 人工智能更有可能以极大的失望而告终

paras.en: - Elon Musk and Sam Altman claim we've reached the AI singularity. But how would we even know that happened?
paras.zh: - 埃隆·马斯克和萨姆·奥尔特曼声称我们已经达到了人工智能奇点。但我们怎么知道这件事发生了呢？

paras.en: "The impressive benchmark results matter, but what matters more is the combination of intelligence, autonomy, computer use, and cybersecurity capability," he said in an email to Live Science. "That combination also demands caution. The more useful these systems become, the greater the consequences when they misunderstand our intentions, are misused, or find ways around the safeguards we give them."
paras.zh: 他在给《Live Science》的一封电子邮件中表示：“令人印象深刻的基准测试结果很重要，但更重要的是智能、自主性、计算机使用和网络安全能力的结合。” “这种组合也需要谨慎。这些系统变得越有用，当它们误解我们的意图、被滥用或找到绕过我们提供的保障措施时，后果就越大。”

paras.en: Wood suggested that whether Astra can be classified as AGI is less relevant than recognizing the need for AI control and governance to keep pace with technical development.
paras.zh: Wood 表示，Astra 是否可以被归类为 AGI 并不重要，重要的是认识到人工智能控制和治理的必要性，以跟上技术发展的步伐。

paras.en: "The possibility that AI could progress from systems like Astra towards all-round superintelligence makes much greater human vigilance, awareness, and collaboration increasingly urgent," he said.
paras.zh: 他说：“人工智能有可能从像 Astra 这样的系统发展成为全方位的超级智能，这使得人类提高警惕、意识和协作变得越来越紧迫。”

paras.en: Adam Shepherd has been a journalist for over 10 years, covering areas including enterprise technology, business events, media and podcasting. His byline has appeared in publications including C&IT, IT Pro, Campaign, and more.
paras.zh: Adam Shepherd 担任记者已有 10 多年，报道领域包括企业技术、商业活动、媒体和播客。他的署名曾出现在 C&IT、IT Pro、Campaign 等出版物中。

paras.en: His professional work frequently explores the practical applications of emerging digital trends, and he has a particular passion for new advancements in computing.
paras.zh: 他的专业工作经常探索新兴数字趋势的实际应用，并且他对计算领域的新进步特别热情。

paras.en: Combining research-backed insights with in-depth analysis, Adam strives to present complex subjects in an insightful, approachable manner. In his personal life, he maintains an interest in programming and video games.
paras.zh: Adam 将研究支持的见解与深入分析相结合，努力以富有洞察力、平易近人的方式呈现复杂的主题。在他的个人生活中，他对编程和视频游戏保持着兴趣。

articles.title: Two Chemists Win Nobel Prize for Unraveling a Mystery of Molecular 'Handedness,' Helping Drugmakers Develop Safer Medications

paras.en: Two scientists have been awarded the Nobel Prize in Chemistry for their work untangling a perplexing puzzle about the “handedness” of molecules, allowing drugmakers to develop safer, more precisely targeted medicines. Chemists Henri Kagan of the University of Paris-Sud and Kenso Soai of the Tokyo University of Science were named Nobel laureates on October 7.
paras.zh: 两位科学家因其解决了分子“旋向性”这一令人费解的难题而获得诺贝尔化学奖，使制药商能够开发出更安全、更精确的靶向药物。 10 月 7 日，巴黎南大学化学家亨利·卡根 (Henri Kagan) 和东京理科大学化学家 Soai Kenso 被评为诺贝尔奖获得者。

paras.en: “The medicines we have today would not be possible without this chemistry,” Rigoberto Hernandez, president of the American Chemical Society and a chemist at the Johns Hopkins University, tells the Associated Press’ Adithi Ramakrishnan, Kostya Manenkov and Stefanie Dazio.
paras.zh: 美国化学会主席、约翰·霍普金斯大学化学家 Rigoberto Hernandez 告诉美联社记者 Adithi Ramakrishnan、Kostya Manenkov 和 Stefanie Dazio：“如果没有这种化学反应，我们今天的药物就不可能出现。”

paras.en: Kagan and Soai’s award-winning research centers on chirality, which derives from the Greek word for “hand.” Some molecules come in two forms that are mirror images of each other, just like our right and left hands. These mirror images, known as chiral forms, may look similar, but they can behave very differently. The chemical carvone, for instance, can smell like mint or caraway, depending on which version of it you sniff.
paras.zh: 卡根和索艾的获奖研究中心是手性，手性源自希腊语“手”。有些分子有两种形式，互为镜像，就像我们的右手和左手一样。这些镜像（称为手性形式）可能看起来相似，但它们的行为可能非常不同。例如，化学香芹酮闻起来像薄荷或香菜，具体取决于您闻到的版本。

paras.en: However, living organisms usually contain just one version of a molecule. The sugars in our DNA, for example, are right-handed, while most amino acids in your body’s proteins are left-handed. Their mirror-image counterparts, by contrast, are rarely found in nature. This phenomenon is known as homochirality, which derives from the Greek words for “same” and “hand.”
paras.zh: 然而，生物体通常只含有一种分子。例如，我们 DNA 中的糖是右旋的，而人体蛋白质中的大多数氨基酸是左旋的。相比之下，它们的镜像对应物在自然界中很少发现。这种现象被称为同手性，它源自希腊语中的“相同”和“手”。

paras.en: For decades, this chemical asymmetry confounded scientists. How do natural reactions in living organisms produce just one type of a molecule? And why did life’s building blocks evolve a preference for one version or the other?
paras.zh: 几十年来，这种化学不对称性让科学家们感到困惑。生物体中的自然反应如何只产生一种类型的分子？为什么生命的组成部分会进化出对其中一种版本的偏好？

paras.en: Deepening the conundrum, they couldn’t replicate this natural asymmetry in the lab. Their experiments produced equal amounts of each version of a molecule—a 50-50 right-handed and left-handed split.
paras.zh: 更进一步的是，他们无法在实验室中复制这种自然的不对称性。他们的实验产生了等量的每种分子——右旋分子和左旋分子各为 50-50。

paras.en: Thanks to Kagan and Soai, as well as numerous scientists who came before them, researchers are now closer to unraveling this mystery.
paras.zh: 感谢卡根和索艾，以及在他们之前的众多科学家，研究人员现在更接近解开这个谜团。

paras.en: Their work hinges on catalysts, or substances that can influence chemical reactions without being used up or permanently altered in the process. In 1986, Kagan reported that if an asymmetrical catalyst is introduced to a chemical reaction, it can cause the resulting molecule to be asymmetrical, too, producing more of the right-handed or left-handed version. The effect of the catalyst is nonlinear, meaning that a small imbalance in the catalyst can lead to a much larger imbalance in the handedness of the ensuing molecules.
paras.zh: 他们的工作取决于催化剂，或者可以影响化学反应而不会在过程中耗尽或永久改变的物质。 1986 年，卡根报告说，如果在化学反应中引入不对称催化剂，它也会导致所得分子不对称，从而产生更多的右旋或左旋分子。催化剂的作用是非线性的，这意味着催化剂中的微小不平衡可能会导致后续分子的旋向性发生更大的不平衡。

paras.en: Soai further tweaked the work and developed chemical reactions that can produce their own asymmetrical catalyst. These “autocatalytic reactions” amplify the imbalance of the ensuing molecule, essentially steering it toward right-handedness or left-handedness. In 2003, he finally published a paper describing a reaction—later dubbed the Soai reaction—in which only one of the mirror images made up the vast majority of the products.
paras.zh: Soai 进一步调整了工作并开发了可以产生自己的不对称催化剂的化学反应。这些“自催化反应”放大了随后产生的分子的不平衡，本质上将其转向右旋或左旋。 2003 年，他终于发表了一篇论文，描述了一种反应（后来被称为 Soai 反应），其中只有一个镜像构成了绝大多数产物。

paras.en: “Their discoveries led to a chemical reaction that spontaneously, without the involvement of other chiral molecules, creates only one mirror image,” said Heiner Linke, chair of the Nobel committee for chemistry and a physicist at Lund University in Sweden, during a livestream of the award announcement. “This is the first time this has happened since the processes that led to the chirality of life billions of years ago.”
paras.zh: 诺贝尔化学委员会主席、瑞典隆德大学物理学家海纳·林克在颁奖典礼直播中表示：“他们的发现导致了一种化学反应，在没有其他手性分子参与的情况下，自发地只产生一个镜像。” “自数十亿年前导致生命手性的过程以来，这是第一次发生这种情况。”

paras.en: Their work doesn’t explain how handedness arose in nature, nor why some molecules are naturally right-handed or left-handed. But it “provides a mechanism by which the problem could be solved,” Matthew Powner, an organic chemist at University College London, tells Nature.
paras.zh: 他们的工作没有解释自然界中旋手性是如何产生的，也没有解释为什么有些分子天生是右旋或左旋的。但它“提供了一种可以解决问题的机制”，伦敦大学学院的有机化学家马修·波纳告诉《自然》杂志。

paras.en: In the 1960s, drugmaker Eli Lilly used the left-handed version of a molecule to develop Novrad, a cough medicine, and the right-handed version to make Darvon, an opioid painkiller, per Science's Eric Hand. Their names are mirror images of each other, too.
paras.zh: 据《科学》杂志的埃里克·汉德 (Eric Hand) 报道，20 世纪 60 年代，制药商礼来 (Eli Lilly) 使用分子的左手版本开发了咳嗽药 Novrad，并使用右手版本的分子开发了阿片类止痛药 Darvon。他们的名字也是彼此的镜像。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Kagan and Soai’s research has had major practical implications for pharmacology. Their discoveries have helped drugmakers develop more targeted medicines with fewer side effects, reports STAT’s Annalisa Merelli.
paras.zh: 与此同时，卡根和索艾的研究对药理学具有重大的实际意义。 STAT 的 Annalisa Merelli 报道称，他们的发现帮助制药商开发出更具针对性且副作用更少的药物。

paras.en: Historically, drugs were often developed as “racemates,” meaning they contained a 50-50 mixture of the left- and right-handed versions of a molecule. While one version of the molecule might produce the desired therapeutic effect, the other might be harmless—or it could interact differently with the body and cause serious side effects.
paras.zh: 从历史上看，药物通常被开发为“外消旋体”，这意味着它们含有左旋分子和右旋分子 50-50 的混合物。虽然该分子的一种版本可能会产生所需的治疗效果，但另一种可能是无害的，或者它可能与身体发生不同的相互作用并导致严重的副作用。

paras.en: In recent years, however, pharmacologists have started producing drugs that are primarily one version of the molecule or the other.
paras.zh: 然而，近年来，药理学家开始生产主要是该分子的一种版本或另一种版本的药物。

paras.en: “To be able to selectively make handed molecules is absolutely critical, because life is handed, and the world is handed,” Hernandez tells Chemical & Engineering News’ Brianna Barbu. “So, if you can control the handedness of the therapeutic or the molecular system that you put out there, then that can lead to control of its function and its downstream effects.”
paras.zh: “能够选择性地制造手性分子绝对是至关重要的，因为生命是手性的，世界也是手性的，”埃尔南德斯告诉《化学与工程新闻》的布丽安娜·巴尔布。 “因此，如果你可以控制治疗药物或分子系统的手性，那么就可以控制其功能及其下游效应。”

paras.en: Soai was out shopping when he learned of his newly minted Nobel laureate status. “I’m very excited,” he said while calling into the award ceremony. “Of course, this is one of the most exciting days of my life. I’m very glad to share the award with Professor Henri Kagan.”
paras.zh: 当索艾得知自己刚刚获得诺贝尔奖时，他正在外出购物。 “我非常兴奋，”他在打电话参加颁奖典礼时说道。 “当然，这是我一生中最激动人心的日子之一。我很高兴与亨利·卡根教授分享这一奖项。”

paras.en: Members of the Nobel committee and journalists couldn’t immediately reach Kagan. However, his daughter, Veronique Le Deunff, told Reuters’ Marie Mannes, Simon Johnson and Johan Ahlander she was “very happy” for her father, adding that “the creativity and originality of his work have opened up new avenues for research.”
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会成员和记者无法立即联系到卡根。然而，他的女儿 Veronique Le Deunff 告诉路透社的 Marie Mannes、Simon Johnson 和 Johan Ahlander，她为父亲“非常高兴”，并补充说“他的工作的创造力和原创性为研究开辟了新的途径。”

paras.en: The Nobel committees will continue revealing winners of their six award categories this week and early next week. Each award comes with 12 million Swedish kronor (about $1.2 million), which gets split among the laureates.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会将在本周和下周初继续公布六个奖项类别的获奖者。每个奖项的奖金为 1200 万瑞典克朗（约合 120 万美元），由获奖者平分。

articles.title: Hundreds of British College Students Clashed With Wooden Swords in a 1966 Re-enactment of the Battle of Hastings. Watch the Rediscovered 'Time Capsule' of Lost Footage

paras.en: On October 14, 1966, several hundred college students dressed in burlap and fake chainmail converged on a grassy hill in southern England. Armed with wooden swords and shields, they prepared to re-enact the Battle of Hastings—the key event in England’s Norman Conquest—to commemorate its 900th anniversary.
paras.zh: 1966 年 10 月 14 日，数百名身穿粗麻布和假链甲的大学生聚集在英格兰南部一座长满青草的小山上。他们手持木剑和木盾，准备重演黑斯廷斯战役——英格兰诺曼征服中的关键事件——以纪念其 900 周年。

paras.en: “We were recruited with the promise of beer on the day and a coach trip and a good day out,” Peter Sampson, who played a Norman foot soldier in the re-enactment, tells the BBC’s Craig Buchan. “At times it got very realistic in terms of aggression between the two sides,” he explains, not least because the students hailed from the rival universities of Kent and Sussex.
paras.zh: 在重演中扮演诺曼步兵的彼得·桑普森 (Peter Sampson) 告诉英国广播公司 (BBC) 的克雷格·巴肯 (Craig Buchan)：“我们被招募时，承诺当天有啤酒、一次长途汽车旅行以及美好的一天。”他解释说：“有时，双方之间的侵略行为变得非常现实。”尤其是因为学生们来自肯特大学和苏塞克斯大学这两个竞争对手。

paras.en: Following that 25-minute dust-up, re-enacting the Battle of Hastings became an annual tradition, albeit with greater attention to historical accuracy. The rowdy 900th anniversary re-enactment appeared to be lost to history, and Sampson, for one, never participated in a re-enactment again.
paras.zh: 在那场 25 分钟的争吵之后，重演黑斯廷斯战役成为了一年一度的传统，尽管人们更加注重历史的准确性。喧闹的 900 周年纪念重演似乎已经消失在历史中，桑普森就是其中之一，再也没有参加过重演。

paras.en: Now, rare color footage of the 1966 event has emerged for the first time. The conservation charity English Heritage has released it as a 12-minute film ahead of this year’s re-enactment, which will take place on October 10 and 11 at Battle Abbey in East Sussex, the site of the 1066 battle.
paras.zh: 现在，1966 年事件的罕见彩色镜头首次出现。保护慈善机构英国遗产组织在今年的重演之前将其制作为一部 12 分钟的电影，重演将于 10 月 10 日至 11 日在东萨塞克斯郡的巴特尔修道院（1066 年战役的发生地）举行。

paras.en: The 1966 film was shot at the behest of the Hastings Town Council by Alan Wootton, a local electronics company owner, and a small production team that included his 12-year-old son, Cliff. After a recent visit to Battle Abbey reminded him of his father’s footage, Cliff worked with English Heritage to turn 300 reels of film into what the Guardian’s Esther Addley calls “a pleasingly Monty Pythonesque record of chaps in fake chainmail bonking each other on the heads with fake weapons.”
paras.zh: 这部 1966 年的电影是应黑斯廷斯镇议会的要求，由当地电子公司老板艾伦·伍顿 (Alan Wootton) 和一个小型制作团队拍摄的，其中包括他 12 岁的儿子克里夫 (Cliff)。最近一次参观战斗修道院让他想起了父亲的镜头，克里夫与英国遗产协会合作，将 300 卷胶片变成了《卫报》的埃丝特·阿德利所说的“令人愉快的蒙蒂·派森式记录，记录了穿着假链甲的小伙子用假武器互相敲打对方的头部。”

paras.en: The real Battle of Hastings was fought by the armies of the English king Harold II and William the Conqueror, the duke of Normandy. William invaded England and confronted Harold on a hilltop less than ten miles outside Hastings. Harold was killed, alongside thousands of soldiers. William’s army emerged victorious and established the Normans as the rulers of England.
paras.zh: 真正的黑斯廷斯战役是由英国国王哈罗德二世和诺曼底公爵征服者威廉的军队进行的。威廉入侵英格兰，并在黑斯廷斯郊外不到十英里的山顶上与哈罗德对峙。哈罗德与数千名士兵一起被杀。威廉的军队取得胜利，诺曼人成为英格兰的统治者。

paras.en: The Bayeux Tapestry, embroidered shortly after the Battle of Hastings, depicts the events of the Norman Conquest of England. Usually housed in the Bayeux Museum in Normandy, France, it is on view at the British Museum in London until July 2027.
paras.zh: 黑斯廷斯战役后不久绣制的贝叶挂毯描绘了诺曼征服英格兰的事件。该作品通常收藏于法国诺曼底的贝叶博物馆，目前在伦敦大英博物馆展出至 2027 年 7 月。

paras.en: The 1966 re-enactment drew some 30,000 spectators. Most rooted against William and his Norman army, despite knowing how the battle turned out. The newly restored film also shows “soldiers on foot getting remarkably close to horses—and what can only be described as a rather relaxed attitude towards health and safety,” per a statement from English Heritage.
paras.zh: 1966 年的重演吸引了大约 30,000 名观众。尽管知道战斗的结果，但大多数人还是反对威廉和他的诺曼军队。根据英国遗产协会的一份声明，这部新修复的影片还展示了“步行的士兵与马匹的距离非常接近——这只能被描述为对健康和安全的一种相当放松的态度”。

paras.en: “There was actually a lot of real pushing and shoving, a lot of fighting going on in there,” Sampson tells the Guardian. “My friend John got a big whack around the head with the end of a [fake] spear, which hurt his face quite a lot.”
paras.zh: 桑普森告诉《卫报》：“实际上，那里发生了很多真正的推搡和打斗。” “我的朋友约翰的头被[假]矛的末端重击了一下，他的脸受了重伤。”

paras.en: English Heritage doesn’t have the names of those who participated in the 1966 spectacle, but officials are encouraging anyone involved to reach out. The charity hopes to host any interested re-enactors as special guests at this year’s event.
paras.zh: 英国遗产组织没有记录 1966 年这一盛事参与者的姓名，但官员们鼓励任何参与其中的人伸出援手。该慈善机构希望邀请任何感兴趣的重演者作为特邀嘉宾参加今年的活动。

paras.en: “This film is an incredible time capsule,” Battle Abbey site manager James Witcombe says in the statement. “It captures not only the first regular Battle of Hastings re-enactment but also the atmosphere of an event that continues, to this day, to bring history to life for thousands of people almost 1,000 years after the original battle.”
paras.zh: “这部电影是一个令人难以置信的时间胶囊，”战斗修道院现场经理詹姆斯·威特科姆在声明中说。 “它不仅捕捉到了第一次常规的黑斯廷斯之战的重演，而且还捕捉到了这一事件的气氛，这一事件一直持续到今天，在最初的战斗发生近 1000 年后，为成千上万的人再现了历史。”

articles.title: African Elephants Often Produce Choruses of Low-Pitched Rumbles. Now, Scientists Are Using A.I. to Decode the Joint Vocalizations

paras.en: Elephants communicate in a variety of different ways, from body language and gestures to their iconic trumpeting sounds. These massive creatures also emit low-pitched rumbles—some below the range of human hearing—which can travel long distances through the air and the ground. The rumbling often occurs together in choruses.
paras.zh: 大象以各种不同的方式进行交流，从肢体语言和手势到标志性的喇叭声。这些巨大的生物还会发出低音隆隆声（有些低于人类听觉范围），这些隆隆声可以通过空气和地面传播很长的距离。隆隆声经常在合唱中一起出现。

paras.en: Now, a study published October 1 in the journal Scientific Reports suggests that these joint vocalizations aren’t simply a jumble of elephants calling at the same time. Instead, they appear to serve as coordinated group messages and may contain additional information beyond what’s encoded in individual rumbles.
paras.zh: 现在，10 月 1 日发表在《科学报告》杂志上的一项研究表明，这些联合发声不仅仅是大象同时发出的混乱叫声。相反，它们似乎充当协调的群体消息，并且可能包含超出单个隆隆声编码的附加信息。

paras.en: In the study, scientists used a form of artificial intelligence called machine learning to analyze 902 recordings of rumbles made by wild African savanna elephant family groups in Amboseli National Park, Kenya. The audio, which included single and chorused rumbles, was collected between 1986 and 2022.
paras.zh: 在这项研究中，科学家们使用一种称为机器学习的人工智能形式来分析肯尼亚安博塞利国家公园野生非洲稀树草原大象家族发出的 902 段隆隆声录音。该音频包括单声隆隆声和合唱隆隆声，收集于 1986 年至 2022 年期间。

paras.en: The calls were made during six specific social contexts: “coo” rumbles from females to calves; “contact” rumbles between separated individuals; “let’s-go” rumbles to facilitate group movements; “cadenced” rumbles while eating, resting or moving slowly; “little-greeting” rumbles between closely bonded individuals; and “greeting” rumbles during reunions.
paras.zh: 这些叫声是在六种特定的社会背景下发出的：从雌性到小牛的“咕咕”隆隆声；分离个体之间的“接触”隆隆声； “let’s-go”的隆隆声促进群体移动；吃饭、休息或缓慢移动时发出“有节奏的”隆隆声；亲密的个体之间会发出“小小的问候”；以及团聚时的“问候”隆隆声。

paras.en: The algorithm predicted the elephants’ activities based on their rumbles better than chance, but it still made plenty of mistakes. Even so, “it is pretty exciting that we’re able to train a model to look at an entire chorus and have some interpretation of exactly what’s going on,” study co-author Sara Keen, a behavioral ecologist at the Earth Species Project, a nonprofit that aims to use A.I. to decode animal communication, tells Scientific American’s Jackie Flynn Mogensen.
paras.zh: 该算法根据大象的隆隆声预测大象的活动，比随机预测的效果更好，但它仍然犯了很多错误。即便如此，“令人兴奋的是，我们能够训练一个模型来观察整个合唱团，并对正在发生的事情做出一些解释”，该研究的合著者萨拉·基恩（Sara Keen）是地球物种项目的行为生态学家，该项目是一个旨在利用人工智能的非营利组织。解码动物通讯，《科学美国人》的杰基·弗林·摩根森告诉《科学美国人》。

paras.en: Overall, the study’s findings suggest that, like individual rumbles, choruses contain information about who is calling and what they’re doing. In some instances, choruses may provide “an additional layer of more fine-grained information” that can’t be gleaned from individual rumbles alone, the scientists write in the paper.
paras.zh: 总的来说，研究结果表明，就像个人的隆隆声一样，合唱包含有关谁在打电话以及他们在做什么的信息。科学家在论文中写道，在某些情况下，合唱可能会提供“一层额外的更细粒度的信息”，而这些信息无法单独从单独的隆隆声中收集到。

paras.en: For example, the analyses revealed that individual rumbles within choruses became more acoustically similar in certain situations. This phenomenon, known as “vocal convergence,” is like “what humans do in conversation, where you almost start to adopt the speaking patterns or accents of whoever you’re interacting with,” Keen tells New Scientist’s Christa Lesté-Lasserre.
paras.zh: 例如，分析表明，在某些情况下，合唱中的各个隆隆声在声学上变得更加相似。这种被称为“声音趋同”的现象就像“人类在谈话中所做的那样，你几乎开始采用与你互动的人的说话模式或口音，”基恩告诉《新科学家》杂志的克里斯塔·莱斯特-拉塞尔。

paras.en: Vocal convergence occurred only during the cadenced, contact and greeting rumbles, so the researchers think it might play some role in helping elephant families coordinate group behaviors. However, they say more research is needed to test this idea.
paras.zh: 声音趋同仅发生在有节奏、接触和问候的隆隆声中，因此研究人员认为这可能在帮助大象家庭协调群体行为方面发挥一定作用。然而，他们表示需要更多的研究来检验这个想法。

paras.en: Andrew McLean, an independent animal behavior researcher and member of the International Union for Conservation of Nature’s Asian Elephant Specialist Group, tells New Scientist the findings are “fascinating” but “not really surprising, given how intensely social elephants are.”
paras.zh: 独立动物行为研究员、国际自然保护联盟亚洲象专家组成员安德鲁·麦克莱恩 (Andrew McLean) 告诉《新科学家》杂志，这些发现“令人着迷”，但“鉴于大象的群居性如此强烈，这并不令人惊讶”。

paras.en: African savanna elephants aren’t the only animals whose sounds researchers are studying with the help of A.I. algorithms, which can find patterns and process vast amounts of information much faster than humans can. Scientists have also used these types of tools to identify mosquitoes’ species, sex and feeding status based on their noises; discover the sperm whale phonetic alphabet; learn that marmoset monkeys call one other by name; and decode the vocalizations of crows.
paras.zh: 非洲草原象并不是研究人员在人工智能的帮助下研究声音的唯一动物。算法，它可以比人类更快地发现模式并处理大量信息。科学家还使用这些类型的工具根据蚊子的噪音来识别蚊子的种类、性别和进食状况。发现抹香鲸的拼音字母；了解狨猴互相称呼对方的名字；并解码乌鸦的声音。

paras.en: “If it’s used responsibly, A.I. can transform what we can do with the data we collect,” Stephanie King, a behavioral biologist at the University of Bristol in England, tells the Guardian’s Amy Martin.
paras.zh: 英国布里斯托大学的行为生物学家斯蒂芬妮·金 (Stephanie King) 告诉《卫报》的艾米·马丁 (Amy Martin)：“如果使用得当，人工智能可以改变我们对收集到的数据的处理方式。”

articles.title: How This Tiny Startup Built the World’s Safest Bike Helmet
articles.author: Chris Haslam

paras.en: For decades, researchers judged cycling helmets on how well they protected against direct impacts. The US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC) still does, even though research shows the danger isn't just how hard your head hits the ground, but how violently it twists. That rotational movement can make the brain twist and stretch inside the skull, increasing the risk of concussion and other brain injuries.
paras.zh: 几十年来，研究人员根据骑行头盔抵御直接撞击的能力来评判骑行头盔。美国消费品安全委员会 (CPSC) 仍然这样做，尽管研究表明危险不仅在于头部撞击地面的力度，还在于头部扭转的剧烈程度。这种旋转运动会使大脑在颅骨内扭曲和伸展，增加脑震荡和其他脑损伤的风险。

paras.en: Not waiting for the CPSC to catch up, the cycling industry got to work. Multidirectional Impact Protection System, or MIPS, hit the market in 2007 and is now a common feature on premium helmets. At the same time, Virginia Tech turned helmet safety into something of a competition for manufacturers. In 2018, it launched helmet STAR ratings (Summation of Tests for the Analysis of Risk), testing beyond the legal minimum and measuring both linear and rotational impacts.
paras.zh: 没等美国消费品安全委员会迎头赶上，自行车行业就开始行动了。多向冲击保护系统 (MIPS) 于 2007 年上市，现已成为高级头盔的常见功能。与此同时，弗吉尼亚理工大学将头盔安全变成了制造商之间的竞争。 2018 年，它推出了头盔 STAR 评级（风险分析测试总结），测试超出了法定最低标准，并测量了线性和旋转影响。

paras.en: Only four of the first 30 helmets earned five stars, but by 2025, 167 of 272 achieved five stars, and Virginia Tech had to tighten its grading. That only drove competition and improved helmet technology. Suddenly, hitting the number one spot was good for business and brains.
paras.zh: 前 30 款头盔中只有 4 款获得了 5 颗星，但到 2025 年，272 款头盔中的 167 款获得了 5 颗星，弗吉尼亚理工大学不得不收紧评级。这只会推动竞争并改进头盔技术。突然间，登上第一名对生意和大脑都有好处。

paras.en: Sitting comfortably ahead of the competition, with a 4.61 score (10.1 or lower earns a five-star rating; lower is better), is the Pikio Si Oblik road cycling helmet, featuring a new safety system called Oblik. Inspired by the headbanging, concussion-proof woodpecker, this new design has wiped the floor with the competition. For context, Pikio's 4.61 score is 2.21 points lower than the previous best Canyon Deflectr’s 6.82. That’s about 32 percent lower, a massive shift when many of the highest-rated helmets score only between 7 and 10 points.
paras.zh: Pikio Si Oblik 公路自行车头盔的得分为 4.61（10.1 或更低为五星级；越低越好），在竞争中遥遥领先，它配备了名为 Oblik 的新型安全系统。受到撞头、防震荡啄木鸟的启发，这一新设计在竞争中一举击败了对手。就上下文而言，Pikio 的 4.61 分数比之前最好的 Canyon Deflectr 的 6.82 低了 2.21 分。这大约降低了 32%，当许多评分最高的头盔得分仅在 7 到 10 分之间时，这是一个巨大的转变。

paras.en: How has this relatively obscure Vancouver startup gotten it right the first time? As founder Daniel Abram explains, it “comes from 18 years researching impact protection and helmet design.” After studying mechanical engineering, he moved into helmet research at Simon Fraser University, where he helped develop BrainShield, a system designed to reduce rotational forces during impacts. He later founded helmet technology company BiaGuard, before MIPS paid around $1 million for the patents and intellectual property in 2022.
paras.zh: 这家相对默默无闻的温哥华初创公司是如何第一次就取得成功的呢？正如创始人 Daniel Abram 所解释的那样，它“来自 18 年对冲击保护和头盔设计的研究。”在学习机械工程后，他进入西蒙弗雷泽大学进行头盔研究，在那里他帮助开发了 BrainShield，这是一种旨在减少撞击过程中旋转力的系统。他后来创立了头盔技术公司 BiaGuard，之后 MIPS 于 2022 年支付了约 100 万美元购买专利和知识产权。

paras.en: Most bike helmets use a thin plastic shell over expanded polystyrene (EPS) foam, which crushes on impact to absorb energy before it reaches your skull. Oblik takes that familiar foam structure and breaks it into independently mounted sections rather than one continuous block.
paras.zh: 大多数自行车头盔在发泡聚苯乙烯 (EPS) 泡沫上使用薄塑料外壳，这种泡沫会在冲击力到达您的头骨之前将其压碎以吸收能量。 Oblik 采用了人们熟悉的泡沫结构，并将其分成独立安装的部分，而不是一个连续的块。

paras.en: Each section attaches to the base EPS layer with flexible connection points, allowing them to move separately or detach if the helmet takes a serious impact. Combined with dual-density foam that absorbs direct impact, the movement helps to minimize the twisting force transmitted to the head. Abram explained how, “Rather than compressing material in one direction, the system is able to deform, deflect, and detach depending on the impact's intensity, location, and direction, helping manage both linear and rotational impact energy.”
paras.zh: 每个部分都通过灵活的连接点连接到基础 EPS 层，允许它们单独移动或在头盔受到严重撞击时分离。结合吸收直接冲击力的双密度泡沫，运动有助于最大限度地减少传递到头部的扭转力。 Abram 解释道：“该系统不是沿一个方向压缩材料，而是能够根据冲击强度、位置和方向变形、偏转和分离，从而帮助管理线性和旋转冲击能量。”

paras.en: Other helmet technologies approach the problem very differently. The now-ubiquitous MIPS remains the dominant commercial system, using a low-friction layer that can move 10 to 15 millimeters during the first 5 to 10 milliseconds of an impact. MIPS Spherical uses two nested liners that rotate relative to each other, while 6D’s Omni-Directional Suspension (ODS) suspends one liner inside another. WaveCel uses an engineered cellular structure that flexes, crumples, and glides under angled impacts.
paras.zh: 其他头盔技术解决这个问题的方式非常不同。现在无处不在的 MIPS 仍然是占主导地位的商业系统，它使用低摩擦层，在撞击的前 5 到 10 毫秒内可以移动 10 到 15 毫米。 MIPS Spherical 使用两个相对旋转的嵌套衬垫，而 6D 的全向悬挂 (ODS) 将一个衬垫悬挂在另一个衬垫内。 WaveCel 采用工程蜂窝结构，可在有角度的冲击下弯曲、皱缩和滑动。

paras.en: Pikio's closest rival, the Release Layer System (RLS), featured on Canyon’s Deflectr and the third-placed, 3D-printed Hexr Miden RLS, tackles rotation from the outside, using external shell panels floating on tiny polycarbonate ball bearings that can roll and detach, redirecting rotational energy before it reaches the head.
paras.zh: Pikio 最接近的竞争对手，释放层系统 (RLS)，以 Canyon 的 Deflectr 和第三名的 3D 打印 Hexr Miden RLS 为特色，利用漂浮在微型聚碳酸酯滚珠轴承上的外壳面板来解决从外部的旋转问题，这些轴承可以滚动和分离，在旋转能量到达头部之前重新定向旋转能量。

paras.en: Lab testing is one thing, but real-world data is something else. If your Pikio helmet is called into serious action, you will need to replace it—as with most EPS foam designs—but the company is offering a 30 percent discount on a replacement if it can get its hands on your damaged helmet.
paras.zh: 实验室测试是一回事，但现实世界的数据是另一回事。如果您的 Pikio 头盔需要采取严重行动，您将需要更换它（与大多数 EPS 泡沫设计一样），但如果该公司能够获得您损坏的头盔，则可提供 30% 的更换折扣。

paras.en: “So far we’ve had four helmets returned and replaced,” Abram says. “Each has proven invaluable, not least because they’ve done their job and kept riders safe.”
paras.zh: “到目前为止，我们已经退回并更换了四顶头盔，”艾布拉姆说。 “事实证明，每一个都是无价的，尤其是因为他们完成了自己的工作并保证了乘客的安全。”

paras.en: At $379, the Pikio is a premium choice—a cool $219 more expensive than the second-best STAR-tested Canyon Deflectr RLS. Much of the cost stems from a vastly more complicated manufacturing process. Abram says a standard cycling helmet has around eight to 10 parts, but the Pikio Si uses around 80 individual components. The separate foam sections, intricately engineered flexible connection points, and dual-density construction all add to the cost.
paras.zh: Pikio 的售价为 379 美元，是一个优质选择，比经过 STAR 测试的第二好的 Canyon Deflectr RLS 贵了 219 美元。大部分成本源于更为复杂的制造工艺。 Abram 表示，标准骑行头盔大约有 8 到 10 个部件，但 Pikio Si 使用大约 80 个单独的部件。单独的泡沫部分、精心设计的柔性连接点和双密度结构都会增加成本。

paras.en: It’s a small price to pay if it saves your life, but how does it fare day to day? I’ve been riding with the Si Oblik for the past month and have been impressed by how few compromises there have been in the pursuit of protection.
paras.zh: 如果它能挽救你的生命，这只是一个小小的代价，但它每天的表现如何呢？过去一个月里，我一直在使用 Si Oblik 骑行，在追求保护的过程中几乎没有做出任何妥协，这给我留下了深刻的印象。

paras.en: At 279 grams (in medium size), it's respectably light, though not class-leading, and the dial-to-fit cradle hugs my head neatly without pinch points. It’s a little bulky for a road lid, but is extremely comfortable; the 17 air vents keep my head refreshingly cool, and nobody has laughed at me for wearing it (yet). I would have preferred Pikio to use a magnetic Fidlock fastening under the chin as they’re brilliant, but it is a minor complaint—which Abram quickly quashed: “Fidlock weighs around 13 grams; a buckle is just four grams.”
paras.zh: 它的重量为 279 克（中等尺寸），虽然不是同类产品中领先的，但相当轻，而且转盘式支架可以整齐地包裹住我的头，没有夹点。对于公路车盖来说，它有点笨重，但非常舒适； 17 个通风孔让我的头部保持凉爽，而且还没有人嘲笑我戴着它。我更希望 Pikio 在下巴下方使用磁性 Fidlock 扣件，因为它们非常出色，但这只是一个小抱怨，Abram 很快就消除了这个抱怨：“Fidlock 重约 13 克；带扣只有 4 克。”

paras.en: It’s a great helmet loaded with unique, deliberately safety-first tech. Abram was keen to point out he is not interested in what he called “crown-like cycle helmet” aesthetics, and that “form always follows function.” The Pikio lacks a little of the cool factor you’ll find with a POC or Giro helmet, but it’s certainly not ugly.
paras.zh: 这是一款很棒的头盔，配备了独特的、刻意安全第一的技术。艾布拉姆热衷于指出，他对他所谓的“皇冠般的自行车头盔”美学不感兴趣，并且“形式总是遵循功能”。 Pikio 缺乏一些 POC 或 Giro 头盔的酷炫元素，但它绝对不难看。

paras.en: For a company most cyclists have never heard of, taking the top spot at Virginia Tech is an extraordinary result. The harder part may be persuading people to trust an unknown name with something as consequential as head protection. MIPS faced a similar problem before turning an independent safety technology into something licensed across much of the helmet industry, and Oblik could conceivably follow the same path.
paras.zh: 对于一家大多数自行车手从未听说过的公司来说，在弗吉尼亚理工大学获得榜首是一个非凡的结果。更困难的部分可能是说服人们相信一个不知名的名字，以及像头部保护这样重要的东西。在将独立安全技术转变为头盔行业大部分许可的技术之前，MIPS 也面临着类似的问题，可以想象，Oblik 也可能会走同样的道路。

paras.en: Whether Pikio becomes a major helmet brand—a second design is due early in the new year—a technology supplier, or both remains to be seen. But for now, it has given the cycling industry a new number to chase.
paras.zh: Pikio 是否会成为主要头盔品牌（第二个设计将于新年年初推出）、技术供应商，还是两者兼而有之，还有待观察。但就目前而言，它给自行车行业带来了新的追逐数字。

articles.title: Humans Watched This Supernova Explode Nearly a Millennium Ago. Now You Can See It in High Definition
articles.author: Jorge Garay

paras.en: Astronomers have obtained the most detailed image to date of the Pa 30 nebula, the remnants of a supernova famous for having likely been observed and documented from Earth during the Middle Ages. Now, the new photograph reveals structures that had long gone unnoticed.
paras.zh: 天文学家获得了迄今为止最详细的 Pa 30 星云图像，这是一颗超新星的残余物，因可能在中世纪从地球上观测和记录而闻名。现在，这张新照片揭示了长期以来被忽视的结构。

paras.en: Previous images of the explosion’s remnants had also captured a sphere of long, filament-like strands of matter that collectively resemble fireworks or a dandelion. The new observations, made with the Gemini North telescope in Hawaii, revealed about 10 times more structures than any previous glimpses of the supernova remnant. With this resolution, researchers can now see that these filaments are not continuous as they had previously appeared. Instead, they’re shaped more like beads on a string, made up of pearl-like knots of gas of relatively uniform size.
paras.zh: 之前爆炸残留物的图像也捕捉到了一个由长丝状物质组成的球体，这些物质总体类似于烟花或蒲公英。夏威夷双子座北望远镜进行的新观测发现，所揭示的超新星遗迹结构比之前看到的超新星遗迹多出大约十倍。有了这个分辨率，研究人员现在可以看到这些细丝并不像以前那样连续。相反，它们的形状更像是串上的珠子，由大小相对均匀的珍珠状气体结组成。

paras.en: These “cosmic pearls” are, in fact, enormous. According to the study published in The Astrophysical Journal, each bead measures about four light-days in diameter. “The planetary region of our solar system could fit in each knot about 10 times with room to spare,” Ilaria Caiazzo, a coauthor of the study, said in a press release. “The knots are quite strikingly uniform. We are excited to try to model them.”
paras.zh: 事实上，这些“宇宙珍珠”是巨大的。根据发表在《天体物理学杂志》上的研究，每颗珠子的直径约为四光日。该研究的合著者伊拉里亚·卡亚佐（Ilaria Caiazzo）在一份新闻稿中表示：“我们太阳系的行星区域可以容纳每个结大约 10 次，并且还有剩余空间。” “这些结非常均匀。我们很高兴尝试对它们进行建模。”

paras.en: How exactly the pearls formed is not yet entirely clear, though it’s assumed they are concentrations of material ejected during the explosion. What’s strange, however, is their regularity. In the aftermath of a supernova, astronomers expected to find much more oddly shaped accumulations, but the knots are similar in size and appear aligned along the filaments. This peculiar order is a new feature that could help researchers gain a deeper understanding of stellar death.
paras.zh: 珍珠究竟是如何形成的尚不完全清楚，尽管人们假设它们是爆炸过程中喷射出的物质的浓缩物。然而，奇怪的是它们的规律性。在超新星爆发后，天文学家预计会发现更多形状奇怪的堆积物，但这些结的大小相似，并且看起来沿着细丝排列。这种奇特的顺序是一个新特征，可以帮助研究人员更深入地了解恒星的死亡。

paras.en: The Pa 30 nebula is also particularly unusual because the central star isn’t exactly dead. Instead, it’s considered a “zombie star.” Typically, a thermonuclear supernova is the violent death of a star, which is completely destroyed in the explosion. But in rare cases, part of the star may survive, and scientists do not yet fully understand how or why this happens. The unusual structures of Pa 30 could help astronomers reconstruct more precisely how these kinds of detonations occur and how zombie stars can live on afterward.
paras.zh: Pa 30 星云也特别不寻常，因为中心恒星并没有完全死亡。相反，它被认为是“僵尸明星”。通常，热核超新星是恒星的剧烈死亡，在爆炸中被完全摧毁。但在极少数情况下，恒星的一部分可能会幸存下来，而科学家们尚未完全了解这种情况是如何或为何发生的。 Pa 30 的不寻常结构可以帮助天文学家更精确地重建此类爆炸是如何发生的以及僵尸恒星随后如何继续存在。

paras.en: All of this has been discovered because scientists seem to have a bit of a crush on Pa 30. Few astronomical structures connect modern observation so directly with human accounts from more than eight centuries ago. The nebula matches the records left by Chinese and Japanese astronomers in 1181, who described the appearance of a new star in the sky that remained visible for several months. At the time, it was impossible to know that they were witnessing the aftermath of a massive stellar explosion. Centuries later, scientists linked that event to the supernova that gave rise to Pa 30.
paras.zh: 所有这些之所以被发现，是因为科学家们似乎对 Pa 30 有一点迷恋。很少有天文结构能够将现代观测与八个多世纪前的人类记录如此直接地联系起来。该星云与中国和日本天文学家在 1181 年留下的记录相符，他们描述了天空中出现了一颗新恒星，并且该恒星在几个月内仍然可见。当时，不可能知道他们正在目睹大规模恒星爆炸的后果。几个世纪后，科学家将这一事件与产生 Pa 30 的超新星联系起来。

paras.en: This story originally appeared on WIRED en Español and has been translated from Spanish.
paras.zh: 这个故事最初出现在《连线》西班牙语版上，并由西班牙语翻译而来。

articles.title: Pentagon updates U.S. death toll of Iran war to 21

paras.en: Oct. 10 (UPI) -- The Pentagon on Friday updated the death toll of those killed during the Iran war to 21.
paras.zh: 10月10日（合众社）——五角大楼周五更新了伊朗战争期间的死亡人数至21人。

paras.en: Two noncombatant deaths were added to the Pentagon's Defense Casualty Analysis System on Friday, which had previously reported 19 deaths. At least 865 service members have been injured.
paras.zh: 周五，五角大楼国防伤亡分析系统新增了 2 例非战斗人员死亡事件，此前该系统报告了 19 例死亡事件。至少 865 名军人受伤。

paras.en: One was Maj. Sorffly Davius, 46, of the Army National Guard, who died in Kuwait on March 6, The Washington Post reported. The other was an unidentified Navy servicemember who died by suicide in September.
paras.zh: 据《华盛顿邮报》报道，其中一位是 46 岁的陆军国民警卫队少校索夫莱·戴维斯 (Sorffly Davius)，他于 3 月 6 日在科威特去世。另一名身份不明的海军军人于九月自杀身亡。

paras.en: Casualties for the war are divided in two categories, one for Operation Epic Fury and another for the conflict since July.
paras.zh: 战争造成的伤亡分为两类，一类是史诗愤怒行动造成的，另一类则是七月份以来的冲突造成的。

paras.en: In the first category, which began with U.S.-Israeli strikes on Iran on Feb. 28, 15 service members were killed and 417 wounded.
paras.zh: 第一类战争始于 2 月 28 日美国和以色列对伊朗的袭击，造成 15 名军人死亡、417 人受伤。

paras.en: Since July 7, six troops were killed and 448 wounded.
paras.zh: 自7月7日以来，已有6名士兵死亡、448人受伤。

paras.en: The revelation comes after The Washington Post reported that the Iran war death toll was higher than the Pentagon was reporting to the public.
paras.zh: 此前，《华盛顿邮报》报道称，伊朗战争死亡人数高于五角大楼向公众报告的数字。

paras.en: At the time, Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth called the report a fabrication.
paras.zh: 当时，国防部长皮特·赫格斯称该报告纯属捏造。

paras.en: "This is DISGUSTING and FAKE," Hegseth wrote in a statement on X. "A complete LIE."
paras.zh: 赫格斯在 X 上的一份声明中写道：“这是令人厌恶和虚假的。完全是谎言。”

paras.en: In a statement, the Pentagon told The Post it "continues to maintain a steadfast commitment to the transparent, accurate accounting of all Service member casualties."
paras.zh: 五角大楼在一份声明中告诉《华盛顿邮报》，它“继续坚定地致力于透明、准确地统计所有军人伤亡情况”。

paras.en: "There is no excuse for a mistake of this magnitude," said Reps. Adam Smith, D-Wash., and Chrissy Houlahann, D-Penn., in a statement. "While we take seriously our duty to serve as the voice of the American people and hold the executive branch accountable as a co-equal branch of government, requiring Congress to step in to rectify such an egregious error is an embarrassment for the Department.
paras.zh: 华盛顿州民主党众议员亚当·史密斯（Adam Smith）和宾夕法尼亚州民主党众议员克丽丝·胡拉汉（Chrissy Houulahann）在一份声明中表示：“如此严重的错误是没有任何借口的。” “虽然我们认真履行作为美国人民的代言人的职责，并要求行政部门作为平等的政府部门承担责任，但要求国会介入纠正这种严重错误对国务院来说是一种尴尬。

paras.en: "The failure of Secretary Hegseth to immediately take ownership of the problem also does a grave disservice to the men and women putting their lives on the line in service to our country."
paras.zh: “赫格塞斯国务卿未能立即解决这个问题，这也对那些冒着生命危险为我们国家服务的男男女女造成了严重伤害。”

articles.title: 12 killed, 300 injured in Houthi attack on Saudi airport

paras.en: Oct. 10 (UPI) -- At least 12 people were killed and more than 300 injured Saturday in a major strike on Saudi Arabia's international airport in Riyadh.
paras.zh: 10 月 10 日（UPI）——星期六，沙特阿拉伯利雅得国际机场发生重大袭击，造成至少 12 人死亡、300 多人受伤。

paras.en: The Iran-backed Houthi militia claimed responsibility for the attack, which was the largest in a Gulf Arab country since the start of the war in Iran, The New York Times reported.
paras.zh: 据《纽约时报》报道，伊朗支持的胡塞民兵声称对此次袭击负责，这是自伊朗战争爆发以来海湾阿拉伯国家发生的最大规模袭击。

paras.en: The death toll at King Khalid International Airport included four Saudi nationals and one U.S. citizen, authorities said. Some of the 309 people injured were in critical condition.
paras.zh: 当局称，哈立德国王国际机场的死亡人数包括四名沙特公民和一名美国公民。 309名伤者中，部分人情况危急。

paras.en: Mohammed al-Bukhaiti, a senior Houthi official, told The Times the attack was in retaliation for Saudi strikes in Yemen.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装高级官员穆罕默德·布海蒂告诉《泰晤士报》，这次袭击是为了报复沙特在也门发动的袭击。

paras.en: The official told The Times the attack was launched "so that the world understands that airports, seaports, wedding and mourning halls, hospitals, and markets in Yemen are civilian facilities that must not be targeted or harmed -- and that the same rules that apply to these facilities in Yemen must also apply to their counterparts everywhere else."
paras.zh: 这位官员告诉《泰晤士报》，发动这次袭击“是为了让全世界明白，也门的机场、海港、婚礼和灵堂、医院和市场都是民用设施，不得成为攻击目标或受到伤害——适用于也门这些设施的规则也必须适用于其他地方的同类设施。”

paras.en: April Longley Alley, a senior fellow at the Washington Institute, said the escalating conflict between the Houthis and Saudi Arabia is a major challenge for President Donald Trump.
paras.zh: 华盛顿研究所高级研究员阿普里尔·朗利·艾利表示，胡塞武装和沙特阿拉伯之间不断升级的冲突对唐纳德·特朗普总统来说是一个重大挑战。

paras.en: "The Trump administration wanted to limit the conflict as much as possible, and to keep the lid on it," she told The Washington Post. "But the lid is popping off already."
paras.zh: “特朗普政府希望尽可能限制冲突，并控制住冲突，”她告诉《华盛顿邮报》。 “但盖子已经打开了。”

paras.en: Trump said he is yet to decide on whether the United States would join Saudi Arabia in its conflict with the Houthis.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，他尚未决定美国是否会加入沙特阿拉伯与胡塞武装的冲突。

paras.en: "We may," the president told The Post. "We're going to look at it."
paras.zh: “我们可能会，”总统告诉《华盛顿邮报》。 “我们会看看。”

paras.en: The attack came a day after another Houthi strike on the Riyadh airport killed three Saudi citizens.
paras.zh: 此次袭击发生前一天，胡塞武装对利雅得机场发动袭击，造成三名沙特公民死亡。

paras.en: The militia also claimed responsibility for attacks on infrastructure in Saudi Arabia's south, including an airport in Najran and an airbase near Khamis Mushait.
paras.zh: 该民兵还声称对沙特阿拉伯南部基础设施的袭击负责，其中包括纳季兰的一个机场和海米斯穆谢特附近的一个空军基地。

articles.title: Criticized on Russia diesel deal, Trump says Ukraine needs new leader

paras.en: Oct. 10 (UPI) -- President Donald Trump on Saturday said "it's time for Ukraine to get a new president" after Volodymyr Zelensky criticized a U.S. deal easing sanctions on the purchase of diesel fuel from Russia.
paras.zh: 10 月 10 日（UPI）——在弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基批评美国放松对从俄罗斯购买柴油的制裁的协议后，唐纳德·特朗普总统周六表示，“乌克兰是时候选出一位新总统了”。

paras.en: A day earlier, Trump said Russian President Vladimir Putin would supply diesel to ease global markets -- and the Treasury Department would allow the exports despite existing U.S. sanctions.
paras.zh: 一天前，特朗普表示，俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京将供应柴油以缓解全球市场压力，尽管美国现有制裁，但美国财政部仍将允许出口。

paras.en: Zelensky said "gifts to Putin will not bring peace" and doubled down on his criticism on Saturday.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基表示“给普京的礼物不会带来和平”，并在周六加大了批评力度。

paras.en: "Today, Russia expressed its thanks for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia," Zelensky wrote in a statement on X. "As of now, sadly, twelve people have been confirmed killed, including three children."
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在 X 的一份声明中写道：“今天，俄罗斯向扎波罗热的住宅楼投掷了五枚滑翔炸弹，对取消柴油出口制裁表示感谢。”“遗憾的是，截至目前，已确认有 12 人死亡，其中包括 3 名儿童。”

paras.en: The Ukrainian president said 13 of the country's regions came under attack, damaging residential buildings, infrastructure and railway facilities.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统表示，该国 13 个地区遭到袭击，住宅建筑、基础设施和铁路设施遭到破坏。

paras.en: "Last night confirmed once again that in Russia, they take any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting, to mean they can keep dropping bombs on cities," Zelensky added. "Different signals are needed. Russia must understand that it needs to stop the war, and for that to happen, Russia must feel its losses."
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基补充道：“昨晚再次证实，在俄罗斯，他们认为任何压力的缓解都意味着他们可以继续战斗，意味着他们可以继续向城市投掷炸弹。” “需要不同的信号。俄罗斯必须明白，它需要停止战争，要做到这一点，俄罗斯必须感受到自己的损失。”

paras.en: Trump said Zelensky has not done enough to achieve peace in the more than four years since Russia invaded its territory.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示，自俄罗斯入侵其领土四年多以来，泽连斯基在实现和平方面做得还不够。

paras.en: "I suggest they get a new leader who can make a deal because he could have made many deals and for some reason he never does," Trump said.
paras.zh: 特朗普表示：“我建议他们找一位能够达成协议的新领导人，因为他本可以达成很多协议，但出于某种原因他从未这样做。”

paras.en: The president added that Zelensky "wants to make problems for the world" and "he'd better damn well stop."
paras.zh: 总统补充说，泽伦斯基“想给世界制造问题”，“他最好停止”。

paras.en: Trump signed new sanctions legislation targeting Russia's energy sector last month, including measures against Russian banks, officials and oil tankers used to circumvent international restrictions.
paras.zh: 特朗普上个月签署了针对俄罗斯能源部门的新制裁法案，包括针对俄罗斯银行、官员和用于规避国际限制的油轮的措施。

paras.en: The agreement announced Friday comes as diesel prices have surged amid the ongoing war in Iran, which has disrupted global oil supplies and shipping through the Strait of Hormuz.
paras.zh: 该协议于周五宣布之际，正值伊朗持续战争导致柴油价格飙升之际，这场战争扰乱了全球石油供应和霍尔木兹海峡的运输。

paras.en: The price of diesel has climbed nearly 70% since the start of the Iran war in February. The national average price for diesel was about $6.28 per gallon Saturday, according to AAA.
paras.zh: 自2月份伊朗战争爆发以来，柴油价格已上涨近70%。据 AAA 称，周六全国柴油平均价格约为每加仑 6.28 美元。

articles.title: Geordie Greep Responds to Sexual Misconduct Allegation, Cancels Tour Dates
articles.author: Mitchell Peters

paras.en: Geordie Greep is responding to sexual misconduct allegations made against him.
paras.zh: 乔迪·格里普正在回应针对他的性行为不当指控。

paras.en: During his show in Vancouver on Thursday (Oct. 8), the former Black Midi frontman addressed accusations of rape after an individual outside the Pearl venue distributed flyers to concertgoers accusing him of sexual assault.
paras.zh: 周四（10 月 8 日）在温哥华举行的演出中，这位前 Black Midi 主唱在珍珠场馆外向音乐会观众分发传单，指控他性侵犯后，对强奸指控进行了回应。

paras.en: The flyers read, “Geordie Greep A Rapist. You know what you did this morning Oct 8th. He thinks he can do what he wants. Let Him Know What Vancouver Thinks of Rapists.”
paras.zh: 传单上写着：“乔迪·格里普是一个强奸犯。你知道10月8日早上你做了什么。他认为他可以做他想做的事。让他知道温哥华对强奸犯的看法。”

paras.en: Greep took the stage about an hour later than scheduled and performed without his backing band, addressing the flyers distributed outside the venue.
paras.zh: 格里普比原定时间晚了大约一个小时登台，在没有伴奏乐队的情况下进行了表演，并向会场外​​分发的传单发表了讲话。

paras.en: “Essentially what happened last night, me and some of the band we went out to some bars, we went around, we met people, and it ended up in a situation where really late at a house party, I got the wrong end of the stick with someone who was there, and I made a move, and it didn’t come off,” Greep told the audience.
paras.zh: 格里普告诉观众：“基本上就是昨晚发生的事情，我和乐队的一些成员去了一些酒吧，我们四处走动，遇到了一些人，最后的情况是在一个家庭聚会上很晚了，我和在场的一个人搞错了，我采取了行动，但没有成功。”

paras.en: “I really quickly, of course, apologized, and it was a complete misunderstanding on my part. I felt extremely bad, I feel extremely sorry, and extremely upset about the whole situation. I would never rape a woman. I’m not a rapist. It’s not how that went down.”
paras.zh: “当然，我很快就道歉了，这完全是我的误解。我感到非常难过，我感到非常抱歉，对整个情况感到非常不安。我永远不会强奸一个女人。我不是强奸犯。事情不是这样发生的。”

paras.en: Greep said he would perform the Vancouver concert solo because he “didn’t want to force them to still play a show in the light of that happening.” He also noted that proceeds from the show would be donated to an anti-violence organization in British Columbia.
paras.zh: 格里普表示，他将在温哥华举行独奏音乐会，因为他“不想强迫他们在发生这种情况的情况下继续演出。”他还指出，演出收益将捐赠给不列颠哥伦比亚省的一个反暴力组织。

paras.en: “We were unsure what the response would be to all this, and I can only tell you that it’s okay if people want refunds, if they want to leave, it’s fine,” Greep continued. “I just wanted to be transparent with you about what happened. I’m very, very, very sorry. I made someone uncomfortable without meaning to. It’s not a good thing, it’s not good.”
paras.zh: “我们不确定对这一切会有什么反应，我只能告诉你，如果人们想要退款，那没关系，如果他们想离开，也没关系，”格里普继续说道。 “我只是想向你们坦白发生的事情。我非常、非常、非常抱歉。我无意中让某人感到不舒服。这不是一件好事，这不好。”

paras.en: Billboard has reached out to Greep’s representatives for further comment.
paras.zh: Billboard 已联系 Greep 的代表以征求进一步评论。

paras.en: Following the allegations, Greep canceled several dates on his current North American tour, including shows in Boise, Idaho, on Friday (Oct. 9), and Salt Lake City, Utah, on Saturday (Oct. 10). He also canceled upcoming concerts scheduled in Boulder and Denver, Colorado.
paras.zh: 受到指控后，格里普取消了当前北美巡演的多个日期，包括周五（10 月 9 日）在爱达荷州博伊西和周六（10 月 10 日）在犹他州盐湖城的演出。他还取消了原定在科罗拉多州博尔德和丹佛举行的音乐会。

paras.en: The final two dates of Greep’s North American tour, scheduled for Des Moines, Iowa, and Omaha, Nebraska, had not been canceled at press time.
paras.zh: 格里普北美巡演的最后两个日期（原定于爱荷华州得梅因和内布拉斯加州奥马哈）截至发稿时尚未取消。

paras.en: Greep is also scheduled to embark on a European tour beginning Nov. 1 in the Netherlands, followed by shows in France, Spain and Portugal.
paras.zh: Greep 还计划于 11 月 1 日在荷兰开始欧洲巡演，随后在法国、西班牙和葡萄牙进行演出。

articles.title: ‘Golden’ Is Still Golden, Wins Best Song at 2026 World Soundtrack Awards (Full Winners List)
articles.author: Paul Grein

paras.en: “Golden” from KPop Demon Hunters is still picking up awards. The global smash, which won a Golden Globe, a Grammy and an Oscar last winter, among many other awards, won best original song at the 2026 World Soundtrack Awards, which were held on Saturday (Oct. 10) at the annual WSA Ceremony & Concert during Film Fest Gent, Belgium’s biggest international film festival.
paras.zh: KPop Demon Hunters 的《Golden》仍在获奖。这首全球热门歌曲于去年冬天赢得了金球奖、格莱美奖和奥斯卡奖等多项奖项，并在周六（10 月 10 日）比利时最大的国际电影节根特电影节期间举行的年度 WSA 颁奖典礼和音乐会上举行的 2026 年世界原声带奖上获得了最佳原创歌曲奖。

paras.en: The song, which was written by Kim Eun-jae, Mark Sonnenblick, Joong Gyu Kwak, Yu Han Lee, Hee Dong Nam, Jeong Hoon Seo and Teddy Park and performed by HUNTR/X: EJAE, Audrey Nuna & REI AMI, topped the Billboard Hot 100 for eight weeks.
paras.zh: 这首歌曲由 Kim Eun-jae、Mark Sonnenblick、Joong Gyu Kwak、Yu Han Lee、Hee Dong Nam、Jeong Hoon Seo 和 Teddy Park 创作，由 HUNTR/X: EJAE、Audrey Nuna 和 REI AMI 演唱，连续八​​周位居 Billboard Hot 100 榜首。

paras.en: British composer Daniel Pemberton was named film composer of the year for Project Hail Mary, The Drama, The Bad Guys 2 and Masters of the Universe.
paras.zh: 英国作曲家丹尼尔·彭伯顿凭借《万福玛丽计划》、《戏剧》、《坏人 2》和《宇宙大师》被评为年度电影作曲家。

paras.en: The television composer of the year award was presented to Jeff Russo for Alien: Earth, Cape Fear and Citadel (Season 2).
paras.zh: 年度电视作曲家奖颁给了杰夫·罗素 (Jeff Russo) 的《异形：地球》、《开普恐惧》和《堡垒》（第二季）。

paras.en: Hannah Peel took home the award for discovery of the year, while the public choice award went to Kevin Smithers’ score for Soy Frankelda.
paras.zh: 汉娜·皮尔 (Hannah Peel) 荣获年度发现奖，而公众选择奖则颁给了凯文·史密瑟斯 (Kevin Smithers) 为《大豆弗兰克尔达》 (Soy Frankelda) 创作的配乐。

paras.en: For three days, international film and film music professionals gathered in Music Centre De Bijloke in the historic heart of Ghent for talks, workshops and masterclasses about the art of composing film music. The last day concluded with the award ceremony and a live concert with selected music by WSA guest of honour Hildur Guðnadóttir and lifetime achievement award recipient Trevor Jones, performed by Brussels Philharmonic and conducted by Dirk Brossé.
paras.zh: 为期三天，国际电影和电影音乐专业人士齐聚根特历史中心的德比洛克音乐中心，参加有关电影音乐创作艺术的讲座、研讨会和大师班。最后一天以颁奖典礼和现场音乐会结束，音乐会由 WSA 特邀嘉宾 Hildur Guðnadóttir 和终身成就奖获得者 Trevor Jones 演奏，由布鲁塞尔爱乐乐团演奏，Dirk Brossé 指挥。

paras.en: Here’s a complete list of winners at the 2026 World Soundtrack Awards.
paras.zh: 以下是 2026 年世界原声带奖的完整获奖者名单。

articles.title: Barry Manilow Walks Off Stage, Cancels Vegas Shows Due to Bronchitis
articles.author: Jessica Lynch

paras.en: Barry Manilow has cut short his return to Las Vegas, walking offstage two songs into a show and canceling a pair of concerts after coming down with bronchitis.
paras.zh: 巴里·马尼洛(Barry Manilow)缩短了返回拉斯维加斯的时间，在一场演出中将两首歌走下舞台，并在患上支气管炎后取消了两场音乐会。

paras.en: The 83-year-old had only just returned to the International Theater at the Westgate Las Vegas Resort & Casino on Thursday (Oct. 8), in what his team called a “triumphant welcome-back concert” following a weeks-long break. But at Friday’s show, he stopped after two songs — reportedly telling the crowd, “Talk amongst yourselves” — and didn’t come back.
paras.zh: 周四（10 月 8 日），这位 83 岁的老人刚刚回到拉斯维加斯西门赌场度假村的国际剧院，在长达一周的休息后，他的团队称这是一场“凯旋的欢迎回来音乐会”。但在周五的演出中，他在唱完两首歌后就停了下来——据报道他告诉观众“你们自己说话”——然后就没有回来。

paras.en: According to Vital Vegas, his band played instrumentals before a voice came over the PA to announce the show was over, and attendees said they later received refund emails from Ticketmaster. Saturday’s concert was called off entirely.
paras.zh: 据 Vital Vegas 报道，他的乐队演奏了乐器，然后扩音器传来了宣布演出结束的声音，与会者表示，他们后来收到了来自 Ticketmaster 的退款电子邮件。周六的音乐会完全取消。

paras.en: “After a triumphant welcome-back concert on Thursday, Barry got hit with bronchitis and had to cancel his Friday and Saturday shows,” a representative for the musician and the venue told Variety.
paras.zh: “周四一场胜利的欢迎回来音乐会后，巴里患上了支气管炎，不得不取消周五和周六的演出，”这位音乐家和场地的代表告诉《综艺》杂志。

paras.en: The illness carries particular significance for Manilow. He disclosed in December 2025 that he had been diagnosed with early-stage lung cancer, discovered after doctors ordered scans while he was recovering from a bout of bronchitis; he subsequently underwent surgery.
paras.zh: 这种疾病对曼尼洛来说具有特殊的意义。 2025 年 12 月，他透露自己被诊断出患有早期肺癌，这是在他从支气管炎康复期间医生要求进行扫描后发现的；他随后接受了手术。

paras.en: The health issues repeatedly postponed his Westgate residency, originally set to begin in February, before he returned to the stage in the U.K. and resumed Vegas dates in July. In late August, he announced another break after a demanding summer run, saying “we were pushing a little too hard.” His team has not said whether upcoming dates — the residency is listed to continue Oct. 15 — will be affected.
paras.zh: 由于健康问题，他原定于二月开始的西门驻场演出一再推迟，随后他回到英国舞台，并于七月恢复拉斯维加斯演出。八月下旬，在经历了艰苦的夏季跑步后，他宣布再次休息，并表示“我们有点太努力了。”他的团队尚未透露即将到来的日期（该实习计划将于 10 月 15 日继续）是否会受到影响。

paras.en: One of the most successful recording artists of all time, Manilow has sold more than 85 million records worldwide. He scored his first Billboard Hot 100 No. 1 with “Mandy” in 1975 and went on to land three chart-toppers, including “I Write the Songs” and “Looks Like We Made It,” along with a long run of adult-contemporary staples such as “Copacabana (At the Copa)” and “Can’t Smile Without You.”
paras.zh: 作为有史以来最成功的唱片艺术家之一，马尼洛已在全球售出超过 8500 万张唱片。 1975 年，他凭借《Mandy》首次登上 Billboard Hot 100 排行榜第一名，随后又登上了三首排行榜冠军，包括《I Write the Songs》和《Looks Like We Made It》，以及一系列成人当代主打歌曲，如《Copacabana (At the Copa)》和《Can't Smile Without You》。

paras.en: He has charted more than a dozen top-40 Hot 100 hits and remains a fixture on Billboard’s Adult Contemporary chart, where his 2026 single “Once Before I Go” reached the top 10. Manilow’s Westgate residency has made him one of Las Vegas’ most enduring headliners, with his tally of shows at the venue surpassing Elvis Presley’s record.
paras.zh: 他已经有十多首热门单曲进入前 40 名，并且仍然稳居 Billboard 成人当代排行榜的常客，他 2026 年的单曲“Once Before I Go”进入了前十名。曼尼洛在 Westgate 的演出使他成为拉斯维加斯最经久不衰的头条人物之一，他在该场馆的演出次数超过了猫王埃尔维斯·普雷斯利 (Elvis Presley) 的纪录。

articles.title: ‘SNL’: Shane Gillis Shares “Gas Station Egg” Nickname From Joe Rogan, Pete Hegseth Celebrates USS Lincoln San Diego Homecoming
articles.author: McKinley Franklin

paras.en: Shane Gillis returned for his third Saturday Night Live hosting stint, where he revealed the nickname Joe Rogan and Theo Von came up for him (“gas station egg”) and his gripes with his “Adolf Hitler haircut.”
paras.zh: 肖恩·吉利斯第三次回归《周六夜现场》主持，他透露了乔·罗根和西奥·冯为他取的绰号（“加油站蛋”），以及他对“阿道夫·希特勒发型”的不满。

paras.en: The comedian started his monologue by talking about how he wanted to lose weight: “I gotta lose weight. It’s a bummer, you know what I mean? When you finally get so fat, you’re like, alright, hit that fat rock bottom.”
paras.zh: 这位喜剧演员开始了他的独白，讲述了他如何想减肥：“我必须减肥。这太糟糕了，你知道我的意思吗？当你最终变得这么胖时，你就像，好吧，跌到了肥胖的谷底。”

paras.en: Gillis shared a story about how hiking wasn’t for him, and then explained his contention with public gyms. “Going to the public gym as a fat guy, especially in New York, is a nightmare, dude. It’s just the hottest gay guys you’ve ever seen. They’re jacked and they look at me, like, ‘Yeah, right.’ ‘I know, dude,’” he said.
paras.zh: 吉利斯分享了一个关于徒步旅行不适合他的故事，然后解释了他与公共健身房的争论。 “作为一个胖子去公共健身房，尤其是在纽约，简直是一场噩梦，伙计。那是你见过的最性感的同性恋者。他们很兴奋，他们看着我，就像，‘是的，对的。’‘我知道，伙计，’”他说。

paras.en: “Also, I haven’t been to the gym in so long, I didn’t know women just dress like whores now,” Gillis said. “Look, I’m sorry, there’s no other way to describe. Have you seen it? I’ve seen it. You’ve seen the shorts? They’re those neon, like, artificial vape-colored [shorts], and the wrinkles go around the cheeks and all combine at the butthole. And don’t look, you’re not allowed to look!”
paras.zh: “而且，我已经很久没去过健身房了，我不知道现在女人都穿得像妓女，”吉利斯说。 “你看，对不起，没有其他方式可以形容。你看过吗？我看过。你看过短裤吗？它们是那种霓虹灯般的人造电子烟色[短裤]，皱纹绕着脸颊延伸，并在屁眼处融合在一起。别看，你不被允许看！”

paras.en: Gillis then raved about Rogan’s own gym that is equipped with a sauna. He said, “The other day I was in the sauna, I’m sitting there, I’m by myself, no one’s around, so I figured I’ll get comfortable. I take my shirt off, I’m in my underwear. About five minutes in, there’s a knock on the glass door of the sauna that scared me. I thought I was alone. I look over and it was Theo Von and Joe, and they opened the door, and Joe just goes, ‘Hey, Theo said you looked like a gas station egg.'”
paras.zh: 吉利斯随后对罗根自己配备桑拿浴室的健身房赞不绝口。他说，“有一天我在桑拿房里，我坐在那里，我一个人，周围没有人，所以我想我会舒服点。我脱掉衬衫，穿着内衣。大约五分钟后，桑拿房的玻璃门被敲响，吓了我一跳。我以为我独自一人。我一看，是西奥·冯和乔，他们打开了门，乔就走了，‘嘿，西奥说你看起来像个气体站蛋。”

paras.en: “The thing that hurt the most was when he closed the glass door, I saw my own reflection and I looked exactly like a gas station egg,” he added. “That’s one of the meanest things anyone’s told me: ‘You look like a wet, bagged, hard boiled egg.'”
paras.zh: “最让人伤心的是，当他关上玻璃门时，我看到了自己的倒影，我看起来就像加油站的鸡蛋，”他补充道。 “这是任何人告诉我的最卑鄙的事情之一：‘你看起来就像一个湿漉漉的、装袋的、煮熟的鸡蛋。’”

paras.en: Gillis said he was used to receiving insults growing up having two older sisters, who he called “big, fat-bitch sisters.” He went on to note that “the thing that I’m really bothered by is I’ve balded directly into an Adolf Hitler haircut.”
paras.zh: 吉利斯说，他在成长过程中已经习惯了在有两个姐姐的过程中受到侮辱，他称她们为“又大又胖的姐姐”。他接着指出，“真正让我烦恼的是我直接秃顶成了阿道夫·希特勒的发型。”

paras.en: He added, “And it’s not good, because I give a lot of speeches and the front falls down a lot, and there’s no way to adjust it without looking exactly like [Hitler]. It’s the only way. I’m not going to [move it], that’s gay. That’s it: You’re either gay or you’re Hitler, and isn’t that where we’re at as a country?”
paras.zh: 他补充道，“这不好，因为我做了很多演讲，前面掉了很多，如果不看起来完全像[希特勒]，就没有办法调整它。这是唯一的方法。我不会[移动它]，那是同性恋。就是这样：你要么是同性恋，要么就是希特勒，这不是我们作为一个国家所处的处境吗？”

paras.en: Later in the episode, Gillis accidentally said the F-word live on-air during a Dr. Seuss sketch where his character was stressing that his father didn’t want to eat green eggs and ham. “Bro, it’s a non-starter. He said he doesn’t fucking,” Gillis said, catching himself swiftly, continuing, “Jeez! Like ’em.”
paras.zh: 在这一集中，吉利斯在苏斯博士的短剧现场直播中无意中说出了脏话，他的角色强调他的父亲不想吃绿鸡蛋和火腿。 “兄弟，这是不可能的。他说他不会做爱，”吉利斯说，很快就控制住了自己，继续说道，“天啊！就像他们一样。”

paras.en: At the end of the night, the comedian seemingly apologized for the slip-up. “Sorry about earlier,” Gillis said during his final remarks to close out the show.
paras.zh: 当晚结束时，这位喜剧演员似乎为自己的失误道歉。 “对之前的事情感到抱歉，”吉利斯在结束演出的最后讲话中说道。

paras.en: SNL’s cold open got the episode started with a greeting from Colin Jost’s Pete Hegseth welcoming the USS Abraham Lincoln home after being deployed for over 300 days.
paras.zh: 《周六夜现场》的冷开场以科林·乔斯特 (Colin Jost) 的皮特·赫格斯 (Pete Hegseth) 的问候开始了这一集，他欢迎亚伯拉罕·林肯号航空母舰在部署 300 多天后回家。
