paras.zh: 科学家建造了一个能够自我稳定的核时钟

paras.en: "What you really want is a self-stabilizing nuclear clock," explains Prof. Thorsten Schumm. "The basic idea is simple: you have a laser and you have thorium. The laser changes the energy state of the thorium nuclei, and the thorium nuclei are used to stabilize the frequency of the laser."
paras.zh: “你真正想要的是一个自稳定核钟，”托尔斯滕·舒姆教授解释道。 “基本思想很简单：你有激光，有钍。激光改变钍原子核的能量状态，钍原子核用于稳定激光的频率。”

paras.en: To make this possible, the researchers developed a system built around a special crystal containing thorium atoms, manufactured at TU Wien. A laser shines onto the crystal, interacting with the thorium nuclei inside.
paras.zh: 为了实现这一点，研究人员开发了一种围绕包含钍原子的特殊晶体构建的系统，该晶体由维也纳工业大学制造。激光照射到晶体上，与内部的钍原子核相互作用。

paras.en: The laser's light oscillates at a particular frequency, providing a regular rhythm that can be used to measure time. However, even tiny changes in the surrounding environment can interfere with that rhythm.
paras.zh: 激光以特定频率振荡，提供可用于测量时间的规则节奏。然而，即使周围环境的微小变化也会干扰这种节奏。

paras.en: "The oscillation of this laser light can be used for timekeeping, but the laser frequency can shift slightly from time to time, for example due to temperature fluctuations," explains Thorsten Schumm. "For high-precision measurements, you therefore need a mechanism to keep the laser frequency exactly stable, so that the clock continues to tick with precisely the same rhythm."
paras.zh: “这种激光的振荡可用于计时，但激光频率可能会不时发生轻微变化，例如由于温度波动，”Thorsten Schumm 解释道。 “因此，对于高精度测量，您需要一种机制来保持激光频率精确稳定，以便时钟继续以完全相同的节奏滴答作响。”

paras.en: Traditional atomic clocks solve this problem by using the energy transitions of electrons in atoms as a stable reference. The Vienna team has now demonstrated that the nuclei of thorium atoms can perform the same function.
paras.zh: 传统原子钟通过使用原子中电子的能量跃迁作为稳定参考来解决这个问题。维也纳团队现在已经证明钍原子核可以执行相同的功能。

paras.en: The mechanism works because thorium nuclei absorb laser light only when the light has precisely the correct frequency. If the laser begins to drift away from that frequency, the amount of light absorbed by the nuclei decreases.
paras.zh: 该机制之所以有效，是因为钍原子核仅在激光具有精确的正确频率时才会吸收激光。如果激光开始偏离该频率，原子核吸收的光量就会减少。

paras.en: The system detects this change and automatically adjusts the laser to bring it back to the correct frequency. This continuous feedback keeps the clock operating at a consistent rate, without requiring a conventional atomic clock to maintain its stability.
paras.zh: 系统检测到这种变化并自动调整激光以使其恢复到正确的频率。这种连续的反馈使时钟以一致的速率运行，而不需要传统的原子钟来保持其稳定性。

paras.en: For the first time, scientists have demonstrated a self-regulating nuclear clock that can function independently.
paras.zh: 科学家首次展示了一种可以独立运行的自我调节核时钟。

paras.en: A Clock With an Error of Just One Second in 30 Million Years
paras.zh: 3000万年误差仅1秒的时钟

paras.en: The potential advantage of nuclear clocks comes from the extraordinary properties of atomic nuclei.
paras.zh: 核钟的潜在优势来自原子核的非凡特性。

paras.en: "The great advantage of the new nuclear clock in Vienna is that, if you use atomic nuclei rather than atoms, much higher precision is possible in principle," says Thorsten Schumm.
paras.zh: “维也纳新核钟的巨大优势在于，如果使用原子核而不是原子，原则上可以实现更高的精度，”托尔斯滕·舒姆说。

paras.en: Atomic nuclei are more than 10,000 times smaller than atoms. Because of their extremely small size, they are much less affected by external influences that can disrupt precise measurements.
paras.zh: 原子核比原子小一万多倍。由于它们的尺寸极小，因此它们受到可能破坏精确测量的外部影响的影响要小得多。

paras.en: This resistance to environmental disturbances makes nuclear energy transitions especially promising for ultra-precise timekeeping.
paras.zh: 这种对环境干扰的抵抗力使得核能转变对于超精确计时特别有希望。

paras.en: To evaluate their prototype, the researchers measured its performance over the course of a day. The nuclear clock achieved a relative precision of approximately 10 to the power of minus 15, equivalent to an error of roughly one second over 30 million years.
paras.zh: 为了评估他们的原型，研究人员测量了它一天的性能。核钟的相对精度约为 10 的负 15 次方，相当于 3000 万年中大约一秒的误差。

paras.en: That figure describes the clock's measured precision rather than an actual test lasting millions of years. Nevertheless, it illustrates the remarkable accuracy the researchers have already achieved with an early prototype.
paras.zh: 该数字描述了时钟的测量精度，而不是持续数百万年的实际测试。尽管如此，它还是说明了研究人员已经通过早期原型实现了惊人的准确性。

paras.en: The new clock is not yet as precise as the world's leading optical atomic clocks, which remain the benchmark for high-performance timekeeping.
paras.zh: 新时钟的精确度尚不及世界领先的光学原子钟，后者仍然是高性能计时的基准。

paras.en: "This is not yet at the level of the world's best optical atomic clocks, but for a first prototype it is a fantastic result," says Thorsten Schumm.
paras.zh: “这还没有达到世界上最好的光学原子钟的水平，但对于第一个原型来说，这是一个了不起的结果，”托尔斯滕·舒姆说。

paras.en: The Next Step Toward Even More Precise Timekeeping
paras.zh: 迈向更精准计时的下一步

paras.en: The researchers believe their nuclear clock has considerable room for improvement. By using more powerful lasers and developing higher-quality thorium crystals, they hope to substantially increase its precision.
paras.zh: 研究人员认为他们的核时钟还有很大的改进空间。通过使用更强大的激光器和开发更高质量的钍晶体，他们希望大幅提高其精度。

paras.en: These upgrades could eventually allow nuclear clocks to outperform existing atomic clocks and establish a new standard for measuring time.
paras.zh: 这些升级最终可能使核钟的性能超越现有的原子钟，并建立测量时间的新标准。

paras.en: The implications extend beyond simply building a better clock. More accurate timekeeping can also improve the measurement of other physical quantities, providing researchers with increasingly sensitive tools for investigating the fundamental properties of nature.
paras.zh: 其影响不仅仅是建造一个更好的时钟。更准确的计时还可以改善其他物理量的测量，为研究人员提供越来越灵敏的工具来研究自然的基本特性。

paras.en: For now, the Vienna team's achievement demonstrates that a long-pursued scientific concept can operate as a self-sustaining timekeeping system. With the world's first self-stabilizing nuclear clock now running independently, scientists have taken an important step toward a future in which time can be measured with unprecedented precision.
paras.zh: 目前，维也纳团队的成就表明，长期追求的科学概念可以作为一个自我维持的计时系统运行。随着世界上第一个自稳定核钟现已独立运行，科学家们朝着可以以前所未有的精度测量时间的未来迈出了重要的一步。

articles.title: Eating olive oil before carbs has a surprising effect on blood sugar

paras.en: Eating olive oil before carbs has a surprising effect on blood sugar
paras.zh: 先吃橄榄油再吃碳水化合物对血糖有惊人的影响

paras.en: Eating fat before carbs dramatically reduced blood sugar spikes in mice, revealing a surprisingly simple strategy that could help people manage blood sugar.
paras.zh: 在吃碳水化合物之前先吃脂肪可以显着降低小鼠的血糖峰值，这揭示了一种令人惊讶的简单策略，可以帮助人们控制血糖。

paras.en: - A simple change in the order you eat your food could help prevent blood sugar spikes. Scientists discovered that giving mice olive oil before carbohydrates slowed digestion and activated a surprising combination of hormones and nerve signals that helped regulate blood sugar, even in mice with type 2 diabetes.
paras.zh: - 简单改变吃饭的顺序就可以帮助防止血糖飙升。科学家发现，在给小鼠喂食碳水化合物之前给小鼠喂橄榄油会减缓消化速度，并激活一种令人惊讶的激素和神经信号组合，从而帮助调节血糖，即使对于患有 2 型糖尿病的小鼠也是如此。

paras.en: The order in which you eat different foods may have a surprising effect on blood sugar levels. Research in mice suggests that consuming fat before carbohydrates can reduce the sharp rise in blood sugar that typically follows a meal. The findings also reveal how hormones and nerve signals work together to influence this response.
paras.zh: 吃不同食物的顺序可能会对血糖水平产生惊人的影响。对小鼠的研究表明，在摄入碳水化合物之前先摄入脂肪可以减少餐后血糖的急剧上升。研究结果还揭示了激素和神经信号如何共同影响这种反应。

paras.en: Keeping blood sugar from rising too high after eating is an important part of diabetes management. Previous clinical studies have shown that eating vegetables, protein, or fat before carbohydrates can help limit these increases. This suggests that changing the sequence of foods during a meal could offer a practical, sustainable way to improve blood sugar control without eliminating entire food groups.
paras.zh: 防止饭后血糖升高过高是糖尿病管理的重要组成部分。先前的临床研究表明，先吃蔬菜、蛋白质或脂肪，然后再吃碳水化合物，有助于限制这些增加。这表明改变膳食中食物的顺序可以提供一种实用、可持续的方法来改善血糖控制，而无需消除整个食物组。

paras.en: Scientists have generally explained this effect through two main mechanisms. The first is slower gastric emptying, which means food moves from the stomach into the small intestine more gradually. The second involves increased release of hormones called incretins, including GLP-1, which help the body regulate blood sugar.
paras.zh: 科学家通常通过两种主要机制来解释这种效应。第一个是胃排空较慢，这意味着食物更逐渐地从胃进入小肠。第二个涉及增加称为肠促胰岛素的激素的释放，包括 GLP-1，它有助于身体调节血糖。

paras.en: However, researchers have not fully understood how hormones produced by the gut and pancreas interact with the nervous system to produce these effects. To investigate, an international research team examined how consuming fat before or after glucose influences blood sugar, hormone activity, and the speed at which the stomach empties.
paras.zh: 然而，研究人员尚未完全了解肠道和胰腺产生的激素如何与神经系统相互作用以产生这些作用。为了进行调查，一个国际研究小组研究了在葡萄糖之前或之后消耗脂肪如何影响血糖、激素活性和胃排空速度。

paras.en: "Our group has long been interested in practical dietary approaches that people can continue in everyday life," says corresponding author Daisuke Yabe of Kyoto University. "Meal-sequencing is appealing because it merely changes how a meal is eaten rather than requiring people to avoid entire food groups."
paras.zh: 京都大学的通讯作者矢部大辅 (Daisuke Yabe) 表示：“我们的团队长期以来一直对人们可以在日常生活中继续使用的实用饮食方法感兴趣。” “进餐顺序很有吸引力，因为它仅仅改变了进餐的方式，而不是要求人们避开整个食物组。”

paras.en: Testing How Olive Oil Changes Blood Sugar Levels
paras.zh: 测试橄榄油如何改变血糖水平

paras.en: The researchers conducted a series of experiments in mice to determine whether the timing of fat consumption affected how the body processed glucose.
paras.zh: 研究人员在小鼠身上进行了一系列实验，以确定脂肪消耗的时间是否会影响身体处理葡萄糖的方式。

paras.en: After an overnight fast, the mice were assigned to three groups. One group received water followed by glucose. A second group was given olive oil, followed 15 minutes later by glucose. The third group received glucose first, with olive oil administered 15 minutes afterward.
paras.zh: 经过一整夜的禁食后，小鼠被分为三组。一组先喝水，然后喝葡萄糖。第二组服用橄榄油，15 分钟后服用葡萄糖。第三组首先服用葡萄糖，15 分钟后服用橄榄油。

paras.en: The scientists then measured blood glucose levels and several hormones involved in blood sugar regulation, including insulin, glucagon, GIP, and GLP-1. Glucagon is normally associated with increasing blood sugar, while GIP and GLP-1 help regulate glucose levels after eating.
paras.zh: 然后，科学家们测量了血糖水平和几种参与血糖调节的激素，包括胰岛素、胰高血糖素、GIP 和 GLP-1。胰高血糖素通常与血糖升高有关，而 GIP 和 GLP-1 有助于调节餐后血糖水平。

paras.en: To determine how quickly material was leaving the stomach, the researchers also administered acetaminophen, a common pain reliever. By measuring how much of the drug appeared in the bloodstream after oral administration, they could estimate the rate of gastric emptying.
paras.zh: 为了确定物质离开胃的速度，研究人员还服用了对乙酰氨基酚（一种常见的止痛药）。通过测量口服给药后血液中出现的药物量，他们可以估计胃排空的速度。

paras.en: The team extended the experiments to additional groups of mice, including animals with type 2 diabetes and others that lacked the receptor needed to respond to GLP-1.
paras.zh: 研究小组将实验扩展到其他小鼠组，包括患有 2 型糖尿病的小鼠和其他缺乏响应 GLP-1 所需受体的小鼠。

paras.en: They also performed experiments that blocked glucagon or GLP-1 signaling, surgically interrupted the vagus nerves below the diaphragm on both sides, and examined whether different dietary fats produced similar results. The vagus nerve is an important communication pathway between the brain and digestive system, helping coordinate functions such as digestion and hormone release.
paras.zh: 他们还进行了阻断胰高血糖素或 GLP-1 信号传导的实验，通过手术中断两侧隔膜下方的迷走神经，并检查不同的膳食脂肪是否会产生相似的结果。迷走神经是大脑和消化系统之间的重要沟通途径，有助于协调消化和激素释放等功能。

paras.en: Eating Fat First Slows Blood Sugar Spikes
paras.zh: 首先吃脂肪可以减缓血糖飙升

paras.en: The results showed a clear difference depending on when the mice received olive oil.
paras.zh: 结果显示出明显的差异，具体取决于小鼠接受橄榄油的时间。

paras.en: When olive oil was given before glucose, the initial rise in blood sugar was smaller than when the oil was administered afterward. The earlier fat intake also slowed gastric emptying, delaying the movement of glucose from the stomach into the intestine.
paras.zh: 当在葡萄糖之前给予橄榄油时，血糖的最初升高比之后给予油时要小。较早的脂肪摄入也会减慢胃排空，延迟葡萄糖从胃进入肠道的运动。

paras.en: At the same time, consuming fat before glucose stimulated an early increase in several hormones, including glucagon, GIP, and GLP-1.
paras.zh: 与此同时，先吃脂肪再吃葡萄糖会刺激多种激素的早期增加，包括胰高血糖素、GIP 和 GLP-1。

paras.en: Importantly, these effects were also observed in mice with type 2 diabetes and severe insulin deficiency. This suggested that the response could still function even when normal insulin regulation was significantly impaired.
paras.zh: 重要的是，在患有 2 型糖尿病和严重胰岛素缺乏的小鼠中也观察到了这些影响。这表明即使正常的胰岛素调节明显受损，这种反应仍然可以发挥作用。

paras.en: A Surprising Role for a Blood Sugar Hormone
paras.zh: 血糖激素的惊人作用

paras.en: One of the most unexpected findings involved glucagon, a hormone generally known for raising blood sugar by stimulating the liver to release stored glucose.
paras.zh: 最意想不到的发现之一涉及胰高血糖素，这是一种众所周知的激素，可以通过刺激肝脏释放储存的葡萄糖来升高血糖。

paras.en: The researchers discovered that blocking glucagon signaling alone did not eliminate the blood sugar lowering effect of consuming olive oil before glucose. Blocking GLP-1 signaling by itself also failed to remove the benefit.
paras.zh: 研究人员发现，仅阻断胰高血糖素信号传导并不能消除先食用橄榄油再食用葡萄糖的降血糖作用。单独阻断 GLP-1 信号传导也未能消除其益处。

paras.en: However, when both signaling pathways were blocked simultaneously, the beneficial effect was reduced.
paras.zh: 然而，当两条信号通路同时被阻断时，有益效果就会降低。

paras.en: This finding suggests that glucagon and GLP-1 work together as part of a more complex system that helps moderate blood sugar after fat is consumed before carbohydrates. It also reveals that glucagon, despite its familiar role in increasing blood sugar, can contribute to a response that ultimately limits the rise in glucose after eating.
paras.zh: 这一发现表明，胰高血糖素和 GLP-1 作为一个更复杂系统的一部分共同发挥作用，有助于在碳水化合物之前消耗脂肪后调节血糖。它还表明，尽管胰高血糖素在升高血糖方面具有众所周知的作用，但它可以有助于最终限制进食后血糖升高的反应。

paras.en: The vagus nerve experiments provided another important clue. When the researchers interrupted these nerve pathways, the results suggested that communication through the vagus nerve also contributes to the body's response to nutrient order.
paras.zh: 迷走神经实验提供了另一个重要线索。当研究人员中断这些神经通路时，结果表明通过迷走神经的通讯也有助于身体对营养顺序的反应。

paras.en: Together, these findings point to a coordinated interaction between digestive hormones, pancreatic signals, and the nervous system.
paras.zh: 总之，这些发现表明消化激素、胰腺信号和神经系统之间存在协调相互作用。

paras.en: Could Changing Meal Order Help Manage Diabetes?
paras.zh: 改变膳食顺序可以帮助控制糖尿病吗？

paras.en: The findings offer a clearer biological explanation for why eating fat before carbohydrates may help reduce blood sugar spikes. Rather than relying on a single hormone or digestive process, the effect appears to involve multiple systems working together to control how quickly glucose enters the intestine.
paras.zh: 这些发现为为什么先吃脂肪再吃碳水化合物可能有助于降低血糖峰值提供了更清晰的生物学解释。这种效应似乎涉及多个系统共同作用来控制葡萄糖进入肠道的速度，而不是依赖于单一激素或消化过程。

paras.en: This could have practical implications for diabetes management. Adjusting the order in which foods are eaten is relatively simple and may be easier to maintain than diets that require avoiding particular food groups.
paras.zh: 这可能对糖尿病管理产生实际影响。调整食物的食用顺序相对简单，并且可能比需要避免特定食物组的饮食更容易维持。

paras.en: However, the experiments were conducted in mice, and the same effects have not yet been established in humans through this research. Additional clinical studies will be needed to determine whether the mechanisms identified in the experiments can be used to improve blood sugar regulation in people with or without diabetes.
paras.zh: 然而，这些实验是在小鼠身上进行的，通过这项研究尚未在人类中证实相同的效果。还需要进行更多的临床研究来确定实验中确定的机制是否可以用于改善患有或不患有糖尿病的人的血糖调节。

paras.en: "Our findings suggest that the order in which nutrients reach the gut can engage a coordinated hormone-nerve response that changes how quickly the stomach delivers glucose to the intestine," says Yabe.
paras.zh: “我们的研究结果表明，营养物质到达肠道的顺序可以引起协调的激素-神经反应，从而改变胃将葡萄糖输送到肠道的速度，”Yabe 说。

paras.zh: 资料由京都大学提供。注意：内容可能会根据样式和长度进行编辑。

articles.title: The eye has a hidden cleanup system scientists never knew existed

paras.en: The eye has a hidden cleanup system scientists never knew existed
paras.zh: 眼睛有一个隐藏的清理系统，科学家们从来不知道它的存在

paras.en: Scientists have uncovered a hidden waste removal system in the eye that could transform how we understand and treat blinding diseases.
paras.zh: 科学家们发现了眼睛中隐藏的废物清除系统，它可以改变我们理解和治疗致盲疾病的方式。

paras.en: - Scientists have discovered a hidden cleanup system at the back of the eye that drains fluid and waste through a previously unknown pathway. The surprising finding, demonstrated in mice, could open the door to new treatments for glaucoma, macular degeneration, and other causes of blindness.
paras.zh: - 科学家们在眼睛后部发现了一个隐藏的清理系统，可以通过以前未知的途径排出液体和废物。这一令人惊讶的发现在小鼠身上得到证实，可能为治疗青光眼、黄斑变性和其他失明原因的新疗法打开大门。

paras.en: Scientists have uncovered a previously unknown cleanup system at the back of the eye, revealing a hidden route that allows fluid and waste to escape into the body's lymphatic system. The discovery challenges long-standing assumptions about how the eye functions and could eventually lead to new approaches for treating serious conditions that cause blindness.
paras.zh: 科学家们在眼睛后部发现了一个以前未知的清理系统，揭示了一条隐藏的路线，可以让液体和废物进入人体的淋巴系统。这一发现挑战了长期以来关于眼睛如何运作的假设，并最终可能导致治疗导致失明的严重疾病的新方法。

paras.en: Glaucoma, age-related macular degeneration, and several other major causes of permanent vision loss are associated with the accumulation of fluid, metabolic waste, and inflammatory material in the back of the eye. Until now, researchers have struggled to explain exactly how this sensitive region removes unwanted substances.
paras.zh: 青光眼、年龄相关性黄斑变性和永久性视力丧失的其他几个主要原因都与眼后部液体、代谢废物和炎症物质的积聚有关。到目前为止，研究人员一直在努力解释这个敏感区域如何去除不需要的物质。

paras.en: A team from the University of British Columbia (UBC) and the University of Toronto has identified a previously unrecognized drainage route called the posterior ocular lymphatic outflow, or POLO pathway. The system appears to carry fluid and waste away from the back of the eye and into the lymphatic network, which helps the body maintain fluid balance, remove waste, and support immune defenses.
paras.zh: 来自不列颠哥伦比亚大学 (UBC) 和多伦多大学的一个团队发现了一条以前未被认识的引流路径，称为眼后淋巴流出道或 POLO 路径。该系统似乎将液体和废物从眼睛后部输送到淋巴网络，这有助于身体保持液体平衡、清除废物并支持免疫防御。

paras.en: The finding, demonstrated in mice, offers scientists a new way to investigate how the eye protects its delicate tissues and what happens when waste removal is disrupted.
paras.zh: 这一发现在老鼠身上得到了证实，为科学家们提供了一种新的方法来研究眼睛如何保护其脆弱的组织，以及当废物清除受到干扰时会发生什么。

paras.en: "The retina is one of the most metabolically active parts of the body, constantly generating byproducts that need to be cleared," said Dr. Neeru Gupta, professor and head of UBC's department of ophthalmology and visual sciences. "This discovery helps explain how the eye flushes this waste and promises to transform how we think about and treat a range of eye conditions."
paras.zh: “视网膜是身体代谢最活跃的部位之一，不断产生需要清除的副产品，”UBC 眼科和视觉科学系教授兼系主任 Neeru Gupta 博士说。 “这一发现有助于解释眼睛如何冲洗这些废物，并有望改变我们思考和治疗一系列眼部疾病的方式。”

paras.en: A Hidden Eye Drainage System Could Open New Paths to Treatment
paras.zh: 隐藏的眼部引流系统可以开辟新的治疗途径

paras.en: The retina, the light-sensitive tissue at the back of the eye, requires substantial energy to convert incoming light into signals the brain can interpret. This constant activity produces metabolic byproducts that must be removed to keep the surrounding tissues functioning properly.
paras.zh: 视网膜是眼睛后部的光敏组织，需要大量能量才能将入射光转换成大脑可以解释的信号。这种持续的活动会产生代谢副产物，必须将其清除以保持周围组织的正常功能。

paras.en: When fluid and waste accumulate, they can contribute to conditions that damage the eye. Glaucoma, macular degeneration, and other retinal disorders are associated with changes in fluid regulation, cellular waste buildup, tissue stress, and inflammation.
paras.zh: 当液体和废物积聚时，可能会导致眼睛受损。青光眼、黄斑变性和其他视网膜疾病与液体调节、细胞废物堆积、组织应激和炎症的变化有关。

paras.en: Age-related macular degeneration alone affects approximately 2.5 million Canadians, highlighting the potential importance of understanding the processes that keep the retina healthy.
paras.zh: 仅年龄相关性黄斑变性就影响了大约 250 万加拿大人，这凸显了了解保持视网膜健康的过程的潜在重要性。

paras.en: The newly identified POLO pathway suggests that the back of the eye has a natural mechanism for moving unwanted material out of this vulnerable region. If scientists can determine how that mechanism works and whether it can be strengthened, it could provide a new target for therapies designed to protect vision.
paras.zh: 新发现的 POLO 通路表明，眼睛后部有一种自然机制，可以将不需要的物质移出这个脆弱区域。如果科学家能够确定该机制如何发挥作用以及是否可以得到加强，那么它可以为旨在保护视力的疗法提供新的目标。

paras.en: "This gives us a whole new framework for understanding these diseases and a potential target for therapeutics," said Dr. Gupta. "The question now is: How can we enhance or exploit this cleanup system to treat or even prevent disease."
paras.zh: “这为我们提供了一个全新的框架来理解这些疾病和潜在的治疗目标，”古普塔博士说。 “现在的问题是：我们如何增强或利用这种清理系统来治疗甚至预防疾病。”

paras.en: A Discovery That Challenges More Than a Century of Assumptions
paras.zh: 挑战一个多世纪假设的发现

paras.en: For over 100 years, scientists generally believed that the eye lacked the lymphatic drainage systems found in nearly every other organ.
paras.zh: 一百多年来，科学家们普遍认为眼睛缺乏几乎所有其他器官所具有的淋巴引流系统。

paras.en: The lymphatic system consists of vessels and tissues that collect excess fluid, transport certain waste products, and help coordinate immune responses. It works alongside the blood circulatory system to maintain healthy conditions throughout the body.
paras.zh: 淋巴系统由血管和组织组成，负责收集多余的液体、运输某些废物并帮助协调免疫反应。它与血液循环系统一起工作，以维持整个身体的健康状况。

paras.en: The idea that the eye was largely separate from this network began to change in 2009, when Dr. Gupta and Dr. Yeni Yücel identified a lymphatic-related drainage route in the front of the eye.
paras.zh: 2009 年，Gupta 博士和 Yeni Yücel 博士在眼睛前部发现了一条与淋巴相关的引流路线，从此，眼睛在很大程度上与该网络分离的想法开始发生变化。

paras.en: They named it the "uveolymphatic" pathway, providing evidence that the eye had previously unrecognized connections to the body's fluid clearance mechanisms.
paras.zh: 他们将其命名为“葡萄膜淋巴”通路，提供了证据表明眼睛与身体的液体清除机制之间存在以前未被识别的联系。

paras.en: Dr. Yücel, a professor and director of ophthalmic pathology at the University of Toronto, continued investigating the possibility that similar pathways might exist elsewhere in the eye.
paras.zh: 多伦多大学眼科病理学教授兼主任于塞尔博士继续研究眼睛其他部位可能存在类似通路的可能性。

paras.en: Despite that earlier discovery, the back of the eye remained relatively unexplored. This was a particularly important gap because the retina and surrounding tissues are affected by some of the most serious diseases responsible for permanent vision loss.
paras.zh: 尽管有这个较早的发现，但眼睛后部仍然相对未被探索。这是一个特别重要的差距，因为视网膜和周围组织受到一些导致永久性视力丧失的最严重疾病的影响。

paras.en: "The retina is responsible for vision and it's also where many of the most serious vision-loss diseases occur," said Dr. Yücel. "Understanding how this part of the eye maintains a balanced environment and flow of materials is critical."
paras.zh: “视网膜负责视力，也是许多最严重的视力丧失疾病发生的地方，”Yücel 博士说。 “了解眼睛的这一部分如何保持平衡的环境和物质流动至关重要。”

paras.en: Scientists Trace a Secret Cleanup Route Behind the Retina
paras.zh: 科学家追踪视网膜后面的秘密清理路线

paras.en: To investigate how fluid leaves the back of the eye, the researchers combined several advanced imaging methods in mice, including magnetic resonance imaging (MRI), near-infrared fluorescence imaging, and microscopic examination.
paras.zh: 为了研究液体如何离开眼睛后部，研究人员在小鼠身上结合了几种先进的成像方法，包括磁共振成像（MRI）、近红外荧光成像和显微镜检查。

paras.en: They placed fluorescent tracer molecules into a narrow space at the rear of the eye. Because these molecules could be detected as they moved, the scientists were able to follow the fluid's path and determine where it traveled.
paras.zh: 他们将荧光示踪分子放入眼睛后部的狭窄空间中。由于这些分子在移动时可以被检测到，因此科学家们能够追踪流体的路径并确定其行进的位置。

paras.en: The results revealed tiny lymphatic vessels in the choroid, a thin, blood vessel-rich layer located beneath the retina. The choroid plays an important role in nourishing the outer retina, but lymphatic vessels had not previously been established in this region.
paras.zh: 结果显示脉络膜中有微小的淋巴管，脉络膜是位于视网膜下方的一层薄薄的、富含血管的层。脉络膜在滋养外视网膜方面发挥着重要作用，但此前该区域尚未建立淋巴管。

paras.en: The team observed fluid moving from the back of the eye into the surrounding orbital tissues, which occupy the space around the eyeball. Within minutes, the tracers reached nearby lymph nodes, connecting the eye's newly identified drainage route to the body's broader lymphatic system.
paras.zh: 研究小组观察到液体从眼睛后部移动到周围的眼眶组织，这些组织占据了眼球周围的空间。几分钟之内，示踪剂到达附近的淋巴结，将眼睛新确定的引流路线与身体更广泛的淋巴系统连接起来。

paras.en: This provided evidence that fluid from the back of the eye could enter an active drainage pathway rather than remaining confined within the eye.
paras.zh: 这提供了证据，表明来自眼睛后部的液体可以进入主动引流路径，而不是限制在眼睛内。

paras.en: "Because lymphatic vessels in the choroid were thought not to exist, the team used multiple techniques to demonstrate both their presence and function," added Dr. Yücel, a pathologist-scientist at St. Michael's Hospital. "We were surprised to see such a direct route for fluid to leave the eye and connect with the lymphatic system. It suggests the back of the eye has an active clearance pathway, which could play an important role in removing fluid, proteins and inflammatory material that build up in disease."
paras.zh: “因为脉络膜中的淋巴管被认为不存在，所以研究小组使用了多种技术来证明它们的存在和功能，”圣迈克尔医院的病理学家兼科学家 Yücel 博士补充道。 “我们惊讶地发现液体有如此直接的途径离开眼睛并与淋巴系统连接。这表明眼睛后部有一条主动的清除途径，在清除疾病中积聚的液体、蛋白质和炎症物质方面可能发挥重要作用。”

paras.en: Could the Eye's Cleanup System Help Prevent Blindness?
paras.zh: 眼睛的清洁系统可以帮助防止失明吗？

paras.en: Although the discovery offers a new explanation for how fluid and waste may leave the back of the eye, important questions remain.
paras.zh: 尽管这一发现为液体和废物如何离开眼睛后部提供了新的解释，但重要的问题仍然存在。

paras.en: The experiments were conducted in mice, and further studies are necessary to establish how the POLO pathway functions in humans. Researchers also need to determine whether changes in this drainage system contribute to eye disease and whether its activity can be safely modified.
paras.zh: 这些实验是在小鼠身上进行的，还需要进一步的研究来确定 POLO 通路在人类中如何发挥作用。研究人员还需要确定该排水系统的变化是否会导致眼部疾病，以及是否可以安全地改变其活性。

paras.en: If those questions can be answered, the pathway could eventually offer several possibilities for treatment.
paras.zh: 如果这些问题能够得到解答，该途径最终可能会提供多种治疗可能性。

paras.en: One approach might involve developing therapies that improve fluid clearance, potentially reducing the buildup of substances associated with inflammation and tissue damage. Another possibility is using knowledge of this drainage route to improve how medications are delivered to structures deep within the eye.
paras.zh: 一种方法可能涉及开发改善液体清除的疗法，从而有可能减少与炎症和组织损伤相关的物质的积累。另一种可能性是利用这种引流途径的知识来改善药物输送到眼睛深处结构的方式。

paras.en: Understanding the system may also help researchers investigate how pressure, inflammation, and fluid movement interact in conditions such as glaucoma and age-related macular degeneration.
paras.zh: 了解该系统还可以帮助研究人员研究压力、炎症和液体运动在青光眼和年龄相关性黄斑变性等疾病中如何相互作用。

paras.en: These applications remain potential future developments rather than established treatments. Nevertheless, the discovery gives scientists a new anatomical pathway to study and a possible explanation for processes that have remained poorly understood for decades.
paras.zh: 这些应用仍然是未来潜在的发展，而不是既定的治疗方法。尽管如此，这一发现为科学家提供了一条新的解剖学研究途径，并为数十年来人们对这一过程知之甚少的过程提供了可能的解释。

paras.en: "This is a foundational discovery that shows the eye is not as closed a system as we previously thought," said Dr. Gupta. "It gives us a new map, a new mechanism and a new set of questions to explore."
paras.zh: 古普塔博士说：“这是一项基础性发现，表明眼睛并不像我们之前想象的那样是一个封闭的系统。” “它为我们提供了新的地图、新的机制和一系列需要探索的新问题。”

paras.en: The findings were published in the scientific journal Translational Vision Science & Technology.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在科学杂志《Translational Vision Science & Technology》上。

paras.en: The research was supported by the Canadian Institutes of Health Research, Glaucoma Research Society of Canada, Henry Farrugia Ophthalmology Research Fund, Canadian Space Agency, Dorothy Pitts Chair, Stephen M. Drance Chair, Thor and Nicky Eaton Research Fund, and Canada Foundation for Innovation Leaders Opportunity Fund.
paras.zh: 该研究得到了加拿大健康研究院、加拿大青光眼研究会、亨利·法鲁贾眼科研究基金、加拿大航天局、Dorothy Pitts 主席、Stephen M. Drance 主席、Thor 和 Nicky Eaton 研究基金以及加拿大创新领袖机会基金基金会的支持。

articles.title: China launches Guowang, Yaogan-40 satellites, sets up busy Q4 manifest
articles.author: Andrew Jones

paras.en: HELSINKI — China completed its ninth and tenth launches of September, sending Guowang and Yaogan satellites into orbit, ahead of an intense finish to the year.
paras.zh: 赫尔辛基——中国在 9 月份完成了第九次和第十次发射，将“国王”号和“遥感”卫星送入轨道，为今年的紧张收官做好准备。

paras.en: A Long March 8A lifted off at 9:32 a.m. Eastern (1332 UTC) Sept. 23 from the Hainan commercial spacecraft launch site, carrying the 26th group of satellites for China’s Guowang national low Earth orbit satellite internet project. Less than a day later, a Long March 6A lifted off at 4:46 a.m. Eastern (0846 UTC) Sept. 24 from Taiyuan Satellite Launch Center with the fourth group of Yaogan-40 satellites.
paras.zh: 9月23日东部时间1332年上午9时32分，长征八号A运载火箭从海南商业航天发射场升空，搭载着中国国网国家低轨卫星互联网工程第26组卫星。不到一天后，长征六号甲运载火箭于9月24日东部时间凌晨4时46分（世界标准时间0846）从太原卫星发射中心升空，搭载第四组遥感四十号卫星。

paras.en: The pair of launches capped a September in which Chinese launchers flew at a pace that frequently saw multiple orbital missions within days, including four different rockets launching from three sites within 48 hours Sept. 15–16.
paras.zh: 这两次发射为9月份画上了圆满的句号，中国运载火箭的飞行速度经常在几天内执行多次轨道任务，其中包括9月15日至16日48小时内从三个地点发射的四枚不同的火箭。

paras.en: China Aerospace Science and Technology Corp. (CASC) stated the Guowang satellites had entered their planned orbits. The satellites were later tracked by U.S. Space Force in roughly circular 1,100-kilometer-altitude orbits inclined by 50 degrees. The batch was developed under the overall leadership of the China Academy of Space Technology (CAST), CASC’s main spacecraft maker, according to the corporation.
paras.zh: 中国航天科技集团公司（CASC）表示，国网卫星已进入预定轨道。这些卫星随后被美国太空军在大约 1,100 公里高、倾斜 50 度的圆形轨道上进行跟踪。据该公司称，这批产品是在中国航天科技集团公司主要航天器制造商中国空间技术研究院（CAST）的全面领导下研制的。

paras.en: Guowang is run by China SatNet, a state-owned enterprise established in 2021, and is planned to comprise around 13,000 satellites. The constellation uses satellites from multiple manufacturers and is launched on a range of Long March vehicles, with the Long March 8A, which debuted in February 2025, now launching regularly from Hainan’s commercial pads.
paras.zh: 国网由成立于 2021 年的国有企业中国卫星网运营，计划包含约 13,000 颗卫星。该星座使用多个制造商的卫星，并在一系列长征运载火箭上发射，其中长征八号甲于 2025 年 2 月首次亮相，现在定期从海南的商业发射场发射。

paras.en: The three Yaogan-40 (04) satellites will mainly be used for electromagnetic environment detection and related technology experiments, Xinhua reported, using boilerplate language typical of Yaogan launches. The satellites were also developed under CAST’s leadership.
paras.zh: 据新华社报道，三颗遥感四十（04）卫星将主要用于电磁环境探测和相关技术实验，使用遥感发射典型的样板语言。这些卫星也是在中国科协的领导下研制的。

paras.en: The satellites entered near polar orbits with altitudes of around 800 km, joining three earlier batches in similar orbits. Analysis by Integrity ISR indicates that the Yaogan-40 groups are placed into orbital planes separated by 72 degrees in right ascension of the ascending node, suggesting a fifth group will be needed to complete the constellation.
paras.zh: 这些卫星进入了高度约 800 公里的近极轨道，加入了类似轨道的早期三批卫星。 Integrity ISR 的分析表明，Yaogan-40 群被放置在升交点赤经中相距 72 度的轨道平面中，这表明需要第五个群来完成该星座。

paras.en: The Long March 6A, a kerosene-liquid oxygen core with solid boosters, is one of CASC’s main vehicles for both Yaogan and megaconstellation missions from Taiyuan. The rocket has now flown 27 times since its debut in March 2022, with all flights successfully reaching orbit, though the upper stage has experienced a number of breakup events after payload deployment.
paras.zh: 长征六号甲运载火箭是带有固体助推器的煤油液氧核心，是中国航天科技集团公司在太原执行遥感和巨型星座任务的主要运载工具之一。自 2022 年 3 月首次亮相以来，该火箭现已飞行 27 次，所有飞行均成功进入轨道，尽管上级在有效载荷部署后经历了多次解体事件。

paras.en: The pair of launches take China to 70 orbital launch attempts for 2026. With the country aiming to surpass 100 launches in a calendar year for the first time, the final quarter will see heavy activity. China launched 26 times in Q3, following 26 in Q2 and 18 in Q1, and would need to conduct at least 31 launches in Q4. The country’s annual launch schedule is typically backloaded with a greater number of launches later in the year.
paras.zh: 这两次发射使中国在 2026 年进行了 70 次轨道发射尝试。由于该国的目标是在一个日历年内首次超过 100 次发射，因此最后一个季度将出现大量活动。中国在第三季度发射了 26 次，继第二季度 26 次和第一季度 18 次之后，第四季度需要至少进行 31 次发射。该国的年度发射计划通常会在今年晚些时候进行更多的发射。

paras.en: One major mission will be Shenzhou-24. China’s next crewed mission now appears likely to launch around November, using a Long March 2F from Jiuquan. The crew is expected, though not officially confirmed, to include a Pakistani payload specialist, chosen from one of two Pakistan Air Force pilots in training at the Astronaut Center of China. The selected astronaut would become the first foreign astronaut to visit Tiangong.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号将是一项重大任务。中国的下一次载人任务现在看来可能会在 11 月左右发射，使用的是酒泉的长征二号F。尽管尚未正式确认，机组人员预计将包括一名巴基斯坦有效载荷专家，他是从在中国宇航员中心接受训练的两名巴基斯坦空军飞行员中挑选的。入选的宇航员将成为第一位访问天宫的外国宇航员。

paras.en: A press conference a day ahead of the Shenzhou-24 launch may also provide updates or insights into the schedule for the first launch of the Mengzhou new generation spacecraft and the Long March 10A, both of which are related to China’s crewed lunar plans.
paras.zh: 神舟二十四号发射前一天的新闻发布会还可能提供孟州新一代飞船和长征十号甲首次发射时间表的最新情况或见解，这两者都与中国的载人登月计划有关。

paras.en: Possible debut launches include Orienspace’s Gravity-2, iSpace’s Hyperbola-3 with a first stage recovery attempt, and Zhihang-1 from Zenk Space, which earlier aimed for a launch in June. These would add to 2026 debuts including Tianlong-3 (April), Kinetica-2 (March), the Long March 12B (June), Long March 10B (July) and Pallas-1 (Sept. 1).
paras.zh: 可能的首次发射包括Orienspace的Gravity-2、iSpace的Hyperbola-3（进行第一阶段回收尝试）以及Zenk Space的Zhihang-1（其早些时候计划于6月发射）。这些将在 2026 年首次亮相的基础上增加，包括天龙三号（4 月）、动能二号（3 月）、长征十二号乙（六月）、长征十号乙（七月）和帕拉斯一号（九月 1 日）。

paras.en: Numerous launches for the Guowang and Qianfan constellations are expected. Other notable possible payloads in the coming months include Fengxing-1 on a Gravity-1 solid rocket, which could be China’s first commercial orbital transfer vehicle, from Future Space. Also expected are space computing payloads. The schedule for the planned debut flight of the Haolong reusable spaceplane for cargo to Tiangong from AVIC on a Zhuque-3 rocket from Landspace is currently unknown.
paras.zh: 国望星座和千帆星座预计将进行多次发射。未来几个月其他值得注意的可能有效载荷包括来自未来空间的重力一号固体火箭上的风行一号，这可能是中国第一个商业轨道转移飞行器。预计还有太空计算有效载荷。昊龙可重复使用航天飞机计划通过蓝箭朱雀三号火箭从中航工业飞往天宫的首次飞行时间表目前尚不清楚。

articles.title: Deposition Sciences, Inc. Expands Sunshade® Tape Offering with New 12″ × 30″ Format
articles.author: Deposition Sciences, Inc

paras.en: Santa Rosa, CA — October 2026 — Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI), a leader in advanced thin film coatings, proudly announces the introduction of a new 12″ × 30″ format for its Sunshade® Tape thermal control material. This expanded size provides engineers and designers with greater flexibility for integrating thermal protection into larger aerospace and industrial systems.
paras.zh: 加利福尼亚州圣罗莎 — 2026 年 10 月 — 先进薄膜涂层领域的领导者 Deposition Sciences, Inc. (DSI) 自豪地宣布为其 Sunshade® Tape 热控制材料推出新的 12" × 30" 格式。这种扩大的尺寸为工程师和设计人员提供了更大的灵活性，可以将热保护集成到更大的航空航天和工业系统中。

paras.en: Sunshade® Tape is engineered for solar reflectance, thermal stability, and durability in extreme environments. Its lightweight, flexible design reduces energy demands while safeguarding sensitive components from heat exposure. The new format ensures easier application across broader surfaces, enhancing mission reliability and equipment performance.
paras.zh: Sunshade® 胶带专为极端环境下的太阳反射率、热稳定性和耐用性而设计。其轻质、灵活的设计降低了能源需求，同时保护敏感部件免受热暴露。新格式确保更轻松地在更广泛的表面上应用，从而提高任务可靠性和设备性能。

paras.en: “Our customers asked for more versatility, and we delivered,” said Justin Mosier, Sr. Mgr Space Materials at DSI. “The new 12″ × 30″ format makes Sunshade® Tape even more adaptable to complex thermal control challenges.”
paras.zh: “我们的客户要求更多的多功能性，我们满足了，”DSI 空间材料高级经理 Justin Mosier 说道。 “新的 12 英寸 × 30 英寸规格使 Sunshade® 胶带更能适应复杂的热控制挑战。”

paras.en: For more information about Sunshade® Tape and its applications, visit Deposition Sciences, Inc. at https://www.depsci.com.
paras.zh: 有关 Sunshade® Tape 及其应用的更多信息，请访问 Deposition Sciences, Inc.，网址为 https://www.depsci.com。

articles.title: What will it take to build a moon base?
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

During a live event at the Johns Hopkins University Bloomberg Center, leaders Astrolab, Firefly Space and APL share what a lunar future could look like and what has to happen in the next couple of years to make it a reality.
paras.zh: 在本集中，行业专家小组讨论了建造月球基地所需的条件。在约翰·霍普金斯大学彭博中心举行的现场活动中，Astrolab、Firefly Space 和 APL 的领导者分享了月球的未来可能是什么样子，以及未来几年必须发生什么才能使其成为现实。

articles.title: NASA to Conduct Flyover, Engage NFL Fans at MetLife Stadium
articles.author: Jessica Taveau

paras.en: As part of the agency’s Inspiration Tour flyover, NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman will pilot one of three F-5 fighter jets to kick off the New York Jets vs. Cleveland Browns game in East Rutherford, New Jersey, on Sunday, Oct. 11.
paras.zh: 作为该机构灵感之旅天桥的一部分，NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 将驾驶三架 F-5 战斗机中的一架，为 10 月 11 日星期日在新泽西州东卢瑟福举行的纽约喷气机队与克利夫兰布朗队的比赛拉开序幕。

paras.en: NASA team members will engage with fans at the agency’s Experience Zone, located at the Jets Tailgate Zone outside the stadium, from 10 a.m. to 1 p.m. EDT before the game. Fans can learn more about NASA’s return to the Moon under the agency’s Artemis dome, enjoy interactive games, and capture photos with a large, inflatable SLS (Space Launch System) rocket.
paras.zh: NASA 团队成员将于上午 10 点至下午 1 点在位于体育场外喷气机尾门区的该机构体验区与球迷互动。比赛前美国东部夏令时间。粉丝们可以在该机构的阿耳忒弥斯穹顶下了解有关 NASA 返回月球的更多信息，享受互动游戏，并使用大型充气 SLS（太空发射系统）火箭拍摄照片。

paras.en: Isaacman will be available for limited media interviews during the game. To arrange interviews, please contact Camille Gallo at: camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov or 202-531-8057.
paras.zh: 艾萨克曼将在比赛期间接受有限的媒体采访。如需安排采访，请联系 Camille Gallo：camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov 或 202-531-8057。

paras.en: With stops across the nation, NASA’s Inspiration Tour convenes academic, industry, and public sector stakeholders to connect the agency with the people, technologies, and organizations that drive American leadership in space.
paras.zh: NASA 的灵感之旅在全国各地停靠，聚集了学术界、工业界和公共部门的利益相关者，将该机构与推动美国在太空领域发挥领导作用的人员、技术和组织联系起来。

paras.en: The tour will culminate in MAX POWER, a public exposition of American air and space innovation, Saturday, Nov. 7, and Sunday, Nov. 8, on and near the agency’s Kennedy Space Center in Florida. Held in honor of America’s historic 250th anniversary, the multi-day, family-friendly event will showcase the next-generation aircraft, spacecraft, autonomous vehicles, and technologies that will help define the future of transportation in air and space.
paras.zh: 此次巡演将在 MAX POWER 上达到高潮，这是一场美国航空航天创新的公开展览，将于 11 月 7 日星期六和 11 月 8 日星期日在该机构位于佛罗里达州的肯尼迪航天中心及其附近举行。为纪念美国历史性的 250 周年而举办的这项为期多天、适合家庭的活动将展示下一代飞机、航天器、自动驾驶汽车以及有助于定义航空和太空运输未来的技术。

paras.en: For more information about MAX POWER and the agency’s missions, visit:
paras.zh: 有关 MAX POWER 和该机构使命的更多信息，请访问：

paras.en: camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov / jessica.c.taveau@nasa.gov
paras.zh: camille.m.gallo@nasa.gov / jessica.c.taveau@nasa.gov

articles.title: Carrick must share burden of Man Utd's underperformance with his players

paras.en: Man Utd 1-1 Spurs: Michael Carrick entering a defining period and must correct underperformance quickly
paras.zh: 曼联 1-1 热刺：卡里克进入决定性时期，必须迅速纠正表现不佳的情况

paras.en: Tottenham snatched a 1-1 draw with 10 men at Manchester United on Saturday, calling Michael Carrick's decision-making further into question; the Man Utd boss has failed to offer many answers to his side's underperformance so far this season; a defining period comes next
paras.zh: 周六，托特纳姆热刺队以10人10人战平曼联，让卡里克的决策进一步受到质疑。曼联主帅未能就球队本赛季迄今为止表现不佳给出很多答案；接下来是一个决定性的时期

paras.en: "We couldn't find a way to get ourselves into the game. With the ball, without the ball, we were off it." A fair assessment from Michael Carrick, if not a wholly explanatory one.
paras.zh: “我们找不到一种方法让自己融入比赛。无论有球还是无球，我们都会偏离比赛。”迈克尔·卡里克的评价即使不是完全解释性的，也是公正的。

paras.en: Stuck in the mire of Manchester United's worst start to a league season for 40 years, the manager appeared lost for legitimate reasons. His margin for error is shrinking by the week.
paras.zh: 曼联陷入了40年来最糟糕的联赛开局泥潭，主教练似乎有正当理由迷失了方向。他的犯错余地每周都在缩小。

paras.en: Why were his side outplayed at home by the Premier League's bottom club? Why can't they hold onto leads? Why do they seem incapable of playing against 10 men?
paras.zh: 为什么他的球队在主场被英超排名垫底的球队击败？为什么他们不能抓住线索？为什么他们看起来无法与 10 个人对抗？

paras.en: All of these are fair questions to put to the man himself and many were asked of Carrick in the wake of Saturday's 1-1 draw with Spurs. None were answered with enough detail to satisfy, though, only really serving to hold a mirror up to what was delivered on the pitch: inadequacy.
paras.zh: 所有这些都是向卡里克本人提出的合理问题，在周六1-1战平热刺后，卡里克也被问了很多问题。然而，没有人给出足够详细的答复，让人们满意，只是真正起到了反映球场上所传达的内容的作用：不足。

paras.en: - Transfer Centre LIVE! | Man Utd news & transfers🔴
paras.zh: - 换乘中心上线！ |曼联新闻和转会🔴

paras.en: - Man Utd fixtures & scores | FREE Man Utd highlights▶️
paras.zh: - 曼联赛程和比分|免费曼联精彩集锦▶️

paras.en: - Got Sky? Watch Premier League games LIVE on your phone📱
paras.zh: - 有天空吗？在手机上观看英超联赛直播📱

paras.en: - Not got Sky? Latest Sky Sports deals or stream PL games with no contract📺
paras.zh: - 没有天空？最新天空体育优惠或无合同直播 PL 比赛📺

paras.en: Clearly the manager can only accept so much of the blame. His players are yet to offer a single complete performance, only bit-part displays of individualism and self-direction. Where is the cohesiveness that shaped the backend of last year? What happened to the clarity that turned a collapsed season into a third-place finish?
paras.zh: 显然，经理只能承担这么多的责任。他的球员们还没有提供一场完整的表演，只是个人主义和自我指导的零星表现。去年塑造后端的凝聚力在哪里？到底发生了什么，让一个崩溃的赛季变成了第三名？

paras.en: Fans who turn up to Old Trafford every week are back to being unsure. They do not know what to expect from one game to the next, only how to voice their dissatisfaction at what transpires. Three separate choruses of boos could be heard from the terraces on Saturday.
paras.zh: 每周都会来到老特拉福德球场的球迷们又开始变得不确定了。他们不知道从一场比赛到下一场比赛会发生什么，只知道如何表达他们对所发生的事情的不满。周六，露台上可以听到三声不同的嘘声。

paras.en: "I think the fans will stay with the project," reflected Gary Neville from Old Trafford. "I don't think the boos are against Michael Carrick for one minute. But what I would say is, they're turning quite quickly."
paras.zh: “我认为球迷们会继续支持这个项目，”老特拉福德的加里·内维尔反映道。 “我认为嘘声一分钟都不针对迈克尔·卡里克。但我想说的是，他们的转变很快。”

paras.en: When United needed a calm voice to steer the ship at the beginning of this year, they turned to a man whose entire playing career was built on it. That version of Manchester United feels far removed from the side that have begun this season, though.
paras.zh: 今年年初，当曼联需要一个冷静的声音来掌舵这艘船时，他们找到了一个整个职业生涯都建立在这个声音之上的人。不过，这个版本的曼联感觉与本赛季开始的球队相去甚远。

paras.en: In midfield is where the problems are most evident. And yet, that is the department that received the biggest injection of cash this summer, a complete overhaul in terms of personnel and profiles. The Kobbie Mainoo-Youri Tielemans axis is not working. Andrey Santos is barely getting a look in.
paras.zh: 中场是问题最明显的地方。然而，该部门今年夏天获得了最大的现金注入，在人员和形象方面进行了彻底的改革。 Kobbie Mainoo-Youri Tielemans 轴不起作用。安德烈·桑托斯 (Andrey Santos) 几乎没有进去看看。

paras.en: Hopes that Carlos Baleba can hit the ground running after an injury-hit start were audible; his introduction after an hour lifted the whole stadium. Almost every touch was positive and he took care of the ball, completing 16 of 18 passes and creating as many chances as Bruno Fernandes managed all game (2).
paras.zh: 人们对卡洛斯·巴莱巴（Carlos Baleba）在开局受伤后能够重新出发充满希望。一小时后他的介绍让整个体育场沸腾了。几乎每次触球都是积极的，他控球，18次传球完成16次，创造的机会与布鲁诺·费尔南德斯整场比赛创造的机会一样多（2次）。

paras.en: Still, the space and freedom with which Spurs operated presents issues that cannot be solved by one midfielder. United were carved open time after time, gaps appearing in a myriad of ways. The visitors were able to win possession in the final third five times in the first half alone. Five of United's work-shy starters did not go away for international duty over the break.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，热刺的空间和自由度仍然是一名中场球员无法解决的问题。曼联一次又一次地被打开，差距以多种方式出现。仅在上半场，客队就在最后三分之一区五次赢得控球权。曼联的五名不愿工作的首发球员在中场休息期间没有缺席国际比赛。

paras.en: And it was not just the aggressiveness of Spurs' press that was effective. They picked holes in United with the ball, too, using slick one-touch combinations to move through the thirds with pace and purpose. Savio attempted 10 dribbles. He only completed half but the recurrence was evidence of his belief that United could be got at. He was right.
paras.zh: 有效的不仅仅是热刺的进攻性压迫。他们也用球在曼联中寻找漏洞，利用灵活的一触球组合，以速度和目标穿过三分线。萨维奥尝试了 10 次带球。他只完成了一半，但再次出现证明了他相信曼联可以被击败。他是对的。

paras.en: Then there are concerns over the mentality of a side who repeatedly fail to beat 10 men. Yet again, United were outrun and outpaced - this time by a team who played with a man less for 21 minutes, including stoppage time.
paras.zh: 此外，人们还担心这支屡次未能击败10人的球队的心态。曼联再一次被追上，速度也被超越——这一次是被一支少人踢球21分钟（包括伤停补时）的球队所追赶。

paras.en: "If we're ahead in the game, we have to see it out," says Carrick. That much is obvious. What is less clear is how some of these patterns of missteps are going to be addressed.
paras.zh: “如果我们在比赛中领先，我们就必须坚持下去，”卡里克说。这是显而易见的。不太清楚的是如何解决其中一些失误模式。

paras.en: "Football is character," concluded opposition boss Roberto De Zerbi. United must find some character from somewhere, or risk being eaten up by the competition. If the last few weeks have taught us anything, it's that the Premier League is in no mood to be handing out sympathy.
paras.zh: “足球就是性格，”反对派主帅罗伯托·德泽尔比总结道。曼联必须从某个地方找到一些有特色的人，否则就有被竞争对手吞噬的风险。如果说过去几周教会了我们什么的话，那就是英超联赛没有心情表示同情。

paras.en: Four of Man Utd's next five games are away from home, including their next three.
paras.zh: 曼联接下来的五场比赛中有四场是客场比赛，包括接下来的三场比赛。

articles.title: Lewis: Fury has mental edge over AJ

paras.en: Fury vs Joshua: Lennox Lewis says Tyson Fury should win the mental game, but praises Anthony Joshua's physicality
paras.zh: 富里 vs 约书亚：伦诺克斯·刘易斯表示泰森·富里应该赢得心理比赛，但赞扬安东尼·约书亚的身体素质

paras.en: Thirty-three years ago Lennox Lewis defended his WBC belt in Cardiff in the first all-British heavyweight world title fight; He gave his thoughts as Cardiff now plays host to its second 'Battle of Britain' bout as Tyson Fury and Anthony Joshua prepare to touch gloves on December 11
paras.zh: 三十三年前，伦诺克斯·刘易斯在卡迪夫举行的第一场全英重量级世界拳王头衔争夺战中卫冕了自己的 WBC 拳王金腰带；在卡迪夫举办第二场“不列颠之战”之际，泰森·富里和安东尼·约书亚准备在 12 月 11 日触摸拳套时，他表达了自己的想法

paras.en: Heavyweight legend Lennox Lewis gives Tyson Fury the mental edge over Anthony Joshua ahead of their all-British showdown in December.
paras.zh: 重量级传奇人物伦诺克斯·刘易斯 (Lennox Lewis) 在 12 月与安东尼·约书亚 (Anthony Joshua) 的全英对决中为泰森·富里 (Tyson Fury) 提供了精神上的优势。

paras.en: Fury's rivalry with Joshua dates back almost a decade and the heavyweight stars will now fight on December 11 at the Principality Stadium in Cardiff.
paras.zh: 富里与约书亚的竞争可以追溯到近十年前，两位重量级明星将于 12 月 11 日在卡迪夫公国体育场展开对决。

paras.en: "I think it's very important for British history and for the British fans as well," Lewis, the former undisputed heavyweight champion, told Sky Sports.
paras.zh: “我认为这对英国历史和英国球迷来说都非常重要，”前无可争议的重量级冠军刘易斯告诉天空体育。

paras.en: - 'Could be in the first round' - AJ plots 'spectacular' win over Fury
paras.zh: - “可能会进入第一轮” - AJ 计划以“壮观”的方式战胜富里

paras.en: - 'They'll be hating each other!' - Nelson: Don't let AJ and Fury smiles fool you!
paras.zh: - “他们会互相憎恨！” - Nelson：别让 AJ 和 Fury 的笑容欺骗了你！

paras.en: - Latest Sky Sports deals or stream with no contract on NOW📺
paras.zh: - 立即观看最新的天空体育优惠或无合同直播📺

paras.en: "This is a unique fight, It's a great fight and it's a fight that everybody's been waiting for."
paras.zh: “这是一场独特的战斗，这是一场伟大的战斗，也是一场每个人都在等待的战斗。”

paras.en: The boxing legend however was not so forthcoming in calling the result.
paras.zh: 然而，这位拳击传奇人物并没有那么乐意宣布结果。

paras.en: "Styles make fights," Lewis said. "And I think this fight is going to make for a good fight because both of them have two different styles.
paras.zh: “风格引发战斗，”刘易斯说。 “我认为这场比赛将会是一场精彩的比赛，因为他们都有两种不同的风格。

paras.en: "I think the fight may go the distance but both of them have knockout power. Anything can happen.
paras.zh: “我认为这场战斗可能会持续很长时间，但他们都有击倒对手的力量。任何事情都有可能发生。

paras.en: "I think that Tyson's winning on the mental, and on the physical I think it's Anthony Joshua."
paras.zh: “我认为泰森在精神上获胜，而在身体上我认为是安东尼·约书亚。”

paras.en: Lewis understands better than anyone the significance of a major fight on UK soil, he was one half of history's first all-British heavyweight title fight when he fought Frank Bruno.
paras.zh: 刘易斯比任何人都更了解在英国土地上进行一场重大比赛的重要性，当他与弗兰克·布鲁诺对决时，他是历史上第一场全英国重量级冠军争夺战的一半。

paras.en: Flashback to October 1 1993, as rain hammered down on Cardiff's now-demolished National Stadium, the predecessor of the Principality.
paras.zh: 时间回到 1993 年 10 月 1 日，当时大雨倾盆而下，卡迪夫国家体育场（卡迪夫公国的前身）现已被拆除。

paras.en: The stormy scene personified the bitter build-up and bad blood between the fighters, setting the stage for 'The Battle of Britain'.
paras.zh: 暴风雨的场景体现了战士们之间的痛苦积怨和不和，为“不列颠之战”奠定了基础。

paras.en: Despite controlling much of the first six rounds, Bruno was stunned in the seventh. A powerful left hook from Lewis stopped him in his tracks, before a barrage of unanswered punches bombarded Bruno and the referee had no other choice but to end the contest and ultimately raise Lewis' glove in triumph.
paras.zh: 尽管布鲁诺在前六轮比赛中控制了大部分比赛，但在第七轮比赛中却陷入了困境。刘易斯一记强力的左勾拳阻止了他，随后一连串未得到回应的拳头轰击了布鲁诺，裁判别无选择，只能结束比赛，最终刘易斯举起了手套，取得了胜利。

paras.en: Now, 33 years later, Cardiff hosts its second pair of Brits hoping to at long last settle their own feud, one that's persisted through nearly a decade of contractual disagreements, verbal sparring and false hopes.
paras.zh: 33 年后的今天，卡迪夫迎来了第二对英国人，他们希望最终能解决他们之间的不和，这场不和已经持续了近十年的合同分歧、口角和虚假的希望。

paras.en: Jeopardy struck over disagreements where the fight would take place, with Joshua's camp adamant it must happen in the UK.
paras.zh: 约书亚阵营坚称比赛必须在英国举行，《危险边缘》因在比赛地点发生分歧而陷入困境。

paras.en: With Wembley all but ruled out due to US broadcasting requirements and New York's Madison Square Garden being considered, eventually Cardiff was selected, echoing the history of Lewis and Bruno.
paras.zh: 由于美国转播要求，温布利几乎被排除在外，而纽约的麦迪逊广场花园也在考虑之中，最终选择了卡迪夫，这与刘易斯和布鲁诺的历史相呼应。

paras.en: The Principality Stadium is where Joshua defeated Carlos Takam and Joseph Parker, it also has a retractable roof meaning the weather will not be too much of factor.
paras.zh: 公国体育场是约书亚击败卡洛斯·塔卡姆和约瑟夫·帕克的地方，它还有一个可伸缩的屋顶，这意味着天气不会造成太大影响。

paras.en: It has been a long time in the making. "This fight is finally here and both guys want the fight, and both guys are ready for the fight," Lewis said.
paras.zh: 它已经酝酿了很长时间了。刘易斯说：“这场战斗终于到来了，两个人都想要战斗，而且两个人都做好了战斗的准备。”

paras.en: "They just have to go to training camp and bring it on."
paras.zh: “他们只需要去训练营并表现出来。”

paras.en: The main event on the third day of the Welsh Racing Festival is the DragonBet Cefnogi Rasio Ceffylau Cymreig Handicap Hurdle where Service Minimum and Leader Crik lock horns.
paras.zh: 威尔士赛马节第三天的主要赛事是 DragonBet Cefnogi Rasio Ceffylau Cymreig Handicap Hurdle，Service Minimum 和 Leader Crik 展开角逐。

paras.en: The Nigel and Willy Twiston-Davies team continue in great form, and Leader Crik looks to have leading claims on his first dip into handicap company. A 12-length winner of a Doncaster maiden hurdle in February, he steps up in distance and rates a key player under Sam Twiston-Davies.
paras.zh: Nigel 和 Willy Twiston-Davies 团队继续保持着良好的状态，领导者 Crik 看起来在他第一次涉足障碍公司时就拥有领先地位。作为二月份唐卡斯特首次跨栏比赛的 12 杆冠军，他在距离上取得了进步，并被认为是山姆·特威斯顿-戴维斯麾下的关键球员。

paras.en: Service Minimum is another who arrives on the back of a success, having scored at Newton Abbot last month. She is up another six pounds but could have more to give now tackling further.
paras.zh: 服务最低限度是另一位取得成功的球员，上个月在牛顿阿伯特取得了进球。她又增加了六磅，但现在还可以进一步努力。

paras.en: Matty's Getaway must be considered after he finished last season with a game victory at Haydock and a reproduction of that would see him go close.

paras.zh: 状态良好的哈斯男孩在 DragonBet Born In Wales 老年人障碍栏的精彩更新中寻求帽子戏法。

paras.en: The Chester Williams-trained nine-year-old sprung back to life off a lesser mark at Wincanton in March before following up at Ascot the same month. He returns from a summer break with obvious chances off this lower hurdles mark.
paras.zh: 这位接受切斯特·威廉姆斯训练的九岁赛马在三月份的温坎顿赛上取得了不小的成绩，随后在同月的阿斯科特赛场上继续比赛。他从暑假回来，显然有机会突破这个较低的障碍。

paras.en: Ooh Betty is the chief danger for Ben Clarke and Ben Jones. She landed the Grade Two Warfield Mares' Hurdle at Ascot in January and ran with credit at Cheltenham and Ayr. This is a drop in grade and she should be involved.
paras.zh: 哦，贝蒂是本·克拉克和本·琼斯的主要危险。一月份，她在阿斯科特赛马场获得了二级战地马匹栏的成绩，并在切尔滕纳姆和艾尔赛跑中获得了荣誉。这是成绩下降的事情，她应该参与其中。

paras.en: Norn Iron and Gower Prince are a consistent pair, while Glengouly is worth a mention switched back to hurdles.
paras.zh: 诺恩·艾恩 (Norn Iron) 和高尔·普林斯 (Gower Prince) 是一对稳定的搭档，值得一提的是，格伦古利 (Glengouly) 又回到了跨栏。

paras.zh: 激动人心的三人组 Princess Day、Divine Diva 和 Connells Cross 在 DragonBet / EBF Mares 的“National Hunt”新手跨栏比赛中展开对决。

paras.en: Princess Day showed excellent form winning her first two bumpers after landing her sole point and was sent off 2/1 favourite when beaten in the Aintree Grade Two in April. Finishing ahead of the reopposing Divine Diva, she looks one to follow over hurdles this season.
paras.zh: 公主戴 (Princess Day) 表现出色，在获得唯一一分后赢得了前两场胜利，并在 4 月份的安特里二级比赛中以 2/1 的优势被淘汰。她领先于再次对手的神圣天后，看起来是本赛季能够跨越障碍的人。

paras.en: Divine Diva, a point-to-point winner last March, ran a screamer when third in Listed company at Cheltenham in November before finishing well beaten in that Aintree event. That can be forgiven and she remains a useful prospect.

paras.en: Connells Cross scored on two of her three bumper starts for Jennie Candlish and makes her hurdling and stable debut for Kim Bailey and Mat Nicholls. A tongue-tie goes on but she could be above average.
paras.zh: 康奈尔斯·克罗斯 (Connells Cross) 为珍妮·坎德利什 (Jennie Candlish) 的三场精彩首发中的两场得分，并为金·贝利 (Kim Bailey) 和马特·尼科尔斯 (Mat Nicholls) 完成了跨栏和稳定的首秀。虽然舌系带有些打结，但她可能会高于平均水平。

articles.title: Flydubai pilot planned a 9/11-style attack on Tel Aviv airport, source says
articles.author: Keir Simmons

paras.en: TEL AVIV — The pilot accused of trying to bring down an Israel-bound flight had been planning a 9/11-style attack by crashing into the country’s main airport in Tel Aviv, a Middle Eastern official has told NBC News.
paras.zh: 特拉维夫——一名中东官员告诉 NBC 新闻，被指控试图击落一架飞往以色列的航班的飞行员一直在策划一场 9/11 式的袭击，撞向特拉维夫的该国主要机场。

paras.en: The pilot, identified by NBC News as Hamman al-Hamammi, told investigators Monday that he wanted to evade Israel’s defenses and crash into the Ben Gurion Airport or another building, said the official, who spoke on condition of anonymity because the person was not authorized to speak publicly.
paras.zh: 这位被 NBC 新闻确认为哈曼·哈马米 (Hamman al-Hamammi) 的飞行员周一告诉调查人员，他想躲避以色列的防御并撞向本古里安机场或另一座建筑，该官员表示，由于未获授权公开发言，该官员要求匿名。

paras.en: Multiple sources from three agencies briefed on the investigation and a diplomat in the Middle East identified al-Hammami, an Omani citizen. Authorities have not officially released the identity.
paras.zh: 来自三个机构的多个消息来源通报了调查情况，一名中东外交官确认了阿曼公民哈马米的身份。当局尚未正式公布该身份。

paras.en: He is currently being questioned by investigators in the United Arab Emirates after he was transferred from Saudi Arabia. The flight from Dubai to Tel Aviv was diverted to an airport in Saudi Arabia, where it landed safely, after last week’s dramatic midair incident.
paras.zh: 他从沙特阿拉伯被转移后，目前正在阿拉伯联合酋长国接受调查人员的讯问。在上周发生戏剧性的空中事件后，这架从迪拜飞往特拉维夫的航班被转移到沙特阿拉伯的一个机场并安全降落。

paras.en: Emirati authorities said Saturday that the pilot attacked his fellow pilot, Capt. Smit Machchhar, with a crash ax and tried to take control of the aircraft’s flight controls.
paras.zh: 阿联酋当局周六表示，这名飞行员用一把坠毁斧袭击了他的飞行员同伴斯密特·马赫恰尔机长，并试图控制飞机的飞行控制装置。

paras.en: The jet, which was carrying 174 passengers, most of them Israeli, then plummeted 14,000 feet in just 29 seconds, according to data from the aviation tracking service Flightradar24, causing panic onboard.
paras.zh: 根据航空跟踪服务 Flightradar24 的数据，这架飞机载有 174 名乘客，其中大多数是以色列人，然后在短短 29 秒内从 14,000 英尺的高度坠落，引起机上恐慌。

paras.en: Machchhar, an Indian national and a veteran pilot of 17 years, said in a call Friday with Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu that his fellow pilot told him he was going to pray, something he didn’t consider unusual as observant Muslims pray five times a day.
paras.zh: 马赫哈尔是一名印度公民，也是一名拥有 17 年飞行经验的资深飞行员。他周五在与以色列总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡的通话中表示，他的飞行员同伴告诉他，他要祈祷，他认为这并不罕见，因为虔诚的穆斯林每天祈祷五次。

paras.en: A few minutes later, he said he felt a strong blow to the head. “Because of his initial blows, my vision was almost like nothing, and I was completely blurred out,” he added. “The next feeling that I had was that the aircraft was sharply going down.”
paras.zh: 几分钟后，他说他感到头部受到重击。 “由于他最初的打击，我的视力几乎为零，我完全模糊了，”他补充道。 “我的下一个感觉是飞机正在急剧下降。”

paras.en: A video of the call was released by Netanyahu’s office.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡办公室发布了通话视频。

paras.en: Initially, Machchhar said, he thought there was “catastrophic damage to the aircraft,” but once the blows kept coming, he “realized that it’s not the aircraft, it’s the other guy who was in the cockpit with me.”
paras.zh: 马赫恰尔说，最初，他认为“飞机遭受了灾难性损坏”，但当撞击不断发生时，他“意识到问题不是飞机，而是和我一起在驾驶舱里的另一个人。”

paras.en: In a separate call with Indian Prime Minister Narendra Modi, also Friday, Machchhar said he managed to open the cockpit’s door on the second attempt, despite the blows raining down.
paras.zh: 同样在周五与印度总理纳伦德拉·莫迪的另一次通话中，马赫恰尔表示，尽管猛烈的攻击，他在第二次尝试中成功打开了驾驶舱的门。

paras.en: “I gave everything that I had and just went for the door and opened the door. And thankfully, people were waiting to pounce back,” he said.
paras.zh: “我倾尽全力，走到门口，打开了门。值得庆幸的是，人们正在等待着反击，”他说。

paras.en: Focus has shifted onto the missed security signals ahead of the flight.
paras.zh: 焦点已转移到飞行前错过的安全信号上。

paras.en: Citing sources familiar with the matter, The Wall Street Journal reported Saturday that al-Hammami had “previously been banned from flying by Oman over concerns he had adopted radical ideological views.”
paras.zh: 《华尔街日报》周六援引知情人士的话报道称，哈马米“此前曾因担心他采取激进的意识形态观点而被阿曼禁止乘坐飞机”。

paras.en: It is unclear how a citizen of Oman, an Arab country with no diplomatic relations with Israel, was allowed to fly the plane carrying Israelis to Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 目前还不清楚与以色列没有外交关系的阿拉伯国家阿曼的公民如何被允许驾驶载有以色列人的飞机飞往特拉维夫。

paras.en: According to Israeli law, airlines must provide information about passengers and crew members, including their names and nationalities, up to 48 hours before a flight.
paras.zh: 根据以色列法律，航空公司必须在航班起飞前 48 小时内提供乘客和机组人员的信息，包括姓名和国籍。

paras.en: Israeli investigators are leaning toward the assessment that the pilot was acting as a lone wolf, according to an Israeli official and a source familiar with the matter, although they said there is still more to learn about what led to his radicalization.
paras.zh: 据一名以色列官员和一位知情人士透露，以色列调查人员倾向于认为这名飞行员是“独狼”，不过他们表示，关于导致他变得激进的原因，还有更多信息需要了解。

paras.en: In the meantime, Netanyahu has called on the head of the National Security Council to appoint an examiner to review “all security aspects” of Israel’s civil aviation in the aftermath of the incident.
paras.zh: 与此同时，内塔尼亚胡呼吁国家安全委员会主席任命一名审查员，对事件发生后以色列民航的“所有安全方面”进行审查。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Vice President JD Vance underlined the concerns about potential security failures.
paras.zh: 在其他地方，副总裁 JD Vance 强调了对潜在安全故障的担忧。

paras.en: “That person should not have been flying an airline, and so we’re certainly looking at our procedures within the United States to make sure that people who are obviously flight risks are not getting behind the wheel of an airplane,” he told a reporter at Joint Base Andrews, Maryland, on Monday.
paras.zh: 他周一在马里兰州安德鲁斯联合基地对记者表示：“那个人不应该乘坐航空公司的航班，因此我们肯定会审查美国境内的程序，以确保明显有飞行风险的人不会驾驶飞机。”

articles.title: Russia says no plague found in contacts of Siberian lab worker who died
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: Plague had not been detected among close contacts of a worker in an anti-plague laboratory in Siberia who died last week, with 60% of the identified group tested so far, officials in Russia said Tuesday.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯官员周二表示，西伯利亚一家抗鼠疫实验室上周死亡的一名工作人员的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫，目前已对已确定人群中的 60% 进行了检测。

paras.en: News from Russia’s consumer and health watchdog Sunday that a female staffer at the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East had died from a “pneumonia of undetermined” origin last week has raised public health fears worldwide.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯消费者和健康监管机构周日发布消息称，西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所的一名女工作人员上周死于“不明原因肺炎”，这一消息引发了全世界的公共卫生担忧。

paras.en: “Laboratory testing identified two cases of Covid-19 and two cases of rhinovirus infection,” watchdog Rospotrebnadzor said in a statement, referring to the virus that causes the common cold. “No other infectious disease pathogens were detected among the contacts,” the statement said, without mentioning the word “plague.”
paras.zh: 监管机构 Rospotrebnadzor 在一份声明中表示，“实验室检测发现了两例 Covid-19 病例和两例鼻病毒感染病例”，指的是引起普通感冒的病毒。声明称，“在接触者中未发现其他传染病病原体”，但没有提及“鼠疫”一词。

paras.en: U.S. President Donald Trump said Tuesday he had a call scheduled with Russian President Vladimir Putin to discuss the matter.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普周二表示，他计划与俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京通话，讨论此事。

paras.en: Darya Shipilova, 28, was identified by her mother and Russian media outlets as the lab worker who died.
paras.zh: 28 岁的达莉亚·希皮洛娃 (Darya Shipilova) 被她的母亲和俄罗斯媒体确认为死亡的实验室工作人员。

paras.en: Regional and national Russian authorities have not confirmed that plague was involved in her death. However, a State Department spokesperson said Monday there had been “reports of a fatal case of suspected pneumonic plague” in Irkutsk oblast.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯地区和国家当局尚未证实她的死亡与瘟疫有关。然而，美国国务院发言人周一表示，伊尔库茨克州有“疑似肺鼠疫死亡病例的报告”。

paras.en: Separately, a State Department official told NBC News on Tuesday that the U.S. had been in contact with the Russian government as early as Friday. Health experts at the State Department had taken part in the contact along with the Russian Foreign Affairs Ministry, the official said.
paras.zh: 另外，美国国务院一名官员周二对 NBC 新闻表示，美国早在周五就已与俄罗斯政府进行了接触。这位官员说，国务院的卫生专家与俄罗斯外交部一起参与了接触。

paras.en: The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention also said on X that it was “working across the U.S. government to assess developments as additional information becomes available.”
paras.zh: 美国疾病控制与预防中心也在 X 上表示，它“正在与美国政府合作，在获得更多信息时评估事态发展”。

paras.en: “At this time, there is no indication of a broader threat to the United States, but CDC and our interagency partners are prepared and will continue to monitor the situation closely,” it added.
paras.zh: 声明补充说：“目前没有迹象表明美国面临更广泛的威胁，但疾病预防控制中心和我们的跨机构合作伙伴已做好准备，并将继续密切监视局势。”

paras.en: The World Health Organization, which oversees global public health matters, said Tuesday that Russian health officials had informed it in response to its request about the lab worker’s death that no case of plague has been recorded in Irkutsk.
paras.zh: 负责监督全球公共卫生事务的世界卫生组织周二表示，俄罗斯卫生官员已根据其有关实验室工作人员死亡的要求告知其，伊尔库茨克尚未记录到鼠疫病例。

paras.en: “According to the authorities, the woman’s illness initially presented as a typical acute respiratory viral infection,” it said.
paras.zh: 声明称：“据当局称，该妇女的病情最初表现为典型的急性呼吸道病毒感染。”

paras.en: No case of plague or other high-threat pathogen has reportedly been found among the woman’s close contacts, the WHO said, quoting the response from the Russian officials, adding that it’s awaiting confirmation from the Russian side about “what pneumonia-causing pathogen had led to the individual’s death.”
paras.zh: 世界卫生组织援引俄罗斯官员的回应称，据报道在该妇女的密切接触者中尚未发现鼠疫或其他高威胁病原体病例，并补充说，正在等待俄罗斯方面确认“哪种肺炎病原体导致了该人的死亡”。

paras.en: On Friday, Maksim Modin, mayor of the Shelekhov municipal district near the border with Mongolia, said that the inpatient facility where the worker is said to have been treated had been closed for quarantine. Russian media cited officials saying that nearly 200 people who had been in contact with the woman had been placed under precautionary medical observation.
paras.zh: 周五，靠近蒙古边境的谢列霍夫市市长马克西姆·莫丁表示，据称这名工人接受治疗的住院设施已关闭进行隔离。俄罗斯媒体援引官员的话称，近200名与该女子有过接触的人已接受预防性医学观察。

paras.en: Russian media outlets have named the woman and identified her as being 28 years old. These details have not been announced by officials.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯媒体已公布这名女子的姓名，确认她今年 28 岁。这些细节尚未由官方公布。

paras.en: Irkutsk’s governor, Igor Kobsev, said Monday that no “microorganisms linked to the employee’s professional activities were detected” in her body.
paras.zh: 伊尔库茨克州州长伊戈尔·科布采夫周一表示，在她的体内“未检测到与该员工职业活动相关的微生物”。

paras.en: The Irkutsk regional branch of Rospotrebnadzor on Tuesday denied what it called “fake” reports circulating online that an “enhanced sanitary-epidemiological regime” and strict restrictions have been imposed in the region.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯联邦运输局伊尔库茨克地区分公司周二否认了网上流传的“虚假”报道，称该地区已实施“加强卫生流行病学制度”和严格限制。

paras.en: “No such decisions have been made at this time,” it said in a statement, saying the situation in the region remains stable.
paras.zh: 它在一份声明中表示，“目前尚未做出此类决定”，并称该地区局势保持稳定。

paras.en: Secretary of State Marco Rubio said Monday that even though there is “very limited travel between the U.S. and Russia,” if “something like that gets out, it could quickly spread.”
paras.zh: 美国国务卿马可·卢比奥周一表示，尽管“美国和俄罗斯之间的旅行非常有限”，但如果“类似的事情传出去，它可能会迅速蔓延。”

paras.en: Rospotrebnadzor, the health watchdog, said Tuesday its probe found “no incidents involving the handling of pathogenic microorganisms.”
paras.zh: 卫生监督机构 Rospotrebnadzor 周二表示，其调查发现“没有涉及处理病原微生物的事件”。

paras.en: Trump told reporters Monday the United States would do what it could to help Russia.
paras.zh: 特朗普周一告诉记者，美国将尽其所能帮助俄罗斯。

paras.en: “I hate to see them having it,” Trump said. “It’s a rough disease.”
paras.zh: “我讨厌看到他们拥有它，”特朗普说。 “这是一种很严重的疾病。”

paras.en: Meanwhile, some of Russia’s neighbors have been stepping up preventive measures and quarantine controls at border crossings.
paras.zh: 与此同时，俄罗斯的一些邻国一直在加强边境口岸的预防措施和检疫控制。

paras.en: The Kremlin has called for those concerned to heed official statements.
paras.zh: 克里姆林宫呼吁有关人士留意官方声明。

paras.en: “Rospotrebnadzor provides comprehensive information,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov said when reporters pressed him about rumors spreading amid sparse official statements.
paras.zh: 当记者追问克里姆林宫发言人德米特里·佩斯科夫（Dmitry Peskov）称，“俄罗斯联邦通讯社”提供了全面的信息。

paras.en: Peskov also deferred to Rospotrebnadzor when asked if the worker’s lab results would be released or if an autopsy has been conducted.
paras.zh: 当被问及是否会公布该工人的实验室结果或是否已进行尸检时，佩斯科夫也听取了俄罗斯联邦俄罗斯局的意见。

paras.en: On its website, the Irkutsk Anti-Plague Institute of Siberia and the Far East says it was founded in 1934 “as a scientific and operational body for combating plague,” but over the years, its scope of responsibility expanded to include “other highly dangerous diseases,” including cholera and anthrax.
paras.zh: 西伯利亚和远东伊尔库茨克抗鼠疫研究所在其网站上表示，它成立于 1934 年，“是一个抗击鼠疫的科学和业务机构”，但多年来，其责任范围扩大到包括“其他高度危险的疾病”，包括霍乱和炭疽。

paras.en: The institute says it’s a “multidisciplinary research and anti-epidemic facility” that helps ensure epidemic safety in the region.
paras.zh: 该研究所表示，这是一个“多学科研究和抗疫设施”，有助于确保该地区的疫情安全。

articles.title: At least 30 people killed as Russia bombs two buses in Ukraine
articles.author: Yuliya Talmazan

paras.en: At least 30 people were killed when a Russian bomb struck two buses in the Ukrainian front-line city of Kramatorsk on Thursday, local officials said, as Moscow’s intensifying attacks grow ever more deadly.
paras.zh: 当地官员称，周四，乌克兰前线城市克拉马托尔斯克的两辆公共汽车遭到俄罗斯炸弹袭击，造成至少 30 人死亡，莫斯科愈演愈烈的袭击变得越来越致命。

paras.en: Another 18 people were wounded when the bomb hit a street in the city at 10 a.m. local time (3 a.m. ET), Ukraine’s National Police said in a statement.
paras.zh: 乌克兰国家警察在一份声明中称，当地时间上午 10 点（美国东部时间凌晨 3 点），炸弹袭击该市街道，另有 18 人受伤。

paras.en: Kramatorsk’s regional governor, Vadym Filashkin, accused Russia of deliberately targeting civilians, sharing images of a charred bus wreckage and bodies and body parts on the road next to it. Filashkin said he was shutting down public transport in the city and neighboring Sloviansk in light of “the sharp deterioration of the security situation.”
paras.zh: 克拉马托尔斯克地区州长瓦迪姆·菲拉什金 (Vadym Filashkin) 指责俄罗斯故意针对平民，并分享了烧焦的巴士残骸以及旁边道路上的尸体和身体部位的图像。菲拉什金表示，鉴于“安全局势急剧恶化”，他将关闭该市和邻近斯洛维斯克的公共交通。

paras.en: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy said in a statement on his social media channels that Russia struck “an ordinary public transport stop” in Kramatorsk with an aerial bomb.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统泽连斯基在其社交媒体频道上发表声明称，俄罗斯用航空炸弹袭击了克拉马托尔斯克的“一个普通公共交通站点”。

paras.en: In a later post, he said doctors were fighting to save the lives of those injured and “some of those killed have still not been identified because of the severity of their injuries.”
paras.zh: 在后来的帖子中，他表示医生正在努力挽救伤者的生命，“由于伤势严重，一些遇难者的身份仍未确定。”

paras.en: Kramatorsk is close to the active front line and part of Ukraine’s industrial Donbas region, which has been central to Russian President Vladimir Putin’s war plans.
paras.zh: 克拉马托尔斯克靠近活跃的前线，也是乌克兰工业顿巴斯地区的一部分，该地区一直是俄罗斯总统弗拉基米尔·普京战争计划的核心。

paras.en: Civilian casualties have surged as Russia intensifies attacks across Ukraine, which is running low on air defense munitions.
paras.zh: 随着俄罗斯加强对乌克兰境内的袭击，平民伤亡人数激增，而乌克兰的防空弹药已经不足。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said in a social media post that it was important the country received “new packages for Ukraine’s defense” promised by its allies. “Supplies of anti-ballistic capabilities, ammunition for our combat aircraft and investments in interceptors — all of this is directly helping save lives every day,” he added.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基在社交媒体帖子中表示，该国收到其盟友承诺的“乌克兰国防新方案”非常重要。他补充说：“反弹道能力的供应、战斗机的弹药以及拦截器的投资——所有这些都在直接帮助每天拯救生命。”

paras.en: Russian bombs hit Ukrainian public buses
paras.zh: 俄罗斯炸弹袭击乌克兰公共汽车

paras.en: His comments came as Ukraine has suffered from an uptick in daytime attacks in recent weeks, creating a round-the-clock threat to civilians.
paras.zh: 他发表此番言论之际，乌克兰最近几周白天的袭击事件有所增加，对平民造成了全天候的威胁。

paras.en: Thursday’s strike came a day after a missile strike on a residential building in the north of the country killed 22 people, including five children.
paras.zh: 周四的袭击发生前一天，该国北部一栋住宅楼遭到导弹袭击，造成 22 人死亡，其中包括 5 名儿童。

paras.en: Zelenskyy visited the site of that attack Thursday, saying in a Telegram post: “Over a hundred residential buildings were damaged, as well as educational institutions, kindergartens, shops, enterprises, and infrastructure that supports normal life in the city.”
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基周四视察了袭击现场，并在一份电报中表示：“一百多栋住宅楼以及支持城市正常生活的教育机构、幼儿园、商店、企业和基础设施遭到破坏。”

paras.en: Moscow has repeatedly denied that it deliberately targets civilians in Ukraine.
paras.zh: 莫斯科一再否认其故意针对乌克兰平民。

paras.en: Elsewhere, Reuters reported Zelenskyy as saying that Ukrainian negotiators will visit the United States for talks Friday and Saturday.
paras.zh: 其他地方，路透社报道泽连斯基表示，乌克兰谈判代表将于周五和周六访问美国进行会谈。

paras.en: Urging President Donald Trump to step up pressure on Russia, he said: “One cannot, on the one hand, negotiate with the Russians about future economic projects, whilst on the other hand say that we find ourselves in some sort of ... diplomatic stalemate.”
paras.zh: 他敦促唐纳德·特朗普总统加大对俄罗斯的压力，他说：“我们不能一方面与俄罗斯就未来的经济项目进行谈判，另一方面又说我们发现自己陷入了某种……外交僵局。”

articles.title: From evading an abusive marriage to dying from a face lift, this is Nellie Melba
articles.author: Hannah Reich

paras.en: Dame Nellie Melba was the Kylie Minogue of her time, an opera singer from Richmond, Melbourne, who became a global superstar in the early 20th century.
paras.zh: 内莉·梅尔巴女爵士是她那个时代的凯莉·米洛，一位来自墨尔本里士满的歌剧歌手，在 20 世纪初成为全球超级巨星。

paras.en: The prima donna is immortalised on our $100 note (if you've seen one of those around lately), yet she seems to have a lost a bit of currency and is now seen by some as a bit musty, fusty and boring.
paras.zh: 这位首席女主角在我们的 100 美元纸币上永垂不朽（如果您最近见过其中一张），但她似乎失去了一点货币，现在被一些人视为有点发霉、陈旧和无聊。

paras.en: But when we made an episode about her (or two, as it turns out) on ABC history podcast The Dead Can't Sue, we discovered that her life was filled with drama and tragedy worthy of the best operas.
paras.zh: 但当我们在 ABC 历史播客《死者不能起诉》中制作一集（或两集，事实证明）有关她的剧集时，我们发现她的生活充满了戏剧性和悲剧性，值得最好的歌剧。

paras.en: It's no wonder a dessert, snack and an exit strategy all bear her name.
paras.zh: 难怪甜点、小吃和退出策略都以她的名字命名。

paras.en: Melba, whose real name was Helen Porter Mitchell, was born in 1861, the eldest of 10 surviving children. She played instruments and sang from an early age, under her mother's influence.
paras.zh: 梅尔巴（Melba）的真名是海伦·波特·米切尔（Helen Porter Mitchell），出生于 1861 年，是 10 个幸存孩子中的长子。在母亲的影响下，她从小就开始演奏乐器和唱歌。

paras.en: Her father was a building contractor whose fortunes were on the rise, but as a conservative presbyterian, he was opposed to music as a career for his daughter.
paras.zh: 她的父亲是一名建筑承包商，财富不断增加，但作为一名保守的长老会教徒，他反对女儿以音乐为职业。

paras.en: However, singing at church events or for charity was acceptable, so in 1869, eight-year-old Melba had her first public performance. The 700-strong audience demanded three encores from the kid.
paras.zh: 然而，在教堂活动或慈善事业上唱歌是可以接受的，因此 1869 年，八岁的梅尔巴进行了她的第一次公开表演。 700 多名观众要求孩子再演三首。

paras.en: Historian Leigh Boucher, co-host of The Dead Can't Sue, says: "She already had a reputation as this growing colonial gem."
paras.zh: 《死者不能起诉》的联合主持人、历史学家利·鲍彻 (Leigh Boucher) 表示：“她已经被誉为一颗不断成长的殖民瑰宝。”

paras.en: At the same time, Melba was also a tomboy, which led her father to pack her off to a boarding school for young women.
paras.zh: 同时，梅尔巴也是个假小子，这导致她的父亲将她送到了一所年轻女子寄宿学校。

paras.en: "[This] was more of a finishing school rather than a robust, rounded education. She ended up getting booted out for misbehaviour," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “[这]更像是一所精修学校，而不是健全、全面的教育。她最终因行为不当而被开除，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: Melba did end up with a well-rounded education, including in music, at Presbyterian Ladies College. Her cheekiness continued; in one instance she dressed up as a nun and solicited donations for a fake charity.
paras.zh: 梅尔巴最终在长老会女子学院接受了全面的教育，包括音乐方面的教育。她的厚颜无耻还在继续。有一次，她打扮成修女，为一家假慈善机构募集捐款。

paras.en: But Melba's joyful adolescence well and truly ended after her mother and a beloved sister died in 1880.
paras.zh: 但梅尔巴的快乐青春期随着她的母亲和心爱的妹妹于 1880 年去世而真正结束。

paras.en: After that, her father moved the family to Mackay in Queensland to run a sugar mill, and Melba, being the eldest daughter, had to run the household.
paras.zh: 此后，她的父亲举家搬到昆士兰州的麦凯经营一家糖厂，而作为长女的梅尔巴则不得不负责经营家庭。

paras.en: Melba gets hitched and finally makes her debut
paras.zh: 梅尔巴结婚并终于首次亮相

paras.en: Happily, Mackay was not, as she might've assumed, an uncultured colonial outpost and Melba slotted right into the town's thriving amateur music scene.
paras.zh: 令人高兴的是，麦凯并不像她想象的那样，是一个没有文化的殖民前哨，而梅尔巴正好融入了该镇蓬勃发展的业余音乐界。

paras.en: The 21-year-old also met Charles Nesbitt Frederick Armstrong, a son of an Irish baronet who had been sent to the colonies for being a troublemaker.
paras.zh: 这位 21 岁的年轻人还遇到了查尔斯·内斯比特·弗雷德里克·阿姆斯特朗 (Charles Nesbitt Frederick Armstrong)，他是一位爱尔兰男爵的儿子，因制造麻烦而被送往殖民地。

paras.en: After a whirlwind romance, they married in 1882 and had a son shortly after. Conflict quickly arose between them.
paras.zh: 经过一段旋风式的恋情后，他们于 1882 年结婚，不久就生下了一个儿子。他们之间很快就产生了冲突。

paras.en: "This is a young woman who has a controlling, dour, respectable father, and she's been swept up by this man with aristocratic heritage who's a bit wild," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “这是一个年轻的女人，她有一个控制欲强、严肃、令人尊敬的父亲，她被这个有贵族血统、有点狂野的男人迷住了，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: "But it turned out that she probably made the mistake I think many people have made … of trying to escape the rule of a patriarch and then ending up choosing another one instead."
paras.zh: “但事实证明，她可能犯了我认为很多人都犯过的错误……试图逃离族长的统治，然后最终选择了另一个族长。”

paras.en: Melba found herself raising a child, mostly on her own, and rarely getting to perform. She decided to return to Melbourne, ostensibly to raise her son alongside her family.
paras.zh: 梅尔巴发现自己大部分时间都是独自抚养孩子，很少有机会表演。她决定返回墨尔本，表面上是为了与家人一起抚养儿子。

paras.en: Once in Melbourne, she worked with a new vocal coach to train her in the bel canto style, which was popular in Europe's concert halls.
paras.zh: 到达墨尔本后，她与一位新的声乐教练一起训练她的美声风格，这种风格在欧洲音乐厅很流行。

paras.en: In 1884, Melba made her professional debut at Melbourne Town Hall and it was a raging success.
paras.zh: 1884年，梅尔巴在墨尔本市政厅首次亮相并获得巨大成功。

paras.en: "In Australian history, it was one of the most momentous debuts you could possibly imagine," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “在澳大利亚历史上，这是你能想象到的最重要的首次亮相之一，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: Melba's father finally appeared to support her ambitions. He had financed her singing classes and brought her to Europe where he was working, giving her a chance to pursue her operatic career.
paras.zh: 梅尔巴的父亲终于出现支持她的野心。他资助了她的歌唱课程，并将她带到了他工作的欧洲，给了她追求歌剧事业的机会。

paras.en: "On the trip to London, Charles began to try and exert a lot of control over her. There are stories about her turning up at breakfast [on the boat over] with bruises on her face," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “在去伦敦的旅途中，查尔斯开始尝试对她施加很大的控制。有报道称，她（在船上）吃早餐时脸上有瘀伤，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: It's no wonder that on her arrival in London in 1886, abused by her husband, hampered by nerves and without the right clothes or accent, Melba flopped her pivotal audition at Covent Garden.
paras.zh: 难怪梅尔巴 1886 年抵达伦敦时，受到丈夫的虐待，精神紧张，衣着不合身，口音也不好，她在考文特花园举行的关键试镜失败了。

paras.en: Undeterred, Melba travelled to Paris and became the student of German opera singer and teacher Mathilde Marchesi. She looked after her son and was barely scraping by.
paras.zh: 梅尔巴没有被吓倒，她前往巴黎，成为德国歌剧歌手兼教师玛蒂尔德·马尔凯西的学生。她照顾儿子，勉强度日。

paras.en: "But Mathilde Marchesi identified Nellie as having a singular talent," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “但玛蒂尔德·马尔切西认为内莉具有非凡的才能，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: Marchesi was a maternal figure to the young singer; she improved her vocal technique but also taught her European etiquette and encouraged her to take on her stage name.
paras.zh: 对于这位年轻歌手来说，马尔凯西就像一位母亲般的人物。她提高了她的声乐技巧，还教她欧洲礼仪，并鼓励她使用自己的艺名。

paras.en: "Together they came up with this identity that both harked back to her roots — Melba being Melbourne — but nonetheless, had an air of sophistication … it was not really a rebranding, I think, but a rebirth."
paras.zh: “他们共同提出了这个标识，既可以追溯到她的根源——梅尔巴就是墨尔本——但仍然有一种成熟的气息……我认为，这并不是真正的品牌重塑，而是一次重生。”

paras.en: Melba debuted as an opera singer in Brussels in 1887 and picked up roles across Europe, making a name for herself playing mad women.
paras.zh: 梅尔巴于 1887 年在布鲁塞尔以歌剧歌手身份首次亮相，随后在欧洲各地担任角色，因扮演疯女人而闻名。

paras.en: "She quickly became renowned as having a possibly once-in-a-generation voice … by 1890 she had broken through at London's Covent Garden, wiping the memory of that failed audition away."
paras.zh: “她很快就因拥有可能是千载难逢的声音而闻名……到 1890 年，她在伦敦考文特花园取得了突破，抹去了那次试镜失败的记忆。”

paras.en: She also began an affair with Philippe, the Duke of Orleans, a dashing heir to the French throne.
paras.zh: 她还与法国王位英俊的继承人奥尔良公爵菲利普开始了恋情。

paras.en: Eventually, after Charles used the adultery as grounds for divorce and essentially abducted their son to Texas where he had relocated, the marriage was over. She didn't see her son for 12 years.
paras.zh: 最终，在查尔斯以通奸作为离婚的理由，并将他们的儿子绑架到他搬迁的德克萨斯州后，婚姻结束了。她已经12年没有见到儿子了。

paras.en: "She was not destroyed by the divorce, and she was not destroyed by the loss of her son. In fact, she sunk herself into work," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “离婚并没有摧毁她，失去儿子也没有摧毁她。事实上，她全身心投入到工作中，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: Melba returned to Australia for a hugely successful tour in 1902.
paras.zh: 1902 年，梅尔巴回到澳大利亚，进行了一次非常成功的巡演。

paras.en: "There were these amazing scenes of her returning to Melbourne and the streets being filled with thronging masses of people," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “当她回到墨尔本时，街道上挤满了拥挤的人群，这些令人惊叹的场景，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: "Nellie was an Australian celebrity who not only was making it in Europe but was making it in European elite culture. She was proving that this was not a crass colony, but in fact a place of modernity."
paras.zh: “内莉是一位澳大利亚名人，她不仅在欧洲取得了成功，而且在欧洲精英文化中取得了成功。她正在证明这不是一个粗俗的殖民地，而实际上是一个现代化的地方。”

paras.en: But after returning to London and, whipped up by the press who claimed she had been replaced, Melba stood in the wings and rudely outsang a rival at the Royal Opera House.
paras.zh: 但回到伦敦后，在声称自己被取代的媒体的煽动下，梅尔巴站在了幕后，在皇家歌剧院粗鲁地击败了对手。

paras.en: "In this moment, an emerging celebrity culture just got the better of her," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “此时此刻，一种新兴的名人文化刚刚战胜了她，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: Melba regained her perch at the top of the opera hierarchy; beloved by the royal family, she had her own dressing room at Covent Garden.
paras.zh: 梅尔巴重新回到了歌剧界的顶端。她深受皇室喜爱，在考文特花园拥有自己的更衣室。
