paras.en: Then in World War I, she raised money for the war effort by going on a US tour. There she was reunited with her son, but the tour was also plagued by strange accidents.
paras.zh: 然后在第一次世界大战期间，她通过美国巡演为战争筹集资金。在那里，她与儿子团聚，但旅行也遭遇了奇怪的事故。

paras.en: "Nellie became convinced that the Germans are out to get her because she was such a useful tool for the morale of the war efforts," Boucher says.
paras.zh: “内莉开始相信德国人想要抓她，因为她是鼓舞战争士气的有用工具，”鲍彻说。

paras.en: By the 1920s Melba was in her 60s and decided to retire. This is how the phrase "doing a Melba" was invented, as she spent many years giving farewell concerts.
paras.zh: 到 1920 年代，梅尔巴已经 60 多岁了，决定退休。这就是“Doing a Melba”一词的由来，因为她多年来一直在举办告别音乐会。

paras.en: It was on one of those many extended farewell tours that she contracted a fever. In 1931 she died quite suddenly in Sydney of septicaemia, a complication from what the press described as "facial surgery".
paras.zh: 正是在众多长途告别旅行中的一次旅行中，她发烧了。 1931 年，她在悉尼因败血症突然去世，媒体将这种并发症称为“面部手术”。

paras.en: Boucher says, in a time without antibiotics, it was probably an early face lift.
paras.zh: 鲍彻说，在没有抗生素的时代，这可能是早期的整容术。

paras.en: "Her story is not reducible to this moment, but there is something in the ways in which she had to negotiate these gendered norms, negotiate the gendered restrictions of celebrity culture, and ended up dying from a face lift … that is tragic. It was a brutal end to an incredible life."
paras.zh: “她的故事不能简化为此时此刻，但她不得不与这些性别规范进行谈判，与名人文化的性别限制进行谈判，最终因整容而死……这是悲剧。这是一个令人难以置信的生命的残酷结局。”

paras.en: Fans and the press across the globe mourned the death of Melba.
paras.zh: 全球各地的球迷和媒体都对梅尔巴的去世表示哀悼。

paras.en: The New York Herald Tribune declared that she "was the last of those soprano empresses of song … Doubtless the gold age of song will return, but no Melba will sing for us again".
paras.zh: 《纽约先驱论坛报》宣称她“是最后一位女高音女皇……毫无疑问，歌曲的黄金时代将会回归，但梅尔巴将不再为我们歌唱”。

paras.en: This article is based on research by Leigh Boucher.
paras.zh: 本文基于 Leigh Boucher 的研究。

articles.title: Children of shark victim call for return to the ocean at his memorial
articles.author: Lucy Murray

paras.en: Hundreds of people attended a tribute to Perth father Greg O'Neill, who was killed by a shark off Sorrento beach last month.
paras.zh: 数百人参加了珀斯父亲格雷格·奥尼尔的悼念活动，他上个月在索伦托海滩被鲨鱼杀死。

paras.en: Mr O'Neill's children urged the crowd to "embrace life" and go back into the ocean.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔先生的孩子们敦促人群“拥抱生活”并回到海洋。

paras.en: Mr O'Neill's death has renewed calls for more shark monitoring ahead of summer.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔先生的去世再次呼吁在夏季之前加强鲨鱼监测。

paras.en: More than a thousand people, many dressed in blue, gathered on Perth's Sorrento beach today to pay tribute to Greg O'Neill, who was killed by a shark just off the shore a few weeks ago.
paras.zh: 今天，一千多人聚集在珀斯的索伦托海滩，悼念几周前在海岸附近被鲨鱼杀死的格雷格·奥尼尔，其中许多人穿着蓝色衣服。

paras.en: Son Keelan O'Neill urged the crowd to return to the water and "keep doing the things that you love", adding that his father would have wanted everyone to "embrace life to the fullest".
paras.zh: 儿子基兰·奥尼尔敦促人群回到水中，“继续做你喜欢的事情”，并补充说，他的父亲希望每个人“充分拥抱生活”。

paras.en: The 63-year-old was swimming close to the shoreline in September when he was attacked and killed by a large great white.
paras.zh: 9月份，这位63岁的老人在靠近海岸线的地方游泳时被一条大白鲨袭击并杀死。

paras.en: He was the third person killed by a shark in Western Australia so far this year.
paras.zh: 他是今年迄今为止西澳大利亚第三名被鲨鱼杀死的人。

paras.en: "He'd wish for you all to keep exercising … keep swimming, keep paddling, keep doing the things that you love as dad would have done, and the things that bring you happiness," Keelan O'Neill said.
paras.zh: 基兰·奥尼尔说：“他希望你们所有人继续锻炼……继续游泳，继续划船，继续做你们喜欢的事情，就像爸爸会做的那样，以及那些给你们带来快乐的事情。”

paras.en: Mr O'Neill's daughter Bianca thanked the crowd, saying: "The love, support and kindness we have received from this community is beyond belief."
paras.zh: 奥尼尔先生的女儿比安卡向人群表示感谢，她说：“我们从这个社区得到的爱、支持和善意令人难以置信。”

paras.en: "The water was dad's happy healing place, he wouldn't want anyone to feel unsafe, because of what happened."
paras.zh: “水是爸爸快乐的疗愈之地，他不希望任何人因为发生的事情而感到不安全。”

paras.en: The family was the first among the crowd to throw a handful of sand into the surf in memory of the beloved father, husband, brother and friend who frequented the beach.
paras.zh: 这家人是人群中第一个将一把沙子扔进海浪中的人，以纪念经常光顾海滩的深爱的父亲、丈夫、兄弟和朋友。

paras.en: Mr O'Neill's swimming group, the Sorrento Squids, were back in the water on Sunday, including, for the first time, the friend who was swimming with him on the day he was killed.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔先生的游泳队索伦托鱿鱼队周日重返水中，其中包括在他遇害当天与他一起游泳的朋友。

paras.en: Mr O'Neill's death was the third fatal shark attack in Western Australia this year and has reignited debate about how to keep beachgoers safe.
paras.zh: 奥尼尔的死亡是西澳大利亚州今年第三起致命的鲨鱼袭击事件，并重新引发了有关如何确保海滩游客安全的争论。

paras.en: A 'catch-and-kill' order was issued for the great white shark in September, but it was called off when the shark was not located.
paras.zh: 九月，政府对大白鲨发出了“捕捉并杀死”的命令，但由于找不到鲨鱼，命令被取消。

paras.en: Head of the Sorrento Surf Life Saving Club, Robert Doherty, said a shark barrier at the beach in Perth's north would ease concerns.
paras.zh: 索伦托冲浪救生俱乐部负责人罗伯特·多尔蒂表示，珀斯北部海滩的鲨鱼屏障将缓解人们的担忧。

paras.en: "I think something small, in an area of the beach, that doesn't affect the whole beach."
paras.zh: “我认为海滩某个区域的一些小事情不会影响整个海滩。”

paras.en: Many from the surf lifesaving club have been left shaken by the fatal attack, including members who witnessed the horror unfold firsthand.
paras.zh: 冲浪救生俱乐部的许多人都对这起致命袭击感到震惊，其中包括亲眼目睹恐怖事件的成员。

paras.en: "We gathered about 20-odd members that were directly involved that day and had a [counselling] session," Mr Doherty said.
paras.zh: “我们召集了大约 20 多名当天直接参与的成员，并进行了[咨询]会议，”多尔蒂先生说。

paras.en: "We thought it was really appropriate that the community does come together today to share a moment, dip your feet in the water."
paras.zh: “我们认为今天社区聚集在一起分享时刻，把脚浸入水中是非常合适的。”

paras.en: Those who entered the surf on Sunday did so under the watchful eye of Water Police, Marine Rescue Surf Life Savers and two shark-spotting drones.
paras.zh: 周日进入冲浪的人们是在水上警察、海上救援冲浪救生员和两架鲨鱼侦察无人机的监视下进行的。

articles.title: 'Incredibly difficult': Business reports robbery after crash injures five
articles.author: Niki Burnside

paras.en: Police investigating report massage parlour was robbed after shopfront car crash
paras.zh: 警方调查报告按摩店在店面车祸后被抢劫

paras.en: ACT Policing is investigating after a Canberra massage parlour was allegedly robbed following a car crash.
paras.zh: 堪培拉一家按摩院据称在车祸后遭到抢劫，首都领地警方正在对此进行调查。

paras.en: Authorities say five people were hospitalised in the crash in Weston at about 11:45am on Friday, including three workers.
paras.zh: 当局表示，周五上午 11 点 45 分左右，韦斯顿发生车祸，造成 5 人住院，其中包括 3 名工人。

paras.en: ACT Policing says it is following up on the reported burglary and is investigating the crash.
paras.zh: 首都领地警察局表示，正在对所报告的入室盗窃案进行​​后续调查，并对事故进行调查。

articles.title: India detains thousands as 'Cockroach' youth movement protests voter list revision
articles.author: Sheikh Saaliq

paras.en: India detains thousands as 'Cockroach' youth movement protests voter list revision
paras.zh: 印度因“蟑螂”青年运动抗议选民名单修改而拘留数千人

paras.en: Election Commission, government reject allegations of voter manipulation
paras.zh: 选举委员会和政府否认操纵选民的指控

paras.en: Indian authorities deployed a sweeping security crackdown across New Delhi and detained thousands of protesters Saturday as India’s youth "Cockroach" movement sought to intensify a nationwide campaign against a contentious voter list revision that has fuelled anger at Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s Hindu nationalist government and election authorities.
paras.zh: 印度当局周六在新德里展开了全面的安全镇压，并拘留了数千名抗议者，因为印度青年“蟑螂”运动试图加强全国范围内的运动，反对有争议的选民名单修改，这一修改激起了人们对总理纳伦德拉·莫迪领导的印度教民族主义政府和选举当局的愤怒。

paras.en: Police moved to break up the demonstration before it could begin, intercepting demonstrators on their way to Jantar Mantar, the designated protest site in the heart of India’s capital, chasing off some and detaining many others.
paras.zh: 警方在示威活动开始前采取行动，在前往印度首都市中心指定抗议地点简塔·曼塔天文台的途中拦截示威者，赶走了一些人，并拘留了许多人。

paras.en: Some demonstrators were dragged away before being bundled into police vehicles and taken to temporary detention centres. Several leaders of the Cockroach Janta Party (CJP), along with opposition lawmakers and student activists, were detained before arriving, effectively crippling the protest ahead of its start.
paras.zh: 一些示威者被拖走，然后被塞进警车并送往临时拘留中心。蟑螂简塔党（CJP）的几位领导人以及反对派议员和学生活动人士在抵达之前被拘留，实际上在抗议活动开始之前就陷入了瘫痪。

paras.en: The crackdown extended beyond the protest venue, with police stopping buses, cars and other vehicles at checkpoints on routes into the capital and searching for demonstrators. Jantar Mantar was barricaded, while anti-riot vehicles equipped with tear gas launchers were stationed along key routes.
paras.zh: 镇压行动超出了抗议场地范围，警方在通往首都的检查站拦截了公共汽车、汽车和其他车辆，并搜寻示威者。简塔·曼塔天文台被设置了路障，而配备催泪瓦斯发射器的防暴车则驻扎在主要路线上。

paras.en: Restrictions on mobile internet and access to parts of the city added to the hurdles facing protesters.
paras.zh: 对移动互联网和进入城市部分地区的限制增加了抗议者面临的障碍。

paras.en: Police said Friday they had denied permission for the protest because the request was submitted late.
paras.zh: 警方周五表示，他们已拒绝批准抗议活动，因为请求提交较晚。

paras.en: Sambit Patra, a spokesperson for Modi’s party, dismissed the demonstrators as "anarchic elements."
paras.zh: 莫迪政党发言人桑比特·帕特拉 (Sambit Patra) 将示威者斥为“无政府分子”。

paras.en: "Their flop show has been completely demolished," Patra said.
paras.zh: “他们的失败表演已经被彻底摧毁，”帕特拉说。

paras.en: The scale of the crackdown underscored the authorities’ determination to disrupt a fast-growing protest campaign that has mobilized thousands of young people, drawn opposition support and intensified scrutiny of Modi.
paras.zh: 镇压的规模凸显了当局破坏快速发展的抗议活动的决心，该活动动员了数千名年轻人，吸引了反对派的支持，并加强了对莫迪的审查。

paras.en: The protests also come at a politically sensitive time, months after demonstrations led by the movement over exam paper leaks forced Modi’s education minister to resign in July.
paras.zh: 这次抗议活动也是在政治敏感时期发生的，几个月前，考试卷泄露运动引发的示威迫使莫迪的教育部长于 7 月辞职。

paras.en: Movement leaders Abhijeet Dipke, Saurav Das and Ashutosh Ranka were expected to be at the forefront of the protest, but were detained after arriving at Delhi airport from Mumbai on Saturday. A video shared by the party on X showed police boarding the aircraft and detaining the three men.
paras.zh: 运动领导人阿比吉特·迪普克 (Abhijeet Dipke)、绍拉夫·达斯 (Saurav Das) 和阿舒托什·兰卡 (Ashutosh Ranka) 预计将成为抗议活动的最前线，但在周六从孟买抵达德里机场后被拘留。该党在 X 上分享的一段视频显示，警察登上了飞机并拘留了三名男子。

paras.en: "The pre-planned interception by Delhi Police aims to cripple the leadership of today’s peaceful demonstrations before they even reach the protest site," the movement said in a statement.
paras.zh: 该运动在一份声明中表示：“德里警方预先计划的拦截旨在削弱今天和平示威活动的领导层，甚至在他们到达抗议地点之前。”

paras.en: Loudspeakers around the protest site warned that gatherings of five or more people were banned in parts of New Delhi, as authorities imposed sweeping security restrictions rarely seen in the capital. Journalists also faced restrictions in some areas, with police briefly detaining some of them.
paras.zh: 抗议地点周围的扩音器警告说，新德里部分地区禁止五人或五人以上的集会，因为当局实施了首都罕见的全面安全限制。记者在某些地区也面临限制，警方短暂拘留了其中一些人。

paras.en: Protesters shout from a police bus after being detained in New Delhi on Saturday. (Adnan Abidi/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，抗议者在新德里被拘留后在警车上大喊大叫。 （阿德南·阿比迪/路透社）

paras.en: Some protesters nevertheless broke through police cordons, chanting slogans against Modi and election authorities before being detained.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，一些抗议者还是冲破了警方的警戒线，在被拘留之前高呼反对莫迪和选举当局的口号。

paras.en: "We are a democracy, yet peaceful protests are being crushed by force. Shouldn’t we fight for our rights?" said Tanya Negi, a college student who travelled from Mumbai with two friends and arrived early Saturday. "Why is Modi afraid of India’s young people?"
paras.zh: “我们是民主国家，但和平抗议却遭到武力镇压。我们难道不应该为自己的权利而战吗？”大学生坦尼娅·内吉 (Tanya Negi) 与两个朋友从孟买出发，于周六早些时候抵达。 “莫迪为什么害怕印度年轻人？”

paras.en: The police response marked an extraordinary show of force in a capital where Modi’s government has repeatedly sought to contain public dissent in the past. Under Modi, authorities have often used arrests and restrictions on public gatherings to contain demonstrations, raising questions about the space for protests in the world’s largest democracy.
paras.zh: 警方的反应标志着莫迪政府过去多次试图遏制公众异议的首都首都的非同寻常的武力展示。在莫迪的领导下，当局经常利用逮捕和限制公众集会的方式来遏制示威活动，引发人们对这个世界上最大民主国家的抗议空间的质疑。

paras.en: The latest crackdown renewed criticism from opposition leaders, who accused the government of curbing dissent.
paras.zh: 最新的镇压行动再次遭到反对派领导人的批评，他们指责政府压制异见。

paras.en: "Is there a democracy in this country? A total siege over the city. Citizens are being driven out," opposition lawmaker John Brittas told The Associated Press. Brittas was later detained by police.
paras.zh: “这个国家有民主吗？对这座城市的全面围困。公民被赶出，”反对派议员约翰·布里塔斯告诉美联社。布里塔斯后来被警方拘留。

paras.en: Voter list dispute raises election concerns
paras.zh: 选民名单争议引发选举担忧

paras.en: The protests centre on India’s Election Commission’s Special Intensive Revision, which the opposition says has disenfranchised millions of eligible voters. Protesters demand the resignation of Gyanesh Kumar, the chief election commissioner, and an end to the change, which has so far removed more than 130 million names from voter lists.
paras.zh: 抗议活动的焦点是印度选举委员会的特别密集修订，反对派称该修订剥夺了数百万合格选民的选举权。抗议者要求首席选举专员贾内什·库马尔(Gyanesh Kumar)辞职，并结束此次变革，迄今为止，这一变革已使超过1.3亿人的名字从选民名单中删除。

paras.en: The Election Commission and the government reject allegations of voter manipulation, saying the revision is intended to eliminate duplicate and ineligible entries.
paras.zh: 选举委员会和政府否认操纵选民的指控，称修订旨在消除重复和不合格的条目。

paras.en: Police officers detain a protester during a Saturday demonstration in New Delhi. (Ritesh Shukla/Getty Images)
paras.zh: 周六在新德里举行的示威活动中，警察拘留了一名抗议者。 （里泰什·舒克拉/盖蒂图片社）

paras.en: The dispute has become a rallying point for opposition parties seeking to challenge Modi’s Hindu nationalist Bharatiya Janata Party.
paras.zh: 这场争端已成为寻求挑战莫迪领导的印度教民族主义印度人民党的反对党的集结点。

paras.en: Saturday’s planned demonstration follows days of protests in the Indian capital where opposition lawmakers also stepped up their campaign, with Congress party leader Rahul Gandhi being briefly detained by police.
paras.zh: 周六计划举行的示威活动是在印度首都举行了数天的抗议活动之后举行的，反对派议员也加大了竞选力度，国大党领导人拉胡尔·甘地被警方短暂拘留。

paras.en: Gandhi and other opposition leaders have accused the commission of conducting the voter revision in a way that benefits Modi’s party. The opposition says voters more likely to support its parties have been disproportionately affected by the removals, while supporters of the BJP have been spared or added to the lists.
paras.zh: 甘地和其他反对派领导人指责该委员会以有利于莫迪政党的方式进行选民修改。反对派表示，更有可能支持其政党的选民受到了不成比例的影响，而印度人民党的支持者则幸免于难或被添加到名单中。

paras.en: The commission and the government deny the allegations.
paras.zh: 该委员会和政府否认这些指控。

paras.en: For the CJP movement, the voter list dispute offers an opportunity to broaden its campaign.
paras.zh: 对于 CJP 运动来说，选民名单争议提供了扩大其竞选范围的机会。

paras.en: Police prevent a detained protester from trying to escape from a bus during a protest by the Cockroach Janta Party in New Delhi on Saturday (Adnan Abidi/Reuters)
paras.zh: 周六，在新德里蟑螂简塔党的一场抗议活动中，警方阻止一名被拘留的抗议者试图逃离公交车（Adnan Abidi/路透社）

paras.en: The movement began online in May and gained prominence through demonstrations, sit-ins and hunger strikes over alleged exam paper leaks. Those protests culminated in the resignation of Modi’s education minister in July, a rare political setback for a prime minister who has maintained a firm hold on national power for more than 12 years.
paras.zh: 该运动于五月在网上开始，并通过示威、静坐和因涉嫌泄露试卷而进行的绝食而获得关注。这些抗议活动最终导致莫迪教育部长于 7 月辞职，这对于一位牢牢掌握国家权力 12 年多的总理来说是罕见的政治挫折。

paras.en: For Modi, the protests pose a challenge almost midway through his third term, though their political impact remains unclear.
paras.zh: 对于莫迪来说，抗议活动在他第三个任期的中期构成了挑战，尽管其政治影响尚不清楚。

paras.en: National elections are not due until 2029, but state elections next year in BJP-ruled Uttar Pradesh, India’s most populous state, and Gujarat, Modi’s home state, will test the party’s standing.
paras.zh: 全国选举要到 2029 年才会举行，但明年在印度人口最多的邦印度人民党统治的北方邦和莫迪的家乡古吉拉特邦举行的邦选举将考验该党的地位。

articles.title: Category 4 Hurricane Simon barrels toward Mexico

paras.en: Category 4 Hurricane Simon barrels toward Mexico
paras.zh: 4 级飓风西蒙正向墨西哥袭来

paras.en: Forecasters warn storm could produce destructive winds, deadly flooding
paras.zh: 预报员警告风暴可能会产生破坏性大风和致命的洪水

paras.en: Hurricane Simon strengthened into a powerful Category 4 storm off Mexico's Pacific coast on Saturday, threatening destructive winds, storm surges and potentially deadly flooding as it approaches landfall.
paras.zh: 周六，飓风西蒙在墨西哥太平洋沿岸增强为强大的四级风暴，在登陆时可能会带来破坏性大风、风暴潮和可能致命的洪水。

paras.en: The U.S. National Hurricane Center (NHC) said Simon was located about 185 kilometres south-southwest of Manzanillo on Saturday morning, packing maximum sustained winds of 240 km/h as it moved northward.
paras.zh: 美国国家飓风中心 (NHC) 表示，周六早上，西蒙位于曼萨尼约西南偏南约 185 公里处，在向北移动时，最大持续风速为 240 公里/小时。

paras.en: Simon is expected to approach the west-central coast of Mexico as a major hurricane late Saturday or early Sunday, and some additional strengthening remains possible before landfall, the NHC said.
paras.zh: 美国国家飓风中心表示，预计西蒙将在周六晚间或周日早些时候以大型飓风的形式逼近墨西哥中西部海岸，在登陆前仍有可能进一步增强飓风强度。

paras.en: A hurricane warning was in effect for portions of Mexico's Pacific coast south of the beach resort of Puerto Vallarta, including the area around Manzanillo, Mexico's largest Pacific port. A tropical storm watch was in effect farther south toward Lázaro Cárdenas.
paras.zh: 飓风警报对巴亚尔塔港海滩度假胜地以南的墨西哥太平洋海岸部分地区生效，包括墨西哥最大的太平洋港口曼萨尼约周围地区。热带风暴监视实际上正在向南延伸至拉萨罗卡德纳斯。

paras.en: The NHC urged residents in the warning area, which also includes the Islas Marías archipelago offshore, to rush preparations to protect life and property.
paras.zh: 国家卫生健康委员会敦促预警区域（还包括近海的玛丽亚群岛）的居民尽快做好准备，保护生命和财产。

paras.en: Workers board up mall windows with plywood in Puerto Vallarta, Mexico, on Saturday. (Fernando Llano/The Associated Press)
paras.zh: 周六，墨西哥巴亚尔塔港，工人们用胶合板封住商场的窗户。 （费尔南多·拉诺/美联社）

paras.en: "Simon has strengthened incredibly quickly, and that’s what makes storms like this so dangerous," said AccuWeather meteorologist Dan Pydynowski.
paras.zh: AccuWeather 气象学家丹·皮迪诺夫斯基 (Dan Pydynowski) 表示：“西蒙风暴的强度增强得令人难以置信，这就是像这样的风暴如此危险的原因。”

paras.en: "Strong winds could damage homes and businesses, while flooding and mudslides could wash out roads and make it difficult for emergency crews to reach some communities. Even after the storm passes, power outages and damaged infrastructure could make recovery challenging."
paras.zh: “强风可能会损坏房屋和企业，而洪水和泥石流可能会冲毁道路，使紧急救援人员难以到达一些社区。即使在风暴过去后，停电和基础设施受损也可能会给恢复带来挑战。”

paras.en: Mexican authorities warned that heavy rainfall was expected in the states of Guerrero, Michoacán, Colima and Jalisco.
paras.zh: 墨西哥当局警告称，格雷罗州、米却肯州、科利马州和哈利斯科州预计将出现强降雨。

paras.en: The NHC said Simon was expected to produce 10 to 20 inches (25 to 51 centimetres) of rain across portions of southwestern Mexico through Sunday, with isolated totals of up to 30 inches (76 centimetres) possible in parts of Michoacan, Colima and Jalisco. The rainfall could trigger life-threatening flooding and mudslides, especially in mountainous areas.
paras.zh: NHC表示，预计到周日，西蒙将给墨西哥西南部部分地区带来10至20英寸（25至51厘米）的降雨，米却肯州、科利马州和哈利斯科州部分地区的个别降雨总量可能高达30英寸（76厘米）。降雨可能引发危及生命的洪水和泥石流，特别是在山区。

paras.en: A storm surge is expected along the coast near and to the east of where the centre makes landfall, accompanied by large and destructive waves, the NHC said. Swells generated by Simon are expected to affect portions of Mexico's southwestern and west-central coast over the coming days, creating dangerous surf and rip current conditions.
paras.zh: 国家飓风中心表示，预计风暴潮中心登陆地点附近和东部的海岸将出现风暴潮，并伴有巨大的破坏性波浪。西蒙产生的海浪预计将在未来几天影响墨西哥西南和中西部海岸的部分地区，造成危险的海浪和离岸流条件。

paras.en: Simon is forecast to be near or just inland of Mexico's west-central Pacific coast on Sunday.
paras.zh: 预计西​​蒙将于周日到达墨西哥中西部太平洋海岸附近或内陆地区。

paras.en: Last week, Hurricane Polo made landfall on the Baja California Peninsula as a Category 2 storm, toppling trees and utility poles, flooding streets and causing other property damage.
paras.zh: 上周，飓风波罗以 2 级风暴的形式登陆下加利福尼亚半岛，导致树木和电线杆倒塌、街道被淹并造成其他财产损失。

articles.title: Children, pregnant woman among 9 dead in Pennsylvania shooting

paras.en: Children, pregnant woman among 9 dead in Pennsylvania shooting
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州枪击案致9人死亡，其中包括儿童和孕妇

paras.en: Erie police release few details but say suspect shooter among the dead
paras.zh: 伊利警方公布了一些细节，但称死者中有嫌疑枪手

paras.en: A shooting in a residential area of Erie, Pa., left nine people dead, including the suspected shooter, and rocked the city. Police said two children and a pregnant woman were among the dead.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州伊利市的一个住宅区发生枪击事件，造成包括枪手嫌疑人在内的九人死亡，震惊了整个城市。警方称，死者中有两名儿童和一名孕妇。

paras.en: Erie police Chief Rick Lorah said the 45-year-old male gunman was related to seven of the victims in Friday's shooting, while the eighth was a friend of the pregnant woman.
paras.zh: 伊利市警察局长里克·洛拉 (Rick Lorah) 表示，这名 45 岁的男性枪手与周五枪击事件中的七名受害者有亲属关系，而第八名受害者是孕妇的朋友。

paras.en: Video and audio evidence recovered by investigators showed two "distressed" women arriving at the home shortly before 5 p.m. and pounding on the door, he said. The gunman then came out and shot them before returning inside.
paras.zh: 调查人员找到的视频和音频证据显示，下午 5 点前不久，两名“痛苦”的妇女来到了这所房子。他说，并敲打着门。枪手随后出来向他们开枪，然后返回室内。

paras.en: Police arrived to find the two women dead outside. Inside they found the bodies of a five-year-old boy, a one-year-old girl, two more women, two young men and the shooter.
paras.zh: 警方赶到后发现两名女子已经死在外面。他们在里面发现了一名五岁男孩、一名一岁女孩、另外两名妇女、两名年轻男子和枪手的尸体。

paras.en: Lorah declined to discuss motive but said investigators would talk to other relatives and examine the cellphones of the women who were killed outside the home.
paras.zh: 洛拉拒绝讨论动机，但表示调查人员将与其他亲属交谈，并检查在家外被杀的妇女的手机。

paras.en: "They knew something was going on at that house," he said. "We have to figure out what that is."
paras.zh: “他们知道那所房子里发生了什么事，”他说。 “我们必须弄清楚那是什么。”

paras.en: Officers arrived within minutes of receiving an alert via ShotSpotter, a controversial gunshot detection system that relies on artificial intelligence and a network of microphones to identify gunshots. All nine deaths occurred before officers arrived, the city said, and no additional shots were fired after that.
paras.zh: 警察在通过 ShotSpotter 收到警报后几分钟内就赶到了，ShotSpotter 是一种有争议的枪击检测系统，依靠人工智能和麦克风网络来识别枪声。该市表示，所有九人死亡都发生在警察到达之前，此后没有再开枪。

paras.en: "Sounds heard during the police response that may have been mistaken for gunfire were flash bangs associated with law enforcement's tactical response," the city said.
paras.zh: 该市表示：“警方在反应过程中听到的声音可能被误认为是枪声，但实际上是与执法部门战术反应有关的闪光弹。”

paras.en: "I have not seen anything like this in my 28-plus years," Lorah told a local news station earlier in the day. "I'm not sure that the city of Erie has ever seen the loss of life and the devastation that we just witnessed."
paras.zh: 洛拉当天早些时候对当地一家新闻台表示：“我 28 多年来从未见过这样的事情。” “我不确定伊利市是否曾经历过我们刚刚目睹的生命损失和破坏。”

paras.en: Pennsylvania Gov. Josh Shapiro said he offered his administration's "full support" to Erie Mayor Daria Devlin.
paras.zh: 宾夕法尼亚州州长乔什·夏皮罗表示，他向伊利市市长达里亚·德夫林表示，他的政府将“全力支持”。

paras.en: Erie is located about 190 kilometres north of Pittsburgh.
paras.zh: 伊利位于匹兹堡以北约190公里处。

articles.title: EU pulls sponsorship from Disinfo2026 event in Lithuania

paras.en: The European Union on Thursday offered its reasons for withdrawing sponsorship for a disinformation event in Lithuania, following media reports claiming that it did so after pressure from the US government.
paras.zh: 欧盟周四提出了撤回对立陶宛虚假信息活动赞助的理由，此前有媒体报道称，欧盟是在美国政府的压力下这样做的。

paras.en: The EU's foreign affairs division, the European External Action Service (EEAS), and the governments of Canada and Lithuania all pulled their support from the event at short notice. Sponsors' logos on flyers and placards at the event were hastily covered over with paper strips.
paras.zh: 欧盟外交部门、欧洲对外行动署（EEAS）以及加拿大和立陶宛政府都在短时间内取消了对该活动的支持。活动传单和标语牌上的赞助商标志被匆忙用纸条覆盖。

paras.en: They withdrew participation in Disinfo2026 after pressure from the US State Department, according to reports in several media outlets, including the British newspaper The Guardian.
paras.zh: 据英国《卫报》等多家媒体报道，在美国国务院的压力下，他们退出了 Disinfo2026。

paras.en: EU spokesperson Christian Wigand made no mention of the US or external pressure on Thursday but also did not repudiate the reports.
paras.zh: 欧盟发言人克里斯蒂安·维甘德周四没有提及美国或外部压力，但也没有否认这些报道。

paras.en: "We were not comfortable with the framing of some of the discussions at the event," he told reporters in Brussels.
paras.zh: “我们对活动中一些讨论的框架感到不满意，”他在布鲁塞尔告诉记者。

paras.en: "The organizers chose to frame some of the discussions in way which does not align with the official positions held by the EU," he said.
paras.zh: “组织者选择以与欧盟官方立场不符的方式进行一些讨论，”他说。

paras.en: He refused to discuss details of which discussions or what framing had perturbed the EEAS. He also would not comment on whether there had been talks with US officials on the matter.
paras.zh: 他拒绝讨论哪些讨论或哪些框架扰乱了 EEAS 的细节。他也不愿评论是否与美国官员就此事进行了会谈。

paras.en: "I'm not commenting on diplomatic exchanges as a matter of principle," he said.
paras.zh: “原则上我不会评论外交交往，”他说。

paras.en: What signs of potential controversy at Disinfo2026 were visible?
paras.zh: Disinfo2026 上有哪些明显的潜在争议迹象？

paras.en: While a number of the sessions planned on the event's website across two days at the Radisson Blu Lietuva Hotel in Vilnius appeared to have the potential to perturb more sensitive members of Donald Trump's administration, the opening two sessions on Wednesday morning stood out.
paras.zh: 虽然该活动网站上计划在维尔纽斯丽笙酒店举行的为期两天的多场会议似乎有可能令唐纳德·特朗普政府中更敏感的成员感到不安，但周三上午开幕的两场会议却引人注目。

paras.en: The opening of the conference was an interview with Kimberly Prost, a judge at the International Criminal Court (ICC), which has come under sustained and heavy fire from Trump and his administration during his second term.
paras.zh: 会议开幕式是对国际刑事法院（ICC）法官金伯利·普罗斯特（Kimberly Prost）的采访，该法院在特朗普第二任期内受到了特朗普及其政府的持续猛烈攻击。

paras.en: This was followed by an hourlong session entitled "USA as a FIMI threat: acknowledge, adapt, push back," using the acronym for Foreign Information Manipulation and Interference. One of the planned speakers was a former CIA officer.
paras.zh: 接下来是一个长达一小时的会议，题为“美国作为 FIMI 威胁：承认、适应、反击”，使用外国信息操纵和干扰的缩写。计划的演讲者之一是一名前中央情报局官员。

paras.en: Strong US free speech safeguards in the First Amendment to its Constitution mean the US has maintained a comparatively hands-off approach to combating disinformation — both in the political and legal spheres. This has arguably intensified, however, under President Donald Trump's leadership, with critics alleging it's partly because of his own often uneasy relationship with the truth.
paras.zh: 美国宪法第一修正案对言论自由提供强有力的保障，这意味着美国在打击虚假信息方面一直保持着相对不干涉的态度——无论是在政治还是法律领域。然而，在唐纳德·特朗普总统的领导下，这种情况可以说有所加剧，批评者声称，部分原因是他自己与真相的关系经常不稳定。

paras.en: If you rely on our team for trusted reporting, please take a moment to select us as your Preferred Source on Google, so you'll always see our verified news first.
paras.zh: 如果您信赖我们团队的可信报道，请花点时间选择我们作为您在 Google 上的首选来源，这样您始终会首先看到我们经过验证的新闻。

articles.title: Finland, the world's happiest nation, faces a glum winter

paras.en: There's an uneasy mood in Finland, the country that's ranked the world's happiest for nine consecutive years. A colder-than-usual winter is on the way and so is the toughest austerity budget in years.
paras.zh: 芬兰这个连续九年被评为全球最幸福国家的国家，气氛有些不安。比平常更冷的冬天即将到来，多年来最严厉的紧缩预算也即将到来。

paras.en: With an election due in April, the argument is no longer how much to cut, but which services, benefits and pensions will face the biggest cuts.
paras.zh: 随着四月份的大选，争论的焦点不再是削减多少，而是哪些服务、福利和养老金将面临最大的削减。

paras.en: Finland's debt and deficit levels are in their worst state since the 1990s, when a banking crash and the collapse of the Soviet Union — a key export partner — pushed the Nordic nation into its own Great Depression.
paras.zh: 芬兰的债务和赤字水平正处于 20 世纪 90 年代以来最糟糕的状态，当时银行业崩溃和主要出口伙伴苏联的崩溃将这个北欧国家推入了大萧条。

paras.en: Finland's debt ratio climbed sharply since the COVID-19 pandemic
paras.zh: 自 COVID-19 大流行以来芬兰的债务比率急剧攀升

paras.en: Last month, Finland's national statistical institution confirmed that the national debt had reached 90.3% of gross domestic product (GDP) in the second quarter. Before the pandemic, that figure was around 65%.
paras.zh: 上个月，芬兰国家统计机构证实，第二季度国债已达到国内生产总值(GDP)的90.3%。在大流行之前，这一数字约为 65%。

paras.en: Trouble to the east is, again, part of the reason. Finland ramped up defense spending after joining NATO a year after Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Helsinki, which used to rely on Moscow for about a third of its energy, also faced much higher costs as it transitioned to other suppliers.
paras.zh: 东方的麻烦再次是部分原因。俄罗斯全面入侵乌克兰一年后，芬兰加入北约，增加了国防开支。赫尔辛基过去大约三分之一的能源依赖莫斯科，但在转向其他供应商时也面临着更高的成本。

paras.en: The Finnish government has spent more than it earns since the 2008/9 global financial crisis, partly due to an aging population and sluggish economic growth. Last month, the State Treasury projected the fiscal deficit would reach 4.2% of GDP in 2026.
paras.zh: 自2008/9年全球金融危机以来，芬兰政府的支出超过了收入，部分原因是人口老龄化和经济增长缓慢。上个月，国家财政部预计2026年财政赤字将达到GDP的4.2%。

paras.en: Brussels has piled pressure on Helsinki to bring down the borrowing gap, as European Union rules require member states to stay below 3% of GDP. In January, the European Council opened an excessive deficit procedure and gave Finland until the end of 2028 to reach the desired target.
paras.zh: 布鲁塞尔向赫尔辛基施加压力，要求其缩小借贷缺口，因为欧盟规则要求成员国将债务占 GDP 的比重保持在 3% 以下。 1月份，欧洲理事会启动了过度赤字程序，并要求芬兰在2028年底前达到预期目标。

paras.en: Prime Minister Petteri Orpo's government, which took office in June 2023, said it would aim to save about €9 billion ($10.1 billion) during this parliamentary term. But whoever wins the next election will have to cut much deeper, economists warn.
paras.zh: 2023 年 6 月上任的总理佩特里·奥尔波政府表示，其目标是在本届议会任期内节省约 90 亿欧元（101 亿美元）。但经济学家警告说，无论谁赢得下一次选举，都必须大幅削减开支。

paras.en: "The amounts currently estimated range from €8 to €11 billion," Jarkko Kivisto, an advisor to the Bank of Finland's monetary policy and research department, told DW.
paras.zh: 芬兰央行货币政策和研究部顾问雅科·基维斯托 (Jarkko Kivisto) 告诉德国之声：“目前估计金额在 8 至 110 亿欧元之间。”

paras.en: Earlier this year, all but one political party agreed to support a debt brake, where the next government commits to tightening the country's deficit to about 2% of GDP by 2031.
paras.zh: 今年早些时候，除一个政党外，所有政党都同意支持债务制动，下一届政府承诺到 2031 年将国家赤字收紧至 GDP 的 2% 左右。

paras.en: To date, Orpo's center-right National Coalition is the only party to promise a further €9 billion in cuts if he wins a second term. As well as further savings from health, social care and welfare, Orpo also plans to target workplace pensions, without reducing current payouts.
paras.zh: 迄今为止，奥尔波领导的中右翼国家联盟是唯一承诺如果他赢得第二个任期将进一步削减 90 亿欧元的政党。除了从医疗、社会关怀和福利方面进一步节省开支外，Orpo 还计划在不减少当前支出的情况下，以工作场所养老金为目标。

paras.en: While the Social Democrats plan to split the reforms between spending cuts and tax hikes, Orpo plans to achieve his target without raising taxes — meaning public services will bear the brunt.
paras.zh: 虽然社会民主党计划将改革分为削减支出和增税两部分，但奥尔波计划在不增税的情况下实现其目标，这意味着公共服务将首当其冲。

paras.en: Kivisto, however, cautioned: "The deficit is so large that it would need a package that includes tax increases and expenditure cuts."
paras.zh: 然而基维斯托警告说：“赤字如此之大，以至于需要一个包括增税和削减开支的一揽子计划。”

paras.en: While Finland's at-risk-of-poverty rate is lower than the EU average, unemployment is higher than anywhere else in the bloc. In August, Finland's jobless total stood at 10.3%, just above Spain's 10%, according to Eurostat, the bloc's statistics agency. Youth unemployment reached 23.3%, against an EU average of 15.4%.
paras.zh: 虽然芬兰的贫困风险率低于欧盟平均水平，但失业率却高于欧盟其他任何地方。根据欧盟统计局的数据，8 月份芬兰的失业率为 10.3%，略高于西班牙的 10%。青年失业率达到 23.3%，而欧盟平均失业率为 15.4%。

paras.en: With household spending already falling, Lauri Holappa, director of the Finnish Centre for New Economic Analysis, warned that a new round of austerity would be a hard blow for the domestic economy.
paras.zh: 由于家庭支出已经下降，芬兰新经济分析中心主任劳里·霍拉帕警告称，新一轮紧缩政策将对国内经济造成沉重打击。

paras.en: "More than a quarter of the population works in the public sector, so if those workers face the threat of being sacked, the savings rate will rise and private spending will drop again," Holappa told DW.
paras.zh: 霍拉帕告诉德国之声：“超过四分之一的人口在公共部门工作，因此如果这些工人面临被解雇的威胁，储蓄率将会上升，私人支出将再次下降。”

paras.en: Successive pressures ranging from the COVID-19 pandemic, higher interest rates and the global financial impact of two current wars have hurt efforts to cut the growing gap between income and borrowing. The 2027 budget proposal still counts on a spending gap of €12.4 billion.
paras.zh: COVID-19 大流行、利率上升以及当前两场战争对全球金融的影响等一系列压力，损害了缩小收入与借贷之间日益扩大的差距的努力。 2027 年预算提案仍预计支出缺口为 124 亿欧元。

paras.en: Finland rearms after Russia's full-scale invasion
paras.zh: 俄罗斯全面入侵后芬兰重新武装

paras.en: Before the Ukraine war, Finland had already committed to buying 64 F-35A fighter jets from the United States, in a deal worth about €8.4 billion.
paras.zh: 在乌克兰战争之前，芬兰已承诺从美国购买64架F-35A战斗机，这笔交易价值约84亿欧元。

paras.en: During more than four years of Russia's war in Ukraine, the Nordic nation raised military spending from $4.5 billion to over $8 billion per year, according to the Stockholm International Peace Research Institute (SIPRI).
paras.zh: 根据斯德哥尔摩国际和平研究所 (SIPRI) 的数据，在俄罗斯乌克兰战争四年多的时间里，这个北欧国家的军费开支从每年 45 亿美元增加到超过 80 亿美元。

paras.en: In April, the government said it would further increase defense spending to 3.2% of GDP, close to NATO's 3.5% target.
paras.zh: 4月份，政府表示将进一步将国防开支增加至GDP的3.2%，接近北约3.5%的目标。

paras.en: With oil prices remaining close to $100 a barrel due to the Iran war, the government has so far resisted pressure to increase fuel subsidies. That's despite the Bank of Finland recording a 50% rise in the cost of imported energy in the early months of the Iran war.
paras.zh: 由于伊朗战争，油价仍接近每桶100美元，政府迄今为止顶住了增加燃料补贴的压力。尽管芬兰银行记录称，在伊朗战争的最初几个月，进口能源成本上涨了 50%。

paras.en: While Finland’s shift to renewables, along with the opening of the Olkiluoto 3 nuclear power plant in 2023, has helped avoid a worse energy crisis, the central bank warned this summer that sustained high oil and gas prices would mean "lower economic growth and higher inflation" next year.
paras.zh: 尽管芬兰转向可再生能源以及奥尔基洛托 3 号核电站将于 2023 年启用，有助于避免更严重的能源危机，但芬兰央行今年夏天警告称，持续高企的石油和天然气价格将意味着明年“经济增长放缓和通胀上升”。

paras.en: On another positive note, parts of Finland's export sector are booming, thanks to strong metal and shipbuilding orders, which Holappa described as strong as "the boom years of Nokia," when the once market-leading phone maker carried Finnish economic growth.
paras.zh: 另一个积极的方面是，得益于强劲的金属和造船订单，芬兰部分出口行业正在蓬勃发展，霍拉帕将其形容为“诺基亚的繁荣时期”，当时这家曾经是市场领先的手机制造商带动了芬兰的经济增长。

paras.en: "There is a possibility that the export sector can steer us out of this recession," he told DW, as long as demand from the rest of Europe remains strong.
paras.zh: 他对德国之声表示：“只要欧洲其他地区的需求依然强劲，出口部门就有可能帮助我们走出这场衰退。”

paras.en: Despite the multiple roadblocks to bringing down the deficit, market reaction to Finland's debt woes has, so far, been muted. Rating agencies have kept the country's outlook stable, apart from S&P, which turned negative in April without cutting the rating.
paras.zh: 尽管降低赤字面临多重障碍，但迄今为止，市场对芬兰债务困境的反应一直很平静。除了标准普尔之外，评级机构一直保持该国的前景稳定，标准普尔在四月份转为负面评级但没有下调评级。

paras.en: On October 6, the premium the Finnish government pays over Germany to borrow for 10 years was 38 basis points. That compares to 128 for France and 107 for Italy. In other words, investors still treat Finnish debt as among the safest in Europe.
paras.zh: 10 月 6 日，芬兰政府为德国 10 年期借款支付的溢价为 38 个基点。相比之下，法国为 128，意大利为 107。换句话说，投资者仍然将芬兰债务视为欧洲最安全的债务之一。

paras.en: That is, as long as the next shock is not another extended oil-price spike, a fresh escalation from Russia, or a Europe-wide debt crisis centered on France.
paras.zh: 也就是说，只要下一次冲击不是油价再次大幅上涨、俄罗斯的新一轮升级或以法国为中心的欧洲范围内的债务危机。

paras.en: Next March, Finland could still be named the planet's happiest nation for the 10th year in a row. How long the smiles last, once the bill for decades of borrowing arrives a month later, is anyone's guess.
paras.zh: 明年三月，芬兰仍可能连续十年被评为地球上最幸福的国家。一个月后，几十年的借款账单到账后，笑容能持续多久，谁也说不准。

articles.title: How the Houthi-Saudi conflict is affecting countries on Africa's Red Sea coast — and beyond

paras.en: In September, one of the major conflicts in the Middle East came within sight of Africa, as Iran-backed Houthi rebels captured Yemen's Perim Island.
paras.zh: 9月，随着伊朗支持的胡塞叛军占领也门的佩里姆岛，中东的重大冲突之一来到了非洲。

paras.en: The island forms the narrowest point of the Bab el-Mandeb Strait, which connects the southern entrance of the Red Sea to the Gulf of Aden. It is roughly 20 kilometers (12 miles) from Djibouti and 20-minutes by air from Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 该岛是曼德海峡的最窄点，连接红海南部入口和亚丁湾。距吉布提约 20 公里（12 英里），距埃塞俄比亚约 20 分钟飞行时间。

paras.en: In early October, Yemen's armed forces and their Saudi allies launched a counteroffensive. The Iran-backed Houthis have been firing on merchant ships since the start of the Gaza war in 2023.
paras.zh: 10月初，也门武装部队及其沙特盟友发起反攻。自 2023 年加沙战争爆发以来，伊朗支持的胡塞武装一直向商船开火。

paras.en: Economic consequences are coupled with higher number of refugees
paras.zh: 经济后果伴随着难民人数的增加

paras.en: African economies are already suffering from crisis in the Strait of Hormuz, which is making fuel and fertilizer scarce and more expensive.
paras.zh: 非洲经济体已经遭受霍尔木兹海峡危机的影响，这使得燃料和化肥变得稀缺且更加昂贵。

paras.en: If the Bab el-Mandeb Strait also becomes impassable, the situation could deteriorate further. Shipping companies would have to make detours via the Suez Canal, which is controlled by Egypt, or the southern tip of Africa, as some already do. The additional costs would be passed on to consumers.
paras.zh: 如果曼德海峡也无法通行，局势可能会进一步恶化。航运公司将不得不绕行埃及控制的苏伊士运河，或者非洲南端，有些公司已经这样做了。额外的成本将转嫁给消费者。

paras.en: The human cost of the escalation in Yemen hit Djibouti almost immediately. According to the UN Refugee Agency (UNHCR), at least 3,700 refugees have crossed from Yemen into Djibouti since September. Most of those who made it to the country's northern Obock region are women and children.
paras.zh: 也门局势升级造成的人员伤亡几乎立刻就波及到了吉布提。据联合国难民署 (UNHCR) 称，自 9 月以来，至少有 3,700 名难民从也门越境进入吉布提。抵达该国北部奥博克地区的大多数是妇女和儿童。

paras.en: The UNHCR is preparing to assist another 10,000 people who have not yet crossed into Djibouti. But Obock, which is on the border with Eritrea, is extremely dry and this is causing other issues.
paras.zh: 联合国难民署正准备协助另外一万名尚未进入吉布提的人。但与厄立特里亚接壤的奥博克非常干燥，这导致了其他问题。

paras.en: "We don't have much water here. There's no groundwater at all," Alessandra Roccasalvo, the UN Development Program (UNDP) representative for Djibouti, told DW. "Everything has to be desalinated."
paras.zh: 联合国开发计划署驻吉布提代表亚历山德拉·罗卡萨尔沃 (Alessandra Roccasalvo) 告诉德国之声：“我们这里没有太多水。根本没有地下水。” “一切都必须淡化。”

paras.en: Despite its small size, Djibouti — a Muslim-majority country at the Horn of Africa with a population of just over a million — is a major player in the region. Its position at the entrance to the Red Sea makes it an attractive commercial and military shipping hub.
paras.zh: 尽管面积不大，吉布提这个位于非洲之角的穆斯林占多数的国家，人口刚刚超过一百万，但却是该地区的重要参与者。它位于红海入口处的位置使其成为一个有吸引力的商业和军事航运中心。

paras.en: The United States, China, France, Italy, and Japan all operate military bases in Djibouti. The German Bundeswehr was also present until 2021, as part of a naval mission to combat maritime piracy.
paras.zh: 美国、中国、法国、意大利和日本都在吉布提设有军事基地。德国联邦国防军也一直驻扎到 2021 年，作为打击海盗的海军任务的一部分。

paras.en: The country's civilian ports serve as transshipment, or intermediate hubs for global shipping cargo, goods and containers. So far, the Houthi advance has not led to empty docks in Djibouti.
paras.zh: 该国的民用港口是全球运输货物、货物和集装箱的转运或中间枢纽。到目前为止，胡塞武装的推进并未导致吉布提的码头空荡荡。

paras.en: But there are still potential consequences, said Roccasalvo: "Basically, there's an economic upswing here — which means, as in any country experiencing an upswing, building materials are needed: cement, raw materials, and other things."
paras.zh: 但仍然存在潜在的后果，罗卡萨尔沃说：“基本上，这里的经济正在复苏，这意味着，就像任何正在经历经济复苏的国家一样，需要建筑材料：水泥、原材料和其他东西。”

paras.en: Less of that money is now coming in because ships have to pay nearly twice as much for insurance and reinsurance as they used to. "Many ships no longer want to pass through the Suez Canal. Many no longer want to pass through the Red Sea."
paras.zh: 现在流入的资金减少了，因为船舶必须支付几乎是以前两倍的保险和再保险费用。 “许多船只不再想通过苏伊士运河。许多船只不再想通过红海。”

paras.en: Knock-on effects for landlocked neighboring Ethiopia
paras.zh: 对内陆邻国埃塞俄比亚的连锁反应

paras.en: Ethiopia — the world's most populous landlocked country — handles about 95% of its imports and exports through Djibouti's ports. Price hikes resulting from higher shipping insurance premiums to cover for potential war-related loss are affecting the country greatly.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚是世界上人口最多的内陆国家，约 95% 的进出口业务是通过吉布提港口处理的。为了弥补潜在的战争相关损失而提高的航运保险费导致价格上涨，对该国产生了巨大影响。

paras.en: Shortly after the Houthis seized Perim, Ethiopia's economy faced another, even more immediate threat: On September 23, fighting broke out in the country's northern Tigray region.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装夺取佩林后不久，埃塞俄比亚经济面临另一个更为直接的威胁：9月23日，该国北部提格雷地区爆发战斗。

paras.en: Since then, the Ethiopian National Defense Forces (ENDF) have reportedly made gains against the Tigray-led rebel coalition that aims to overthrow the national government. The rebels briefly advanced toward the main corridor used for transporting goods between Djibouti's ports and the Ethiopian hinterland.
paras.zh: 据报道，此后，埃塞俄比亚国防军（ENDF）在对抗提格雷领导的旨在推翻国家政府的叛军联盟方面取得了进展。叛乱分子短暂地向吉布提港口和埃塞俄比亚腹地之间运输货物的主要走廊推进。

paras.en: According to certain experts, the ENDF's advances have since reduced the threat of yet another trade blockade — but as long as the conflict remains unresolved, the situation could potentially deteriorate again.
paras.zh: 据某些专家称，ENDF 的进展已经减少了再次贸易封锁的威胁，但只要冲突仍未解决，局势就有可能再次恶化。

paras.en: For months now, Ethiopia has suffered more than almost any other African country from the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz and has already had to ration fuel at times. In the long term, the country aims to reduce its dependence on imports, for example by powering vehicles with domestically generated electricity instead of imported gasoline.
paras.zh: 几个月来，埃塞俄比亚因霍尔木兹海峡封锁而遭受的苦难比几乎所有其他非洲国家都要严重，并且有时不得不实行燃料配给。从长远来看，该国的目标是减少对进口的依赖，例如用国内发电代替进口汽油为车辆提供动力。

paras.en: Can the conflict in Ethiopia affect Bab el-Mandeb access?
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚的冲突会影响曼德海峡的通行吗？

paras.en: Ethiopia and its northern neighbor, Eritrea, have severed diplomatic ties; other regional powers such as Sudan, Egypt, and Somalia may find themselves siding with Eritrea rather than with Ethiopia.
paras.zh: 埃塞俄比亚与其北部邻国厄立特里亚断绝了外交关系；苏丹、埃及和索马里等其他地区大国可能会发现自己站在厄立特里亚而不是埃塞俄比亚一边。

paras.en: Eritrea sees itself as facing a threat that Ethiopian Prime Minister Abiy Ahmed has reiterated on several occasions: With Ethiopia deprived of access to the sea since Eritrea's independence, Abiy has often alluded to rectifying this perceived injustice — either through a political agreement, as was once sought with Somalia's breakaway region of Somaliland, or by force.
paras.zh: 厄立特里亚认为自己面临着埃塞俄比亚总理阿比·艾哈迈德多次重申的威胁：自厄立特里亚独立以来，埃塞俄比亚被剥夺了出海权，阿比经常暗示要纠正这种不公正现象——要么通过政治协议，就像曾经与索马里分离地区索马里兰寻求的那样，要么通过武力。

paras.en: The port of Assab is located on the edge of Eritrea's panhandle — and is often described as the most likely target should Abiy choose the path of aggression. If the fighting within Ethiopia further escalates into a full-blown regional war, this could also lead to additional restrictions on safe passage through the Bab el-Mandeb Strait and the surrounding waters.
paras.zh: 阿萨布港位于厄立特里亚狭长地带的边缘，通常被描述为如果阿比选择侵略道路最有可能的目标。如果埃塞俄比亚境内的战斗进一步升级为全面的地区战争，这也可能导致曼德海峡及周边水域的安全通行受到额外限制。

paras.en: Experts have also raised concerns about the Shiite Houthis increasingly collaborating with the Sunni terrorist group Al-Shabab, which is based in Somalia. Although their ideologies are fundamentally different, they are particularly united by their hostility toward Israel and the US.
paras.zh: 专家们还对什叶派胡塞武装日益与总部位于索马里的逊尼派恐怖组织青年党合作表示担忧。尽管他们的意识形态根本不同，但他们因对以色列和美国的敌意而特别团结。

paras.en: What tools are at the disposal of African countries to help remedy the situation?
paras.zh: 非洲国家可以使用哪些工具来帮助扭转局面？

paras.en: The three African non-permanent members of the UN Security Council — the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Liberia, and Somalia — held an emergency meeting in mid-September, jointly calling for free shipping lanes and endorsing the demand that the crisis in Yemen be resolved under the auspices of the UN.
paras.zh: 联合国安理会三个非洲非常任理事国刚果民主共和国、利比里亚和索马里于9月中旬召开紧急会议，共同呼吁建立自由航线，并支持在联合国主持下解决也门危机的要求。

paras.en: The situation at Bab el-Mandeb and in northern Ethiopia once again demands flexibility from Africa. In fact, some African economies could also benefit from relocation activities: Ports inKenya and Tanzania, for example, are becoming increasingly attractive for transshipment.
paras.zh: 曼德门和埃塞俄比亚北部的局势再次要求非洲表现出灵活性。事实上，一些非洲经济体也可以从搬迁活动中受益：例如，肯尼亚和坦桑尼亚的港口对转运的吸引力越来越大。

paras.en: And while many countries are suffering from high oil prices, Nigeria's Dangote Group has announced an initial public offering and a new refinery in Kenya.
paras.zh: 尽管许多国家都在遭受高油价的困扰，尼日利亚丹格特集团却宣布进行首次公开​​募股，并在肯尼亚开设新炼油厂。

paras.en: This article was originally published in German. It has been updated.
paras.zh: 本文最初以德文发表。它已经更新了。

articles.title: Taiz hospitals near collapse as Houthis tighten siege: Yemen government

paras.en: Yemen’s internationally recognised government has warned of an “imminent health and humanitarian catastrophe” in the besieged city of Taiz, in the country’s southwest, as the Houthis continue their siege and “obstruct essential supplies”.
paras.zh: 国际公认的也门政府警告称，由于胡塞武装继续围困并“阻碍基本物资供应”，该国西南部被围困的城市塔伊兹将面临“迫在眉睫的健康和人道主义灾难”。

paras.en: Yemen’s Ministry of Public Health and Population said in a statement on Saturday that medicines, intravenous fluids, medical supplies and fuel at the city’s health facilities were “nearing depletion”.
paras.zh: 也门公共卫生和人口部周六在一份声明中表示，该市卫生设施的药品、静脉注射液、医疗用品和燃料“接近耗尽”。

paras.en: It said emergency care, surgery, intensive care, dialysis and neonatal services could be forced to stop if the situation continued, putting patients, injured people, pregnant women and newborns “at immediate risk”.
paras.zh: 报告称，如果情况持续下去，紧急护理、手术、重症监护、透析和新生儿服务可能被迫停止，使患者、伤者、孕妇和新生儿“面临直接风险”。

paras.en: Fuel shortages also threaten electricity generators, ambulances and the cold chains that keep medicines and vaccines usable, which could cause “severe complications and preventable deaths”, the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示，燃料短缺还威胁到发电机、救护车以及保证药品和疫苗可用的冷链，这可能导致“严重并发症和可预防的死亡”。

paras.en: It demanded the siege be lifted immediately, and supply routes reopened, with safe passage for patients, ambulances, health workers and aid.
paras.zh: 它要求立即解除围困，并重新开放供应路线，为患者、救护车、卫生工作者和援助提供安全通道。

paras.en: It called on the United Nations and humanitarian organisations to “deliver medicines, intravenous fluids, medical supplies, oxygen and fuel” to the city’s health facilities.
paras.zh: 它呼吁联合国和人道主义组织向该市的卫生设施“提供药品、静脉注射液、医疗用品、氧气和燃料”。

paras.en: “Every delay increases the risk of service interruption and loss of life,” the ministry said.
paras.zh: 该部表示：“每次延误都会增加服务中断和人员伤亡的风险。”

paras.en: The Houthis, an armed group backed by Iran and also known as Ansar Allah, seized Yemen’s capital, Sanaa, by force in 2014 and later imposed their own government. They control the country’s north and northeast.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装是一个由伊朗支持的武装组织，也被称为安萨尔安拉 (Ansar Allah)，于 2014 年武力占领也门首都萨那，随后建立了自己的政府。他们控制着该国的北部和东北部。

paras.en: Taiz endured a devastating Houthi siege between 2015 and 2016, when Yemeni government forces were confined to an enclave in the city centre.
paras.zh: 2015 年至 2016 年间，塔伊兹遭受了胡塞武装的毁灭性围攻，当时也门政府军被限制在市中心的一个飞地。

paras.en: The siege was broken in 2016, though the Houthis kept a partial blockade through other access points. In 2024, they agreed to reopen a route from the east, but it has been closed after fighting resumed.
paras.zh: 2016 年，围困被打破，但胡塞武装仍部分封锁其他出入口。 2024年，他们同意重新开放一条来自东部的路线，但在战斗恢复后该路线已被关闭。

paras.en: The renewed siege took shape in early October.
paras.zh: 新的围困于十月初形成。

paras.en: The Houthis launched an offensive along the Red Sea coast of the Taiz governorate in September, capturing the port city of Mocha, and by October 4 had taken the town of At Turbah, cutting the last main road between Taiz city and other government-held areas.
paras.zh: 9月，胡塞武装沿塔伊兹省红海沿岸发动攻势，占领了港口城市摩卡，并于10月4日占领了图尔巴镇，切断了塔伊兹市与其他政府控制地区之间的最后一条主干道。

paras.en: Yemeni government forces, backed by Saudi Arabia, began a counteroffensive in early October.
paras.zh: 也门政府军在沙特阿拉伯的支持下于10月初开始反攻。

paras.en: Nabil Jamil, director-general of the Yemeni government’s planning and development office in the Taiz governorate, told Al Jazeera the current siege is “more comprehensive and its impact more severe than in 2015”.
paras.zh: 也门政府塔伊兹省规划和发展办公室主任纳比尔·贾米尔告诉半岛电视台，目前的围困“比 2015 年更全面，影响也更严重”。

paras.en: He said about 2.8 million people live in government-held areas of the governorate, along with 200,000 who have recently been displaced.
paras.zh: 他说，大约有 280 万人生活在该省政府控制的地区，还有 20 万人最近流离失所。

paras.en: Fuel has become scarce, and on the black market, the price of a 20-litre (5.2-gallon) container of petrol has risen from 30,000 Yemeni riyals ($19) to 90,000 ($58).
paras.zh: 燃料变得稀缺，在黑市上，一箱 20 升（5.2 加仑）汽油的价格已从 30,000 也门里亚尔（19 美元）上涨到 90,000 也门里亚尔（58 美元）。

paras.en: “We are still waiting for a response or intervention on the ground,” Jamil said.
paras.zh: 贾米尔说：“我们仍在等待当地的回应或干预。”

paras.en: The UN refugee agency and the World Health Organization have warned that the fighting is putting Yemen’s fragile health system in peril.
paras.zh: 联合国难民机构和世界卫生组织警告说，战斗正在使也门脆弱的卫生系统陷入危险。

paras.en: “Civilians must never be turned into a means of exerting pressure in any conflict,” said Nabil Sharyan, a lawyer and head of the Justice for Rights and Development Organization.
paras.zh: “决不能让平民成为在任何冲突中施加压力的工具，”律师兼正义与发展组织负责人纳比勒·沙里安 (Nabil Sharyan) 表示。

articles.title: US opens antitrust probe into TV networks for halting Trump coverage

paras.en: The United States Department of Justice has opened an investigation into television networks’ decision to halt coverage of President Donald Trump last month.
paras.zh: 美国司法部已对电视网络上个月停止报道唐纳德·特朗普总统的决定展开调查。

paras.en: A spokesperson said on Saturday that the department was investigating whether the networks violated federal antitrust laws by their boycott, which followed a White House decision to pull the credentials of reporters from three news organisations, including CNN.
paras.zh: 周六，一名发言人表示，该部门正在调查这些网络的抵制行为是否违反了联邦反垄断法，此前白宫决定吊销包括 CNN 在内的三个新闻机构记者的证件。

paras.en: The networks under investigation are ABC, CBS, CNN, NBC and Fox News, said Emily Convington, the Justice Department spokesperson.
paras.zh: 司法部发言人艾米丽·康文顿 (Emily Convington) 表示，接受调查的网络包括 ABC、CBS、CNN、NBC 和福克斯新闻。

paras.en: “Group boycotts among commercial competitors can violate the Sherman Act,” she said of the antitrust legislation.
paras.zh: “商业竞争对手之间的集体抵制可能违反《谢尔曼法案》，”她在谈到反垄断立法时说道。

paras.en: “The Antitrust Division is simply investigating to determine whether these news organizations have violated the antitrust laws.”
paras.zh: “反垄断部门只是进行调查，以确定这些新闻机构是否违反了反垄断法。”

paras.en: The investigation is the latest in a series of clashes between the Trump administration and major news organisations. Trump has repeatedly called the mainstream media “fake news” and frequently clashes with reporters during encounters with the press.
paras.zh: 此次调查是特朗普政府与主要新闻机构之间一系列冲突中的最新一起。特朗普多次称主流媒体为“假新闻”，并在与媒体见面时频频与记者发生冲突。

paras.en: The action also puts legal and potentially financial pressure on the media to continue coverage of the president even when they disagree with how the White House handles them.
paras.zh: 这一行动还给媒体带来了法律和潜在的财务压力，要求他们继续报道总统，即使他们不同意白宫的处理方式。

paras.en: The networks did not immediately comment on the announcement.
paras.zh: 该网络没有立即对此公告发表评论。

paras.en: The Justice Department’s move came after the television pool of five broadcasters last month ceased presidential coverage after the administration barred CNN, MS NOW and Politico from the White House.
paras.zh: 司法部采取这一举措之前，上个月政府禁止 CNN、MS NOW 和 Politico 进入白宫，五家广播公司组成的电视台停止了对总统的报道。

paras.en: The White House said on September 19 that covering the president was a “privilege – not a right”. The outlets sued the administration, alleging the exclusions violated the First Amendment and that the White House was retaliating over their coverage.
paras.zh: 白宫 9 月 19 日表示，报道总统是一种“特权，而非权利”。这些媒体起诉政府，声称排除条款违反了第一修正案，并且白宫正在对其报道进行报复。

paras.en: CNN is one of the five news organisations – along with ABC, CBS, Fox News and NBC – that make up the primary White House television pool.
paras.zh: 美国有线电视新闻网 (CNN) 是构成白宫主要电视频道的五个新闻机构之一，另外还有美国广播公司 (ABC)、哥伦比亚广播公司 (CBS)、福克斯新闻 (Fox News) 和全国广播公司 (NBC)。

paras.en: They share the costs of covering the president, take turns organising coverage, and share the footage with outlets around the country.
paras.zh: 他们分担报道总统的费用，轮流组织报道，并与全国各地的媒体分享镜头。

paras.en: All of the five television networks that cover the White House, including Fox News, suspended coverage in solidarity and refused to provide replacement coverage.
paras.zh: 包括福克斯新闻在内的所有五个报道白宫的电视网络都暂停了报道，并拒绝提供替代报道。

paras.en: The White House reinstated the credentials on September 24 after US District Judge Timothy Kelly ruled that the ban was likely unconstitutional and ordered the administration to “immediately return, reinstate, and restore” their access.
paras.zh: 在美国地区法官蒂莫西·凯利裁定该禁令可能违宪并命令政府“立即归还、恢复和恢复”他们的访问权限后，白宫于 9 月 24 日恢复了这些凭证。

paras.en: However, disputes over access to specific presidential events and pool assignments continued.
paras.zh: 然而，关于参加特定总统活动和池分配的争议仍在继续。

paras.en: Jose Zamora, the Committee to Protect Journalists’ Americas director, on Saturday criticised the administration’s decision to investigate.
paras.zh: 保护记者委员会美洲主任何塞·萨莫拉周六批评政府的调查决定。

paras.en: “The government should not use antitrust investigations to intimidate news outlets defending press access,” Zamora said on X. “The public’s right to know depends on that access.”
paras.zh: 萨莫拉在 X 节目中表示：“政府不应利用反垄断调查来恐吓捍卫新闻采访权的新闻媒体。公众的知情权取决于这种采访权。”

articles.title: How genocidal war on Gaza is shaping Israel’s election

paras.en: As Israel entered the final month before its October 27 election, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu had a chilling warning to share.
paras.zh: 以色列进入 10 月 27 日大选前的最后一个月，总理本雅明·内塔尼亚胡 (Benjamin Netanyahu) 发出了一个令人不寒而栗的警告。

paras.en: Israel’s enemies, he said on September 29, were plotting an attack on the country before the vote. Without providing any evidence, he then quickly referred to continuing attacks by Israeli troops in the Gaza Strip, where he said they had killed more than 100 “terrorists” in recent weeks.
paras.zh: 9 月 29 日，他表示，以色列的敌人正在密谋在投票前袭击该国。在没有提供任何证据的情况下，他随后很快提到了以色列军队在加沙地带的持续袭击，他说最近几周以色列军队在那里杀死了 100 多名“恐怖分子”。

paras.en: That link drawn by Netanyahu – between the genocidal war on Gaza that began after the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attacks, the upcoming elections, and Israel’s national security – was not coincidental, say analysts.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，内塔尼亚胡将哈马斯领导的 2023 年 10 月 7 日袭击后开始的加沙种族灭绝战争、即将举行的选举和以色列国家安全之间的联系并非巧合。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s insistence that he alone can secure Israelis from a range of threats they face from across the country’s borders, they say, lies at the heart of his re-election campaign, even as his alleged failures during the attack three years ago and in securing the quick release of captives have offered his opponents ammunition.
paras.zh: 他们说，内塔尼亚胡坚持认为，只有他才能确保以色列人免受来自该国边境的一系列威胁，这是他连任竞选的核心，尽管据称他在三年前的袭击中以及确保迅速释放俘虏方面的失败为他的对手提供了弹药。

paras.en: When a Flydubai flight packed with Israeli passengers on their way from Dubai to Tel Aviv a day after his recent warning nearly crashed after a co-pilot attacked his pilot with an axe in the cockpit, Netanyahu was quick to seize on the incident to argue that he is still man for the country’s top job.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡最近警告称，一名副驾驶在驾驶舱内用斧头袭击了他的飞行员，导致一架载满以色列乘客的迪拜航空航班几乎坠机，一天后，内塔尼亚胡迅速抓住这一事件，辩称他仍然是该国最高职位的人选。

paras.en: Polls suggest that he faces a stiff test in what is the first general vote since the 2023 attacks, which led to the killing of 1,139 people in Israel and triggered the genocidal war on the Gaza Strip, where Israeli have attacks have since killed more than 74,000 Palestinians.
paras.zh: 民意调查显示，他在自 2023 年袭击事件以来的首次大选中面临着严峻考验，这次袭击导致以色列 1,139 人死亡，并引发了加沙地带的种族灭绝战争，以色列的袭击已导致超过 74,000 名巴勒斯坦人丧生。

paras.en: Three years later, the war has become inseparable from the domestic debate over Israel’s direction while also accelerating a political shift to the right – with once-fringe positions on Palestinians now very much the mainstream view.
paras.zh: 三年后，这场战争已经与国内关于以色列方向的辩论密不可分，同时也加速了政治右倾 — — 曾经对巴勒斯坦人的边缘立场现在已成为主流观点。

paras.en: Few embody this transformation more than Israel’s far-right financial Minister Bezalel Smotrich, sanctioned by a number of Western countries and known for his incendiary and racist language and policies towards Palestinians.
paras.zh: 很少有人比以色列极右翼财政部长贝扎莱尔·斯莫特里奇更能体现这种转变，他受到许多西方国家的制裁，并以其针对巴勒斯坦人的煽动性和种族主义语言和政策而闻名。

paras.en: In one of his characteristically inflammatory statements, Smotrich told Israeli outlet Ynet late last month that the Israeli army should “go to war” in the occupied West Bank and “do there what we did in Gaza”.
paras.zh: 斯莫特里奇上个月末在一份典型的煽动性声明中告诉以色列媒体 Ynet，以色列军队应该在被占领的约旦河西岸“参战”，并“在那里做我们在加沙所做的事情”。

paras.en: Less than two weeks later, Smotrich’s electoral ally Moshe Feiglin added fuel to the fire.
paras.zh: 不到两周后，斯莫特里奇的选举盟友摩西·费格林火上浇油。

paras.en: “The enemy is Gaza, not Hamas”, he told the Jerusalem Post, calling for the annexation of the besieged territory after the election. “The baby that will be born tomorrow in Gaza will do exactly the same,” he said, in reference to the 2023 attacks.
paras.zh: “敌人是加沙，而不是哈马斯”，他告诉《耶路撒冷邮报》，并呼吁在选举后吞并被围困的领土。 “明天将在加沙出生的婴儿也会做同样的事情，”他在谈到 2023 年的袭击时说道。

paras.en: Palestinian political analyst Ahmed Najar said these are not “stray comments” from marginal figures but an electoral message from power-seeking politicians aimed at portraying Palestinians as “not a people with rights, but a demographic and security problem to be expelled, conquered or destroyed”.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦政治分析家艾哈迈德·纳贾尔表示，这些并不是边缘人物的“流言蜚语”，而是寻求权力的政客发出的选举信息，旨在将巴勒斯坦人描绘成“不是一个拥有权利的人民，而是一个需要被驱逐、征服或摧毁的人口和安全问题”。

paras.en: He added: “The frightening reality is that the coming election risks becoming a competition not over whether Palestinian life should be protected, but over who can promise to erase it most aggressively.”
paras.zh: 他补充说：“可怕的现实是，即将到来的选举可能会成为一场竞争，不是关于是否应该保护巴勒斯坦人的生命，而是关于谁能承诺最积极地消除巴勒斯坦人的生命。”

paras.en: Following October 7, the younger generation in particular slid rightwards, said Ahron Bregman, an Israeli security analyst and senior teaching fellow at King’s College London.
paras.zh: 以色列安全分析师、伦敦国王学院高级教员阿伦·布雷格曼 (Ahron Bregman) 表示，10 月 7 日之后，年轻一代尤其右倾。

paras.en: He said the forces driving Israel to the right had been gathering for decades.
paras.zh: 他说，推动以色列右倾的力量已经聚集了数十年。

paras.en: “The trend toward the right began after the Yom Kippur War in 1973, but it has intensified dramatically since October 7,” Bregman told Al Jazeera, referring to the bloody 19-day October War, or the 1973 Arab-Israeli War – a conflict between Israel and a coalition of Arab states led by Egypt and Syria.
paras.zh: 布雷格曼告诉半岛电视台：“右倾趋势始于1973年赎罪日战争之后，但自10月7日以来急剧加剧。”他指的是血腥的19天十月战争，或1973年的阿以战争——以色列与埃及和叙利亚领导的阿拉伯国家联盟之间的冲突。

paras.en: More recently, the far right has been emboldened through electoral politics as part of Netanyahu’s government since 2022 – the most right-wing government in Israeli history.
paras.zh: 最近，自 2022 年以来，极右翼势力通过选举政治成为内塔尼亚胡政府的一部分，成为以色列历史上最右翼的政府。

paras.en: Another outspoken cabinet member alongside Smotrich is Minister of National Security Itamar Ben-Gvir, a far-right provocateur who has previously been convicted of inciting racism and of supporting a terrorist organisation.
paras.zh: 与斯莫特里奇一起的另一位直言不讳的内阁成员是国家安全部长伊塔马尔·本·格维尔（Itamar Ben-Gvir），他是一位极右翼煽动者，此前曾因煽动种族主义和支持恐怖组织而被定罪。

paras.en: “Netanyahu’s greatest mistake – among many – was bringing figures like Ben-Gvir and Smotrich into his coalition,” said Bergman. “By doing so, he legitimised them as influential forces in Israeli politics.”
paras.zh: 伯格曼说：“内塔尼亚胡最大的错误是把本格维尔和斯莫特里奇这样的人物带入他的联盟。” “通过这样做，他使他们合法化为以色列政治中的有影响力的力量。”

paras.en: Ben-Gvir has been so cemented into Israel’s political system, he has hopes pinned on becoming the next Israeli defence minister, the analyst pointed out.
paras.zh: 这位分析人士指出，本-格维尔已经深深融入以色列的政治体系，他希望成为下一任以色列国防部长。

paras.en: “This is madness. But that’s contemporary Israel,” said Bergman.
paras.zh: “这太疯狂了。但这就是当代以色列，”伯格曼说。

paras.en: Analysts also pointed out that several parties running, including ones that are currently in power and a number that are challenging the current coalition, all advocate for the expulsion of Palestinians from Gaza, as one of the examples of the shift to the right.
paras.zh: 分析人士还指出，一些参选政党，包括目前执政的政党和一些挑战当前联盟的政党，都主张将巴勒斯坦人驱逐出加沙，这是右倾的例子之一。

paras.en: Omar Baddar, director of Palthink for Strategic Studies, said the messaging from across the Israeli political and military spectrum in the lead-up to the election shows that there is “a consensus” to continue the attacks on Gaza, where nearly 1,500 have been killed since a “ceasefire” last year.
paras.zh: Palthink 战略研究中心主任奥马尔·巴达尔 (Omar Baddar) 表示，选举前夕，以色列政界和军事界发出的信息表明，人们“达成共识”继续对加沙发动袭击，自去年“停火”以来，加沙已有近 1,500 人死亡。

paras.en: “They’re using the threats to get more votes,” he said, pointing out to what he described as the radicalisation of the society.
paras.zh: “他们利用威胁来获得更多选票，”他说，并指出了他所说的社会激进化。

paras.en: With the election approaching, added Baddar, Israeli leaders are seeking to undo one another: “Who[ever]’s more radical is more likely to get more votes.”
paras.zh: 巴达尔补充说，随着选举的临近，以色列领导人正在寻求相互摧毁：“谁更激进，谁更有可能获得更多选票。”

paras.en: As Ehab Jabareen, a Palestinian political analyst and researcher from inside Israel, writes, “what it means to be ‘right-wing’ in Israel today is above all to take a harder line on Palestinian national claims, security and territorial control.”
paras.zh: 正如来自以色列内部的巴勒斯坦政治分析家和研究员埃哈卜·贾巴林（Ehab Jabareen）所写，“今天，在以色列‘右翼’意味着首先要在巴勒斯坦的民族主张、安全和领土控制问题上采取更强硬的立场。”

paras.en: He adds: “On security and the Palestinians, a large part of Jewish Israeli politics already works from assumptions that would have been treated as right-wing a generation ago: Deep suspicion of a sovereign Palestinian state, a high tolerance for prolonged military control, and a stronger insistence on Jewish sovereignty as the starting point rather than one value among others.”
paras.zh: 他补充道：“在安全和巴勒斯坦人问题上，犹太以色列政治的很大一部分已经基于上一代人被视为右翼的假设：对巴勒斯坦主权国家的深深怀疑，对长期军事控制的高度容忍，以及更加坚持将犹太主权作为出发点，而不是其中的一种价值观。”

paras.en: Observers and rights groups say the disparity is even evident in the electoral process. A prominent politician and Palestinian citizen of Israel, Sami Abu Shehadeh, has been forced to withdraw from the election over his remarks about the Gaza war, while Israeli far-right leaders have remained untouched despite their violent rhetoric against Palestinians.
paras.zh: 观察家和人权组织表示，这种差异在选举过程中甚至很明显。以色列著名政治家、巴勒斯坦公民萨米·阿布·谢哈德 (Sami Abu Shehadeh) 因其有关加沙战争的言论而被迫退出选举，而以色列极右翼领导人尽管发表了针对巴勒斯坦人的暴力言论，但并未受到影响。

paras.en: Recent polling indicates that the events of October 7 are top of mind for Israelis, who also have questions about who was responsible for the security failures of that day.
paras.zh: 最近的民意调查显示，10 月 7 日发生的事件是以色列人最关心的问题，他们还想知道谁应对当天的安全失败负责。

paras.en: Just last month, reports surfaced indicating that Netanyahu had received two separate warnings about an imminent Hamas attack in 2023, from Egypt’s intelligence chief, Abbas Kamel, and United Arab Emirates President Sheikh Mohamed bin Zayed Al Nahyan.
paras.zh: 就在上个月，有报道称内塔尼亚胡收到了埃及情报局长阿巴斯·卡迈勒和阿拉伯联合酋长国总统谢赫·穆罕默德·本·扎耶德·阿勒纳哈扬关于哈马斯即将在 2023 年发动袭击的两份独立警告。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s two main rivals in the race for prime minister have cited the alleged warnings to call the prime minister “unfit” to remain at the helm of the country.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡在总理竞选中的两个主要竞争对手都引用了所谓的警告，称总理“不适合”继续掌管国家。

paras.en: But Netanyahu has denied suggestions that he had been forewarned about the attack, and the reports do not appear to have had a significant effect on opinion polls.
paras.zh: 但内塔尼亚胡否认了有关他已就此次袭击事件预先收到警告的说法，而且这些报道似乎并未对民意调查产生重大影响。

paras.en: While October 7 represents a profound rupture in Israelis’ sense of security, public trust in the Netanyahu government had already been badly shaken by its controversial judicial overhaul, introduced when the prime minister’s current coalition first came to power, said Mairav Zonszein, an Israel-Palestine analyst at the International Crisis Group based in Tel Aviv.
paras.zh: 总部位于特拉维夫的国际危机组织的以色列-巴勒斯坦问题分析师迈拉夫·宗泽因 (Mairav Zonszein) 表示，虽然 10 月 7 日标志着以色列人安全感的深刻破裂，但公众对内塔尼亚胡政府的信任已经因内塔尼亚胡政府在总理现任联盟首次上台时推出的颇具争议的司法改革而严重动摇。

paras.en: Despite these breaches of trust, the Israeli leader retains support.
paras.zh: 尽管存在这些违反信任的行为，这位以色列领导人仍然得到了支持。

paras.en: “Israelis in general still see Netanyahu as kind of the guy on security. And more to the point, they don’t really see an alternative,” Zonszein told Al Jazeera.
paras.zh: “以色列人总体上仍然将内塔尼亚胡视为安全问题上的人。更重要的是，他们并没有真正看到替代方案，”宗泽因告诉半岛电视台。

paras.en: A June survey by Mitvim – the Israeli Institute for Regional Foreign Policies found that the Israeli public supports its government’s military and security solutions, and rejects resolving the Palestinian issue and ending the Israeli occupation of Palestinian territory. This is the case even while it has been concerned about international isolation and the decline of Israel’s international standing since the beginning of the genocidal war on Gaza, the survey reported.
paras.zh: 以色列地区外交政策研究所 Mitvim 6 月份的一项调查发现，以色列公众支持政府的军事和安全解决方案，拒绝解决巴勒斯坦问题和结束以色列对巴勒斯坦领土的占领。调查报告称，尽管自加沙种族灭绝战争开始以来，以色列一直担心国际孤立和以色列国际地位的下降，但情况仍然如此。

paras.en: Yet Israelis are also increasingly war-weary, even as they back the use of more force. Its troops – stretched between six fronts of war in the last few years – are bearing the brunt of this fatigue in Israeli society.
paras.zh: 然而，以色列人也越来越厌战，尽管他们支持使用更多武力。过去几年，其军队在六条战线之间奔波，在以色列社会的这种疲劳中首当其冲。

paras.en: Israel’s Ministry of Defence said on Tuesday that nearly 30,000 soldiers and security personnel are facing psychological trauma since the war.
paras.zh: 以色列国防部周二表示，自战争以来，近3万名士兵和安全人员面临心理创伤。

paras.en: The ministry said its rehabilitation department’s budget has increased by 88 percent over the past three years to 10 billion shekels ($3.3m), with the majority supporting treatment for mental health conditions and post-traumatic stress disorder.
paras.zh: 该部表示，其康复部门的预算在过去三年中增加了 88%，达到 100 亿谢克尔（330 万美元），其中大部分用于支持精神健康状况和创伤后应激障碍的治疗。

paras.en: As Israel expands, the two-state solution fades
paras.zh: 随着以色列的扩张，两国解决方案逐渐消失

paras.en: Still, Israel in recent months has been more and more vocal about its expansionist vision, with officials brazenly stating the goal of “Greater Israel”. The claim for the conquest is based on a biblical verse (Genesis 15:18-21).
paras.zh: 尽管如此，近几个月来，以色列对其扩张主义愿景的呼声越来越高，官员们公然宣称“大以色列”的目标。征服的主张是基于圣经经文（创世记 15:18-21）。

paras.en: For decades, Israel has ignored international law in its continuous occupation of Palestinian and Syrian land, and has shown little respect for its neighbours’ sovereignty, occupying more land in Syria, as well as in Lebanon in more recent years.
paras.zh: 几十年来，以色列无视国际法，持续占领巴勒斯坦和叙利亚土地，也很少尊重邻国的主权，近年来在叙利亚和黎巴嫩占领了更多土地。

paras.en: According to Najar, the political economist, the “complete dehumanisation” of Palestinians as evidenced during the campaign reveal that Gaza “is being presented to Israeli voters not as a catastrophe or a crime for which there must be accountability, but as a blueprint to be repeated elsewhere”.
paras.zh: 政治经济学家纳贾尔表示，竞选期间所证明的巴勒斯坦人的“完全非人化”表明，加沙“并不是作为一场必须追究责任的灾难或犯罪行为呈现给以色列选民，而是作为一个可以在其他地方重复的蓝图”。

paras.en: In southern Lebanon, where Israel has been carrying out near daily attacks and and has occupied large swathes of land, residents have told Al Jazeera they expect little to change even if Netanyahu is defeated in the election.
paras.zh: 在黎巴嫩南部，以色列几乎每天都发动袭击，并占领了大片土地，居民告诉半岛电视台，即使内塔尼亚胡在选举中失败，他们预计也不会发生什么变化。

paras.en: Netanyahu’s main political challenger, Gadi Eisenkot – head of the Yashar party and former army chief of staff – is the father of the so-called Dahiyeh Doctrine, and is just as hawkish about expansion. That doctrine, since Israel’s war with the Lebanese group Hezbollah in 2006, calls for the use of huge force, even against civilian infrastructure, as a deterrent against enemies and was deployed in Israel’s recent wars, particularly in Beirut’s southern suburbs.
paras.zh: 内塔尼亚胡的主要政治挑战者、亚沙尔党领袖、前陆军参谋长加迪·艾森科特是所谓“达希耶主义”之父，对扩张同样持强硬态度。自2006年以色列与黎巴嫩真主党发生战争以来，这一学说要求使用大规模武力，甚至针对民用基础设施，以威慑敌人，并在以色列最近的战争中得到运用，特别是在贝鲁特南部郊区。

paras.en: If it were up to Eisenkot, the Lebanon front of war would have never scaled down: He has accused Netanyahu of bowing to US pressure to halt operations in Beirut, and has insisted that the military should be able to attack Hezbollah anywhere in Lebanon.
paras.zh: 如果由艾森科特决定，黎巴嫩的战线永远不会缩小：他指责内塔尼亚胡屈服于美国停止在贝鲁特行动的压力，并坚称军队应该能够攻击黎巴嫩任何地方的真主党。

paras.en: For Israelis still reeling from the events of October 7, Eisenkot could fill the security void many are feeling, said Zonszein.
paras.zh: Zonszein 表示，对于仍然深受 10 月 7 日事件影响的以色列人来说，Eisenkot 可以填补许多人感到的安全空白。

paras.en: “They really … see the world as kind of very hostile towards them, the world not understanding what they went through on October 7, and [therefore why] the need to have these security buffer zones in Lebanon, in Syria, and Gaza,” she said.
paras.zh: “他们确实……认为世界对他们非常敌视，世界不理解他们在 10 月 7 日所经历的事情，以及[因此为什么]需要在黎巴嫩、叙利亚和加沙建立这些安全缓冲区，”她说。

paras.en: A two-state solution to the Israel-Palestine conflict is therefore out of the question, said the analysts – and has not even made a blip of an appearance in campaigning before the election.
paras.zh: 分析人士表示，因此，以巴冲突的两国解决方案是不可能的 — — 而且甚至没有在选举前的竞选活动中出现过。

paras.en: The idea first emerged during the Oslo Accords more than 30 years ago, which set out a negotiating process aimed at resolving the Israeli-Palestinian conflict, predicated on the belief that the creation of a Palestinian state alongside Israel was imperative to forge peace.
paras.zh: 这一想法首次出现于30多年前的《奥斯陆协议》中，该协议规定了旨在解决以色列-巴勒斯坦冲突的谈判进程，其基础是建立与以色列并肩的巴勒斯坦国对于缔造和平至关重要。

paras.en: But since the Oslo process began in 1993, the number of Israeli settlers in the West Bank has ballooned from about 260,000 to more than 700,000, embedded deep inside West Bank areas that would be needed for a contiguous Palestinian state.
paras.zh: 但自 1993 年奥斯陆进程开始以来，约旦河西岸的以色列定居者人数已从约 26 万激增至超过 70 万，深入扎根于西岸地区，而这些地区是一个毗邻的巴勒斯坦国所需要的。

paras.en: “The concept of a two-state solution is currently irrelevant and likely will remain so for another decade or two, if not longer,” said Bergman. “It is unlikely to become a reality in the foreseeable future, as no Israeli leader can propose it to the Israeli public after the events of October 7.”
paras.zh: 伯格曼表示：“两国解决方案的概念目前无关紧要，而且很可能在未来一两年甚至更长时间内仍然如此。” “在可预见的未来，这不太可能成为现实，因为在 10 月 7 日事件之后，没有以色列领导人能够向以色列公众提出这一建议。”

paras.en: The only way it could regain prominence is if there is substantial international pressure, including severe sanctions on Israel, and a non-violent intifada, or an uprising by Palestinians, he said.
paras.zh: 他说，要想重新占据主导地位，唯一的办法是施加巨大的国际压力，包括对以色列的严厉制裁、非暴力起义或巴勒斯坦人的起义。

paras.en: The outright rejection of Palestinian statehood has simply become much more “acceptable”, said Zonszein.
paras.zh: 宗泽因说，彻底拒绝巴勒斯坦建国已经变得更加“可接受”。

paras.en: “There’s several parties who advocate these views, whereas there isn’t a single Jewish Zionist Party that puts the need for a two-state solution or a Palestinian political process at the forefront,” she said.
paras.zh: “有几个政党提倡这些观点，但没有一个犹太复国主义政党将两国解决方案或巴勒斯坦政治进程的需要放在首位，”她说。

paras.en: Taken all together, Israel’s election appears less a demand for change than a further entrenchment of the jingoism that surged after October 7, 2023.
paras.zh: 总而言之，以色列的选举与其说是对变革的要求，不如说是对 2023 年 10 月 7 日之后激增的沙文主义的进一步巩固。

paras.en: “[There’s] more and more movement towards more military force, more need for pushing the borders … out of a lot of fear that another October 7 could happen,” said Zonszein.
paras.zh: Zonszein 表示：“越来越多的运动倾向于增加军事力量，越来越需要突破边界……出于对另一次 10 月 7 日可能发生的恐惧。”

articles.title: Trump weighs joining the fight against Houthis after Riyadh airport attack
articles.author: The Associated Press

paras.en: Trump weighs joining the fight against Houthis after Riyadh airport attack
paras.zh: 利雅得机场袭击后，特朗普考虑加入打击胡塞武装

paras.en: CAIRO (AP) — The international airport in Saudi Arabia's capital, Riyadh, was attacked again Saturday as the kingdom faces an extraordinary series of assaults in the new front in the Iran war. President Donald Trump said he was evaluating whether the U.S. should join Saudi strikes against the Tehran-backed Houthi rebels in neighboring Yemen.
paras.zh: 开罗（美联社）——沙特阿拉伯首都利雅得国际机场周六再次遭到袭击，该国在伊朗战争的新战线上面临一系列非同寻常的袭击。唐纳德·特朗普总统表示，他正在评估美国是否应该加入沙特对邻国也门境内德黑兰支持的胡塞武装的打击行动。

paras.en: The Houthis claimed attacks earlier in the week on King Khalid International Airport that killed three Saudis, including a pilot. On Saturday, a missile struck a complex housing terminals 3 and 4 for domestic flights and many people were wounded, a regional official said, speaking on condition of anonymity because they weren't authorized to speak to the media.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装声称本周早些时候袭击了哈立德国王国际机场，造成三名沙特人死亡，其中包括一名飞行员。一名地区官员表示，周六，一枚导弹击中了国内航班的 3 号和 4 号航站楼大楼，造成多人受伤。该官员要求匿名，因为他们无权接受媒体采访。

paras.en: "We may. We're going to look at it," Trump said of intervening. "We just found out about the recent attack. So we'll make a decision. We move very quickly."
paras.zh: “我们可能会。我们会考虑一下，”特朗普谈到干预时说道。 “我们刚刚发现最近发生的袭击事件。所以我们会做出决定。我们行动非常快。”

paras.en: The surge in attacks, including against other Saudi airports, military facilities and oil infrastructure, has come in the week since a Saudi-led coalition launched a major military offensive against the Houthis. There was no immediate statement from the rebels, who earlier Saturday accused Saudi Arabia of striking Sanaa International Airport in the Houthi-held Yemeni capital.
paras.zh: 自沙特领导的联军对胡塞武装发动大规模军事攻势以来，本周袭击事件激增，其中包括针对沙特其他机场、军事设施和石油基础设施的袭击。叛军没有立即发表声明，周六早些时候，叛军指责沙特阿拉伯袭击了胡塞武装控制的也门首都萨那国际机场。

paras.en: Riyadh airport operations have been suspended
paras.zh: 利雅得机场运营已暂停

paras.en: Saudi civil aviation authorities said airport operations were suspended and the extent of injuries and damage was being assessed. An official notice to aviators said the suspension was through midnight. The airport had a heavy police presence, with all entrances blocked, and lights around the complex were dimmed.
paras.zh: 沙特民航当局表示，机场运营已暂停，受伤和损失程度正在评估中。给飞行员的官方通知称，停飞将持续到午夜。机场有大量警察驻守，所有入口都被封锁，机场周围的灯光也很暗。

paras.en: Flights diverted elsewhere, the Flightradar24 tracker said. Countries including the United States, Britain, Germany, Australia and Canada warned citizens to avoid the airport.
paras.zh: Flightradar24 追踪器称，航班改道至其他地方。美国、英国、德国、澳大利亚和加拿大等国警告公民避免前往机场。

paras.en: The attacks on Saudi Arabia, the world's top oil exporter, have rattled markets and the region. And yet the Saudi energy ministry hours after the latest one was still promoting a major international energy conference set to begin in Riyadh on Sunday.
paras.zh: 全球最大石油出口国沙特阿拉伯遭受的袭击震惊了市场和该地区。然而，在最新一次会议发生数小时后，沙特能源部仍在推动将于周日在利雅得召开的大型国际能源会议。

paras.en: Fighting in Yemen between the Houthis and Saudi-backed Yemeni government forces has escalated, with the Saudi-led coalition providing air support for government forces attempting to reverse recent Houthi gains along the Red Sea. Those gains gave the rebels better surveillance of shipping on a corridor that is a crucial alternative to the Strait of Hormuz, where Iran has been attacking ships.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装和沙特支持的也门政府军之间的战斗不断升级，沙特领导的联军为试图扭转胡塞武装最近在红海沿岸取得的进展的政府军提供空中支援。这些成果使叛军能够更好地监视走廊上的航运，该走廊是霍尔木兹海峡的重要替代通道，伊朗一直在霍尔木兹海峡袭击船只。

paras.en: Though the Houthis have told the AP and others they are only targeting Saudi shipping as part of a blockade in retaliation for one imposed on them, concerns about wider attacks persist. The Houthis previously attacked other ships after the war in Gaza began, calling it solidarity with Palestinians. A U.S. bombing campaign sharply limited that.
paras.zh: 尽管胡塞武装告诉美联社和其他人，他们只是针对沙特航运作为封锁的一部分，以报复对他们实施的袭击，但对更广泛袭击的担忧仍然存在。加沙战争开始后，胡塞武装此前曾袭击过其他船只，称其是为了声援巴勒斯坦人。美国的轰炸行动极大地限制了这一点。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia has run low on interceptors, officials say
paras.zh: 官员称沙特阿拉伯拦截弹已所剩无几

paras.en: Saudi Arabia is running low on missile interceptors and has asked France, Britain, Pakistan and Egypt to deploy air defense support to the region, regional officials told the AP last month, with one noting that the U.S. has seen its own stock dwindle during the war with Iran.
paras.zh: 地区官员上个月告诉美联社，沙特阿拉伯的导弹拦截器数量不足，并已要求法国、英国、巴基斯坦和埃及向该地区部署防空支持，其中一位官员指出，在与伊朗的战争期间，美国的库存不断减少。

paras.en: Officials have said U.S. assistance has included intelligence sharing, target identification and planning for the latest offensive against the Houthis.
paras.zh: 官员们表示，美国的援助包括情报共享、目标识别以及针对胡塞武装的最新攻势的规划。

paras.en: On Saturday, Saudi Arabia said its foreign minister and Omani counterpart spoke by phone about the importance of "supporting diplomatic solutions to de-escalate tensions" in the region. Oman, which lies across the Strait of Hormuz from Iran, has played a mediator role at times in the region.
paras.zh: 周六，沙特阿拉伯表示，其外交部长和阿曼外长通过电话谈到了“支持外交解决方案以缓解该地区紧张局势”的重要性。阿曼与伊朗隔霍尔木兹海峡相望，有时在该地区发挥调解人的作用。

paras.en: Meanwhile, Saudi authorities warned the public this week that "filming, publishing or sharing information related to countering missiles and drones and their impact sites exposes you to legal liability."
paras.zh: 与此同时，沙特当局本周警告公众，“拍摄、发布或分享与对抗导弹和无人机及其影响地点相关的信息会让你承担法律责任。”

paras.en: The Houthis this week warned global airlines "for the last time" about the potential consequences of operating in Saudi airspace, which they described as a theater for their military operations.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装本周“最后一次”警告全球航空公司在沙特领空开展业务的潜在后果，他们称沙特领空是其军事行动的战场。

paras.en: At least 291 flights at the Riyadh airport had been canceled over the past 24 hours, according to flight-tracking site FlightAware. Before the latest attack, Air India, FlyDubai, Lufthansa Group and Pakistan International Airlines were among airlines suspending flights to and from Riyadh and other Saudi airports for varying periods.
paras.zh: 根据航班跟踪网站 FlightAware 的数据，过去 24 小时内，利雅得机场至少有 291 个航班被取消。在最近一次袭击之前，印度航空、迪拜航空、汉莎航空集团和巴基斯坦国际航空等航空公司都在不同时期暂停了往返利雅得和其他沙特机场的航班。

paras.en: The European Union Aviation Safety Agency had expanded its guidance on Saudi airspace, noting the Houthis' ability to strike targets deeper inside the kingdom, including Riyadh, and a "greater focus on aviation infrastructure."
paras.zh: 欧盟航空安全局扩大了对沙特领空的指导，指出胡塞武装有能力打击沙特境内更深处的目标，包括利雅得，并且“更加关注航空基础设施”。

paras.en: The missile and drone attacks and interception efforts "create an increased risk of misidentification of civil aircraft," it said.
paras.zh: 报告称，导弹和无人机的攻击和拦截工作“增加了误认民用飞机的风险”。

paras.en: Two regional officials said Houthi attacks on the Riyadh airport on Thursday damaged three planes. The officials spoke on condition of anonymity because they weren't authorized to brief the media. The Saudi national carrier said one of its aircraft was damaged while it was on the ground, with no passengers on board.
paras.zh: 两名地区官员表示，胡塞武装周四对利雅得机场发动袭击，造成三架飞机受损。这些官员要求匿名，因为他们无权向媒体通报情况。沙特国家航空公司表示，其一架飞机在地面时受损，机上没有乘客。

articles.title: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
articles.author: Henry Larson

paras.en: Bayeux Tapestry's London tour spurs enthusiasts to Battle of Hastings reenactment
paras.zh: 贝叶挂毯的伦敦之旅激发了爱好者们重演黑斯廷斯战役的热情

paras.en: A reenactment of the Battle of Hastings, which took place almost a millennium ago, is drawing crowds of enthusiasts in the UK.
paras.zh: 近千年前发生的黑斯廷斯战役的重演吸引了英国的大批爱好者。

paras.en: The Battle of Hastings is as famous for the Brits as the American Revolution is for us. The artwork that depicts that battle of almost a millennium ago this week, the Bayeux Tapestry, has been displayed in the British Museum for the first time. And this weekend, the reenactment of that gruesome conquest is drawing big crowds. NPR's Henry Larson reports.
paras.zh: 黑斯廷斯战役对于英国人来说就像美国革命对于我们来说一样著名。本周，描绘近千年前那场战斗的艺术品《贝叶挂毯》首次在大英博物馆展出。这个周末，那场可怕的征服的重演吸引了大批观众。 NPR 的亨利·拉尔森报道。

paras.en: UNIDENTIFIED ANNOUNCER: Look at the speed of these warriors. Give...
paras.zh: 身份不明的播音员：看看这些战士的速度。给...
