articles.title: Frustrated Arkansas football fans float wild plan to get AD fired, and it could happen today

paras.en: It's been a brutal year for Arkansas football.
paras.zh: 对于阿肯色州足球来说，这是残酷的一年。

paras.en: Well, scratch that. It's been a brutal ... decade ... for Arkansas football.
paras.zh: 好吧，从头开始。对于阿肯色州足球来说，这是残酷的十年。

paras.en: The Razorbacks sit at 2-3 and near the bottom of the SEC ahead of today's matchup was Tennessee, and the prospects don't look great. The Vols (4-1) are No. 15 in the country, and are better than Arkansas in just about every metric possible.
paras.zh: 剃刀鲸队目前战绩为 2 胜 3 负，在今天对阵田纳西州队之前，在 SEC 排名中垫底，前景看起来并不乐观。沃尔斯 (4-1) 在全国排名第 15，并且几乎在所有可能的指标上都比阿肯色州更好。

paras.en: By all accounts, it should be a blowout — most Razorback losses this season have been. There's little reason to believe today will be any different.
paras.zh: 从各方面来看，这应该是一场井喷——本赛季剃刀鲸队的大部分失利都是如此。没有理由相信今天会有什么不同。

paras.en: But, there is some good news! Win OR lose (probably lose), fans are still mulling perhaps the most diabolical plan known to man to get AD Hunter Yurachek fired ...
paras.zh: 但是，有一些好消息！无论赢还是输（可能会输），球迷们仍在考虑也许是人类已知的最邪恶的计划，以解雇 AD Hunter Yurachek...

paras.en: "Win or lose we #stormthefield Every game ends in a field storming and a $250,000 fine until @ArkRazorbacks fire @HunterYurachek," one X user posted earlier this week in a now-viral post with more than 1 million views.
paras.zh: “无论输赢，我们#stormthefield 每场比赛都以一场场风暴和 25 万美元的罚款结束，直到@ArkRazorbacks 解雇@HunterYurachek，”一位 X 用户本周早些时候在一篇现已疯传的帖子中写道，该帖子的浏览量已超过 100 万次。

paras.en: Amazing. It just means more in the SEC, baby! Frankly, it's brilliant. This is the sort of out-of-the-box thinking the Razorbacks could use on an offense that currently ranks 115th in the country. Or a defense that ranks 108th and is currently giving up nearly 30 points per game.
paras.zh: 惊人的。这对 SEC 来说意味着更多，宝贝！坦白说，这太棒了。这是 Razorbacks 可以在目前全国排名第 115 位的进攻中使用的那种创新思维。或者是排名第108位、目前场均失分近30分的防守。

paras.en: Look, it probably won't happen but ... never say never. Razorback fans are tired. It's been a long few years, and that's an understatement.
paras.zh: 看，这可能不会发生，但是……永远不要说永远。剃刀鲸球迷很累。已经过去了好几年了，这是轻描淡写的。

paras.en: Arkansas went 2-10 last season, and that wass the third such 2-10 campaign in the last decade. Just an absurd stat for an SEC school. It's unfathomable.
paras.zh: 阿肯色州上赛季取得2胜10负的战绩，这是过去十年中第三次取得2胜10负的战绩。对于 SEC 学校来说，这只是一个荒谬的统计数据。这是深不可测的。

paras.en: The Razorbacks haven't won 10 games since 2011, and have just one 9-win season (2021) in that same span. Growing up, Vanderbilt was the SEC bottom-feeder. Everyone knew it. That game was an automatic win when you looked at the preseason schedule.
paras.zh: 自 2011 年以来，剃刀鲸队还没有赢过 10 场比赛，并且在同一时期内只有一个 9 胜的赛季（2021 年）。在成长过程中，范德比尔特一直是美国证券交易委员会垫底的人。每个人都知道。当你查看季前赛的赛程表时，那场比赛是自动获胜的。

paras.en: Arkansas has officially taken that spot, and it's probably going to get worse (somehow) before it gets better.
paras.zh: 阿肯色州已经正式占据了这一位置，在情况好转之前，情况可能会变得更糟（以某种方式）。

paras.en: Perhaps fans storming the field — win or lose — and costing the program a hefty $250,000 fine each time they do so (per the NCAA rules) will expedite that process?
paras.zh: 也许球迷冲进球场——无论输赢——每次这样做都会给项目带来 25 万美元的巨额罚款（根据 NCAA 规则），这会加快这一过程吗？

articles.title: Arch Manning ranked fifth among 2027 NFL Draft quarterbacks as exec questions 'blind faith' based off name

paras.en: Arch Manning is focused on helping his No. 1 Texas Longhorns reach the College Football Playoff, and hopefully, the national championship game this season, but many are focused on what he does at the next level of his football career.
paras.zh: 阿奇·曼宁专注于帮助他的第一名德克萨斯长角牛队进入大学橄榄球季后赛，并希望进入本赛季的全国冠军赛，但许多人都关注他在足球生涯的下一个阶段所做的事情。

paras.en: Manning, the nephew of NFL great quarterbacks Peyton and Eli Manning, has been carrying that weight since he was in high school as a top prospect. But while there have been flashes of greatness from the Longhorns signal caller, ESPN’s latest quarterback rankings for the stacked 2027 NFL Draft have him at No. 5.
paras.zh: 曼宁是 NFL 伟大四分卫佩顿和伊莱·曼宁的侄子，从高中时期起，他就一直是最有前途的球员。尽管这位长角牛队的信号呼叫者已经展现出了伟大的表现，但 ESPN 最新的 2027 年 NFL 选秀四分卫排名中，他排名第五。

paras.en: In fact, one AFC assistant general manager told the outlet that Manning seems to have created "this blind faith" due to his namesake.
paras.zh: 事实上，一位亚足联助理总经理告诉媒体，曼宁似乎因为他的同名而创造了“这种盲目信仰”。

paras.en: "What’s giving so many people this blind faith that there’s just this monstrous ceiling with him?" the executive questioned. "Maybe this current state is just who he really is as a prospect."
paras.zh: “是什么让这么多人盲目相信他有这么可怕的天花板？”这位高管问道。 “也许目前的状态正是他作为潜在客户的真实身份。”

paras.en: Manning entered the 2026 college season with something to prove after what some viewed as an underwhelming 2025 campaign. He threw for 3,163 yards with 26 touchdowns and seven interceptions in 13 games.
paras.zh: 在经历了一些人认为平淡无奇的 2025 年赛季后，曼宁进入了 2026 年大学赛季，并需要证明一些东西。他在 13 场比赛中传球 3,163 码，取得 26 次达阵和 7 次拦截。

paras.en: This season, Manning has thrown for 862 yards with seven touchdowns and three interceptions for his 4-0 Longhorns, which includes a 21-point fourth-quarter comeback against Ohio State earlier this season.
paras.zh: 本赛季，曼宁带领长角牛队取得 4 胜 0 负的战绩，传球推进 862 码，取得 7 次达阵和 3 次拦截，其中包括本赛季早些时候对阵俄亥俄州立大学时第四节拿下 21 分的逆转。

paras.en: The expectations for Manning, though, coming into college were as astronomical as you may think given the quarterbacks with the same name that came before him. He hasn’t hit those high expectations on a consistent basis, but there’s still lots of football left to play.
paras.zh: 然而，考虑到在他之前的同名四分卫，人们对曼宁进入大学的期望就像你想象的天文数字一样。他并没有始终如一地达到这些高期望，但仍有很多比赛要做。

paras.en: But as NFL teams have already begun the rigorous scouting period ahead of next year’s draft in April, every throw, pre-snap check and more for Manning, and the other top quarterback prospects, mean that much more.
paras.zh: 但由于 NFL 球队已经在明年 4 月份的选秀之前开始了严格的球探期，因此对于曼宁和其他顶级四分卫候选人来说，每一次投球、预扣检查等都意味着更多。

paras.en: For now, one AFC scout told ESPN that Manning is someone a team might "fall in love with" down the road – not necessarily right now.
paras.zh: 目前，一名亚足联球探告诉 ESPN，曼宁是球队未来可能会“爱上”的人，但不一定是现在。

paras.en: "He’s always be graded on a different scale because of the name," the scout admitted. "…I don’t think he’s the best in the class, but his flashes in games are fascinating and a preview of what could happen down the road."
paras.zh: “因为他的名字，他总是被按照不同的标准进行评分，”球探承认。 “......我不认为他是班上最好的，但他在比赛中的闪光令人着迷，并且预示着未来可能发生的事情。”

paras.en: We’ve seen time and time again how prospects can change their draft stock with performances throughout a season. Even the NFL Scouting Combine changes the minds of all teams watching.
paras.zh: 我们一次又一次地看到新秀如何通过整个赛季的表现来改变他们的选秀顺位。甚至 NFL 球探联盟也会改变所有观看比赛的球队的想法。

paras.en: But Manning is expected to be in a draft class for the ages, with top quarterbacks like Oklahoma State’s Drew Mestemaker, Miami’s Darian Mensah, Ole Miss’ Trinidad Chambliss, and Notre Dame’s CJ Carr, who were all ranked higher than him in ESPN’s latest list.
paras.zh: 但曼宁预计将长期参加选秀，俄克拉荷马州立大学的德鲁·梅斯特梅克、迈阿密大学的达里安·门萨、密西西比大学的特立尼达·钱布利斯和圣母大学的 CJ·卡尔等顶级四分卫在 ESPN 的最新名单中排名都比他高。

paras.en: Manning has opportunities to change those perceptions in the upcoming weeks, facing five straight ranked opponents after the "Red River Rivalry" game against Oklahoma on Saturday. Texas is set to face No. 16 Florida, No. 9 Ole Miss, No. 17 Mississippi State, No. 14 Missouri and No. 10 LSU, respectively.
paras.zh: 曼宁有机会在接下来的几周内改变这些看法，在周六对阵俄克拉荷马州的“红河对抗”比赛后，他将面对五位连续排名的对手。德克萨斯州将分别面对排名第 16 的佛罗里达州、排名第 9 的密西西比州、排名第 17 的密西西比州、排名第 14 的密苏里州和排名第 10 的路易斯安那州立大学。

articles.title: Israeli combat medicine slashes IDF deaths after Oct 7, draws US military interest

paras.en: JERUSALEM — The growing number of Israeli army battlefield life-saving measures have emerged during the Iranian regime-backed multi-front war against the Jewish state that those new technologies are helping the U.S. too.
paras.zh: 耶路撒冷——在伊朗政权支持的针对犹太国家的多战线战争期间，以色列军队采取了越来越多的战场救生措施，这些新技术也为美国提供了帮助。

paras.en: Fox News Digital was briefed on the most current insights and data on Israel’s success rate in saving soldiers’ lives from a senior Israel Defense Forces (IDF) medical specialist in battlefield medicine.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军 (IDF) 战地医学高级医疗专家向福克斯新闻数字频道简要介绍了有关以色列拯救士兵生命成功率的最新见解和数据。

paras.en: The grueling Israeli ground offensive against the U.S.-designated terrorist movement Hamas in the Gaza Strip, which started in Oct. 2023, following the Jihadi organization’s invasion of Israel on Oct. 7, introduced cutting-edge medical tactics to the battlefield.
paras.zh: 继哈马斯圣战组织于 10 月 7 日入侵以色列后，以色列于 2023 年 10 月开始在加沙地带对美国指定的恐怖组织哈马斯发动艰苦的地面攻势，将尖端医疗战术引入战场。

paras.en: Hamas brutally murdered over 1,200 people in southern Israel, including more than forty Americans, and kidnapped 251 people.
paras.zh: 哈马斯在以色列南部残酷杀害了1200多人，其中包括40多名美国人，并绑架了251人。

paras.en: An IDF spokesman laid out the new advances: "The IDF Medical Corps adapted its operational capabilities during the war, including casualty evacuation, innovative medical technologies and providing treatment under fire in a challenging terrain. "
paras.zh: 以色列国防军发言人阐述了新的进展：“以色列国防军医疗队在战争期间调整了其作战能力，包括伤员后送、创新医疗技术以及在具有挑战性的地形中在炮火下提供治疗。”

paras.en: The IDF medical specialist told Fox News Digital that during "the Second War in Lebanon [in 2006 against the Lebanese-based terrorist group Hezbollah] it took 15 to 20 minutes for advanced life support to reach a casualty. Now advanced life support can reach a casualty immediately or within 4 minutes."
paras.zh: 以色列国防军医疗专家告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，“黎巴嫩第二次战争（2006 年针对黎巴嫩恐怖组织真主党）期间，高级生命支持需要 15 到 20 分钟才能到达伤员身边。现在，高级生命支持可以立即或在 4 分钟内到达伤员身边。”

paras.en: The placement of "medical personnel on the battlefield, including a doctor in every company, allows the IDF to make critical decisions early on during the care process, said the IDF medical specialist. The use of helicopters to deliver seriously wounded soldiers to medical facilities, as seen in video footage provided to Fox News Digital, plays a critical role in preventing death.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军医学专家表示，“在战场上部署医务人员，包括每个连队的一名医生，使以色列国防军能够在护理过程的早期做出关键决定。正如福克斯新闻数字频道提供的视频片段所示，使用直升机将重伤士兵送往医疗机构，在防止死亡方面发挥着关键作用。”

paras.en: The second advance is, according to the IDF medical specialist, "rapid evacuation," which means "We can evacuate casualties to Israeli hospitals rapidly."
paras.zh: 以色列国防军医疗专家表示，第二个进步是“快速疏散”，这意味着“我们可以迅速将伤员疏散到以色列医院”。

paras.en: There has been "an emphasis on the use of blood products since 2013 on stopping bleeding," said the IDF medical specialist. He added that the IDF is the first medical organization that "used plasma on the point of injury instead of salt and water."
paras.zh: 以色列国防军医学专家表示，“自 2013 年以来，一直强调使用血液制品来止血”。他补充说，以色列国防军是第一个“在受伤点使用血浆代替盐和水”的医疗组织。

paras.en: He noted the IDF implemented a sophisticated rapid-fire system for providing blood to injured soldiers. A telling example: Blood was placed on the back of first responders in coolers to stop bleeding and control the hemorrhaging. The method "saved significant numbers" of injured soldiers.
paras.zh: 他指出，以色列国防军实施了先进的快速射击系统，为受伤士兵提供血液。一个生动的例子：血液被放置在冷却器中的急救人员的背部，以止血并控制出血。这种方法“拯救了大量”受伤的士兵。

paras.en: An additional improvement in lifesaving first response medicine in the war zone involves an "advanced system of learning and the collection of data that transmits the data over technical networks so that every provider can see patient data."
paras.zh: 战区救生急救医学的另一项改进涉及“先进的学习和数据收集系统，通过技术网络传输数据，以便每个提供者都可以看到患者数据。”

paras.en: The IDF specialist said that "Every relevant medical officer on the chain can see the patient data. This system had very good results."
paras.zh: IDF专家表示，“链上每个相关医疗人员都可以看到患者数据。这个系统效果非常好。”

paras.en: The case mortality rate is the best index for quantifying care, said the IDF medical specialist. The results have been dramatic. According to IDF data, the mortality rate during the 2006 war against Hezbollah was 15% in contrast to 7.1% during 2023.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军医学专家表示，病例死亡率是量化护理的最佳指标。结果是戏剧性的。根据以色列国防军的数据，2006 年针对真主党的战争期间的死亡率为 15%，而 2023 年期间的死亡率为 7.1%。

paras.en: The IDF medical specialist said Israel’s military medicine apparatus has relied on the bedrock 2012 U.S. study "Death on the battlefield (2001–2011): Implications for the future of combat casualty care," which covered American medical aid during the war in Iraq.
paras.zh: 以色列国防军医疗专家表示，以色列的军事医疗设备依赖于2012年美国研究“战场上的死亡（2001-2011）：对战斗伤员护理未来的影响”的基础研究，该研究涵盖了伊拉克战争期间美国的医疗援助。

paras.en: Dr. Marc Siegel, senior medical analyst for Fox News, is also a clinical professor of medicine and a practicing internist at NYU Langone Medical Center, told Fox News Digital, "Battle field advances based on the latest technologies that have been developed in Israel, including surgical techniques as well as the latest burn treatment Nexobrid help not just today’s wounded but fuel medical and surgical advances around the world."
paras.zh: 福克斯新闻的高级医学分析师、纽约大学兰格尼医学中心的医学临床教授和执业内科医生马克·西格尔博士告诉福克斯新闻数字媒体，“基于以色列开发的最新技术的战场进步，包括外科技术以及最新的烧伤治疗 Nexobrid 不仅帮助当今的伤员，而且推动了世界各地的医疗和外科进步。”

paras.en: Siegel's latest book "The Angels Among Us: How God's Messengers Play a Role in Healing," features a chapter involving a medical rescue during the Gaza war.
paras.zh: 西格尔的最新著作《我们身边的天使：上帝的使者如何在治愈中发挥作用》有一章涉及加沙战争期间的医疗救援。

paras.en: The U.S. Army and the IDF have been cooperating in how to advance battlefield medicine for years.
paras.zh: 美国陆军和以色列国防军多年来一直在如何推进战地医学方面进行合作。

paras.en: According to an April 2026 U.S. military report titled "Israeli Defense Force Medical Lessons Learned," the American military authors explained in the 78-page study the pressing need to absorb Israel’s advances from the start of the Swords of Iron War campaign in 2023.
paras.zh: 根据 2026 年 4 月题为“以色列国防军医疗经验教训”的美国军事报告，美国军事作者在这份长达 78 页的研究报告中解释了从 2023 年铁剑战争战役开始以来吸收以色列先进技术的迫切需要。

paras.en: The U.S. Army wrote, "In the fields of operational health and force readiness, the IDF executed proactive public health measures – including robust bio-surveillance, forward-positioned preventive medicine teams and stringent food safety protocols – to mitigate health threats and maintain operational readiness."
paras.zh: 美国陆军写道：“在作战健康和部队战备领域，以色列国防军采取了积极主动的公共卫生措施，包括强有力的生物监测、前瞻性的预防医学团队和严格的食品安全协议，以减轻健康威胁并保持战备状态。”

paras.en: The American army warned that "Despite Israel’s preparations, it had to undergo a painful process of transformation in contact that the U.S. now has the opportunity to avoid. The time for preparation is now. Simply possessing clinical and tactical skills is insufficient."
paras.zh: 美国陆军警告说，“尽管以色列做好了准备，但它必须经历一个痛苦的接触转型过程，而美国现在有机会避免这一过程。现在是准备的时候了。仅仅拥有临床和战术技能是不够的。”

paras.en: An IDF spokesman told Fox News Digital that the U.S. Army study of Israel's emergency health care providers during the wars" was a joint collaboration, and American officers came to learn from the IDF."
paras.zh: 以色列国防军发言人告诉福克斯新闻数字频道，美国陆军对战争期间以色列紧急医疗保健提供者的研究“是一项联合合作，美国军官前来向以色列国防军学习。”

articles.title: Ukraine hit by deadly Russian strikes as ‘thanks’ for Trump diesel deal, Zelenskyy says
articles.author: Oliver Holmes

paras.en: Russia launched deadly strikes on civilians in Ukraine as “thanks” for a deal cut by Donald Trump with Vladimir Putin to buy large quantities of Russian diesel, Volodymyr Zelenskyy has said, accusing Washington of helping fund Moscow’s war.
paras.zh: 弗拉基米尔·泽连斯基表示，俄罗斯对乌克兰平民发动致命袭击，是为了“感谢”唐纳德·特朗普与弗拉基米尔·普京达成的购买大量俄罗斯柴油的协议，并指责华盛顿帮助资助莫斯科的战争。

paras.en: The Ukrainian president has expressed repeated outrage at the agreement announced by Trump on Friday, which the US president said was needed to reduce diesel prices, and comes ahead of November midterm elections in which fuel costs are a key voter issue.
paras.zh: 乌克兰总统多次对特朗普周五宣布的协议表示愤怒，美国总统称该协议是降低柴油价格所必需的，并且是在 11 月中期选举之前进行的，其中燃料成本是选民的一个关键问题。

paras.en: The deal, which appeared to blind side Kyiv as it was announced while Ukrainian negotiators were in Miami for peace talks, was described by Zelenskyy as a “gift” to Russia’s president.
paras.zh: 泽伦斯基称，这项协议是在乌克兰谈判代表在迈阿密进行和平谈判时宣布的，这似乎让基辅措手不及。泽连斯基将其描述为送给俄罗斯总统的“礼物”。

paras.en: He said Russia would use the money it raised from the fuel sales to invest in its war and that “any easing of sanctions” would play into Russia’s hands, “allowing it to kill more, wage war for longer”.
paras.zh: 他表示，俄罗斯将利用从燃料销售中筹集到的资金来投资战争，“任何制裁的放松”都会对俄罗斯有利，“使其能够杀死更多人，发动更长时间的战争”。

paras.en: That prediction was realised hours later, when Ukrainian officials announced that a barrage of Russian strikes on the country’s south-east early on Saturday had killed 15 people, including three children.
paras.zh: 几小时后，这一预测成为现实，乌克兰官员宣布，俄罗斯于周六早些时候对该国东南部发动一连串袭击，造成 15 人死亡，其中包括 3 名儿童。

paras.en: “Today, Russia expressed its thanks for the lifting of sanctions on diesel exports by dropping five glide bombs on residential buildings in Zaporizhzhia,” Zelenskyy said on social media on Saturday.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周六在社交媒体上表示：“今天，俄罗斯向扎波罗热的住宅楼投掷了五枚滑翔炸弹，对取消柴油出口制裁表示感谢。”

paras.en: “Last night confirmed once again that in Russia, they take any easing of pressure to mean they can keep fighting, to mean they can keep dropping bombs on cities. Different signals are needed,” he said.
paras.zh: “昨晚再次证实，在俄罗斯，他们认为任何压力的缓解都意味着他们可以继续战斗，意味着他们可以继续向城市投掷炸弹。需要不同的信号，”他说。

paras.en: There were also “large-scale power outages” in the capital, Kyiv, the country’s largest private energy provider said.
paras.zh: 该国最大的私营能源供应商表示，首都基辅也出现了“大规模停电”。

paras.en: In stark contrast to Zelenskyy’s open frustration with Trump, a Kremlin readout of Friday’s call between the US president and Putin was glowing, with the Russian news agency Interfax quoting an aide as saying it was “very substantive and friendly”.
paras.zh: 与泽伦斯基公开对特朗普表示不满形成鲜明对比的是，克里姆林宫宣读了美国总统和普京周五的通话，俄罗斯通讯社国际文传电讯社援引一名助手的话说，通话“非常实质性和友好”。

paras.en: “Neither wanted to be the first to hang up,” the Kremlin foreign policy aide Yuri Ushakov said of the two leaders. “They hung up simultaneously, literally at the same time.” Zelenskyy has previously said Putin is playing games with Trump.
paras.zh: “两人都不想成为第一个挂断电话的人，”克里姆林宫外交政策助理尤里·乌沙科夫在谈到两位领导人时说道。 “他们同时挂断电话，实际上是同时挂断电话。”泽连斯基此前曾表示，普京正在与特朗普玩游戏。

paras.en: The diesel deal disrupts four years of western financial pressure on Moscow and leaves Kyiv’s allies in Europe and Nato scrambling to adapt their sanctions plan. The EU’s top diplomat, Kaja Kallas, said the diesel deal “provides Moscow with more revenues to wage war”.
paras.zh: 柴油协议扰乱了西方四年来对莫斯科施加的财政压力，并让基辅的欧洲盟友和北约争先恐后地调整其制裁计划。欧盟最高外交官卡亚·卡拉斯表示，柴油协议“为莫斯科提供了更多的收入来发动战争”。

paras.en: “This is not the time to ease pressure on Russia, and Europe won’t,” she said on Saturday. “On Monday, EU foreign ministers intend to approve the biggest set of sanctions listings targeting Russia’s war machine since the start of the war.” She was referring to plans to formally add 1,600 new individuals and entities to the EU’s sanctions blacklist.
paras.zh: “现在不是减轻对俄罗斯压力的时候，欧洲也不会，”她周六表示。 “周一，欧盟外长打算批准自战争开始以来针对俄罗斯战争机器的最大规模制裁清单。”她指的是正式将 1,600 名新个人和实体加入欧盟制裁黑名单的计划。

paras.en: Major European governments have attempted to balance their diplomatic and trade relationships with a mercurial Trump and their support for Ukraine.
paras.zh: 欧洲主要国家政府试图平衡与反复无常的特朗普的外交和贸易关系以及对乌克兰的支持。

paras.en: The German government spokesperson Stefan Kornelius said Berlin “remains committed to the sanctions imposed on Russia and is working with its European partners on further sanctions”, adding that support for Ukraine “remains unwavering”.
paras.zh: 德国政府发言人斯特凡·科尼利厄斯表示，柏林“仍然致力于对俄罗斯实施的制裁，并正在与欧洲伙伴合作实施进一步的制裁”，并补充说，对乌克兰的支持“仍然坚定不移”。

paras.en: Ulf Kristersson, the Swedish prime minister, expressed “regret” at the US agreement, saying energy revenues were “a vital source of funding Russia’s war of aggression”.
paras.zh: 瑞典首相乌尔夫·克里斯特森对美国的协议表示“遗憾”，称能源收入是“资助俄罗斯侵略战争的重要来源”。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said on Saturday that Russia “must feel its losses” and has promised to respond. In the Russian-occupied Luhansk region, Ukrainian attacks in the past 24 hours had killed four civilians and wounded five, the region’s Russian-installed governor, Leonid Pasechnik, said on Saturday.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基周六表示，俄罗斯“必须感受到损失”，并承诺做出回应。俄罗斯任命的卢甘斯克地区州长列昂尼德·帕塞奇尼克 (Leonid Pasechnik) 周六表示，在俄罗斯占领的卢甘斯克地区，乌克兰在过去 24 小时内发动的袭击已造成 4 名平民死亡、5 人受伤。

paras.en: Zelenskyy said that Ukraine was ready to take “de-escalatory steps” in the war but only if Russia did the same.
paras.zh: 泽连斯基表示，乌克兰准备在战争中采取“缓和局势的步骤”，但前提是俄罗斯也这样做。

paras.en: Russia’s fuel production has become a key point of contention between Zelenskyy and Trump, who has attempted to stop Ukraine from bombing Russian refineries, which he says exacerbates a global diesel shortage. The Ukrainian leader has rejected such requests unless Russia stops attacking Ukraine’s energy infrastructure.
paras.zh: 俄罗斯的燃料生产已成为泽伦斯基和特朗普之间争论的一个关键点，特朗普试图阻止乌克兰轰炸俄罗斯炼油厂，他说这加剧了全球柴油短缺。乌克兰领导人拒绝了此类请求，除非俄罗斯停止攻击乌克兰的能源基础设施。

paras.en: The Financial Times reported that during the talks in Miami, Trump’s envoys Steve Witkoff and Jared Kushner raised the possibility that US intelligence sharing could be cut off if Kyiv did not halt the strikes.
paras.zh: 英国《金融时报》报道称，在迈阿密会谈期间，特朗普特使史蒂夫·威特科夫和贾里德·库什纳提出，如果基辅不停止袭击，美国情报共享可能被切断。

articles.title: Dozens reported injured in Yemeni Houthi attack at Riyadh airport
articles.author: Patrick Wintour Diplomatic editor and agencies

paras.en: Yemen’s Houthis have launched a missile attack on Riyadh’s international airport in Saudi Arabia, with dozens reported wounded and a witness describing panic in the terminal.
paras.zh: 也门胡塞武装对沙特阿拉伯利雅得国际机场发动导弹袭击，据报道有数十人受伤，一名目击者描述了航站楼内的恐慌。

paras.en: Saudi authorities did not confirm any new attack or evacuation, but one witness reported hearing an explosion while waiting to board a flight, and another said they saw a strike that left people wounded.
paras.zh: 沙特当局没有证实发生任何新的袭击或疏散事件，但一名目击者报告称，在等待登机时听到爆炸声，另一名目击者表示，他们看到一次袭击，导致人员受伤。

paras.en: “I was on gate 403,” at the domestic terminal, the witness told Agence France-Presse. “I saw [gate] 401 hit, I saw injured [people] in front of my eyes. Everyone was running.”
paras.zh: 目击者告诉法新社，“我在国内航站楼的 403 号登机口”。 “我看到 401 号门被击中，我看到受伤的人就在我眼前。每个人都在逃跑。”

paras.en: A source at a local hospital told the news agency that five people were in intensive care after being wounded at the airport, and “dozens” more had been injured.
paras.zh: 当地一家医院的消息人士告诉该通讯社，有五人在机场受伤后正在接受重症监护，另有“数十人”受伤。

paras.en: The relative of one injured person said they had been wounded in the shoulders and arms by shattered glass and taken to hospital.
paras.zh: 一名伤者的亲属表示，他们的肩膀和手臂被碎玻璃击伤，被送往医院。

paras.en: Witnesses said people were being evacuated from the airport.
paras.zh: 目击者称，人们正在从机场疏散。

paras.en: Saturday’s incident comes amid an escalation of missile strikes by Yemen’s Iran-aligned Houthi on the kingdom. The airport has already been attacked twice this week, leaving four people dead and others wounded, and badly damaging an aircraft.
paras.zh: 周六的事件发生之际，也门与伊朗结盟的胡塞武装对也门的导弹袭击升级。该机场本周已遭受两次袭击，造成四人死亡、多人受伤，一架飞机严重受损。

paras.en: The Houthis have repeatedly attacked Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers after a truce in their long-running war with Yemen’s Riyadh-backed government unravelled in July.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装与也门利雅得支持的政府的长期战争于7月破裂，此后，胡塞武装多次袭击沙特机场、石油设施和油轮。

paras.en: The attack came as forces allied to the UN-recognised government in Yemen claim to have mounted a successful offensive to retake the Bab al-Mandab strait from Houthi rebels, but accounts vary as to whether the push has been repelled.
paras.zh: 此次袭击发生之际，联合国承认的也门政府的盟友声称已成功发动进攻，从胡塞叛军手中夺回了曼德海峡，但对于进攻是否被击退的说法不一。

paras.en: A Houthi spokesperson said forces from the Saudi-backed government based in Aden “were targeted with a large number of ballistic missiles, artillery support and heavy weapons, resulting in the destruction of more than 22 armoured vehicles and the killing and wounding of dozens, including a number of commanders.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装发言人表示，沙特支持的驻亚丁政府部队“遭到大量弹道导弹、火炮支援和重型武器的攻击，导致超过 22 辆装甲车被毁，数十人死伤，其中包括多名指挥官。”

paras.en: “More than 30 ambulances arrived in Aden to transport the dead and wounded from the Saudi enemy’s mobilisations.”
paras.zh: “30多辆救护车抵达亚丁，运送沙特敌人动员中的死伤者。”

paras.en: By contrast, the Saudi ambassador to Yemen, Mohammed al-Jaber, said: “Blessed Friday and victory for every Yemeni and Arab. Bab al-Mandab has been cleared of the remnants of the Houthi terrorist militia.”
paras.zh: 相比之下，沙特驻也门大使穆罕默德·贾比尔表示：“星期五是幸福的，每个也门人和阿拉伯人都取得了胜利。曼德城已经清除了胡塞武装恐怖民兵的残余势力。”

paras.en: The exposed 5 sq mile (13 sq km) Perim Island straddles the strait, acting as a lookout point for all traffic from the Red Sea into the Gulf of Aden and towards the Indian Ocean. Aidarous al-Zubaidi, the president of the Southern Transitional Council (STC), one of the main political forces in the south of Yemen, claimed the island and coastal area had been recaptured from Houthi hands.
paras.zh: 裸露的 5 平方英里（13 平方公里）的佩林岛横跨海峡，是从红海到亚丁湾和印度洋所有交通的瞭望点。也门南部主要政治力量之一的南方过渡委员会（STC）主席艾达鲁斯·祖拜迪声称，也门岛屿和沿海地区已从胡塞武装手中夺回。

paras.en: An official military spokesperson for the UN-recognised government forces qualified the claim, saying only half the area had been recaptured so far. Waddah al-Dabish said newly established Houthi defensive lines had been broken on the land next to the strait, leading to the death of thousands of Houthi fighters.
paras.zh: 联合国承认的政府军的官方军事发言人证实了这一说法，称迄今为止只收复了一半地区。瓦达赫·达比什表示，胡塞武装新建立的防线在海峡附近的土地上被突破，导致数千名胡塞武装人员死亡。

paras.en: It is thought that as many as 500 Houthis fighters are stationed on the island, and Saudi Arabia is desperate to be able to report that the strait has been reclaimed to show that the land counteroffensive it launched at the beginning of the week is advancing.
paras.zh: 据认为，岛上驻扎着多达500名胡塞武装，沙特迫切希望能够报道称，该海峡已被收复，以表明其本周初发起的陆地反攻正在推进。

paras.en: The report came as the United Nations’ special envoy to Yemen, Hans Grundberg, admitted to the UN security council in New York that Yemen – the poorest country in the world – had lapsed back into full-scale war and said the first victims would be women and children.
paras.zh: 该报告发布之际，联合国也门特使汉斯·格伦德伯格在纽约向联合国安理会承认，也门这个世界上最贫穷的国家已经重新陷入全面战争，并表示首当其冲的受害者将是妇女和儿童。

paras.en: The Houthis seized control of the strait two weeks ago and said no Saudi-linked commercial traffic would be permitted to go through the narrow waterway. The Houthis are waging a war to remove Saudi influence from Yemen, and have been mounting missile attacks on Riyadh in support of this objective.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装两周前控制了该海峡，并表示不允许与沙特有关的商业交通通过这条狭窄的水道。胡塞武装正在发动一场战争，以消除沙特对也门的影响，并一直在对利雅得发动导弹袭击以支持这一目标。

paras.en: There have been previous premature reports of military breakthroughs by the Saudi-backed Yemeni government since it launched its counteroffensive at the start of the week, but the recapture of the land by the strait and Perim Island (also known as Mayyun Island) is a military prize western governments desperately need.
paras.zh: 沙特支持的也门政府自本周初发动反攻以来，曾有过军事突破的过早报道，但收复海峡和彼林岛（又称马云岛）的土地是西方政府迫切需要的军事战利品。

articles.title: Thousands gather in London to express support for Palestinians after three years of ‘genocide’
articles.author: Sammy Gecsoyler

paras.en: Thousands of people have gathered in central London to express their support for Palestinians after three years of “genocide” carried out against them by Israel.
paras.zh: 在以色列对巴勒斯坦人实施三年“种族灭绝”后，数千人聚集在伦敦市中心，表达对巴勒斯坦人的支持。

paras.en: The demonstrators, many wearing keffiyehs and holding Palestine flags, gathered on the Embankment at midday on Saturday. Some carried placards reading “End the genocide” and “Free Palestine” as they marched towards parliament. A bride and groom appeared to be among those in attendance and a two-minute silence was held to reflect on the lives lost in Gaza.
paras.zh: 周六中午，示威者聚集在堤岸上，其中许多人戴着头巾，举着巴勒斯坦旗帜。一些人在走向议会时举着写有“结束种族灭绝”和“自由巴勒斯坦”的标语牌。出席者中似乎有一对新娘和新郎，并举行了两分钟的默哀，以反思在加沙丧生的生命。

paras.en: The Metropolitan police said 20 arrests had been made, including for criminal damage after climbing on to the Battle of Britain memorial, having Palestine Action placards, making a Nazi salute and assaulting police as officers made arrests.
paras.zh: 伦敦警察局表示，已逮捕 20 人，其中包括因爬上不列颠之战纪念碑、举着“巴勒斯坦行动”标语牌、行纳粹礼以及在警察逮捕时袭击警察而造成的刑事破坏。

paras.en: Protesters were calling for the UK government to stop supplying arms to Israel, which various bodies – including the UN, Amnesty International, B’Tselem and Physicians for Human Rights, the latter two of which are Israeli-based – have said is committing genocide against Palestinians in Gaza.
paras.zh: 抗议者呼吁英国政府停止向以色列供应武器，包括联合国、国际特赦组织、B’Tselem 和医生促进人权组织（后两个组织均设在以色列）等多个机构均表示，以色列正在对加沙的巴勒斯坦人实施种族灭绝。

paras.en: A ceasefire was declared a year ago but Israeli airstrikes have continued in Gaza. In the last year, the overall death toll has risen by a further 1,400 people. Settlers have also ramped up their attacks against Palestinians in the West Bank. According to UN figures, 230 Palestinians were killed in the West Bank by Israeli forces and settlers in 2025.
paras.zh: 一年前宣布停火，但以色列对加沙的空袭仍在继续。去年，总死亡人数又增加了 1,400 人。定居者还加大了对西岸巴勒斯坦人的攻击力度。根据联合国数据，2025年，230名巴勒斯坦人在约旦河西岸被以色列军队和定居者杀害。

paras.en: Husam Zomlot, the Palestinian ambassador to the UK, shared a video from the march on social media. “Three years on, Israel’s atrocities in Gaza and the West Bank continue, and so does the solidarity of the British people. Louder, bigger and not going anywhere. Thank you all,” he said. By Saturday afternoon, organisers said 250,000 people were at the march.
paras.zh: 巴勒斯坦驻英国大使胡萨姆·佐姆洛特在社交媒体上分享了游行的视频。 “三年过去了，以色列在加沙和西岸的暴行仍在继续，英国人民的团结也在继续。声音更大，规模更大，但没有任何进展。谢谢大家，”他说。截至周六下午，组织者称已有 25 万人参加了游行。

paras.en: The Met have imposed conditions on the event – which is organised by the Palestine Coalition, which has organised more than 30 mass demonstrations since October 2023, with a counter-protest by Stop The Hate – to “minimise the risk of serious disruption to communities”.
paras.zh: 大都会艺术博物馆对这次由巴勒斯坦联盟组织的活动施加了条件，以“尽量减少对社区造成严重破坏的风险”，该活动自 2023 年 10 月以来已组织了 30 多次大规模示威活动，并由“停止仇恨”组织进行了反抗议。

paras.en: The Met posted on X saying: “The front of the procession has now entered Whitehall where a rally will take place.
paras.zh: 大都会博物馆在 X 上发帖称：“游行队伍的前端现已进入白厅，那里将举行集会。

paras.en: “Several arrests have been made so far including a woman and a man with placards declaring support for proscribed organisation Palestine Action.
paras.zh: “到目前为止，已有几人被捕，其中包括一名女子和一名男子，他们举着标语牌宣称支持被禁组织巴勒斯坦行动。

paras.en: “We have also arrested a number of protesters on suspicion of criminal damage after they climbed on to the Battle of Britain memorial on Victoria Embankment.”
paras.zh: “我们还逮捕了一些涉嫌刑事破坏的抗议者，他们爬上了维多利亚堤岸的不列颠之战纪念碑。”

paras.en: The national march is the first held since the foreign secretary, Ed Miliband, announced sweeping sanctions on trade with Israeli settlements and declared the UK government would take the official position that Israel’s occupation of the West Bank was unlawful in its entirety. He also told the Commons that settler terrorists supported by Benjamin Netanyahu’s government are committing ethnic cleansing in the West Bank.
paras.zh: 这次全国游行是自外交大臣埃德·米利班德宣布对与以色列定居点的贸易实施全面制裁并宣布英国政府将采取官方立场，即以色列对约旦河西岸的占领完全非法以来举行的首次全国游行。他还告诉下议院，本杰明·内塔尼亚胡政府支持的定居恐怖分子正在西岸进行种族清洗。

paras.en: At Labour party conference last month, Miliband appeared to reference the marches, which at their peak regularly numbered hundreds and thousands of people, telling the audience in Liverpool: “I want to say to the millions of people in this country and indeed elsewhere who have been moved and outraged by the plight of the Palestinian people: we hear you, you were right.”
paras.zh: 在上个月的工党会议上，米利班德似乎提到了游行，在高峰期通常有成百上千人参加，他对利物浦的观众说：“我想对这个国家以及其他地方数百万因巴勒斯坦人民的困境而感动和愤怒的人说：我们听到了，你是对的。”

paras.en: Deputy assistant commissioner Carl Galvin said: “We know Saturday’s event, so close to the third anniversary of the terror attack on Israel, has the potential to have a greater impact on communities than the previous national marches.”
paras.zh: 副助理专员卡尔·加尔文说：“我们知道周六的活动距离以色列恐怖袭击三周年纪念日如此之近，有可能比之前的全国游行对社区产生更大的影响。”

paras.en: Galvin, who is leading the policing operation this weekend, said the force’s presence on Saturday will be “significant”.
paras.zh: 负责本周末警务行动的加尔文表示，周六的警力部署将“意义重大”。

paras.en: “We will also be using powers under the Public Order Act requiring anyone in the protest area wearing face coverings to deliberately conceal their identity to remove them,” Galvin continued.
paras.zh: 加尔文继续说道：“我们还将利用《公共秩序法》赋予的权力，要求抗议地区佩戴面罩的任何人故意隐藏自己的身份以将其摘下。”

paras.en: The Met have imposed conditions on the march and require the group to travel via Westminster Bridge, York Road, Waterloo Bridge and The Strand on to Whitehall, with a rally concluding by 6.30pm. The force has said that any speeches and music must conclude by 5.30pm.
paras.zh: 大都会艺术博物馆对游行施加了条件，要求游行队伍经威斯敏斯特桥、约克路、滑铁卢桥和斯特兰德街到达白厅，集会于下午 6 点 30 分结束。警方表示，任何演讲和音乐都必须在下午 5.30 之前结束。

paras.en: A counter-protest by Stop The Hate is also taking place, with about 30 people gathered outside New Scotland Yard, some with flags.
paras.zh: Stop The Hate 组织也发起了反抗议活动，约有 30 人聚集在新苏格兰场外，其中一些人举着旗帜。

paras.en: The force has also imposed conditions on the demonstration “to minimise the risk of serious disruption”. The demonstrators must remain within a designated area outside the Met’s headquarters, with the assembly concluding at 2.30pm.
paras.zh: 部队还对示威活动施加了条件，“以尽量减少严重扰乱的风险”。示威者必须留在大都会总部外的指定区域内，集会于下午 2 点 30 分结束。

paras.en: Last Saturday, on the third anniversary of the 7 October attacks, when Hamas militants broke across the Israeli border to launch a wave of attacks on kibbutzim, border towns, military bases and music festivals, killing at least 1,209 people, a small pro-Palestine student demonstration in central London was held.
paras.zh: 上周六，在10月7日袭击事件三周年之际，哈马斯武装分子突破以色列边境，对基布兹、边境城镇、军事基地和音乐节发动一波袭击，造成至少1,209人死亡，伦敦市中心举行了一场小型的亲巴勒斯坦学生示威活动。

paras.en: The Met publicly appealed to those behind the demonstration to “exercise [their] right to protest on a different date” and admitted that finding the organisers had been “frankly difficult”. In the end, it went ahead and about 100 people attended. Five people were arrested for breaching conditions imposed on the march.
paras.zh: 大都会公开呼吁示威背后的人“行使在不同日期抗议的权利”，并承认找到组织者“坦白说很困难”。最终，活动如期进行，大约有100人参加。五人因违反游行条件而被捕。

paras.en: The Palestine Coalition organising the march includes Palestine Solidarity Campaign, Stop the War, CND, the Muslim Association of Britain, Friends of Al Aqsa and the Palestinian Forum in Britain.
paras.zh: 组织这次游行的巴勒斯坦联盟包括巴勒斯坦团结运动、停止战争、全国民主联盟、英国穆斯林协会、阿克萨之友和英国巴勒斯坦论坛。

articles.title: Nobel peace laureate says US sanctions on ICC 'unacceptable'

paras.en: Navi Pillay, the winner of this year's Nobel Peace Prize, has called US sanctions on the International Criminal Court (ICC) "unheard of" and "unacceptable".
paras.zh: 今年诺贝尔和平奖获得者纳维·皮莱称美国对国际刑事法院（ICC）的制裁“闻所未闻”且“不可接受”。

paras.en: The South African former ICC judge was awarded the prize on Friday "for her efforts to promote peace and international law", which paved the way for a "more comprehensive global legal order", the Nobel committee said.
paras.zh: 诺贝尔委员会表示，这位南非前国际刑事法院法官于周五“因促进和平与国际法的努力”而获奖，这为“更全面的全球法律秩序”铺平了道路。

paras.en: US President Donald Trump expressed his disatisfaction with the pick and hours later the US unveiled sweeping sanctions in a significant acceleration of its attempt to "dismantle" what it described as a "rogue" institution.
paras.zh: 美国总统唐纳德·特朗普表达了对这一选择的不满，几小时后，美国宣布了全面制裁，大大加速了其试图“拆除”其所称的“流氓”机构的步伐。

paras.en: The ICC said the measures were an assault on the rule of law and the foundations of the international legal order.
paras.zh: 国际刑事法院表示，这些措施是对法治和国际法律秩序基础的攻击。

paras.en: Pillay, speaking via video link during an event at the Nobel Peace Center in Oslo on Saturday, said: "There is so much tension and anxiety over the continued existence of international courts, mainly the International Criminal Court in The Hague.
paras.zh: 皮莱周六在奥斯陆诺贝尔和平中心的一次活动中通过视频连线发表讲话，他说：“国际法院，主要是海牙国际刑事法院的继续存在，引起了如此多的紧张和焦虑。

paras.en: "Most importantly, sanctions have been announced by one country against the judges, just for the judicial orders they issue. This is unheard of, unacceptable."
paras.zh: “最重要的是，一个国家仅仅因为他们发布的司法命令就宣布对法官实施制裁。这是闻所未闻、不可接受的。”

paras.en: US Secretary of State Marco Rubio earlier said the sanctions - which include a ban on US entities making transactions with the ICC - were intended to "defend US sovereignty" and accused the court of seeking to prosecute Americans.
paras.zh: 美国国务卿卢比奥早些时候表示，制裁措施——包括禁止美国实体与国际刑事法院进行交易——旨在“捍卫美国主权”，并指责该法院试图起诉美国人。

paras.en: The US has already sanctioned 17 ICC judges and officials, but this move sanctions the court itself as an institution and is intended to inhibit its ability to operate financially.
paras.zh: 美国已经制裁了17名国际刑事法院法官和官员，但此举制裁国际刑事法院本身作为一个机构，旨在抑制其财务运作能力。

paras.en: However, the US has provided a six-month grace period before some of these latest sanctions kick in, meaning member states can keep paying for its operations - a move Washington says is to allow countries time to negotiate a "solution to address" US concerns.
paras.zh: 然而，在最新的一些制裁生效之前，美国提供了六个月的宽限期，这意味着成员国可以继续为其业务支付费用——华盛顿表示，此举是为了让各国有时间谈判“解决”美国担忧的解决方案。

paras.en: The Trump administration claims that the ICC is run by what it calls globalists who threaten American sovereignty.
paras.zh: 特朗普政府声称国际刑事法院是由威胁美国主权的全球主义者管理的。

paras.en: It is furious over a past investigation into actions of US soldiers in Afghanistan the court has since closed and by its arrest warrants for Israeli officials including Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu. The new sanctions, however, do not say that those warrants must be withdrawn before the measures can be lifted.
paras.zh: 它对过去对美国士兵在阿富汗的行动进行的调查感到愤怒，该法院已关闭，并对包括总理本杰明·内塔尼亚胡在内的以色列官员发出逮捕令。然而，新的制裁并没有规定在解除措施之前必须撤回这些逮捕令。

paras.en: UN Secretary General Antonio Guterres called the US decision "a serious blow to our collective pursuit of international criminal justice, of which the ICC is a key pillar".
paras.zh: 联合国秘书长安东尼奥·古特雷斯称美国的决定“对我们集体追求国际刑事司法的严重打击，而国际刑事法院是国际刑事司法的关键支柱”。

paras.en: The UK joined Canada, Denmark, Germany, France, Italy, Japan and the Netherlands in saying they "regret and strongly disagree with" the sanctions.
paras.zh: 英国与加拿大、丹麦、德国、法国、意大利、日本和荷兰一起表示，他们对制裁“感到遗憾并强烈反对”。

paras.en: Pillay, 85, also served as UN rights chief, taking part in high-profile work considering allegations of human rights violations, including in Rwanda, Myanmar and Gaza.
paras.zh: 85 岁的皮莱还担任联合国人权事务负责人，参与了考虑卢旺达、缅甸和加沙等地侵犯人权指控的高调工作。

paras.en: Her early work included defending anti-apartheid activists in South Africa, and on Friday she became the country's fifth Peace Prize winner - following in the footsteps of Nelson Mandela and Archbishop Desmond Tutu.
paras.zh: 她的早期工作包括捍卫南非的反种族隔离活动人士，周五她成为该国第五位和平奖获得者——追随纳尔逊·曼德拉和德斯蒙德·图图大主教的脚步。

paras.en: Trump called the announcement of Pillay as 2026's winner "disgraceful and embarassing", and an "indelible stain on the country of Norway".
paras.zh: 特朗普称宣布皮莱为2026年获胜者“可耻且令人尴尬”，也是“挪威国家不可磨灭的污点”。

paras.en: He has long indicated he thought he should have been awarded the prestigious prize, and was nominated by several allies for it last year.
paras.zh: 他长期以来一直表示他认为自己应该获得这一享有声望的奖项，并于去年获得了几个盟友的提名。

articles.title: US murderer Christa Pike discharged from hospital 10 days after failed execution

paras.en: US death row inmate Christa Pike has been discharged from hospital following her botched execution at the end of last month, her lawyers have said.
paras.zh: 美国死囚克里斯塔·派克 (Christa Pike) 的律师表示，她在上个月底处决失败后已出院。

paras.en: The 50-year-old murderer has been returned to the prison where she has spent the last 30 years, according to a statement from her lawyers on Saturday.
paras.zh: 据她的律师周六发表的一份声明称，这名 50 岁的凶手已被送回她过去 30 年关押的监狱。

paras.en: She is continuing to receive medical care at the prison.
paras.zh: 她继续在监狱接受医疗护理。

paras.en: Pike survived two lethal injections of the drug pentobarbital on 30 September, which left her in a critical condition.
paras.zh: 9 月 30 日，派克两次注射戊巴比妥致死，但幸存下来，情况危急。

paras.en: Earlier this week, she regained consciousness and began speaking - stunning experts, medical staff and her lawyers.
paras.zh: 本周早些时候，她恢复了知觉并开始讲话——令专家、医务人员和她的律师惊叹不已。

paras.en: "She is grateful to the first responders and her medical team for their care in these extraordinary circumstances," her lawyers said in their statement.
paras.zh: 她的律师在声明中表示：“她感谢急救人员和她的医疗团队在这种特殊情况下给予的照顾。”

paras.en: Pike's case is now in uncharted territory as Pike is believed to be the only person to have survived an execution attempt by lethal injection.
paras.zh: 派克的案件目前处于未知领域，因为派克被认为是唯一在注射死刑中幸存的人。

paras.en: At a court hearing on Wednesday, Tennessee Assistant Attorney General Will Ayers told the judge he does not know whether the state intends to try to execute her again.
paras.zh: 在周三的法庭听证会上，田纳西州助理司法部长威尔·艾尔斯告诉法官，他不知道该州是否打算再次尝试处决她。

paras.en: The judge also ordered the state of Tennessee to preserve all evidence related to the failed injections. That evidence could lay the groundwork for a future lawsuit against the state.
paras.zh: 法官还命令田纳西州保留与注射失败有关的所有证据。这些证据可能为未来针对该州的诉讼奠定基础。

paras.en: Pike was 18 when she and her then-boyfriend, Tadaryl Shipp, beat, tortured and killed 19-year-old Colleen Slemmer, whom they had met at a job training camp for low-income young people.
paras.zh: 派克 18 岁时，和她当时的男友塔达里尔·希普 (Tadaryl Shipp) 殴打、折磨并杀害了 19 岁的科琳·斯莱默 (Colleen Slemmer)，他们是在低收入年轻人职业培训营认识的。

paras.en: After Pike survived the two lethal injections, she lost consciousness and was taken to a local hospital.
paras.zh: 派克在两次注射死刑后幸存下来，她失去了知觉，被送往当地一家医院。

paras.en: For days, her legal team believed she was brain dead, and expected her to be taken off life support at any moment.
paras.zh: 几天来，她的法律团队认为她已经脑死亡，并希望她随时停止生命支持。

paras.en: She eventually woke up and began talking again on Tuesday - her lawyer Randy Spivey said her first words were "Where am I?" and "Who are you?"
paras.zh: 她最终醒来并在周二再次开始说话——她的律师兰迪·斯皮维说她的第一句话是“我在哪里？”和“你是谁？”

paras.en: At a press conference on Wednesday, Pike's lawyers said she was shackled to the bed and suffering from pneumonia, significant swelling on her arms, and was unable to swallow.
paras.zh: 在周三的新闻发布会上，派克的律师表示，她被铐在床上，患有肺炎，手臂严重肿胀，无法吞咽。

paras.en: "We don't know the toll all of this will take" on her mental health, Spivey said at the time, noting she felt "angry and confused".
paras.zh: 斯皮维当时表示，“我们不知道这一切会对她的心理健康造成什么影响”，并指出她感到“愤怒和困惑”。

paras.en: It's not clear what medical care Pike is receiving back in prison, but her lawyers previously said she faced a "long road to recovery".
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚派克在监狱中接受了哪些医疗护理，但她的律师此前表示，她面临着“漫长的康复之路”。

articles.title: Several injured in attack on airport in Saudi capital Riyadh

paras.en: Several people have been injured in another attack on an international airport in the Saudi capital Riyadh, authorities say, days after Yemen's Houthis claimed to have carried out similar strikes on the hub.
paras.zh: 当局称，在沙特首都利雅得国际机场发生的另一次袭击中，多人受伤，几天前也门胡塞武装声称对该机场发动了类似袭击。

paras.en: Operations at King Khalid International Airport in Riyadh were suspended on Saturday after the attack, the Saudi Civil Aviation Authority said in a statement.
paras.zh: 沙特民航局在一份声明中表示，袭击发生后，利雅得哈立德国王国际机场的运营于周六暂停。

paras.en: More than a dozen ambulances were seen rushing to the airport, according to news agency Reuters, citing an eyewitness.
paras.zh: 据路透社援引目击者的话称，十几辆救护车正赶往机场。

paras.en: The US embassy said it was "aware of attacks on King Khalid International Airport" and urged American citizens to avoid the airport and surrounding areas.
paras.zh: 美国大使馆表示“意识到哈立德国王国际机场遭到袭击”，并敦促美国公民避开机场和周边地区。

paras.en: The attack comes a day after authorities said three Saudis including a pilot were killed in two attacks on the airport by the Iran-backed Houthis the day prior. Another three people were killed in Houthi attacks on two Saudi airports on 6 and 7 October.
paras.zh: 此次袭击发生前一天，当局表示，包括一名飞行员在内的三名沙特人在前一天伊朗支持的胡塞武装对机场发动的两次袭击中丧生。 10 月 6 日至 7 日，胡塞武装袭击了沙特的两个机场，造成另外 3 人死亡。

paras.en: A source at a local hospital told AFP that dozens of people had been wounded in Saturday's attack.
paras.zh: 当地一家医院的消息人士告诉法新社，周六的袭击造成数十人受伤。

paras.en: "I saw 401 hit, I saw injured in front of my eyes. Everyone was running," an eyewitness who said they had been at gate 401 in the domestic terminal told the news agency.
paras.zh: “我看到401被击中，我在我眼前看到受伤的人。每个人都在逃跑，”一位目击者告诉新闻机构，他说他们当时在国内航站楼的401号登机口。

paras.en: Western embassies in Saudi Arabia have warned their citizens away from the airport.
paras.zh: 西方驻沙特阿拉伯大使馆已警告其公民远离机场。

paras.en: Several Gulf airlines said they had cancelled their flights to and from the airport. with Kuwait Airways citing the "security situation" there.
paras.zh: 几家海湾航空公司表示，他们已经取消了往返机场的航班。科威特航空公司援引那里的“安全局势”。

paras.en: All flights to Riyadh have either been diverted or cancelled, aviation tracker Flightradar shows.
paras.zh: 航空追踪器 Flightradar 显示，所有飞往利雅得的航班都已改道或取消。

paras.en: Doctors had been asked to report to hospitals to address the situation, a medical source told AFP.
paras.zh: 一位医疗消息人士告诉法新社，医生已被要求向医院报告以解决这一情况。

paras.en: "We were told we are dealing with a 'serious emergency situation'," the medical source told the agency.
paras.zh: “我们被告知我们正在处理‘严重的紧急情况’，”医疗消息人士告诉该机构。

paras.en: The suspected attack comes during a marked escalation in renewed fighting between Yemen's Saudi-backed government forces and the Houthis, who control most of the country's north-west.
paras.zh: 这起疑似袭击事件发生之际，沙特支持的也门政府军与控制该国西北部大部分地区的胡塞武装之间的战斗再次明显升级。

paras.en: The Houthis say they are targeting Saudi Arabia over its support for government forces in Yemen's civil war.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装表示，他们的目标是沙特阿拉伯，因为它在也门内战中支持政府军。

paras.en: The conflict worsened after the Houthis seized strategically important stretches of the Red Sea coast in a rapid offensive.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装通过快速攻势夺取了红海沿岸具有重要战略意义的地区后，冲突进一步恶化。

paras.en: That included the port of Mokha on the Bab al-Mandab Strait, which is the narrowest point of the Red Sea and a chokepoint for global shipping. Yemeni pro-government forces have since said they had "secured" the strait at the southern end of the Red Sea.
paras.zh: 其中包括曼德海峡上的莫卡港，该海峡是红海最狭窄的地方，也是全球航运的咽喉要道。也门亲政府部队此后表示，他们已经“保卫”了红海南端的海峡。

paras.en: A Saudi-led coalition was formed in 2015 after Arab countries joined forces to stop the Houthis taking over Yemen from the country's internationally recognised government.
paras.zh: 2015年，阿拉伯国家联手阻止胡塞武装从国际公认的也门政府手中接管也门后，沙特领导的联盟成立。

paras.en: A temporary ceasefire was brokered in 2022 after years of air strikes and ground fighting led to the deaths of hundreds of thousands of people, triggering one of the world's worst humanitarian crises.
paras.zh: 多年的空袭和地面战斗导致数十万人死亡，引发了世界上最严重的人道主义危机之一，2022 年达成了临时停火。

paras.en: But the informal truce began to unravel in July.
paras.zh: 但非正式休战在七月开始瓦解。

paras.en: The Houthis announced a "maritime embargo" against Saudi Arabia and began missile and drone attacks on Saudi airports, oil facilities and tankers in the Red Sea. They said they were retaliating against what they described as a years-long Saudi blockade and for an air strike on Sanaa airport.
paras.zh: 胡塞武装宣布对沙特阿拉伯实行“海上禁运”，并开始对沙特机场、红海石油设施和油轮进行导弹和无人机袭击。他们表示，他们是对沙特长达数年的封锁和对萨那机场的空袭进行报复。

articles.title: South Korean 'robot dog' became first to run a marathon on a single battery charge — now we know how
articles.author: Alan Bradley

paras.en: A four-legged robot completed a full marathon on a single battery charge, covering 26.2 miles (42.2 kilometers) on a hilly public-road course in South Korea two years ago. Now we know a lot more about how it achieved this record-breaking feat.
paras.zh: 两年前，一台四足机器人在韩国的一条丘陵公路上完成了单次电池充电的全程马拉松，全程26.2英里（ 42.2公里）。现在，我们对它如何实现这一创纪录的壮举有了更多的了解。

paras.en: The dog-like robot, called RAIBO2, finished the 22nd annual Sangju Dried-Persimmon Marathon in just over 4 hours, 19 minutes. The bot's developers say it's the first quadruped robot to have completed an official marathon-distance event without stopping to recharge. They're commonly referred to as "robot dogs" because the movement of their joints in both front and hind legs resembles that of canines.
paras.zh: 这个名为RAIBO2的狗形机器人在短短4小时19分钟内完成了第22届年度尚州干柿马拉松比赛。该机器人的开发人员表示，这是第一个在不停下来充电的情况下完成官方马拉松距离赛事的四足机器人。它们通常被称为“机器狗” ，因为它们的前腿和后腿的关节运动类似于犬科动物。

paras.en: The scientists outlined their findings about the robot's feat, which it achieved Nov. 17, 2024, in a study published Sept. 23 in the journal Nature.
paras.zh: 科学家们在9月23日发表在《自然》杂志上的一项研究中概述了他们对机器人壮举的发现，该壮举于2024年11月17日实现。

paras.en: This achievement represented a new milestone in overcoming a critical limitation for quadruped robots: endurance. Although four-legged robots can cross difficult terrain that wheeled machines struggle to traverse (like stairs and rugged trails), their endurance has been limited because powering multiple joints while repeatedly lifting and stabilizing the machine's body consumes huge amounts of energy.
paras.zh: 这一成就代表着克服四足机器人关键限制的新里程碑：耐力。尽管四足机器人可以穿越轮式机器难以穿越的困难地形（例如楼梯和崎岖的小路），但它们的耐力受到限制，因为在反复提升和稳定机器身体的同时为多个关节提供动力会消耗大量能量。

paras.en: "Unlike wheeled robots, quadrupeds continuously expend energy at their joints to support body weight and incur kinetic energy losses during intermittent foot-ground contact," the researchers wrote in the study.
paras.zh: 研究人员在研究中写道：“与轮式机器人不同，四足动物在关节处不断消耗能量来支撑体重，并在间歇性脚与地面接触期间产生动能损失。”

paras.en: RAIBO2's race was a demanding real-world trial. It took place during the Sangju Dried-Persimmon Marathon, with the bot racing alongside human participants. The route covered two 50-meter [164 feet] elevation climbs, with slopes of up to 10 degrees. Those kinds of gradients put increased strain on the robot's energy resources, stress-testing the bot's battery management capabilities, the scientists said.
paras.zh: RAIBO2的比赛是一场苛刻的现实世界试验。它发生在Sangju Dried-Persimmon马拉松比赛期间，机器人与人类参与者一起比赛。这条路线覆盖了两个50米（ 164英尺）的高度攀登，斜坡高达10度。科学家们说，这些梯度对机器人的能源造成了更大的压力，对机器人的电池管理能力进行了压力测试。

paras.en: RAIBO2 had previously run a 26.7-mile (43 km), GPS-guided route across a flat athletic field, which it knocked out in 4 hours, 40 minutes on one charge. However, an earlier marathon attempt across uneven terrain against other competitors had to be aborted around the 23-mile (37 km) mark after the robot's battery ran out. The robot's developers attributed that shortfall in part to frequent pace changes as the machine attempted to adjust to the pace of nearby runners.
paras.zh: RAIBO2 此前曾在 GPS 引导下在平坦的运动场上跑过 26.7 英里（43 公里）的路线，一次充电只用了 4 小时 40 分钟就跑完了。然而，早些时候，在机器人电池耗尽后，在不平坦的地形上与其他参赛者进行的马拉松尝试在 23 英里（37 公里）大关附近不得不中止。该机器人的开发人员将这种不足部分归因于频繁的配速变化，因为机器试图适应附近跑步者的配速。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: To compensate, the team boosted the robot's battery capacity by 33% and tinkered with the control system, including implementing joint-stiffness control at the actuator. This allowed the bot to soften its leg when it had to absorb an impact or it needed a stable, forceful push-off. After the adjustments, RAIBO2 expanded to a maximum range of 41.6 miles (67 km) on a single charge, albeit on straight paths, according to the researchers.
paras.zh: 作为补偿，该团队将机器人的电池容量提高了33% ，并对控制系统进行了修补，包括在执行器上实施关节刚度控制。这使得机器人在必须吸收冲击或需要稳定、有力的推力时能够软化其腿部。根据研究人员的说法，在调整后， RAIBO2一次充电的最大范围扩展到41.6英里（ 67公里） ，尽管是在直线路径上。

paras.en: Another key metric was RAIBO2's total cost of transport — a measure of the energy required to move a body over a given distance, with lower values indicating less energy expended. Researchers reported that RAIBO2 achieved a total cost of transport of 0.25, compared with a human benchmark of 0.37. The researchers said their machine was the first quadruped robot to surpass that figure.
paras.zh: 另一个关键指标是RAIBO2的总运输成本—衡量在给定距离内移动身体所需的能量，较低的值表示消耗的能量较少。研究人员报告说， RAIBO2的总运输成本为0.25 ，而人体基准为0.37。研究人员表示，他们的机器是第一个超过这一数字的四足机器人。

paras.en: The team attributed that efficiency to several optimizations across RAIBO2's software and hardware. Especially vital were its lightweight mechanical components, which were capable of transmitting kinetic energy from its joints with very little interference. They also credited a low-loss motor-driving circuit and, on the software side, a locomotion policy specifically streamlined to limit energy use. The system was also trained using the team's simulation environment, called RaiSim, which includes models of slopes, stairs and icy roads.
paras.zh: QUERY LENGTH LIMIT EXCEEDED. MAX ALLOWED QUERY : 500 CHARS

paras.en: Like many electric vehicles, RAIBO2 can regenerate some battery by capturing kinetic energy, particularly while traveling downhill. That capability allows it to offset some of the energy it expends while climbing, though it doesn't eliminate the extra cost of hilly terrain.
paras.zh: 像许多电动汽车一样， RAIBO2可以通过捕获动能来再生一些电池，特别是在下坡行驶时。这种能力可以抵消攀登时消耗的一些能量，尽管它不能消除丘陵地形的额外成本。

paras.en: The researchers said RAIBO2 has more than three times the travel range per charge of existing quadruped robots, with a total battery capacity of 2,016 watt-hours. It's in part because of that capacity increase that the team now estimates that the robot could travel up to 15.5 miles (25 km) farther than its marathon stint, up to a total of 41.6 miles (67 km).
paras.zh: 研究人员表示， RAIBO2每次充电的行驶里程是现有四足机器人的三倍以上，总电池容量为2,016瓦时。部分原因是容量增加，该团队现在估计机器人可以比马拉松跑步长15.5英里（ 25公里） ，总长达41.6英里（ 67公里）。

paras.en: That kind of endurance could broaden the roles for quadruped robots in places where wheeled models are impractical, the developers added in the study. For example, they could be useful in disaster zones and mountainous areas, where a sufficiently mobile, high-endurance robot could carry cameras, sensors or communications gear across uneven terrain.
paras.zh: 开发人员在研究中补充说，这种耐力可以扩大四足机器人在轮式模型不切实际的地方的作用。例如，它们可能在灾区和山区有用，在那里，一个足够机动的高耐力机器人可以在不平坦的地形上携带摄像头、传感器或通信设备。

A quadruped robot designed to complete a marathon on a single battery charge. Nature. https://doi.org/10.1038/s41586-026-11102-5

articles.title: Bronze ring with Lighthouse of Alexandria engraving discovered at palace on submerged island in Egypt
articles.author: Owen Jarus

paras.en: A bronze signet ring depicting the Lighthouse of Alexandria, a wonder of the ancient world, has been discovered underwater in the Mediterranean off Alexandria, Egypt.
paras.zh: 在埃及亚历山大附近的地中海水下发现了一枚描绘古代世界奇迹亚历山大灯塔的青铜图章戒指。

paras.en: A joint team from the European Institute for Underwater Archaeology (IEASM) and the Egyptian Ministry of Tourism and Antiquities found the artifact in the remains of a palace on the now-submerged island of Antirhodos, marking the first time a signet ring featuring the image of the lighthouse has been found, the IEASM team said in a statement.
paras.zh: 欧洲水下考古研究所（IEASM）和埃及旅游和文物部的联合小组在一份声明中表示，在现已被淹没的安蒂罗多斯岛一座宫殿的废墟中发现了这件文物，这是首次发现带有灯塔图像的图章戒指。

paras.en: The image on the ring is similar to depictions of the lighthouse that have been previously found on coins dating to the second century, representatives of IEASM said.
paras.zh: IEASM 的代表表示，戒指上的图像与之前在二世纪硬币上发现的灯塔图案相似。

paras.en: "The discovery of the ring-signet is even more important as it has been excavated in the legendary palace of the Island of Antirhodos, that once was a centre of power," Franck Goddio, president of IEASM, said in the emailed statement.
paras.zh: IEASM 主席弗兰克·戈迪奥 (Franck Goddio) 在电子邮件声明中表示：“戒指印章的发现更为重要，因为它是在曾经是权力中心的安蒂罗多斯岛传奇宫殿中出土的。”

paras.en: The palace was used by Egyptian pharaohs who reigned during the Ptolemaic period (304 to 30 B.C.), a dynasty of rulers descended from one of Alexander the Great's generals. The lighthouse was built on the island of Pharos around 280 B.C. and stood more than 328 feet (100 meters) tall. Some ancient writers, such as Pliny the Elder, considered it among the wonders of the world, and it continued to be used into the Middle Ages, until earthquakes and erosion resulted in its destruction and disappearance beneath the sea.
paras.zh: 这座宫殿曾被托勒密王朝（公元前 304 年至公元前 30 年）统治时期的埃及法老使用过，该王朝的统治者是亚历山大大帝的一位将军的后裔。灯塔建于公元前 280 年左右，建于法罗斯岛上。身高超过 328 英尺（100 米）。一些古代作家，如老普林尼，将其视为世界奇迹之一，并一直被使用到中世纪，直到地震和侵蚀导致其被破坏并消失在海底。

paras.en: While the lighthouse was modified over time, it would have had a statue, possibly of Zeus, at the top holding an oil lamp that helped guide mariners.
paras.zh: 虽然灯塔随着时间的推移进行了改造，但它的顶部有一座雕像，可能是宙斯，手持一盏油灯，帮助引导水手。

paras.en: Whoever was wearing a signet ring could have used it to make an impression on soft materials, such as clay and wax, to create a seal. The discovery of the ring in the remains of the palace at Antirhodos suggests that the palace was used for administrative functions related to the lighthouse, representatives of IEASM said in the statement.
paras.zh: 无论谁戴着印章戒指，都可以用它在粘土和蜡等柔软材料上留下印记，以形成印章。IEASM的代表在声明中表示，在安提罗多斯宫殿遗址中发现的戒指表明，这座宫殿用于与灯塔相关的行政职能。

paras.en: Even though the ring's engraving is somewhat worn, it likely depicts the lighthouse, said Doris Behrens-Abouseif, a professor emeritus of history of art and archaeology at the University of London who has written about the lighthouse but was not part of the research team.
paras.zh: 伦敦大学艺术史和考古学名誉教授多丽丝·贝伦斯-阿布塞夫 (Doris Behrens-Abouseif) 表示，尽管戒指的雕刻有些磨损，但它很可能描绘的是灯塔。多丽丝·贝伦斯-阿布塞夫曾撰写过有关灯塔的文章，但不是研究团队的成员。

paras.en: There are "thousands of coins from Alexandria showing a similar depiction of the lighthouse," she told Live Science in an email. Those coins date to the Ptolemaic or Roman (29 B.C. to A.D. 395) periods, she noted.
paras.zh: 她在一封电子邮件中告诉《生活科学》，“来自亚历山大的数千枚硬币上都有类似的灯塔描绘”。她指出，这些硬币的历史可以追溯到托勒密或罗马时期（公元前 29 年至公元 395 年）。

paras.en: Behrens-Abouseif added that she wasn't familiar enough with rings from Alexandria to comment on whether this is the only ring that contains this image.
paras.zh: 贝伦斯-阿布塞夫补充说，她对来自亚历山大的戒指不够熟悉，无法评论这是否是唯一包含此图像的戒指。

paras.en: Other scholars told Live Science that they, too, believe that this ring depicts the lighthouse, with two scholars noting that it may feature smoke coming from a lamp at top.
paras.zh: 其他学者告诉Live Science ，他们也认为这枚戒指描绘了灯塔，两位学者指出它可能有来自顶部灯泡的烟雾。

paras.en: The "most interesting thing about the new signet ring engraved gem is an asymmetrical feature at its peak," which "may depict a plume of smoke from the oil lamp in the hand of the crowning statue," Andrew Chugg, an independent researcher who wrote the book "The Pharos Lighthouse in Alexandria: Second Sun and Seventh Wonder of Antiquity" (Routledge, 2024), said in an email.
paras.zh: “新的图章戒指雕刻宝石最有趣的地方是其顶部的不对称特征”，“可能描绘了加冕雕像手中的油灯冒出的缕缕烟雾”，《亚历山大法罗斯灯塔：第二太阳和古代第七奇迹》（Routledge，2024）一书的独立研究员安德鲁·查格（Andrew Chugg）在一封电子邮件中说。

paras.en: Margaret Miles, a professor emeritus of art history and classics at the University of California, Irvine, also noticed the possible plume of smoke. Miles noted in an email that this "ring could have been used as a signet ring by a merchant from Alexandria who used the profile of the [lighthouse] to signal his location in Alexandria. The lighthouse was famous, so it became a symbol of the city."
paras.zh: 加州大学欧文分校艺术史和古典学名誉教授玛格丽特·迈尔斯也注意到了可能存在的烟雾。迈尔斯在一封电子邮件中指出，这枚戒指“可能被一位来自亚历山大的商人用作图章戒指，他利用灯塔的轮廓来表明他在亚历山大的位置。这座灯塔很有名，所以它成为了这座城市的象征。”

paras.en: Research off the coast of Alexandria over the past few years, including the discovery of 22 massive blocks, has revealed more information about the lighthouse, including how exactly it looked, which is helping researchers who are trying to digitally reconstruct it.
paras.zh: 过去几年，亚历山大海岸附近的研究，包括发现了 22 个巨大的灯塔，揭示了有关灯塔的更多信息，包括它的外观，这正在帮助试图以数字方式重建灯塔的研究人员。

paras.en: Are you a fan of mummies and hieroglyphs? Find out with our ancient Egypt quiz!
paras.zh: 您是木乃伊和象形文字的粉丝吗？通过我们的古埃及测验找出答案！

paras.en: Owen Jarus is a regular contributor to Live Science who writes about archaeology and humans' past. He has also written for The Independent (UK), The Canadian Press (CP) and The Associated Press (AP), among others. Owen has a bachelor of arts degree from the University of Toronto and a journalism degree from Ryerson University.
paras.zh: 欧文·贾鲁斯 (Owen Jarus) 是《Live Science》的定期撰稿人，撰写有关考古学和人类过去的文章。他还为《独立报》（英国）、加拿大通讯社 (CP) 和美联社 (AP) 等撰稿。欧文拥有多伦多大学文学学士学位和瑞尔森大学新闻学学位。

articles.title: 'October is the ideal time to get vaccinated': Flu season is kicking off early, experts say
articles.author: Olivia Maule

paras.en: Flu season is off to an early start in some parts of the U.S., data shows.
paras.zh: 数据显示，美国部分地区的流感季节提前开始。

paras.en: In a typical year, U.S. flu activity starts building in late fall — typically in October or November — and peaks between December and February. This year, flu activity is currently low but rising nationwide: During the week ending Sept. 26, 3.4% of respiratory samples tested by clinical labs were positive for flu, according to Centers for Disease Control and Prevention (CDC) data.
paras.zh: 在典型的年份中，美国流感活动在秋末开始增加——通常是在十月或十一月——并在十二月至二月之间达到高峰。今年，流感活动目前较低，但全国范围内有所上升：根据美国疾病控制与预防中心 (CDC) 的数据，在截至 9 月 26 日的一周内，临床实验室检测的呼吸道样本中有 3.4% 呈流感阳性。

paras.en: That's about seven times the rate that was seen at the same point last year. About 0.5% of samples tested positive during the week ending Sept. 27, 2025.
paras.zh: 这大约是去年同期的七倍。截至 2025 年 9 月 27 日的一周内，约 0.5% 的样本检测呈阳性。

paras.en: "This particular year, it appears to be starting early — like right now," Dr. William Schaffner, a professor of preventive medicine and infectious diseases at Vanderbilt Health in Tennessee, told Live Science. Patients at clinics in his area are already testing positive for flu, he said.
paras.zh: 田纳西州范德比尔特健康中心预防医学和传染病教授威廉·沙夫纳博士告诉《生活科学》杂志：“今年，它似乎开始得很早——就像现在一样。”他说，他所在地区诊所的患者流感检测结果已经呈阳性。

paras.en: The early uptick in flu is mostly unfolding in Western states, including Washington, California and Arizona. In Washington, for example, the share of emergency department visits diagnosed as flu climbed from 0.25% in the week ending Aug. 29 to 1.34% in the week ending Oct. 3, according to CDC emergency department data. That's a more than fivefold increase over six weeks.
paras.zh: 流感的早期上升主要发生在西部各州，包括华盛顿州、加利福尼亚州和亚利桑那州。例如，根据 CDC 急诊科数据，在华盛顿，诊断为流感的急诊科就诊比例从截至 8 月 29 日当周的 0.25% 攀升至截至 10 月 3 日当周的 1.34%。六周内增加了五倍多。

paras.en: Where the flu took off first isn't a warning sign in itself, Schaffner noted.
paras.zh: 沙夫纳指出，流感首先爆发的地方本身并不是一个警告信号。

paras.en: "There's nothing unusual about flu starting in the West Coast and moving east," he said. Recent seasons have more often begun in the Southeast or Midwest, he noted, but "it can start almost anywhere."
paras.zh: 他说：“流感从西海岸开始并向东传播并没有什么不寻常的。”他指出，最近的季节通常在东南部或中西部开始，但“它几乎可以在任何地方开始”。

paras.en: Get the world’s most fascinating discoveries delivered straight to your inbox.
paras.zh: 将世界上最迷人的发现直接发送到您的收件箱。

paras.en: Nowadays, seasonal flu is caused by three subtypes of flu viruses: two subtypes of influenza A, called H1N1 and H3N2, and the Victoria lineage of influenza B. (A second subtype of influenza B used to circulate but is now thought to be extinct.)
paras.zh: 如今，季节性流感是由三种流感病毒亚型引起：甲型流感的两种亚型，即 H1N1 和 H3N2，以及乙型流感的维多利亚系。（乙型流感的第二种亚型曾经流行，但现在被认为已经灭绝。）

paras.en: Last season, a fast-spreading version of H3N2 known as subclade K dominated. The CDC classified the 2025-2026 season as highly severe for children, as at least 195 children died of flu-related causes.
paras.zh: 上个季节，被称为 K 分支的 H3N2 快速传播版本占据主导地位。疾病预防控制中心将 2025-2026 年流感季节列为对儿童来说非常严重的季节，因为至少有 195 名儿童死于流感相关原因。

paras.en: Schaffner likens influenza A and B to siblings. "They're very related, but they each have their own individual characteristics," he said. Influenza A strains usually cause the biggest outbreaks early in the season, while influenza B strains "kind of smolder along" and account for most cases toward the end, he noted.
paras.zh: 沙夫纳将甲型流感和乙型流感比作兄弟姐妹。 “他们非常相关，但他们都有自己的个性特征，”他说。他指出，甲型流感病毒株通常会在季节初期引起最大的疫情爆发，而乙型流感病毒株“会一直闷烧”，并在临近季节末时造成大多数病例。

paras.en: This year, H1N1 has taken the initial lead. Of the influenza A samples that public health labs subtyped during the week ending Sept. 26, 96% were identified as H1N1, according to CDC data. That doesn't mean H1N1 will continue to dominate throughout the season; it just gives a snapshot of what's happening now.
paras.zh: 今年，H1N1流感已初步领先。根据 CDC 数据，在截至 9 月 26 日的一周内，公共卫生实验室对甲型流感样本进行了亚型分类，其中 96% 被鉴定为 H1N1。这并不意味着 H1N1 流感将继续在整个季节占据主导地位；它只是提供了现在正在发生的事情的快照。

paras.en: The dominant strain matters because flu is "a moving target," said Dr. Paul Offit, director of the Vaccine Education Center at Children's Hospital of Philadelphia. The virus constantly mutates — especially hemagglutinin, the protein on the virus's surface that it uses to latch onto human cells. Hemagglutinin is the main target of flu vaccines.
paras.zh: 费城儿童医院疫苗教育中心主任保罗·奥菲特博士说，主要毒株很重要，因为流感是“一个不断变化的目标”。该病毒不断变异，尤其是血凝素，它是病毒表面的蛋白质，可用来附着在人类细胞上。血凝素是流感疫苗的主要目标。

paras.en: An early start to the season doesn't guarantee it'll be a severe one, either. In its 2026-2027 season outlook, the CDC projected that this season will likely be moderate, although it has only low-to-moderate confidence in that forecast.
paras.zh: 赛季的早期开始也不能保证会是一个艰难的赛季。疾病预防控制中心在其2026-2027年季节展望中预测，本季度可能会温和，尽管它对该预测只有低到中等的信心。

paras.en: Everyone 6 months and older is recommended to get an annual flu vaccine.
paras.zh: 建议 6 个月及以上的每个人每年接种一次流感疫苗。

paras.en: Influenza is especially dangerous for children under 5, adults 65 and older, people with chronic health conditions and pregnant people, as these groups are more prone to severe infections. Serious cases of flu can lead to complications such as pneumonia, sepsis, and brain or heart inflammation, and in some cases, they can be deadly. Tens of thousands of people die of flu each season in the U.S.
paras.zh: 流感对于 5 岁以下儿童、65 岁及以上成人、患有慢性疾病的人和孕妇尤其危险，因为这些群体更容易受到严重感染。严重的流感病例会导致肺炎、败血症、脑部或心脏炎症等并发症，在某些情况下，可能会致命。在美国，每个季节都有数万人死于流感。

paras.en: For flu vaccination, timing matters. The CDC generally doesn't recommend vaccination in July or August for most adults, because the shot's protection can wane over the course of a season. But with flu arriving early, "October is the ideal time to get vaccinated, and even more so right now," Schaffner said.
paras.zh: 对于流感疫苗接种来说，时机很重要。疾病预防控制中心通常不建议大多数成年人在七月或八月接种疫苗，因为疫苗的保护作用可能会随着季节的推移而减弱。但随着流感提前到来，“十月是接种疫苗的理想时间，现在更是如此，”沙夫纳说。

paras.en: When circulating strains' features differ from those captured in the vaccine, "that usually predicts a more difficult season," Offit said. That said, it's too early to know if this year's flu shots are a good match for the circulating flu viruses.
paras.zh: 奥菲特说，当流行毒株的特征与疫苗中捕获的特征不同时，“通常预示着一个更困难的季节”。也就是说，现在判断今年的流感疫苗是否适合流行的流感病毒还为时过早。

paras.en: Protection begins building right after you get the shot, but it takes up to about two weeks to reach full strength.
paras.zh: 注射后，保护作用就开始建立，但需要大约两周的时间才能达到完全强度。

paras.en: How much protection a flu vaccine offers varies by season, depending partly on how well its formulation matches the strains that circulate. Offit said that protection against symptomatic illness varies by age group and that the vaccines are "a little more effective" at preventing more severe illness. In terms of flu cases that prompt people to seek medical care, the shot has been 29% to 56% effective over the past decade, the CDC estimates.
paras.zh: 流感疫苗提供的保护程度因季节而异，部分取决于其配方与流行毒株的匹配程度。奥菲特说，针对症状性疾病的保护作用因年龄组而异，并且疫苗在预防更严重的疾病方面“更有效”。 CDC 估计，在促使人们就医的流感病例方面，过去 10 年注射疫苗的有效率为 29% 至 56%。

paras.en: While the vaccines are less reliable at preventing mild cases of flu, Schaffner said, they work best at "keeping you out of the hospital, keeping you out of the intensive care unit, and keeping you out of the cemetery."
paras.zh: 沙夫纳说，虽然疫苗在预防轻度流感方面不太可靠，但它们在“让你远离医院、让你远离重症监护室、让你远离墓地”方面效果最好。

paras.en: The CDC's 2026-2027 guidance keeps its recommendation of an annual flu vaccine for everyone 6 months and older, with high-dose and adjuvanted shots preferred for adults 65 and older. (Adjuvanted shots contain an extra ingredient to help rev up the immune system.)
paras.zh: CDC 的 2026-2027 年指南保留了对 6 个月及以上的所有人每年接种流感疫苗的建议，65 岁及以上的成年人首选高剂量和佐剂疫苗。 （佐剂注射液含有一种额外的成分，可以帮助增强免疫系统。）

paras.en: There's also a new option: In August, the Food and Drug Administration approved mFlusiva, the first mRNA flu vaccine, for adults 50 and older. (You can find out where mFlusiva shots are available near you using Moderna's vaccine finder.) With the mRNA shot, "you're less likely to get symptomatic disease," Offit told Live Science.
paras.zh: 还有一个新的选择：8 月，美国食品和药物管理局批准了 mFlusiva，这是第一种 mRNA 流感疫苗，适用于 50 岁及以上的成年人。 （您可以使用 Moderna 的疫苗查找器找到您附近哪里可以注射 mFlusiva 疫苗。）通过 mRNA 注射，“您患上症状性疾病的可能性较小，”Offit 告诉 Live Science。

paras.en: Traditional flu shots contain purified pieces of the virus itself, Schaffner explained. With mRNA, the vaccine contains a "blueprint" of those proteins — essentially a set of genetic instructions that the body's cells then use. In mFlusiva's case, those instructions code for hemagglutinin (the protein on the virus's surface that it uses to latch onto human cells) from each of three flu subtypes, Offit said. The mRNA then breaks down in the body, Offit noted. It "cannot influence human genetic material," Schaffner emphasized.

paras.en: Whether this early start gives way to a heavy flu season should become clearer in the coming weeks, as the CDC's weekly surveillance reports will show whether cases keep climbing beyond the West.
paras.zh: 疾病预防控制中心的每周监测报告将显示西方国家以外的病例是否继续攀升，因此，这种早期开始是否会导致严重的流感季节，在未来几周内应该会变得更加清楚。

paras.en: This article is for informational purposes only and is not meant to offer medical advice.
paras.zh: 本文仅供参考，并不旨在提供医疗建议。

paras.en: Olivia Maule is a science journalist whose beats include space, biotechnology and the environment. She holds a B.A. in biology and a B.S. in anthropology from the University of Florida and completed a master's degree in science communication at U.C. Santa Cruz. A 2025 AAAS Mass Media Fellow, she wrote stories and produced videos during a summer at El Nuevo Día, Puerto Rico's largest newspaper, and has written for Eos, Mongabay, Science magazine and Stanford Report. Olivia is a native Spanish and English speaker.
paras.zh: 奥利维亚·莫尔 (Olivia Maule) 是一位科学记者，关注领域包括太空、生物技术和环境。她拥有学士学位。生物学学士学位和学士学位获得佛罗里达大学人类学博士学位，并在加州大学获得科学传播硕士学位。圣克鲁斯。作为 2025 年美国科学促进会大众媒体研究员，她在一个夏天为波多黎各最大的报纸 El Nuevo Día 撰写故事并制作视频，并为《Eos》、《Mongabay》、《科学》杂志和《斯坦福报告》撰稿。奥利维亚的母语是西班牙语和英语。
