paras.zh: 艾森伯格指出，主要针对啮齿类动物的研究揭示了这一护理系统的运作方式。人类身上不断出现的证据表明，即使在非养育子女的情况下，这个系统也会发挥作用，比如在痛苦中抓住伴侣或给家人钱。在初步工作中，布朗和同事甚至在活动期间结识的陌生人中发现了这种迹象。

paras.en: Researchers are missing fascinating questions
paras.zh: 研究人员错过了一些有趣的问题

paras.en: The contradictory feelings Eisenberger experienced while caring for her dad are common. Caregivers can’t disentangle the advantages of the mammalian caregiving system from the strain of helping. Yet over half of caregivers surveyed by AARP reported that caring for a loved one gave them a sense of purpose.
paras.zh: 艾森伯格在照顾父亲时经历的矛盾感受很常见。护理人员无法将哺乳动物护理系统的优势与帮助的压力区分开来。然而，美国退休人员协会 (AARP) 调查显示，超过一半的护理人员表示，照顾亲人给了他们一种使命感。

paras.en: Ironically, minimizing potential positives to protect caregivers may do more harm than good, researchers say. Caregivers may hear only how awful their next several months or years may be. Others might run from the responsibility and later experience regret.
paras.zh: 研究人员表示，讽刺的是，为了保护护理人员而最大限度地减少潜在的积极因素可能弊大于利。护理人员可能只会听到他们接下来的几个月或几年可能会多么糟糕。其他人可能会逃避责任，然后感到后悔。

paras.en: “What if we tell people that … helping others can be really fulfilling even if it can be stressful, too?” Eisenberger says.
paras.zh: “如果我们告诉人们......帮助他人可以真正让人感到满足，即使它也可能有压力？”艾森伯格说。

paras.en: Reticence around caregiving’s benefits has also hampered scientists’ ability to advise people undertaking such a difficult role, Eisenberger and colleagues note. Can feeling compassion for a sick loved one turn on the mammalian caregiving system, or does one have to provide care? What if someone has a fraught relationship with the sick family member? Ultimately, when does the stress of opting out of caregiving outweigh the stress of opting in? Framing caregiving as entirely negative means those questions rarely even get asked.
paras.zh: 艾森伯格和同事指出，对护理好处的沉默也阻碍了科学家为承担如此困难角色的人们提供建议的能力。对生病的亲人的同情可以开启哺乳动物的护理系统，还是必须提供护理？如果有人与生病的家庭成员关系紧张怎么办？最终，选择退出护理的压力何时超过选择接受护理的压力？将护理视为完全消极意味着这些问题很少被问到。

articles.title: A quake on Mars may have set these rocks rolling
articles.author: Katherine Kornei

paras.en: Earthquakes frequently trigger rock falls. Now there’s solid evidence marsquakes can send boulders tumbling, too.
paras.zh: 地震经常引发岩石坠落。现在有确凿的证据表明火星地震也会导致巨石翻滚。

paras.en: Scientists mined high-resolution imagery of the Red Planet taken shortly after a recent temblor and found hundreds of new imprints left by tumbling boulders, researchers report September 2 in npj Space Exploration. Such rockfalls can be used as a proxy for seismic data, which is difficult to collect across the solar system.
paras.zh: 研究人员于 9 月 2 日在 npj Space Exploration 上报告称，科学家们挖掘了最近一次地震后不久拍摄的这颗红色星球的高分辨率图像，发现了数百个翻滚巨石留下的新印记。这种落石可以用作地震数据的代理，而地震数据很难在整个太阳系中收集。

paras.en: The data were collected with NASA’s InSight lander, which touched down on Mars in 2018. Over the next four years, its seismometer detected more than a thousand marsquakes. Many of those temblors originated in a region known as Cerberus Fossae, just north of the Martian equator. That’s a dynamic landscape riddled with slopes, cracks and rocks on the move, says Vijayan, a planetary scientist at the Physical Research Laboratory in Ahmedabad, India, who goes by a single name. “Thousands and thousands of boulders have fallen.”
paras.zh: 这些数据是通过 NASA 的 InSight 着陆器收集的，该着陆器于 2018 年登陆火星。在接下来的四年里，其地震仪检测到了一千多次火星地震。许多地震起源于火星赤道以北的一个名为塞伯鲁斯窝的地区。印度艾哈迈达巴德物理研究实验室的行星科学家维贾扬（Vijayan）说，这是一个动态的景观，布满了斜坡、裂缝和移动的岩石。 “成千上万的巨石倒塌了。”

paras.en: Vijayan and his collaborators focused on one well-detected marsquake captured by InSight that occurred in July 2019 just a few tens of kilometers from Cerberus Fossae. By comparing images taken in June 2019 and December 2020, the researchers discovered 27 new linelike features. Each was composed of tens to hundreds of distinct marks. These structures were most likely tracks created by boulders bouncing downhill, the team concluded.
paras.zh: Vijayan 和他的合作者重点研究了 InSight 捕捉到的一场地震，该地震发生在 2019 年 7 月，距离 Cerberus Fossae 仅几十公里。通过比较 2019 年 6 月和 2020 年 12 月拍摄的图像，研究人员发现了 27 个新的线状特征。每个标记都由数十到数百个不同的标记组成。研究小组得出结论，这些结构很可能是巨石下坡时留下的痕迹。

paras.en: Using historical imagery, the researchers calculated that only about two such features form each year on average in Cerberus Fossae. “We have statistics of previous boulder falls,” says Bivas Das, a seismologist at the Physical Research Laboratory and a member of the research team. Recording 27 new structures over a span of just 18 months is wholly unexpected, Das says. “That’s a big increase.” The nearby marsquake recorded by InSight was probably the instigator, the team concluded.
paras.zh: 研究人员利用历史图像计算出，Cerberus Fossae 每年平均只有大约两个这样的特征。 “我们有以前巨石坠落的统计数据，”物理研究实验室的地震学家、研究小组成员比瓦斯·达斯（Bivas Das）说。 Das 表示，在短短 18 个月内记录了 27 个新结构，这完全出乎意料。 “这是一个很大的增长。”研究小组得出结论，洞察号记录的附近的火星地震可能是始作俑者。

paras.en: Mysteries remain, however. All of the rockfalls occurred on the north side of a prominent valley in Cerberus Fossae, despite more boulders being located on the south side of the valley. “That puzzles us,” Vijayan says. The complex landscape of Cerberus Fossae might well alter how seismic waves travel, making it difficult to predict how shaking will impact different areas, he says. “The wave propagation is going to be complicated.”
paras.zh: 然而，谜团依然存在。尽管更多的巨石位于山谷的南侧，但所有落石都发生在塞伯鲁斯窝沟的一个著名山谷的北侧。 “这让我们感到困惑，”维贾扬说。他说，Cerberus Fossae 的复杂景观很可能会改变地震波的传播方式，从而很难预测震动将如何影响不同地区。 “波的传播将会很复杂。”

paras.en: Looking for such boulder falls elsewhere could help space exploration efforts, the team suggests. Human settlements would do best avoiding areas that are seismically active, and tumbling boulders can be the proverbial canaries in the coal mine, Vijayan says. “They’re like a proxy in the absence of seismic data.”
paras.zh: 研究小组表示，在其他地方寻找此类巨石坠落可能有助于太空探索工作。维贾扬说，人类住区最好避开地震活跃的地区，而翻滚的巨石可能是煤矿里众所周知的金丝雀。 “在缺乏地震数据的情况下，它们就像一个代理。”

articles.title: New Trial Compared Muscle Gains in Vegetarians And Meat Eaters. One Difference Stood Out.
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: Plant-based diets are associated with many long-term health benefits, but for older adults, there may be a potential downside.
paras.zh: 以植物为基础的饮食与许多长期健康益处相关，但对于老年人来说，可能存在潜在的缺点。

paras.en: Eating a strictly vegetarian diet may make it harder to protect muscle mass as we age.
paras.zh: 随着年龄的增长，严格素食可能会使保护肌肉质量变得更加困难。

paras.en: Protein is a key component in building, maintaining, and strengthening muscle, and in older age, you could need more of it than current guidelines suggest.
paras.zh: 蛋白质是构建、维持和增强肌肉的关键成分，在老年时，您可能需要比当前指南建议的更多的蛋白质。

paras.en: Vegetarians tend to eat less dietary protein than meat eaters, and recent research suggests that underweight vegetarians are less likely to live to 100.
paras.zh: 素食者往往比肉食者吃更少的膳食蛋白质，最近的研究表明，体重过轻的素食者活到 100 岁的可能性较小。

paras.en: Now, a new clinical trial adds a positive spin.
paras.zh: 现在，一项新的临床试验增添了积极的一面。

paras.en: Among adults aged 55 and over, both vegetarians and meat eaters gained muscle and showed similar improvements in strength and physical performance after 12 weeks of resistance training.
paras.zh: 在 55 岁及以上的成年人中，经过 12 周的阻力训练后，素食者和肉食者都获得了肌肉，并且在力量和身体表现方面表现出类似的改善。

paras.en: The findings are published in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition.
paras.zh: 研究结果发表在《美国临床营养学杂志》上。

paras.en: "Importantly, our results also show that a predominantly plant-based diet can still support meaningful improvements in muscle mass, strength, and physical function when protein intake is sufficiently high and combined with resistance training," write researchers at the Amsterdam University of Applied Sciences in the Netherlands.
paras.zh: 荷兰阿姆斯特丹应用科学大学的研究人员写道：“重要的是，我们的结果还表明，当蛋白质摄入量足够高并结合阻力训练时，以植物为主的饮食仍然可以支持肌肉质量、力量和身体功能的有意义的改善。”

paras.en: In the randomized trial, 108 adults undertook either a vegetarian diet or an omnivorous diet for three months.
paras.zh: 在这项随机试验中，108 名成年人接受了三个月的素食或杂食饮食。

paras.en: During the trial, they also partook in resistance training three times a week, with exercises including leg presses, squats, chest presses, lat pulldowns, arm pulls, and abdominal exercises.
paras.zh: 试验期间，他们还每周参加3次阻力训练，练习内容包括腿推、深蹲、推胸、背阔肌下拉、手臂拉和腹部练习。

paras.en: Each participant was counseled on healthy eating plans and how to consume at least 1.2 grams of protein per kilogram of their body weight each day.
paras.zh: 每位参与者都被告知健康饮食计划以及如何每天每公斤体重摄入至少 1.2 克蛋白质。

paras.en: On average, both groups were successful in meeting their daily protein goals – even the vegetarians, who could not eat meat or fish, only dairy, eggs, or plant-based proteins.
paras.zh: 平均而言，两组人都成功地实现了每日蛋白质目标——即使是素食者，他们不能吃肉或鱼，只能吃奶制品、鸡蛋或植物性蛋白质。

paras.en: By the end of the trial, muscle strength and physical performance improved in both groups, with no significant difference between vegetarians and meat eaters.
paras.zh: 试验结束时，两组的肌肉力量和身体机能都有所改善，素食者和肉食者之间没有显着差异。

paras.en: On leg presses, participants could lift more weight, and on chair stands, they stood up faster than they did when the trial first started.
paras.zh: 在腿部推举中，参与者可以举起更多的重量，在椅子支架上，他们站起来的速度比试验刚开始时更快。

paras.en: But there was one key difference between the groups.
paras.zh: 但两组之间有一个关键的区别。

paras.en: Muscle mass in the legs and arms increased in both vegetarians and omnivores during the trial, but omnivores showed about 70 percent more gains (+0.66 kilograms, compared to +0.38 kg for vegetarians).
paras.zh: 在试验期间，素食者和杂食者的腿部和手臂肌肉质量均有所增加，但杂食者的肌肉质量增加了约 70%（增加了 0.66 公斤，而素食者则增加了 0.38 公斤）。

paras.en: It is not clear whether this is due to lower protein intake by vegetarians, or something about the quality of dietary protein provided by meat and other animal-based foods.
paras.zh: 目前尚不清楚这是由于素食者蛋白质摄入量较低，还是与肉类和其他动物性食品提供的膳食蛋白质质量有关。

paras.en: Interestingly, the study found that vegetarians who ate more protein tended to gain more muscle, whereas meat eaters who ate more protein didn't.
paras.zh: 有趣的是，研究发现，吃更多蛋白质的素食者往往会获得更多的肌肉，而吃更多蛋白质的肉食者则不然。

paras.en: "The omnivorous group likely reached a saturating protein threshold where additional intake yielded no further anabolic benefit," the authors hypothesize.
paras.zh: 作者推测：“杂食性群体可能达到了饱和蛋白质阈值，额外摄入不会产生进一步的合成代谢益处。”

paras.en: Nutrition is a highly complex area of research subject to lifestyle, behavioral, genetic, social, and environmental factors too numerous to count.
paras.zh: 营养是一个高度复杂的研究领域，受到生活方式、行为、遗传、社会和环境因素无数的影响。

paras.en: This particular cohort of older adults was predominantly White, healthy, and highly educated. It is unclear if these findings are relevant to others.
paras.zh: 这个特殊的老年人群体主要是白人、健康且受过高等教育。目前尚不清楚这些发现是否与其他发现相关。

paras.en: Still, the results join other recent studies suggesting that vegetarian diets, as long as they provide enough calories and essential nutrients, can be associated with lives as long and as healthy as those of meat eaters.
paras.zh: 尽管如此，这些结果与最近的其他研究相结合，表明素食饮食只要提供足够的热量和必需营养素，就可以与肉食者一样长寿和健康。

paras.en: Research like this is a good reminder that eating enough protein in older age is important, especially for vegetarians.
paras.zh: 这样的研究很好地提醒我们，在老年时摄入足够的蛋白质很重要，尤其是对于素食者来说。

paras.en: "The suitability of a more plant-based diet may depend on individual context," the authors of the new study conclude.
paras.zh: 这项新研究的作者总结道：“以植物为主的饮食是否适合可能取决于个人情况。”

paras.en: "For people with low appetite or low energy intake, extra focus on meeting protein targets and ensuring protein quality is likely needed to maintain muscle mass, which is particularly important for older adults."
paras.zh: “对于食欲低下或能量摄入低的人来说，可能需要额外关注达到蛋白质目标并确保蛋白质质量以维持肌肉质量，这对老年人尤其重要。”

paras.en: The research has been published in the American Journal of Clinical Nutrition.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《美国临床营养学杂志》上。

articles.title: A Distinct New Type of Diabetes Has Officially Been Recognized
articles.author: Carly Cassella

paras.en: After decades of controversy, the International Diabetes Federation (IDF) officially recognized a fifth form of diabetes in 2025.
paras.zh: 经过数十年的争议，国际糖尿病联盟 (IDF) 于 2025 年正式承认第五种糖尿病。

paras.en: It's now urging other health authorities, like the World Health Organization (WHO), to follow suit.
paras.zh: 它现在敦促世界卫生组织（WHO）等其他卫生当局效仿。

paras.en: Type 5 diabetes is rarely discussed or researched, and yet it is thought to impact up to 25 million people worldwide, especially those in low- and middle-income nations where access to medical care is limited.
paras.zh: 5 型糖尿病很少被讨论或研究，但人们认为它影响着全世界多达 2500 万人，特别是那些获得医疗服务有限的低收入和中等收入国家的人。

paras.en: It was first described in 1955 in Jamaica, then forgotten about for many years. Even once it was acknowledged by the WHO in the 1980s, the diagnosis created controversy.
paras.zh: 它于 1955 年在牙买加首次被描述，随后被遗忘多年。即使在 20 世纪 80 年代被世界卫生组织承认后，这一诊断仍然引起了争议。

paras.en: For going on seven decades, scientists have debated whether type 5 diabetes exists at all, and in 1999, WHO withdrew the classification due to a lack of evidence. There has been little agreement on how to diagnose type 5 diabetes or how to treat it.
paras.zh: 七十年来，科学家们一直在争论 5 型糖尿病是否存在，1999 年，世界卫生组织因缺乏证据而撤销了这一分类。关于如何诊断 5 型糖尿病或如何治疗它，目前尚未达成一致意见。

paras.en: Type 1 diabetes is an autoimmune condition that destroys the pancreas's ability to produce insulin. Type 2 diabetes is an insensitivity to insulin due to diet and lifestyle. Type 3c diabetes is commonly caused by damage to the pancreas. Gestational diabetes is triggered by hormonal changes during pregnancy.
paras.zh: 1 型糖尿病是一种自身免疫性疾病，会破坏胰腺产生胰岛素的能力。 2型糖尿病是由于饮食和生活方式而对胰岛素不敏感。 3c 型糖尿病通常是由胰腺损伤引起的。妊娠期糖尿病是由怀孕期间荷尔蒙的变化引发的。

paras.en: Type 5 diabetes seems to stem from nutrient deficiency. Previously known as malnutrition-related diabetes mellitus (MRDM), this form of diabetes is commonly misdiagnosed as other types.
paras.zh: 5 型糖尿病似乎源于营养缺乏。这种糖尿病以前被称为营养不良相关糖尿病 (MRDM)，通常被误诊为其他类型。

paras.en: And yet, because insulin resistance does not seem to be the primary cause of type 5 diabetes, existing treatments may not help. In fact, they may even harm.
paras.zh: 然而，由于胰岛素抵抗似乎并不是 5 型糖尿病的主要原因，现有的治疗方法可能无济于事。事实上，它们甚至可能造成伤害。

paras.en: Watch the clip below for a summary of the announcement:
paras.zh: 观看下面的剪辑，了解该公告的摘要：

paras.en: "Understanding the specific types of diabetes someone has is crucial to providing the right treatment," Craig Beall, a diabetes researcher at the University of Exeter, explained in May 2025.
paras.zh: 埃克塞特大学糖尿病研究人员克雷格·比尔 (Craig Beall) 于 2025 年 5 月解释说：“了解某人所患糖尿病的具体类型对于提供正确的治疗至关重要。”

paras.en: For years now, Meredith Hawkins, an endocrinologist at the Albert Einstein College of Medicine's Global Diabetes Institute, has called for global recognition of type 5 diabetes, which typically impacts people in Asia and Africa who are experiencing severe food insecurity.
paras.zh: 多年来，阿尔伯特·爱因斯坦医学院全球糖尿病研究所的内分泌学家梅雷迪思·霍金斯一直呼吁全球对 5 型糖尿病的认识，这种糖尿病通常会影响亚洲和非洲面临严重粮食不安全的人们。

paras.en: "Malnutrition-related diabetes is more common than tuberculosis and nearly as common as HIV/ AIDS, but the lack of an official name has hindered efforts to diagnose patients or find effective therapies," Hawkins said in 2025.
paras.zh: “与营养不良相关的糖尿病比肺结核更常见，几乎与艾滋病毒/艾滋病一样常见，但缺乏正式名称阻碍了诊断患者或寻找有效疗法的努力，”霍金斯在 2025 年表示。

paras.en: "I'm hopeful that this formal recognition as type 5 diabetes will lead to progress against this long-neglected disease that severely debilitates people and is often fatal."
paras.zh: “我希望，对 5 型糖尿病的正式认可将导致在对抗这种长期被忽视的疾病方面取得进展，这种疾病严重削弱人们的能力，并且往往是致命的。”

paras.en: In recent years, numerous animal and human studies have shown that chronic nutrient deficiencies can have lifelong impacts on the pancreas, disrupting its ability to secrete insulin and balance blood sugar levels.
paras.zh: 近年来，大量动物和人类研究表明，慢性营养缺乏会对胰腺产生终生影响，破坏其分泌胰岛素和平衡血糖水平的能力。

paras.en: Hawkins' own work, published in 2022, was the first to establish a unique metabolic profile for this with malnutrition-related diabetes.
paras.zh: Hawkins 自己的研究成果于 2022 年发表，首次针对营养不良相关的糖尿病建立了独特的代谢特征。

paras.en: She and her colleagues ran a small trial in south India, which showed people with MRDM are insulin-deficient like people with type 1 diabetes, but not to the same degree, and still sensitive to insulin, unlike people with type 2 diabetes who develop resistance.
paras.zh: 她和她的同事在印度南部进行了一项小型试验，结果显示 MRDM 患者与 1 型糖尿病患者一样缺乏胰岛素，但程度不同，并且仍然对胰岛素敏感，这与产生耐药性的 2 型糖尿病患者不同。

paras.en: "Type 5 diabetes stands apart with its unique pathogenesis, theorized to involve compromised pancreatic development resulting from extended periods of nutritional insufficiency," Rahul Garg, a physician at F.H. Medical College and Hospital in India, wrote in a recent review.
paras.zh: 印度 F.H. 医学院和医院的医生 Rahul Garg 在最近的一篇评论中写道：“5 型糖尿病因其独特的发病机制而与众不同，理论上与长期营养不足导致的胰腺发育受损有关。”

paras.en: In light of this evidence, the IDF is making a concerted effort to at last recognize type 5 diabetes.
paras.zh: 鉴于这一证据，IDF 正在齐心协力，最终识别 5 型糖尿病。

paras.en: Some researchers have said the move is "long overdue", while others argue that it is "unwarranted" due to "diagnostic uncertainty" stemming from the variety of diabetes cases seemingly related to malnutrition.
paras.zh: 一些研究人员表示，此举“早就应该”，而另一些研究人员则认为，此举“没有根据”，因为各种糖尿病病例似乎与营养不良有关，导致“诊断不确定性”。

paras.en: Some say the number of patients with type 5 diabetes is growing; others say its prevalence is receding. Either way, it's all tied up in whether the condition is properly diagnosed and recognized.
paras.zh: 有人说，5 型糖尿病患者的数量正在增加；有人说，5 型糖尿病患者的数量正在增加。其他人则表示其流行率正在下降。不管怎样，这都取决于这种情况是否得到正确的诊断和识别。

paras.en: Without a formal name and recognition, it's challenging to fund research, and without further evidence, it's impossible to know enough about a condition to formulate a standard diagnosis or to say how many people it affects.
paras.zh: 如果没有正式的名称和认可，资助研究就很困难，而且如果没有进一步的证据，就不可能对某种疾病有足够的了解来制定标准诊断或说出它影响了多少人。

paras.en: In 2025, the IDF established a type 5 diabetes working group, with Hawkins as chair, to develop formal diagnostic criteria and therapeutic guidelines for type 5 diabetes; establish a global research registry; and create training for healthcare professionals.
paras.zh: 2025年，IDF成立了5型糖尿病工作组，由霍金斯担任主席，制定正式的5型糖尿病诊断标准和治疗指南；建立全球研究登记处；并为医疗保健专业人员提供培训。

paras.en: The distinct metabolic profile of type 5 diabetes means treating doctors need to tread a fine line when managing patients' insulin levels.
paras.zh: 5 型糖尿病独特的代谢特征意味着治疗医生在管理患者的胰岛素水平时需要谨慎行事。

paras.en: People with type 5 diabetes might only need minimal amounts of supplementary insulin or require alternative approaches to stimulate insulin secretion, to avoid insulin levels plummeting or spiking dangerously.
paras.zh: 5 型糖尿病患者可能只需要最少量的补充胰岛素，或者需要其他方法来刺激胰岛素分泌，以避免胰岛素水平急剧下降或危险上升。

paras.en: "Inappropriate insulin treatment could induce hypoglycemia [low blood sugar levels], which can be a particular risk in settings with food insecurity and where glucose monitoring might not be affordable," Hawkins and colleagues explained, in a review published after type 5 diabetes was formally recognized.
paras.zh: 霍金斯及其同事在正式承认 5 型糖尿病后发表的一篇评论中解释说：“不适当的胰岛素治疗可能会导致低血糖，这在粮食不安全和血糖监测可能无法负担的环境中可能是一个特殊的风险。”

paras.en: The issue isn't confined to Asia and Africa, either. Undernourishment is a growing problem in parts of Latin America and the Caribbean, where a complicated mix of environmental, political, and economic factors is magnifying health inequalities and extreme poverty.
paras.zh: 这个问题也不只限于亚洲和非洲。在拉丁美洲和加勒比地区，营养不良是一个日益严重的问题，环境、政治和经济因素的复杂组合正在加剧健康不平等和极端贫困。

paras.en: "There is no quick fix, and so we expect the fight against this disease to require substantial further research and advocacy," said Hawkins in an interview.
paras.zh: 霍金斯在接受采访时表示：“没有快速解决办法，因此我们预计对抗这种疾病需要进一步大量研究和宣传。”

paras.en: "Once you have seen young patients dying from inappropriate treatment of a neglected form of diabetes, there's no turning back."
paras.zh: “一旦你看到年轻患者因被忽视的糖尿病治疗不当而死亡，就没有回头路了。”

articles.title: Mounting Evidence Shows a Common Plastic Chemical Can Affect Human Ovaries
articles.author: Jess Cockerill

paras.en: A class of chemicals called phthalates is widespread in our lives, and there are growing concerns about what impact they're having on our reproductive health.
paras.zh: 一类叫做邻苯二甲酸盐的化学物质在我们的生活中广泛存在，人们越来越担心它们对我们的生殖健康产生的影响。

paras.en: The most common phthalate – DEHP (di-2-ethylhexyl phthalate) – is usually added to materials to make them more flexible. It's used in PVC pipes, cling wrap, shower curtains, medical tubing, eyelash glue, and many other everyday items.
paras.zh: 最常见的邻苯二甲酸酯——DEHP（邻苯二甲酸二-2-乙基己酯）——通常添加到材料中以使其更加柔韧。它用于 PVC 管、保鲜膜、浴帘、医用管、睫毛胶和许多其他日常用品。

paras.en: It can easily get into our bodies, particularly if it's in our food or water, since it's readily absorbed through the lining of the intestines. When DEHP enters the human body, our enzymes convert it to MEHP (mono-(2-ethylhexyl) phthalate).
paras.zh: 它很容易进入我们的身体，特别是在我们的食物或水中，因为它很容易通过肠道内壁吸收。当 DEHP 进入人体时，我们的酶会将其转化为 MEHP（邻苯二甲酸单（2-乙基己基）酯）。

paras.en: Many in vitro and animal studies have also demonstrated that this byproduct can disrupt the endocrine system, potentially affecting fertility.
paras.zh: 许多体外和动物研究也表明，这种副产物会扰乱内分泌系统，可能影响生育能力。

paras.en: New research published in eBioMedicine adds to this picture by mapping out how MEHP exposure affects the cellular machinery of human ovarian tissue.
paras.zh: 发表在《eBioMedicine》上的新研究通过绘制 MEHP 暴露如何影响人类卵巢组织的细胞机制，进一步丰富了这一图景。

paras.en: The study was conducted by a team from the Karolinska Institute and its affiliated hospital in Sweden.
paras.zh: 这项研究是由瑞典卡罗林斯卡学院及其附属医院的一个团队进行的。

paras.en: Restrictions on the use of DEHP vary widely from country to country.
paras.zh: 各国对 DEHP 使用的限制差异很大。

paras.en: Generally, restrictions apply to children's toys, but policy relating to its use in medical equipment, cosmetics, food packaging, and household items is inconsistent, due to uncertainty around how harmful it really is.
paras.zh: 一般来说，限制适用于儿童玩具，但由于其真正危害程度的不确定性，有关其在医疗设备、化妆品、食品包装和家居用品中使用的政策并不一致。

paras.en: These products offer a lot of convenience, make people a lot of money, and in the case of medical equipment, can save lives, so scientists will need to present strong evidence of harm that outweighs these benefits if DEHP is to be restricted more widely.
paras.zh: 这些产品提供了很多便利，让人们赚了很多钱，并且就医疗设备而言，可以挽救生命，因此如果要更广泛地限制 DEHP，科学家将需要提供强有力的证据来证明危害大于这些好处。

paras.en: Prior research in this area has focused on the egg-producing follicles, since these are the ovarian cells directly involved in reproduction.
paras.zh: 该领域的先前研究主要集中在产生卵子的卵泡上，因为这些是直接参与生殖的卵巢细胞。

paras.en: But the follicles can't pump out an egg without the help of the many other kinds of cells that surround and support them. We need to understand how MEHP affects these non-follicular cells, too.
paras.zh: 但是，如果没有周围和支持卵泡的许多其他类型的细胞的帮助，卵泡就无法排出卵子。我们还需要了解 MEHP 如何影响这些非滤泡细胞。

paras.en: "Our results show that phthalates affect considerably more cell types in the ovary than the egg cells and follicles that have traditionally been the focus of research," says reproductive biologist Pauliina Damdimopoulou, the study's senior author.
paras.zh: 该研究的资深作者、生殖生物学家 Pauliina Damdimopoulou 表示：“我们的研究结果表明，邻苯二甲酸盐对卵巢中的细胞类型的影响远多于传统上研究重点的卵细胞和卵泡。”

paras.en: "The most unexpected finding was that cells from the ovary's nervous system appeared to be particularly sensitive to the exposure."
paras.zh: “最出乎意料的发现是，卵巢神经系统的细胞似乎对暴露特别敏感。”

paras.en: To arrive at these conclusions, the team experimented on ovarian tissue samples from seven individuals. Five of these donors donated the tissue as part of gender-affirming ovary removal; the other two donors' tissues were collected as a biopsy during elective cesarean section.
paras.zh: 为了得出这些结论，研究小组对七个人的卵巢组织样本进行了实验。其中五名捐赠者捐赠了组织，作为性别确认卵巢切除的一部分；另外两名捐献者的组织是在选择性剖腹产时收集的活检样本。

paras.en: None of these donors had a history of ovarian disease, and none were current smokers (though a few had a history).
paras.zh: 这些捐赠者中没有一个有卵巢疾病史，也没有一个是当前吸烟者（尽管少数有历史）。

paras.en: The donors who were undergoing gender-affirming surgery had also been on androgen therapy for three to eight years, which can sometimes cause changes to the ovaries similar to women with PMOS. As such, their ovarian tissue may not be totally representative of the general population.
paras.zh: 接受性别确认手术的捐赠者也接受了三到八年的雄激素治疗，这有时会导致卵巢发生类似于患有 PMOS 的女性的变化。因此，他们的卵巢组织可能不能完全代表一般人群。

paras.en: But donated human ovarian tissue is difficult to come by: presumably, not many women with healthy ovaries are volunteering to give them up.
paras.zh: 但捐赠的人类卵巢组织很难获得：想必没有多少拥有健康卵巢的女性自愿放弃它们。

paras.en: For many valid ethical reasons, studies like this one are about as close as medical research can get to experimenting directly on humans.
paras.zh: 出于许多合理的伦理原因，像这样的研究几乎是医学研究中最接近直接在人体上进行实验的研究。

paras.en: Once removed from a donor's body, the researchers grew the ovarian tissue in a lab. The samples spanned a wide variety of ovarian cells: oocytes, granulosa cells, stromal cells, perivascular cells, endothelial cells, immune cells, and glial cells.
paras.zh: 一旦从捐献者体内取出卵巢组织，研究人员就在实验室中培养卵巢组织。这些样本涵盖多种卵巢细胞：卵母细胞、颗粒细胞、基质细胞、血管周围细胞、内皮细胞、免疫细胞和神经胶质细胞。

paras.en: Each sample was exposed to one of three treatments across six days: one group was treated with an MEHP-free chemical solvent, for comparison; the other two were exposed to either 20.51 nanomoles per liter (nM) or 20.51 × 1000 nM of MEHP.
paras.zh: 每个样品在六天内接受三种处理中的一种：一组使用不含 MEHP 的化学溶剂进行处理，以进行比较；一组使用不含 MEHP 的化学溶剂进行处理，以进行比较；另外两个暴露于 20.51 纳摩尔每升 (nM) 或 20.51 × 1000 nM MEHP。

paras.en: The 20.51 nM dose, the authors note, is an 'epidemiologically relevant' concentration, meaning it's a more realistic exposure level.
paras.zh: 作者指出，20.51 nM 剂量是一个“流行病学相关”浓度，这意味着它是一个更现实的暴露水平。

paras.en: The team conducted single-cell sequencing to get a detailed picture of how one donor's tissue responded to MEHP exposure. This donor was a 23-year-old who had undergone gender-affirming oophorectomy.
paras.zh: 该团队进行了单细胞测序，以详细了解捐献者的组织对 MEHP 暴露的反应。这位捐赠者是一名 23 岁的人，接受了性别确认卵巢切除术。

paras.en: Across all seven cell types, gene expression was significantly different between the control treatment and the MEHP exposure groups, which suggests the phthalate byproduct can change the normal function of cells (though scientists will need to replicate this in tissue from many more individuals to know if human cells generally respond in this way).
paras.zh: 在所有七种细胞类型中，对照治疗组和 MEHP 暴露组之间的基因表达存在显着差异，这表明邻苯二甲酸盐副产品可以改变细胞的正常功能（尽管科学家需要在更多个体的组织中复制这一点，以了解人类细胞是否通常以这种方式做出反应）。

paras.en: In most cells, the gene expression difference seemed to follow a dose-dependent pattern: higher MEHP exposure meant a greater number of differentially-expressed genes.
paras.zh: 在大多数细胞中，基因表达差异似乎遵循剂量依赖性模式：较高的 MEHP 暴露意味着更多数量的差异表达基因。

paras.en: It disrupted pathways related to maintaining cell structure, adhesion, and oxidative phosphorylation, which is a crucial step in how cells generate energy.
paras.zh: 它破坏了与维持细胞结构、粘附和氧化磷酸化相关的途径，而氧化磷酸化是细胞产生能量的关键步骤。

paras.en: But in glial cells, nervous-system cells that have only recently been discovered in ovaries, the number of differentially-expressed genes wasn't all that different between MEHP concentrations. The researchers say this could indicate that glial cells are particularly sensitive to MEHP exposure.
paras.zh: 但在神经胶质细胞（最近才在卵巢中发现的神经系统细胞）中，MEHP 浓度之间差异表达基因的数量并没有那么大的差异。研究人员表示，这可能表明神经胶质细胞对 MEHP 暴露特别敏感。

paras.en: MEHP exposure also reduced the ability of cells to communicate with each other, with a greater effect at a higher dose.
paras.zh: MEHP 暴露还会降低细胞相互通讯的能力，剂量越高效果越显着。

paras.en: "Taken together, current evidence indicates that phthalates disrupt human ovarian function at epidemiologically relevant concentrations, extending beyond the follicular compartment," the authors conclude.
paras.zh: “总而言之，目前的证据表明，邻苯二甲酸盐在流行病学相关浓度下会破坏人类卵巢功能，并延伸到卵泡室之外，”作者总结道。

paras.en: "In particular, the observed susceptibility of glial cells to MEHP offers new modes of action for environmental chemical-mediated disruption of ovarian biology and may explain reported links between phthalate exposure and polycystic ovaries.
paras.zh: “特别是，观察到的神经胶质细胞对 MEHP 的敏感性为环境化学介导的卵巢生物学破坏提供了新的作用模式，并可能解释所报道的邻苯二甲酸盐暴露与多囊卵巢之间的联系。

paras.en: "These findings should encourage ovarian toxicity research to expand its focus beyond follicles and guide chemical safety testing accordingly."
paras.zh: “这些发现应该鼓励卵巢毒性研究将其重点扩展到卵泡之外，并相应地指导化学安全测试。”

paras.en: The research has been published in eBioMedicine.
paras.zh: 该研究已发表在《eBioMedicine》上。

articles.title: NASA astronauts splash down after 100 million miles in space

paras.en: NASA astronauts splash down after 100 million miles in space
paras.zh: NASA 宇航员在太空飞行 1 亿英里后溅落

paras.en: - NASAâs SpaceX Crew-12 astronauts have returned to Earth after 237 days in space, traveling more than 100 million miles and completing over 3,792 orbits while conducting research to prepare for future missions to the Moon and Mars. The mission also made history with record-setting spacewalk achievements and experiments that could transform medicine both in space and on Earth.
paras.zh: - NASA 的 SpaceX Crew-12 宇航员在太空飞行 237 天后返回地球，飞行超过 1 亿英里，完成超过 3,792 圈轨道，同时进行研究，为未来的月球和火星任务做准备。这次任务还创造了历史，创造了创纪录的太空行走成就和实验，这些成就和实验可以改变太空和地球上的医学。

paras.en: After spending more than seven months aboard the International Space Station, NASA's SpaceX Crew-12 astronauts have safely returned to Earth. Their spacecraft splashed down Thursday in the Pacific Ocean near Los Angeles, bringing an extraordinary mission to a close.
paras.zh: 在国际空间站度过七个多月后，NASA 的 SpaceX Crew-12 宇航员已安全返回地球。他们的飞船周四在洛杉矶附近的太平洋上溅落，结束了一项非凡的任务。

paras.en: The four astronauts spent 237 days in orbit, traveled more than 100 million miles, and completed thousands of trips around Earth while carrying out scientific experiments that could help shape future missions to the Moon and Mars.
paras.zh: 这四名宇航员在轨道上度过了 237 天，飞行了超过 1 亿英里，完成了数千次绕地球飞行，同时进行了有助于塑造未来月球和火星任务的科学实验。

paras.en: NASA will host a news conference at 3:30 p.m. EDT on Thursday, Oct. 15, at Johnson Space Center in Houston, where returning crew members will discuss their experiences and research accomplishments.
paras.zh: NASA 将于下午 3:30 召开新闻发布会。美国东部时间 10 月 15 日星期四，休斯敦约翰逊航天中心，返回的宇航员将在那里讨论他们的经历和研究成果。

paras.en: "Jessica, Jack, Sophie, and Andrey spent 237 days living and working in orbit, traveled more than 100 million miles, advanced important science, and returned safely home because of the extraordinary expertise and competence of thousands across NASA, SpaceX, and our international partners," said NASA Administrator Jared Isaacman. "Building the capability, experience, and confidence to do this repeatedly is exactly what will allow us to go farther, and I am grateful to Crew-12 and their families for their service to humanity's greatest adventure."
paras.zh: NASA 局长贾里德·艾萨克曼 (Jared Isaacman) 表示：“杰西卡、杰克、索菲和安德烈在轨道上生活和工作了 237 天，行程超过 1 亿英里，推进了重要的科学发展，并安全返回家园，这得益于 NASA、SpaceX 和我们的国际合作伙伴数千人的非凡专业知识和能力。” “建立重复执行此操作的能力、经验和信心正是让我们走得更远的原因，我感谢 Crew-12 及其家人为人类最伟大的冒险所做的贡献。”

paras.en: NASA Astronauts Return After 237 Days and 100 Million Miles
paras.zh: NASA 宇航员历经 237 天、飞行 1 亿英里后返回

paras.en: The returning crew included NASA astronauts Jessica Meir and Jack Hathaway, ESA (European Space Agency) astronaut Sophie Adenot, and Roscosmos cosmonaut Andrey Fedyaev.
paras.zh: 返回的机组人员包括美国宇航局宇航员杰西卡·梅尔和杰克·海瑟薇、欧空局（欧洲航天局）宇航员索菲·阿德诺特和俄罗斯航天局宇航员安德烈·费德亚耶夫。

paras.en: Their spacecraft touched down in the Pacific at 8:34 a.m. PDT. SpaceX recovery teams aboard specialized vessels reached the capsule shortly afterward and brought the astronauts and spacecraft aboard.
paras.zh: 他们的飞船于太平洋夏令时间上午 8 点 34 分降落在太平洋。不久之后，SpaceX 的回收小组乘坐专门的船只到达了太空舱，并将宇航员和航天器带上太空。

paras.en: Following routine medical evaluations, the crew members will be transported to shore before traveling to NASA's Johnson Space Center in Houston.
paras.zh: 经过例行医疗评估后，机组人员将被送往岸上，然后前往美国宇航局位于休斯敦的约翰逊航天中心。

paras.en: "NASA's activities supporting the International Space Station -- transporting crew, conducting impactful research, and maintaining critical national assets -- enable the science, engineering, and risk‑reduction needed for future missions across the solar system," said Dana Weigel, manager of NASA's Low Earth Orbit Program at the agency's Johnson Space Center. "We're grateful for the dedication across the human spaceflight team that makes this possible, and we're thrilled to welcome Jessica, Jack, Sophie, and Andrey home."
paras.zh: “美国宇航局支持国际空间站的活动——运送宇航员、进行有影响力的研究和维护重要的国家资产——为未来跨太阳系的任务提供了所需的科学、工程和风险降低，”美国宇航局约翰逊航天中心近地轨道项目经理达纳·韦格尔说。 “我们感谢载人航天团队的奉献精神，使这一切成为可能，我们很高兴欢迎杰西卡、杰克、索菲和安德烈回家。”

paras.en: Over the course of their 237-day stay, the astronauts circled Earth more than 3,792 times, accumulating over 100 million miles of travel.
paras.zh: 在 237 天的停留期间，宇航员绕地球飞行超过 3,792 圈，累计飞行里程超过 1 亿英里。

paras.en: For Meir and Fedyaev, Crew-12 marked their second journey into space. Hathaway and Adenot, meanwhile, completed their first space missions.
paras.zh: 对于 Meir 和 Fedyaev 来说，Crew-12 标志着他们的第二次太空之旅。与此同时，海瑟薇和阿德诺完成了他们的首次太空任务。

paras.en: The crew launched on Feb. 13 at 5:15 a.m. EST, reaching and docking with the International Space Station the following day.
paras.zh: 宇航员于美国东部时间 2 月 13 日凌晨 5 点 15 分发射升空，并于次日抵达国际空间站并对接。

paras.en: Space Station Experiments Could Help Future Moon and Mars Missions
paras.zh: 空间站实验可以帮助未来的月球和火星任务

paras.en: Beyond the remarkable distance traveled, Crew-12 devoted hundreds of hours to scientific investigations designed to support future human exploration and improve life on Earth.
paras.zh: 除了非凡的飞行距离之外，Crew-12 还投入了数百个小时进行科学研究，旨在支持未来的人类探索和改善地球上的生活。

paras.en: One research project explored ways to produce stem cells in space for potential use in cell-based medical treatments. Another demonstrated technology capable of producing IV fluids on demand, an ability that could become especially valuable during long-duration missions far from Earth.
paras.zh: 一项研究项目探索了在太空中生产干细胞的方法，以用于细胞医学治疗。另一项展示的技术能够按需生产静脉输液，这种能力在远离地球的长期任务中可能变得特别有价值。

paras.en: The astronauts also investigated how pneumonia-causing bacteria may contribute to lasting heart damage. Understanding this relationship could offer new insights into cardiovascular health.
paras.zh: 宇航员还研究了引起肺炎的细菌如何导致持久的心脏损伤。了解这种关系可以为心血管健康提供新的见解。

paras.en: Other experiments focused on nutrition in space and how individual physical characteristics may influence blood flow during spaceflight. These studies could help researchers better understand the health risks astronauts face during extended stays in microgravity.
paras.zh: 其他实验的重点是太空中的营养以及个体身体特征如何影响太空飞行期间的血流。这些研究可以帮助研究人员更好地了解宇航员在微重力下长时间停留期间面临的健康风险。

paras.en: Together, the investigations provide valuable information about keeping humans healthy beyond Earth while testing technologies that may eventually support crewed expeditions to the Moon and Mars.
paras.zh: 这些调查共同提供了有关在地球以外保持人类健康的宝贵信息，同时测试了最终可能支持载人月球和火星探险的技术。

paras.en: Historic Spacewalks Mark Crew-12 Mission
paras.zh: 历史性太空行走 Mark Crew-12 任务

paras.en: The mission also included significant milestones outside the space station.
paras.zh: 这次任务还包括空间站外的重要里程碑。

paras.en: Meir carried out four spacewalks during Crew-12, raising her career total to seven. That achievement places her third among NASA women for the most career spacewalks, behind former astronauts Peggy Whitson and Suni Williams.
paras.zh: 梅尔在 Crew-12 期间进行了四次太空行走，使她的职业生涯太空行走总数达到七次。这一成就使她在美国宇航局职业太空行走次数最多的女性中排名第三，仅次于前宇航员佩吉·惠特森和苏尼·威廉姆斯。

paras.en: Adenot also reached a historic milestone by completing three spacewalks. In doing so, she became the first French woman to venture outside the International Space Station.
paras.zh: 阿德诺还完成了三次太空行走，达到了历史性的里程碑。在此过程中，她成为第一位在国际空间站外冒险的法国女性。

paras.en: With Crew-12 safely back on Earth, NASA has completed another extended mission that combined scientific research, international cooperation, and human spaceflight experience. The knowledge gained will contribute to preparations for more ambitious journeys beyond Earth's orbit.
paras.zh: 随着 Crew-12 安全返回地球，NASA 完成了另一项结合科学研究、国际合作和载人航天经验的扩展任务。所获得的知识将有助于为更雄心勃勃的地球轨道之外的旅程做准备。

articles.title: A quantum prediction from 1931 just came to life

paras.en: A quantum prediction from 1931 just came to life
paras.zh: 1931 年的量子预测刚刚成为现实

paras.en: - Nearly a century after physicist Hans Bethe predicted them, scientists have created and directly observed unusual quantum states known as âBethe stringsâ in an ultracold gas. By cooling cesium atoms to near absolute zero and trapping them in thousands of tiny one-dimensional tubes, researchers were able to make groups of atoms bind together without ordinary chemical bonds. These strange clusters could contain six or more particles and even collide with one another without falling apart.
paras.zh: - 在物理学家汉斯·贝特（Hans Bethe）预测它们近一个世纪后，科学家们在超冷气体中创造并直接观察到了被称为“贝特弦”的不寻常量子态。通过将铯原子冷却到接近绝对零并将它们捕获在数千个微小的一维管中，研究人员能够使原子团在没有普通化学键的情况下结合在一起。这些奇怪的星团可能包含六个或更多的粒子，甚至相互碰撞而不会散开。

paras.en: Nearly a century after Nobel laureate Hans Bethe predicted their existence, scientists have created and observed unusual quantum structures known as "Bethe strings" using ultracold atoms. The experiment, led by quantum physicist Hanns-Christoph Nägerl, provides researchers with a highly controllable way to explore these unusual quantum many-body states.
paras.zh: 在诺贝尔奖获得者汉斯·贝特预言它们的存在近一个世纪后，科学家们利用超冷原子创造并观察到了被称为“贝特弦”的不寻常的量子结构。该实验由量子物理学家 Hanns-Christoph Nägerl 领导，为研究人员提供了一种高度可控的方法来探索这些不寻常的量子多体态。

paras.en: In 1931, physicist Hans Bethe proposed that particles in certain quantum systems restricted to one dimension could join together into collective states now called Bethe strings. These structures differ fundamentally from familiar molecules. Rather than being connected through chemical bonds, the particles remain bound because of their interactions with one another, and the resulting states can exist only in one dimension.
paras.zh: 1931 年，物理学家汉斯·贝特 (Hans Bethe) 提出，某些仅限于一维的量子系统中的粒子可以结合在一起形成现在称为贝特弦的集体状态。这些结构与熟悉的分子根本不同。粒子不是通过化学键连接，而是由于彼此之间的相互作用而保持束缚，并且所得状态只能存在于一个维度中。

paras.en: For much of the past century, Bethe strings were primarily a theoretical idea. Researchers at the University of Innsbruck have now created and detected these multiparticle bound states in an ultracold gas, working with theory teams from the Department of Experimental Physics at the University of Amsterdam and the Technical University of Munich. The results were published in Nature Communications.
paras.zh: 在上个世纪的大部分时间里，贝特弦主要只是一个理论想法。因斯布鲁克大学的研究人员现已与阿姆斯特丹大学实验物理系和慕尼黑工业大学的理论团队合作，在超冷气体中创建并检测到了这些多粒子束缚态。研究结果发表在《自然通讯》上。

paras.en: Creating Bethe Strings Near Absolute Zero
paras.zh: 创建接近绝对零的贝特弦

paras.en: To produce the unusual quantum states, the researchers started with a cloud of cesium atoms cooled to within only a few billionths of a degree above absolute zero. They then separated the cloud into several thousand extremely narrow tubes.
paras.zh: 为了产生不寻常的量子态，研究人员首先将铯原子云冷却到绝对零以上仅十亿分之几度的范围内。然后他们将云分成数千个极其狭窄的管子。

paras.en: Within each tube, the atoms are effectively restricted to moving along a single direction, creating the one-dimensional environment required for Bethe strings to exist. The researchers can also precisely adjust how strongly the atoms interact.
paras.zh: 在每个管内，原子被有效地限制为沿单一方向移动，从而创造了贝特弦存在所需的一维环境。研究人员还可以精确调整原子相互作用的强度。

paras.en: By changing those interactions from repulsive to attractive, the team caused the atoms to bind together. Rather than simply collapsing into one group, the atoms formed bound states of several different sizes. Some of the larger clusters contained six or more particles.
paras.zh: 通过将这些相互作用从排斥性变为吸引性，研究小组使原子结合在一起。原子不是简单地塌缩成一组，而是形成了几种不同大小的束缚态。一些较大的星团包含六个或更多粒子。

paras.en: The next challenge was demonstrating that these particles were truly bound together.
paras.zh: 下一个挑战是证明这些粒子确实结合在一起。

paras.en: "One of the simplest experiments was to let the strings expand," says Milena Horvath, one of the lead authors.
paras.zh: “最简单的实验之一就是让弦膨胀，”主要作者之一米莱娜·霍瓦斯 (Milena Horvath) 说。

paras.en: The researchers first allowed the atoms to spread out while keeping them trapped inside their one-dimensional tubes. During this expansion, the strings encountered one another and collided, yet the bound structures survived.
paras.zh: 研究人员首先让原子扩散，同时将它们困在一维管内。在这次膨胀过程中，弦彼此相遇并发生碰撞，但束缚结构却幸存下来。

paras.en: "This is a remarkable feature of the strings: they can collide without breaking apart," says Milena Horvath.
paras.zh: “这是弦的一个显着特征：它们可以碰撞而不破裂，”米莱娜·霍瓦斯说。

paras.en: The scientists then performed a second version of the experiment in which they removed the confinement and allowed the atoms to expand freely through three-dimensional space. Because Bethe strings can exist only in one dimension, releasing the atoms into three dimensions caused the bound states to fall apart.
paras.zh: 然后，科学家们进行了第二个版本的实验，他们取消了限制，允许原子在三维空间中自由膨胀。由于贝特弦只能存在于一维，因此将原子释放到三维会导致束缚态瓦解。

paras.en: The energy that had kept the particles bound was then transformed into motion, making the atoms spread apart faster. Comparing the two types of expansion gave the researchers a clear way to identify the presence of Bethe strings.
paras.zh: 然后，使粒子保持束缚的能量转化为运动，使原子更快地分开。比较这两种类型的扩展为研究人员提供了一种明确的方法来识别贝特弦的存在。

paras.en: When the particles were unbound, as they were when the interactions were repulsive, both expansion measurements produced essentially the same energy. When Bethe strings were present, however, the three-dimensional expansion contained extra energy released as the bound states broke apart.
paras.zh: 当粒子未结合时，就像相互作用是排斥的那样，两种膨胀测量产生的能量基本上相同。然而，当贝特弦存在时，三维膨胀包含束缚态破裂时释放的额外能量。

paras.en: A New Laboratory for Quantum Many-Body Physics
paras.zh: 量子多体物理新实验室

paras.en: "Bethe strings were predicted almost a century ago as part of a beautiful mathematical description of quantum many-body systems," says Sudipta Dhar, another lead author. "Now we can create them in the laboratory, manipulate them and make them collide and probe their remarkable collisional stability."
paras.zh: 另一位主要作者苏迪普塔·达尔 (Sudipta Dhar) 表示：“贝斯弦在大约一个世纪前就被预测为量子多体系统美丽数学描述的一部分。” “现在我们可以在实验室中制造它们，操纵它们并使它们发生碰撞并探测它们卓越的碰撞稳定性。”

paras.en: Bethe strings have previously been detected experimentally in solid-state magnetic systems. The new work places these unusual quantum bound states in a very different environment: an ultracold atomic gas where researchers can control the system's geometry, particle density, and interactions with exceptional precision.
paras.zh: 贝特弦之前已在固态磁系统中通过实验检测到。这项新工作将这些不寻常的量子束缚态置于一个非常不同的环境中：研究人员可以在超冷原子气体中以极高的精度控制系统的几何形状、粒子密度和相互作用。

paras.en: "This opens new possibilities for studying how these collective quantum objects form and interact," says lead theorist Alvise Bastianello.
paras.zh: 首席理论家 Alvise Bastianello 表示：“这为研究这些集体量子物体如何形成和相互作用开辟了新的可能性。”

paras.en: The research was funded by the Austrian Science Fund FWF through a Wittgenstein Prize grant, the European Union through an ERC grant, and the UK Engineering and Physical Sciences Research Council. Milena Horvath is a member of the FWF doctoral program Atoms, Light and Molecules (DK-ALM).
paras.zh: 该研究由奥地利科学基金会 FWF 通过维特根斯坦奖资助、欧盟通过 ERC 资助以及英国工程和物理科学研究委员会资助。 Milena Horvath 是 FWF 博士项目原子、光和分子 (DK-ALM) 的成员。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of Innsbruck. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由因斯布鲁克大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

paras.en: - Milena Horvath, Alvise Bastianello, Sudipta Dhar, Rebekka Koch, Yanliang Guo, Jean-SÃ©bastien Caux, Manuele Landini, Hanns-Christoph NÃ¤gerl. Probing Bethe strings in an attractive one-dimensional Bose gas. Nature Communications, 2026; 17 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-76018-0
paras.zh: - Milena Horvath、Alvise Bastianello、Sudipta Dhar、Rebekka Koch、Yanliang Gu、Jean-Sébastien Caux、Manuele Landini、Hanns-Christoph Nägerl。在有吸引力的一维玻色气体中探测贝特弦。自然通讯，2026； 17 (1) DOI: 10.1038/s41467-026-76018-0

articles.title: A 9-billion-year-old signal could help explain dark energy

paras.en: A 9-billion-year-old signal could help explain dark energy
paras.zh: 90亿年前的信号可以帮助解释暗能量

paras.en: - A Canadian radio telescope has detected the faint glow of hydrogen from billions of years ago using only its own observations, proving a long-awaited way to map the distant universe can actually work. CHIME can use this hydrogen signal to trace how matter is spread across space and measure how the universe has expanded over time, offering a powerful new way to investigate dark energy.
paras.zh: - 加拿大射电望远镜仅利用自己的观测就探测到了数十亿年前的微弱氢光，证明了一种期待已久的绘制遥远宇宙地图的方法实际上是可行的。 CHIME 可以利用这种氢信号来追踪物质如何在空间中传播，并测量宇宙如何随着时间的推移而膨胀，从而为研究暗能量提供了一种强大的新方法。

paras.en: For the first time, the Canadian Hydrogen Intensity Mapping Experiment (CHIME) has demonstrated that it can detect the extremely faint radio glow of hydrogen gas from the distant universe using only its own observations.
paras.zh: 加拿大氢强度测绘实验（CHIME）首次证明，它可以仅利用自己的观测来探测来自遥远宇宙的极其微弱的氢气射电辉光。

paras.en: The result could give scientists a faster and less costly way to investigate dark energy, the still mysterious phenomenon believed to be accelerating the expansion of the universe. Understanding dark energy remains one of the biggest unresolved problems in modern physics. The achievement is also an important milestone for CHIME, which was originally designed with this type of measurement in mind. The findings were published in The Astrophysical Journal.
paras.zh: 这一结果可以为科学家提供一种更快、成本更低的方法来研究暗能量，这种仍然神秘的现象被认为正在加速宇宙的膨胀。了解暗能量仍然是现代物理学中尚未解决的最大问题之一。这一成就对于 CHIME 来说也是一个重要的里程碑，CHIME 最初设计时就考虑到了这种类型的测量。研究结果发表在《天体物理学杂志》上。

paras.en: "Hydrogen is the most common element in the universe and the raw material from which stars form," said co-author Dr. Arnab Chakraborty, postdoctoral fellow at the University of Toronto who first proposed the finding. "Its faint radio emission acts like a cosmic tracer, revealing how matter is distributed across space."
paras.zh: “氢是宇宙中最常见的元素，也是恒星形成的原材料，”首次提出这一发现的多伦多大学博士后研究员阿纳布·查克拉博蒂（Arnab Chakraborty）博士说。 “它微弱的无线电发射就像宇宙示踪剂，揭示了物质在空间中的分布情况。”

paras.en: Scientists have proposed competing explanations for the nature of dark energy. Because CHIME can now make these measurements using its own data, researchers can test those ideas independently and gather evidence that could support or challenge existing theories.
paras.zh: 科学家们对暗能量的本质提出了相互竞争的解释。由于 CHIME 现在可以使用自己的数据进行这些测量，因此研究人员可以独立测试这些想法并收集可以支持或挑战现有理论的证据。

paras.en: "This is a completely new technique for probing the cosmos, delivered by an instrument that was conceived, built and funded by Canadians," said co-author Dr. Mark Halpern, professor in the UBC department of physics and astronomy and CHIME principal investigator. "It's a bold new step in the global cosmology program and a Canadian success story."
paras.zh: “这是一种探测宇宙的全新技术，由加拿大人构思、建造和资助的仪器提供，”合著者、UBC 物理和天文学系教授、CHIME 首席研究员 Mark Halpern 博士说。 “这是全球宇宙学计划中大胆的新一步，也是加拿大的成功故事。”

paras.en: CHIME is a radio telescope located near Penticton, British Columbia, and hosted by the National Research Council of Canada (NRC). The instrument surveys the entire northern sky every day.
paras.zh: CHIME 是一座射电望远镜，位于不列颠哥伦比亚省彭蒂克顿附近，由加拿大国家研究委员会 (NRC) 主办。该仪器每天都会观测整个北方天空。

paras.en: The project brings together researchers from across Canada, including scientists at the University of British Columbia, McGill University, the University of Toronto, and the Dominion Radio Astrophysical Observatory (NRC). Other North American collaborators, including Arizona State University, also participate in the effort.
paras.zh: 该项目汇集了来自加拿大各地的研究人员，包括不列颠哥伦比亚大学、麦吉尔大学、多伦多大学和多米尼恩射电天体物理观测站（NRC）的科学家。其他北美合作者，包括亚利桑那州立大学，也参与了这项工作。

paras.en: One of CHIME's main goals is to chart how hydrogen gas was distributed in the earlier universe. By measuring that large-scale structure, astronomers can reconstruct how the universe expanded over time and use those measurements to investigate dark energy.
paras.zh: CHIME 的主要目标之一是绘制氢气在早期宇宙中的分布情况。通过测量这种大规模结构，天文学家可以重建宇宙如何随时间膨胀，并利用这些测量结果来研究暗能量。

paras.en: Until now, CHIME researchers needed to compare their radio observations with galaxy survey data collected by other telescopes. Those surveys address similar cosmological questions by observing light from galaxies in much greater detail. However, they can cost millions of dollars more and mainly probe regions of the universe that are hot and dense enough for stars to form.
paras.zh: 到目前为止，CHIME 研究人员需要将他们的射电观测数据与其他望远镜收集的星系调查数据进行比较。这些调查通过更详细地观察来自星系的光来解决类似的宇宙学问题。然而，它们可能要花费数百万美元，并且主要探测宇宙中温度和密度足以形成恒星的区域。

paras.en: CHIME instead measures the combined radio emission produced by hydrogen itself. That approach allows researchers to examine much larger regions of the cosmos, reach farther back in time and pursue similar questions at a fraction of the cost, without depending on data from other surveys.
paras.zh: CHIME 而是测量氢气本身产生的综合无线电发射。这种方法使研究人员能够检查宇宙中更大的区域，回溯到更早的时间，并以一小部分成本探索类似的问题，而无需依赖其他调查的数据。

paras.en: In an accompanying paper, the researchers analyzed what the newly detected signal can tell scientists about how hydrogen was distributed throughout the universe.
paras.zh: 在随附的一篇论文中，研究人员分析了新检测到的信号可以告诉科学家氢是如何在整个宇宙中分布的。

paras.en: "Our data indicate that roughly two per cent of the hydrogen in the universe was in neutral atomic form at this time, broadly consistent with other measurements," said co-author Dr. Shabbir Shaikh, postdoctoral fellow at Arizona State University. "By measuring how that hydrogen is distributed and clustered, CHIME gives us a new way to test our understanding of how galaxies form and evolve."
paras.zh: “我们的数据表明，此时宇宙中大约百分之二的氢处于中性原子形式，这与其他测量结果大致一致，”共同作者、亚利桑那州立大学博士后沙比尔·谢赫博士说。 “通过测量氢的分布和聚集方式，CHIME 为我们提供了一种新方法来测试我们对星系如何形成和演化的理解。”

paras.en: The measurement therefore offers more than a new way to study cosmic expansion. It can also help researchers test models of galaxy formation and better understand how matter became organized across the universe.
paras.zh: 因此，这项测量提供的不仅仅是一种研究宇宙膨胀的新方法。它还可以帮助研究人员测试星系形成的模型，并更好地了解宇宙中的物质是如何组织的。

paras.en: The discovery did not arrive as a sudden breakthrough. Researchers had to use new data processing and analysis methods to extract the extremely weak hydrogen signal from much stronger sources of interference.
paras.zh: 这一发现并不是一个突然的突破。研究人员必须使用新的数据处理和分析方法，从更强的干扰源中提取极微弱的氢信号。

paras.en: That background included radio noise from the universe itself, signals produced by human technology, and even effects created by the telescope. After identifying the possible hydrogen signature, the team spent more than a year testing it to make sure the result was genuine.
paras.zh: 该背景包括来自宇宙本身的无线电噪声、人类技术产生的信号，甚至是望远镜产生的效果。在确定了可能的氢特征后，该团队花了一年多的时间对其进行测试，以确保结果是真实的。

paras.en: Their analysis ultimately showed that the signal came from hydrogen in the distant universe when the universe was about five billion years old. The result was based on 94 nights of observations collected in 2019.
paras.zh: 他们的分析最终表明，信号来自遥远宇宙中的氢，当时宇宙年龄约为 50 亿年。该结果基于 2019 年收集的 94 个夜晚的观测结果。

paras.en: "We worked very hard to convince ourselves that this wasn't a false alarm," said Dr. Chakraborty. "After all the tests, the signal remained. That gave us confidence we were seeing real hydrogen from the distant universe."
paras.zh: 查克拉博蒂博士说：“我们非常努力地说服自己，这不是虚惊一场。” “在所有测试之后，信号仍然存在。这让我们相信我们看到了来自遥远宇宙的真正的氢。”

paras.en: Seven Years of CHIME Observations Remain
paras.zh: CHIME 观察仍持续七年

paras.en: The new result draws on only a small portion of the information CHIME has gathered since it began operating.
paras.zh: 新结果仅利用了 CHIME 自开始运营以来收集的一小部分信息。

paras.en: Researchers now have nearly seven years of observations available for analysis. They are working to extend the technique farther into cosmic history, with the goal of studying an era when the universe was only three billion years old.
paras.zh: 研究人员现在有近七年的观察结果可供分析。他们正在努力将该技术进一步扩展到宇宙历史，目标是研究宇宙只有三十亿年历史的时代。

paras.en: "For a long time, astrophysicists have believed there is great potential in this hydrogen mapping technique with this kind of telescope. By actually showing that the technique works in practice, we've opened up a whole new window on the universe. We can use it to test our current theories and learn new things about galaxies and other properties of the universe," said co-author Dr. Simon Foreman, assistant professor at Arizona State University.
paras.zh: “长期以来，天体物理学家一直相信这种望远镜的氢测绘技术具有巨大的潜力。通过实际证明该技术在实践中发挥作用，我们为宇宙打开了一个全新的窗口。我们可以用它来测试我们当前的理论，并了解有关星系和宇宙其他特性的新知识，”合著者、亚利桑那州立大学助理教授西蒙·福尔曼博士说。

paras.en: This project is funded by the Canada Foundation for Innovation, the National Research Council of Canada, the Natural Sciences and Engineering Research Council and the provinces of British Columbia, Ontario and Quebec, and supported by the Digital Research Alliance of Canada.
paras.zh: 该项目由加拿大创新基金会、加拿大国家研究委员会、自然科学与工程研究委员会以及不列颠哥伦比亚省、安大略省和魁北克省资助，并得到加拿大数字研究联盟的支持。

paras.en: Materials provided by University of British Columbia. Note: Content may be edited for style and length.
paras.zh: 材料由不列颠哥伦比亚大学提供。注意：内容的风格和长度可能会被编辑。

articles.title: Rethinking risk with electronics for space
articles.author: SpaceNews Editor

paras.en: In this episode, SpaceNews’ Mike Gruss speaks with Ken Stoler, the space business development lead for Arrow. They discuss how spacecraft designers and operators have changed their attitudes toward risk, how the move toward massive megaconstellations has started to impact purchasing behavior in the space supply chain and the challenges and constraints of adding more AI-enabling computing power to spacecraft.
paras.zh: 在本集中，SpaceNews 的 Mike Gruss 与 Arrow 太空业务开发主管 Ken Stoler 进行了交谈。他们讨论了航天器设计者和运营商如何改变对风险的态度，向巨型星座的转变如何开始影响航天供应链中的购买行为，以及为航天器增加更多支持人工智能的计算能力的挑战和限制。

paras.en: Arrow Electronics is a Fortune 500-ranked distributor of electronic components and enterprise computing products that helps thousands of leading manufacturers and service providers turn technology ideas into market-ready solutions. From concept and design through sourcing, integration, manufacturing, and lifecycle management, Arrow comes alongside innovators with deep engineering expertise, comprehensive supply chain services and one of the industry’s most extensive product portfolios. Whether helping enable next-generation aerospace and defense systems, AI-driven applications, industrial automation, robotics platforms or connected devices, Arrow helps its customers accelerate innovation, solve complex design challenges, and bring mission-critical technologies to market faster.
paras.zh: Arrow Electronics 是财富 500 强电子元件和企业计算产品分销商，帮助数千家领先制造商和服务提供商将技术理念转化为市场就绪的解决方案。从概念和设计到采购、集成、制造和生命周期管理，Arrow 与拥有深厚工程专业知识、全面供应链服务和业界最广泛产品组合之一的创新者并肩作战。无论是帮助实现下一代航空航天和国防系统、人工智能驱动的应用、工业自动化、机器人平台还是互联设备，Arrow 都可以帮助客户加速创新、解决复杂的设计挑战，并更快地将关键任务技术推向市场。

paras.en: Space Minds is a new audio and video podcast from SpaceNews that focuses on the inspiring leaders, technologies and exciting opportunities in space.
paras.zh: Space Minds 是 SpaceNews 推出的新音频和视频播客，重点关注太空中鼓舞人心的领导者、技术和令人兴奋的机会。

paras.en: The weekly podcast features compelling interviews with scientists, founders and experts who love to talk about space, covers the news that has enthusiasts daydreaming, and engages with listeners. Join David Ariosto, Mike Gruss and journalists from the SpaceNews team for new episodes every Thursday.
paras.zh: 每周播客对热爱谈论太空的科学家、创始人和专家进行引人注目的采访，报道让爱好者们做白日梦的新闻，并与听众互动。每周四与 David Ariosto、Mike Gruss 和 SpaceNews 团队的记者一起观看新剧集。

paras.en: Watch a new episode every Thursday on SpaceNews.com and on our YouTube, Spotify and Apple channels.
paras.zh: 每周四在 SpaceNews.com 以及我们的 YouTube、Spotify 和 Apple 频道上观看新剧集。

paras.en: Be the first to know when new episodes drop! Enter your email, and we’ll make sure you get exclusive access to each episode as soon as it goes live!
paras.zh: 成为第一个知道新剧集何时发布的人！输入您的电子邮件，我们将确保您在每集上线后立即获得独家访问权限！

paras.en: Note: By registering, you consent to receive communications from SpaceNews and our partners.
paras.zh: 注意：注册即表示您同意接收来自 SpaceNews 和我们合作伙伴的通信。

articles.title: World Space Week 2026 Celebrates the “Rocket Revolution”
articles.author: World Space Week Association

paras.en: HOUSTON, Texas (September 30, 2026)— World Space Week events, beginning October 4 in 100 nations, will celebrate how launch innovation has stimulated the rapidly-growing space economy and enabled new uses of space to help the world.
paras.zh: 德克萨斯州休斯顿（2026 年 9 月 30 日）——世界太空周活动将于 10 月 4 日在 100 个国家开始，庆祝发射创新如何刺激快速增长的太空经济，并实现太空的新用途来帮助世界。

paras.en: “This year’s theme is the Rocket Revolution,” said Dennis Stone, World Space Week Association President. “It recognizes how increased space access and falling launch prices have stimulated the space ecosystem and exciting new space applications,” he said. The rocketry theme will also be used to inspire student interest in STEM, he added.
paras.zh: “今年的主题是火箭革命，”世界太空周协会主席丹尼斯·斯通说。他说：“它认识到太空准入的增加和发射价格的下降如何刺激了太空生态系统并令人兴奋的新太空应用。”他补充说，火箭主题还将用于激发学生对 STEM 的兴趣。

paras.en: Planned World Space Week 2026 activities include:
paras.zh: 2026 年世界空间周计划活动包括：

paras.en: ESA and The Pokémon Company International will celebrate World Space Week 2026 with a Europe-wide family exhibition combining real space science with Pokémon, alongside special Pokémon GO activities at participating museums.
paras.zh: ESA 和 Pokémon Company International 将为庆祝 2026 年世界太空周举办一场欧洲范围内的家庭展览，将真实的太空科学与 Pokémon 相结合，并在参与的博物馆举办特别的 Pokémon GO 活动。

paras.en: NASA Kennedy Space Center Visitor Complex will host a World Space Week Expo featuring Space Shuttle Atlantis, highlighting the Rocket Revolution and its impact on space exploration and access.
paras.zh: 美国宇航局肯尼迪航天中心游客中心将举办世界航天周博览会，以亚特兰蒂斯号航天飞机为主题，突出火箭革命及其对太空探索和进入的影响。

paras.en: Students and rocket clubs around the world will put the Rocket Revolution into action by launching model rockets. In the U.S., enthusiasts will launch Vulcan model rockets provided by United Launch Alliance and Estes.
paras.zh: 世界各地的学生和火箭俱乐部将通过发射模型火箭将火箭革命付诸实践。在美国，爱好者将发射由联合发射联盟和 Estes 提供的 Vulcan 模型火箭。

paras.en: Saudi Arabia’s Ministry of Education and SUPARCO, Pakistan’s national space agency, will lead large-scale national celebrations, with thousands of schools and events engaging students and the public in World Space Week.
paras.zh: 沙特阿拉伯教育部和巴基斯坦国家航天局 SUPARCO 将领导大规模的全国庆祝活动，数千所学校和活动将吸引学生和公众参与世界空间周。

paras.en: UN-declared World Space Week, the largest space event on Earth, last year was celebrated by 50,000 events held by space agencies, schools, aerospace companies, and others according to the Association. World Space Week is held each October 4-10.
paras.zh: 据该协会称，联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，去年由太空机构、学校、航空航天公司和其他机构举办了 50,000 场活动来庆祝。世界空间周于每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行。

paras.en: John Elbon, former ULA Interim CEO, serves as Honorary Chair of World Space Week 2026 to help showcase the launch industry. Tory Bruno, President of Blue Origin National Security, will serve as Honorary Chair in 2027 with the theme “To the Moon.”
paras.zh: ULA 前临时首席执行官 John Elbon 担任 2026 年世界太空周名誉主席，帮助展示发射行业。蓝色起源国家安全总裁托里·布鲁诺 (Tory Bruno) 将担任 2027 年名誉主席，主题为“To the Moon”。

paras.en: “We encourage students and the public to celebrate space in their own way next week as part of the biggest space event in the world,” Stone said. The public can see what’s planned in their area at worldspaceweek.org.
paras.zh: 斯通说：“我们鼓励学生和公众下周以自己的方式庆祝太空，作为世界上最大的太空活动的一部分。”公众可以在 worldspaceweek.org 上查看他们所在地区的计划。

paras.en: The largest space event on Earth, UN-declared World Space Week is celebrated October 4–10 annually. It is an international celebration of the contribution of space science and technology to the betterment of the human condition. World Space Week consists of numerous space-related events held by space agencies, aerospace companies, schools, planetaria, museums, astronomy clubs, and others in a common timeframe to achieve greater student and public impact through synchronization. In 2025, 50,000 events were reported in 102 countries.
paras.zh: 联合国宣布的世界空间周是地球上最大的太空活动，每年 10 月 4 日至 10 日举行庆祝活动。这是一次国际性庆祝空间科学技术对改善人类状况所做贡献的活动。世界空间周由航天机构、航空航天公司、学校、天文馆、博物馆、天文学俱乐部和其他机构在同一时间范围内举办的众多与太空相关的活动组成，以通过同步实现更大的学生和公众影响。 2025 年，102 个国家报告了 50,000 起事件。

paras.en: World Space Week Association is the global coordinator of World Space Week. As an international non-government, non-profit organization, it serves as a permanent observer on the UN Committee on the Peaceful Uses of Outer Space and is supported by voluntary contributions from sponsors including Blue Origin, United Launch Alliance, Texas Instruments, Firefly Aerospace, L3 Harris, BAE Systems, Black Sky, Airbus, Club for the Future, Cesium Astro, Space Foundation, Gaia Horizons, and Space News. The Association was founded in 1982 and is one of the world’s oldest space advocacy organizations.
paras.zh: 世界空间周协会是世界空间周的全球协调机构。作为一个国际非政府、非营利组织，它是联合国和平利用外层空间委员会的常任观察员，并得到了赞助商的自愿捐款支持，这些赞助商包括蓝色起源、联合发射联盟、德州仪器、Firefly Aerospace、L3 Harris、BAE Systems、Black Sky、空客、未来俱乐部、Cesium Astro、太空基金会、Gaia Horizo​​ns 和 Space News。该协会成立于 1982 年，是世界上历史最悠久的太空倡导组织之一。

paras.zh: 丹尼斯·斯通，dstone@worldspaceweek.org（美国）

paras.zh: Alma Okpalefe，aokpalefe@worldspaceweek.org（尼日利亚）
